title_ko: ChatGPT가 한국인 고등학생 영어 학습자의 대학수학능력시험 영어 읽기 과업의 인지 처리 과정에미치는 영향에 관한 시론적 탐색
title_en: Effects of ChatGPT on the cognitive processing of K-CSAT English reading tasks by Korean high school learners: A preliminary study
kw_ko: 대학수학능력시험 영어 읽기; 대화형 인공지능; 프롬프트
kw_en: ChatGPT; KSAT English reading tasks; dialogic artificial intelligence; prompt
abstract_ko: This study aims to investigate how ChatGPT affects the cognitive processing of Korean high school students in the Korean College Scholastic Test (K-CSAT) English reading tasks. Specifically, the study examines how ChatGPT affects learners’ cognitive reading processes (bottom-up, top-down, and interactive) when dealing with three different types of K-CSAT reading tasks, namely, (i) factual information questions (FIQ), (ii) main idea inference questions (MIIQ), and (iii) fill-in-the-blank questions (FITBQ). Three Korean high school students were employed to investigate the effectiveness of the instructional intervention of ChatGPT on the performance of K-CSAT English reading tasks. The main findings are as follows: first, the pedagogical intervention of ChatGPT positively affected learners’ activation of bottom-up processes when answering FIQs in K-CSAT English reading tasks. Second, the instructional intervention of ChatGPT also facilitated learners in performing top-down processes when answering MIIQs. Third, contrary to the previous two findings, the instructional intervention of ChatGPT demonstrated limited effectiveness in the activation of learners’ interactive processes when answering FITBQs. The findings and implications are further explored from the perspective of the incorporation of ChatGPT in meticulously designed language-learning procedures.

title_ko: 챗GPT를 활용한 중등 영어 교수 자료 개발 연구
title_en: A field study on the development of teaching materials for secondary English and its use of ChatGPT
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 인공지능; 영어 교수 자료 개발; 의사소통 기능; 수준별 읽기 자료
kw_en: ChatGPT; artificial intelligence; English language teaching materials; communicative functions; level-based reading materials
abstract_ko: This study explores the potential and limitations of ChatGPT in developing English teaching materials to enhance productive and receptive language skills. Using ChatGPT 3.5, communicative function teaching materials and level-based English reading materials were created, and the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages levels were employed to provide suitable content. The findings reveal the feasibility of ChatGPT-assisted development of both productive and receptive teaching materials. Teachers, however, need to critically and objectively validate ChatGPT-generated results when designing materials. After various validation steps, refinement and improvement of the materials by a teacher is also necessary. These findings offer valuable insights into understanding and recognizing the limitations of ChatGPT in teaching material development. This research contributes to understanding the implications and constraints of employing ChatGPT in creating speaking and reading materials. Further research is needed on various areas that were not investigated in this study. Furthermore, more individualized English learning for students will be possible if additional research is conducted using students who learn English through ChatGPT.

title_ko: 챗GPT의 영어 교육적 활용가능성에 대한 대학 교수자 인식 연구
title_en: A Study on University Professors’ Perception on Educational Applicability of ChatGPT in English Classes
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 인공지능; 교수자 인식; 교육도구; 영어학습챗GPT; 영어학습
kw_en: chatGPT; artificial intelligence(AI); professors’ perception; educational tool; English learning
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 챗GPT을 학습목적으로 활용하는데 있어서 교수자의 인식을 살펴보고 제언하는데 있다. 이를 위하여 충청남도에 소재 대학에서 영어수업을 담당하고 있는 15명의 교수자를 대상으로 온라인 설문을 실시했다. 본 연구의 결과로, 챗GPT의 의미나 개념에 대해 이미 알고 있고 대부분의 참여자들이 활용한 경험을 가지고 있었다. 챗GPT가 유용한 학습도구라고 여기며 챗GPT를 수업에 사용해보고자 하는 높은 의지를 보였다. 하지만 챗GPT를 활용해서 교수-학습 활동을 진행하는데 있어서는 다소 어려움을 느꼈다. 둘째로, 챗GPT 활용의 기대효과로 동기유발, 학습보조, 그리고 상호작용 역할을 할 수 있을 것이라고 믿었다. 하지만 챗GPT 활용에 있어서 예상되는 어려움으로 영어수준별 활용 능력의 한계, 절대적 신뢰의 위험성, 윤리적 위험성 등의 우려를 나타냈다. 본 연구결과를 바탕으로 교육관계자와 교수자에게 챗GPT 활용에 관한 제언을 하였다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this paper is to examine professors’ perceptions on chatGPT and provide some suggestions about them. To that end, a total of fifteen professors belonging to universities in Chungcheong-namdo participated in the online survey. The findings of this study are as follows. First, the meaning or concept of chatGPT was already known, and most of the participants had experience using it. Also, professors thought chatGPT is a useful educational tool and showed strong willingness to use in classes. However, the professors mentioned conducting teaching-learning activities by using chatGPT could be difficult. Second, It was believed that the expected effect of using chatGPT could serve as motivation, learning aid, and interaction. However, as expected difficulties, concerns such as limitations in English proficiency, risk of absolute trust, and ethical risks were raised. The study provided some suggestions to educators and administrators.

title_ko: 메타버스를 이용한 영어학습을 위한 메타버스 플랫폼 비교분석
title_en: Comparative Analysis of Metaverse Platforms for English Learning Using Metaverse
kw_ko: 메타버스; 메타버스를 이용한 영어학습; 컴퓨터 보조 언어 학습
kw_en: metaverse; English learning with metaverse; CALL
abstract_ko: Recently, the word Metaverse is becoming more important to the extent that it is not an exaggeration to say that services using the Internet or IT are developing around the word Metaverse. In the future, the time people spend in the metaverse will increase, and it is expected that economic and social activities in reality will be connected and converted into the metaverse. This study analyzes the currently serviced metaverse platforms, identified the characteristics of each platform, and proposes how to use these characteristics for English teaching/learning. To this end, the metaverse platforms currently in service were selected, and through the first analysis, the metaverse platforms for the second analysis were selected, and the characteristics of each metaverse platform were analyzed through the second in-depth analysis. The metaverse platforms selected for the first analysis are 1) Pokemon Go, 2) Animal Crossing New Horizons, 3) Minecraft, 4) Gathertown, 5) Zeppetto, 6) Roblox. In the result part of this paper, the characteristics of each metaverse platform identified through analysis are presented, and in the conclusion and suggestion part, suggestions for how to use the characteristics of each metaverse when using metaverse for English learning are presented.

title_ko: 한국인 영어 학습자의 기계번역 사용에 대한 태도 연구: 고등학생 학습자의 사례를 중심으로
title_en: Korean EFL Students’ Attitudes on the Use of the Machine Translation in L2 Writing Class: The Case of High School Students
kw_ko: 기계번역; 제2언어쓰기; 제2언어습득; 영어학습; EFL환경
kw_en: Machine Translation; L2 Writing; Second Language Acquisition; L2 learning; EFL settings
abstract_ko: 우리나라와 같은 EFL환경에서 기계번역은 학습자와 교수자 모두에게 영어를 배우는 혁신적인 방법으로 기능할 수 있다. 이러한 도전에 맞서, 이 논문의 목적은 고등학교 영어학습자들의 기계번역 사용에 대한 인식과 태도를 조사함으로써 향후 영어학습에 기계번역의 역할에 대한 제언을 제시하고자 한다. 이를 위해 서울 소재 고등학교 학생 173명을 대상으로 기계번역에 대한 기대와 정의적 영역에 미치는 효과를 조사하였다. 그 결과 대부분의 학생들이 기계번역의 정확성에 대해 만족감을 나타내고 영어학습에 수반되는 불안이 감소하였다고 하였으나 이것이 영어학습에 대한 흥미나 성취감으로 연결되지는 않았다. 이러한 기계번역에 대한 교육학적인 접근에 근거하여 향후 기계번역의 사용이 제2언어 학습에 있어 지속적으로 교사와 학생들에게 전례없는 고려와 의문점을 던질 것이라는 예측이 가능하다고 할 수 있다.
abstract_en: Machine Translation (MT) such as Google Translate and Naver Papago has had an important role in L2 learning. In EFL settings, which are classroom-based English learning environments, Machine Translation (MT) has provided both learners and teachers with innovative means to learn English. With these ground-breaking challenges, the aim of this research was to study high school students’ perceptions and attitudes on the use of MT in English writing classes. This study gathered qualitative data using a questionnaire to 173 students at a high school located in Seoul. The survey questions included students’ use of MT and their degree of satisfaction. Also, students’ level of expectations and affective aspects were asked in the questionnaire. Findings show most students who responded to the survey used MT to search for the meaning of unknown English words and to translate L1 sentences into English ones. While anxiety level caused by L2 learning was reported to be lowered, whether the level of learning interest and accomplishment was increased or not remained uncertain. Based on the pedagogical implication the use of MT in English learning will give unprecedented questions and considerations to teachers and learners of L2 continuously.
note: 고교생 173명 쓰기수업 MT 사용 태도 설문

title_ko: 인공지능 기반 DALL-E2 활용 쓰기 활동에 대한 영어학습자들의 인식 조사
title_en: A Pilot Study of English Learners' Perception on Writing Activities using AI-Based DALL-E2
kw_ko: 이미지 생성 인공지능; 영어교육; 작문 활동; 인식
kw_en: AI-Image Generator; English education; Writing activity; Perception
abstract_ko: 본 예비연구의 목적은 이미지 생성 인공지능 도구인 DALL-E2를 활용하여 영어 작문 활동을 실시한 후 중학생들의 영어 학습에 미치는 반응을 살펴보는 데 있다. 이를 위하여 15명의 중학교 영어학습자를 대상으로 3주간 실험수업을 진행하였으며 그 결과를 정리하면 다음과 같다. 첫째, DALL-E2 활용 영어 작문 활동에 대한 설문조사 결과, 자신감, 흥미 및 인공지능 기반 도구 활용 쓰기에 대한 인식이 긍정적으로 변화하였음을 알 수 있었다. 아울러 통계적으로 유의미한 차이가 나타났음을 확인하였으며 이는 인공지능 활용 학습이 영어 작문 및 전반적인 영어 학습에 있어 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤다는 것을 의미하였다. 둘째, DALL-E2 활용 영어 작문 활동에 대한 소감문을 내용분석을 통해 분석한 결과, 핵심 주제를 3가지(인지적, 정의적, 심동적 특성)로 추출할 수 있었으며 영어 학습에 있어 인공지능 기반의 DALL-E2의 활용과 접목은 학습에 대한 새로운 흥미와 도전, 의지, 적극성을 높이며 궁극적으로는 영어표현력(productive skill) 향상에 일부 기여한 것으로 해석할 수 있었다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this pilot study is to examine the responses of middle school students to English learning after conducting English writing activities using DALL-E2, an image-generating artificial intelligence tool. To this end, an experimental class was conducted for 3 weeks for 15 middle school English learners, and the results are summarized as follows. First, as a result of a survey on English writing activities using DALL-E2, it was found that confidence, interest, and awareness of writing using artificial intelligence-based tools changed positively. In addition, it was confirmed that there was a statistically significant difference, which meant that learning using artificial intelligence had a positive effect on English writing and overall English learning. Second, as a result of analyzing the English writing activities using DALL-E2, core themes could be extracted into three (cognitive, affective, and psychodynamic characteristics), and the use and implementation of artificial intelligence-based DALL-E2 in English learning showed potential to increase learning interest, challenge, will, and desire in learning and ultimately contribute to enhancing productive skill.

title_ko: 인공지능 툴 퀼봇(QuillBot)을 활용한 영어 글쓰기 능력 제고 연구: 교양선택 교과목 [고급영작문]
title_en: Study of Applying an AI-powered Paraphrasing Tool Quillbot to an Elective General Education Course “Advanced English Writing”
kw_en: Quillbot; paraphrasing; self-directed learning; Quillbot’s ease of use; statistical information
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study is to develop an efficient teaching method that can motivate college students’ self-directed learning and ultimately enhance their English writing skills in an elective general education English-only course of “Advanced English Writing,” which touches upon in on improving writing skills of a variety of essays, by using QuillBot, an artificial intelligence-based paraphrasing tool. In order to verify its self-directed learning motivation and educational effectiveness, bipartite experiments using QuillBot and the survey were conducted, and the results were analyzed in terms of the arithmetic and inferential statistics. It was confirmed that students were motivated by QuillBot’s ease of use, providing synonyms, and statistical information of paraphrasing, so it positively induces students’ interest to voluntarily write, proofread, and polish their own essay, carrying out a useful strategy to increase learning motivation. It was also confirmed that using QuillBot showed improvements in the rate of correct answers and grades between midterm and final exam on paraphrasing, performing a supplementary learning tool. It is inferred that QuillBot not only motivates learners’ self-directed learning of English writing, but also plays a positive role in enhancing high quality of writing skills at paraphrasing vocabulary and sentence structure.

title_ko: Performance of ChatGPT 3.5 on CSAT: Its Potential as a Language Learning and Assessment Tool
title_en: Performance of ChatGPT 3.5 on CSAT: Its Potential as a Language Learning and Assessment Tool
kw_ko: 챗지피티3.5; 수능; 언어 학습 및 평가; 데이터셋
kw_en: ChatGPT3.5; CAST; language learning and assessment; dataset
abstract_ko: The purpose of this paper is to evaluate ChatGPT 3.5’s performance on the English reading comprehension section of the Korean College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT). More specifically, this study analyzes its potential as a language learning and assessment tool based on its performance on the high-stakes national test. This study also identifies the strengths and limitations of the large language model (LLM) and explores aspects that need improvement to use for learning. The results suggest that the LLM’s strengths in reasoning and explanation can be useful for language learning. The results also highlight the need for ChatGPT to gain extensive domain-specific knowledge and advanced reasoning skills in order to enhance its contextual understanding. Moreover, the results indicate that human judgment from educators is necessary to ensure the accuracy and reliability of ChatGPT’s outputs, particularly for a high-stakes exam like the CSAT. Combining AI and human judgment can result in more effective and trustworthy results.

title_en: Investigating the performance of generative AI ChatGPT’s reading comprehension ability
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 독해능력; 읽기능력평가; 생성형 인공지능
kw_en: ChatGPT; reading comprehension; reading test; generative AI
abstract_ko: This study examines the performance of the generative Artificial Intelligence, ChatGPT, in reading comprehension tasks of recent CSAT English tests. For this, several experiments were carried out in which ChatGPT responded to CSAT English reading items from the 2021 to 2023 versions, and the correct answer rates were determined. The study investigates how the correct answer rate might vary by item type and according to the different versions of ChatGPT (3.5 and 4). The findings reveal that ChatGPT-3.5 answered approximately 69% of the reading items correctly, while GPT-4 achieved almost perfect results. Additionally, the study explores whether similar trends are found in other foreign language tests, using TOEFL iBT reading items. The results indicate a similar trend in TOEFL iBT items. The implications for teachers, test developers, and language learners on how to use this generative AI for teaching and learning and for test-preparation purposes are discussed. The study highlights the potential of using AI in the language learning and teaching processes and its potential impact on test development.

title_ko: ChatGPT로 분석한 2022 교육과정 활용 유의 사항:영어과 의사소통 기능과 예시문을 중심으로
title_en: ChatGPT’s notes on the use of the 2022 curriculum: Focusing on the communicative functions and example sentences
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 2022 개정 영어과 교육과정; 의사소통 기능; 예시문
kw_en: ChatGPT; 2022 revised curriculum of English; communicative functions; example sentences
abstract_ko: This study investigates the appropriateness of the communicative functions and example sentences in the 2022 revised curriculum for English, using ChatGPT as an AI-based literacy tool. Prompts for ChatGPT were designed considering both a) the relationship between a function and its example sentences and b) the coherence among the examples within a function. In response, ChatGPT provided its interpretations of functions and example sentences, which were further analyzed, leading to the following results. First, ChatGPT accurately interpreted 83 of the 91 communicative functions based on the example sentences, which validates the current organization of the communicative functions in the curriculum. Second, guiding notes on the use of the curriculum emerged in three areas: a) naming of functions, b) interpretation of names, and c) use of example sentences. Third, it was observed that the example sentences in each function exhibited several variations in terms of context, meaning, and attitude. The implications of the study for English education encompass the effective application of AI tools such as ChatGPT for curriculum literacy tasks, the necessity for educators and learners to actively reinterpret the curriculum, and the consideration of diverse socio-linguistic factors when teaching communicative functions in English.

title_ko: 유도(guided) 쓰기 활동에서 ChatGPT의 활용 방안
title_en: Utilizing ChatGPT in guided writing activities
kw_ko: 교육에서의 인공지능; 챗GPT; 에디트GPT; 유도 쓰기; 챗 뤼튼
kw_en: AIED; ChatGPT; editGPT; guided writing; Chat Wrtn
abstract_ko: This study investigates the potential of ChatGPT as a tool for guided writing instruction with 21 pre-service teachers. The study examines the effects of using ChatGPT during the planning and revising stages of writing. The results of the study indicate that the ideas and outlines provided by ChatGPT are highly beneficial in the writing process. The majority of the participants (71.4%) responded that ChatGPT’s ideas and outlines were very helpful, and the remaining 28.6% stated that they were somewhat helpful. This indicates that ChatGPT can assist writers in generating ideas and organizing their thoughts before they begin writing. Moreover, ChatGPT’s feedback was found to be useful in the reviewing and revising process. 76.2% of the participants evaluated ChatGPT’s feedback as very helpful, and the remaining 23.8% responded that it was somewhat helpful. However, some participants pointed out that excessive reliance on ChatGPT could have a counterproductive effect on learning. Therefore, the study recommends that teachers provide meticulous guidance to learners in utilizing ChatGPT. In conclusion, some limitations and suggestions for further research are also provided.

title_ko: AI·디지털 적자생존시대의 TMSIB 메타메이커 모형:ChatGPT, 생성인공지능, 증강능력을 중심으로
title_en: TMSIB meta-maker education model for the era of AI·digital darwinism: Focused on ChatGPT, Generative AI, and augmented capability
kw_ko: 메타메이커 모형; 챗지피티; 생성인공지능; 증강능력
kw_en: TMSIB meta-maker model; ChatGPT; GenAI; augmented capability; TMSIB
abstract_ko: The current technological zeitgeist, ChatGPT, has evolved at a searing pace in an AI·digital darwinism era. More than ever, educators nowadays are forced to retrain and harness the capacity to leverage cutting-edge technologies to thrive in the face of an unprecedented wave of change. Against this backdrop, fueled by the tenets of Web 3.0 and human-centered AI, this study developed a new maker-education paradigm, dubbed TMSIB meta-maker model. The TMSIB meta-maker educational model was carried out in a hybrid form, featuring both in-person and virtual (Zoom) sessions with sixteen graduate students from diverse backgrounds. After taking virtual, augmented, metaversal tours of human body systems, the participants collaborated to generate ideas (Tinkering), created and constructed prototypes (Making), displayed their digital creations in the Metaverse exhibition (Sharing) and iterated on their inventions (Improving). Through Blockchain technology, touted as a game changer in Web 3.0, the participant creations were encrypted in the NFT marketplace OpenSea (Blockchaining). Following meta-reflection upon the processes, this study suggest ways of augmenting human capability of the educational initiatives via ChatGPT and other generative AI tools.

title_ko: The Effect of AI Chatbot-Based Tourism English Instruction on Intercultural Communicative Competence
title_en: The Effect of AI Chatbot-Based Tourism English Instruction on Intercultural Communicative Competence
kw_en: AI chatbot; learning with AI (LWAI); learning about AI (LAAI); Tourism English learning; intercultural communicative competence
abstract_ko: The present study aimed at investigating AI chatbot-based Tourism English instruction for college students to develop their intercultural communicative competence. For the study, two distinctive models of AI based educational approach were proposed; learning with AI (LWAI) and learning about AI (LAAI). A total of 50 Tourism English 3 learners with the model of LWAI were assigned to conduct a conversation with the chatbot during the semester, while 20 Tourism English 6 learners with the model of LAAI were asked to build a hotel English chatbot. In LWAI, the collected chatbot conversation reports were analyzed in terms of task completion rates. It was found that the chatbot conversations mostly involved small talk rather than problem-solving tasks. In LAAI, Tourism English learners collected English for hotel reservations and coded data into the hotel English chatbot with the help of computer engineering students. As a result of a team project, the hotel English chatbot building was successful. Lastly, there was an increase in participants’ intercultural communicative competence in terms of respect for cultural differences and interaction attentiveness. In short, the present study showed that the AI chatbot-based Tourism English instruction had a positive effect on the development of intercultural communicative competence.

title_ko: 영어 작문 과정에 활용한 ChatGPT에 대한 한국인 예비영어교사의 인식 탐색
title_en: Exploring perceptions of Korean pre-service English teachers on using ChatGPT in the English writing process
kw_ko: 인공지능기반 챗지피티; 영어쓰기교육; 수정 도구로서 챗지피티
kw_en: AI-based ChatGPT; English writing instruction; ChatGPT as a revision tool
abstract_ko: This study explores Korean pre-service English teachers’ perceptions of using ChatGPT in the English writing process and its impact on their writing competence. Participants composed the first drafts on assigned topics, followed by use of ChatGPT for revisions. They were then asked to reflect on their experience with ChatGPT to aid in the revision process. A thematic analysis of learners’ reflections and surveys was conducted to identify emerging themes. The findings uncovered several key emerging themes that are divided into two categories: positive and negative aspects. Positive aspects were divided into cognitive and affective categories. Participants perceived the feedback on content, organization, language use, and all-inclusive service as cognitively positive. In addition, they perceived its effects to be positive in terms of excitement, time efficiency, confidence boost, and willingness to use. However, the hallucination of ChatGPT, ethical issues such as authorship and overreliance were pointed out as negative aspects. This study demonstrates the potential benefits of integrating ChatGPT as a writing tool in English language learning, particularly for Korean pre-service English teachers. The findings offer valuable insights for educators considering the adoption of AI-driven conversational agents to enhance students’ writing competence and foster self-regulation in the revision process.

title_ko: PROMPT 리터러시 시대의 도래에 관한 고찰: 영어교육을 위한 ChatGPT와 DALL·E의 활용을 중심으로
title_en: The emergence of generative AI and PROMPT literacy: Focusing on the use of ChatGPT and DALL-E for English education
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 지피티; 챗지피티; 달이; 영어교육
kw_en: Generative AI; GPT; ChatGPT; DALL-E; EFL education
abstract_ko: The main purpose of this paper is to examine the role that generative AI plays in English education. Specifically, it emphasizes the characteristics and types of generative AI tools that create text, images, and other multimodal content and explores their educational benefits and potential. This study suggests how ChatGPT and DALL-E can be used to enhance English language learning. The findings show that ChatGPT can improve language proficiency, provide immediate feedback, and offer genre-based learning opportunities, while DALL-E can stimulate language immersion and imagination. Based on these findings, this paper proposes a new term, “PROMPT literacy,” which refers to the characteristics that students need to have in an AI-based society. Taking the acronym PROMPT, it includes the following qualities: Problem-solving pioneer, Resilient resourcer, Open-minded organizer, Multidisciplinary thinker, Personalized discriminator, and Trend seeker. The paper further highlights the need for teachers to be at the forefront of this technological revolution to educate AI digital natives.

title_ko: A Study on Elementary English Teachers’ Responses to Classes Using AI-Powered Application: Focusing on Odinga English
title_en: A Study on Elementary English Teachers’ Responses to Classes Using AI-Powered Application: Focusing on Odinga English
kw_en: artificial intelligence; elementary English; educational application; technology; Odinga English
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study is to examine the responses of English teachers to utilizing an AI-based interactive application, Odinga English. To determine their views, a case study was conducted with four English teachers. The findings are as follows. First, the contents of the application consisted of fun elements with graphics which had a positive effect on increasing learners’ interest and motivation. In addition, learners improved their self-confidence by solving problems on their own. Second, the design and interface of the application were appealing to young learners, an important point as both accessibility and convenience play an important role when lower-grade students are learning with a new tool. Third, the adaptation of the educational application was appropriate for elementary school students who are familiar with using technology to learn. Lastly, each learner received individual feedback on their speaking and pronunciation. Based on the results, it can be concluded that the use of the AI-based application was positive for elementary school English learners. Above all, it was effective in increasing learning interest and confidence, which are important for elementary school learners. It was also positive in improving learners’ speaking and pronunciation skills through customized feedback.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 독일어 초급 학습자의 작문 연습에 관한 연구
title_en: Untersuchung zur Verwendung von ChatGPT für Schreibübungen von Deutsch-Anfängern
kw_ko: 독일어 교육; 독일어 작문; AI 기반 외국어 교육; 작문 자동평가
kw_en: Deutschunterricht; Deutsch Schreiben; ChatGPT; KI-basierter Fremdsprachenunterricht; automatische Schreibauswertung
abstract_ko: 본 논문은 독일어 초급 학습자의 작문 연습에 ChatGPT를 활용하는 방안을 제안하고, ChatGPT의 독일어 교정 및 작문 텍스트의 언어학적 특징 분석을 바탕으로 학습 도구로써의 ChatGPT의 효과를 살펴보았다. 생성형 인공지능 모델인 ChatGPT는 사용자의 질의에 대해 응답을 출력해주는 대화형 인터페이스로 구현되었으며, 사용자와의 자유 대화뿐만 아니라 번역, 정보 검색, 코드 작성, 소설이나 시 작성 등이 가능하여 최근 다양한 분야에서 활용되고 있다. 본 논문은 학습자의 작문 텍스트를 검토하는 교정 도구와 예시 텍스트를 만드는 학습자료 생성 도구로 ChatGPT를 활용할 수 있음을 제안하였고, 그 효과를 검증하기 위해 독일어 초급 학습자가 작성한 텍스트의 평가 항목으로 문법, 어휘, 구조 측면의 언어학적 지표를 제시하였다. 독일어 초급 학습자 15명이 작성한 총 30개의 독일어 텍스트를 바탕으로 실험을 진행하였다. 실험 1에서 학습자가 작성한 텍스트와 이를 ChatGPT가 교정한 텍스트를 비교해 본 결과, 독일어 작문 평가를 위해 제안한 7개의 평가 항목 중 총 6개의 항목에서 긍정적인 학습 효과가 나타날 수 있음을 확인하였다. 실험 2에서 ChatGPT가 작성한 텍스트와 이를 학습자가 후편집한 텍스트를 비교해 본 결과, 총 6개의 항목에서 긍정적인 학습 효과가 발생할 수 있음을 알 수 있었다.
abstract_en: In der vorliegenden Untersuchung wurden zwei Methoden zur Verwendung von ChatGPT für die Schreibpraxis von Anfängern vorgeschlagen: ein Lernmittel zum Korrigieren des Schreibens von Deutsch-Anfängern und ein Lernmittel zum Generieren von Beispieltexten als Referenz. Um die Wirkung der Schreibübungen mit ChatGPT zu evaluieren, wurden außerdem sprachliche Merkmale in Bezug auf Grammatik, Wortschatz und Struktur als Bewertungspunkte für Texte von Deutsch- Anfängern diskutiert. Zwei Experimente wurden mit insgesamt 30 deutschen Texten durchgeführt, die von 15 Deutsch-Anfängern geschrieben wurden. In Experiment 1 wurden der vom Lernenden geschriebene Text und der von ChatGPT korrigierte Text verglichen. Als Ergebnis wurde bestätigt, dass positive Lerneffekte bei 6 der 7 vorgeschlagenen Bewertungspunkte für die Bewertung des deutschen Schreibens auftraten. In Experiment 2 wurden der von ChatGPT geschriebene Text und der vom Lernenden nachbearbeitete(‘Post-editing’) Text verglichen. Es zeigte sich, dass ChatGPT als Lernmittel zum Generieren von Beispieltexten bei 6 Bewertungspunkten zu positiven Lerneffekten führte.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 텍스트 데이터 증강 가능성 탐색
title_en: Exploring the Possibility of Text Data Augmentation Using ChatGPT
kw_ko: 텍스트 데이터 증강; 자동채점; 코사인 유사도; 인공지능
kw_en: ChatGPT; data augmentation; automatic grading; cosine similarity; artificial intelligence
abstract_ko: 본고는 ChatGPT를 활용한 한국어 서·논술형 데이터 증강 방안 및 활용 가능성을 제시하였다. 한국어 논술 데이터의 특성상 대량의 고품질 텍스트 데이터를 확보하기는 어려움이 있다. 이를 극복하기 위한 방안으로 ChatGPT를 활용하여 데이터를 증강 후, 인공지능 학습용 데이터로 사용하였다. 연구 결과 ChatGPT를 활용하여 원본 데이터의 문장 및 글의 의미를 유지한 상태에서 시간적, 경제적 비용을 줄이고 원본 데이터와 유사한 글을 생성할 수 있는 것으로 밝혀졌다. 또한, 증강 데이터를 활용한 머신러닝 모델 성능 평가 결과, 특정 영역에서 모델의 성능이 향상되는 것을 확인하였다. 이러한 연구 결과를 통하여 한국어 논술 데이터 증강 시, ChatGPT 활용이 유의미한 효과가 있음을 확인하였다. 하지만, 점수대별 더 높은 수준의 글 생성, 생성된 글의 라벨 타당성 확보를 위해서는 도메인 전문가의 적극적인 참여 및 관련 연구 생태계 활성화가 필요하다.
abstract_en: This paper presents an approach to augmenting Korean essay data using ChatGPT and explores its potential applications. Due to the nature of Korean essay data, there are difficulties in collecting a large amount of high-quality text data. To overcome this problem, ChatGPT was utilized to augment the data, which was then used for training artificial intelligence. The study results revealed that by using ChatGPT, it is possible to generate text similar to the original data while maintaining the meaning of sentences and reducing both time and economic costs. Additionally, performance evaluations of machine learning models using augmented data showed improvements in specific domains. These research findings confirm the significant effectiveness of employing ChatGPT for augmenting Korean essay data. However, to generate higher-quality texts across different score levels and ensure the validity of labels for generated texts, active participation from domain experts and the activation of the related research ecosystem are necessary.

title_ko: Investigating EFL College Students’ English Writings Produced by AI-Based Machine Translation
title_en: Investigating EFL College Students’ English Writings Produced by AI-Based Machine Translation
kw_ko: 영어쓰기; EFL 대학생; AI기반; 기계번역기 활용; 자기교정
kw_en: English writing; EFL college students; AI-based; use of machine translation; self-revision
abstract_ko: The purpose of this research was to investigate the characteristics of Korean college students’ writings, which have been produced without or with the help of machine translation tool in the classroom. Specifically, this research attempted to investigate the linguistic characteristics of the students’ writings, and types of errors identified in the writings. Twelve pieces of writings from three college students were collected for analysis. Two online word analysis programs, Word Counter (2023) and LIWC-22 (2023), were employed for data analysis. The findings of data analysis found out that 1) The students’ drafts consisted of 22.8 sentences including 303.9 words in 3.6 paragraphs on average. 2) In the students’ drafts, ‘unique’ words (46.8%) were included a lot more than ‘difficult’ words (27%), and students tended to write their essay writings in an unfiltered or impromptu way rather than an analytical way regardless of their English language proficiency levels. 3) The highest frequency of errors was seen in grammatical errors (41.7%) followed by lexical errors (31.6%). Based on the research findings, pedagogical implications and suggestions for the effective use of machine translation in English writing classes were presented.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 중학교 영어 자유 작문 개별화 수업 설계
title_en: Enhancing Middle School English Free Writing with ChatGPT: A Lesson Plan Development and Usability Study
kw_en: ChatGPT; Instructional design; Indivisualized learning; English free writing; AI literacy
abstract_ko: 본 논문은 ChatGPT를 활용한 중학 영어 자유 작문 수업 지도안을 ChatGPT와의 공동 교수 설계를 통해 도출하였다. 첫째, 교수 설계자와 ChatGPT가 대화를 주고 받으며 중학 영어 자유 작문 개별화 수업지도안 초안을 설계했으며, 둘째, 도출된 초안을 활용하여 중학교 1학년 남학생을 대상으로 학습자 사용성 테스트를 시행했다. 셋째, 테스트 결과 도출된 시사점을 바탕으로 수업 지도안을 최종적으로 수정, 보완했다. 연구 결과는 다음과 같다. 첫째, 학습자가 ChatGPT를 활용하여 자신이 좋아하는 영화 캐릭터에게 궁금한 점을 질문하고 답장을 받는 자유 영작 활동을 통해 영어 글쓰기에 보다 흥미롭고 자신 있게 접근할 뿐 만 아니라 글쓰기 유창성이 증대함을 알 수 있었다. 이는 ChatGPT를 중학 영어 자유 작문 활동에 도입할 때, 컴퓨터 매개 의사소통의 효과성 강화, 내용-언어 통합 교수법의 효과성 제고, 하 수준 학습자의 자유 작문에 대한 접근성 제고가 가능함을 시사한다. 둘째, ChatGPT를 활용한 수업에서 학습자가 ChatGPT의 문장 자동 생성 기능에 지나치게 의존하지 않도록 세심한 수업 설계가 필요함을 알 수 있었다. 이를 반영하여 짝 활동 등의 구술 활동, KWL 차트 등의 메타 인지 관련 활동, ChatGPT의 생성 문장을 의무적으로 자신의 문장으로 수정하는 활동, ChatGPT의 도움 없이 손 편지를 쓰는 활동을 수정, 보완된 수업 지도안에 포함하였다. 본 연구는 급변하는 기술 환경에 대응하는 교수 설계가 ChatGPT의 도움으로 신속하게 이루어질 수 있음을 시사하며, ChatGPT의 수업 도입으로 인해 교사의 역할과 수업 설계에 변화가 있어야 함을 제안한다.
abstract_en: This study implies that instructional design in rapidly changing technological environments can be swiftly achieved with ChatGPT's help, suggesting changes in the roles of teachers and instructional designers in the era of generative Artificial Intelligence. This research paper presents a comprehensive lesson plan for middle school English free writing classes utilizing ChatGPT. The study encompasses three main phases: initial collaboration between an instructional designer and ChatGPT to create an individualized lesson plan, a usability test conducted with a first-year male student using the drafted plan, and subsequent revisions and improvements based on the test results. The research findings highlight two significant outcomes. Firstly, by engaging in free writing activities that involved interacting with ChatGPT and asking questions to favorite movie characters, the student demonstrated enhanced interest, confidence, and fluency in English writing. This suggests that integrating ChatGPT in middle school English free writing activities has the potential to improve computer-mediated communication effectiveness, content-based instruction teaching efficacy, and accessibility to free writing for low-level learners. Secondly, the study emphasizes the importance of thoughtful lesson planning to avoid excessive dependence on ChatGPT's automatic sentence generation. To address this concern, the revised lesson plan incorporates paired oral activities, metacognitive-related tasks utilizing KWL charts, mandatory modifications of ChatGPT-generated sentences, and opportunities for students to practice writing letters by hand without ChatGPT assistance. Overall, this study showcases how instructional design, in response to rapidly changing technological environments, can be effectively accomplished with the assistance of ChatGPT, indicating potential shifts in the roles of teachers and lesson planning strategies with the integration of ChatGPT in the classroom.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 영시 쓰기 수업 사례
title_en: Utilizing ChatGPT in Writing Poem in English
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 영어번역; 포스트-에디팅; 시 생성; 영어능력 향상
kw_en: ChatGPT; English translation; post-editing; generating a poem; improvement in English proficiency
abstract_ko: The objective of this study is to investigate how the use of ChatGPT, a generative artificial intelligence, in a university English literature class affects students’ perceptions of this technology. Specifically, the study focuses on the students’ experiences with ChatGPT during an English poem writing activity, in which two approaches were employed. The first approach involved students creating their own English poems using an English dictionary, while the second approach required students to use ChatGPT to rephrase their self-translated poems and edit the resulting output. The results indicated that students found the structured English poem writing activity at a basic level to be easy, but they preferred ChatGPT’s faster and more convenient process and its use of natural and sophisticated vocabulary, grammar, and poetic expression with poetic license. Students also reported that post-editing with ChatGPT resulted in more seamless and higher quality outputs than direct translation. They noted that ChatGPT helped improve their English writing and translation skills, sentence structure and grammar checking, appropriate vocabulary selection and usage, natural sentence expression, and colloquial conversation.

title_ko: ChatGPT 글쓰기 표절 대응과 교육적 활용 전략
title_en: Strategies for Solving the AI Plagiarism Problem and Educational Applications of ChatGPT
kw_ko: 챗GPT; AI 표절; AI 면역; 교육에서의 AI; 인공지능 기반 교육; 자기 결정 학습; 성찰적 사고; 학습 경험
kw_en: ChatGPT; AI Plagiarism; AI Immunity; AIED; Artificial Intelligence Based Education; Self-Determined Learning; Reflective Thought; Learning Experience
abstract_ko: 거대 언어 모델 AI인 ChatGPT의 탁월한 성능으로 인해 교육적 활용에 대한 기대와 함께 우려도 점점 커지고 있다. 특히, ‘AI표절(AIgiarism)이라는 신조어가 생길 정도로, 많은 교육자들은 학생들이 AI를 이용한 과제 글쓰기를 생성해 제출할 것을 우려한다. AI로 과제를 대신하기 어려운 ‘AI 면역성’(AI-immunity)을 높이고 동시에 교육 효과도 함께 고려해야 한다. 그러나 실제로 AI 활용과 AI 표절은 구분하기 어렵다. 오히려 적극적인 AI 이해와 활용을 통한 교육의 전환이 요청된다. 이를 위해 ChatGPT를 이용한 글쓰기 표절 문제를 극복하고 교육의 재설계를 위한 교수학습의 설계 방향을 제시하였다. 향후 ChatGPT를 교육적으로 활용할 때 부정적 효과를 최소화하고 잠재적 이점을 극대화하는 데 의미 있는 참조점이 되길 기대한다.
abstract_en: The promise of ChatGPT, a Large Language Model AI, has led to both excitement and concern about its educational applications. In particular, many educators fear that students will use AI to generate and submit written assignments, leading to the coining of the phrase “AIgiarism”. The goal is to build “AI-immunity,” which makes it harder for AI to take over assignments, while still ensuring educational effectiveness. However, it is difficult to distinguish AI use from AI plagiarism. Rather, a shift in education is required through active understanding and utilization of AI. To this end, the design direction of teaching and learning for the redesign of education was presented by overcoming the problem of writing plagiarism using ChatGPT. It is expected that it will be a basic study to minimize risks and maximize potential benefits in the educational use of ChatGPT in the future.

title_ko: Analyzing ChatGPT’s Judgments on Nativelikeness of Sentences Written by English Native Speakers and Korean EFL Learners
title_en: Analyzing ChatGPT’s Judgments on Nativelikeness of Sentences Written by English Native Speakers and Korean EFL Learners
kw_en: ChatGPT; AI; conversational AI; nativelikeness; EFL writing; fine-tuning; grammaticality; plausibility
abstract_ko: In this study, ChatGPT was asked to determine the likeliness of a given sentence being written by a native speaker of English. A total of 2,000 prompt sentences were provided: 1,000 from an English native-speaker corpus (LOCNESS) and 1,000 from a Korean EFL learner corpus (GLC). It was found that ChatGPT determined the sentences from the native corpus to be more nativelike than those from the nonnative corpus. The classification accuracy (proportion of native sentences classified as native and nonnative sentences classified as nonnative) was 62.75%. Most of the responses were simple phrases, such as “very likely” or “not very likely,” but in some cases, ChatGPT also provided reasons for a judgment or suggestions for correction. ChatGPT’s answers show that it considers grammaticality and plausibility as the criteria for determining the nativelikeness of a sentence, conforming to the literature. Following the initial testing, ChatGPT was fine-tuned with 1,600 sentences from the prompt data and tested with the remaining 400 sentences. After fine-tuning, the classification accuracy increased to 96.75%. This result showed that the fine-tuning of ChatGPT can enhance accuracy. Finally, the study briefly discussed the characteristics of the answers provided by GPT-4 in comparison with those provided by GPT-3.5.

title_ko: 인공지능(AI) 기반 영어학습 챗봇의 원리와 기능, 그리고 영어학습에의 활용가능성
title_en: Principles, functions, and potential applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based English learning chatbots.
kw_en: AI; chatbot; natural language processing; English learning; chatGPT
abstract_ko: This paper discusses the key technologies and limitations of AI-based chatbots, as well as their types and functions, and their contributions to English language learning. Two specific research questions were posed: first, what are the background and key technologies of AI-based language learning, and what are the technological limitations? Second, what are the conversation processing technologies and types of AI-based chatbots, their roles in English language learning, and pedagogical challenges? Based on the discussion, the main conclusions are as follows: first, the core principles of AI chatbots are human-robot interaction (HRI) technology and natural language processing (NLP) technology, which are evolving into various interactive and game-like models, tailored to the diversity and individuality of learners. Second, natural language processing technology has overcome initial linguistic, technical, and practical challenges and is increasingly being utilized for English language learning through the emergence of ChatGPT. Third, AI personal assistant tools can become effective lifestyle English learning tools as natural language processing technology continues to advance. Fourth, AI-based English learning chatbots are effective in pattern matching, conversation database, knowledge base, and language generation models, in that order. Finally, the role and pedagogical challenges of AI chatbots as English language learning tools are discussed.

title_ko: 영어 교육용 챗봇이 사용하는 Wh-의문문 분석 연구: 2022 개정 영어과 교육과정의 언어 형식을 기준으로
title_en: A study on the wh-questions used by an English education chatbot: Based on the language forms in the 2022 revised national curriculum of English.
kw_en: chatbot; edutech; wh-question; 2022 revised national curriculum of English; elementary English
abstract_ko: This study investigated the usage of wh-questions by a chatbot for English education, within the framework of the 2022 revised national curriculum, which highlights the use of AI technology and edutech in English language teaching and learning. Initially, we analyzed both the lexical and structural features of the example sentences at the elementary English level in the curriculum and identified ten types of wh-questions that would be suitable for elementary English. With reference to the ten types of wh-questions, we explored the conversational experiences provided by AI Pengtalk, a chatbot widely used by elementary English learners. In particular, we examined the formal and functional characteristics of 185 wh-questions in the chatbot’s speaking task. Notable parallels and divergences were identified between the chatbot and elementary English textbooks. For example, both frequently used what-questions, while only the chatbot regularly employed why-questions. Furthermore, the chatbot was found to incorporate at least five different types of wh-questions across all conversation topics, providing many opportunities to practice various roles in meaningful contexts. These findings may contribute to improving chatbots for foreign language learners and advancing edutech-based English education programs.

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능이 국어교육에 미치는 영향과 대응 방안 - ChatGPT는 국어교육의 도구인가, 위협인가?
title_en: The Impact of Generative Artificial Intelligence on Korean Education and Response Strategies - ChatGPT: A Tool or Threat for Korean Education?
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 챗GPT; 인공 텍스트; 근원적 문식성; 기계 기반 문식성; 국어과 평가; 쓰기 평가; 자동 채점; AI 기반 평가

abstract_ko: 이 연구에서는 생성형 인공지능(GAI)를 중심으로 인공 텍스트의 특성을 검토하고 이것이 국어교육에 미칠 영향을 살펴 향후 국어교육의 대응 방안에 대해 논의하였다. 먼저 ChatGPT로 대변되는 언어 모델로서 GAI의 특성을 검토하고, 기존의 자연어 처리 기술과 구별되는 GPT-4의 특징을 메타 학습 방법론과 대화형 챗봇 모델을 중심으로 살펴보았다. 또한 GAI가 생성한 인공 텍스트에 대해 텍스트성 개념을 중심으로 검토하여 그 특성을 밝혔다. 이후 GAI가 국어교육에 미칠 영향을 저자 개념, 평가의 국면을 중심으로 살펴보았다. 나아가 기계 기반 문식성의 도입, GAI를 활용한 국어과 평가 방안, GAI 활용을 위한 기초 연구의 방향을 중심으로 국어교육의 대응 방향을 모색하였다. 이 연구는 국어교육의 관점에서 GAI를 논의한 점에서 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: This study examines the characteristics of artificial text generated by generative language models (GAI). It investigates the potential impact of these models on Korean education, discussing response strategies for future Korean education. This study reviews the distinctive features of Generative AI (GAI), focusing on the characteristics of the GPT series language models as exemplified by ChatGPT, a representative commercially available GAI service. Specifically, the unique characteristics of GPT-4 are examined with an emphasis on meta-learning methodologies and conversational chatbot models, comparing it with traditional natural language processing technologies. Additionally, the characteristics of artificial texts generated by GAI are analyzed, centering on the concept of textuality. The influence of GAI on Korean education is then explored, focusing on the author’s concept and the assessment phase. Furthermore, response directions for Korean education are sought, centering on the introduction of machine-based literacy, language assessment methods utilizing GAI, and fundamental research directions for applying GAI. This study is significant in that it discusses GAI from the perspective of Korean education.

title_ko: ChatGPT의 활용이 예비영어교사의 영어 요약하기 과정에 미치는 영향 탐색
title_en: Exploring ChatGPT’s impact on the English summary writing of pre-service English teachers
kw_en: ChatGPT; English summary writing; process-based writing; pre-service English teachers
abstract_ko: This study investigates the influence of ChatGPT on Korean pre-service English teachers' summary writing skills, utilizing a qualitative research approach. The participants included 25 pre-service English teachers, each assigned the task of engaging with ChatGPT during their summary writing revision. Data were collected through participants’ initial drafts, revised summaries, reflective journals, in-depth interviews, and surveys. Thematic analysis was employed to scrutinize the influence of ChatGPT on participants’ summary writing. The results identified key themes categorized into pedagogical, technical and affective aspects. On the pedagogical aspect, the utilization of ChatGPT led to improved lexical choices, enhanced organizational revisions, and heightened awareness of content inclusion and exclusion. Additionally, participants benefited from continuous, individualized, and technically immediate feedback. These pedagogical and technical benefits subsequently influenced participants’ affective perspectives towards ChatGPT, with reports of reduced writing anxiety, increased confidence in summary writing, and a more positive attitude towards the willingness to use of ChatGPT. This study emphasizes the value of ChatGPT as a tool for enhancing summary writing competencies and fostering positive pedagogical and affective attitudes among pre-service English teachers. It underlines the potential for integrating ChatGPT into English writing teaching methodologies.

title_ko: 자연어 처리 기반 교수자의 온라인 글쓰기 피드백 양상 유형화 연구
title_en: A study on the typology of online written feedback of instructors based on natural language processing
kw_ko: 서면 피드백; 피드백 유형; 온라인 작문 피드백; 대학 글쓰기; 비지도학습; 지도학습; 군집화; 토픽 모델링; 기계학습; 초점 및 방식
kw_en: Written feedback; Feedback typology; Online writing feedback; University writing; Unsupervised learning; Supervised learning; Clustering; Topic modeling; Machine learning; Focus and mode
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study is to categorize feedback provided by instructors according to the focus and mode, based on pattern recognition related to natural language processing. This study analyzed the feedback provided by 20 writing professors on 30 pieces of online writing each, adding up to a total of 600 pieces. The analysis was conducted using a combination of machine learning methods such as clustering from unsupervised learning and classification from supervised learning. As a result of clustering, focus was classified into four types: context, content, organization, and correctness. Mode was classified into three types: reflective statement and praise, correction and command, and advice and suggestion. The types of focus and mode were predicted by dividing the pieces by paragraph. Then, types and predicted values were applied to the neural network model to derive the types of instructor feedback through a deep learning method. Finally, this study identified the possibility of instructor feedback categorization by examining the examples of instructor feedback by type and discussing their differences.

title_en: Analysis of English automated speaking scoring tests
kw_ko: 영어 말하기 평가; 자동말하기채점; 평가 문항; 평가 준거; 채점; 평가리포트
kw_en: English speaking tests; automated speaking scoring (ASS); test items; assessment criteria; scoring; test report
abstract_ko: This study investigated the feasibility of adopting an automatic scoring system (ASS) in a domestic English-speaking education context. Scope, test items, assessment criteria, scoring methods, and reporting strategies of six overseas English-speaking tests utilizing ASSs were examined. Moreover, a comparative analysis was conducted to identify disparities between ASS-based and non-ASS-based speaking tests. Findings were: 1) some ASS-based tests utilized ASS technology throughout the assessment, while others adopted a hybrid scoring system involving human raters; 2) compared to non-ASS-based tests, ASS-based tests used more test items targeting low-level skills such as sound and forms but fewer test items targeting conversation and discourse level skills; 3) pronunciation, fluency, and vocabulary were widely employed as evaluation criteria with sparse use of organization, content, and task completion in most ASS-based tests; 4) differences were minimal in assessment criteria application and score calculation between ASS-based and non-ASS-based tests; and 5) some ASS-based tests provided criteria-specific results and feedback with total scores and proficiency levels.

title_ko: 영어 쓰기에서 자동 쓰기 평가 시스템(AWE)의 효과적 활용을 위한 교수전략 개발 연구
title_en: Development of Teaching Strategies for the Effective Use of Automated Writing Evaluation(AWE) in English Writing
kw_ko: 영어 쓰기; 글쓰기 자동 평가; 교수전략; AWE 활용 단계; 설계개발연구
kw_en: AWE; English writing; Automated writing evaluation; Teaching strategies; AWE utilization stage; Design and development research
abstract_ko: 영어 교육에서 쓰기는 의사소통 역량 함양에 있어 필수적인 학습 영역이지만, 쓰기 교육에 대한 중요성은 간과되고 있다. 이에 대한 원인으로 교수자들이 시간적 한계로 인해 모든 학습자의 쓰기 결과물에 대해 개별적 피드백을 적시에 제공하기 어렵다는 점이 지적된다. 인공지능 기술을 기반으로 하는 자동 쓰기 평가 시스템(Automated Wrting Evalaution, AWE)은 학습자에게 개인화된 채점 및 피드백을 실시간으로 제공할 수 있다는 점에서 이러한 교육적 문제를 해결할 수 있는 가능성을 지닌다. 그러나 AWE는 시스템의 기술적 오류, 불충분한 피드백 제공 등의 한계를 지니고 있으므로 AWE를 효과적으로 활용하기 위해서는 교수설계적 처치에 대한 연구가 필요하다. 따라서 본 연구에서는 Richey와 Klein(2007)의 설계․개발 연구 중 모형 연구(유형2)를 적용하여 실제 영어 교육 현장에서 AWE의 효과적인 활용을 위한 교수전략을 개발하고 그 타당성을 검증하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 연구 결과 영어 쓰기에서의 AWE의 효과적 활용을 위한 8개의 초기 교수전략 및 23개의 하위 상세지침을 개발되었으며, 총 3차례의 전문가 타당화를 통한 내적 타당성 검증, 5주 간의 현장 적용을 통한 외적 타당성 검증을 실시하였다. 내적 타당화 결과, 타당성, 설명력, 유용성, 보편성, 이해도 측면에서 모두 높은 평정 결과를 확인할 수 있었으며, CVI와 IRA가 모두 1.00점으로 교수전략이 타당함을 확인하였다. 외적 타당화 결과, 본 교수전략을 적용한 수업에 대한 학습자들의 높은 만족도(M=4.44)가 나타났으며, 특히 ‘쓰기 중’ 단계의 교수전략에 대해 학습자들이 높게 동의함을 확인하였다. 내적 및 외적 타당화 결과를 바탕으로 최종적으로 8개의 교수전략과 27개의 하위 상세지침을 개발하였다.
abstract_en: In English education, writing is an essential learning area for fostering communication skills, but the importance of writing education is overlooked. As a cause, it is pointed out that it is difficult for instructors to provide individual feedback on all learners’ writing processes and results in a timely, due to time limitations. Automated Writing Evaluation(AWE) has the potential to solve these educational problems, in that it can provide learners with personalized feedback and scoring. However, since AWE has limitations such as technical errors and insufficient feedback, research on instructional design research is needed to effectively utilize AWE. Therefore, this study aims to develop teaching strategies for the effective use of AWE in the actual English writing education field and verify their validity, by using model research(Type 2) of design and development research. As a result, eight initial teaching strategies and 23 sub-detailed guidelines were developed. As a result of internal validation through three times of expert validation, high evaluation results are confirmed in terms of validity, explanation, usefulness, and understanding, and both CVI and IRA were 1.00 point, confirming that the teaching strategies are valid. As a result of external validation through field application, learners’ high satisfaction with the class applying these teaching strategies was found(M=4.44), and in particular, learners agreed highly with the teaching strategy at the ‘during writing’ stage. Based on the results of internal and external validation, eight teaching strategies and 27 sub-detailed guidelines were finally developed.

title_ko: AI 펭톡이 초등 영어 학습자들의 어휘력과 정의적 영역에 미치는 효과 및 활용 방안
title_en: Exploring the use and effects of AI PengTalk in primary English learners’ vocabulary knowledge and affective domains
kw_ko: AI 펭톡; 어휘력; 정의적 영역; 초등영어교육
kw_en: AI PengTalk; vocabulary knowledge; affective domains; primary English education
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study was to explore the use and effects of AI PengTalk on primary English learners’ vocabulary knowledge and affective domains. The research was carried out with one class of sixth graders (a total of 17 students) from a primary school. Learning English based on AI PengTalk was conducted over fifteen weeks. Vocabulary knowledge tests, affective domain tests, a student questionnaire, and a teacher's observation journal were used to collect data. The results were analyzed using quantitative and qualitative methods. Paired t-tests using SPSS were used to analyze quantitative data, and the questionnaire and observation journal analysis were used to analyze qualitative data. It was found that learning English using AI Peng Talk had a positive effect on primary English learners’ vocabulary knowledge and affective domains. In addition, it is determined that AI PengTalk increases primary English vocabulary knowledge and affective domains such as attitude, interest, belief, and expectation.

It was found that learning English using AI Peng Talk had a positive effect on primary English learners’ vocabulary knowledge and affective domains. In addition, it is determined that AI PengTalk increases primary English vocabulary knowledge and affective domains such as attitude, interest, belief, and expectation.

title_ko: AI 기계번역을 활용한 교양강좌 영작문 수업 사례
title_en: A Case Study of English Writing Classes Using AI Machine Translation
kw_ko: 인공지능; 기계번역; 교양 영작문; 피드백
kw_en: artificial intelligence; machine translation; English writing; feedback; DeepL; ChatGPT
abstract_ko: 글로벌 역량을 갖춘 인재를 양성하기 위하여 많은 대학은 교양 영어 수업에서 효과적인 영어 작문 수업이 이루어지도록 노력을 기울이고 있다. 특히 작문 수업에서는 학습자의 작문 과업에 대해 효과적인 피드백을 제공하는 것이 교수자의 가장 중요한 역할이라고 할 수 있겠다. Hyland and Hyland(2006), Zimmerman and Kitsantas, 2002) 윤권기, 정동욱, 2010 등의 연구에 따르면 학습자가 받는 피드백은 직접적인 작문 능력 향상뿐 아니라 나아가 학습 동기 유발에도 긍정적인 측면이 있어, 작문 수업에서 피드백은 작문 실력 향상에 결정적인 역할을 한다고 볼 수 있겠다. 본고에서는 대학의 영어 작문 교양수업에서 AI기반(Artificial Intelligence based) 기계번역(Machine Translation)인 DeepL과 ChatGPT를 피드백의 도구로 활용한 수업 사례를 공유하고, 긍정적인 측면과 동시에 기계번역 사용 시 주의해야 할 점을 살펴보고 학습지도시 발전 방향을 제시하고자 한다.
abstract_en: In order to develop globally-competent students, many universities are striving to teach effective English writing in their liberal arts classes. Studies such as Hyland and Hyland(2006), Zimmerman and Kitsantas(2002), and Yoon and Jung(2010) have shown that feedback has a positive effect on learners’ writing skills, not only in terms of direct improvement but also in terms of motivation to learn, so it can be said that feedback plays a crucial role in improving writing skills. In this article, we will share a classroom example of using DeepL and ChatGPT as a feedback tool in English writing classes. In terms of the efficiency, learners and instructors can encounter various expressions and forms within a limited time. It is believed that collaboration between learners and instructors can stimulate learners’ learning motivation and at the same time help learners to self-review and cultivate foreign language skills by utilizing MT in a self-directed manner. In addition, instructors should directly demonstrate the use of AI-based MT in the classroom informing learners of the limitations of using the translator and familiarizing them with the points to keep in mind. In this article, we examine the positive aspects and the points to be noted when using machine translation, and suggest developmental directions for learning guidance.

title_ko: 대학교육의 챗GPT 대응 현황 및 방안 연구
title_en: A Study on the Response Status and Improvements to ChatGPT in University Education
kw_ko: 대학교육; 챗GPT; 교양교육; 현황; 방안
kw_en: ChatGPT; University Education; Liberal Arts Education; Current Situation; Improvement
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 대학교육에서의 챗GPT의 대응 현황과 현실적인 방안을 탐색하는 데 그목적이 있다. 챗GPT는 최근 4.0 버전까지 등장했고 국내·외에서 교육 및 연구 등에 대한 여러 쟁점을 가시화하고 있다. 특히, 교육 현장에서 교수자와 학습자가 챗GPT를 활용해도 되는지, 활용을 한다면 그 범위는 어디까지인지, 가이드라인이나 윤리 강령을제시해야 하는지 등에 대해 현재까지 명확히 정리되지 않은 상태라고 할 수 있다. 이러한 점에서 챗GPT의 활용 현황 등의 전반적인 양상을 확인하고 앞으로의 방향성을 모색하는 것은 시의적절하다고 하겠다. 본 연구를 위해 챗GPT 관련 최신 국내·외 선행연구, 도서, 신문 기사 등의 문헌 자료를 종합적으로 조사하여 그 내용을 살펴보았다. 연구에 제시된 자료는 2023년 3~7월 경에 확인 가능한 최신 내용에 기반한 것이다. 이를토대로 챗GPT의 주요 특징과 관련 이슈, 국내·외 대응 현황, 대학교육에서의 대응 방안을 제시하였다. 본 연구를 통해 대학교육을 중심으로 챗GPT의 활용에 대한 대응 현황과 쟁점 등을 전반적으로 살펴보고 효과적인 교육 방안을 모색할 수 있을 것이다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to find the current response status and realistic improvements to ChatGPT in university education. ChatGPT has recently appeared in the 4.0 version and is visualizing various issues related to education and research at home and abroad. In particular, it can be said that it has not been clearly organized so far on whether instructors and learners can use ChatGPT in the educational field, what is the scope of it if they use it, and whether guidelines or ethics codes should be presented. In this respect, it is timely to check the overall aspects such as the current status of the use of ChatGPT and seek future directions. For this study, literature materials such as the latest domestic and foreign prior studies, books, and newspaper articles related to ChatGPT were comprehensively investigated and the contents were examined. The data presented in the study is based on the latest available from March to July 2023. Based on this, the main characteristics of ChatGPT, related issues, domestic and foreign response status, and improvements in university education were presented. Through this study, it will be possible to examine the overall response status and issues to ChatGPT, focusing on university education, and to find effective educational improvements.

title_ko: AI펭톡 활용 수업이 초등학생 영어 발음 능력 향상과 정의적 영역에 미치는 효과
title_en: Effects of AI PengTalk classes on improvement of English pronunciation abilities and affective factors of elementary students
kw_ko: AI펭톡 활용 수업; 영어 발음능력; 영어 발음의 정의적영역
kw_en: AI PengTalk classes; English pronunciation abilities; English pronunciation affective factors
abstract_ko: The aim of this study was to investigate effects of English classes using AI PengTalk on English pronunciation ability of elementary students and affective factors of English pronunciation. Forty-two participants (5th graders) were divided into experimental (n = 21) and control (n = 21) groups. Their pronunciation scores of pre-and post-pronunciation tests focusing on evaluating segmentals, intonation, stress and rhythm, and speech rate were quantitatively analyzed. Data from a questionnaire about affective factors of English pronunciation including a journal writing were quantitatively and qualitatively analyzed. Findings of this study indicated that: 1) there were statistically significant differences in English pronunciation abilities between the two groups, 2) there were also statistically significant differences in affective factors such as self-confidence, interests, and attitudes, and 3) students indicated in their responses to open-ended questions and their selfevaluation journal that AI PengTalk classes helped them speak English well and enhanced their self-confidence, interests, and positive attitudes in their pronunciation. These results suggest that AI PengTalk need to be actively used in schools as a good tool for developing students’ English pronunciation abilities and that primary school teachers should focus on their pronunciation teaching for promoting students’ self-confidence, interests, and attitudes towards pronunciation learning.
abstract_en: The aim of this study was to investigate effects of English classes using AI PengTalk on English pronunciation ability of elementary students and affective factors of English pronunciation. Forty-two participants (5th graders) were divided into experimental (n = 21) and control (n = 21) groups. Their pronunciation scores of pre-and post-pronunciation tests focusing on evaluating segmentals, intonation, stress and rhythm, and speech rate were quantitatively analyzed. Data from a questionnaire about affective factors of English pronunciation including a journal writing were quantitatively and qualitatively analyzed. Findings of this study indicated that: 1) there were statistically significant differences in English pronunciation abilities between the two groups, 2) there were also statistically significant differences in affective factors such as self-confidence, interests, and attitudes, and 3) students indicated in their responses to open-ended questions and their selfevaluation journal that AI PengTalk classes helped them speak English well and enhanced their self-confidence, interests, and positive attitudes in their pronunciation. These results suggest that AI PengTalk need to be actively used in schools as a good tool for developing students’ English pronunciation abilities and that primary school teachers should focus on their pronunciation teaching for promoting students’ self-confidence, interests, and attitudes towards pronunciation learning.

title_en: Phenomenological Study of Learner-Centered Learning Using Metaverse - Based Facilitation -
kw_ko: 메타버스; 게더타운; 퍼실리테이션; 학습자 중심 학습; 현상학
kw_en: Metaverse; GatherTown; facilitation; learner-centered learning; phenomenological study
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 메타버스 기반의 퍼실리테이션을 활용한 학습자 중심의 미디어 영어 학습을 현상학적 방법으로 분석하는 것이다. 충북 사립 대학교에서 교양 영어 수업을 메타버스 플랫폼의 하나인 게더타운에서 실행하고, 교수의 적절한 퍼실리테이션을 통해 학습자 중심의 수업을 하였다. 이 새로운 수업환경에서 학생들이 직접 경험 한 것, 교수의 역할, 학생들의 내적, 외적 변화를 Mustakas의 현상학적연구방법을 활용하여 NVivo 10 프로그램으로 심층 분석하였다. 연구 결과, 첫째, 학생들은 새로운 학습에 재미와 흥미를 느꼈고, 둘째, 교수는 학생의 참여와 협력을 촉진하는 퍼실리테이터의 역할을 하였으며, 셋째, 이 수업을 통해 학생들은 내적으로 능동적인 학습 동기를 가지게 되었으며, 넷째, 학생들은외적으로 학생들 간의 상호작용을 통해 학습자 중심의 학습을 경험하게 되었다. 마지막으로 메타버스를기반으로 한 영어 수업을 위해서는 교수자의 적절한 퍼실리테이션이 이루어져야 할 것이다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to analyze learner-centered Media English learning using Metaverse-based facilitation through a phenomenological method, which is a type of qualitative research. An English class at a private university in Chungcheongbuk-do was implemented in GatherTown, one of the Metaverse platforms, and made learner-centered through appropriate facilitation by the professor. The students' experiences in this new classroom environment, the professor's role, and the students' internal and external changes were analyzed in depth using Mustakas' phenomenological research method. First, students felt fun and interesting in new learning; Second, the professor played the role of a facilitator who promoted student participation and cooperation; Third, the class made students internally motivated to learn actively; and fourth, students externally experienced learner-centered learning through interaction among students. Finally, we discussed the need for proper facilitation by the instructor for a metaverse-based English class

title_ko: 초등영어교육에서 ChatGPT의 활용 방안 탐색
title_en: Exploring the utilization of ChatGPT in elementary English education
kw_en: ChatGPT; generating; feedback; recommendation; elementary English education
abstract_ko: This study explores the utilization of ChatGPT in elementary English education. Specific applications of ChatGPT in this educational context are examined to assess its utilization and explore effective implementation strategies. Data were collected using ChatGPT 3.5, categorizing the research content into two domains: generating data and evaluation questions, and feedback and recommendation. The results of this study indicate that ChatGPT effectively generates materials and evaluation questions essential for elementary English education, tailored to specific requirements. Additionally, the findings indicate that ChatGPT offers valuable feedback on learners' writing corrections and recommends suitable picture books. Additionally, the study proposed plans for enhancing the effectiveness of ChatGPT in elementary English education. It reveals that ChatGPT can proficiently employ appropriate teaching and learning methods or materials. As a result, this research provides a comprehensive plan for utilizing ChatGPT effectively in future English education, drawing insights from specific case studies in elementary English education. Furthermore, by using ChatGPT in elementary English education, learners can participate more independently and actively in their language learning, benefiting from individually customized teaching methods and materials. This research significantly contributes to the advancement of English education by using ChatGPT to provide a more personalized and engaging learning experience for elementary learners.

title_ko: 영어학습 플랫폼으로서의 ChatGPT 활용 방안
title_en: Application of ChatGPT for an English Learning Platform
kw_en: ChatGPT; chatbot; English learning; intelligent tutor system; intelligent adaptive learning
abstract_ko: This paper aims to explore the potential of ChatGPT to serve as a comprehensive English learning platform for public school context by analyzing previous literature and current AI-based chatbots. To this end, the study investigated the potential of ChatGPT through four research questions: First, what are the educational possibilities of English learning chatbots?; Second, what are the possibilities and limitations of English learning chatbots when applied in classroom lessons?; Third, how can ChatGPT be utilized in classroom lessons?; Fourth, how can ChatGPT be utilized when applied to an intelligent adaptive learning model? The main conclusions of this discussion are as follows: First, the capabilities of AI-based English learning chatbots rely on natural language processing abilities, conversation modeling, providing dynamic feedback to learners, and offering personalized learning experiences which are lack in existing AI chatbots. Second, conventional English learning chatbots have been utilized in school education as free conversation apps, debate-specific bots, and integrated learning platforms. Third, ChatGPT has the potential to be integrated into a language learning platform and applied in formal learning environments. Finally, this paper proposes a plan to utilize ChatGPT in the context of an intelligent adaptive learning model.

title_ko: The Implementation of ChatGPT-assisted Writing Instruction in ESL/EFL Classrooms
title_en: The Implementation of ChatGPT-assisted Writing Instruction in ESL/EFL Classrooms
kw_en: AI; NLP tools; Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT); ChatGPT; Deep Language Learning (DLL) models; ESL/EFL writing
abstract_ko: This article explores integrating AI tools like ChatGPT into university-level EFL writing instruction. It discusses several potential uses of ChatGPT in writing instruction, including brainstorming, drafting, revising, and editing. For brainstorming, ChatGPT can be used to generate ideas and prompts for students. For drafting, it can provide sentence structures and pre-writing activities that guide students to compose more complex and engaging constructions. For revision, it can help students avoid grammatical and syntactic errors, avoid inadvertent plagiarism, and analyze sentence structures to improve clarity, concision, and coherence. For editing, it can proofread the work for grammatical errors, and provide guidance on formatting and citation styles. It appears that implementing AI tools in ways that benefit students is a complex and difficult task for teachers, but they will continue to have a significant impact on higher education.

title_ko: 교양 글쓰기 수업에서 ChatGPT의 활용 가능성과 한계
title_en: Utilizing ChatGPT in Writing Classes －The Possibilities and Limitations－
kw_ko: 글쓰기; 글쓰기 교육; 글쓰기 윤리
kw_en: Writing; ChatGPT; Writing Education; Writing Ethics
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 교양 글쓰기 교육에서의 ChatGPT 활용 가능성과 한계를 짚어 보고 수업 현장에 적용할 수 있는 방법을 도출하기 위한 것이다. 최근 언론과 미디어에서 ChatGPT의 능력을 앞다퉈 보도하면서 새로운 기술에 대한 학생들의관심이 커지는 한편, 글쓰기 수업에서 이를 악용하는 것이나 글쓰기 윤리에 어긋나는 상황에 대한 우려도 커지고 있다. ChatGPT가 ‘사고 과정으로서의 글쓰기’를 인간처럼 해낼 수는 없을 것이라는 의견도 있으나, ChatGPT의 초고 작성 능력은 형식과 내용 면에서 예상 밖으로 뛰어나고, 아이디어 구상부터 문제제기, 목차 작성, 고쳐 쓰기 등 글쓰기의 전 과정을 완벽하게 수행해 낸다. 그러므로 전통적인 글쓰기 교육 방법만을 고수하며 ChatGPT의 활용을 금지하는방식은 비현실적이다. 이제는 수업 현장에서 학습자나 교수자가 능동적으로ChatGPT를 활용할 방법을 고민해야 할 것이다. 이에 이 논문에서는ChatGPT가 글쓰기의 전 과정에서 어떠한 역할을 할 수 있는지, 그리고 그 한계는 무엇인지 살펴보고, 문화비평문 쓰기 수업에서 ChatGPT를 단계적으로활용할 수 있는 방법을 제안하였다.
abstract_en: This study delves into the possibilities and limitations of employing ChatGPT within the context of general writing education and explores methods for actively integrating ChatGPT into classroom environments. As media coverage highlights the astonishing capabilities of ChatGPT, students’ curiosity about this novel technology intensifies. However, concerns regarding its potential misuse and ethical implications in writing education also escalate. While some skeptics reject the notion of ChatGPT replicating a human-like “thinking process” in writing, it has proven to exceed expectations with its advanced generation abilities in both form and content, seamlessly covering the entire writing process, from ideation to problem-solving, outlining, and editing. As a result, maintaining a rigid adherence to traditional writing education methods and outright prohibition of ChatGPT’s usage appear unrealistic. Instead, there arises a necessity to carefully contemplate how learners and instructors can actively harness the potential of ChatGPT in the classroom setting. This paper thoroughly examines the diverse roles ChatGPT can assume at each stage of the writing process while also identifying its inherent limitations. Moreover, we present a gradual approach to effectively integrating ChatGPT into cultural criticism writing classes.

title_ko: 인공지능을 활용한 <독해 질문 자동 생성기>의 개발 연구
title_en: The development of <Automatic Reading Comprehension Questions Cheon, Gyeongrok Generator> using artificial intelligence (AI)
kw_ko: 인공지능; 독해 질문; 사실적 질문; 추론적 질문; 독해 질문 자동 생성기
kw_en: AI; comprehension questions; literal questions; inferential questions; <Automatic Reading Comprehension Questions Generator>
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 인공지능을 활용한 <독해 질문 자동 생성기>를 개발하는 데에 있다. 이를 위하여 독해 질문의 유형을 ‘사실적 질문’과 ‘추론적 질문’으로 구분하였다. 사실적 질문은 텍스트에 답이 명시적으로 제시되어 있는 질문이다. 이에 비하여 추론적 질문은 텍스트에 답이 명시적으로 제시되어 있지는 않지만, 독자가 배경지식을 활용하여 답할 수 있는 질문이다. 또한 텍스트의 유형을 ‘서사체 텍스트’와 ‘설명체 텍스트’로 구분하였다. 서사체 텍스트에는 동화, 소설 등이 포함된다. 이에 비하여 설명체 텍스트에는 설명문, 논설문 등이 포함된다. 이와 관련된 데이터를 수집한 후에, 인공지능을 활용한 <독해 질문 자동 생성기>를 개발하였다. 이 질문 생성기는 4가지 기능을 제공한다. 첫 번째와 두 번째 기능은 사용자가 텍스트와 정답을 입력하면, 인공지능이 자동으로 질문을 생성하는 기능이다. 이를 통하여 사용자는 질문을 만드는 데에 드는 시간과 노력의 부담을 덜 수 있다. 이에 비하여 세 번째와 네 번째 기능은 사용자가 데이터를 추가하여, 새로운 인공지능 학습 모델을 만들 수 있는 기능이다. 이를 통하여 사용자는 자신의 연구 분야와 목적에 맞는 새로운 질문 생성기를 만들 수 있다. 본 연구에서 개발한 <독해 질문 자동 생성기>는 국어 교과의 읽기(독서) 분야 뿐만 아니라 여러 분야에서 활용할 수 있을 것으로 기대된다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to develop <Automatic Reading comprehension Questions Generator> using artificial intelligence. For this purpose, the types of reading comprehension questions were divided into ‘literal questions’ and ‘inferential questions’. In addition, the types of texts were divided into ‘narrative texts’ and ‘expository texts’. After collecting data related to this, we developed <Automatic Reading comprehension Questions Generator> using artificial intelligence. This question generator provides four functions. The first and second functions allow artificial intelligence to automatically generates questions when the users input texts and correct answers. Through this, the user can reduce the time and effort required to create questions. In contrast, the third and fourth functions allow users to add data to create new artificial intelligence learning models. Through this, users can create new question generators suitable for their research fields and purposes. The <Automatic Reading comprehension Questions Generator> developed in this study is expected to be used not only in the field of reading in Korean subjects, but also in various fields.

title_ko: AI 챗봇을 활용한 영어교육 프로그램이 언어교육 효과에 미치는 영향에 대한 메타분석
title_en: Meta-analysis on the effect of English education programs using AI Chatbots on language education effectiveness
kw_ko: AI 챗봇; 언어 교육효과; 메타분석
kw_en: AI chatbots; language education effectiveness; meta analysis
abstract_ko: This study aimed to analyze the effect size of English education programs using AI chatbots on EFL learners’ language education effectiveness as well as moderator variables affecting program effectiveness. Forty-four dissertations and academic journals published from 2002 to March 2023 were selected as the analysis subjects, and the effect size was calculated using a random effect model due to high heterogeneity among studies. A meta-regression analysis was performed to confirm moderation effects, and publication bias was verified using Egger’s regression test. The effect size of AI education programs was significant, with a moderate effect size (0.428; 95% CI: 0.310-0.546), and major variables affecting language education effectiveness included school level by age and length for a single class. In terms of school level, it showed a higher effect size in the order of college students, high school students, and elementary school students. The most effective length of a single class was found to be 51-60 minutes. The time range of 51-60 minutes is mainly associated with university student learning. From both the school level and the length of a single class perspectives, the effect size related to university students is the largest. This can be attributed to the higher likelihood of university students engaging in self-directed learning compared to younger learners. It is believed that self-directed learning time has contributed significantly to improving learning effectiveness. This study provides useful information for developing and application of AI education programs for EFL learners.

kw_ko: 인공지능; 정보 정확성; 데이터 신뢰성; 스페인어 교육

abstract_ko: 인공지능(Artificial Intelligence: AI) 기술의 발전으로 인해 언어 교육 분야에서도 AI 기반 언어 학습에 대한 관심이 점점 증가하고 있다. 그러나 관련 기술의 발전에도 불구하고 여전히 AI를 수업에 어떻게 적용할지에 대한 실제적인 방안은 확립되지 않고 있으며 이에 대한 효과성 검증도 충분하지 않은 실정이다. 이 논문에서는 국내 제 2외국어로서 스페인어 학습에서 ChatGPT와 같은 AI의 활용 방안에 대해 고찰하고자 한다. 구체적으로, ChatGPT를 통한 스페인어 구문 학습에 관한 몇 가지 가정적 상황들을 제시하고 ChatGPT가 생성한 답변에 대해 비판적으로 검토하고자 한다. 또한, ChatGPT의 활용에 따른 장단점 및 한계에 대해 논의하고, 스페인어 구문 학습에서 ChatGPT는 기존의 교실수업에서는 여러 여건상 실행하기 힘든 학습활동들을 보완할 수 있는 보조적 수단으로 활용될 수 있음을 제안하고자 한다. 즉, ChatGPT를 활용한 디지털 수업에서는 교수자의 적절한 개입을 통해 ChatGPT가 생성하는 정보의 정확성을 판별하고 데이터의 신뢰성을 검증하는데 있어 중요한 역할을 할 수 있다.
abstract_en: With the development of artificial intelligence (AI) technology, there is a growing interest in AI-based language learning in the field of language education. However, despite the advancement of related technologies, practical measures on how to apply AI to actual classes are still not established, and the effectiveness is not sufficiently verified. This paper aims to study the application of AI such as ChatGPT in learning Spanish as a second language in Korea. Specifically, I present several hypothetical situations for learning syntactic structures of Spanish through ChatGPT and critically examine the answers generated by ChatGPT. In addition, I discuss the advantages, disadvantages, and limitations of using ChatGPT, and suggest that ChatGPT can be used as a supplementary tool for learning syntactic structures of Spanish to complement traditional classroom instruction that may not be feasible in many situations. This means that in a digital classroom utilizing ChatGPT, appropriate intervention by the instructor can play an important role in determining the accuracy of the information generated by ChatGPT and verifying the reliability of the data.

title_ko: Exploring Linguistic Productivity of ChatGPT: A Comparison to L2 Learners in English Blending
title_en: Exploring Linguistic Productivity of ChatGPT: A Comparison to L2 Learners in English Blending
kw_en: linguistic productivity; ChatGPT; L2 learners; English blending
abstract_ko: This study examined the linguistic productivity of ChatGPT via two English blending experiments with L2 learners and analyzed the size of the blend and the source word order. The results support previous research by demonstrating that the length of the longer source word and the second source word influence the size of blends. The results also indicate that the relative lengths of the source words influence the order of source words in blends, particularly when the second source word is longer than the first. However, the patterns of blending created by humans and ChatGPT were not identical. The responses of human participants also demonstrate the effect of the presence of onsets in the first syllable of source words on the order of source words in blends, whereas those of ChatGPT do not. These results highlight the differences between human and artificial language production and call for additional research to improve LLMs such as ChatGPT.

title_ko: The Effect of Voice-enabled ChatGPT on Speaking Proficiency, Affective and Metacognitive Domains of Korean EFL Learners
title_en: The Effect of Voice-enabled ChatGPT on Speaking Proficiency, Affective and Metacognitive Domains of Korean EFL Learners
kw_en: ChatGPT; AI (Artificial Intelligence); Chatbot; L2 Speaking; Computer-assisted Language Learning (CALL); Technology-enhanced language learning
abstract_ko: AI chatbots have opened new possibilities for interactive and meaningful communication in foreign language learning. However, the effectiveness of AI chatbots in enhancing L2 speaking abilities remains unexplored. Furthermore, unlike existing chatbots, ChatGPT offers personalized instruction, feedback, and interactive conversations, holding high potential for L2 learning. Therefore, this study compared voice-enabled ChatGPT to peer practice for 33 Korean Grade 1 mid dle school students concerning overall speaking proficiency, sub-skills (vocabulary, grammar, fluency, pronunciation, and task completion), and affective/metacognitive aspects. Participants were randomly assigned to either the experimental group utiliz ing ChatGPT or the control group with peer interactions. Results revealed that the ChatGPT group significantly outperformed the group that interacted with their peers in L2 speaking proficiency. When it came to sub-skills, the gains were significantly higher in the ChatGPT group’s vocabulary. Moreover, the ChatGPT group showed significantly more improvement in all affective/metacognitive domains, while the control group only showed changes in confidence and motivation. The ChatGPT group showed positive changes in reduced anxiety and willingness to communicate in the classroom, significantly more than those in the peer interaction group. These findings highlight the efficacy of incorporating ChatGPT into L2 speaking class rooms and bring forward pedagogical implications for L2 acquisition
