title_ko: Evaluating ESL Speaking Assessments: A Comparative Analysis Between Traditional and AI-Assisted Methods
title_en: Evaluating ESL Speaking Assessments: A Comparative Analysis Between Traditional and AI-Assisted Methods
authors: 파딜라 존에드워드(Department of Digital Media, Soongsil University); 이강희(Department of Digital Media, Soongsil University)
kw_en: AI-powered assessments; Artificial intelligence; AI-based tools; English as second language; Youtube; Grammarly
abstract_ko: This paper conducts a thorough comparison between traditional assessment methods and AI-powered tools within the context of an ESL school, specifically focusing on evaluating English speaking skills. The aim is to evaluate the precision, usability, and accessibility of a newly proposed AI-assisted assessment method that incorporates technologies from platforms like YouTube and Grammarly, emphasizing that it does not require complex implementation or involve prohibitive costs. Our investigation thoroughly examines the accuracy and reliability of these AI technologies in accurately determining language proficiency among ESL learners. This paper provides detailed insights into both the potential and the limitations of current AI tools for precise evaluation of language skills. Our findings indicate that the AI-powered approach generally yields results that are comparable to those of traditional methods. This underscores the potential of the proposed AI tools to both standardize and streamline the assessment process in educational contexts. By integrating AI tools that are freely accessible, such as those offered by YouTube for video content and Grammarly for text analysis, this method proposes a cost-effective and scalable solution for ESL programs. Such integration is poised to revolutionize assessment practices by significantly enhancing both reliability and accessibility, potentially leading to widespread adoption in educational settings across the globe.

title_ko: 대학 영어 글쓰기 수업에서 아이디어 브레인스토밍을 위한 ChatGPT 활용 가능성 탐색
title_en: Exploring the Possibility of Using ChatGPT for Brainstorming Ideas in a College English Writing Class
kw_ko: 국내 영어 학습자; 영어 어휘 습득; EFL 환경; EFL 학습자; 챗봇
kw_en: Korean students of English; English vocabulary learning; EFL settings; EFL students; Chatbot
abstract_ko: The aim of this study is to explore the feasibility of using ChatGPT for brainstoring ideas in a collge-level English writing class. Specifically, it aims to investigate how Korean college students utilized ChatGPT during the brainstorming phase for English writing and how ChatGPT feedback influenced their essay writing process. To achieve this objective, the following research questions were established; 1) How did students use ChatGPT differently according to their English proficiency levels? 2) How did students’ English writings vary in terms of the extent and scope of their interactions with ChatGPT? This study qualitatively analyzed students’ prompts, ChatGPT feedback, and their writings by using QuillBot’s Word Counter, Grammarly, KCI literature similarity check service. Research finidngs indicate that 1) Intermediate to advanced-level students interacted with ChatGPT more actively than beginners. 2) Sentences written by advanced-level students based on ChatGPT feedback were relatively longer and more complex compared to those written by lower level students. 3) Regardless of students’ English proficiency levels, there has been a higher uptake of ideas rather than expressions created by ChatGPT. Based on the research findings, this study proposes effective ways to use ChatGPT in English writing classes.

title_ko: Exploring the Effects of ChatGPT on Video-Making Projects in an EFL Course
title_en: Exploring the Effects of ChatGPT on Video-Making Projects in an EFL Course
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI); ChatGPT; Video; Technology-Enhanced Language Learning; English as a Foreign Language (EFL)
abstract_ko: The purpose of the study is to develop a new method for English learning with the use of ChatGPT for video-making projects. All participants were 20 undergraduate students taking an EFL course held during the fall semester of 2023. Throughout the project, the students produced videos by completing three tasks: Preparation, Production, and Presentation. ChatGPT was used as a way to complete the tasks for learning vocabulary, phrases, and expressions related to video topics. The main data of the study were gathered through surveys to investigate students’ perspectives on learning English with ChatGPT. The questionnaire was developed based on the previous research. Major findings are as follows: First, the students showed a stable interest in language and culture. However, a shift was found in their learning priorities towards speaking, listening, and vocabulary. Interestingly, there was a consistent view of grammar as less important. The findings highlight the varied applications of ChatGPT in language learning regarding vocabulary, expressions, translation, pronunciation, spelling, grammar, and specific information. Despite certain limitations, this study provides insights into EFL learning by pinpointing more precise applications of ChatGPT in educational settings. ChatGPT offers interactive and effective learning experiences, facilitating a natural and engaging way to study English.
abstract_en: The purpose of the study is to develop a new method for English learning with the use of ChatGPT for video-making projects. All participants were 20 undergraduate students taking an EFL course held during the fall semester of 2023. Throughout the project, the students produced videos by completing three tasks: Preparation, Production, and Presentation. ChatGPT was used as a way to complete the tasks for learning vocabulary, phrases, and expressions related to video topics. The main data of the study were gathered through surveys to investigate students’ perspectives on learning English with ChatGPT. The questionnaire was developed based on the previous research. Major findings are as follows: First, the students showed a stable interest in language and culture. However, a shift was found in their learning priorities towards speaking, listening, and vocabulary. Interestingly, there was a consistent view of grammar as less important. The findings highlight the varied applications of ChatGPT in language learning regarding vocabulary, expressions, translation, pronunciation, spelling, grammar, and specific information. Despite certain limitations, this study provides insights into EFL learning by pinpointing more precise applications of ChatGPT in educational settings. ChatGPT offers interactive and effective learning experiences, facilitating a natural and engaging way to study English.

title_ko: 영어 쓰기 수업에서 피드백 보조도구로서의 ChatGPT 활용 가능성
title_en: Exploring ChatGPT’s potential as a supplementary feedback tool in English writing classes
kw_ko: 챗GPT/챗GPT 프롬프트/영어 쓰기 수업/쓰기 피드백
kw_en: ChatGPT/ChatGPT prompt/English writing classes/writing feedback
abstract_ko: This study analyzes students’ use of ChatGPT prompts to explore its potential as a supplementary feedback tool in English writing classes. Thirty-one pre-service teachers participated and were divided into high, middle, and low groups based on their self-evaluation, standardized test scores, and essay scores prior to receiving ChatGPT feedback. The data sources included their two essays, ChatGPT prompts, questionnaires, and transcripts from the second writing conference. The ChatGPT prompts and questionnaires were analyzed using descriptive statistics, and the writing conference transcripts were examined to understand the participants’ use of prompts. The results showed participants used prompts 40 times in the first assignment and 175 times in the second assignment. The average prompt usage increased from 1.5 times in the first assignment to 6.7 times in the second assignment. In terms of students’ levels, the high group used more prompts (5.58 times) than the middle (5 times) and the low groups (1.75 times). Notably, students who used ChatGPT commands five times or more were mostly from the high and middle groups. Differences in prompt usage patterns were also identified, with the high and middle groups engaging in more continuous and interactive conversations with ChatGPT. Students expressed satisfaction with ChatGPT’s feedback, particularly in vocabulary selection, grammar correction, and sentence generation.

title_ko: 초등학생의 인공지능에 대한 지각된 동질성과 사회적 존재감이 영어학습에 미치는 영향
title_en: Effects of Perceived Homophily and Social Presence on English Learning of Elementary School English Learners for AI tool
kw_ko: AI 펭톡; 영어 학습; 지각된 동질성; 사회적 존재감; 상호작용; 잘파세대
kw_en: AI PengTalk; English Learning; Perceived Homophily; Social Presence; Interaction; Zalpha Generation
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 AI 펭톡과 같은 디지털 도구와 학습자 간의 상호작용 가운데 학습자들이 기기에 대하여 인식하는 지각된 동질성과 사회적 존재감의 정도를 알아보고 이들이 영어 학습에 미치는 영향에 관하여 살펴보는 것이다. 이를 위하여 지각된 동질성 또는 사회적 존재감이 영어 학습에 대하여 정(+)의 영향을 미칠 것이라는 가설을 세우고 초등영어학습자 22명을 대상으로 한 실험을 통해 이를 검증해 보았다. 연구결과를 정리하면 우선, AI 펭톡이 지닌 가치, 태도 및 외모와 같은 요인은 영어 학습에 유의미한 영향을 미치는 것으로 나타났다. 다음으로 AI 펭톡 활용 영어 학습에 대한 학습자들의 사회적 존재감의 정도를 분석한 결과, 이해도와 친밀성은 AI 펭톡 활용 교육 필요성에 유의한 영향을 미치는 것으로 드러났다. 이와 같이 본 연구 결과를 종합해 보면 지각된 동질성이나 사회적 존재감 요소는 학습자들이 디지털 도구와 상호작용 함에 있어 중요한 역할을 담당하는 것으로 정리할 수 있었다. 이는 잘파세대(Zalpha Generation)의 초등학습자들을 위한 교육용 애플리케이션 제작과 보급에 있어 이러한 요소들을 잘 반영할 필요가 있음을 의미한다고 볼 수 있다.
abstract_en: This study aims to determine the degree to which elementary English learners perceive homophily and social presence in AI-powered tools, such as AI PengTalk, and examine their impact on English learning. To this end, a hypothesis was established that perceived homophily or social presence would positively (+) affect English learning. This hypothesis was tested through an experiment involving 22 elementary English learners. To summarize the research results, first, factors such as the values, attitudes, and appearances of AI PengTalk were found to have a significant influence on English learning. Next, an analysis of the degree of social presence among learners using AI PengTalk revealed that understanding and intimacy significantly affected the perceived necessity of AI PengTalk-based activities. Thus, it can be concluded that perceived homophily and social presence play important roles in learners’ interactions with digital tools. These findings suggest that such factors need to be carefully considered in the production and distribution of educational applications for elementary school learners, specifically those in the Zalpha Generation.
note: AI펭톡 지각된 동질성·사회적 존재감 영향

title_ko: 인공지능 챗봇 활용 영어교육이 초등학생의 영어 발음과 어휘력 향상에 미치는 영향
title_en: Effects of English Classes using AI Chat-bot on Improvement of English Pronunciation and Vocabulary Abilities of Elementary Students
kw_ko: 인공지능 챗봇; AI 펭톡; 영어 교육; AI펭톡 활용 수업; 영어 발음 능력; 영어 어휘력
kw_en: AI chatbot; AI Pengtalk; English education; English proununciation abilites; English vocabulary
abstract_ko: 영어교육의 궁극적 지향점은 ‘의사소통 역량’이다. 우리나라 학생들은 노출과 학습강도가 미흡한 상황이나, 인공지능(Artificial intelligence, AI) 챗봇을 이용한 외국어 회화 연습으로 이를 극복할 수 있다는 여러 연구 결과가 있다. 영어 인공지능 시스템인 AI 펭톡은 초등학교 학습자를 위해 제작된 맞춤형 인공지능 말하기 연습시스템이다. 본 연구에서는 AI 펭톡을 활용한 공교육 영어과 수업을 구성하고, 초등학생 학습자들의 발음 능력과 어휘력에 미치는 영향, 영어과 학습에 대한 정의적 영역에 대한 변화를 분석한다. 실험집단 20명, 통제 집단 20명으로 5학년 학생 전체 40명을 대상으로 10차시의 수업을 4주간 실시한 후 결과를 평가하였다. 결과에 따르면 두 집단 모두 발음 능력과 어휘력이 향상되었고, 실험집단의 경우 발음 능력 향상 정도에서 통제집단과 통계적으로 유의한 차이를 보였다. 학생들은 AI 펭톡을 활용한 영어 수업에 전반적으로 긍정적인 반응을 보였으며, 영어 학습에 대한 자신감이 향상된 것을 확인하였다.
abstract_en: The aim of study is investigate effects of English classes using Artificial intelligence(AI) Chatbot on English pronunciation and vocabulary ability of elementary students. Forty participants(5th graders) were divided into experimental(n=20) and control(n=20) groups. Their pronunciation scores of pre-and post-pronunciation tests focusing on segmentals, stress, intonation, speed and rhythm were quantitatively analyzed. Findings of this study indicated that: 1) There were statistically significant differences in pronunciation abilities between the two groups. 2) There were statistically improve in English vocabulary abilities in both group. 3) students responses to open-ended questions that AI Pengtalk classes enhanced their interests, and helped them speak English well, enhanced their interests, positive attitudes and self-confidence in their English study. These results suggest that AI Pengtalk is good tool for developing students’ English pronunciation abilities in schools.

title_ko: 인공지능 도구의 사용 현황과 인식 조사 - 일본어 전공 대학생들의 ChatGPT와 번역기 활용 분석 -
title_en: Survey on the Usage and Perception of AI Tools: An Analysis of ChatGPT and Translator Usage Among Korean Japanese Major College Students
kw_en: ChatGPT; translator; perception survey; usage status; artificial intelligence; 翻訳機; 認識調査; 使用状況; 人工知能
abstract_ko: 本稿は、日本語を専攻とする韓国の大学生152名を対象に、人工知能技術に代表さ れる翻訳機とChatGPTの使用状況と認識を調査し、人工知能ベースの教育ツールの効 率的な設計のための資料を提供することを目的とする。 調査の結果、すべての回答者において翻訳機の使用経験があり、大多数がネイ バー․パパゴを主に使用していた。翻訳機の使用は主に日韓の言語ペアに集中してお り、学習ツールとして活用されていることが分かった。翻訳機に対する回答者の高い 活用度と依存度が示され、このような結果は、翻訳機関連の研究と教育設計の必要性 と緊急性を示唆している。 一方、ChatGPTの使用経験は高かったが、使用頻度は低く、ユーザー満足度も翻訳 機に比べ低かった。ChatGPTの主な使用目的は学習支援と情報検索であったが、使用 事例と利点が十分に知られていないため、定期的なユーザーが少ないことが分かっ た。これらの結果は、翻訳機とChatGPTの活用が日本語学習に与える影響を明らかに し、技術受容に関する認識を把握することで、教育技術開発や政策立案に重要な情報 を提供する。 本稿では、現時点で翻訳機とChatGPTが語学専攻者にどのように認識され、どのよ うに活用されているかについての現状分析を行い、体系的な教育プログラム開発の必 要性を論じる。
abstract_en: This paper aims to provide data for efficient design of A.I-based educational tools by investigating the usage status and perceptions of translators and ChatGPT represented by A.I technologies among 152 Korean university students majoring in Japanese. The results showed that all respondents had experience using a translator, with the majority using NAVER Papago. The use of translators is mainly focused on Korean -Japanese language pairs and is being utilized as a learning tool. The respondents’ high utilization and reliance on translators suggest the need and urgency for translator-related research and instructional design. In contrast, ChatGPT was used more frequently but less frequently, and user satisfaction was lower than with translators. The main purposes of ChatGPT were academic support and information retrieval, but the use cases and benefits were not well understood, resulting in fewer regular users. These results shed light on the impact of using translators and ChatGPT on Japanese language learning and provide important information for educational technology development and policy formulation by identifying perceptions of technology acceptance. This paper suggests directions for how translators and ChatGPT have been used by language students and the need to develop systematic training programs.

title_ko: AI 학습을 활용한 초등학교 영어학습 부진아 연구
title_en: A study on using AI learning for elementary school students struggling with English
kw_ko: AI 프로그램(AI program); 영어 학습부진아(English-deficient students); 학습경험(learning experiences); 질적연구(qualitative study)
abstract_ko: This study implemented an AI program to improve the educational outcomes for students struggling with English. It focused on quantitatively measuring academic enhancements and collecting qualitative feedback from elementary students with English deficiencies who used the AI program. The research began by assessing the English proficiency of the participants. It then analyzed the academic progress of these students as they used the AI program. Finally, the study looked into the educational experiences provided by the AI program to the students, their parents, and their teachers. Key findings included limited time devoted to studying English outside of regular school hours and a general late start in English education among the students. Furthermore, the English proficiency of participants who used the AI program showed greater improvement compared to a control group that did not use the program. Interviews and journal entries from the study indicated that all students who completed the program were actively engaged and experienced enhancements in their English capabilities. The feedback highlighted the program's ability to foster strategic thinking and self-motivation for learning. It also noted that the program's conversational nature was particularly beneficial for improving communication skills, especially among introverted students, and that immediate feedback was crucial for effective learning.

title_ko: 대학교 교양 영작문 수업의 학습자 영작문과 생성형 AI 기계번역 결과물의 비교를 통한 학습 방안 제시
title_en: Enhancing College EFL Writing: Comparing Student Compositions and AI Translations
kw_ko: 교양 영작문; 기계번역; 인공지능; 오류 분석
kw_en: DeepL; English composition; machine translation; artificial intelligence; error analysis
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 대학교 교양 영작문 수업에서 학습자가 직접 작성한 영작문과 AI 기계 번역기를 사용한 결과물을 비교하여 어형적, 통사적, 어휘적 차이점을 분석하고 영어 글쓰기 수업의 학습 방안을 제시하고자 한다. 본 연구에서 학습자는 한국 고등 교육 과정에서 체육 수업 확대에 대한 찬반 의견을 한 단락의 국문으로 작성한 후 영작한 결과물과 DeepL Translate(이하 딥엘)로 번역한 결과물을 분석하였다. 그 결과, 학습자의 영작문은 관사 및 한정사의 오류 및 동사의 형태적 오류와 시제 오류 등이 발견되었으며, 통사적 측면에서는 학습자의 글이 단순하고 직접적 문장이 많고, 딥엘은 복문과 다양한 접속사를 활용하여 풍부한 문장을 생성하였다. 어휘 사용면에서 학습자 작문은 어휘의 부적절한 선택과 반복이 사용이 빈번하게 발견되었다. 이러한 결과를 토대로 초급 학습자의 영어 글쓰기 교육에서는 관사 및 한정사 사용, 동사의 다양한 형태와 기능, 어휘의 적절한 선택과 반복 회피, 복문 작성 연습 등을 강조할 필요가 있음을 제안한다.
abstract_en: This study aims to compare and analyze the morphological, syntactic, and lexical differences between English texts written by students and those generated using AI machine translation (DeepL) in a university-level English composition course. The research involved writing a paragraph in Korean expressing opinions on the expansion of physical education in the Korean high school curriculum, then translating it into English manually and using DeepL. The analysis revealed that student-written texts exhibited frequent errors in articles and determiners, verb forms, and tense usage, indicating significant morphological differences. Lexically, inappropriate word choices and repetitions were common in student writings. Syntactically, student texts tended to be simpler and more direct, while machine translations produced more complex sentences with varied conjunctions. Based on these findings, the study suggests emphasizing the correct use of articles and determiners, various verb forms, appropriate word choice, and the practice of writing complex sentences using conjunctions in English writing education.
note: 학습자 영작문 vs DeepL 번역 오류 비교 분석

title_ko: 초등 6학년 국어과 교육에서 생성형 인공지능 서비스를 활용한 수업 전략

kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능 서비스; 초등학교; 수업 전략; 국어교육
kw_en: Generative artificial intelligence service; elementary school; class strategy; Korean language educaction
abstract_ko: 연구목적: 본 연구의 목적은 초등학교 6학년 국어 수업에서 생성형 인공지능 서비스를 적용할 수 있는 전략을 제시하는 것이다. 연구방법: 연구대상은 초등학교 6학년 국어교육에서의 생성형 인공지능 서비스 활용방안이다. 연구의 절차는 다음과 같다. 첫째, 여러 생성형 인공지능 서비스 중 현장에서 활용하기에 적합한 생성형 인공지능 서비스를 선정하고, 그 특징을 분석한다. 둘째, 앞에서 선정된 인공지능 서비스의 6학년 국어과 차시별 활용 전략을 구체적인 교과서 내용과 연계하여 제시한다. 셋째, 제시된 전략에 대해서 여러 전문가와의 인터뷰를 통해 타당도를 검증한다. 연구결과: 속담 사전 만들기에 생성형 인공지능을 활용하는 전략을 제시하였다. 또, 관심있는 내용으로 뉴스 만들기 및 글 속에 등장하는 인물이 추구하는 가치를 자신의 삶과 관련짓기에 생성형 인공지능을 활용하는 전략을 제시하였다. 그리고 제시한 전략에 대하여 여러 전문가와의 인터뷰를 통한 타당도 검증을 하였다. 그리고 마지막으로 초등학교 6학년 국어과 수업에서 생성형 인공지능 서비스를 이용할 때 유의해야 할 지침을 제시하였다. 첫째, 생성형 인공지능을 국어 수업 시간에 활용할 때 명확한 목적을 가지고 활용해야 하며, 활용 제한점을 학생에게 반드시 안내해야 한다. 둘째, 인공지능이 주는 정보가 신뢰할 만한지 항상 확인하고 활용하도록 학생들에게 안내가 이루어져야 한다. 셋째, 학생이 생성형 인공지능을 통해 자신이 원하는 정보를 얻을 수 있도록 활용방안에 대해 미리 교육해야 한다. 논의 및 결론: 제시된 전략을 실제 교실에서 활용할 때에는 수업이 진행되는 상황에 맞게 변형하여 실제 수업을 진행해야 할 것이다. 본 연구와 다른 후속 연구를 통해 초등학교 6학년 국어과에서 생성형 인공지능 서비스를 좀 더 체계적으로 이용할 수 있도록 도움을 줄 수 있을 것으로 기대된다.
abstract_en: Purpose: The purpose of this study is to present strategies for applying generative artificial intelligence(AI) services in 6th grade Korean language classes. Method: The participants of the study are 6th grade elementary school students. The research procedure is as follows. First, among various generative AI services, a generative AI service suitable for use in the field is selected and its characteristics are analyzed. Second, specific teaching strategies for each lesson in the 6th grade Korean language class are presented in connection with specific textbook contents. Third, the validity of the proposed strategies is verified through interviews with several experts. Results: Strategies for using generative AI was presented to create a proverb dictionary. In addition, a strategy for using generative AI to create news with content of interest and to relate the values ​​pursued by characters appearing in the text to their own lives was presented. And The validity of the proposed strategies was verified through interviews with several experts. And finally, guidelines have been provided for using generative AI services in 6th Korean language classes. First, when using generative AI in Korean language classes, it must be used with clear purposes, and students must be informed of the limitations of its use. Second, students should be guided to check whether the information provided by AI is reliable and use it accordingly. Third, students must be educated in advance on how to utilize generative AI so that they can obtain the information they want. Conclusion: When implementing the presented strategies in an actual classroom, it should be modified to suit the situation in which the class is being taught. This study and other follow-up studies is expected that AI services can be used more systematically in 6th grade Korean language lessons with a useful assistance.
note: 초등 국어 차시별 생성형AI 수업전략 개발·전문가 타당화

title_ko: Exploring the Use of ChatGPT as a Tool for Written Corrective Feedback in an EFL Classroom
title_en: Exploring the Use of ChatGPT as a Tool for Written Corrective Feedback in an EFL Classroom
authors: Ho Sze Long(Education Bureau of Hong Kong SAR)
kw_en: EFL; writing; written corrective feedback (WCF); ChatGPT; AI tools; cognitive processing; Hong Kong
abstract_ko: 這項研究旨在探討可能影響ChatGPT作為寫作反饋工具效果的認知因素。研究參與者為香港一 所第二組別中學的五名中四學生。在每次會面中，他們被要求完成一項寫作任務，並根據從 ChatGPT收到的反饋進行修改。為了了解反饋處理過程中涉及的認知過程，在每次修改過程後， 學生均參加刺激回憶訪談。在第四次會面中，他們亦被問及對這種反饋使用感受。此項研究發 現兩個與寫作反饋效果相關的因素：（1）反饋能否被理解；（2）學習者能否在下次寫作時， 對反饋提供的改進方面，給予足夠的關注。學生們普遍重視反饋的使用，但承認有時無法理解 反饋或未能足夠關注反饋所針對的語言項目。建議進一步研究ChatGPT作為寫作反饋工具及其 不同的應用方法，有助於教師做出教學決策，以最大程度發揮反饋的效果。
abstract_en: The study aims at exploring cognitive factors that might have an impact on the effect of the use of ChatGPT as a writing feedback giving tool. Five Form four students in a Band two secondary school in Hong Kong participated in the study. In each meeting session, they were asked to write a writing task and revise it based on the feedback received from ChatGPT. To understand more about the cognitive processes involved when the feedback is processed, a stimulated recall interview was conducted after each revision process. In the fourth meeting, some questions regarding how they feel about the use of this kind of feedback were asked. Two factors were found to be related to the effectiveness of the WCF: (1) whether the feedback could be processed with understanding; (2) whether the learners can pay enough attention to the areas for improvement provided by the feedback the next time they write. Students generally value the use of feedback but admitted that sometimes failing to understand the feedback or pay enough attention to the language items targeted. Further research into the effect of ChatGPT as a writing feedback giving tool with variation can help teachers make pedagogical decisions to maximize the effect of the feedback.
note: ChatGPT 쓰기 교정 피드백, 자극회상 면담 5명

title_ko: Exploring the Efficacy of ChatGPT as a Language Learning and Assessing Tool
title_en: Exploring the Efficacy of ChatGPT as a Language Learning and Assessing Tool
kw_en: ChatGPT; College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT); Large Language Model (LLM)
abstract_ko: This study aims to assess how well ChatGPT-3.5 performs on the English reading comprehension section of the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT, henceforth), with a focus on its viability as a tool for language learning and evaluation. To do this, tests were conducted where ChatGPT answered questions from the 2022 to 2024 CSAT English exams, and its accuracy was recorded. The research also looks into how ChatGPT’s performance changes depending on the type of question and the version of the AI. The results showed that ChatGPT-3.5 correctly answered about 74.1% of the questions, whereas GPT- 4 had nearly flawless accuracy. The research outlines the capabilities and shortcomings of the large language model (LLM) and discusses areas that require enhancement for educational use. Furthermore, the research examined if these trends hold true for other international English language tests, specifically using reading questions from the TOEFL iBT. Similar performance trends were observed with the TOEFL iBT. The findings indicate that the LLM’s abilities in reasoning and explanation could benefit language education. However, it also emphasizes the necessity for ChatGPT to acquire more specific knowledge and improved reasoning abilities to understand context better.

title_ko: 체화된 인지 기반 초등 영어 학습 활동 개발 및 적용: IPA(Intelligent Personal Assistant)로서 ChatGPT의 효과적 활용
title_en: A Study on the Development and Application of Embodied Cognition-Based Elementary English Learning Activities: Effective Utilization of ChatGPT as an Intelligent Personal Assistant
kw_en: embodied cognition; generative AI; ChatGPT-4; action research
abstract_ko: This study explores the use of ChatGPT as an Intelligent Personal Assistant (IPA) in developing embodied cognition-based English learning activities for elementary students. Embodied cognition emphasizes the integration of mind, body, and environment, prompting physical engagement in learning. Conducted with 23 fifth-grade students, the research utilized interactions with ChatGPT and prompt engineering to create and refine English learning activities, categorized into two intensity groups based on the 'Embodied Cognition-Based English Learning Activity Checklist’. The study employed an action research model and involved memory tests and affective domain assessments. Initial findings indicated that while students enjoyed the physical aspects, they struggled to recall key sentences in English. Subsequent revisions to the activities led to improvements in English memory scores. The affective domain also showed positive enhancements in interest, motivation, anxiety, confidence, and attitude. However, further studies are recommended for comparing between groups and varying English proficiency levels. Also, further research is needed to explore the potential of using ChatGPT for English learning and assessment utilizing prompt engineering and RAG strategies. Finally, it is necessary to conduct research on the application of ChatGPT as an IPA in the context of teaching and learning, as well as in the assessment domain.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 시대의 대학 글쓰기 교육 방향 - 논증적 글쓰기에서 생성형 AI 사용을 중심으로 -
title_en: A Way of University Writing Education in the Era of Generative AI -Focused on Use of Generative AI in Argumentative Writing-
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 챗GPT; 대학 글쓰기; 논증적 글쓰기; 사고의 표현; 글쓰기의 인지적 과정
kw_en: Generative AI; ChatGPT; University Writing; Argumentative Writing; Expression of Thought; Cognitive Process of Writing
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 생성형 AI 시대의 대학 글쓰기 방향을 탐색하는 작업이다. 특히 논증적 글쓰기에서의 생성형 AI 사용 가능성을 살펴보고자 한다. 이를 위해 먼저 글쓰기 교육에서 활발히 논의되고 있는 생성형 AI의 활용논쟁에 대해 정리하였다. 그 결과 ‘새로운 기술의 적극적 활용’과 ‘글쓰기의 교육적 가치 재인식’ 입장으로 대별되었다. 그런 다음 논증적 글쓰기의본질과 생성형 AI의 위상을 정립하였다. 논증적 글쓰기가 특히 사고의 표현이자 학문 공동체의 입문이며 인지적 과정을 중시한다는 점을 확인하였다. 이에 생성형 AI는 논증적 글쓰기에서 ‘활용’이 아닌 ‘사용’의 위상을 지닌다는 것을 파악하였다. 이를 바탕으로 논증적 글쓰기에서 생성형 AI의 사용 방안을 가늠하였다. Kellogg(1999)의 인지적 글쓰기 모형에서 생성형 AI가 필자의 사고와 표현 과정에 조력할 수 있는 지점과 세부 활동을 제시하였다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to explore the direction of university writing in the era of generative AI, particularly focusing on the potential use of generative AI in argumentative writing. To accomplish this aim, this study first summarized the debate surrounding the active utilization of generative AI in writing education, which is currently under vigorous discussion. The results revealed two contrasting perspectives: “embracing the proactive utilization of new technology” versus “reconsidering the educational value of writing.” And then, this study established the essence of argumentative writing and the role of generative AI within it. It was confirmed that argumentative writing serves as both an expression of thought and an entry point into academic communities, emphasizing cognitive processes. In light of this, this study was recognized that generative AI holds a position of “use” rather than “utilization” in argumentative writing. Building upon this understanding, potential ways of incorporating generative AI into argumentative writing were explored. Drawing from Kellogg(1999)’s cognitive writing model, specific points and activities where generative AI could assist in the author's thought and expression processes were outlined.
note: L1 대학 글쓰기 방향론, 실제 적용 없음(prev Y)

title_ko: 대학 글쓰기 수업에서의 ChatGPT ‘환각(Hallucination)’ 교육 사례 연구
title_en: A Case Study of ChatGPT 'Hallucination' Training in a University Writing Class
kw_ko: ChatGPT ‘환각(Hallucination)’; 대학 글쓰기; 환각 교육; 환각 유형; 환각 완화 방안
kw_en: ChatGPT; ChatGPT 'Hallucination'; College Writing; Hallucination Education; Types of Hallucination; Hallucination Mitigation
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 학습자들이 ChatGPT를 학습 도구로 적절하고 주체적으로 활용하기 위해서는 ChatGPT의 오류와 한계에 대해 정확히 이해를 하고 있어야 한다는 문제의식에서 ChatGPT의 ‘환각’ 완화 방안 교육의 필요성과 함께 교육 방안과 사례를 제시하였다. H대학의 필수 교양 <말하기와 글쓰기> 수업 3개 분반 학습자를 대상으로 75분 2차시에 걸쳐 ‘환각’ 개념 이해, 유형에 따른 분류, 완화 방안 교육을 실시하였다. 개념 이해 및 사례 찾기 활동을 통해 학습자의 흥미를 유발하고, ‘환각’의 위험성을 공유하였으며, ‘환각’의 유형 교육에서는 기존 연구 결과를 토대로 ‘환각’ 유형을 소개하여 ChatGPT ‘환각’에 대한 이해를 높였다. ‘환각’ 완화 방안 교육에서는 프롬프트 작성 단계와 답변 결과를 검증하는 단계로 나누어 학습자가 ChatGPT ‘환각’ 발생을 완화하기 위해 참조할 수 있는 방안을 추천했다. 매 차시 교육 효과를 검증하기 위하여 퀴즈를 제시하여 개념을 알고 있는지 지식 측면의 이해를 확인하였고, 실제로 ‘환각’의 오류를 수정할 수 있는지를 확인하였다. 이어서 설문조사를 실시하여 유형, 개념, 완화 방안 순으로 학습자에게 도움이 되었음을 확인하였다. ‘환각’ 교육의 효과에 대한 긍정적인 평가는 학습자들이 ‘환각’에 대한 경각심을 갖게 되었다는 점, 검증 필요성 및 그 어려움을 인식하게 되었다는 점, 검색 엔진과의 비교를 진행하여 더 적절한 학습 ‘도구’를 선택할 수 있는 기준을 세우게 되었다는 점 등에서 찾을 수 있다.
abstract_en: This study started from the problem that learners should have a clear understanding of the errors and limitations of ChatGPT in order to properly and actively utilize it as a learning tool. This study presented the need for 'Hallucination' education of ChatGPT, as well as education plans and examples. The study was conducted on 105 learners in three classes of H University's required liberal arts <speaking and writing> class. Two 75-minute sessions were conducted to understand the concept of 'Hallucinations,' categorize them by type, and provide mitigation measures. Conceptualization and case-finding activities were used to arouse learners' interest and share the dangers of hallucinations. In the 'Hallucination Types' training, we introduced the types of 'Hallucinations' based on existing research results to enhance the understanding of ChatGPT 'Hallucinations'. In the 'Hallucination Mitigation Measures' training, we recommended measures that learners can refer to in order to mitigate the occurrence of ChatGPT hallucinations by dividing the training into the steps of creating prompts and validating the answer results. To verify the effectiveness of the training, a quiz was given after each session to check the knowledge and understanding of the concepts, and to see if they could actually correct the 'hallucination' errors. Afterward, a survey was conducted to confirm that the training was helpful to the learners in understanding the type, concept, and mitigation measures. The positive evaluation of the effectiveness of the 'Hallucinations' training was based on the learners' awareness of 'Hallucinations', the need for verification and its difficulties, and the comparison with search engines, which provided a basis for choosing a more appropriate learning tool.
note: 교양 말하기와 글쓰기 환각 교육

title_ko: AI 시대 논증적 글쓰기를 위한 프롬프팅 연구- 메타인지를 활용한 ChatGPT 글쓰기 수업 방법을 중심으로
title_en: A Study on on Prompting for Argumentative Writing in the AI Era－ Focusing on ChatGPT Writing Instruction Methods Utilizing Metacognition
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 인공지능; 대학 글쓰기; 논증적글쓰기; 리터러시; 글쓰기; 메타인지
kw_en: ChatGPT; Artificial Intelligence; University Writing; Argumentative Writing; Literacy; Writing; Metacognition
abstract_ko: ChatGPT 등장 이후 글쓰기 환경이 달라진 것은 주지의 사실이다. 대학 글쓰기 교육의 변형된 의식·태도·사례를 분석하는 일 또한 인공지능의 등장이라는 담론적 고찰과 함께 사유되고 있다. 이런 가운데 대학 글쓰기 수업에서는 기술적 차원을 넘어 학습자가 필수적으로 함양해야 하는 역량이 요구된다. 그것은 뉴미디어와 알고리즘에빈번하게 노출된 학습자 세대의 무의식적 편향성에 대처할 수 있도록 논증적 글쓰기를 통한 논리 체계와 비판의식, 메타인지적 관점을 습득하는 것이다. 실제 수업에서 AI 활용을 위한 프롬프팅(prompting)을 논의하는 일은 상술한 과정을 수반하는 데 필요한 작업으로 판단된다. 따라서 본 논문에서는 인공지능의 글쓰기와 대학 글쓰기 교육에 대한 시의적 논의와 함께 인간‘스러운’ 기계를 ‘도전 상대’ 또는 ‘특별한 존재’로 격하 내지 격상시키는 담론틀에서 벗어나 ‘글쓰기를 위한 유용한 도구’로 받아들이고 활용 방법론을 구상하기 위해 실험과 실습 과정을 제시하고있다. 도래할 범용인공지능(AGI, Artificial General Intelligence) 시대에 발맞추어 인공지능 기술의 역할은 점점 더 넓어질 것이다. 이러한 실정에 수업 도구로써 ChatGPT의적절성을 판단하는 일 또한 유보할 수 없다. 인공지능의 역할은 인간의 고유한 영역을빼앗는 것이 아니라 인간 고유의 영역을 효율적으로 조력하는 방향으로 나아가야 한다는 것이 본 논문의 테제이다. 이를 위해 최근 인공지능을 활용한 논증적 글쓰기 교육의 실습 사례와 교재를 분석했다. 이에 대한 유용성과 한계를 타진한 후 오늘날 글쓰기 교육의 주체인 학생들에게 인공지능을 활용할 때 어떤 방식의 프롬프팅을 제시해야 하는지 고찰하였다.
abstract_en: The emergence of ChatGPT has undoubtedly transformed the landscape of writ ing. Accordingly, the modified awareness, attitudes, and cases in university-level writing education are being contemplated in conjunction with the discourse on the advent of artificial intelligence. In this context, university writing courses demand the acquisition of essential competencies that go beyond the technical dimension, such as the logical frame work, critical thinking, and metacognitive perspectives through argumentative writing. Discussing the use of AI, particularly prompting, is deemed necessary to facilitate this process. This paper presents experiments and practices to move away from the discourse that either degrades or elevates AI as a “challenger” or “special entity,” and in stead, to embrace it as a “useful tool” for writing. As the era of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) approaches, the role of AI technology will continue to expand. Accordingly, evaluating the appropriateness of using ChatGPT as an instructional tool is unavoidable. The thesis of this paper is that the role of AI should not be to usurp the unique domains of humans but to efficiently assist them. To this end, the study analyzes recent practical cases and teaching materials that utilize AI in argumentative writ ing education, exploring their usefulness and limitations. It then examines the type of prompting that should be provided to students, the primary agents of today's writing education, when employing AI.

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능 모델로 생성한 오류의 수정을 통한 독일어 문법 학습의 효과
title_en: Lerneffekt der deutschen Grammatik durch die Korrektur von mit generativer KI erzeugten Grammatikfehlern
kw_ko: 독일어 교육; 독일어 문법 교육; 오류 분석; 생성형 인공지능
kw_en: Deutschunterricht; Deutschgrammatikunterricht; Fehleranalyse; Generative Künstliche Intelligenz
abstract_ko: 본 연구에서는 생성형 인공지능 모델로 독일어 문법 오류를 포함하는 문장을 생성하고, 학습자가 이에 대한 문법성을 판단하고 직접 오류를 수정함으로써 독일어 문법을 학습하는 방식에 대해 논의한다. 학습자가 작성한 독일어 텍스트에 대한 생성형 인공지능 모델의 교정을 통해 부수적으로 문법을 학습할 수 있음을 밝힌 기존 연구들과 달리, 본 연구는 사용자가 직접 오류를 수정할 것을 목표로 의도적으로 문법 오류 문장을 생성형 인공지능 모델에 요구하고 생성된 학습 자료를 바탕으로 독일어 문법을 학습하는 것을 제안한다. 이를 위해 독어독문학 전공 대학생 16명을 대상으로 실험을 진행하였다. 문법 주제는 관사와 동사 어미변화로 선정하였고, 각각 총 3번의 실험을 수행하였다. 실험 결과 독일어 관사에 대한 오류 수정에서는 실험 회차가 진행됨에 따라 정답률이 상승하는 것을 확인할 수 있었지만, 초급 학습자의 수준에 맞는 실험 재료를 생성하지 못해 동사 어미변화의 경우 실험 1, 2회차에서는 정답률이 상승했지만 3회차에서 정답률이 급격하게 하락하였다. 본 연구는 기존의 DaF 교재에 부재한 연습문제 유형을 최근 활발하게 활용되고 있는 생성형 인공지능 모델을 이용해 생성함으로써 새로운 교육⋅학습법을 제안한다는 의의가 있다. 하지만 실험에 참여한 피험자 수가 다소 부족하고 오류 수정과 문법 학습 간의 직접적인 상관관계를 보여줄 수 있는 실험 설계의 부족 등의 한계점이 있어 이를 보완하기 위한 향후 연구계획을 밝히며 논문을 마무리한다.
abstract_en: In der vorliegenden Untersuchung wird eine Methode zur Nutzung eines generativen künstlichen Intelligenz (‘generative KI’) Modells für das Lehren und Lernen der deutschen Grammatik vorgeschlagen. Bisher wird generative KI hauptsächlich zum Sprechen oder Schreiben von Fremdsprachen eingesetzt, diese Studie befasst sich jedoch mit dem Erlernen der Grammatik von Fremdsprachen. Diese Studie schlägt vor, mithilfe generativer KI deutsche Sätze zu erstellen, die grammatikalische Fehler enthalten, und die Lernende die deutsche Grammatik lernen, indem sie die grammatikalischen Fehler in den Sätzen selbst korrigieren. Da diese Methode absichtlich von der generativen KI verlangt, Sätze mit Grammatikfehlern zu erzeugen, ist sie weniger anfällig für das Problem der Halluzinationen. Um den Lerneffekt der vorgeschlagenen Methode zu überprüfen, wird ein Experiment mit Deutschlernenden durchgeführt. Insgesamt nahmen 16 Studierende an dem Experiment teil, und durch dieses Experiment wurden zwei Grammatikthemen erlernt: Artikel und Verbformen (Konjugation) im Präsens und Perfekt. Für jedes Experimentthema werden drei Versuche durchgeführt und beobachtet, ob sich der Prozentsatz der richtigen Antworten veränderte. Das Ergebnis für Experiment 1 (Artikel) zeigte, dass der Prozentsatz der richtigen Antworten allmählich anstieg, wenn die Grammatik durch Fehlerkorrektur gelernt wird. Im Fall von Experiment 2 (Konjugation) nahm der Prozentsatz richtiger Antworten jedoch im dritten Versuch ab. Es wird angenommen, dass dies darauf zurückzuführen ist, dass die im dritten Experiment von Thema 2 verwendeten Sätze viele Wörter enthielten, die die Studierende nicht kannten.
note: 독일어 문법 학습

title_ko: EFL 대학생의 영어 말하기 학습 플랫폼으로서 ChatGPT 활용 가능성 탐색
title_en: Exploring Expoitability of ChatGPT as a Learning Platform for EFL College Students’ Speaking
kw_en: users’ prompts; requests; Talk-To-ChatGPT (TTC); feedback from ChatGPT; interaction with AI
abstract_ko: The purpose of this research was to investigate the characteristics of questions and requests used by Korean college students, and feedback generated by Talk-To-ChatGPT (hereafter TTC) as they were involved in English speaking practice by using TTC for five weeks. Five conversations conducted by six students were converted into text files, and a total of 30 conversation files were analyzed, in terms of vocabulary use, syntactic structure, and semantic cohesion. The results of data analysis showed that, first, the students used longer sentences and more words in their questions and requests as their involvement was more intensified. Second, there was no statistically significant difference in the average length of sentences and words in TTC feedback over five conversations with the students. However, the average word length of TTC feedback was relatively longer than the average word length of the student's questions and requests. Based on these findings, the pedagogical implication that ChatGPT tools such as TTC can be utilized as an effective human-like interlocutor for English speaking practice is suggested.

title_ko: Exploring the Efficacy of ChatGPT in Improving L2 Writers’ Use of English Conjunctive Adjuncts
title_en: Exploring the Efficacy of ChatGPT in Improving L2 Writers’ Use of English Conjunctive Adjuncts
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 연결사; 코퍼스 분석; 한국인 영어학습자; 제2언어쓰기
kw_en: ChatGPT; conjunction; corpus analysis; EFL learner; L2 writing
abstract_ko: This study explored the impact of ChatGPT on L2 academic writing by focusing on the use of conjunctive adjuncts (or “conjunctions,” e.g., and, but, since, however, as a result, on the other hand) among L1-Korean college students. A mixed-methods approach was adopted to compare a treatment group interacting with ChatGPT (n = 36) with a control group interacting with peers (n = 40) during instructional activities designed to teach these structures’ usage. Quantitative results indicated no significant difference in the frequency or types of conjunctions used between the two groups, suggesting that ChatGPT’s influence on conjunction usage patterns was minimal. However, a manual analysis revealed that the treatment group demonstrated more formal and structured uses of conjunctions, aligning with academic writing norms, while the control group more frequently deviated from these norms, by, for instance, starting sentences with coordinating conjunctions and using incorrect structures such as sentence fragments. While this study had a small sample size and a narrow focus on only one aspect of grammar, its results suggested a need to more comprehensively assess AI’s potential to complement traditional language learning methods.

title_ko: How to Use AI for English Education in EFL Contexts: Several Suggestions from the Second Language Acquisition Perspectives
title_en: How to Use AI for English Education in EFL Contexts: Several Suggestions from the Second Language Acquisition Perspectives
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI); EFL; Second Language Acquisition; Limitations of AI; Prompt Engineering
abstract_ko: This paper explores the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in English education through the lens of Second Language Acquisition (SLA) principles. It addresses the challenges EFL learners face, such as insufficient L2 input, limited meaningful interactions, and the difficulty of deactivating the L1. While AI offers significant advantages, including providing abundant, tailored L2 input and reducing anxiety associated with language practice, it also has notable limitations. This paper examines these limitations through SLA research and presents strategies to enhance accuracy, fluency, and socio-pragmatic competence using effective prompt engineering. It emphasizes the role of teachers in guiding AI use to ensure that feedback aligns with learners’ proficiency levels and educational needs. Furthermore, the paper suggests structured approaches to AI-facilitated learning to optimize educational outcomes. Integrating AI with traditional SLA principles presents a promising avenue for advancing EFL education, offering personalized and effective learning experiences.

title_ko: ChatGPT in the EFL Writing Classroom: Perceptions of AI Chatbot Assistance Among Korean University Students
title_en: ChatGPT in the EFL Writing Classroom: Perceptions of AI Chatbot Assistance Among Korean University Students
kw_ko: AI-활용 L2 글쓰기 지도; 챗봇; L2 글쓰기 교육/학습. 학습자 변수; 학습 효과
kw_en: iCALL; ChatGPT; EFL; AI-assisted L2 writing instruction; chatbots; L2 writing teaching/learning; learner variables; learning effect
abstract_ko: This study explored the perceptions of Korean university students studying English as a foreign language (EFL) after using the AI chatbot tool ChatGPT in an advanced writing class for one semester. A questionnaire was used to collect data from students about three learner variables (being comfortable in completing a task, being motivated to complete a task, and being confident that they can complete a task). The questionnaire also asked students if they felt their learning experience was improved by using AI tools (as opposed to classes taught only using traditional methods) and if they thought a blended method using both AI tools and traditional methods was preferable to one using strictly one or the other. The results showed that students were much more comfortable writing in English with the assistance of AI writing tools, that they felt less anxiety while completing tasks with the assistance of AI writing tools, and that they felt more confident when writing in English with the assistance of AI writing tools. They also indicated that using AI writing tools in the classroom was preferable to classes taught only in the traditional method, and that classes using a blended method were preferable to those taught using strictly AI tools or traditional methods alone.

title_ko: 인공지능과 메타버스를 활용한 MBTI 맞춤형 영어교육 콘텐츠 제작 및 서비스러닝: 블록체인 오픈배지 도입
title_en: AI and Metaverse in MBTI-Customized English Learning Content for Service Learning: Implementing Blockchain Open Badges
kw_en: service-learning; digital open badge; personalized education; MBTI; customized content
abstract_ko: This study aimed to develop MBTI-based customized English education content using artificial intelligence and the metaverse, integrated with the PARADE (Preparation-Action-Reflection-Achievement-Digital open badge-Evaluation) service learning model. The customized content was crafted using the listening questions of previous college entrance exams, involving a total of 32 pre-service English teachers. Data sources included the pre-service teachers’ self-reflection journals, customized content creations, and feedback from students participating in the service learning, which were analyzed via content analysis. The results provided insights into achieving personalized education through practical student grouping methods and highlighted the importance of engaging in English learning. The study also stressed the need for preparing pre-service teachers for future educational challenges. By issuing blockchain-based digital badges, this study aimed to provide official recognition of the pre-service teachers’ achievements through a transparent and reliable certification system. The research concludes with several implications derived from the findings.
abstract_en: This study aimed to develop MBTI-based customized English education content using artificial intelligence and the metaverse, integrated with the PARADE (Preparation-Action-Reflection-Achievement-Digital open badge-Evaluation) service learning model. The customized content was crafted using the listening questions of previous college entrance exams, involving a total of 32 pre-service English teachers. Data sources included the pre-service teachers’ self-reflection journals, customized content creations, and feedback from students participating in the service learning, which were analyzed via content analysis. The results provided insights into achieving personalized education through practical student grouping methods and highlighted the importance of engaging in English learning. The study also stressed the need for preparing pre-service teachers for future educational challenges. By issuing blockchain-based digital badges, this study aimed to provide official recognition of the pre-service teachers’ achievements through a transparent and reliable certification system. The research concludes with several implications derived from the findings.

title_ko: 일본어 문법 수업에서의 ChatGPT 활용에 대한 사례 연구
title_en: A Case Study on the Utilization of ChatGPT in Japanese Grammar Classes
kw_ko: 문법수업; 사례연구; 설문조사
kw_en: 文法授業、ChatGPT、事例研究、アンケート調査; Grammar Class; ChatGPT; Case Study; Survey
abstract_ko: 本研究は、日本語文法の授業にChatGPTを活用した授業実践の事例研 究である。授業では文法項目に関する説明の後、受講生にChatGPTを自分の学習に使わせた。そして文法の学習にChatGPTを活用することの有効性と問題点を探るため、アンケート調査を行った。調査の結果から、ChatGPTは日本語の文法学習の補助ツールとしての有用性が高いことがわかった。また、ChatGPTの使用は、各学習者の日本語レベルに合わせた個別․自律学習にも役立つ可能性が高いこともわかった。そして今回の授業で学生達はChatGPTを使う上で、本人が望む良い答えを得るためには具体的でかつ明確な指示を出すことの大切さを経験することができ、これからの学習に活かせると考える。 しかし、ChatGPTの最大の短所は、情報の信頼性の問題である。ChatGPTが間違った答えを出した場合、今のところ、学習者が自らそれを確認․検証するしか方法がない。このような場合は適切なフィードバックを行うなどの教師側の役割が重要となる。今回の実践事例が、文法の授業だけではなく、語学関連授業でのChatGPTの活用についてのヒントとなることを期待する。
abstract_en: This research is a case study on the utilization of ChatGPT in Japanese grammar classes. In the class, after explaining grammatical points, students were encouraged to use ChatGPT for their own learning. A survey was conducted in order to explore the effectiveness and issues of using Chat GPT in grammar learning. The survey results indicated that ChatGPT is highly useful as an auxiliary tool for learning Japanese grammar. Additionally, it was found that using ChatGPT could potentially helpful in individualized and self-directed learning tailored to each learner's Japanese proficiency level. However, the biggest drawback of ChatGPT is the reliability of the information. When ChatGPT provides incorrect answers, learners currently have no choice but to verify and confirm the information by themselves. In such cases, the role of the teacher in providing appropriate feedback becomes crucial. It is hoped that this practical case study will provide insights into the utilization of ChatGPT not only in grammar classes but also in other language -related classes.
note: 일본어 문법 수업

title_ko: 챗GPT를 활용한 통합적 일본어 교육의 가능성에 대한 고찰
title_en: A Study on the Potential of Integrated Japanese Language Education Using ChatGPT
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 일본어교육; 통합교육; 학습툴
kw_en: チャットGPT、日本語教育、統合教育、学習ツール; Chat GPT; Japanese language education; Integrated education; Learning tool
abstract_ko: ChatGPTは、教育現場での教授法の領域にとどまらず、教師の業務負担を軽減するなどの教育行政の領域においても、その活用可能性が試みられており、その役割が徐々に拡大していることが分かる。教育現場においてChatGPTの活用が拡大することが明らかな現時点では、ChatGPTを教育補助ツールとして活用することが有効であると予想される。本稿では、教育分野におけるChatGPTの事例を検討し、既存の日本語文法教育の現状とその限界点を確認した上で、ChatGPTを活用した統合的な日本語教育の可能性について考察した。日本語教育のさまざまな角度からChatGPTの活用が試みられ、その有効性が証明されつつある。しかし、ChatGPT活用に対する明確な評価基準の欠如や、ChatGPTを用いた実際の授業における長期的な効果や持続可能性についての検証など、今後解決すべき根本的な課題は多く残されている。にもかかわらず、即時的かつ能動的な学習パターンの実現という観点から、ChatGPTは有効な学習ツールとして活用する価値があり、文法と作文およびコミュニケーション能力を統合的にアプローチする革新的な教育道具として期待できる。本稿の考察結果を基に、実際の授業におけるChatGPTを活用した統合的な日本語教育の可能性について検証することを今後の課題とする。
abstract_en: In this paper, the examples of ChatGPT in the field of education were examined, and after confirming the current state and limitations of the existing Japanese grammar education, the potential of integrated Japanese language education using ChatGPT was considered. Although various attempts have been made to utilize ChatGPT from different perspectives in Japanese language education, and its effectiveness is being proven, there are still many fundamental issues to be resolved, such as the lack of clear evaluation criteria for using ChatGPT and the need for verification of its long-term effects and sustainability in actual classroom settings. Nevertheless, from the perspective of realizing immediate and active learning patterns, ChatGPT is valuable as an effective learning tool and can be expected to be an innovative educational tool that approaches grammar, composition, and communication skills in an integrated manner. Based on the results of this study, future tasks will include verifying the potential of integrated Japanese language education using ChatGPT in actual classroom settings.

title_ko: 일본어학부에서 ChatGPT와 파이썬을 활용한 일본어 멀티미디어저작도구 수업 설계와 운영사례 연구
title_en: Research on the Design and Implementation of a Japanese Multimedia Authoring Tool Class Utilizing ChatGPT and Python in the Department of Japanese Language
kw_ko: 영상저작; IT융합교육; 일본IT; 일본취업; 파이썬
kw_en: Multimedia authoring; IT convergence education; Japan IT; Employment in Japan; Python; 映像著作、IT融合教育、日本IT、日本就職、Python
abstract_ko: 本研究は、日本語学部が独自に運営している日本語マルチメディア著作授業において、ChatGPTとPythonを活用して字幕を自動生成し、日本語の映像を著作することを目指して設計した授業運営に関する事例研究である。本研究が行われた日本語学部では、日本語を専攻する学生に対し、第4次産業革命時代の急速に変化するIT技術を現実的かつ具体的に日本語学習に活用できるように、IT融合教育を実施しており、本研究はそのような授業の一例である。本研究では、学生がIT技術を自然に学習し、興味を引き出せるように、PhotoshopおよびPremiere動画編集ツールの学習と共に、AI技術の活用を目的とした授業運営計画と実行に関するものである。 本研究と関連する授業は、低学年向けに開設・運営されており、学生は自然に映像著作過程でChatGPTとPythonを活用する方法を習得する。将来的には日本語学習に活用できる日本語文分析および品詞タグ付けなどの日本語単語分析を目的とした学部内の高学年向けの授業へとつなげるように設計されている。最終的に、第4次産業革命時代のAI技術を活用できる日本語専攻者を育成することを目標としている。
abstract_en: This study examines the design and implementation of a Japanese multimedia authoring class using ChatGPT and Python to automatically generate subtitles and create Japanese videos. The Department of Japanese Language offers IT convergence education to help students apply rapidly evolving IT technologies to their Japanese studies. This research is an example of such a class. The class aims to engage students by incorporating Photoshop and Premiere for video editing and AI technologies. Manually creating subtitles for long videos is challenging, so ChatGPT is used to obtain Python code for STT (Speech to Text), which converts speech to text. This text is then translated back into Japanese and used for subtitles in Premiere. The class, offered to lower-year students, teaches the use of ChatGPT and Python in video authoring and is designed to lead to advanced courses like Japanese sentence analysis and part-of-speech tagging. The ultimate goal is to cultivate Japanese majors capable of utilizing AI technologies of the Fourth Industrial Revolution.

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능 번역과 한국인 영어학습자 번역 비교분석: 문학작품 및 대중문화 콘텐츠를 중심으로
title_en: Comparative Analysis Between Generative AI Translation and Korean English learners’ Translation: Focusing on Literary Works and Popular Culture Content.
kw_en: generative AI translation; human translation; literary works; popular culture content; ChatGPT
abstract_ko: The current study conducted a qualitative analysis comparing translations by generative AI and Korean English learners to determine which is superior and in what ways generative AI might surpass human translations. A total of 12 participants presented their translations alongside machine or generative AI translations. The study focused on comparing translations from ChatGPT, a leading example of generative AI perceived to have overcome the limitations of traditional machine translation, with those of Korean English learners. The results showed that while translations of both literary works and popular culture content were compared, neither generative AI nor human translations proved to be unequivocally superior. An impressive aspect of this study was the observation that, compared to the past, generative AI has significantly improved its ability to convey the author’s intent and the emotional nuances often considered a uniquely human domain. As a result, in some instances, the translations by ChatGPT, a generative AI, were deemed superior, with participants acknowledging that it sometimes produced translations that they had not considered, surpassing their own efforts. This led to the conclusion that, over time, generative AI translation capabilities could match or even exceed those of human translators.

title_ko: AI펭톡을 활용한 플립 러닝 수업이 초등학습자의 영어 말하기 능력에 미치는 영향
title_en: The Effect of AI PengTalk-based Flipped Learning on Elementary EFL Learner’s Speaking Proficiency
kw_en: artificial intelligence; PengTalk; L2 speaking; flipped learning
abstract_ko: This study investigates the effect of using AI PengTalk into flipped learning model on elementary students’ English-speaking proficiency. The participants included 22 elementary students that were divided into two groups and received different treatments: the experimental group completed activities on AI PengTalk before class while the control group viewed video materials. Classes were 45 minutes long and conducted twice a week over a period of 8 sessions. The results revealed that both groups improved their speaking abilities, with the experimental group demonstrating progress across all evaluated areas of content, fluency, vocabulary, grammar, and intelligibility. The control group, on the other hand, showed positive changes only in fluency, vocabulary, and intelligibility. Further analysis of within-group changes based on proficiency levels indicated that higher-level learners in the experimental group improved their fluency, vocabulary, and overall speaking, with no significant gains observed in the control group. For the lower-level learners, the experimental group improved in all aspects of speaking, but the control group only showed improvement in vocabulary. Lastly, the experimental group reported increased self-efficacy, while the control group showed no changes in affective domains.

title_ko: 한국 대학생 영작문에 대한 영어 원어민 교사와 ChatGPT의 피드백 비교 및 학습자 인식 연구
title_en: A Comparative Study of Feedback from Native English Teachers and ChatGPT on Korean University Students’ English Composition with Student Perceptions
kw_en: ChatGPT; English writing feedback; student perception on feedback; native English teachers; university students
abstract_ko: This study examined the feedback provided to Korean undergraduate students on their English writing by native English-speaking teachers and ChatGPT. This study addressed two research questions: 1) What are the similarities and differences between feedback from native English speakers and ChatGPT? 2) How do Korean undergraduate students perceive feedback from native English teachers versus ChatGPT? Thirty university students wrote English essays on a designated topic and received feedback from both two native English teachers and ChatGPT in a blind manner. Analysis of the feedback revealed differences in content and length. Native English teachers tended to emphasize negative feedback, whereas ChatGPT provided both positive and negative feedback. Additionally, ChatGPT’s feedback was generally longer, including both general and specific comments. However, it also exhibited a tendency to repeat generic templates, which could compromise reliability and accuracy of feedback. Student perceptions of the feedback from different providers were further examined through a questionnaire. The findings indicate that students found feedback from native English teachers to be more comprehensible, helpful in identifying writing issues, and effective for enhancing their writing skills.

title_ko: 영어말하기 학습활동 성격에 따른 AI활용 효과 비교 분석
title_en: Does the Nature of Speaking Tasks Influence the Effect of AI on English-Speaking Proficiency?
kw_en: EFL speaking proficiency; shadow reading; conversation learning; AI-technology-based learning; nature of EFL speaking tasks
abstract_ko: The primary purposes of the study were to see whether incorporating AI technology-based learning tools (hereafter AI) into speaking tasks brings speaking proficiency improvement and to explore whether the nature of tasks in terms of learning principles influences the improvement. The study also examined whether the students’ proficiency levels affect the degree of proficiency improvement. For the above reasons, shadow reading and conversation learning were chosen as two tasks with different learning principles, and for each task, traditional and AI-assisted teaching methods were applied. Eighty students participated in the study, and the results showed that the participants who used AI improved their speaking proficiency overall. However, when considering the nature of the tasks, the degree of proficiency improvement was significantly different depending on the teaching method, in that the conversation learning group showed significantly higher scores than the traditional method group when AI was applied. Regarding proficiency levels, the lower-level students’ proficiency improved significantly in shadow reading. The study results demonstrate that the nature of tasks and learners’ current proficiency level affect the advantages AI could bring to learning English speaking and thus suggest sensible and data-driven incorporation of AI into teaching EFL students.

title_ko: 게임 헤드라인 기계번역의 플랫폼별 비교 연구
title_en: Analysis of Post-Editing Strategies for Translating Game Headlines
kw_ko: 게임 번역; 헤드라인; 포스트에디팅; 기계번역; 챗GPT
kw_en: Game Translation; Headlines; Post-Editing; Machine Translation; ChatGPT
abstract_ko: This study aims to examine the translation strategies for effectively translating headlines when post-editing results from machine translation engines and generative AI focusing on the unique characteristics of game texts based on interactivity. For this study, translations of game content from Need for Speed: Unbound and Real Racing 3 were compared across Human Translation (HT), DeepL, Google Translate, Papago, and ChatGPT. The results revealed that human translators employed literal translation, transliteration, and context-based translation, while machine translations predominantly used literal and transliteration methods. Among the platforms, Google Translate used literal translation the most, followed by Papago and DeepL. Conversely, transliteration was most frequently used by DeepL, with Google Translate using it the least. Consequently, while human translation accounted for approximately 25%, the absence of such contextual consideration in machine translations suggests that they fail to capture the contextual nuances of game texts.

title_ko: Investigating Phrasal Features in CLIL and Non-CLIL Writing through an NLP Tool
title_en: Investigating Phrasal Features in CLIL and Non-CLIL Writing through an NLP Tool
authors: 이종봉(Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies)
kw_ko: 자연어처리; 내러티브; 영어 학습자
kw_en: CLIL; Natural Language Processing; narrative; EFL learners
abstract_ko: Using a natural language processing (NLP) tool, this study exploratorily investigates the effects of content and language integrated learning (CLIL) on L2 writing. CLIL is a language-immersion approach where subjects are instructed in the target language. It is expected to help learners develop their academic writing skills. Limiting its focus to written phrasal features, the study compares the written narratives of EFL students in CLIL and non-CLIL classes with regard to phrasal complexity. The study also examines how phrasal features contribute to overall writing quality, assessed by expert raters’ holistic scoring of the students’ writing. The results indicate that the CLIL students showed higher phrasal complexity in their narratives than the non-CLIL students. A regression model shows that total holistic scores were best predicted by prepositions per object of the preposition, dependents per direct object (no pronouns), and dependents per nominal subject (standard deviation). The findings suggest implications for writing assessment and pedagogy.

title_ko: A Study on Designing Future-Oriented English Textbooks and Classroom Environments Using AI Image Generator
title_en: A Study on Designing Future-Oriented English Textbooks and Classroom Environments Using AI Image Generator
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 미래교육; 실감형기술; 영어교육
kw_en: generative AI; future education; immersive technology; English education
abstract_ko: This study aims to highlight the importance of designing future-oriented English learning environments and content. By examining the experiences of pre-service English teachers and utilizing text-to-image AI generators, the study identifies key themes essential for the innovation. These themes include the creation of classroom environments that allow direct knowledge experience, the integration of VR and AI-integrated immersive textbooks, and the use of hologram-based textbooks for experiential learning. The findings emphasize the necessity of flexible and advanced educational resources that enhance student engagement, comprehension, and practical application of knowledge. The implications for educational practice include the need for dynamic classroom design, the integration of advanced technologies, and the evolving role of teachers as facilitators in technologically-enhanced learning environments. Additionally, the study suggests that future research should focus on longitudinal studies, diverse educational contexts, and the potential of AI in educational resource development. This study underscores the importance of embracing technological advancements to transform English education, making it more engaging and effective, and better aligned with the demands of the future-oriented educational context.

title_ko: Developing a ChatGPT-based Teaching and Learning Model for High School Reading English Literature
title_en: Developing a ChatGPT-based Teaching and Learning Model for High School Reading English Literature
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 영미 문학 읽기; 수업 모형; 2022 개정 교육과정
kw_en: ChatGPT; Reading English Literature; instructional model; 2022 Revised National Curriculum
abstract_ko: This study aims to develop a ChatGPT-based instructional model for ‘High School Reading English Literature’, a career elective subject, aligning with the 2022 Revised National Curriculum, which promotes the integration of AI tools such as ChatGPT. With limited empirical research on the application of ChatGPT in English literature, this study is significant in bridging this gap by developing an instructional model in accordance with academic procedures. To address this, a needs survey was conducted among 33 high school teachers and 144 Jeonnam high school students to identify their perceptions of ChatGPT and Reading English Literature. An instructional model was then developed, and an expert group evaluated its validity. A four-hour pilot class was conducted, followed by a post-survey and post-interview to assess its effectiveness and gather pedagogical implications. The study reveals significant differences between teachers and students’ perceptions of Reading English Literature. The model was positively evaluated by the expert group, and the results of the post-survey and the post-interview further confirmed its efficacy, providing three main implications. The findings of this study addressed the issue of over-reliance on ChatGPT and reshaping students’ perceptions of Reading English Literature, as well as validating the effectiveness of ChatGPT in education.
abstract_en: This study aims to develop a ChatGPT-based instructional model for ‘High School Reading English Literature’, a career elective subject, aligning with the 2022 Revised National Curriculum, which promotes the integration of AI tools such as ChatGPT. With limited empirical research on the application of ChatGPT in English literature, this study is significant in bridging this gap by developing an instructional model in accordance with academic procedures. To address this, a needs survey was conducted among 33 high school teachers and 144 Jeonnam high school students to identify their perceptions of ChatGPT and Reading English Literature. An instructional model was then developed, and an expert group evaluated its validity. A four-hour pilot class was conducted, followed by a post-survey and post-interview to assess its effectiveness and gather pedagogical implications. The study reveals significant differences between teachers and students’ perceptions of Reading English Literature. title_ko: 기계번역을 활용한 영작문 강의 수업에 대한 학생의 인식 및 만족도 탐색
title_en: The investigation of students’ perceptions and satisfaction with English writing instruction using machine translation
kw_ko: 기계번역; 영작문 강의 수업; 학생 인식
kw_en: machine translation; English writing instruction; students’ perceptions
abstract_ko: This study investigates college students’ perceptions and satisfaction with English writing instruction that incorporates machine translation. Sophomores majoring in English language and literature and enrolled in a writing course participated in the study. The instructional model comprises seven steps: (1) an instructional session on the features and drawbacks of machine translation, (2) writing an essay in Korean, (3) translating the Korean essay into English by the students, (4) using Google Translate a maximum of seven times to translate words, phrases, or sentences from Korean into English, (5) revising the English essay, (6) completing Reflection Activity handouts, and (7) answering survey items and optionally participating in individual interviews. The results reveal that most participants perceived machine translation as useful for improving their overall writing skills. Students specifically mentioned that it helped them learn new sentence structures and identify grammatical errors by comparing their own sentences with Google-translated ones. Additionally, students with different levels of English proficiency did not perceive the effectiveness of the instruction differently. The findings provide practical implications for this instructional model in English writing courses, serving as a valuable reference for writing instructors in similar contexts.

title_ko: Analysis of Lexical Sophistication Using a Natural Language Processing Tool: A Corpus Study of English Picture Books
title_en: Analysis of Lexical Sophistication Using a Natural Language Processing Tool: A Corpus Study of English Picture Books
authors: 안지은(Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies); 박지현(Gyeongin National University of Education)
kw_ko: 자연어 처리; 코퍼스; 어휘 정교성
kw_en: natural language processing; corpus; lexical sophistication
abstract_ko: This study investigates lexical sophistication in children's picture books across different reading levels. We analyzed a corpus of 107 picture books (Park & Ahn, 2021) across ATOS levels 0-5 using TAALES (Kyle & Crossley, 2015), a natural language processing tool. Lexical indices including word frequency, range, and psycholinguistic information (familiarity, concreteness, imageability, meaningfulness, age of acquisition) were computed and compared across book levels. Results revealed that as book levels increased, word frequency and range decreased, indicating higher-level books contain less common words with narrower usage. Psycholinguistic features also showed significant changes: words in higher-level books were less familiar and meaningful, but more concrete, imageable, and acquired later. These findings suggest that higher-level picture books employ more sophisticated vocabulary, underscoring their potential as a valuable resource for exposing young L2 learners to rich and diverse language. Our study highlights the need to choose picture books considering specific lexical features and reading levels. Such careful selection is crucial for achieving language teaching goals and enhancing vocabulary development.

title_ko: A Study on Understanding Students’ Perspectives Regarding the Integration of ChatGPT in an EFL Writing Class
title_en: A Study on Understanding Students’ Perspectives Regarding the Integration of ChatGPT in an EFL Writing Class
kw_en: ChatGPT; AI writing assistant; English writing class; student perspectives; ethical awareness
abstract_ko: This research aims to explore the integration of ChatGPT as a writing assistant in an English writing course, focusing on student perspectives obtained through surveys and interviews. The study evaluates ChatGPT's effectiveness, potential, and limitations in educational settings. While most participants found ChatGPT easy to use and helpful for writing tasks, survey results revealed notable concerns in the Concerns and Limitations section. Students appreciated ChatGPT's ability to generate outlines and correct grammar, but interviews criticized its lack of personal engagement and creativity. Moreover, there were major worries regarding the authenticity and ethical aspects of content produced by AI. The study suggests the need for enhancing ChatGPT's user-friendliness, providing special training on prompt writing, and emphasizing the irreplaceable role of human instructors in developing students' creative and critical thinking skills. Comprehensive ethical training on AI usage is recommended to ensure responsible and effective integration of AI tools in education. In conclusion, while ChatGPT offers significant benefits as a writing assistant, addressing its challenges will help teachers enhance the learning experience and maintain educational integrity, ensuring a balanced and ethically sound education.

title_ko: 대학 영작문 교육에서의 ChatGPT 활용 가능성 탐구
title_en: Exploring the Applicability of Using ChatGPT in University English Writing Class
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 영작문 학습; 만족도; 인식
kw_en: ESL; ChatGPT; English writing; satisfaction; perception
abstract_ko: This study was conducted to explore the applicability of ChatGPT for English writing classes at the university level. The primary goal was to assess how effectively ChatGPT can support English learners in improving their writing skills. The study compare and analyze errors in English writing using pre- and post test, which conducted before and after ChatGPT-based English writing lessons. Errors were examined through error analysis and paired-sample t-tests, focusing on 75 university students who completed both pre- and post-test out of 96 participants in total. The error analysis revealed that ChatGPT was particularly influential in reducing grammatical mistakes, whereas its impact on vocabulary, expression, and structural errors was comparatively limited. Additionally, a survey among the participants indicated that participants expressed a high level of satisfaction with the English writing classes that utilized ChatGPT. This suggests that ChatGPT has significant potential as a valuable learning tool for English learners in university-level English writing education, contributing to the improvement of learners’ writing competencies.

title_ko: AI-Enabled Special Education : A Study on Factors Influencing Chinese Disabled College Students' Acceptance of AI-Assisted Mobile Foreign Language Vocabulary Learning
title_en: AI-Enabled Special Education : A Study on Factors Influencing Chinese Disabled College Students' Acceptance of AI-Assisted Mobile Foreign Language Vocabulary Learning
authors: 포동(장춘대학교 계명학원 한국어학과); 포신운(장춘대학교 외국어대학 스페인어학과)
kw_ko: 특수교육; 중국 장애 대학생; 수용도; 인공지능 보조 모바일 외국어 어휘 학습; 인지적 접근성
kw_en: Special Education; Chinese Disabled College Students; Acceptance; AI-Assisted Mobile Foreign Language Vocabulary Learning; Perceived Accessibility
abstract_ko: The application of artificial intelligence technology in special education is receiving increasing attention. In mobile learning environments, intelligent technology provides personalized and accessible language learning support for disabled students, potentially promoting educational equity and enhancing the learning experience. However, existing research has paid little attention to the factors influencing disabled students' acceptance of AI-assisted mobile foreign language vocabulary learning and the underlying mechanisms. This study targets 301 disabled college students, applying PLS-SEM to explore how system characteristics such as perceived accessibility, perceived usefulness, and perceived ease of use influence students' acceptance through cognitive and affective attitudes. The research finds that perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, and perceived accessibility have decreasing levels of influence on students' acceptance, respectively. Cognitive and affective attitudes play a dual mediating role between external stimuli factors and acceptance, but perceived accessibility only influences acceptance through cognitive attitude rather than affective attitude. These findings reveal key psychological factors and mechanisms in disabled students' adoption of new technology, highlighting the importance of perceived ease of use and emotional experience. They enrich research on technology acceptance behavior in special education and provide empirical evidence and practical insights for optimizing the design and promotion of related learning systems. The results of this study have important reference value for the in-depth application and innovative development of artificial intelligence technology in special education.

title_en: Applicability and challenges of AI digital textbooks in Korean language writing education
kw_ko: AI 디지털 교과서; AI 활용 교육; AI 융합 교육; 쓰기 자동 채점; 쓰기 자동 피드백; 판별형 인공지능; 생성형 인공지능
kw_en: AI digital textbooks(AIDT); AI in education(AIED); AI convergence education; automated writing scoring; automated writing feedback; discriminative artificial intelligence; generative artificial intelligence
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 국어과 쓰기 영역에 적용할 수 있는 AI 디지털 교과서의 구현 가능태를 탐색하고, 각 가능태별로 구현 방향과 쟁점을 살펴보았다. 인공지능 교육 및 쓰기에 활용되는 기술 유형에 따라 ‘쓰기 자동 채점, 어휘 및 문장 교정, 쓰기 자동 피드백, 초고 작성, 복합양식 콘텐츠 생성’ 등을 나누고 ‘디지털 쓰기’를 포함한 여섯 가지 가능태를 검토하였으며, 디지털 미디어의 다층적 속성(기술적 대상, 개인적 텍스트, 상징적 환경)을 종합적으로 고려하였다. 분석 결과를 바탕으로 AI 디지털 교과서 구현을 위한 쟁점으로 ① 디지털·AI 공간에서의 소통이 대면 상호작용을 대체할 수 있는가, ② 특정 담화 관습에 편향될 우려가 없는가, ③ 필자의 고차원적 사고를 촉진할 수 있는가, ④ 실재감 저하로 인해 교육 효과가 떨어지지 않는가, ⑤ 우수한 결과물(글)의 생성이 학습자의 능력(쓰기) 향상으로 이어지는가, ⑥ 국어과 쓰기 교육의 본질에 부합하는가, ⑦ 학습 과정에서의 제약을 어떻게 극복할 것인가 등의 질문을 제기하였다.
abstract_en: This study explored the potential application of AI digital textbooks in the writing domain of Korean language education and examined the associated directions and challenges. Six possibilities were reviewed based on the types of AI education and techniques used in writing: digital writing, automated scoring, vocabulary and sentence correction, automated feedback, drafting, and the production of multimodal content. The multilayered aspects of digital media-technical subjects, individual texts, and symbolic environments-were comprehensively considered. The study raised several issues regarding the initial implementation of AI digital textbooks: (a) Can communication in digital and AI spaces effectively replace face-to-face interaction? (b) Is there a bias toward specific discourse conventions? (c) Does the use of AI promote higher-order thinking? (d) Does it diminish educational effectiveness due to low presence? (e) Does the quality of the written outcome accurately reflect the individual's writing ability? (f) Does it align with the core principles of writing instruction? (g) How can it overcome constraints in the learning process?

title_ko: 학습자 영작문, ChatGPT 피드백 수정본, 영어원어민 교사 피드백 수정본 간의 비교: Coh-Metrix 분석
title_en: A Study on the Comparison of English Learners’ Composition, ChatGPT’s Feedback-based Revised English Composition, and Native English Teachers’ Feedback-based Revised English Composition: A Coh-Metrix Analysis
kw_ko: 영작문; 수정된 영작문; 챗지피티; 코메트릭스; 테라
kw_en: English composition; revised English composition; ChatGPT; Coh-Metrix; TERA
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study is to investigate the differences among students' original English compositions, native English teachers’ feedback-based revised English compositions, and ChatGPT’s feedback-based revised English compositions in terms of vocabulary, syntax, discourse, and readability using Coh-Metrix analyses. The study involved fifteen students who provided their original English compositions. These compositions were then revised after feedback from both native English teachers and ChatGPT to analyze the variations in the revised versions. The research results indicated statistically significant differences among the three types of compositions in three vocabulary indices and one syntax index. However, there were no statistically significant differences among the three types of compositions in all indices of discourse and readability. The findings highlight precise areas where human revisions and ChatGPT-assisted revisions both diverse and converge. Pedagogical implications on these findings will be provided.

abstract_ko: The purpose of this study was to investigate how the English speaking ability of Korean EFL college students was affected by their interactions with Talk-to-ChatGPT while taking an ‘English Interview’ class. Thirty pieces of English conversation scripts with thirty chatbot conversations created by five students were collected for analysis. Two online text analysis programs, Quillbot including word counter and grammar checker and T.E.R.A.(Text Ease and Readability Assessor), were used for data analysis. The findings of data analysis revealed that 1) The average length of the sentences and words spoken by the participants has increased through English speaking practice using Talk-to-ChatGPT, and 2) There was no significant change in text ease and readability, and coherence of students’ utterances through English speaking practice using a chatbot while there were differences depending on their English proficiency levels. 3) Students A, B, and D, who had relatively low levels of English proficiency, showed a slight increase in syntactic accuracy and semantic clarity in their English interview practice. Based on the study findings, pedagogical implications for the effective use of AI-based apps or programs in English speaking classes were presented.
