title_ko: Korean University Students’ Prompt Literacy Training with ChatGPT: Investigating Language Learning Strategies
title_en: Korean University Students’ Prompt Literacy Training with ChatGPT: Investigating Language Learning Strategies
authors: Thomas Dillon(Foreign Language Education Centre, Daegu Catholic University)
kw_en: ChatGPT; Strategy Inventory for Language Learning (SILL); Strategic Self-Regulation (S2R); Korean EFL students; AI in education; student interaction; language learning strategies
abstract_ko: This study explores the integration of ChatGPT, OpenAI’s conversational AI, into English as a Foreign Language (EFL) classrooms at Korean universities, focusing on student interactions and language learning strategy preferences. It categorises interactions using the Strategy Inventory for Language Learning (SILL) and Strategic Self-Regulation (S2R) frameworks to evaluate the pedagogical effectiveness of AI- assisted learning. Ninety-nine university students participated in training sessions with ChatGPT prompts tailored to different learning strategies. Data were collected through surveys, chat transcripts, and qualitative feedback. Results indicate frequent student interactions with ChatGPT, averaging 4.49 strategies in initial training chats. Compensatory strategies like error correction and adaptive difficulty received high ratings, while social strategies were rated lowest. Metacognitive strategies, especially planning and summarising, were also well-received. The study concludes that ChatGPT supports diverse learning strategies, enhancing linguistic competence and promoting self-regulated learning. However, limitations such as AI accuracy and authenticity issues highlight the need for continued human interaction in language education.

title_ko: Q-Craft 프로그램을 이용한 자동생성문항 타당성 평가 연구
title_en: A Study on the Validity of Automatically Generated Questions Using the Q-Craft
kw_ko: 자동문항생성(AIG); Q-Craft 프로그램; 동형검사신뢰도; 검사정보함수
kw_en: Automatic Generation Item(AIG); Q-Craft program; parallel test reliability; Test Information Function
abstract_ko: 목적 자동문항생성에 대한 수요가 증가하는 환경에서 자동문항생성이 실제 교육현장에서 제대로 활용되기 위해서는 공인된 인간출제 검사 문항과 유사하게 또는 동형의 수준으로 자동문항생성에 의한 문항들이 만들어질 필요가 있다. 따라서, 본 연구는 전통적인 방식의 인간출제 문항(MIG 문항)들을 기반으로 이와 유사한 문항들을 자동문항생성 프로그램을 통하여 생성하고, 생성된 문항들이 MIG 문항들과 얼마나 유사하게 생성되었는지를 분석함으로써 Q-Craft 프로그램을 이용하여 자동생성된 문항의 타당성을 평가하고자 하였다. 방법 이를 위하여 서울시 교육청에서 주관하는 2023년 3월 고3 전국연합학력평가 영어시험에서 15가지의 대표적인 문항유형을 선정하여 MIG 문항들을 구성하고, 이와 유사하게 자동문항생성 프로그램인 Q-Craft에 의해 15개의 자동문항(AIG 문항)들을 생성하였다. AIG 문항은 내용전문가 10명에게 블라인드 리뷰를 의뢰하였으며, 대학교 신입생 48명을 대상으로 MIG 문항 검사와 AIG 문항 검사를 동시에 시행하였다. 결과 AIG 문항을 내용전문가에게 의뢰한 결과, 지문흐름의 자연스러움, 영어표현의 자연스러움에서 높은 수준의 평가를 받았으나, 선택지의 매력정도는 상대적으로 낮은 평가를 받았다. 대학생들을 대상으로 MIG 문항 검사와 AIG 문항 검사를 동시에 수행하여 응답결과를 분석한 결과 동형검사 신뢰도는 .662로 유사성 정도가 높은 편이었으며, 검사정보함수를 통해 비교한 결과 두 검사가 최대 검사정보를 주는 학생의 능력수준이 동일하였다. 결론 본 연구에서 동형검사 신뢰도는 .662로 유사성 정도는 높다고 할 수 있으나, MIG 문항 검사와 AIG 문항 검사가 동형검사라고 하기에는 미흡하다고 판단하였다. 그러나, 검사정보함수 분석결과 AIG 문항 검사가 MIG 문항이 정확하게 추정해내는 학생들의 능력수준과 동일하였던 것은 매우 의미있으며, 검사 목적에 따라 AIG 문항은 타당성을 부여할 수 있다.
abstract_en: Objectives In an environment where the demand for automatic item generation is increasing, it is crucial for automatically generated items to match the quality of manually created items to be effectively utilized in educational settings. This study aims to automatically generate items (AIG items) similar to traditional manually generated items (MIG items) using an automatic item generation program and to evaluate the validity of these automatically generated items by analyzing their similarity to MIG items. Methods 15 representative items types from the March 2023 National Assessment of Education for 12th grade, administered by the Seoul Metropolitan Office of Education, were selected to form the MIG items. Similarly, 15 AIG items were generated using the Q-Craft automatic item generation program. The AIG items were subjected to blind review by 10 subject-matter experts and were simultaneously administered along with the MIG items to 48 first-year university students. Results The expert review of the AIG items indicated a high level of naturalness in the flow of the passages and the use of English expressions. However, the attractiveness of the answer choices received relatively lower ratings. The analysis of the responses from the university students revealed a high degree of similarity between the MIG and AIG items, with a parallel test reliability of .662. Furthermore, the comparison using test information functions showed that the ability levels of students providing the maximum test information were identical for both sets of items. Conclusions The AIG items are not yet fully equivalent to the MIG items. Nonetheless, the fact that the AIG items accurately estimated the ability levels of students, as the MIG items did, is highly significant. This suggests that AIG items can be deemed valid depending on the testing purpose.

title_ko: 학교 영어 수업을 위한 에듀테크 활용 가능성 고찰: 인공지능 챗봇과 메타버스를 중심으로
title_en: Reflection on the potential of EdTech for school English education: Focusing on AI chatbots and metaverses
kw_ko: 학교 영어 수업에서의 에듀테크 활용; 학습자 중심의 영어 수업; 인공지능 챗봇; 메타버스
kw_en: educational technology for school English classes; learner-centered English classes; AI chatbots; metaverse
abstract_ko: This study investigates the integration of advanced educational technologies, specifically artificial intelligence (AI) and the metaverse, into English language curricula to address the evolving demands of a knowledge-based society. By reviewing relevant literature, the study evaluates the feasibility and effectiveness of these technologies in enhancing school-based English instruction. The findings indicate that AI chatbots can significantly improve English communication opportunities, alleviate emotional burdens, stimulate learner interest, offer personalized learning experiences, and support autonomous learning by overcoming constraints related to time and location. Additionally, the study examines the metaverse’s potential for learner-centered English instruction, highlighting its ability to provide authentic scenarios and interactive contexts that foster deeper engagement and meaningful learning experiences for English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learners. Although the metaverse offers valuable tools through diverse social activities and immersive environments, the primary emphasis remains on AI’s transformative impact on English education. This research emphasizes that integrating AI and the metaverse can enhance English instruction, making it more effective and responsive to learners' needs in the contemporary educational landscape. By focusing on these technologies, the study contributes to a deeper understanding of their potential benefits and applications in modern English education.

title_ko: 챗GPT를 활용한 외국인 유학생 기초 교양 쓰기 수업 사례 연구
title_en: Case study on basic liberal arts writing class for international students using ChatGPT
kw_ko: 챗GPT 활용 수업; 한국어 쓰기 교육; 질적 사례연구; 유학생 기초 교양 쓰기; 학문목적 한국어교육
kw_en: Class using ChatGPT; Korean Writing Education; Qualitative Case Study; Basic Liberal Arts Writing for International Students; Korean Language Education for Academic Purposes
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 외국인을 위한 한국어 쓰기 수업에 챗GPT를 활용할 경우 나타나는 학습자의 반응을 관찰하고 이를 있는 그대로 기술함으로써 생성형 인공지능의 교육적 활용 가능성을 모색하는 데에 있다. 이를 위해 연구방법론으로 질적 사례연구를 선택하였으며 자료의 삼각화를 충실히 이행하기 위하여 한 학기 동안 학습 결과물, 챗GPT와의 대화 내용, 수업 만족도 등을 수집하였다. 수집 자료를 분석한 결과 형태적 측면에서는 문법적인 오류를 수정하고, 잘못된 표현을 바로잡는 데 챗GPT를 유용하게 활용하였으며 어휘적 측면에서는 모르는 단어나 구어체와 문어체 간의 변환을 이해하는 데 도움을 받았고 내용적 측면에서는 주제문을 작성하고 논리적인 단락을 구성하는 데 도움을 받았다. 본 연구는 챗GPT가 교수자와 학습자 간의 상호작용을 보완하여 학습자들의 학습 자율성을 높일 수 있다는 가능성을 보여준다. 이는 전통적인 교수법의 한계를 보완하며, 다양한 학습자들의 요구에 대응할 수 있는 새로운 교육 방법을 제시할 수 있다는 점에서 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to explore the educational potential of utilizing ChatGPT in Korean writing classes for foreign learners by observing and documenting learner responses. To this end, a qualitative case study methodology was selected, with efforts made to ensure data triangulation by collecting learning outcomes, ChatGPT interaction records, and course satisfaction feedback throughout the semester. The analysis of the collected data revealed that, in terms of form, ChatGPT was effectively used to correct grammatical errors and rectify improper expressions. In the lexical aspect, it provided assistance in understanding unfamiliar words and the transformation between colloquial and formal language. Regarding content, it was helpful in composing topic sentences and organizing logical paragraphs. This study demonstrates that ChatGPT can supplement the interaction between instructors and learners, thereby enhancing learners' autonomy. It holds significance in that it compensates for the limitations of traditional teaching methods and offers a new approach to education that can cater to the diverse needs of learners.
note: 유학생 한국어 쓰기 수업 챗GPT 질적 사례

title_ko: ChatGPT와 Copilot을 활용한 독일어 통합 교수-학습 가능성에 대한 연구
title_en: Studie über die Möglichkeit der integrierten Lehre und des Lernens der deutschen Sprache unter Verwendung von ChatGPT und Copilot
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 코파일럿; 프롬프트(명령어); 통합적; 상호작용
kw_en: ChatGPT; Copilot; Prompt; integriert; Interaktion
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 ChatGPT 및 Copilot과의 상호작용을 통하여 독일어 교육에서 이들의 활용 가능성을 탐색하는 것을 목적으로 한다. ChatGPT 3.5 및 Microsoft Copilot과의 텍스트, 음성 상호작용 분석을 통해 독일어 교육현장에서 언어의 네 가지 기능인 읽기, 쓰기, 듣기. 말하기를 어떻게 통합하여 교수-학습 할 수 있는지에 대한 적용 가능성을 비교분석해 보겠다. 2022년 11월에 공개된 ChatGPT 3.5는 Open AI가 개발한 거대언어모델이며, 인공신경망을 이용하여 사용자의 문자입력에 따라 답변을 생성하는 무료로 제공되는 챗봇이다. 2023년 3월에 출시된 최신 ChatGPT 4는 ChatGPT 3.5버전과 달리, 유로로 사용할 수 있음에도 불구하고, 시간당 메시지 수량 제한이 있어 향후 서비스 향상이 요구된다(오창근/장윤재 2023 14, 21). 그런데, 2024년 1월 Microsoft에서 Windows 11 업데이트를 통해 Copilot 인공지능 기능이 추가됨으로 인해서 ChatGPT 4, GPT 비전, 달리(DALL-E) 3을 지원하여 무료로 사용할 수 있게 됨으로써, 텍스트, 음성뿐 아니라 이미지나 노래도 생성할 수 있고, 실시간 데이터 접근도 가능하게 되었다. 더불어 지속적으로 언급되고 있는 ChatGPT의 부정확성(할루네이션), 신뢰성 문제 등 한계점은 출처를 제시해 주는 기능이 탑재된 Copilot과의 대화를 통해서 극복될 수 있을 것이다.
abstract_en: In der vorliegenden Arbeit werden die Anwendungsmöglichkeiten von ChatGPT und Copilot für den Deutschunterricht anhand textueller und sprachlicher Interaktionen untersucht. Dabei wird erörtert, wie Lesen-Schreiben und Hören-Sprechen integriert unterrichtet werden können. Zusammenfassend geht aus den Forschungsergebnissen hervor, dass ChatGPT und Copilot beide für textbasierte Interaktionen effizient genutzt werden können und für sprachliche Interaktionen in Deutsch geeignet sind. Insbesondere bietet Copilot eine höhere Zuverlässigkeit und Genauigkeit bei der Echtzeitbereitstellung von Webdaten und Quellen, aber auch für Rollenspiele, Alltagsgespräche und Diskussionen im Bereich Hören und Sprechen ist Copilot besser geeignet. ChatGPT und Copilot können Deutschlerner als Hilfsmittel dienen, um Grammatik und Aussprache zu üben, und den Wortschatz zu erweitern. Außerdem bieten sie interaktive Lernumgebungen, in denen die Sprachfähigkeiten verbessert werden können. Lehrkräfte können diese Tools auch nutzen, um Unterrichtsmaterialien zu entwickeln und maßgeschneiderte Übungsaufgaben entsprechend dem Niveau der Lernenden zu erstellen.
note: 독일어 교육 ChatGPT·Copilot

title_ko: The Effectiveness of AI-Assisted Language Learning: Possibilities of Facilitating the Intelligibility of Korean-Accented English
title_en: The Effectiveness of AI-Assisted Language Learning: Possibilities of Facilitating the Intelligibility of Korean-Accented English
authors: 정보현(국립공주대학교); Hyun Kyung Miki Bong(Ritsumeikan University)
kw_en: pronunciation teaching; mobile-assisted language learning; AI; intelligibility; Korean-accented English
abstract_ko: This study investigated an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted mobile application’s effects on both motivation and development in Korean-speaking English learners (KSLs). We addressed three research questions: whether implementing AI apps, such as Google Assistant in L2 pronunciation training (1) enhances L2 listening proficiency, (2) increases L2 learning motivation, and (3) enhances extracting learnable phonological features. Three intact classes of KSLs (N = 74) were assigned to three groups: control (N = 25); a form-focused group that received a four-week explanation of Korean-accented English (KoE) (N = 25); and an AI app treatment group that received four weeks of mobile application pronunciation training in addition to the KoE explanation (N = 24). We conducted a quasi-experimental design with pre-, post-, and delayed post- listening tests on speech perception. In addition, we administered two questionnaires adopted from the Attitude and Motivation Test Battery (Gardner, 1985) ten weeks apart using a pre- and post-test design. Our results indicated that the mobile-assisted pronunciation practice improved L2 listening proficiency (linguistic level) and motivational level (affective domain). The findings confirmed that the ability to distinguish between consonant related features is readily learnable, suggesting that pronunciation practice using AI apps should be encouraged in L2 teaching and learning.

We addressed three research questions: whether implementing AI apps, such as Google Assistant in L2 pronunciation training (1) enhances L2 listening proficiency, (2) increases L2 learning motivation, and (3) enhances extracting learnable phonological features. Three intact classes of KSLs (N = 74) were assigned to three groups: control (N = 25); a form-focused group that received a four-week explanation of Korean-accented English (KoE) (N = 25); and an AI app treatment group that received four weeks of mobile application pronunciation training in addition to the KoE explanation (N = 24). The findings confirmed that the ability to distinguish between consonant related features is readily learnable, suggesting that pronunciation practice using AI apps should be encouraged in L2 teaching and learning.

kw_en: Korean Language Education; Writing Education; Writing Strategies; Generative AI; ChatGPT; Writing Strategy Education
abstract_ko: 본고는 생성형 AI를 활용한 한국어 쓰기 전략 교육의 방안을 제안하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 본고에서는 쓰기 교육에서 쓰기 전략의 개념과 교육 내용에 대해 밝히고 그에 따른 생성형 AI에 대한 전략으로서 가치를 평가했다. 현 시대의 생성형 AI가 가지는 한계를 명확히 파악한다는 전제하에 생성형 AI를 쓰기 전략 교수-학습을 위한 도구로 활용하는 것이 교육적으로 가치가 있음을 주장했다. 본고는 생성형 AI이 쓰기 전략 교수-학습에 있어 가치가 있음을 밝히기 위해 교육 분야에서의 생성형 AI 활용과 관련된 연구와 생성형 AI를 활용한 글쓰기와 관련된 연구를 살펴보았다. 해당 연구들을 통해 생성형 AI를 활용한 글쓰기가 막을 수 없는 시대의 흐름임을 파악할 수 있었고 따라서 교육 분야에서 생성형 AI 등장에 따른 교수-학습 방법론의 변화와 글쓰기 교육에서 전략 교육의 변화는 자연스러운 현상이며, 따라서 쓰기 교육 연구 역시 교육 현장에서 생성형 AI를 활용하여 교수자나 학습자 모두 교육적으로 좋은 결과물을 만들어 낼 수 있도록 돕는 방안을 제안해야 할 필요성이 있음을 확인했다. 이에 본고는 한국어 쓰기 교육에서 전략을 교육하는 데 있어 가능한 접근법을 쓰기 교육 단계에 맞춰 ‘전-중-후’로 나누어 제시했다. 쓰기 전 단계에서는 ‘주제 선정하기’와 ‘주제에 대한 접근 방식 고려하기’ 전략을 학습하는 데 도움이 되는 프롬프트 작성법에 대해 제안했다. 쓰기 단계에서는 실제 수업 시간에 활용된 방안을 소개하는 것을 통해 ‘쓰기 모니터링하기’와 ‘조정 기술 사용하기’ 전략의 학습이 가능한 생성형 AI 활용법에 대해 제안했다. 마지막으로 쓰기 후 단계에서는 글의 응집성을 높이기 위한 방안에 대해 논하였다. 다만 본고에서 생성형 AI를 활용한 한국어 쓰기 전략 교육이 가능하다고 주장하는 데에는 본 연구에서 삼은 교육 대상이 외국인 한국어 학습자이기 때문이다. 유학생은 한국어를 학습하는 과정에 있으며, 따라서 한국어를 모어로 하는 학습자를 대상으로 하는 쓰기 교육과는 교육 목적에 차이가 있다. 외국인을 대상으로 하는 한국어 쓰기 교육에는 합목적성과 그에 따른 장르적 지식이 명확하게 제시된다. 따라서 모어 화자 대상의 글쓰기 교육과는 접근이 다를 수밖에 없다. 즉, 생성형 AI를 활용한 쓰기 전략 교육에는 명확한 한계가 있기에 앞으로도 기술의 발전과 그에 따른 교육 방법론적 발전이 요구될 것이다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this paper is to propose a plan for teaching Korean writing strategies using generative AI. To this end, the paper clarifies the concept and content of writing strategies in writing education and evaluates the value of generative AI as a strategy. Based on the premise of fully understanding the limitations of current generative AI, it argues that using generative AI as a tool for teaching and learning writing strategies has educational value. To demonstrate the value of generative AI in teaching writing strategies, this paper reviews research related to the use of generative AI in education and studies related to writing using generative AI. Through these studies, it was recognized that writing using generative AI is an inevitable trend in the current era. Therefore, the changes in teaching and learning methodologies in the field of education and the changes in strategy education in writing instruction brought about by the emergence of generative AI are natural phenomena. Accordingly, this paper confirms the necessity for writing education research to propose methods that help both instructors and learners produce educationally valuable outcomes using generative AI in educational settings. In this regard, this paper presents possible approaches to teaching strategies in Korean writing education, divided into three stages: "pre-writing," "during writing," and "post-writing." In the pre-writing stage, the paper proposes prompt-writing techniques that help in learning strategies such as "selecting a topic" and "considering approaches to the topic." In the writing stage, it introduces methods utilized in actual classroom settings to suggest ways to use generative AI to learn strategies like "monitoring writing" and "applying adjustment techniques." Finally, in the post-writing stage, the paper discusses ways to enhance the coherence of the text. However, it should be noted that the argument for the feasibility of using generative AI in Korean writing strategy education in this paper is based on the fact that the study targets foreign learners of Korean. International students are in the process of learning Korean, and thus, the educational objectives differ from those of writing education for native Korean speakers. Korean writing education for foreigners clearly presents purposes and the corresponding genre knowledge. Therefore, the approach differs from that of writing education for native speakers. In other words, there are clear limitations to using generative AI for teaching writing strategies, and continuous advancements in technology and corresponding pedagogical development will be required in the future.
note: 외국인 학습자 한국어 쓰기 전략 교육 생성형AI 방안 제안

title_ko: Young Korean EFL learners’ discrimination of AI-generated English front vowels
title_en: Young Korean EFL learners’ discrimination of AI-generated English front vowels
authors: 양세정(Institute for Humanities, Jeju National University)
kw_en: AI; Amazon Polly; coda voicing; vowel perception; young EFL learners
abstract_ko: This study evaluates the perceptual accuracy of young Korean EFL learners in distinguishing front vowel contrasts /i/, /ɪ/, /ɛ/, and /æ/ in the coda voicing contexts bVd and bVt. Utilizing advanced AI-generated speech stimuli from Amazon Polly, the study explores the discrimination challenges faced by these learners. Participants (N = 17) were subjected to an AB/BA discrimination task with a ternary forced-choice setup. Despite a high overall discrimination accuracy (mean = 87.01%), the learners found the /ɛ/-/æ/ contrast particularly more challenging than the /i/-/ɪ/ contrast. This challenge can be attributed to the closely matched F1 frequencies of AI-generated stimuli for /ɛ/ and /æ/. Additionally, the inherent vowel length difference between /i/ and /ɪ/ likely served as a discernible cue, given its accessibility compared to spectral cues for young EFL learners. Results also indicate that participants more effectively discerned vowel contrasts following the voiced consonant /d/ than the voiceless /t/, suggesting that vowel acquisition in young Korean EFL learners can be enhanced in contexts with voiced codas, which extend vowel durations for better processing. The pedagogical implications of the study are that a targeted sequence of instruction, beginning with easier vowel contrasts like /i-ɪ/ in voiced coda contexts, can foster improved pronunciation. Additionally, incorporating AI tools and phonetic awareness exercises can further enhance English front vowel perception.

title_ko: 온라인 상호작용을 위한 대화상대로서 ChatGPT의 활용 가능성에 관한 소고 -유럽언어공통참조기준 보충판의 온라인 상호작용 능력기술문에 기초하여-
title_en: Réflexion sur le potentiel de ChatGPT en tant qu'interlocuteur pour les interactions en ligne : basée sur les descripteurs d'interaction en ligne du CECR 2021
kw_ko: 유럽언어공통참조기준 보충판; 온라인 상호작용; 외국어교수법; 온라인대화상대
kw_en: ChatGPT; CECR volume complémentaire; didactique des langues étrangères; interaction en ligne; interlocuteur
abstract_ko: 정보통신기술의 발전은 외국어로서의 프랑스어(FLE)교수·학습을 비롯한 모든 교육 분야에 혁신과 변화를 불러오고 있다. 특히, 생성형 인공지능 대화서비스는 텍스트 기반 실시간 온라인 상호작용을 위한 대화상대로서 새로운 가능성을 열어주고 있으며, 이를 통해 전통적인 교육구성원 간 상호작용의 유형을 넘어서는 인간과 인공지능 간의 관계가 형성되고 있다고 해도 과언이 아닐 것이다. 본 연구는 FLE학습자의 온라인 상호작용을 활성화하고, 그 능력을 증진시키기 위한 대화상대로서 ChatGPT의 활용 가능성을 탐구하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 우선 전통적인 상호작용의 개념을 재정의하였다. 다음으로, 텍스트 기반 실시간 온라인 상호작용이 컴퓨터 매개 통신에서부터 현재의 생성형 인공지능 대화서비스로 발전해 온 과정을 살펴보며 대화상대의 범위를 인공지능에까지 확장할 가능성에 관하여 논하였다. 이를 토대로 하여, 2018년 유럽언어공통참조기준 보충판에 제시된 온라인 상호작용 능력기술문에 나타난 상호작용자로서의 학습자의 역할 변화와 함께 대화상대로서 인공지능의 역할을 고찰하였다. 덧붙여, ChatGPT가 FLE학습에서 대화상대로서 어떠한 역할을 할 수 있으며, 그 한계는 무엇인지에 대해서도 논의하였다. 본 연구를 통하여 디지털 시대의 외국어 교육에서 상용화된 인공지능 대화서비스가 제공할 수 있는 잠재적인 가치를 평가하고, 더욱 효율적인 활용 방법을 모색하는 데 기여하고자 한다.
abstract_en: Le développement des technologies de l'information et de la communication (TIC) apporte des innovations et des changements dans tous les domaines de l'éducation, y compris dans l'enseignement-apprentissage du français langue étrangère (FLE). En particulier, les services de conversation basés sur l'intelligence artificielle (IA) générative ouvrent de nouvelles possibilités en tant qu'interlocuteurs pour les interactions en ligne en temps réel et textuelles. Ces innovations permettent l’émergence d'une relation entre l'humain et l'IA, dépassant ainsi les formes traditionnelles d'interaction entre les acteurs sociaux de langue. Cette recherche a pour objectif d'explorer le potentiel de ChatGPT en tant que support pour favoriser les interactions en ligne des apprenants de FLE et améliorer leurs compétences dans ce domaine. Pour ce faire, nous avons d'abord redéfini le concept traditionnel d'interaction. Ensuite, nous avons examiné l'évolution des interactions textuelles en ligne en temps réel, depuis la communication médiée par ordinateur jusqu'aux services de conversation basés sur l'IA générative, en discutant de la possibilité d'élargir le champ de la notion d'interlocuteur à l'IA. À partir de là, nous avons analysé le rôle de l'IA en tant qu'interlocuteur en lien avec l'évolution du rôle des apprenants, tel que présenté dans les descripteurs de compétence d'interaction en ligne du volume complémentaire du Cadre européen commun de référence pour les langues (CECR) publié en 2021. De plus, nous avons examiné les rôles que ChatGPT pouvait jouer en tant qu'interlocuteur dans l'apprentissage du FLE, ainsi que ses limites. Cette recherche vise à évaluer la valeur potentielle que peuvent offrir les services de conversation basés sur l'IA dans l'enseignement des langues étrangères à l'ère numérique. Elle pourra également contribuer à la recherche de méthodes d'utilisation plus efficaces.
note: 프랑스어(FLE) ChatGPT 대화상대

title_ko: Quelle place accorder à ChatGPT dans le cadre d’un cours de conversation de niveau A2?
title_en: Quelle place accorder à ChatGPT dans le cadre d’un cours de conversation de niveau A2?
kw_ko: 구두 상호작용; 회화; 다중양식 (Multimodality; 멀티 모달리티); 인공지능(AI)
kw_en: ChatGPT; interaction orale; conversation; multimodalité; intelligence artificielle
abstract_ko: À l’heure où ChatGPT prend place dans nos salles de classe, se pose la question du rôle que nous pourrions réellement lui attribuer dans l’enseignement/apprentissage du FLE. En tant qu’agent conversationnel dont la fonction première réside dans la simulation d’une conversation humaine, nous avons examiné la capacité du programme à s’inscrire dans le prolongement d’un cours de conversation de niveau A2. Nos étudiants sud-coréens n’ayant qu’assez peu d’opportunités de pratiquer l’oral en dehors de la classe, ChatGPT serait-il en mesure de remplir cette fonction d’interlocuteur francophone et de permettre la réutilisation de savoirs langagiers transmis en classe ? Pour y répondre, nos travaux seront développés en deux temps. Le présent article s’intéresse aux composantes de l’interaction orale, à sa multimodalité et au fonctionnement de ChatGPT. La confrontation de ces notions accompagnée de quelques tests sur le programme nous permettra d’émettre des hypothèses quant à sa capacité à occuper le rôle que nous souhaitons lui attribuer. Notre recherche pose ainsi les bases d’une étude plus large où, à l’aide d’un échantillon d’apprenants, nous vérifierons la validité de ces résultats.

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능 시대의 문식성 교육 방향 탐색─행위자 네트워크 이론을 중심으로─
title_en: Strategies for an Autonomous Literacy Network─Centered on Actor-Network Theory─
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 문식성; 행위자-네트워크 이론; 문식성 교육.
kw_en: Generative AI; Literacy; Latour; Actor-Network Theory; Literacy Education.
abstract_ko: 생성형 인공지능이 국어교육과 교실 현장에 미치는 영향은 심대하다. 언어 사용 행위의 표층적 층위에서 언어 행위를 대체하기 때문이다. 이 연구는 생성형 인공지능이 가져올 문식성 변화 양상을 기술하기 위한 이론적 논의를 목적으로 하였다. 이를 위해 라투르로 대표되는 행위자-네트워크 이론에 기대어 생성형 인공지능이 우리의 국어사용 교육에 미치는 영향을 체계적으로 검토하였다. 먼저 문식성 네트워크의 새로운 행위자로서 생성형 인공지능의 역할과 번역의 양상을 검토하였다. 이를 바탕으로 주체적 문식성 네트워크 구축을 위한 문식성 교육 방안을 목표, 내용, 방법의 측면에서 논의하였다. 이 연구는 문식성 교육에서 생성형 인공지능에 대응하는 관점의 이론적 토대를 마련하였다는 점에서 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: The impact of generative artificial intelligence on Korean language education and classroom environments is profound as it substitutes language actions at the superficial levels of linguistic usage. This study aimed to examine the theoretical discussions for describing the patterns of literacy changes that generative artificial intelligence will bring about. To this end, drawing on Actor-Network Theory, as represented by Latour, the study systematically examined the impact of generative artificial intelligence on our Korean language education. Initially, the analysis focused on the role of generative artificial intelligence as a new actor within the literacy network and the nature of its translations. Building on these findings, the discussion covered educational strategies from the perspectives of objectives, content, and methods to establish an autonomous literacy network. This significant research lays a theoretical foundation for addressing generative artificial intelligence within literacy education.
note: ANT 기반 문식성 교육 방향 이론 논의(prev Y)

title_ko: ChatGPT 사용 경험에 대한 대학생 인식: 영어 글쓰기 과제 수행 중심으로
title_en: Korean College Students’ Perceptions of Using ChatGPT in English Writing
kw_ko: 챗지피티(ChatGPT); 영어교육; 인공지능; 한국 대학생; 대학생 영어 글쓰기; 학습자 인식
kw_en: ChatGPT; artificial intelligence; Korean college students; EFL writing; students’ perceptions
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 학문적 영어 글쓰기 과제 수행 과정에서 한국 대학생들의 ChatGPT 사용 목적과 효용성에 대한 인식을 파악하여 효과적인 과제 수행 방안을 모색해 나가는 데 연구의 목표를 둔다. 연구를 위해 총 93명의 참여자가 ChatGPT 사용의 목적과 만족도, 장단점, 그리고 전반적인 효용성에 관한 설문을 작성하였다. 수집된 자료는 빈도분석을 통한 기술분석을 시행하였고, ChatGPT의 장단점을 조사한 개방형 문항은 워드 클라우드를 사용해 주제 분석을 하였다. 연구 결과, 본 연구의 참여자들은 ChatGPT에 대해 전반적으로 긍정적인 인식을 가지고 사용에 만족하고 있었다. ChatGPT는 주로 과제 수행과 수업 내용 이해와 같은 학문적 목적으로 가장 많이 사용되었으며, 영어 학습에 있어서는 글쓰기에서 문법과 문장 구조를 확인하기 위한 용도로 주로 사용되었다. 영어 글쓰기에서는 교정과 수정을 위해 ChatGPT가 가장 높은 빈도로 활용되었다. 또한, 영어 글쓰기 과정에서 ChatGPT 사용을 통해 참여자들이 향상되었다고 인식한 부분은 문법 사용의 정확도와 교정 및 수정 실력향상이 상위를 차지하였다. ChatGPT의 장점과 관련된 키워드는 '쉽게', '정보', '원하는'이었으며, 단점과 관련된 키워드는 '오류'와 '실수'였다. 흥미롭게도, 학생들은 또래나 사전보다 ChatGPT의 피드백에 더 의존하는 경향을 보였지만, 여전히 교수자의 피드백을 ChatGPT보다 더 신뢰하는 것으로 드러났다. 이와 같은 결론을 종합해보자면, 한국 대학생들은 글쓰기 과제 수행 시 ChatGPT의 사용을 대체로 긍정적으로 받아들여 ChatGPT가 영어 글쓰기에 유용한 도구가 될 수 있음을 시사한다. 그러나 학습 효과를 극대화하기 위한 인공지능과 교수자의 상호보완적 역할에 대한 논의는 교육자들에게 여전히 중요한 과제로 남아 있다.
abstract_en: This study explores the experiences and perceptions of Korean college students using ChatGPT as a tool for completing assignments in a general English course focused on academic writing skills. A total of 93 students participated in the study by completing a questionnaire that addressed the purpose and satisfaction of using ChatGPT, its advantages and disadvantages, and its overall effectiveness. Descriptive statistics and thematic analysis were employed to analyze the data. A Word Cloud was used as an analytical tool to visualize the keywords from the two open-ended questions regarding the advantages and disadvantages of ChatGPT. The results indicated that Korean college students generally had a positive perception of ChatGPT. In terms of the purpose of using ChatGPT, it was found that ChatGPT was most frequently used for academic purposes, such as completing assignments and understanding course content. In the context of studying English, students primarily used ChatGPT to revise grammar and sentence structure. For English writing, ChatGPT was most often utilized for proofreading and editing. The keywords associated with the advantages of ChatGPT were "easily," "information," and "desired," while those related to its disadvantages were "errors" and "mistakes." Interestingly, students reported relying more on ChatGPT’s feedback than on that of their peers or dictionaries, yet they still valued human instructors’ feedback more highly than ChatGPT's. These findings suggest that ChatGPT can be a valuable tool for English writing, given the students' positive perceptions and satisfaction. However, the discussion of the complementary roles of artificial intelligence and human instructors remains important for educators.

title_ko: ChatGPT as a Tool in EFL Writing: An Analysis of Students Usage and Perceptions
title_en: ChatGPT as a Tool in EFL Writing: An Analysis of Students Usage and Perceptions
authors: 이종현(Seoul National University); 최회건(Seoul National University)
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 교육에서의 인공지능; 인공지능 보조 작문; 외국어로서의 영어 작문 지도; 과정 중심 작문
kw_en: ChatGPT; AI in education; AI-assisted writing; EFL writing instruction; Process Writing
abstract_ko: The advent of AI-powered language models such as ChatGPT is transforming educational practices, particularly in English as a Foreign Language (EFL) writing instruction. This study explored the integration of ChatGPT in EFL writing tasks within a college-level classroom setting. With minimal instructional intervention, students used ChatGPT to autonomously complete essay assignments, which were subsequently analyzed alongside a survey assessing their perceptions and experiences. Findings revealed that despite limited guidance, participants were able to effectively use ChatGPT to construct well-structured essays and generally held positive perceptions of the tool. They were aware of its limitations and reported increased motivation for language learning. However, participants did not fully maximize ChatGPT’s potential. Its usage was predominantly focused on the pre-writing stage. They did not report significant learning gains or increased confidence in their writing abilities. There was uncertainty regarding the tool’s linguistic completeness and its implications for plagiarism. These results suggest that while ChatGPT has potential as a powerful tool for EFL writing instruction, its educational benefits may be limited if thorough training on its effective and ethical use is not provided.

title_ko: 日本語学習における生成AIチャットボットの使用実態
title_en: The Actual Use of Generative AI Chatbots in Japanese Language Learning
kw_en: Generative AI; fact-finding survey; Japanese language learning; ChatGPT; 生成AI、実態調査、日本語学習、ChatGPT
abstract_ko: 本研究は、日本語学習者の生成AIチャットボット(ChatGPT、Gemini、Copilotなど)の使用実態を明らかにし、教育における活用を検討するための基礎資料を提供することを目的としている。近年、AI技術の進化と普及が進み、教育分野でも新しい学習方法として注目されているが、実際にどれだけの学生が生成AIを利用しているのか、その実態については十分に理解されていない。そこで、本研究では2024年4月から6月にかけて、韓国のB大学の日本語学習者206名を対象に、生成AIの利用実態に関するアンケート調査を実施した。その結果、生成AIの認知度は高く、回答者の93.2%が認知していたが、実際の使用経験は約75%に留まり、さらにその利用頻度は低く、一度または数回使用しただけの学生が多いことが明らかになった。利用しない理由としては「必要性を感じない」「信頼できる情報がない」「興味・関心がない」が主要な要因として挙げられた。外国語学習において生成AIを利用した学生は全体の42%程度であり、具体的な利用目的としては「文章の翻訳」「文法と語彙の説明」など、単純な結果や情報を求める使い方が多く、会話練習などの自律学習での利用は少ないことがわかった。また、高学年や上級レベルほど外国語学習のために利用する割合が高く、初級レベルでは使用していても明確な目的をもたない場合が多いことが示された。この結果から、日本語教育における生成AIの活用を検討する上で、生成AIの基本的な使い方や活用方法の教育、利用に関する学習倫理の確立、初級レベルの学習者向けのプロンプト設定やGPTsの開発、専攻や学年に応じた利用法の提案の必要性を指摘した。
abstract_en: This study aims to clarify how Japanese language learners are utilizing generative AI chatbots (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot) and to provide foundational data for their use in education. In recent years, AI technology has been evolving and is attracting attention as a new learning method in education. However, the extent to which students actually use generative AI remains unclear. A survey was conducted from April to June 2024 in the form of a questionnaire among 206 Japanese language learners at University B. The results revealed that 93.2% of the respondents were aware of generative AI chatbots, yet only 75% had actually utilized them, and even less frequently, with many students having used it only once or a few times. The main reasons given for not using the system were “not feeling the need,” “lack of reliable information” and “lack of interest”. 42% of the students used generative AI chatbots for foreign language learning, indicating that the specific purposes of use were “translation of texts,” “explanation of grammar and vocabulary” and “correction and proofreading of texts” with little use for autonomous learning such as conversation practice. Additionally, it was observed that higher grades and advanced level students were more likely to use AI chatbots for foreign language learning, whereas beginners often lacked clear objectives when using AI chatbots. Based on these findings, the study suggests the need for education on the basic usage and application of generative AI chatbots, the establishment of learning ethics concerning their use, the development of prompts and GPTs tailored to beginner-level learners, and the formulation of usage methods according to the learner's major and grade level in the context of Japanese language education.

title_ko: 메타버스를 활용한 교양일본어 수업 설계 및 평가 ― ZEP과 교실 내 학습을 융합한 블렌디드 러닝 ―
title_en: Design and Evaluation of a Liberal Arts Japanese Language Course Using the Metaverse: Blended Learning Combining ZEP and Classroom Learning
kw_ko: 교양일본어; 메타버스; 학습 동기
kw_en: Japanese language courses for liberal arts; metaverse; ZEP; learning motivation
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 메타버스 플랫폼 ZEP을 활용한 교양 일본어 수업을 설계하고 그 효과를 검증하는 것을 목적으로 한다. ZEP을 활용한 교양 일본어 수업의 효과적인 설계 및 운영을 위해, 자기결정이론(SDT)과 ARCS 모델을 통합 적용하여 학습자의 자율성, 유능감, 관계 형성을 지원하고, 주의 집중, 관련성, 자신감, 만족감을 높이는 메타버스 기반 교양 일본어 수업 설계 전략을 수립하였다. 이를 바탕으로 ZEP 기반 가상 학습 공간을 구축하고, 2023년 2학기 Y대학교 교양 일본어 수업 수강생 89명을 대상으로 실제 수업을 진행하였으며, 설문 조사를 통해 학습 동기 유발 및 수업 만족도를 분석하였다. 분석 결과, ZEP 활용 수업은 학습 동기 유발과 수업 만족도 향상에 효과적인 것으로 나타났다. 특히 주의 집중, 관련성, 자신감, 만족감 측면에서 긍정적인 평가를 받았는데, 이는 메타버스 플랫폼이 학습 동기를 유발하고 학습 참여를 촉진하는 데 효과적인 도구임을 시사한다. 본 연구는 메타버스를 활용한 일본어 교육의 잠재력과 가능성을 보여주는 실제적인 수업 설계 및 운영 방안을 제시하며, 향후 메타버스 기반 교육 모델 개발을 위한 기초 자료를 제공한다. 나아가 교양 일본어 교육뿐만 아니라 다른 외국어 교육 분야에도 적용 가능한 효과적인 교수 학습 모델 개발에 시사점을 제공할 수 있을 것이다.
abstract_en: This study aimed to design and evaluate the effectiveness of a college-level Japanese language course utilizing the metaverse platform ZEP. An instructional design strategy was developed by integrating Self-Determination Theory (SDT) and the ARCS model to foster learner autonomy, competence, and relatedness, while enhancing attention, relevance, confidence, and satisfaction within the metaverse-based learning environment. A virtual learning space was constructed on ZEP, and the course was implemented with 89 students enrolled in a college-level Japanese language class at Y University in the fall semester of 2023. Surveys were conducted to analyze learner motivation and satisfaction. The results revealed that the ZEP-based course was effective in enhancing learner motivation and satisfaction, particularly in the areas of attention, relevance, confidence, and satisfaction. This suggests that metaverse platforms can be effective tools for stimulating learner motivation and promoting active participation. This study contributes to the field by presenting a practical instructional design and implementation plan that demonstrates the potential and possibilities of metaverse-based Japanese language education. It provides a foundation for future development of metaverse-based educational models and offers implications for effective teaching and learning approaches in Japanese and other foreign language education contexts.

title_ko: AI로 재구성된 수준별 텍스트를 활용한 고등학교 영문학 수업 효과 연구
title_en: Utilizing AI-Generated Leveled Texts in EFL Literature Class
kw_en: EFL literature class; ChatGPT; AI-generated leveled text; pleasure reading; EFL learners
abstract_ko: This study aims to explore the use of AI to adapt English literature for easier comprehension in EFL classes, addressing the challenge learners face with the complexity of literary texts. By utilizing AI-assisted learning tools, specifically automatic text generation capabilities of ChatGPT, complex literary works are paraphrased into simplified versions. This study tested the effectiveness of AI-generated leveled texts through a case study involving twelve high school students reading various levels (1, 2, 3) of the adapted novel Wonder over three weeks. Students engaged in pleasure reading and evaluated the texts on aspects such as flow, coherence, difficulty, and engagement. The experiment’s findings indicate that the level-adapted texts were highly beneficial, offering more advantages than drawbacks. Students reported increased immersion and enjoyment, and even attempted more challenging texts. The adaptation’s effectiveness varied by proficiency; upper-level learners used simplified texts as supplementary materials, middle-level students were more engaged, and lower-level students found even the simplest texts challenging. Overall, students reported increased self-efficacy and motivation, suggesting that AI-modified texts enhance reading speed and comprehension. Despite its benefits, limitations in AI-generated leveled texts were recognized, pointing to potential areas for further refinement. This approach offers a promising avenue for making English literature more accessible to EFL learners, expanding educational possibilities for those intimidated by original literary works.

title_ko: “AI로 영어 에세이 읽기”: 영문과 전공수업에서챗GPT 활용 사례 연구
title_en: “Reading English Essay through AI”: A Case Study of Using ChatGPT in a Course for English Majors
kw_en: ChatGPT; reading; essay; question-answer teaching method; project-based learning; CSAT
abstract_ko: Based on the question-answer teaching method in teaching and learning English reading, this study aims to propose a new relational model between users and ChatGPT as a practical and symbiotic method of utilizing AI. In the dialogues presented in this paper, between me (instructor) and ChatGPT (virtual student), and between students (mentors) and ChatGPT (mentee), I position ChatGPT as both the object of being instructed and the agent of learning. This approach seeks to move away from the traditional perspective of viewing AI as a competitor or a substitute for human intellectual labor, which focuses on results―what AI can do for us. Furthermore, the goal is to shift the perspective of students, as users of ChatGPT, from passive, uncritical recipients of the information and answers provided by AI, to proactive learners and practitioners with three interconnected specialized roles: questioners, conversationalists, and future AI prompt engineers.

title_ko: 생성형 이미지 AI를 활용한 영문학 교육: 다중모드 문해력 활동으로써의 영화 포스터 제작
title_en: Teaching English Literature with Generative Image AI: Movie Poster Creation as a Multimodal Literacy Activity
kw_en: generative AI; multimodal literacy; English literature education; film poster project
abstract_ko: This article explores the integration of AI image generators in English literature education, focusing on “The Creation of Film Poster with AI” project implemented in a college-level “English Novels and Films” course. While AI’s role in education has garnered attention, its effectiveness in English literature pedagogy remains relatively understudied. This research demonstrates how generative image AI can enhance preservice teachers’ multimodal literacy skills and motivate them to incorporate AI skills in their future teaching practices. During the project, students worked collaboratively to analyze texts, design images, and create film posters. Results indicate that the creation of film posters with AI fosters students’ active engagement with texts, critical thinking, and the development of digital and multimodal literacy skills with knowledge of AI’s capabilities and limitations. Hence, this article contributes to the ongoing discourse on AI integration in English education, particularly in literature; my research underscores the importance of guiding students to critically understand AI’s potentials, developing their multimodal literacy alongside traditional literary analysis skills.

title_ko: 대화형 인공지능(ChatGPT)을 활용한 대화 연습 모형 개발 - 메타인지적 반성적 경험을 중심으로 -
title_en: The Development of a Conversation Practice Model Using Conversational AI(ChatGPT) - Focusing on Metacognitive Reflective Experience -
kw_ko: 한국어 말하기 교육; 상황 대화 연습; 대화형 인공지능(ChatGPT); 메타인지; 반성적 경험
kw_en: Korean Speaking Education; Situational Conversation Practice; Conversational Artificial Intelligence(ChatGPT); Metacognition; Reflective Experience
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 대화형 인공지능(ChatGPT)을 활용하여 한국어 말하기 교육의 효과를 분석하고, 그 과정에서 발견된 한계점들을 극복하기 위한 구체적인 방안을 탐구하였다. ChatGPT 기반의 말하기 수업 모형을 교육 현장에 적용한 결과, 학습자들의 말하기 유창성과 적절성이 향상되었으며, 자신의 발화를 성찰하고 오류를 수정하는 과정을 통해 정확성 또한 향상되었다. 이러한 경험은 단순한 언어 지식 습득을 넘어서, 학습자들이 말하기 상황을 스스로 인식하고 체험하는 능력을 증진시키는 데 중요한 역할을 하였다. 그러나 발음 인식의 오류, 반응 속도에 따른 부담, 그리고 비언어적 표현의 한계 등도 나타났다. 이 연구는 ChatGPT의 활용이 한국어 말하기 교육에서 어떻게 실질적인 효과를 발휘하며 동시에 어떤 한계를 가지고 있는지를 보여줌으로써, 성찰적 피드백과 메타인지적 접근의 필요성을 강조한다. 이러한 점에서 본 연구는 학습자들이 자기 성찰을 바탕으로 언어 능력을 강화하고, 실질적인 의사소통 능력을 개선할 수 있도록 하였다는 데 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: This study explored the effectiveness of Korean speaking education using ChatGPT and identified strategies to address its limitations. The application of a ChatGPT-based model in education improved learners’ fluency and appropriateness of speech, enhancing accuracy through self-reflection and error correction. Despite these advances, challenges such as pronunciation recognition errors and the burden of quick responses were noted. This research highlights the importance of reflective feedback and metacognitive approaches, emphasizing its role in enhancing learners’ linguistic skills and practical communication abilities through self-reflection.

title_ko: Theorizing the Role of Machine Translation in L2 Reading Comprehension: Validating the Theory and Exploring the Learning Potential through MT Use
title_en: Theorizing the Role of Machine Translation in L2 Reading Comprehension: Validating the Theory and Exploring the Learning Potential through MT Use
kw_en: machine translation; CI model; L2 reading; L1 reading; learning potential; translanguaging
abstract_ko: This study investigates the theoretical dimensions of how machine translation (MT) plays a role in relation to L1 reading competence in L2 reading comprehension. Leveraging Kintsch’s Construction-Integration (CI) model for L2 reading proposed by Oh (2014), our research posits that MT mediation enhances the textbase by alleviating constraints related to L2 proficiency. This, in turn, facilitates a more effective utilization of L1 reading resources, contributing to an enriched situation model. To explore this hypothesis, we conducted an empirical study with 89 college students enrolled in a general English course at a South Korean university. Participants engaged in reading activities under two conditions: a pre-MT (reading without MT) and a post-MT (reading with MT). The comprehensive model, incorporating a textbase indicated by L2 vocabulary, grammar, and sentence parsing, and a situation model represented by L1 reading competence, was examined through structural equation modelling across these conditions. Additionally, we analyzed learning potential scores (LPS)—reflecting the difference between the two conditions—using hierarchical multiple regression to identify significant predictors of enhanced comprehension with MT use. Our findings confirm the validity of the models, demonstrating the textbase as a key mechanism through which MT influences reading comprehension. The results also underscore the significance of L1 reading competence and L2 parsing ability as key predictors for LPS. These findings are discussed within the context of the changing multiliteracies landscape, contributing to the broader discourse on language education and technology integration.

title_ko: 인공지능 기반 쓰기 평가 도구와글쓰기 평가자의 비교 연구 -독후감 텍스트를 중심으로-
title_en: A Comparative Study of AI-Based Writing Assessment Tools and Human Evaluators - Focusing on book report texts -
kw_ko: 쓰기 평가; 쓰기 평가 기준; 독후감 평가; 인공지능; 인공지능 자동 채점; 쓰기 자동 채점 프로그램; 데이터 분석
kw_en: writing assessment; writing assessment criteria; assessment of book reports; artificial intelligence; writing auto-grader; writing auto-grader program; data analytics
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 인공지능을 활용한 글쓰기 평가 프로그램이 교사를 대신하여 교육현장에서 쓰기 평가 도구로 활용할 수 있는지에 관한 가능성을 알아보고, 인공지능을 활용하여 쓰기 평가를 위해 필요한 채점 기준을 찾아보는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위하여 독후감 경연대회에 출품한 854편의 독후감을 대상으로 자동 채점도구 KEEwi를 사용하여, 6가지 평가 기준과 최종적인 종합 점수로 글쓰기를 평가하였다. 평가 후 각 항목 간 관계성 확인을 위해 상관 행렬을 확인하였다. 분석 결과 인공지능 평가의 종합점수 분포가 종형 곡선(bell curve)의 정규분포를 따르는 것으로 나타나 인공지능의 글쓰기 평가능력이 평가 항목에 따라 자체적으로 합리성을 갖추고 있는 것을 알 수 있었다. 그러나 심사위원이 좋은 글로 평가한 ‘수상작’을 비교한 결과 인공지능 평가와 일치하지는 않았다. 하지만인간이 평가한 수상작의 77%가 인공지능 평가 점수의 중간값을 기준으로 오른쪽 구간에서 더 많이 나타나 전체적인 쓰기 평가 경향을 살펴볼 때 인공지능과인간 평가에 유사성이 있는 것으로 파악되었다. 이와 같은 분석 결과를 통해 인공지능 자동 채점을 위해 필요한 교육적 논의로 장르적 특성을 고려한 평가 기준 마련과 학습자 수준 등 변인에 따른 쓰기평가 기준이 개발의 필요성을 들었다. 글쓰기 평가자와 인공지능 쓰기 평가 도구를 비교하여 그 결과를 분석했다는 데 그 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: This study aimed to investigate the feasibility of a writingassessment program using generative AI to replace writing assessmentby teachers in educational settings and to identify the necessary scoringcriteria for writing assessment using generative AI. To this end, 854book reports submitted to a book report contest were evaluated usingKEEwi, an automated scoring tool, to assess writing based on sixevaluation criteria and a final composite score. After the evaluation, acorrelation matrix was calculated to see the relationship between eachitem. The analysis revealed that the overall score distribution of AIevaluations followed a normal distribution and; formed a bell-shapedcurve. This indicates that AI writing assessment capabilities possessinherent rationality across different evaluation criteria. However, 77%of the winning entries evaluated by humans were more frequentlyfound in the right segment than in the median of the AI evaluationscores, suggesting a similarity between AI and human evaluations inoverall writing assessment trends. These results indicated, a need foreducational discussions to establish evaluation criteria considering genrecharacteristics and develop writing assessment standards based on variables such as learner levels for AI- automated scoring. Thesignificance of this study lies in the comparison and analysis of theresults between human evaluators and AI writing assessment tools.

title_ko: Chat GPT류 AI와 학습자 간 텍스트 요약 양상 고찰
title_en: Exploration of Text Summarization Patterns Between ChatGPT-like AIs and Learners
kw_ko: 텍스트 요약; 언어 생성형 AI; 추출 요약; 추상 요약; 읽기 교육
kw_en: text summarization; language generative AI; extractive summarization; abstractive summarization; reading education
abstract_ko: 본고는 대규모 언어 모델인 언어 생성형 의 요약 능력을 학습자와 비교하고AI , 그 결과를 논의하였다 학습자 수준에 따라 차이가 있었는데 언어 수행 수준이 낮. , 다고 상정된 학습자들에 비해서는 가 더 나은 결과를 언어 수행 수준이 상대적AI , 으로 높다고 상정된 학습자들과는 차이가 없었다 아울러 가 산출한 요약문과 학. AI 습자의 요약문의 속성에는 차이가 없었다. 본고는 제한적으로나마 학습자와 의 요약 능력 비교를 통해 그 교육적 논의를 AI 구성하였다 학습자의 수준이나 연령 몇몇 제한된 의 사용 등에서 일정한 한계. , AI 가 따랐지만 의 텍스트 요약 수준이 학습자와 큰 차이가 없거나 오히려 우수했, AI 음이 드러났다 기존의 자연 언어 처리에서의 자동 요약이 보이던 낮은 수준과는 현저하게 다른 모습이다 향후 국어교육 현장의 읽기나 쓰기 교육에서의 의 활용 . AI 가능성에 대해 다양하고 본격적인 논의가 기대된다.
abstract_en: This paper compares the summarization abilities of large language models, such as conversational and generative AI, with those of learners and discusses the results. There were differences based on the learners' proficiency levels: AI performed better compared to learners with assumed lower language proficiency, while there was no significant difference between AI and learners with assumed higher proficiency. Additionally, there were no notable differences in the characteristics of the summaries produced by AI and those produced by learners. Through this limited comparison of summarization abilities between learners and AI, the paper contributes to educational discussions. Despite certain limitations related to the learners' proficiency, age, and the restricted use of AI, the study revealed that AI's summarization capabilities were either comparable to or superior to those of learners. This represents a significant improvement compared to the lower levels seen in previous automatic summarization systems within natural language processing. Future discussions on the potential use of AI in reading and writing education within Korean language education are anticipated to be diverse and substantial.

title_ko: ChatGPT-integrated English Writing: Writing Strategies and Perceptions
title_en: ChatGPT-integrated English Writing: Writing Strategies and Perceptions
kw_en: ChatGPT; English writing; writing strategy; writing anxiety
abstract_ko: The study explored Korean university students’ writing strategies and perceptions of ChatGPTintegrated English writing. Twenty-seven students participated in the study, and completed the survey, which included questions on English writing strategies, English writing anxiety, and perceptions of ChatGPT-integrated English writing class. In addition, interviews were conducted with seven participants to gain deeper insights. The results revealed that the participants frequently employed strategies such as contemplating the given topic before writing in English, utilizing translation applications when writing in English, ask for help from ChatGPT for revising. The study also indicated that the participants perceived ChatGPT as a valuable tool for English writing, benefiting them both cognitively and affectively. Moreover, the results of paired samples t-test demonstrated that ChatGPT contributed to reducing the participants’ English writing anxiety. The interview results reaffirmed the benefits and challenges of incorporating ChatGPT in English writing. Based on the findings, the study suggests that ChatGPT be utilized as a writing assistant in EFL writing instruction, benefiting both EFL learners and teachers.

title_ko: ChatGPT 활용에 관한 중학교 영어 교사의 인식 및 태도
title_en: The perceptions and attitudes of middle school English teachers toward the use of ChatGPT in Korea
kw_ko: 한국 중학교 영어 교사; ChatGPT 활용 전략; 디지털 역량
kw_en: Korean Middle School English Teachers; Strategies for Using ChatGPT; Digital
abstract_ko: This study examines the perceptions and attitudes of middle school English teachers in Korea regarding the use of ChatGPT and its potential educational applications. A survey was conducted with 141 teachers to assess various dimensions, including the usefulness, effectiveness, and appropriateness of using ChatGPT in educational settings. The main results of the study are as follows. The majority of the middle school English teachers use ChatGPT in their daily lives but do not actively use it in their classes. The reason for this discrepancy is that, although they recognize ChatGPT as a useful and appropriate tool, they do not believe students will find it interesting as a learning tool. Additionally, while teachers acknowledge the necessity of using ChatGPT in the classroom, they do not intend to actively utilize it. A noteworthy finding is that the middle school English teachers do not perceive limitations in fostering critical thinking and provision of inaccurate or inappropriate information, often cited as disadvantages of ChatGPT, as negative aspects of using ChatGPT in the classroom. This result is consistent with the recognition of ChatGPT as a useful and appropriate tool and the acknowledgment of the need to use it in the classroom. Nonetheless, many teachers are unwilling to use ChatGPT in the classroom because they find it difficult to use ChatGPT as a teaching tool or learning aid. Lastly, middle school English teachers recognize that various factors, such as AI ethics and assessment criteria, need to be considered before ChatGPT can be used appropriately in English classes in Korea. These findings provide valuable insights for advancing the use of AI in middle school English instruction and contribute to the broader discussion on AI’s potential in education.

title_ko: 기계번역기 사용방법에 대한 탐구: 영어 능숙도가 다른 두 한국인 학습자를 통한 사례연구
title_en: An investigation of machine translator use: A case study with two Korean EFL students at different English proficiency levels
kw_ko: 기계번역기 사용; 영작문; 한국인 영어학습자; 제2언어 능숙도
kw_en: machine translator use; English writing; Korean EFL learners; L2 proficiency
abstract_ko: While the effectiveness of machine translators (MT) has been overtly focused on in L2 writing, scant attention has been paid to students’ actual use of MT in situated educational contexts. To fill this gap, the present study explored how two Korean college students with different levels of English proficiency utilized MT for composing an English text. Students were asked to participate in a series of writing sessions, where they wrote English texts with the help of MT at their discretion. A variety of data were collected for qualitative analysis, including questionnaires, student texts, reflection journals, and interviews. It was found that students exhibited divergent strategies to take advantage of technological affordances. The main purpose of MT use by the more proficient student was to construct cohesion and coherence in writing and search for sophisticated vocabulary, whereas the other student used MT mainly for identifying and addressing her difficulties in terms of grammar and vocabulary. Despite their different purposes of MT use, both students took MT as a self-directed learning tool. These findings shed light on the educational potential of MT, which could be implemented in a writing classroom to assist not only English learners, but also instructors.

title_ko: 교양영어의 AI앱 활용 PBL 수업활동에 대한 학생들의 정의적 태도와 수업경험에 관한 연구
title_en: A Study on Students’ Affective Attitudes and Learning Experiences in PBL Activities Utilizing an AI App in General English Classes
kw_ko: 문제중심; 협동수업; AI앱; 정의적 태도; 수업경험
kw_en: PBL; Cooperative Learning; AI App; Affective Attitudes; Learning Experience
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 AI앱을 활용한 PBL의 협동수업이 학습자의 정의적 태도에 영향을 미치는지 살펴보고 PBL 활동에서 학생들의 학습경험을 조사하는데 있다. 이를 위하여 충청남도 소재 대학의 1학년에 재학 중인 71명을 대상으로 온라인 설문을 실시하였고 PBL 활동에 대한 학습일지를 작성하도록 하였다. 학생들의 AI앱 PBL 활동에서 정의적 영역을 조사하기 위해 SPSS 28 프로그램을 사용하여 신뢰도 측정과 사전과 사후 설문의 t검정을 실시하여 분석하였다. 또한 수집된 주관식 문항은 같은 개념으로 범주화하여 분석되었다. 본 연구의 결과로 PBL 활동이 학생들의 정의적 태도 중 영어의 흥미도, 학습동기, 자신감에 영향을 미친다는 것을 알 수 있었다. 하지만 수업 참여도에서는 유의미한 결과를 보이지 않았다. 또한, 학생들은 AI앱을 활용하는데 있어서 PBL1보다 PBL2활동에서‘재표현하기’, ‘요약하기’, ‘고쳐쓰기’, ‘내용 조직하기’에 대한 활용이 높아진 것을 알 수 있었다. 학생들은 AI앱 기반 PBL 활동에서 AI앱에 대한 학습적, 심리적, 정의적 측면 그리고 유용성에 있어서 긍정적인 학습경험을 얻었다고 했다. 본 연구결과를 바탕으로 몇 가지 시사점을 토론하였다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to examine the influence of AI apps on learners' affective attitudes in problem-based learning (PBL) cooperative classes and to investigate students' learning experiences in PBL activities. For this purpose, an online survey was conducted with 71 first-year students at a university in Chungcheongnam-do, and they were asked to keep learning journals about their PBL activities. To investigate the affective areas in students’ AI-based PBL activities, the SPSS 28 program was used to measure reliability and conduct t-tests for pre- and post-surveys. Moreover, the collected open-ended responses were categorized and then analyzed. The study found that PBL activities positively influenced students' affective attitudes, specifically their interest in English, learning motivation, and confidence. However, there were no statistically significant results in regard to student class participation. In addition, when using the AI app, students were found to have increased their use of ‘rephrasing,’ ‘summarizing,’ ‘revising,’ and ‘organizing content’ in PBL2 activities compared to PBL1. Students also reported that they gained positive learning experiences from AI app-based PBL activities in terms of educational, psychological, and affective aspects, as well as the usability of the AI app. Based on the results of this study, several implications were discussed.
note: AI앱 PBL 교양영어 정의적 태도 사전·사후, 앱 미상

title_ko: Processing of Machine Translation Errors by Korean Learners of English: An Eye-tracking Study
title_en: Processing of Machine Translation Errors by Korean Learners of English: An Eye-tracking Study
kw_ko: 기계 번역 오류; 시선 추적; L2 학습자; L2 능숙도; 한영 번역
kw_en: machine translation; eye-tracking measures; L2 processing; L2 proficiency; Korean-to-English translation errors
abstract_ko: The present study investigates second language (L2) processing of machine translation (MT) errors in Korean-to-English translations using an eye-tracker. Twenty-five Korean learners of English participated in an Acceptability Judgment Task in which they had to rate the accuracy of Korean-to-English translated sentences while their reading times, fixations, and revisits were recorded. The effect of proficiency level (high vs. low), six error types, and language (English vs. Korean) on the participants’ responses and reading measures were examined and analyzed. The findings indicate that high-proficiency learners demonstrated a clearer differentiation between accurate and inaccurate translations and were better at recognizing errors related to proverbs and subjects, while low-proficiency learners exhibited a higher number of revisits and fixations especially when processing subject-related errors. These findings highlight the importance of proficiency level in shaping how learners process MT errors and have important pedagogical implications for MT-assisted language instruction.

The findings indicate that high-proficiency learners demonstrated a clearer differentiation between accurate and inaccurate translations and were better at recognizing errors related to proverbs and subjects, while low-proficiency learners exhibited a higher number of revisits and fixations especially when processing subject-related errors. title_ko: 챗봇 제작과 상호문화교육 - 일본 민담 <해파리는 뼈가 없다>를 중심으로
title_en: Creating Chatbot and Intercultural Education - Focusing on the Japanese Folktale The Jellyfish Has No Bones
kw_ko: 챗봇; 상호문화교육; 다이얼로그플로우; 마이클 바이람; 일본 민담; 다문화; 질문; 해석; 디지털 인문학
kw_en: Chatbot; Intercultural Education; Dialogflow; Michael Byram; Japanese folktale; Multi-cultural; question; interpretation; Digital Humanities
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 한국 중학생들을 대상으로 구글의 챗봇 빌더인 다이얼로그플로우(Dialogflow)를 활용해 일본 민담 <해파리는 뼈가 없다>를 주제로 챗봇을 제작하고, 그 과정을 상호문화교육의 관점에서 분석하는 것이다. 상호문화교육은 다문화사회에서 필수적인 교육 방식이며 본 연구에서는 마이클 바이럼(Michael Byram)의 상호문화 이론 중 '해석하고 관련짓는 기술'과 '발견하고 상호작용하는 기술'을 중심으로 고찰한다. 연구에 참여한 학습자들은 이야기 속 다양한 요소를 분석하고 해석하여 질문과 답을 생성하고, 사용자의 입장에서 수정과 테스트를 반복하며 챗봇을 제작한다. 이 과정에서 학습자들은 타문화에 대해 깊이 있게 탐구하며 상호문화 능력을 향상한다.
abstract_en: This study focuses on the development of a chatbot based on the Japanese folktale The Jellyfish Has No Bones, created using Google's chatbot builder, Dialogflow, with a group of Korean middle school students. The process is analyzed through the lens of intercultural education, a crucial approach in multicultural societies. Specifically, this study applies Michael Byram's intercultural theory, with an emphasis on the skills of ‘interpreting and relating’ and ‘discovering and interacting.’ The participating students analyzed and interpreted various elements of the story, generating questions and responses while continuously refining and testing the chatbot from the user’s perspective. Through this process, the students engaged deeply with another culture and enhanced their intercultural competence.
note: 일본 민담 챗봇 제작=상호문화교육, 언어교육 아님

title_ko: 생성형 AI를 활용한 언어교육 연구의 동향과 전망－토픽 모델링과 키워드 분석을 중심으로
title_en: Trends and Prospects of Language Education Research Using Generative AI : Focusing on Topic Modeling and Keyword Analysis
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 언어교육; 연구 동향; 토픽 모델링; 생성형 AI 교육적 활용 사례
kw_en: generative AI; language education; research trends; topic modeling; educational use cases of generative AI
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 인공지능을 활용한 언어교육의 최신 연구 동향을 분석하여, 생성형 인공지능이 언어교육에서 활용 가능성과 전망을 살펴보는 데 있다. 이를 위하여 한국학술지인용색인(KCI)와 학술연 구정보서비스(RISS)에 게재된 학술지, 학위 논문을 상세 검색하여 연구 대상을 수집하여 통계적 분석과 LDA 기반 토픽 모델링(Topic Modeling) 기법으로 언어교육에서 생성형 인공지능을 활용한 연구 주제에 대해 분석하였다. 이를 분석 결과 92편의 연구는 ChatGPT 3.0이 개발된 2023년 이후 급격히 증가하였고, 주로 생성형 AI를 활용한 연구가 주를 이룬 것으로 나타났다. 언어권별로는 한국어를 주제로 한 연구가 가장 많았으며, 그다음으로 영어, 독일어 순이었다. 토픽 모델링 기법을 사용하여 92편 학술 문서를 키워드 분석한 결과 생성형 인공지능에 대한 학술 논문에서는 ‘교육’, ‘생성’, ‘활용’, ‘인공지능’, ‘학습’ 등이 가장 많이 나타났다. 이런 연구 결과를 바탕으로 실제 언어교육에서 생성형 AI의 활용 사례를 국내외로 살펴보고, 언어교육 현장에서 그 활용 가능성을 알아보았다. 그리고 언어교육에서 생성형 인공지능을 활용 시 문제점을 제시하고 이를 해결하기 위한 방안을 제안하였다.`
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to analyze the latest research trends in language education using artificial intelligence, focusing on the potential and prospects of generative artificial intelligence in this field. To achieve this, academic journals and dissertations published on the Korea Citation Index (KCI) and the Academic Research Information Service (RISS) were thoroughly searched to collect subjects for research, which were then analyzed using statistical methods and LDA-based topic modeling techniques. The analysis showed a significant increase in research, with 92 studies emerging after the development of ChatGPT 3.0 in 2023, predominantly focusing on the use of generative AI. The majority of these studies were focused on the Korean language, followed by English and German. Keyword analysis of the 92 academic documents using topic modeling techniques revealed that terms such as ‘education’, ‘generation’, ‘utilization’, ‘artificial intelligence’, and ‘learning’ were most frequently used. Based on these findings, the study examines practical examples of generative AI use in language education both domestically and internationally, explores its potential in the educational field, identifies challenges when utilizing generative AI in language education, and proposes solutions to address these issues.`

title_ko: Student Perceptions of ChatGPT in Mandatory EFL Writing Classes at a Korean University : A Case Study
title_en: Student Perceptions of ChatGPT in Mandatory EFL Writing Classes at a Korean University : A Case Study
kw_ko: AI 도구; 영어 작문 수업; 영어 교육
kw_en: ChatGPT; AI tools; EFL writing class; English education
abstract_ko: This study explored to what extent students at a Korean university perceive ChatGPT as useful in mandatory university EFL writing classes. In addition, preferences regarding methods of instruction and the outlook for future classes of a similar nature in the era of ChatGPT were also examined. 239 students enrolled at a university located on the outskirts of Seoul responded to a survey questionnaire consisting of a combination of multiple choice, 10-point Likert scale, and open-ended questions, which was used as the primary data collection method. Data analysis was conducted using general qualitative analysis for open ended questions and descriptive statistics for multiple choice and 10-point Likert scale questions. In addition, if consent was given, survey participants were contacted by e-mail to discuss responses in further detail. Despite concerns relating to ownership of learning and overreliance, the findings indicate generally positive perceptions of ChatGPT in terms of assisting with grammar, vocabulary, brainstorming, and proofreading. Conventional approaches (e.g., human teacher, in person lessons, and inter student / teacher communication) are still highly desired although the increasing influence of ChatGPT cannot be ignored. There is a belief that mandatory EFL writing classes currently play a vital role at Korean universities, and there is a strong preference for them to continue. Administrational and educational implications are also discussed.`

title_ko: 초·중등 교사교육을 위한 생성형 인공지능 적용 진로영어 연계교육: 대학생 피드백을 통한 통찰
title_en: Generative AI in career English integrated education for K-12 teacher training: Insights from university student feedback
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 진로영어 통합교육; 2022 개정 교육과정; 교사교육
kw_en: generative AI; career-English integrated education; 2022 revised curriculum; teacher education
abstract_ko: This study investigates the use of generative AI in career English integrated education for K-12 teacher training, carried out in two stages. In the first stage, university students with various majors participated in AI-based career English integrated lessons. Feedback from these students led to refinement of AI tools, including a shift from Poe AI to Mizou AI for better accessibility and functionality. In the second stage, various AI tools were introduced to elementary and secondary teachers, guiding them on personalizing career English integrated education. Results showed that elementary teachers responded more positively and consistently, while secondary teachers, in contrast, identified challenges, particularly with the rigid, grade-based evaluation systems. Specifically, elementary teachers rated career decision-making and subject interest higher than secondary teachers, although their differences were not statistically significant (p > 0.05). These results suggest that while AI tools can offer promising solutions for integrating career education into English teaching, their effectiveness is contingent on flexibility of existing evaluation systems and adapting AI tools to classroom-specific contexts. Additionally, this study highlights the need for ongoing professional training for teachers to better integrate AI technologies into their pedagogy, ensuring they can utilize these tools effectively across diverse educational settings.

title_ko: The Effects of ChatGPT-Assisted Teacher Feedback on Korean College Students’ English Writing
title_en: The Effects of ChatGPT-Assisted Teacher Feedback on Korean College Students’ English Writing
kw_ko: ChatGPT 보조 피드백; 교사 피드백; 대학생 영어 글쓰기; 동기
kw_en: ChatGPT-assisted feedback; teacher feedback; college English writing; motivation
abstract_ko: This study investigates the impact of ChatGPT-assisted teacher feedback on the writing skills and motivation of Korean EFL learners, compared to traditional teacher feedback, in two English composition classes at a Korean university. 41 Korean EFL university students were divided into two groups: 20 students in the control group received traditional teacher feedback whereas 21 students in the experimental group received ChatGPT-assisted teacher feedback. Data was collected through writing samples, questionnaires and interviews. To assess the students’ writing skills, pre- and post-tests of writing were administered as well as a survey questionnaire and interviews about their motivation and perceptions of the use of ChatGPT. Students were individually interviewed to examine the influence of ChatGPT-assisted teacher feedback in the revision process. There were statistically significant differences in learners’ writing performance between pre- and post-test scores in both groups. Results revealed that both feedback styles were efficient for an improvement of the learners’ writing ability. However, the two groups were distinguished in terms of their perceptions and attitudes to feedback practices. The control group was motivated with the teacher’s context-specific feedback on content while the experimental group was demotivated with ChatGPT’s hallucinated feedback. This study implicates the effectiveness of using ChatGPT as a supplemental tool for constructive feedback on the revision process with EFL Korean university learners.

title_ko: 인간과 AI의 위치짓기에 관한 국어교육적 접근: 비-인간 행위자로서 AI와의 대화 상황을 중심으로
title_en: Korean language educational approach to the positioning of humans and AI: Focusing on the situation of conversation with AI as a non-human actor
kw_ko: 인공지능; 위치짓기; AI 리터러시; 국어교육; 질문 생성; 변혁적 역량
kw_en: artificial intelligence; positioning; AI literacy; question generation; transformative capabilities
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 인간이 AI를 활용하여 의미를 구성해가는 맥락을 인간과 비-인간 행위자의 소통 과정으로 전제하고 위치짓기 이론을 중심으로 인간과 AI의 대화 장면에서 발견될 수 있는 이들 간의 역동(力動)을 살핌으로써, 서로의 위치가 결정되는 요인을 ‘입장’, ‘발화와 기타 행위’, ‘줄거리’를 중심으로 도출하였다. 세 가지 요인을 토대로 인간과 AI의 위상(位相)을 좌표평면에 도해하고, 각 위치에서의 활용 사례와 특성을 탐색하였다. 끝으로, AI의 주체적인 사용자로서 학습자를 지원하기 위한 ‘다시-위치짓기’의 국어교육적 접근 방향을 모색하였다. 끝으로 새로운 매체인 AI를 향한 대응과 가능성 모두를 타진하는 교육 연구가 계속해서 이어지기를 제언하였다.
abstract_en: This study assumes a context in which humans use AI to construct meaning as part of the communication process between human and non-human actors. By examining the dynamics between humans and AI in dialogue, with a focus on the theory of positioning, the factors determining each party’s position were identified, centering on “position,” “speech and other acts,” and “storyline.” Based on these three factors, the positioning between humans and AI was plotted on a coordinate plane, and the dialogue patterns and characteristics at each point were analyzed. The educational approach of “second-positioning” was also explored to support learners as independent users of AI. Lastly, it is suggested that educational research examining both the responses and potential of AI as a new medium should continue.

title_ko: 예비 국어교사를 대상으로 한 인공지능 활용 시 창작 수업 사례 연구 - 인공지능 활용 시 창작 수업에 대한 인식과 시 창작 프롬프트 분석을 중심으로
title_en: A Case Study on AI-Assisted Poetry Writing Classes for Pre-Service Korean Language Teachers - Focusing on Perceptions of AI-Assisted Poetry Education and Prompt Analysis
kw_ko: 인공지능; 시 창작; 예비 국어교사; 문학 교육; 챗GPT

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 인공지능(AI) 프로그램을 활용한 시 창작 교육에 대한 예비 국어교사의 인식을 분석하고, 시 창작 과정에서 AI 프로그램이 어떻게 활용될 수 있는지에 대한 실질적인 교육 사례를 제시한다. 연구는 수도권 K대학교 사범대학 국어교육과 전공 수업에서 진행된 인공지능 시 창작 수업을 바탕으로, 수업 전후 예비 교사들의 인식 변화를 설문조사와 프롬프트 분석을 통해 탐색하였다. 연구 결과, AI 프로그램을 활용한 시 창작 수업이 학생들의 창의적 사고를 유도하며 시에 대한 흥미를 높이는 데 긍정적인 영향을 미치는 것으로 나타났다. 또한, 프롬프트의 적절한 구성은 창작 주체로서 학생이 역할을 유지하는 데 중요한 요소로 작용하였다. 이러한 결과를 바탕으로 AI 프로그램이 교육 현장에서 시 창작 도구로 활용될 가능성을 논의하며, 교사의 역할과 프롬프트 설계의 중요성을 강조한다.
abstract_en: This study examines the perceptions of pre-service Korean language teachers regarding poetry creation using artificial intelligence (AI) programs and presents practical examples of how AI can be integrated into the poetry writing process. The research is based on an AI poetry creation class conducted in the Korean Language Education Department at a university in the Seoul metropolitan area. Using surveys and prompt analysis, the study explored changes in pre-service teachers’ perceptions before and after the class. The findings reveal that AI-assisted poetry writing can foster students' creative thinking and significantly enhance their interest in poetry. Moreover, the appropriate design of prompts was found to be crucial in maintaining students' roles as primary creative agents. Based on these results, the study discusses the potential use of AI as a tool for poetry education in schools and emphasizes the importance of teacher involvement and effective prompt design in maximizing educational outcomes.

title_ko: AI 챗봇의 교육적 활용 가능성과 효과성 고찰을 위한 영어 학습자의 인식 및 태도 연구
title_en: A Study on English Learners' Perceptions and Attitudes to Examine the Potential and Effectiveness of the Educational Application of an AI Chatbot
kw_ko: AI 챗봇; 교육적 활용; 효과성; 교양영어수업; 인식과 태도
kw_en: AI Chatbot; Educational Application; Effectiveness; General English Classes; Perceptions and Attitudes
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 대학교의 교양영어에서 학습도구로서 AI 챗봇의 교육적 활용 가능성 및 효과성을 알아보기 위한 목적으로 수행되었다. 이를 위해 97명의 대학생들은 AI 챗봇을 활용하여 조별 발표 프로젝트 및 개별 과업을 수행하였고 AI 챗봇 활용일지 작성을 수행하였다. 영어수업에서 AI 챗봇의 활용에 대한 학습자 인식과 태도를 조사하기 위한 사전·사후 설문조사, 그리고 사전·사후 영어성취도 평가는 기술통계로 분석되었고, AI 챗봇 활용일지의 학생 의견은 질적분석 방법으로 분석되었다. 본 연구의 결과는 다음과 같다. 첫째, 영어수업에서 AI 챗봇 활용에 대한 학습자의 인식과 태도는 전반적으로 긍정적인 결과를 보였다. 둘째, 영어수업에서 AI 챗봇 활용은 용이성과 편리성 때문에 영어수업에 대한 높은 효과와 만족도를 이끌었다. 셋째, 영어수업에서 AI 챗봇의 활용은 학습자들의 영어성취도를 향상시키고 전반적인 학습성과에 긍정적인 영향을 주었다. 본 연구의 결과를 바탕으로, 교수자들에게 학습자에 대한 더욱 깊은 이해의 필요성과 함께 대학교의 영어수업에서 AI 챗봇 활용의 가능성을 제안하고, AI 기반의 영어수업을 운영하는데 필요한 실질적인 도움을 제공하고자 하였다.
abstract_en: This study investigated the potential educational application and effectiveness of an AI chatbot as a learning tool in general English classes at universities. To achieve this, 97 college students used an AI chatbot to perform group presentation projects and individual tasks and kept AI chatbot usage journals. A descriptive analysis was conducted on pre- and post-surveys of learners’ perceptions and attitudes toward using an AI chatbot in English classes and on pre- and post-English achievement tests. In addition, student opinions from AI chatbot usage journals were analyzed using qualitative methods. The results of this study are as follows. First, learners' perceptions and attitudes toward using an AI chatbot in English classes showed positive results. Second, using an AI chatbot led to high effectiveness and satisfaction in English classes due to its ease of use and convenience. Third, using an AI chatbot in English classes improved learners' English achievement and had a positive effect on overall learning outcomes. The results of this study suggest the potential of an AI chatbot as an educational tool in English university classes, highlight the importance of gaining a deeper understanding of learners’ needs and provide practical support for implementing AI-based English classes.

title_ko: Fine-Tuning-Free English Pronunciation Assessment System Using Multimodal Large Language Models
title_en: Fine-Tuning-Free English Pronunciation Assessment System Using Multimodal Large Language Models
kw_ko: 멀티모달 대형 언어 모델; 영어 발음 평가
kw_en: Multimodal large language models; English pronunciation assessment
abstract_ko: This study explores the performance and characteristics of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in evaluating the English pronunciation of Korean speakers. While advancements in AI have enabled the development of various pronunciation assessment models with minimal data and fine-tuning, the limitation of requiring well-curated training data for specific purposes persisted. However, pre-trained Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated the ability to perform tasks based on human instructions without additional training. This research investigates the effectiveness of using pre-trained MLLMs for pronunciation assessment without fine-tuning, comparing their evaluation results with those of human raters using the Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC). The results showed a high correlation of 0.798 for prosody scores, while articulation scores exhibited a lower correlation of 0.45. Despite scoring discrepancies between model and human raters, this study proposes a novel approach to pronunciation assessment without additional training, suggesting the potential for MLLMs to be widely applied as automated speaking assessment systems. These findings contribute to the growing body of research on AI-assisted language assessment and open new avenues for developing more efficient and adaptable pronunciation evaluation tools.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 학습이 한국 대학생의 영어 말하기 능력에 미치는 영향
title_en: The Impact of ChatGPT-Assisted Learning on English Speaking Proficiency of Korean University Students
kw_en: ChatGPT; English Speaking Proficiency; EFL; AI-based Learning; Vocabulary Acquisition; Pronunciation Improvement; Autonomous Learning; Educational Technology
abstract_ko: This study investigates the impact of ChatGPT-based learning on Korean university students' English speaking proficiency, specifically within an EFL (English as a Foreign Language) context. Given the rapid integration of AI and educational technology, this research aims to explore the potential of ChatGPT in enhancing students’ vocabulary, pronunciation, grammatical accuracy, and fluency. Two groups participated in the study: an experimental group engaged in interactive learning sessions with ChatGPT, while a control group followed traditional instructor-led feedback methods. Assessments were conducted pre- and post-experiment to measure speaking proficiency. Weekly assignments, surveys, and interviews provided quantitative and qualitative insights. Results indicate that the ChatGPT-based approach led to significant improvements in vocabulary acquisition, pronunciation clarity, and conversational fluency, while also reducing students' psychological barriers to language use. This research highlights the effectiveness of AI-driven language learning tools in supporting autonomous learning and enhancing practical language skills in real-world contexts.

title_ko: 영어 학습에서의 AI 활용에 대한 고등학생의 인식 연구
title_en: Perceptions of high school students on the use of AI tools in English learning
kw_ko: 도구; 인식; 활용의 편리성; 교육적 효능성; 만족도
kw_en: AI tools/perceptions; convenience to use; educational effectiveness; satisfaction; AI
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study is to explore high school students’ perceptions of using AI tools in learning English and to investigate how gender impacts these perceptions. A total of 194 students from a high school in Gyeonggi Province participated in the survey. Data were analyzed using mean, percentage, standard deviation, independent sample t-tests, and repeated measures ANOVA. Open-ended responses were categorized, and a thematic frequency analysis was also conducted. The findings are summarized as follows: 1) Students showed a positive perception of AI tools’ convenience and a willingness to use them. 2) Perceptions of the educational effectiveness and interest and satisfaction were also high, though slightly lower. Frequency analysis supports these results, revealing positive views on AI tools’ usefulness, but some concerns about learning effectiveness and information reliability. Most students viewed AI tools’ convenience positively, with minimal negative feedback. 3) A significant gender-based difference was observed only in the perception of interest. The study also discusses the implications and suggestions arising from these findings.

title_ko: ChatGPT 활용 협력학습을 통한 대학생의 메타화용적 인식 증진
title_en: Facilitating metapragmatic awareness through collaborative learning with ChatGPT
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 메타화용 인식; 미디어 기반 학습; 교양영어
kw_en: ChatGPT; metapragmatic awareness; media-based learning; general English education
abstract_ko: This study investigates the use of ChatGPT and media-based collaborative learning to enhance metapragmatic awareness among 30 Korean EFL university students. The students analyzed English expressions from animated programs and English-dubbed Korean dramas, using ChatGPT to compare pragmatic differences and discuss language use appropriate to different contexts. The data included group discussion transcripts, ChatGPT-student interaction logs, and student reflection journals. The results revealed that metapragmatic discussions, facilitated by ChatGPT, improved students’ understanding of the contextual nuances in English expressions. Collaborative learning encouraged deeper exploration of pragmatic differences and fostered student autonomy in language analysis. Additionally, ChatGPT’s personalized feedback helped students adapt example dialogues to their own language proficiency, making complex pragmatic concepts more accessible. The findings suggest that AI tools like ChatGPT hold potential for enhancing metapragmatic awareness in EFL learners.

title_ko: 대학 교양 글쓰기 평가를 위한 ChatGPT 활용 방안
title_en: Utilizing ChatGPT for University Liberal Arts Writing Assessment: Opportunities and Challenges
kw_ko: 대학 글쓰기 평가; 자동 채점; 즉각적 피드백; 전이 학습; 제로샷 러닝; AI 도구
