abstract_ko: 본 연구는 대학 교양 글쓰기 수업에서 ChatGPT와 같은 인공지능(AI) 도구의 활용 가능성을 탐구하였다. ChatGPT는 자동 채점과 즉각적인 피드백 제공을 통해 교수자의 채점 부담을 줄이고, 평가의 일관성 및 신속성을 높일 수 있는 도구로 주목받고 있다. 본 연구는 ChatGPT의 전이 학습과 제로샷 러닝 기능을 바탕으로 다양한 글쓰기 과제를 평가할 수 있는 유연성과 활용성을 분석하였다. 또한 ChatGPT의 주요 장점과 한계를 고찰하며, 실제 수업에서의 적용 가능성을 검토하였다. 연구 결과, ChatGPT는 대학 글쓰기 평가에서 보조적 도구로서의 잠재력을 지니고 있으나, 일부 한계점에 대한 교수자의 보완적 접근이 필요함을 제안하였다.
abstract_en: This study explores the potential of using AI tools such as ChatGPT in university liberal arts writing courses. ChatGPT, noted for its ability to provide automated grading and instant feedback, offers a promising solution to reduce the grading burden on instructors while enhancing the consistency and speed of evaluations. This study analyzes ChatGPT's flexibility and applicability, leveraging its transfer learning and zero-shot learning capabilities to assess various types of writing tasks. Furthermore, the strengths and limitations of ChatGPT are examined, alongside a review of its practical applicability in actual classroom settings. The findings suggest that while ChatGPT holds significant promise as an auxiliary tool for university writing assessment, complementary approaches from instructors are necessary to address certain limitations.

title_ko: 생성 인공지능을 활용한 영문학 교육의 가능성 연구: Gemini Pro, GPT-3.5, GPT-4의 패러디 과제 평가 분석을 중심으로
title_en: Exploring the Pedagogical Potential of Generative AI in English Literature Education: Comparative Assessment of Parody Assignments Through Gemini Pro, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4
kw_en: automated written feedback; automated writing evaluation; parody; ChatGPT; AI-assisted education
abstract_ko: This study investigates how effectively generative AI can provide feedback on creative writing for English literature education. In order to examine the reliability and validity of the automated feedback, 40 movie parody assignments written by 40 English major undergraduates were evaluated by three AI models (Gemini 1.0 Pro, GPT-3.5-turbo, and GPT-4-turbo) with four constructs. Statistical analysis of the three models’ scores, generated at four temperature settings (0, 0.4, 0.7, 1.0) with 30 iterations per setting, are as follows: First, all three models showed high reliability in scoring on a 0 to 5 scale. Second, rank-based scoring analysis revealed differences in reliability among the models. Gemini 1.0 Pro demonstrated high reliability only at 0 temperature, whereas GPT-4 maintained consistent reliablity across all temperature settings. Third, scoring validity varied significantly among models. Validity assessments through the review of student assignments and the analysis of rank-based scoring contrasted the limited validity of Gemini 1.0 Pro with the high validity of GPT-4’s consistent reliability scoring. However, GPT-4’s tendency toward holistic scoring should be considered. These findings suggest that all three models, which can consistently provide general-level feedback, would be limited in providing optimized feedback. The significance of this study lies in its empirical validation of generative AI’s potential as a feedback provider in creative writing education.

title_ko: Utilizing ChatGPT for Analysis and Evaluation of Korean English Learners’ Presentations
title_en: Utilizing ChatGPT for Analysis and Evaluation of Korean English Learners’ Presentations
kw_en: AI-assisted evaluation; AI-generated feedback; learner-centric feedback; ChatGPT; English oral presentations
abstract_ko: This study explores the utilization of ChatGPT for evaluating English oral presentations by Korean university students. By comparing assessments made by an instructor and ChatGPT, this study aims to determine the efficacy and reliability of AI-assisted evaluation in language education. The findings indicate that ChatGPT can effectively learn and apply the evaluation criteria provided by instructors, particularly in aspects such as delivery and time management. However, limitations exist, including the AI’s tendency to overlook critical areas emphasized by human evaluators, such as content depth and the logical cohesion of ideas. Additionally, non-linguistic elements like body posture and eye contact were less accurately assessed by the AI. These discrepancies highlight the need for continuous refinement of AI algorithms to better mimic human judgment and incorporate detailed evaluation factors. The study also underscores the potential of AI-generated feedback to support a learner-centric approach, enabling students to access tailored feedback and improve their language skills independently. Future research should focus on refining AI evaluation algorithms and exploring the long-term impact of AI-assisted feedback on student performance. The integration of AI tools like ChatGPT into educational practices holds promise, but ongoing evaluation and refinement are crucial to ensure they meet pedagogical goals.

title_ko: Variation in the Adaptation of English <x> into Korean: A ChatGPT-based Study
title_en: Variation in the Adaptation of English <x> into Korean: A ChatGPT-based Study
kw_en: <x>; adaptation; variation; English; Korean; ChatGPT; overprediction; underprediction
abstract_ko: This paper examines how the English letter <x> in words, such as xylophone and xylitol, is adapted into Korean: as [s] in the former and as [c] in the latter. It is particularly notable that some lexical items show variation in the adaptation of <x> in Korean, such as xanthan: [s], [c], and [kʰɨ.s]. By using ChatGPT (version: ChatGPT-4; OpenAI 2023), one of the most widely used large language models, the present study investigates whether and how this generative artificial intelligence chatbot predicts variation in Korean pronunciations of English words with <x> that were selected from the Corpus of Contemporary American English (Davies 2008-). Results show that ChatGPT did not correctly predict reported variants in most cases: it either overpredicted or underpredicted the reported variants. Based on the results, this paper suggests two important factors that could help improve ChatGPT’s predictions: different origins of words (e.g., Greek) and different groups of words (e.g., chemical terminology).

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 학술적 글쓰기 사례와 교육 방안 고찰 -H대학교 <논리적 사고와 글쓰기> 강좌를 중심으로-
title_en: Researching Academic Writing Practices and Pedagogy with ChatGPT – A Case Study of H University's “Logical Thinking and Writing” Course
kw_ko: 인공지능; 교양 교육; 학술적 글쓰기; 논리적 사고와 글쓰기
kw_en: AI; ChatGPT; artificial intelligence; liberal arts education; academic writing; logical thinking and writing
abstract_ko: The advent of generative AI technologies, including ChatGPT, has brought transformative changes to education, necessitating an evolution in pedagogical approaches to integrate these tools effectively. Recognizing the potential of AI, universities and governmental bodies have begun implementing policies that embrace generative AI while safeguarding learners' rights to utilize such technologies. In this context, the debate surrounding AI and its role in writing instruction has intensified, prompting both a reevaluation of traditional writing pedagogy and exploration into innovative uses of these tools. University-level writing education primarily aims to cultivate critical thinking and academic inquiry, which are essential for producing true knowledge through academic writing. Given this objective, there is a growing need to investigate how tools like ChatGPT can be practically integrated into the academic writing process without compromising the development of independent thinking skills. This study examines this question through an empirical investigation of students enrolled in Logical Thinking and Writing, a required liberal arts course at H University in Seoul, South Korea. The course was designed to incorporate ChatGPT into the academic writing process, with a focus on understanding students' experiences and perceptions. Findings reveal that students found ChatGPT most beneficial during the initial stages of topic selection and organizing their writing direction. However, the tool was perceived as less effective during the drafting phase due to the awkward phrasing and errors in its generated content. Furthermore, students highlighted challenges related to ChatGPT's reliance on unverifiable sources, raising concerns about the authenticity and reliability of its outputs. Other limitations included hallucinations, abstract or generic language, and biases stemming from its training data. Many learners also struggled to craft effective prompts, underscoring the need for targeted instruction on prompt design and strategic questioning. This study emphasizes the importance of fostering critical thinking skills to evaluate AI-generated content and ensuring that students learn to ethically and effectively utilize generative AI. Additionally, the findings highlight the need to develop students' proficiency in prompt engineering, enabling more productive interactions with AI tools. By exploring both the possibilities and limitations of generative AI in academic writing, this study provides valuable insights into the future direction of writing education in the AI era. This research contributes to the growing body of literature on generative AI in education and underscores the need for an adaptive approach to writing pedagogy that prepares students to collaborate effectively with emerging technologies.

title_ko: Enhancing Cyber Foreign Language Writing Education with ChatGPT
title_en: Enhancing Cyber Foreign Language Writing Education with ChatGPT
kw_en: ChatGPT; Foreign language writing; Self-directed learning; Feedback; Writing process.
abstract_ko: This study investigates an educational approach for enhancing foreign language writing skills in cyber university students by promoting the self-directed use of ChatGPT. Using a case study method, the research explores both the potential benefits and limitations of ChatGPT, a generative AI that can support writing tasks by providing real-time feedback, text summaries, and support for various writing forms, including essays and stories. While ChatGPT offers advantages such as reducing instructors' feedback workload and fostering improvements in students' writing, concerns arise regarding ChatGPT’s provision of inaccurate information and its potential to encourage plagiarism if students submit ChatGPT-generated content without proper revision. To address challenges, this study proposes instructional strategies for creating effective prompts that can elicit meaningful feedback from ChatGPT, alongside methods for students to integrate and reflect upon this feedback throughout each stage of the writing process. These instructional strategies are designed to enhance students' independent learning and encourage the responsible use of ChatGPT in educational settings.

title_ko: How Machine Translation Systems Handle Relative Clause Attachment: A Comparative Analysis
title_en: How Machine Translation Systems Handle Relative Clause Attachment: A Comparative Analysis
kw_ko: 인공지능; 기계번역; 관계절부착; 구조적 중의성
kw_en: AI; machine translation; relative clauses attachment; structural ambiguity
abstract_ko: The use of machine translators (MTs) in teaching and learning English has increased in recent years. This study investigates how English-to-Korean and Korean-to-English MTs handle relative clause (RC) attachment. A total of 72 sentences 36 English and 36 Korean were collected from 16 research articles on RC attachment. The collected RC attachment items were categorized into three types: ambiguous, high attachment (HA), and low attachment (LA). English RCs with ambiguity (n=18) were translated into ambiguous Korean RCs; LA preference sentences (n=16) were translated into Korean RCs as LA. However, Korean RCs with ambiguity (n=34) were translated into ambiguous English RCs or HA preference sentences. Results showed that RCs with ambiguity in English and Korean were translated differently into the target language. The main cause of this distinction seemed to be that Korean RCs involving genitive case -uy were translated into English RCs using prepositions such as of and the genitive -’s. These two possible structures resulted in two different outcomes in English: (i) NP-of-NP structures, where ambiguity is preserved, or (ii) NP’s NP structures, where only HA preference was possible. These findings suggest that RC attachment is translated differently between the two languages by MTs.

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능 시대에 자기표현적 글쓰기를 활용한 평생 필자로의 성장 방안 - 2022 교육과정을 중심으로 -
title_en: A Study on How to Grow as a Lifelong Writer Using Expressive Writing in the Era of Generative Artificial Intelligence - Based on the 2022 curriculum -
kw_ko: 자기표현적 글쓰기; 평생 필자; 생성형 인공지능 시대; 질문하기; 2022 교육과정자기표현적 글쓰기; 2022 교육과정
kw_en: expressive writing; lifelong writer; the era of generative artificial intelligence; questioning; 2022 curriculum
abstract_ko: 이 연구의 목적은 2022 교육과정과 교과서에 나타난 자기표현적 글쓰기의 양상을 분석함으로써, 인공지능 시대에 자기표현적 글쓰기를 활용한 평생 필자로의 성장 방안을 모색하는 데 있다. 이를 위해 생성형 인공지능 시대에서 자기표현적 글쓰기의 중요성을 고찰하였으며, 2022 교육과정의 학년군별 쓰기 교육과정, ‘공통국어’, ‘독서와 작문’ 교과서에 나타난 자기표현적 글쓰기의 양상을 분석하여 자기표현적 글쓰기의 교육 방안을 탐색하였다. 이에 쓰기의 경험을 온전히 경험하도록 하여 쓰기를 생활화하고 ‘질문하기’를 통해 사고력을 함양하며 인공지능 시대에 질문하는 능력을 키우기 위해, ‘질문 중심 자기표현적 글쓰기 교수·학습 모형(Q-ODWH)’을 구안하였다. 이 모형은 ‘관찰→의미의 발견→표현→기록의 습관’의 단계로 구성되며, ‘질문 중심 읽기-생각 나누기-쓰기 학습 모형’ 및 Peter Elbow의 표현적 글쓰기 이론을 참고하여 ‘질문하기’와 ‘고쳐쓰기’ 활동이 가능하도록 새롭게 구안한 모형이다. 이 모형에서는 ‘질문하기’, ‘고쳐쓰기’를 활용한 자기 점검을 활성화하였으며, 2022 교육과정에서 자기표현적 글쓰기에서 ‘읽고 쓰는’ 활동이 교수·학습의 중심을 이루고 있다는 점을 고려하여 ‘관찰’ 단계의 활동을 다양화하였다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to explore ways to grow into a lifelong writer using expressive writing in the age of generative AI by analyzing the aspects of expressive writing in the 2022 curriculum and textbooks. To this end, I analyzed the importance of expressive writing in the age of generative AI and explored the educational method of expressive writing by examining the patterns of expressive writing in the textbooks “Common Korean” and “Reading and Writing.” To make writing part of daily life by fully experiencing it, to cultivate thinking skills through “questioning,” and to develop the ability to ask questions in the age of generative AI, a question-oriented expressive writing teaching and learning model (Q-ODWH) was devised. This model consists of the stages of “observation → discovery of meaning → expression → habit of recording,” and was newly designed to enable a “question-based reading-thinking-writing learning model” and “fix writing” activities by referring to Peter Elbow's expressive writing theory. Self-checking using “questioning” and “fixing” was activated, and activities in the “observation” stage were diversified in consideration of the fact that “reading and writing” activities in expressive writing are central to teaching and learning in the 2022 curriculum.

title_ko: AI기반 생성적 독서에 관한 연구
title_en: A Study on AI-Based Generative Reading
kw_ko: AI기반 독서; 생성적 독서; AI독서; AI독자
kw_en: AI-based Reading; Generative Reading; AI Reading; AI Reader
abstract_ko: 이 연구에서는 생성형 AI를 활용한 독서의 의미 및 특성을 탐구하였다. 생성형 AI는 자연어 처리 모델로, 사용자의 질문에 답변을 제공하며 그 답변의 질이 높아 정보 검색 및 텍스트 작업에 유용하다. 생성형 AI를 활용하여 텍스트를 생성하여 읽는 행위를 이 글에서는 ‘AI 기반 생성적 독서’로 정의한다. 생성적 독서는 AI의 생성 모델을 통해 텍스트를 생성하고 이를 읽는 것을 의미하며, 전통적인 독서와는 다르다. 기존의 독서에서는 독자가 이미 완성된 텍스트를 해석하는 반면, 생성적 독서에서는 독자가 AI와 상호작용하여 자신이 원하는 텍스트를 생성한 후 이를 읽는다. 또한 AI가 텍스트를 생성하는 방식은 기 존재하는 텍스트들을 참조하여 상호텍스트적 관계를 형성함으로써 이루어진다. AI 기반 생성적 독서는 디지털 독서의 연장선에 있으며, 디지털 매체를 활용한 하이퍼텍스트 독서와 유사한 특징을 지닌다. 디지털 독서에서는 독자가 컴퓨터나 스마트 기기 등을 통해 온라인 텍스트를 읽으며, AI 기반 생성적 독서는 ChatGPT 같은 AI를 통해 텍스트를 생성하고 이를 독서하는 방식이다. AI 기반 생성적 독서는 개방적이고 텍스트 생성의 주체가 AI알고리즘이며 정보중심성이 있고 비판적 이해가 중요하다. 결론적으로, AI 기반 생성적 독서는 기존의 디지털 독서 방식과 구별되는 특성을 지니며, 국어교육 등에서 AI를 활용한 새로운 교육 방법론을 모색할 필요가 있다. AI 기술의 발전에 따라 생성적 독서의 양태도 더욱 다양화될 것이고 이에 대한 국어교육계의 관심이 요구된다.
abstract_en: This study explores the meaning and characteristics of reading through generative AI, such as ChatGPT. As a natural language processing model, generative AI provides high-quality responses to user inquiries, making it useful for information retrieval and text creation tasks. In this study, the act of generating and reading texts through such AI is defined as "AI-based generative reading." Generative reading involves generating texts through an AI model and then reading them, which differs from traditional reading where readers interpret pre-existing texts. In generative reading, users interact with AI to produce the texts they want to read. The AI generates texts by referencing existing materials and forming intertextual relationships. AI-based generative reading is part of the broader scope of digital reading and shares similarities with hypertext reading, which involves reading online texts through digital devices like computers and smartphones. This type of reading is characterized by its openness, with the AI algorithm acting as the primary agent for text creation. It focuses on extracting information, and critical understanding plays a significant role in this process. In conclusion, AI-based generative reading exhibits distinct characteristics compared to traditional digital reading. There is a growing need to explore new educational methodologies, especially in language education, that incorporate AI. As AI technology continues to evolve, the forms of generative reading will also diversify.

title_ko: EBS AI 펭톡 기반 어휘학습에 대한 초등영어학습자들의 반응 조사
title_en: A Study on Elementary English Language Learners’ Reactions to AI PengTalk-based Vocabulary Learning
kw_ko: 인공지능; 어휘; 초등영어학습자; 영어교육
kw_en: PengTalk; Artificial intelligence; Vocabulary; Elementary English learners; English education
abstract_ko: 초등 공교육 현장에 AI 펭톡이 보급된 이후, 영어 교수-학습에 있어 펭톡의 효과성에 대한 다양한 연구들이 이루어졌으나 어휘 학습과 관련된 연구사례는 상대적으로 미흡하였다. 이에 본 연구는 펭톡 기반 어휘 학습이 초등영어학습자들의 어휘력 변화와 영어 학습에 미치는 효과를 살펴보고자 하였다. 이에 초등영어학습자 22명을 대상으로 총 14주에 걸친 실험 수업을 진행하였으며 이를 통해 분석한 결과를 정리하면 다음과 같다. 첫째, 어휘력 관련 인지적 영역 변화에 있어 교과서 위주의 수업과 펭톡을 활용한 수업 모두 학습 전·후 학생들의 어휘력은 향상하였음을 확인하였다. 다만, 교과서 위주의 수업과펭톡을 활용한 수업 간 향상도 차이는 크지 않았다. 또한 학생들의 사전·사후 어휘력 검사의 변화 정도를 비교한 결과 긍정적 향상을 확인할 수 있었으나, 통계적으로 유의미한 결과는 나타나지 않았다. 둘째, 학습자의 소감을 수집하여 분석한 결과, 펭톡을 활용하였을 때 흥미와 어휘 학습의 유용성 측면에서81%의 학생들이 긍정적인 반응을 보였다. 학생들은 학습 단계를 통과하며 학습 흥미를 느낄 수 있었고, 펭톡의 포인트 개념인 참치캔을 모으고, 캐릭터를 꾸미는 과정에서 영어 학습에 대한 외재적 동기 또한얻을 수 있어 긍정적인 반응을 보인 것으로 추측할 수 있었다. 이러한 결과를 통해 본 연구는 펭톡과 같은 인공지능 기반의 도구를 활용한 어휘 학습의 교육적 제언을 하고자 한다.
abstract_en: After AI PengTalk was spread in the public education field, various studies have been conducted on the effectiveness of PengTalk in English teaching-learning. However, since previous research cases related to vocabulary learning were insufficient, this study examined the effect of PengTalk-based vocabulary instruction on the change of vocabulary proficiency levels of elementary English learners. The results verified through 14 weeks of experimental classes are summarized as follows. First, in terms of cognitive domain change, both textbook-oriented classes and classes using PengTalk improved students’ vocabulary before and after learning, but there was not a significant difference in improvement between textbook-oriented classes and classes using PengTalk. As a result of comparing the degree of change in students’ pre and post-vocabulary tests, positive improvement was confirmed, but this did not show statistically significant results. Second, according to the learner’s impression, 81% of students responded positively in terms of interest and the usefulness of vocabulary learning when using PengTalk. Students could feel the intrinsic motivation they felt as they passed through the learning stage, and it could be assumed that they responded positively because they could also get external motivation for learning English in the process of collecting tuna cans, the concept of PengTalk, and decorating characters.

title_en: A Study on the Effectiveness of an ESP Course for Airline Cabin Services with Aid of ChatGPT
kw_ko: 학습코칭; 항공사 객실서비스

abstract_ko: This study examines the potential benefits of an English-for-Specific-Purposes (ESP) program for airline cabin services incorporating ChatGPT and individualized coaching. A 10-session intensive course, designed based on interviews with experienced flight attendants, combined classroom activities and ChatGPT-driven assignments to enhance students’ English communication and service skills. Ten preservice college students participated in the experimental program, which significantly boosted their confidence and self-efficacy in English. The integration of AI tools like ChatGPT complemented traditional teaching methods, promoting interactive and autonomous learning. The findings underscore a shift from static ESP materials to dynamic, learner-centered methodologies supported by AI, addressing critical gaps in ESP education. Key factors for successful learning included self-directed learning, adaptability to AI, and effective time management, with underperforming students showing notable improvement. This study highlights the evolving role of technology in education and the importance of tailoring programs to leverage AI’s interactive capabilities. By integrating AI tools and learner coaching, the program demonstrates a promising approach to meet modern educational demands. These insights support the adoption of AI-enhanced ESP programs and emphasize the significant influence of learner characteristics on outcomes.

abstract_ko: This study aims to develop an AI-enhanced ESP program tailored for pre-service airline cabin crew. Grounded in theories highlighting the synergy between AI technologies and learner coaching in language education, this program integrates ChatGPT and personalized coaching to address students’ unique linguistic and professional needs. Based on in-depth interviews with 10 experienced flight attendants, this study resulted in a structured 10-session syllabus focused on essential service scenarios and procedures for cabin crew operations. The course utilizes interactive, AI-enhanced learning environments to provide real-time feedback, supporting structured learning outcomes in procedural language tasks and enhancing students’ readiness for professional responsibilities in aviation settings. Integrating learner coaching within the ESP framework emphasizes individualized approaches to language education, contributing to more effective skill development. While this study is limited to program development and does not include practical implementation or empirical validation of learning outcomes, it lays the groundwork for future research on program effectiveness in real-world settings. It is suggested that future studies focus on experimental assessments to evaluate the program’s impact on language proficiency and job performance.

title_ko: Korean In-service Teachers’ Perspectives on AI Integration in the Revised English Curriculum
title_en: Korean In-service Teachers’ Perspectives on AI Integration in the Revised English Curriculum
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence; National Curriculum; Korean EFL Learners; Communicative Competence; Teacher Training
abstract_ko: This study explores Korean in-service English teachers’ perspectives on the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies into the 2022 Revised Korean National Curriculum for secondary English education. Semi-structured interviews were conducted with ten in-service English teachers from Seoul and Gyeonggi Province to examine their views on the curriculum’s pedagogical objectives, instructional methodologies, and assessment practices incorporating AI technologies. The findings reveal three key insights. First, in terms of pedagogical objectives, teachers highlighted challenges in meeting the high-level learning goals set by the revised curriculum. They emphasized the importance of promoting sentence-level language production beyond rote memorization, but noted the limitations of current AI tools in developing the language creation capabilities. Second, with respect to instructional methodologies, teachers identified significant barriers, including a lack of clear implementation guidelines, issues with technological reliability, and inadequate professional training. Finally, regarding assessment practices, teachers expressed concerns about their reliability and ethical guidelines in using AI technologies, particularly in evaluating productive language skills. These findings highlight the need for comprehensive teacher training programs, robust technological infrastructure, and instructional approaches that effectively integrate AI methodologies while maintaining the strengths of traditional English teaching practices.

title_ko: AI 디지털교과서 활용 영어교육의 기초
title_en: The basics of AIDT-powered English education
kw_ko: AI 디지털교과서/AIDT 활용 영어교육/챗봇
kw_en: AI digital textbook(AIDT)/AIDT powered English education/Chatbot
abstract_ko: In the current situation, where expectations and concerns coexist regarding the introduction of AI digital textbooks, the results of a survey on perceptions of AI digital textbooks reveal both positive and negative aspects. However, concerns may be alleviated when considering research findings that show chatbot-assisted English education, such as using AI-based tools like AI PengTalk, is effective for learning and significantly improves affective factors. In addition, it is necessary to address apprehensions and concerns in educational settings by providing practical training on the key features of AI digital textbooks as well as teaching, learning, and assessment models. It is also important to notice that AI digital textbooks are useful tools that support various learning styles, provide personalized learning experiences for students, offer real-time feedback, automate assessments, and assist teachers in delivering their curricula. After reviewing two types of models for teaching, learning, and assessment using AI digital textbooks(traditional teaching-learning models and assessment-centered teaching-learning models), this paper proposed a list of learning activities utilizing AI digital textbook functions for the use of AI digital textbooks in English education. Additionally, it suggested a feature-selective AI digital textbook teaching-learning model, enabling selective use of features and functions during preview, classroom instruction, or review.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 활용 독일어 작문 자기 피드백 모형
title_en: Ein Modell zum Selbstfeedback mit generativer KI im DaF-Schreibunterricht
kw_ko: 생성형 Al; Al 리터러시; 독일어 작문; 자기 피드백; 독일어 교육
kw_en: Generative KI; KI im DaF; KI-Kompetenz; Schreiben; Selbstfeedback
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 독일어 작문 교육에서 생성형 AI를 활용한 자기 피드백 모형을 제안하고, 초급 학습자의 작문을 예시로 그 모형의 적용 가능성을 탐색하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 Tseng/Warschauer(2023)가 제시한 학습자 AI 리터러시 향상을 위한 프레임워크를 기반으로 작문 자기 피드백 모형을 개발하였다. 작문 자기 피드백 모형은 세 단계로 구성된다. 먼저 활용 준비 단계'에서는 학습자가 생성형 AI의 기능과 한계를 이해하고, 적절한 프롬프트 작성 전략을 습득함으로써 향후 생성형 AI의 피드백을 유용하게 활용할 수 있는 기반을 다진다. 이어서 활용 단계에서는 학습자가 습득한 전략을 실제로 적용하여 생성형 AI에 프롬프팅을 수행하고, 자신의 작문에 대한 구체적이고 개별화된 피드백을 제공받는다. 마지막으로 활용 점검 단계에서는 생성형 AI의 피드백을 교차 검증하고 비판적으로 수용하면서, 학습자가 자신의 작문을 독립적이고 주체적으로 개선할 수 있도록 한다. 이러한 과정을 통해 학습자는 작문 자기 피드백 과정에서 생성형 AI를 효과적으로 활용할 수 있으며, 개인 맞춤형 학습 체계를 마련하고 비판적 사고와 메타 인지적 역량을 높일 수 있다. 이 연구는 급변하는 기술 환경 속에서 독일어 교육의 새로운 방향을 모색하는 데 의의를 지닌다.
abstract_en: In dieser Arbeit wird ein Modell vorgestellt, das die Nutzung generativer KI zur Förderung von Selbstfeedback im DaF-Schreibunterricht systematisch beschreibt. Aufbauend auf dem Framework von Tseng und Warschauer (2023) zur Förderung der KI-Kompetenz, wird ein dreiphasiges Modell entwickelt, das auf die schrittweise Integration und kritische Nutzung generativer KI abzielt. In der ersten Phase, der Vorbereitungsphase, setzen sich die Lernenden gezielt mit den Potenzialen und Beschränkungen generativer KI auseinander und erarbeiten effektive Strategien für den Einsatz von Prompts. Die zweite Phase, die Durchführungsphase, dient der praktischen Anwendung: Hier wenden die Lernenden ihre entwickelten Prompting-Strategien an, um differenziertes Feedback zu ihren Texten zu erhalten. Abschließend folgt die Reflexionsphase, in der das erhaltene Feedback analysiert und gezielt in den Schreibprozess der Lernenden integriert wird. Die praktische Anwendbarkeit dieses Modells wird durch ein Beispiel aus einem DaF-Anfängerkurs verdeutlicht. Die Ergebnisse zeigen, dass der gezielte Einsatz von KI sowohl die Selbstlernfähigkeit als auch die Schreibkompetenz der Lernenden verbessern kann. Ein kritischer Umgang mit den KI-generierten Rückmeldungen erweist sich jedoch als unerlässlich, um deren didaktischen Nutzen zu maximieren und den Lernenden eine fundierte Reflexion ihrer Schreibkompetenz zu ermöglichen.

title_ko: 기계번역에 대한 독일어 학습자의 경험과 인식 - 학부 전공생 대상의 설문 조사를 바탕으로
title_en: Erfahrungen und Wahrnehmungen von Deutschlernenden bezüglich maschineller Übersetzung - Basierend auf einer Umfrage unter koreanischen Studierenden
kw_ko: 기계번역; 설문 조사; 사용 경험과 인식; 독일어 교육; 기계번역 리터러시
kw_en: Maschinelle Übersetzung; Umfrageanalyse; Erfahrung und Wahrnehmung; Deutschunterricht; Maschinelle Übersetzungskompetenz
abstract_ko: 본 논문은 기계번역의 성능 향상 및 활용 증대 추세에 직면하여 독일어 학습에서도 기계번역 리터러시에 관한 논의가 필요한 시점으로 판단하고, 논의의 토대를 마련하기 위해 독일어를 전공하는 대학생의 기계번역 사용 양상, 사용 경험, 인식에 대해 설문 조사를 실시하였다. 설문 항목은 4점 리커트 척도로 선택형 25문항, 서술형 5문항, 객관식의 하위 서술형 3문항으로 구성되었다. 사용 양상은 기계번역 사용 빈도, 채널, 목적, 단위(9항), 사용 경험은 기계번역 사용 만족도, 의존도, 능숙도(7문항), 인식은 기계번역에 대해 가지고 있는 신뢰, 기대, 우려(12문항)에 관한 내용이다. 서술형 문항에서는 기계번역의 문제점, 인간 대체 가능성, 통번역사 직업 대체 가능성 등에 대해 자유롭게 기술하도록 했다. 국내 대학의 독일어 관련 학과 재학생 266명을 대상으로 오프라인 설문을 실시하여 응답을 분석하였다. 그 결과, 응답자 모두 기계번역 사용 경험이 있었고, 독한 방향에서 사용 경험이 많았으며, 파파고 번역기를 가장 많이 사용했으며, 만족도와 숙달도는 높으나 신뢰도는 낮고, 높은 의존도로 인한 학습 및 인지 능력 저하에 관한 우려가 강했다. 그럼에도 기계번역의 발전 가능성을 확신하는 편이며 학습에서도 기계번역의 활용 능력이 필요하다는 답변이 많았다. 본 설문 조사 연구의 결과는 향후 독일어 교수 학습에서 학생들의 기계번역 사용 양상, 만족도, 신뢰도, 의존도, 우려를 반영하고 그에 맞는 구체적인 교수 학습 방안을 마련하는 데 도움이 될 수 있다.
abstract_en: Diese Studie untersuchte anhand einer Umfrage unter Deutschstudierenden in Korea die Nutzungsmuster, Erfahrungen und Wahrnehmungen im Hinblick auf maschinelle Übersetzung (MÜ). Der Fragebogen bestand aus 25 Multiple-Choice-Fragen auf einer 4-Punkte-Likert-Skala, 3 optionalen offenen Fragen und 5 offenen Fragen. Die Fragen zu den Nutzungsmustern bezogen sich auf die Häufigkeit, den Zweck und die genutzten Spracheinheiten bei der maschinellen Übersetzung (9 Fragen). Die Fragen zu den Erfahrungen behandelten Zufriedenheit, Abhängigkeit und Vertrautheit (7 Fragen), während die Fragen zur Wahrnehmung Vertrauen, Erwartungen und Bedenken (12 Fragen) thematisierten. In den offenen Fragen sollten die Teilnehmenden die Probleme der maschinellen Übersetzung sowie die potenzielle Ersetzung von Menschen durch Maschinen beschreiben. Die Umfrage wurde offline durchgeführt, und 266 gültige Antworten wurden analysiert. Alle Befragten hatten MÜ-Erfahrung, nutzten sie hauptsächlich für Übersetzungen vom Deutschen ins Koreanische und verwendeten am häufigsten Papago. Die Zufriedenheit und Vertrautheit mit der MÜ waren hoch, das Vertrauen jedoch gering. Es bestanden erhebliche Bedenken hinsichtlich der Auswirkungen einer hohen Abhängigkeit von MÜ auf das Lernen und die kognitiven Fähigkeiten. Die Teilnehmenden gingen davon aus, dass sich die maschinelle Übersetzung weiterentwickeln wird, und betonten, dass die MÜ-Kompetenzen im Lernprozess benötigt werden. Diese Ergebnisse können in zukünftigen Diskussionen über den Einsatz von maschineller Übersetzung beim Erlernen der deutschen Sprache von Nutzen sein.

title_ko: The Effect of ChatGPT on Enhancing University Students’ Self-Directed Learning: Implications for English Language Learning and Assessment
title_en: The Effect of ChatGPT on Enhancing University Students’ Self-Directed Learning: Implications for English Language Learning and Assessment
kw_en: ChatGPT; self-directed learning (SDL); personalized learning; self- regulation; student perception
abstract_ko: This study explored the impact of ChatGPT on university students’ self-directed learning (SDL) and its implications for English language learning and assessment. Through a survey of 58 undergraduate students, this study examined how students use ChatGPT to set goals, manage resources, monitor progress, and reflect on their learning. The findings revealed that while ChatGPT usage did not significantly influence specific components of SDL, students’ perceptions of ChatGPT had a notable impact on their overall SDL ability. Students with a positive perception of ChatGPT demonstrated stronger self-regulation skills, suggesting that fostering awareness of AI tools’ potential can enhance learning autonomy. Additionally, ChatGPT’s ability to provide personalized feedback and real-time support highlights its potential to enhance English learning and evaluation processes, particularly by fostering autonomous learning environments and reducing biases in assessment. The study contributes to the understanding of AI’s influence in educational contexts and highlights the need for further research on how AI tools like ChatGPT can support personalized learning strategies in diverse educational contexts.

title_ko: 영어 장르의 유형과 ChatGPT가 한국인 영어 학습자의 쓰기에 미치는 영향
title_en: The Influence of English Genres and ChatGPT on Korean EFL Learners’ Writing Performance
kw_en: English genres; ChatGPT; comparative; cause and effect; argumentative
abstract_ko: This study investigates the influence of ChatGPT and specific English genre types— comparative, causal, and argumentative essays—on the writing performance of 25 Korean university students. Participants independently composed essays in each genre and received feedback from ChatGPT for subsequent revisions. Each essay was evaluated based on criteria including 1) thesis statement, 2) idea generation, 3) idea development, 4) idea organization, 5) topic sentence, 6) coherence, 7) lexical diversity, and 8) syntactic complexity. Mean comparisons were conducted using Multivariate Analysis of Variances (MANOVA) using SPSS 24. The MANOVA results revealed significant improvements in coherence, lexical diversity, and syntactic complexity across all genres after using ChatGPT. Genre-specific differences were identified, consistent with existing research on AI-assisted writing. The study highlights ChatGPT's potential to enhance genre awareness and writing enhancement among learners, suggesting its value as an effective pedagogical tool in academic writing instruction.

title_ko: AI 번역을 활용한 학습자 중심 영미문학 수업에서의 핵심역량 함양에 대한 학습자 인식 연구
title_en: A Study on Learners' Perceptions of Core Competency Development in AI-assisted Learner-centered English Literature Classes
kw_en: AI-based machine translation; core competencies; English proficiency; learner-centered English literature classes; learners’ perceptions
abstract_ko: This study investigates how high school students perceive the development of core competencies, as outlined in the 2015 revised English curriculum, through learner- centered English literature classes that utilize AI-based machine translation. The study involved 153 senior high school students in Gwangju, South Korea, who participated in a 9-week English literature course. Data were collected through surveys and analyzed using both quantitative and qualitative methods. The findings reveal that learners perceived significant improvements in all four core competencies: English communication, self-management, community, and knowledge information processing. Notably, community and knowledge information processing competencies each showed statistically higher achievement compared to English communication and self-management competencies. The study also found no significant differences in the learners’ perceptions of competency across different English proficiency levels except for knowledge information processing. Qualitative analysis indicated overall positive perceptions of the course; the majority of students found it highly engaging and enjoyable, with additional responses of increased creativity and imagination. The research suggests that learner-centered English literature education using AI translation tools can effectively foster core competencies regardless of students' English proficiency. This approach shows promise in developing not only language skills but also higher-order thinking abilities and socio-cultural understanding.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 포털 뤼튼을 활용한 초등영어 쓰기 수업의 효과 및 개선
title_en: Effectiveness and improvement strategies of elementary English writing lessons using the Generative AI Portal WRTN
kw_en: generative AI; WRTN; ChatGPT; primary school English; writing instruction; primary school English learners
abstract_ko: This study aims to investigate the impact of teaching English writing using the Generative AI Portal WRTN on elementary learners’ writing abilities and affective domain. Additionally, it explores the challenges learners face during lessons and the strategies implemented to overcome these difficulties. The analyses were also conducted based on students’ writing levels. A total of 41 sixth-grade students from two classes participated in eight writing lessons over four months. The data included an initial student information survey, pre- and post-writing tests, pre-and post-affective-domain surveys, student logs, student interviews, and a teacher journal. The data were analyzed using both quantitative and qualitative methods within a mixed-methods approach. The major findings are as follows: (1) The English lessons utilizing the generative AI WRTN had positive effects on learners’ English writing achievement, particularly in free-writing tasks. (2) The lessons contributed to improvements in students’ interest, motivation, confidence, and anxiety related to English writing, with variations observed across different writing skills and affective factors depending on students’ writing levels. (3) Learners faced distinct challenges according to their writing levels. Higher-level students struggled with time management, which was mitigated by pre-class preparation of the AI tool. Intermediate-level students had difficulty understanding the AI’s feedback on complex grammatical issues, which was resolved by adjusting the difficulty level of the responses. Lower-level students experienced challenges in selecting appropriate vocabulary, which was addressed through teacher guidance and modified AI commands. The study provides significant implications for integrating generative AI into English writing instruction.

title_ko: The Effects of Prosody Training with AI Chatbot on the English Pronunciation Improvement of Korean EFL Learners
title_en: The Effects of Prosody Training with AI Chatbot on the English Pronunciation Improvement of Korean EFL Learners
kw_en: prosody training; AI chatbot; English pronunciation; Korean elementary school learners; EFL education
abstract_ko: This study investigated the impact of prosody training using pitch contour feedback on the English pronunciation of Korean elementary school students. The aim was to evaluate whether this training could lead to significant improvements in pronunciation. The study involved 18 fifth-grade students who participated in a twoweek intensive program using AI PengTalk, a chatbot developed to support Korean elementary school students’ English learning on a national scale. The participants practiced aligning their pitch contours with those of native English speakers using the tool. The effectiveness of the training was evaluated through AI PengTalk’s automated pronunciation scoring and assessments by native English speakers, who rated pronunciation based on nativeness and intelligibility, using a 5-point Likert scale and a ratio scale, respectively. Additionally, the study explored the transferability of the training to unpracticed sentences. Although the automated scoring did not reveal statistically significant differences, assessments by native English speakers indicated notable enhancements in pronunciation regarding both nativeness and intelligibility. Furthermore, the training effect was generalized to novel sentences that were not explicitly practiced during the sessions. These findings suggest that prosody training with pitch contour feedback is a promising approach for improving English pronunciation among young Korean EFL learners.

title_ko: 영어 수업을 위한 예비 초등교사의 디지털 매체 및 에듀테크 활용 역량 탐색
title_en: Investigating Pre-service Elementary Teachers’ Competencies in Utilizing Digital Media and EdTech for English Instruction
kw_ko: 에듀테크(EdTech); 초등교사교육(Elementary teacher training); 디지털 매체(Digital Media); 인공지능(Artificial Intelligence)
abstract_ko: The present study implemented Project-Based Learning (PBL) to enhance pre-service teachers’ competencies in using EdTech, focusing on learning and practicing various digital tools for elementary English instruction. Throughout a six-week PBL course, 65 pre-service teachers participated in activities such as creating digital storybooks using text-to-speech (TTS) tools, developing AI chatbots, and designing interactive experiences in the metaverse. Despite the limited timeframe, pre-service teachers effectively developed a strong understanding of new EdTech tools and their classroom applications. Participants self-evaluated their EdTech application skills through pre- and post-surveys, revealing a meaningful increase in their self-evaluation scores after the course. The results suggest that the digital competence development program experienced through this study significantly improved the participants’ perceived abilities to utilize EdTech in their teaching practices. Additionally, the AI chatbots, metaverse spaces, and digital storybooks produced by the pre-service teachers were deemed suitable for elementary English classes, displaying a high level of completeness.

title_ko: Evaluating ChatGPT’s Efficacy: Automated vs. Human Scoring of EFL Students’ Summary Writing
title_en: Evaluating ChatGPT’s Efficacy: Automated vs. Human Scoring of EFL Students’ Summary Writing
kw_en: ChatGPT; automated scoring; human scoring; summary writing; EFL writing assessment
abstract_ko: This study examines ChatGPT’s potential as an assessment tool by comparing its performance with human raters in English as a Foreign Language (EFL) writing assessment conducted in a university classroom. Using a mixed-methods approach, 14 writing samples from university students in a Korean teacher education program were assessed through analytical and holistic scoring by ChatGPT and two human raters. Quantitative analyses measured intra- and inter-rater reliability as well as scoring leniency, while qualitative analyses explored differences in descriptive feedback. The findings indicate that ChatGPT demonstrates strong consistency in analytical scoring but greater variability in holistic scoring, highlighting the need for clearly defined evaluation criteria. While ChatGPT provides balanced feedback by addressing both content accuracy and language use, its comments remain general and lack detailed grammatical corrections. These findings suggest that AI tools can complement writing assessment by providing initial, broad feedback but require human oversight for more specific and nuanced evaluations. The study highlights the importance of well-designed prompts and integrating AI with traditional assessment methods to enhance EFL writing instruction.

title_ko: 고등학교 영어 쓰기 교육을 위한 인공신경망 번역기(NMT) 활용 가능성 연구
title_en: A Study of the Effects of Machine Translators in High School English Writing Education
kw_ko: 고등학교 영어 쓰기 교육(High School English Writing Education); 영어 쓰기 교육(English Writing Education); 번역기(Machine Translator (MT)); 네이버파파고(Naver Papago); 신경망 기계번역(Neural Machine Translation)
abstract_ko: This study examines the perceived impact of machine translator (MT) use on the English writing ability of Korean high school students and their attitudes toward its effectiveness. A total of 66 first-year students participated in six experimental writing classes over six weeks. The experimental group (35 students) used the Naver Papago translator for writing tasks, while the control group (31 students) completed the same tasks without a translator. Writing performance was assessed across six categories: outline writing, content, composition, grammar, vocabulary, and mechanical elements. Based on the analysis of the data which were collected quantitatively as well as qualitatively, this study showed that MT use did not significantly influence writing ‘content,’ but it notably improved ‘grammar’ and ‘vocabulary’, particularly for lower-proficiency learners. Upper-proficiency students mainly used MT during revision, enhancing accuracy, while lower-proficiency students struggled to identify mistranslations, often submitting incorrect outputs as they were. These findings suggest that MT tools can effectively enhance certain aspects of writing, depending on learners’ proficiency levels. This study underscores the potential of MT tools in high school English writing education and highlights the need for strategies encouraging effective, student-centered use.

abstract_ko: 본 고는 앞으로 교육 현장에서 활용도가 높아질 것으로 예상되는 ChatGPT를 활용한 일본어 작문 수업 사례를 공유하고, 학습자의 피드백에 대한 성찰 및 인식을 조사하는 것으로 목적으로 하였다. 질문의 중요성을 확인하기 위해 복수의 질문을 이용하였다. 학습자가 ChatGPT의 피드백을 어떻게 수용하고 있는 지 등 성찰을 확인해 보고, ChatGPT활용에 대한 학생들의 인식을 조사하였다. 활용 자체에 관한 것은 긍정적인 평가가 많았으나 선행연구와 유사하게 주의할 점 등도 지적되었다. 또한 예비교사로서 추후 교육현장에서 활용할 수 있는 방안에 대해서는 다양한 방법이 제안되었으나, 활용에 우려를 나타내는 학습자도 있었다.
abstract_en: This paper aims to share examples of Japanese composition classes utilizing ChatGPT, a tool expected to see increased usage in educational settings. It investigates learners' reflections and perceptions of feedback provided by ChatGPT. Multiple questions were used to verify the importance of inquiry, allowing an analysis of how learners receive ChatGPT’s feedback and an assessment of their overall perception of ChatGPT use. While the application of ChatGPT received mostly positive evaluations, similar to previous studies, certain points for caution were also highlighted. Additionally, various strategies for applying ChatGPT in future educational settings were proposed, particularly for pre-service teachers, though some learners expressed concerns about its usage.

title_en: A Study on Metaverse-Based Language Learning: A Qualitative Meta-Analysis
kw_ko: 메타버스; 메타버스 기반 언어학습; 가상세계; 연구동향; 메타연구
kw_en: metaverse; metaverse-based language learning; virtual world; research trend; meta-analysis
abstract_ko: This study conducted a qualitative meta-analysis of 29 experimental studies on metaverse-based language learning from 2021 to 2023. The research aimed to comprehensively analyze trends in these studies, exploring how they have evolved during this critical period. The analysis focused on 1) research trends, 2) research design in pedagogical and technological perspectives, and 3) learner behavior. The findings are as follows. Firstly, there was a significant rise in interest in metaverse-based studies from 2021 to 2022, followed by a slight decline in 2023. Most studies targeted university students, emphasizing Korean and English language learning, primarily focusing on speaking skills. Secondly, research designs adapted traditional online learning methods into metaverse environments, with lecture-based instruction being the most common. Metaverse platforms were mainly used as media for online classes, incorporating authentic task-based activities in virtual spaces to facilitate meaningful speaking interactions. Thirdly, learners reported an enhanced sense of presence - social, cognitive, and affective - which positively influenced their satisfaction with the learning experience. These findings highlight the potential of metaverse-based language learning to address the limitations of traditional face-to-face and online methods, providing innovative opportunities for interaction and engagement in virtual environments.

title_en: Cognitive Strategies and Affective Responses in Collaborative Writing with ChatGPT - Comparison with Individual Writing Using ChatGPT
kw_ko: ChatGPT 활용; 협력적 글쓰기; AI 기반 글쓰기 교육; 인지적 전략; 정의적 반응; 개인적 글쓰기와 협력적 글쓰기 비교

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 ChatGPT를 활용한 개인적 글쓰기와 협력적 글쓰기에서 학생들이 사용하는 인지적 전략과 정의적 반응을 비교하여 AI 기반 도구가 글쓰기 과정에 미치는 영향을 탐구하였다. 연구 결과, 협력적 글쓰기에서는 팀 상호작용을 통한 비판적 평가와 지식 재구성이 활발히 이루어졌고, 글의 질 향상에 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤다. 또한, 협력적 글쓰기는 쓰기 동기와 지속 의지에도 긍정적 영향을 미쳤으며, 팀원과의 피드백을 통해 ChatGPT 의존성을 줄이는 경향을 보였다. 반면, 개인적 글쓰기에서는 ChatGPT의 산출물을 그대로 사용하는 경향이 높아 독립적 사고와 창의적 사고가 다소 제한될 가능성이 있었다. 본 연구는 AI 도구가 교육 현장에서 학습자에게 미치는 인지적, 정의적 영향을 다각도로 분석하여 협력적 학습 환경에서 AI의 효과적 활용 방안을 제시하는 기초 자료를 제공한다.
abstract_en: Based on a comparison of cognitive strategies and affective responses that students use in individual versus collaborative writing with ChatGPT, this study explores the impact of AI-based tools on the writing process. In collaborative writing, critical evaluation and knowledge reconstruction through team interactions were actively conducted, thus positively influencing the quality of the writing. Additionally, with a tendency to reduce reliance on ChatGPT through feedback from team members, such writing exerted a positive effect on writing motivation and persistence,. By contrast, individual writing displayed a higher tendency to use ChatGPT outputs as they were, which could potentially limit independent and creative thinking. Our results provide foundational data on the cognitive and affective impacts of AI tools on learners in educational settings, ultimately offering insights into effective AI utilization strategies within collaborative learning environments.

title_en: Analysis on the understanding and utilization of edutech by elementary English teachers: Focusing on importance and performance analysis.
kw_ko: 에듀테크/초등영어교사/교사교육/IPA 분석/AI 디지털교과서
kw_en: edutech/primary school teacher/teacher education/IPA analysis/AIDT
abstract_ko: This study aims to analyze the degree of importance and performance that in-service primary English teachers attribute to edutech, which is widely used in primary education. To this end, 57 primary school teachers at public elementary schools in Gangwon State responded to a questionnaire related to their ability to understand and utilize edutech in education. The results examined the difference between importance and performance through SPSS and IPA analysis. The findings are summarized as follows. First, descriptive statistics on edutech understanding showed the importance of most items was higher than their performance levels, and the results of the sample t-tests also showed a significant difference. The results of the IPA analysis demonstrated the areas requiring focus were related to diagnosing the learning process and monitoring progress through edutech. Next, statistical analysis examining the importance and performance of edutech utilization capabilities found the average importance of overall edutech utilization capabilities was about 0.6 points higher than their performance. Compared to the importance of edutech utilization capabilities, current performance in the educational field did not meet this level. Overall, these results suggest that teacher training is necessary to enhance understanding of edutech and strengthen related skills before the implementation of AIDT.

title_ko: 초급 수준 대학생의 영어 능력 평가를 위한 챗봇 기반 말하기 평가 실행
title_en: Implementing a Chatbot-Based Speaking Assessment of Beginner College Students’ English Language Proficiency
kw_en: voice chatbots; speaking assessment; beginner; college students; English speaking
abstract_ko: There is a lack of research on the use of the AI voice chatbot in speaking tests. This study compared ESWT (English Speaking & Writing Test) and CEST (Chatbot-based English Speaking Test) scores, analyzed the impact of interactional competence on the wholistic scores of CEST, and examined test-takers’ perceptions of item difficulties. Twenty-seven Korean university students, primarily at novice English language proficiency levels, participated in the study. They took both ESWT and CEST followed by surveys asking their self-perceived item difficulty for each test. The results of paired ttest showed that ESWT yielded higher mean scores across all analytical constructs and holistic scores with significant differences in pronunciation and coherence. A Ridge regression revealed that the interactivity and fluency constructs of CEST strongly influenced its wholistic score, highlighting the potential of AI chatbots to enhance EFL learners' speaking abilities. Participants, however, perceived CEST as more challenging than ESWT, pointing out the need for more preparation and response time due to their low proficiency levels. Regarding item difficulty, read-aloud and selfintroduction tasks were considered the easiest, while opinion-giving and long consecutive questions were the most challenging in ESWT. Participants also found all items challenging overall, reflecting their limited language competence and underscoring the necessity of targeted speaking skill development. Based on these findings, the study presents discussions and practical implications for integrating AI chatbots into speaking assessment.

title_ko: Comparative Analysis of AI-Generated and Human-Made Instructional Videos: Effects on Learning English Caused-Motion Constructions by Korean High School EFL Learners
title_en: Comparative Analysis of AI-Generated and Human-Made Instructional Videos: Effects on Learning English Caused-Motion Constructions by Korean High School EFL Learners
kw_en: AI-generated video; human-made video; video-based learning; generative AI; caused-motion construction
abstract_ko: This study examines the instructional efficacy and learner perceptions of AI-generated videos for teaching English causedmotion constructions and compares them with human made ones within the Korean EFL context. Employing generative AI to automate the creation of multimodal educational materials is expected to maximize instructional efficiency within Korean EFL settings. However, empirical research comparing AI-generated materials to traditional human-instructed content in language learning remains limited. This study addresses this gap using a mixed-methods design involving ninety high school students divided into the AI-generated and human-made video groups. Participants completed a perception survey and Elicited Writing Tasks (EWT) to assess engagement and learning outcomes. The results from the perception study demonstrate that Human-made videos were preferred for pacing and instructor support, highlighting the importance of human presence in instructional content. Nevertheless, AI-generated videos were also valued for their engaging visuals and efficiency, though participants suggested enhancements in avatar realism and speech clarity. A repeated-measures ANOVA revealed that both AI-generated and human-made videos significantly improved learners’ production of caused-motion constructions in the immediate posttest; however, the instructional effect was not sustained in the delayed posttest. The findings support using AI-generated videos as effective instructional tools and emphasize the need to balance technological efficiency with human-like features for optimal learning experiences. The pedagogical implications of the study are also discussed.
abstract_en: This study examines the instructional efficacy and learner perceptions of AI-generated videos for teaching English causedmotion constructions and compares them with human made ones within the Korean EFL context. Employing generative AI to automate the creation of multimodal educational materials is expected to maximize instructional efficiency within Korean EFL settings. However, empirical research comparing AI-generated materials to traditional human-instructed content in language learning remains limited. This study addresses this gap using a mixed-methods design involving ninety high school students divided into the AI-generated and human-made video groups. Participants completed a perception survey and Elicited Writing Tasks (EWT) to assess engagement and learning outcomes. The results from the perception study demonstrate that Human-made videos were preferred for pacing and instructor support, highlighting the importance of human presence in instructional content. Nevertheless, AI-generated videos were also valued for their engaging visuals and efficiency, though participants suggested enhancements in avatar realism and speech clarity. A repeated-measures ANOVA revealed that both AI-generated and human-made videos significantly improved learners’ production of caused-motion constructions in the immediate posttest; however, the instructional effect was not sustained in the delayed posttest. The findings support using AI-generated videos as effective instructional tools and emphasize the need to balance technological efficiency with human-like features for optimal learning experiences. The pedagogical implications of the study are also discussed.

title_ko: The Effect of ChatGPT’s Grammar and Reformulation Feedback on EFL College Students’ Writing Performance
title_en: The Effect of ChatGPT’s Grammar and Reformulation Feedback on EFL College Students’ Writing Performance
kw_en: ChatGPT-3.5; EFL writing; automated feedback; grammar correction; reformulation feedback; writing performance
abstract_ko: This study investigates the impact of ChatGPT’s grammar and reformulation feedback on the writing performance of EFL college students. Twenty-nine undergraduate EFL students from a Korea national university participated in this research, which utilizes ChatGPT-3.5 to provide automated grammar corrections and reformulation feedback, focusing on improvements in writing accuracy, fluency, and complexity. Using a pre-test and post-test design, the study also measures participants’ attitudes through a six-point Likert-scale questionnaire, analyzing their writing improvements based on IELTS descriptors. The results reveal statistically significant improvements in accuracy and fluency in student compositions. However, students noted minimal impact on complexity, suggesting that deeper noticing and engagement are necessary. This research highlights the potential of AI-driven feedback to support EFL learners and reduce instructor workload, while also emphasizing the importance of integrating awareness-raising activities by teachers or peers to maximize the utility of AI feedback.

title_ko: 대학 스페인어 교육에서의 ChatGPT 효과성 연구와 AI 리터러시 교육 : ZenoChat 적용 사례 분석
title_en: A study on the effectiveness of ChatGPT in university Spanish education and AI literacy education: Analysis of ZenoChat application cases
kw_ko: 교육에서의 ChatGPT 활용; AI 리터러시 교육; ZenoChat 활용 효과
kw_en: Usage of ChatGPT; AI literacy education/Benefits of using ZenoChat
abstract_ko: Artificial intelligence has permeated various aspects of contemporary society, with education being no exception. As ChatGPT tools become increasingly prevalent in higher education settings, opposing or prohibiting their use appears increasingly anachronistic. This paradigm shift requires universities to adapt their educational frameworks to incorporate GPT-based conversational AI services and implement course-optimized tools that enhance student learning outcomes. Contemporary higher education must evolve to create adaptive learning environments by integrating emergent AI technologies into existing curricula through diverse pedagogical methodologies and practical applications. As institutions implement ChatGPT to enhance educational quality, it is imperative to ensure alignment between AI tool adoption, institutional learning objectives, and desired student competencies. While extensive research exists regarding the educational value and potential of ChatGPT integration, a significant gap remains in empirical studies examining specific implementations within university courses or investigating optimal instructor roles. This study focuses on this research gap by conducting statistical analyses of ChatGPT implementation within university-level Spanish language courses, thereby providing a concrete model for AI integration in foreign language education. Through this investigation, we aim to contribute to the growing body of knowledge regarding AI-enhanced education and provide actionable insights for institutions seeking to implement similar technological innovations in their language programs.

title_ko: AI 디지털교과서 도입에 따른 초등영어 읽기 학습 진단 및 맞춤형 학습 방안 탐색
title_en: Enhancing Diagnostic and Personalized Reading Instruction in Elementary School English Through AI-Powered Digital Textbooks
kw_ko: AI 디지털교과서; 디지털 읽기; 읽기 진단; 학습 분석; 맞춤형 학습
kw_en: AI Digital Textbook; Digital Reading; Reading Diagnosis; Learning Analytics; Personalized Learning
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 2025학년도 초등영어 AI 디지털교과서 도입에 따른 학생들의 읽기 학습 진단 및 맞춤형학습 방안을 탐색하였다. AI 디지털교과서는 이전의 디지털교과서와 마찬가지로 각종 멀티미디어 자료와 그림 사전 등을 포함하고 있지만, 클라우드 방식의 인공지능형 학습 플랫폼으로 개발되어 학생들의 읽기 학습 과정과 결과를 다각적으로 분석ㆍ진단한 결과를 제공하고, 이에 따른 맞춤형 읽기 학습을 제공할 것으로 기대된다. 먼저 읽기 학습의 진단 방안을 탐색하고자, 본 연구는 기존에 개발된교육과정 표준체계의 내용 요소와 읽기 진단 선행 연구의 영역을 비교하였으며, 이들 내용 요소는 학습자의 읽기 능력을 진단하는 데 대체로 적절한 것으로 분석되었다. 다만 개별 학습자의 성취 수준이나 발달 단계를 세밀하게 포착하기 위해 내용 요소 간의 위계 및 연계를 보여주는 학습맵을 좀 더 세분화할 필요가 있었다. 그리고 세분화된 내용 요소와 연계된 문항 데이터베이스 구축이 필요하며, 음성 인식 엔진 등의 기능을 활용한 다양한 평가 방법이 필요한 것으로 파악되었다. 아울러 데이터 마이닝을 활용한 학습분석학 연구를 참고하여 학습자들의 읽기 패턴이나 수행 양상, 참여 정도를 다각적으로 수집하여 분석할 것을 제안하였다. 맞춤형 읽기 학습과 관련하여, 미국 사례와 우리나라 교육과정에 대한 비교 분석을 바탕으로 알파벳 체계, 유창성, 이해의 영역별, 난이도별 학습 콘텐츠 개발이필요함을 제안하였으며, 이를 위해 기존에 개발된 학습 콘텐츠의 분류 및 활용 방안을 탐색하였다. 그리고 학습자 특성에 기반한 코스웨어 설계 방안으로서, 그림과 텍스트 배치, 단일 화면 텍스트의 길이및 구성, TTS 기능의 적정한 활용 방안을 살펴보았다. 마지막으로 AI 디지털교과서의 발전 및 활용도를 높이기 위한 후속 연구 방향을 제시하였다.
abstract_en: This study explores ways to assess students’ reading skills and provide individualized learning through AI digital English textbooks for elementary school students, scheduled for implementation in the 2025 academic year. Similar to previous digital textbooks, these AI versions will include various multimedia resources and picture dictionaries; however, they will also function as a cloud-based AI learning platform. This will allow for a comprehensive analysis of students’ reading skills and learning outcomes, thereby facilitating personalized reading instruction. To investigate diagnostic approaches, this study examined the suitability of the curriculum content elements for diagnostic purposes by comparing them with areas identified in previous reading research. Overall, the curriculum elements were found to be appropriate for the detailed assessment of students’ reading skills. However, to better capture individual achievement levels and developmental stages, a more detailed learning map illustrating the sub-elements was deemed necessary. A rich database of test items aligned with these sub-elements, along with various assessment methods, was also identified as essential. Drawing upon learning analytics research and data mining, this study further suggests a multifaceted analysis of students’ reading patterns, performance, and engagement. For individualized reading instruction, it proposes the development of level-differentiated learning content focusing on alphabet principles, fluency, and comprehension, based on a comparative analysis of instructional areas from the U.S., the National Reading Panel, and Korea’s curriculum. It also suggests ways to utilize existing learning content for individualized learning. To support effective courseware design, the study examined the optimal arrangement of images and text, text length, interactive on-screen features, and the appropriate use of text-to-speech (TTS) functions. Finally, the study concludes with recommendations for further research to enhance the development and application of AI digital textbooks.

title_ko: How Did EFL College Instructors Incorporate ChatGPT into their Speaking Classes: Focused on Using Prompts and Obtaining Feedback?
title_en: How Did EFL College Instructors Incorporate ChatGPT into their Speaking Classes: Focused on Using Prompts and Obtaining Feedback?
kw_ko: 인공지능; 인공지능 활용 영어 수업; 챗GPT; 대학교 영어 말하기 수업; 교수자 인식
kw_en: AI; AI-implemented English class; ChatGPT; college English speaking class; instructors’ perception
abstract_ko: This study attempted to explore how two EFL college instructors incorporate ChatGPT into their English-speaking classes. It specifically aims to investigate the use of ChatGPT prompts and its feedback. To accomplish these research aims, two instructors implemented ChatGPT in their English speaking classes with the total of 105 university students throughout the semester. Two instructors’ lesson plans, class materials, and recorded conversations through Zoom were collected and analyed with the content analysis approach and then categorized to recurrent themes. The findings showed that the instructors effectively integrated ChatGPT into their in-class activities and offered well-organized prompts for students’ speaking practice with ChatGPT. Reflecting on ChatGPT’s feedback with human teachers was also educationally significant, linking in-class and out-of-class activities. While ChatGPT’s educational potentials are beginning to be reported as add-on activities to the traditional English teaching approach, instructors’ experiences and perceptions of using it as a connecting factor in and out of their English speaking classes need further investigation. Based on the research findings, educational implications on the potentials of implementing AI technologies in speaking classes are discussed.

title_ko: From No Aid to Neural Aids: Exploring the Influence of Machine Translation on L2 Reading Problems
title_en: From No Aid to Neural Aids: Exploring the Influence of Machine Translation on L2 Reading Problems
authors: 박경진(Department of English Education, Hanyang University); 전유아(한양대학교)
kw_en: machine translation; second language reading; reading problems; second language proficiency
abstract_ko: Neural machine translators (NMTs), such as Google Translate, may assist second language (L2) readers with general comprehension. However, previous empirical studies show mixed results regarding their effectiveness. In this study, 145 Korean English learners from a girls’ high school were asked to solve three types of reading comprehension problems (grammar judgment, inferring meaning from context, inferring main idea) under three reading conditions (no aid, MT, glossary). Overall, when using MT, reading comprehension scores were higher than in either the no aid or glossary conditions individually. However, none of the reading aid conditions improved grammar judgment. Only mid-proficiency learners benefited from MT in both inferring meaning from context and inferring main idea tasks. The results suggest that the glossary may have interrupted the flow of the reading process. With the widespread availability of MT as an online reference tool, L2 teachers should consider incorporating MT as a legitimate reading aid for different proficiency levels and reading purposes.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 활용 영어수업에서초등학생의 프롬프트 사용과 리터러시 특성 연구
title_en: Exploring primary EFL learners’ prompt use and literacy in English classes utilizing generative AI
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 프롬프트 리터러시; 맥락 해석; 프롬프트 수정; 비판적 사고
kw_en: generative AI; prompt literacy; context interpretation; prompt refining; critical thinking
abstract_ko: This study investigated the characteristics of young EFL learners who exhibited advanced prompt literacy when working with generative AI. It explored how elementary students crafted and refined prompts to create images for specific conversation contexts. Twenty-two third-grade learners participated in a semester-long project in 2024. The data included students’ hand-drawn sketches of conversation scenes, crafted prompts, AI-generated images, final artworks, learning logs, and teaching journals. The data were analyzed both quantitatively and qualitatively using a content analysis. The results revealed that students created prompts an average of 3.89 times. However, they used identical prompts 1.47 times, resulting in original prompt usage of 2.42 times. The percentage of students using identical prompts was notably high at 25.7%. Additionally, three notable characteristics were observed among students with advanced prompt literacy: context interpretation, prompt refinement, and critical thinking. Students who clearly understood the context were able to create prompts rich in context. Critically examining AI output, these students iteratively improved their prompts for better results. This study adds empirical evidence on how EFL learners creatively express their ideas in English conversation contexts by using digital devices. It advocates for pedagogical implications for cultivating prompt literacy in futuristic primary English education.

title_ko: 생성형 AI를 활용한 영어 그림책 제작 수업이 고등학교 영어 학습자의 영어 읽기 및 쓰기 능력, AI 리터러시, 자기효능감에 미치는 영향
title_en: The impacts of creating English picture books using generative AI on English reading and writing skills, AI literacy, and self-efficacy of Korean high school students
authors: 황보은(Department of English Education, Kongju National University); 배지영(Department of English Education, Kongju National Universtiy)
kw_ko: 영어 그림책; 생성형 AI; 읽기 능력; AI 리터러시; 자기효능감
kw_en: English picture book; generative AI; reading skills; artificial intelligence literacy; self-efficacy
abstract_ko: This study examined the effects of creating English picture books using generative artificial intelligence (AI) on Korean high school students’ reading and writing skills, AI literacy, and self-efficacy. Forty-five students were divided into two groups and participated in tasks that included selecting a character from English-speaking cultures, generating images using Bing Image Creator, drafting and revising stories with ChatGPT, and creating audiobooks with ClovaDubbing. Reading and writing skills were evaluated using pre- and post-tests, and AI literacy as well as affective factors, including self-efficacy, were measured through surveys. The results indicated a significant improvement in students’ writing skills and self-efficacy, whereas reading skills did not demonstrate statistically significant progress. The study underscores the potential of generative AI as a tool for enhancing writing skills, AI literacy, and self-efficacy in language learning. However, it also emphasizes the need for further pedagogical efforts to design instructional strategies that effectively improve reading skills. These findings offer practical guidance for integrating generative AI into EFL education to enhance language learning and AI literacy.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 AI기술의 활용과 학습분석학적 접근을 통해, 유아의 언어발달 상태를 대시보드 형태로 보여주는 시스템 개발을 목표로 하고 있다. 연구 대상자는 G시의 J어린이집 3세반 유아 5명이다. 유아가 어린이집 교실에서 교사 및 또래 유아들과 대화 혹은 혼잣말을 하는 음성 데이터를 수집하였다. 수집된 자료는 STT 기술을 적용하여 음성 데이터를 텍스트로 변환하고, 유아의 언어발달을 의미론적 측면(어휘다양성, 이해가능도, 주 사용 어휘)과 통사론적 측면(발화 길이, 조사개수, 복문․단문의 비율)으로 분석하였다. 그 결과 의미론적 분석에서는 유아의 언어표본 시간 대비 발화수와 총 낱말수, 서로 다른 낱말 수, 낱말 유형 비율, 전체 발화수 대비 이해 가능한 발화의 비율, 빈번하게 언급된 낱말들을 유목화한 그룹별 빈도를 도출하였다. 통사론적 분석에서는 유아의 전체 발화 횟수, 최장 발화 길이, 평균 발화 길이, 조사의 유형별 활용 빈도, 복문과 단문의 비율을 살펴보았다. 이러한 분석 과정을 통해 AI기술을 활용한 유아 언어발달 분석의 이점과 한계점을 논의하며, 향후 유아의 언어발달 상태를 보다 자동화된 방식으로 실시간 제시하는 시스템 개발을 위한 발전 과제에 대해 논하였다.
abstract_en: This study aims to develop a system that utilizes AI technology and a learning analytics approach to visualize the language development status of children through a dashboard. Five 3-year-old children from a preschool in G City were recruited, and voice data were collected as the children interacted with teachers, peers, or spoke to themselves in the classroom. The collected data were converted into text using Speech-to-Text (STT) technology, and then analyzed from semantic (e.g., lexical diversity, comprehensibility, frequently used words) and syntactic (e.g., utterance length, number of particles, ratio of complex to simple sentences) perspectives. Semantic analysis examined measures, such as the number of utterances per unit of time, total number of words, number of unique words, lexical type-token ratio, the proportion of comprehensible utterances to total utterances, and group frequencies of commonly mentioned words. Syntactic analysis examined total utterance counts, maximum and average utterance lengths, usage frequencies of different particle types, and the ratio of complex to simple sentences. Through this process, the study discussed the advantages and limitations of using AI for analyzing children's language development. It also outlined future tasks for developing a more automated, real-time system to present children's language development status.
note: 유아 언어발달 STT 분석 시스템, 언어교육 아님

title_ko: 이미지 생성 인공지능을 활용한 초등영어 쓰기 프로그램 개발 및 적용
title_en: Development and implementation of an elementary English writing program using image-generative AI
authors: 김은송(Hwaseong Dongyang Elementary School); 안경자(Department of English Education, Seoul National University of Education)
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 이미지 생성형 AI; 영어쓰기; 초등영어; 영어교사
kw_en: generative AI; image-generative AI; English writing; elementary English; English teacher
abstract_ko: This study developed and implemented an elementary English writing program using image-generative AI to examine its effects on students’ writing abilities and affective domains. The program was designed following the ADDIE model and aligned with the 2022 Revised English National Curriculum. It used Padlet’s ‘I Can’t Draw,’ allowing students to create images based on their prompts. Eighty sixth-grade students participated, with data collected through pre- and post-writing tests, affective domain surveys, student work, reflections, and teacher interviews. A mixed-methods analysis, combining ANCOVA and content analysis, revealed the following: (1) The program improved the syntactic and lexical complexity and fluency of students’ writing, but not accuracy. (2) Students’ situational interest significantly increased, but individual interest did not. Additionally, students’ engagement and motivation in learning English improved. These findings indicate that image-generative AI is an effective tool for enhancing English writing lessons and providing feedback. The study also emphasizes the critical role of teacher competence in successfully integrating AI into language instruction.

title_ko: A Comparative Study of Students’ Perceptions on ChatGPT and Machine Translators
title_en: A Comparative Study of Students’ Perceptions on ChatGPT and Machine Translators
kw_ko: 기계번역; AI(인공지능); 발표문; 작문
kw_en: machine translator; AI(Artificial Intelligence); presentation script; ChatGPT; writing
abstract_ko: This study examines the impact of ChatGPT compared to traditional machine translators on university students’ English writing and speaking skills, perceptions, and preferences. Conducted with 23 freshmen in a College English course, the research utilized surveys to assess changes in learners’ abilities, confidence, satisfaction, and tool preferences before and after incorporating AI tools. The findings reveal that ChatGPT significantly improved students’ self-reported writing and speaking skills, confidence, and satisfaction, surpassing the effectiveness of traditional machine translators. While machine translators were valued for their ease of use and grammatical accuracy, they hindered self-directed learning and proficiency improvement. In contrast, ChatGPT offered advanced capabilities, including grammar correction, natural sentence refinement, and learning support, but faced limitations such as occasional inaccuracies and dependency risks. Despite the study’s limited scope and absence of direct language proficiency evaluations, it highlights the potential of the tools in language education. Future research should explore their broader impact, including their influence on the four language skills and their integration with other AI tools to enhance language learning outcomes.

title_ko: 예비 영어 교사의 수업계획서 작성을 위한 생성형 AI 활용
title_en: Utilizing Generative AI for Lesson Planning for Prospective English Teachers
kw_ko: 챗 GPT; 영어 수업계획서 작성; 예비 영어 교사; 생성형 AI; 교사 교육
kw_en: ChatGPT; English lesson planning; Prospective English teachers; generative AI; teacher education
abstract_ko: This study examines the effectiveness of ChatGPT in assisting prospective English teachers with lesson planning, addressing a significant research gap in empirical studies on the educational applications of generative AI in English education. Participants first received theoretical instruction on English lesson planning, followed by collaborative activities where they created lesson plans using ChatGPT. Data was collected through surveys, interviews, and learner journals to assess (1) the perceived contributions of ChatGPT to different components of lesson plans, (2) its usefulness in developing various instructional activities, and (3) the advantages and challenges encountered during the lesson planning process. The findings indicated that ChatGPT was particularly effective in selecting and organizing learning materials, developing vocabulary activities, and designing lesson closure activities. However, it demonstrated relatively lower effectiveness in areas such as assessment tool development and speaking activity design. Prospective teachers reported that ChatGPT was most beneficial when they provided detailed instructional contexts and specific English prompts that included textbook content. These findings underscore the need for systematic guidelines for integrating AI tools into prospective teacher education programs, recognizing both their potential and limitations. The study also emphasizes the importance of balancing AI-generated suggestions with teachers’ professional judgment to develop effective English lesson plans.

title_ko: Towards Regionally Customized English AI Digital Textbooks
title_en: Towards Regionally Customized English AI Digital Textbooks
authors: 양세정(제주대학교, University of Hawaii at Manoa)
kw_en: English textbooks; AI digital textbook (AIDT); large culture; small culture; region
abstract_ko: Korean elementary schools have relied on standardized, paper-based English textbooks. This pilot study examines how these textbooks represent regions such as Jeju and Busan, aiming to inform the development of the Artificial Intelligence Digital Textbook (AIDT), set to launch in 2025. AIDT is software or a textbook that leverages intelligent technologies, including AI, to provide personalized learning materials and support tailored to individual students’ abilities and levels. Drawing on Holliday’s (1999) cultural paradigm, this study utilizes both qualitative and quantitative analyses. The analyses focus on textbooks from two publishers widely used on Jeju Island. The findings reveal a lack of regional references in textbooks for lower grades (grades 3 and 4). Specific regions are mentioned in textbooks for higher grades (grades 5 and 6), but primarily as weekend or summer travel destinations. Seoul is presented as the main character’s place of origin, implicitly positioning it as the central place of residence. Jeju, which appears frequently, is consistently depicted as a tourist destination, reinforcing an oversimplified and peripheral image of the region. This study emphasizes the significance of AIDT in providing regionally tailored English education that reflects the lived experiences of students outside Seoul in Korea.
