title_ko: 영어 그림책 기반 에듀테크 활용 블렌디드 러닝에 대한 교사들의 인식 및 경험
title_en: Teachers’ perceptions and experiences of edutech-utilizing blended learning based on English picture books
kw_ko: 그림책; 블렌디드 러닝; 에듀테크; 영어 교육; 포스트코로나
kw_en: picture books; blended learning; edutech; English education; post-COVID era
abstract_ko: This study investigated teachers' perceptions and experiences with blended learning using English picture books. Sixteen teachers enrolled in an English instruction course focused on educational technology in a graduate TESOL program participated in the research during the second semester of 2023. Data were collected through pre- and post-surveys, edutech utilization reports, and interviews, with the analysis being primarily qualitative. The findings are as follows: First, regarding teachers' perceptions, participants recognized the possibility and necessity of blended learning in their English picture book reading classes. They moved beyond initial resistance and fear towards blended learning, demonstrating confidence and a challenging attitude toward future implementation and learning. Teachers also acknowledged the value of English picture books in edutech-utilizing blended learning. Second, from the perspective of teachers' experiences, participants were able to expand their teaching experiences by utilizing educational technology for vocabulary instruction, as well as for guiding reading and collaborative writing, and for assigning tasks. However, they encountered issues such as students' lack of proficiency with devices, difficulties accessing programs, and limitations of free versions. Based on these findings, implications were provided for effective edutech integration in English teaching, advocating for comprehensive support and further research.

title_ko: 챗GPT 피드백이 대학생들 영작문 과제 수행과 학습자 인식에 미치는 영향
title_en: The Effect of ChatGPT Feedback on College Students’ English Writing and Their Affective Factors
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 인공 지능 기반 글쓰기; 영작 피드백; 교양 영어; 영어 쓰기
kw_en: ChatGPT; AI-based Writing; English Writing Feedback; General English; English Writing
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 교양 영어를 수강하는 대학생들이 생성형 인공지능인 챗GPT를사용하여 피드백을 받아 영어 작문 과제를 수행할 때 영어 글쓰기 결과물에어떤 변화가 있었는지, 또한 학습자들의 심리적 만족감과 자신감 등의 정의적요인에 어떤 영향을 미쳤는지를 알아보고자 하였다. 연구대상은 교양 영어를수강하는 대학생 76명으로 아무런 기계적 도움 없이 영어 작문 초안을 작성하게 한 후 챗GPT가 준 피드백을 가지고 수정안을 작성하도록 하였다. 그 결과, 수정안의 모든 쓰기 영역에서 점수가 유의미하게 높았으며 이는 챗GPT의 피드백이 영어 작문과제를 수행하는데 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤음을 의미한다. 특히 내용이나 구성보다는 문법 및 어휘, 기계적 오류, 과제완성에서 유의미하게더 도움을 받은 것으로 나타났다. 또한, 학습자들은 내용, 구성 관련 피드백보다 문법 및 어휘, 과제완성, 기계적 오류 관련 형식 중심 피드백에 대한 높은만족도를 보여주었다. 정의적 측면에서는, 챗GPT가 제시한 작문 피드백이 영어 작문에 대한 동기 부여와 자신감의 상승 등의 긍정적인 영향을 끼쳤으나챗GPT에 대한 지나친 의존에 대한 우려와 실제적인 영어 실력향상에 대한부정적인 의견도 있었다. 인공지능을 활용한 학습 도구가 학습자들의 작문능력 및 정의적 요인에 미치는 효과를 지속적으로 탐구하고, 교육적 활용 방안을 보다 체계적으로 설계해 나가는 것이 필요하다.
abstract_en: This study aimed to examine how the use of generative AI, specifically ChatGPT, influenced the quality of English writing and affective factors such as psychological satisfaction and self-confidence among university students enrolled in a general English course. The study involved 76 college-level students who were asked to draft an initial English composition without any mechanical assistance and then revise it based on feedback provided by ChatGPT. The results showed that the scores significantly improved across all writing domains in the revised drafts, indicating that ChatGPT’s feedback positively impacted the quality of their English writing. Notably, there were significantly higher scores in grammar and vocabulary, mechanics, and task completion compared to content and organization domains. Additionally, the students expressed higher satisfaction with form-focused feedback related to grammar and vocabulary, task completion, and mechanics than with content and organization feedback. In terms of affective factors, ChatGPT’s feedback positively influenced the students’ motivation and confidence in English writing. However, concerns about excessive reliance on ChatGPT and its limited impact on actual English proficiency were also noted. It is essential to continue exploring the effects of AI-based learning tools on learners’ English writing abilities and their affective factors and to systematically design educational applications to maximize their potential.

title_ko: Machine Translation and EFL Writing Development: A Focus on Complexity, Accuracy, and Fluency
title_en: Machine Translation and EFL Writing Development: A Focus on Complexity, Accuracy, and Fluency
kw_en: machine translation; complexity; accuracy; fluency; EFL writing
abstract_ko: This study investigates the effect of machine translation (MT) use on the writing performance of Korean EFL students, focusing on complexity, accuracy, and fluency (CAF). Six participants completed a series of writing tasks in which they first translated their L1 writing into L2 manually and then used MT to revise their L2 drafts. This process was repeated across ten different writing topics. Participants’ drafts were analyzed using CAF measures to assess MT’s impact on their writing performance and observe changes over tasks. The results show that MT significantly improved accuracy and fluency. However, gains in syntactic and lexical complexity were less evident. While group-level analysis showed consistent progress, individual trajectories varied widely, indicating diverse patterns of development. Overall, the findings suggest that MT enhances writing accuracy and fluency among Korean EFL students, although its impact on syntactic and lexical complexity is limited. These results indicate that MT can serve as a valuable tool for self-directed learning, helping students independently improve their writing accuracy and fluency and develop essential self-editing skills. This study highlights the potential of MT as a supplementary tool to support EFL students’ writing development, along with traditional instruction.

title_ko: Cyber English Learners’ Use and Perceptions of ChatGPT
title_en: Cyber English Learners’ Use and Perceptions of ChatGPT
kw_en: ChatGPT; Feedback; Self-directed learning; Cyber learners
abstract_ko: This study surveyed cyber university students enrolled in an English writing course to examine how ChatGPT influences their learning process and assess its educational potential. Participants used ChatGPT without prior instruction and completed a questionnaire on their experiences. Results indicate high satisfaction, with 89.1% finding ChatGPT useful for English writing, primarily for feedback on grammar, vocabulary, and sentence structure. However, students noted limitations, such as insufficient support for self-directed writing skills and a lack of clear guidance for improving writing organization. In terms of affective impact, ChatGPT was found to increase writing confidence and reduce stress, although its effect on fostering interest in writing varied. Overall, these findings suggest that while ChatGPT can be beneficial, effective integration may require additional instructor support to provide personalized feedback and supplement areas where ChatGPT falls short. Based on the results of this study, suggestions are made for effectively utilizing ChatGPT as an educational tool for cyber learners.

title_ko: A Systematic Review of Generative Artificial Intelligence in L2 Education
title_en: A Systematic Review of Generative Artificial Intelligence in L2 Education
kw_en: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI); Chat GPT; large language models (LLMs); L2 education; ELT
abstract_ko: This literature review examines a comprehensive review of generative AI (GenAI) in English as second/foreign language (L2) education, analyzing its application in writing, pronunciation, translation, and assessment. Drawing on thematic analysis of recent studies, it identifies key categories, research themes, and significant findings while addressing gaps in prior reviews. Methodologically, the study synthesizes insights from peer-reviewed research published between 2023 and 2024, offering a robust framework for understanding GenAI’s impact and guiding future exploration in L2 education. Key findings highlight GenAI's potential to enhance personalization, efficiency, and learner engagement, while addressing challenges such as ethical concerns, over-reliance, and output quality. Teacher training, critical evaluation, and balanced integration are essential for effective implementation. The review underscores the importance of combining technological innovation with pedagogical expertise to maximize GenAI's impact on L2 learning and teaching.

title_ko: 과정 중심 영어 글쓰기 수업에서의 ChatGPT 활용 가능성 연구－학습자 경험과 인식을 중심으로
title_en: Exploring the Potential of ChatGPT in Process-oriented English Writing Classes : Focusing on Learners’ Experiences and Perceptions
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 과정 중심 영어 글쓰기; 학습자 인식
kw_en: ChatGPT; Generative AI; Process-Oriented English Writing; Learner Perceptions
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 과정 중심 영어 글쓰기 수업에서 ChatGPT를 활용한 학습자들의 경험과 인식을 분석하고, 생성형 AI 도구가 학습자의 영어 글쓰기 능력 향상에 미치는 영향과 한계를 탐구하는 것이다. 연구는 A대학의 1학년 필수 교양 영어 수업에 참여한 학생 51명을 대상으로 진행되었다. 설문지는 ChatGPT 활용도, 효과성, 영어 학습 능력 향상, ChatGPT를 활용한 영어 글쓰기 학습 경험의 만족도에 대한 객관식 문항과 영어 글쓰기에서 ChatGPT를 활용했을 때의 장점과 단점을 묻는 서술식 문항으로 구성되어있으며, 자료는 IBM SPSS 27.0을 이용하여 통계적 분석을 수행하였다. 분석 결과, 학습자들은 주로 내용 수정, 문법 오류 교정, 개요 작성에서 ChatGPT를 활용했으며, ChatGPT가 에세이 질 향상에긍정적 영향을 미친다고 평가했다. 약 68%의 학습자는 ChatGPT를 활용한 영어 글쓰기 활동을 흥미롭게 경험했다고 답변했다. 그러나 ChatGPT의 내용을 그대로 반영하기보다는 보조 도구로 활용하는 경향이 두드러졌으며, 정보 신뢰성 부족과 과도한 의존에 대한 우려도 나타났다. 또한, 학습자들은 ChatGPT가 직접적인 영어 능력 향상에는 한계가 있다고 인식하였다. 결론적으로, ChatGPT는 영어 글쓰기 교육에서 학습자들에게 긍정적인 학습 경험을 제공하고, 흥미와 동기를 유발하는 데 기여할 수 있는 도구로 평가되었다. 그러나 정보 신뢰성과 창의성 저하 등의 문제점을 해결하기 위한 교육적 보완책이 필요하다. 본 연구는 ChatGPT를 활용한 영어 글쓰기 경험에 대한 학습자들의 인식과 만족도를 바탕으로 향후 연구 방향과 교육적 시사점을 제시하고자 한다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to analyze students' experiences and perceptions of using ChatGPT in process-oriented English writing classes and to explore the effects and limitations of generative AI tools on improving students' English writing skills. The study was conducted with 51 first-year students participating in a required general English course at University. The survey consisted of multiple-choice questions about ChatGPT usage, effectiveness, improvement in English learning ability, and satisfaction with the English writing learning experience using ChatGPT, as well as open-ended questions about the advantages and disadvantages of using ChatGPT in English writing. The data was statistically analyzed using IBM SPSS 27.0. The results revealed that students primarily used ChatGPT for content revision, grammar error correction, and outline creation, and they evaluated ChatGPT as having a positive impact on improving essay quality. Approximately 68% of learners reported finding the English writing activities using ChatGPT interesting. However, there was a notable tendency to use ChatGPT as a supplementary tool rather than directly incorporating its content. Concerns were also raised about the lack of information reliability and over-reliance on the tool. Additionally, students perceived that ChatGPT had limitations in directly improving English language proficiency. In conclusion, ChatGPT was evaluated as a tool that can provide positive learning experiences in English writing education and contribute to generating interest and motivation. However, educational measures are needed to address issues such as information reliability and potential decline in creativity. Based on students' perceptions and satisfaction with their English writing experiences using ChatGPT, this study aims to suggest future research directions and educational implications.

title_ko: South Korean STEM Graduate Students’ Use of ChatGPT in Self-Initiated L2 Writing: A Process-Tracing Study
title_en: South Korean STEM Graduate Students’ Use of ChatGPT in Self-Initiated L2 Writing: A Process-Tracing Study
kw_en: academic writing; CALL; ChatGPT; eye-tracking; writing process
abstract_ko: Using process-tracing technologies such as webcam-based eye-tracking, screen recording, and stimulated recall, this study explored how South Korean STEM graduate students employed ChatGPT in their self-initiated and naturalistic English writing settings. The analysis of three 30-minute writing sessions and stimulated recalls, as well as semi-structured interviews from four participants, revealed the complex and dynamic patterns of tool use and behaviors in ChatGPT-mediated writing. At the tool level, participants employed a range of digital tools alongside ChatGPT, guided by personal preferences and writing community norms. At the behavioral level, they demonstrated that using ChatGPT in L2 writing involved not only diverse gaze and non-gaze behaviors but also individualized sequences of these behaviors to meet specific writing goals. The closer analysis of the two participants’ cases showed idiosyncratic patterns in tool usage and behavior. One participant used ChatGPT in a brief and targeted way, focusing only on specific vocabulary and expression searches. The other adapted ChatGPT-related behaviors dynamically based on the purpose and stage of writing. By unobtrusively tracing L2 writers’ real-time evolutions during the writing process, this study suggests that ChatGPT has urged us to rethink conventional writing stages and behaviors and to develop new research methods that can capture such dynamic processes of AI-mediated L2 writing.

title_ko: Exploring AI-Generated Substitutions for the Preposition ‘Over’: Frequency and Contextual Alternatives in Formal Written English
title_en: Exploring AI-Generated Substitutions for the Preposition ‘Over’: Frequency and Contextual Alternatives in Formal Written English
kw_en: substitutes; over; L2 learners; linguistics; ChatGPT
abstract_ko: This study investigates the substitution patterns of the preposition over in written, formal English, utilizing AI-generated data as an alternative to traditional corpus methods. Two datasets of 100 and 200 sentences were analyzed, with the preposition about emerging as the most frequent and versatile substitute for over. Other alternatives, including of, above, and against, appeared in more specific contexts. The statistical analysis, supported by a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.9939 between the two datasets, confirmed the reliability and consistency of the AI-generated data. The results indicate that AI-generated examples can serve as a valid and efficient tool for exploring linguistic phenomena, capturing consistent prepositional patterns even with increasing sample sizes. Pedagogical implications suggest that educators can prioritize high-frequency alternatives like about in language instruction, while focusing on contextualized learning to help L2 learners navigate the complexity of prepositional usage.

kw_ko: 메타버스; 일본어교육; 메타버시티; 학습자주도; 플립드러닝

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 일본어전공 대학생을 대상으로, 메타버스 교육 플랫폼 「메타버시티」를 활용하여 학습자주도형 수업을 제작 후, 실제로 메타버시티에서 수업을 진행하고, 학생들과 교수자의 의견을 수집한 설문결과와 적용사례 고찰을 통해 가상의 환경이 일본어 교수･학습에도 활용가능한지를 확인하고자 한다. 아울러 현 시점에서 보충할 점과 메타버스 기반 수업에 대한 학생들의 인식에 대해서도 확인하였다. 그 결과 가상환경 속 교육컨텐츠 제작을 위한 다양한 교육이 필요하며, 교수자가 수업의 질과 학생 관리에만 집중하도록 메타비티 를 제작해 줄 전문가들과의 협업도 필요하다. 또한, 과제 및 단어학습 활동을 가능하게 해 줄 다양한 온라인 도구의 발굴 필요성이 모두 충족된다면, 여전히 오프라인 수업을 선호하는 학생들을 대상으로도 일본어뿐만 아니라 다양한 언어를 학습하는 메타버시티 기반 수업의 확대 가능성은 충분하다.
abstract_en: This study aims to assess the feasibility of using a new metaverse-based educational platform, Metaversity, for self-directed learning in Japanese language courses for university students majoring in Japanese. After creating a class utilizing this platform and conducting lessons within the virtual environment, the study gathered feedback from both students and instructors through surveys and case studies. The goal was to determine whether this type of class could be effectively used for teaching Japanese. Additionally, the study sought to identify areas for improvement and understand students’ perceptions of metaverse-based classes at this stage. The results highlighted the need for diverse educational training to develop content suitable for the virtual environment, as well as the importance of collaboration with Metaversity experts to allow instructors to focus on teaching quality and student management. Furthermore, there is a need to discover online tools that facilitate learning activities such as submitting assignments and vocabulary study. If these needs are addressed, the potential to conduct not only Japanese language classes but also various language courses through Metaversity, even for students who still prefer offline classes, was confirmed.
note: 일본어 메타버스 수업

title_ko: 성찰적 글쓰기 수업에서 ChatGPT 활용 여부에 따른 대학생의 쓰기효능감과 학업성취도의 비교 연구
title_en: A Comparative Study of University Students’ Writing Efficacy and Academic Achievement: The Impact of ChatGPT in Reflective Writing Classes
kw_ko: ChatGPT 활용 글쓰기; 쓰기효능감; 학업성취도; 대학 글쓰기; 성찰적 글쓰기
kw_en: ChatGPT-assisted writing; writing efficacy; academic achievement; university writing; reflective writing
abstract_ko: 목적 본 연구는 대학 글쓰기 수업에서 신입생들이 겪는 어려움을 해소하기 위한 대안으로 ChatGPT 활용 가능성을 타진하고, 쓰기효능감과 학업성취도에 미치는 영향에 대해 실증적으로 검증하고자 하였다. 방법 경기도 소재 4년제 대학의 <기초글쓰기> 교과목 수강생 130명을 대상으로, 중간고사 이후 성찰적 글쓰기 수업에서 ChatGPT를 활용한 실험집단과 활용하지 않은 통제집단으로 나누어 사전-사후 쓰기효능감에 대한 설문조사를 실시하고, 학생들의 성찰일지, 교수자의 관찰일지 및 중간, 기말고사 성적으로 학업성취도 자료를 수집하여 통계 분석과 질적 분석을 실시하였다. 결과 분석 결과, ChatGPT를 활용한 학생들은 전반적인 쓰기 효능감, 특히 표현기능에서 유의미한 향상을 보였는데, ChatGPT를 통해 제공된 아이디어와 어휘를 참조하여 자신의 아이디어 생성과 표현의 어려움을 완화하고, 사고를 확장시켜 창의적이고 효과적으로 생각을 표현하는 데 도움을 받은 것으로 관찰되었다. 학업성취도 면에서도 ChatGPT 활용 집단은 통제집단보다 기말고사에서 유의미하게 높은 성적을 보였으며, 쓰기효능감과 학업성취도 간의 상관관계 분석 결과, 구조기능보다는 문법기능과 표현기능이 학업성취도와 더 강한 상관관계를 보였다. 결론 이러한 연구 결과들은 ChatGPT를 통해 참조한 샘플과 개별화된 피드백이 학생들의 글쓰기에서 자가 수정 능력을 향상시키고, 학습 동기와 몰입을 증진시켜 더 나은 학업 성과를 이끌어 냈음을 시사한다. 본 연구는 ChatGPT와 같은 AI 도구가 글쓰기 교육에서 개별화된 피드백을 제공하여 창의적 표현력과 쓰기효능감 및 학습 성과를 높일 수 있다는 실증적 데이터를 제시하고, 교육 현장에서 AI 도구를 효과적인 통합에 대한 유용한 통찰을 제공한다.
abstract_en: Objectives This study aims to explore the potential of using ChatGPT as an alternative to address the difficulties faced by freshmen in university writing classes and empirically verify its impact on writing efficacy and academic achievement. Methods The study involved 130 students from a four-year university in Gyeonggi Province enrolled in a Basic Writing course. After the midterm exam, students were divided into an experimental group using ChatGPT and a control group that did not. A pre- and post-survey on writing efficacy was conducted, and data on academic ach ievement were collected through midterm and final exam scores, along with qualitative data from students' re flective journals and instructor observation logs. Results The statical and qualitative analysis revealed that students who used ChatGPT showed significant im provement in overall writing efficacy, particularly in expressive functions. By referencing ideas and vocabulary pro vided by ChatGPT, students were able to ease difficulties in generating and expressing their own ideas, expanding their thinking to express themselves more creatively and effectively. In terms of academic achievement, the ChatGPT group performed significantly better on the final exam compared to the control group. Correlation analy sis between writing efficacy and academic achievement showed that grammar and expression functions had a stronger correlation with academic performance than structural functions. Conclusions These results suggest that the samples and personalized feedback provided by ChatGPT improved students' self-editing abilities in writing, boosted their motivation and engagement, and ultimately led to better academic outcomes. This study offers empirical evidence that AI tools like ChatGPT can enhance creative ex pression, writing efficacy, and academic performance by providing individualized feedback in writing education. It also offers valuable insights into effectively integrating AI tools in educational settings.
note: 대학 기초글쓰기 교과 실험

title_ko: AR과 AI음성인식을 활용한 영어교육게임개발 연구
title_en: Research on English education game development using AR and AI speech recognition
kw_ko: 실감콘텐츠; 증강현실; 교육용 게임
kw_en: Immersive Content; AR; Educational games
abstract_ko: 최근 4차 산업혁명으로 AR과 AI가 주목을 받고 있다. 하지만 최신 기술을 응용해서 교육용 게임콘텐츠를 개발하는 연구가 부족한 실정이다. 언어학습에 대한 수요가 꾸준히 증가하고 있고 교육용 게임의 시장이 커지고 있기 때문에 언어학습을 할 수 있는 교육용 게임을 제작하였다. AI음성인식을 이용하여 이용자의 음성을 텍스트로 전환하고 전환한 텍스트를 비교하여 다음 단계로 넘어가는 형식의 교육용 게임을 구현하였다. 영어단어와 영어문장을 연습할 수 있도록 두 가지 모드를 구현하였고, 제한시간 안에 문제를 맞춰야하는 규칙을 정했다. 또한 원어민 발음을 직접 들을 수 있는 기능과 힌트를 볼 수 있는 기능을 추가하여 교육적 요소와 게임적 요소를 접목하였다. 본 연구는 다양한 기술을 사용하여 기존과는 다른 교육용 게임에 대한 가능성을 제시하였고, 이 연구를 활용하여 다양한 콘텐츠가 제작되기를 기대한다.
abstract_en: Recently, AR and AI have been attracting attention as the fourth industrial revolution. However, there is a lack of research on developing educational game content by applying the latest technologies. As the demand for language learning is steadily increasing and the market for educational games is growing, we created an educational game that can learn languages. We implemented an educational game that uses AI speech recognition to convert the user's voice into text, compare the converted text, and move on to the next step. We implemented two modes for practicing English words and English sentences, and set a rule to solve the questions within the time limit. In addition, we combined educational and game elements by adding a function to listen to the pronunciation of native speakers and a function to view hints. This study showed the possibility of educational games that are different from the existing ones by using various technologies, and we hope that various contents will be created using this study.
note: AI음성인식 기반 영어 단어·문장 발화 게임 개발(AR 병용)

title_ko: 대학 영어 글쓰기 평가에서 ChatGPT의 활용
title_en: The Use of ChatGPT in College English Writing Evaluation
kw_en: ChatGPT; GPT-3.5 and GPT-4; AI-assisted writing evaluation; Human rater and ChatGPT; EFL writing assessment; Korean college students
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study was to examine the evaluation results of Korean college students’ writing assignments assessed by a human rater and ChatGPT (GPT-3.5 and GPT-4) to explore the feasibility of ChatGPT as an assistant tool in English writing evaluation. A total of 77 paragraph writing assignments were collected and evaluated using a five-point rubric. Quantitative analysis was conducted using one-way ANOVA, and qualitative analysis provided deeper insights into evaluation discrepancies. The findings revealed statistically significant differences among the scores of the human rater, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4, with GPT-3.5 demonstrating greater similarity to the human rater than GPT-4. Qualitative analysis highlighted that ChatGPT’s evaluations were occasionally simplistic, erroneous, or misaligned with the rubric criteria. Notably, ChatGPT tended to prioritize content evaluation over format assessment. These findings suggest that while ChatGPT can be effectively used as a supplementary tool in English writing evaluation, its current limitations in consistency and adherence to criteria indicate that it cannot fully replace human raters.

title_ko: 학습계약서와 ChatGPT를 활용한 자기주도적 영어 글쓰기 학습
title_en: Self-Directed Learning of English Writing Using Learning Contract and ChatGPT
kw_en: ChatGPT; English writing; learning contract; pre-service teacher; self-directed learning
abstract_ko: This study examines the effectiveness of learning contracts and ChatGPT in promoting self-directed English writing among 23 pre-service elementary school teachers. It addresses three research questions: (1) the effects of learning contracts and ChatGPT on self-directed English writing, (2) the correlation between learning contract implementation and writing performance, and (3) the utility of ChatGPT as a supplementary tool. Over the 15-week period, data were collected from pre- and post-questionnaires, essays, learning contracts, and transcribed writing conferences. Results showed that learning contracts facilitated goal setting and sustained motivation, with 69.6% of participants achieving their objectives. Learning contract implementation correlated positively with post-test scores (self-evaluation: r = .54; teacher evaluation: r = .53), and frequent implementation was linked to improvement (r = .36). The students responded that they received the most help from ChatGPT in vocabulary, grammar, and sentence construction. While barriers like busy schedules were noted, findings suggest that learning contracts and ChatGPT together effectively support self-directed writing.

title_ko: ChatGPT의 국어 문법 개념 이해도 평가 - 의미 유사도 분석을 통한 교육적 활용 가능성 탐색 -
title_en: An Evaluation of ChatGPT’s Understand of Korean Grammar Concepts -Exploring Its Educational Potential through Semantic Similarity Analysis-
kw_ko: 문법 교육; 인공지능 교육; 의미 유사도
kw_en: Grammar Education; ChatGPT; AI Education; Semantic Similarity
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 ChatGPT 4o가 국어 문법 용어의 개념을 얼마나 정확하게 이해하고 있는지를 평가하고, 이를 통해 국어 문법 교육에서의 ChatGPT 활용 가능성을 탐색하는 것을 목적으로 하였다. 이를 위해 2019년에 발행된 ‘언어와 매체’ 교과서 5종에서 394개의 문법 용어를 선정하였으며, 각 용어에 대한 ChatGPT의 정의와 표준국어대사전의 정의를 비교하였다. KoBERT를 이용한 의미 유사도 분석 결과, 평균 유사도 값은 0.86으로 나타나, ChatGPT가 국어 문법 용어를 상당히 정확하게 이해하고 있음을 확인하였다. 또한, 단원별 의미 유사도 분석에서도 모든 단원에서 높은 유사도가 나타나, ChatGPT가 국어 문법 교육에서 학습 보조 도구로 활용될 수 있는 잠재력을 보여주었다. 다만, ChatGPT의 응답이 프롬프트에 따라 다소 변동될 수 있고, 새로운 모델이 출시될 때 응답 내용이 달라질 수 있으며 잘못된 정보를 제공할 수 있다는 점이 이 연구의 한계점이다.
abstract_en: This study aims to evaluate how accurately ChatGPT 4o understands the concepts of Korean grammar terms and to explore its potential for use in Korean grammar education. To this end, 394 grammatical terms were selected from five "Language and Media" textbooks published in 2019, and ChatGPT's definitions were compared with those from the Standard Korean Dictionary. The results of the semantic similarity analysis using KoBERT revealed an average similarity score of 0.86, indicating that ChatGPT has a considerable understanding of Korean grammar terms. In addition, the analysis of semantic similarity by textbook chapter showed high similarity scores across all chapters, suggesting that ChatGPT has the potential to be used as an educational support tool in Korean grammar education. However, a limitation of this study is that ChatGPT's responses may vary depending on the prompt, and the content of its responses may change with the release of new models.
note: ChatGPT 국어문법 용어 정의 KoBERT 유사도 평가, 실증

title_ko: 생성 AI를 활용한 서사 창작교육 방법 탐색
title_en: Methods for Generative AI Usage in Narrative Creation Education
kw_ko: 생성AI; 서사 창작교육; AI 서사 창작교육; AI 문학교육; AI 창작교육
kw_en: ChatGPT; Generative AI; Narrative Creation Education; AI Narrative Creation Education; AI Literary Education; AI Creation Education
abstract_ko: 본고의 목적은 생성 AI를 활용한 서사 창작교육 방법을 탐색하는 것이다. 이를 위하여 먼저, 생성 AI가 활용될 현 시대의 서사 창작교육의 성격과 목표를 확인하였다. 이에 따라, 서사 창작교육에서 생성 AI가 활용될 수 있는 방식을 “제안자”, “점검자”, “협력자” 기능을 중심으로 제안하였다. 그리고, 생성 AI를 활용한 서사 창작교육 방법으로 ‘생성 AI 활용 단위 및 활동의 획정’, ‘생성 AI 접촉 층위의 다양화’, ‘생성 AI의 윤리성 회피에 대한 대응’으로 제안하였다. 본고는 서사 창작교육에서 생성 AI 활용 지점을 명료화하고 서사 창작교육 연구에서 생성 AI 활용의 방법론을 마련하였다는 의의를 지닌다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to explore methods for utilizing generative AI in narrative creation education. To this end, the traits and objectives of narrative creation education in the current era, where generative AI is actively applied, were first examined. Based on these findings, the study proposed three main roles for generative AI in narrative creation education: as a “proponent”, “inspector”, and “collaborator”. Furthermore, methods for applying generative AI in narrative creation education were suggested, including ‘demarcating the units and activities of generative AI use’, ‘diversifying levels of interaction with generative AI’, and ‘addressing ethical challenges associated with generative AI’. This study is significant in that it clarifies the points of application for generative AI in narrative creation education and establishes a methodology for integrating generative AI in narrative creation education research.
note: 생성AI 서사창작교육 방법 설계 제안, 담론 경계

title_ko: 프랑스 언어학 교육에서 생성형 인공지능 활용을 위한 학습자의 디지털 리터러시에 관한 고찰
title_en: Une réflexion sur la littératie numérique des apprenants pour l’utilisation de l’IA générative dans l’enseignement de la linguistique française
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 챗GPT; 디지털 리터러시; 인공지능 리터러시; 프랑스 언어학 교육
kw_en: IA générative; ChatGPT; littératie numérique; littératie en intelligence artificielle; enseignement de la linguistique française
abstract_ko: 오늘날 생성형 인공지능은 교육 분야에서 새로운 변화를 가져오고 있다. 현재 프랑스어 교육에서는 인터넷, 유튜브(YouTube) 등과 같은 디지털 도구들이 적극적으로 활용되고 있지만, 챗GPT와 같은 생성형 인공지능은 기존의 디지털 도구와 달리 사전 학습된 데이터를 바탕으로 해서 창조적 글쓰기가 가능하다는 점에서 프랑스어 교육을 넘어서 프랑스 언어학 교육에도 확대 적용될 수 있다. 그렇지만, 생성형 인공지능은 기존의 디지털 도구와 다른 특성이 있어서 교수자와 학습자가 이를 효과적으로 활용하기 위해서는 새로운 디지털 역량이 요구된다. 본 논문은 코퍼스 기반 교육과 챗GPT의 특성을 비교한 후, 프랑스 언어학 교육에서 생성형 인공지능을 효과적으로 활용하기 위해서는 다양한 유형의 디지털 리터러시 능력이 매우 중요하며, 학습자가 챗GPT의 답을 비판적으로 수용하기 위해서는 학습자의 디지털 리터러시 역량을 강화하기 위한 교육이병행되어야 한다는 것을 강조하고자 하였다.
abstract_en: Aujourd’hui, l’intelligence artificielle (IA) générative apporte des changements innovants dans le domaine de l’enseignement. Alors que des outils numériques tels qu’Internet et YouTube sont couramment utilisés en FLE, l’IA générative, dotée d’une capacité à produire des écrits créatifs, peut également être appliquée à l’enseignement de la linguistique française. Toutefois, étant donné que les réponses générées par l’IA générative sont étroitement liées aux problématiques de fiabilité et d’éthique, il est nécessaire d’enseigner aux apprenants à ce sujet. Cet article vise à mettre en lumière l’importance de l’enseignement de cette compétence numérique, littératie numérique, afin que les enseignants et les apprenants puissent utiliser efficacement l’IA générative, notamment dans l’enseignement de la linguistique française. Pour ce faire nous avons, d’abord, comparé les caractéristiques de la méthodologie basée sur le corpus à celle de l’IA générative en vue de l’utilisation des données numériques. Ensuite, nous avons souligné la nécessité de renforcer la formation en matière de littératie numérique, ce qui permet aux apprenants d’appréhender de manière critique les réponses proposées par l’IA générative.

title_ko: 포르투갈어 기계번역 사용에 대한 한국인 학습자의 인식 연구
title_en: A Study on Korean Learners' Perceptions of Using Korean-Portuguese Machine Translation
kw_ko: 포르투갈어; 기계번역; 번역기; 한국인 학습자; 교수-학습전략
kw_en: Portuguese; Machine translation; Translators; Korean learners; Teaching-Learning strategies
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 주요 목적은 포르투갈어를 공부하는 한국인 학습자가 포르투갈어 기계번역에 대하여 어떠한 인식을 가지고 있는지 살펴보고, 이를 통해 교육적으로 고려해야 할 부분을 찾는 것이다. 이를 위해 포르투갈어 전공 대학생들을 대상으로 번역기 사용의 현황, 번역기 사용 만족도, 번역기 사용 필요성 및 번역기 사용의 장단점에 대한 설문조사를 실시하고, 그 내용을 분석하여 포르투갈어 교육에서 교수자와 학습자가 이용 가능한 전략에 대하여 살펴보았다. 학습자들이 가장 많이 사용하는 번역기는 구글 번역이고, 번역기 사용이 학습에 확실히 도움은 되지만, 실력향상으로 이어지지 않을 수 있다는 우려도 표출하였다. 모르는 것, 불확실한 것을 빠르고 간편하게 해결할 수 있다는 점에서 대다수의 학습자들은 번역기 사용이 필요하다고 인식하고 있다. 반면, 학생들은 번역기에 대한 잦은 의존성으로서 인해 실력향상에 저해가 될 수 있고, 부정확한 번역결과에 대처하기 어려울 수도 있다. ‘의존성’과 ‘정확성’, 두 가지 이슈의 양면성에 대하여 학습자들의 올바른 인식과 활용이 요구된다. 기계번역은 시간적, 공간적 환경의 제한 없이 이용가능하다. 사용 편의성과 성능은 이미 학습에 훌륭한 보조 도구 역할을 하고 있다. 하지만 번역의 결과물에 대해선 오류가 있는지 검토하는 과정이 꼭 필요하다. 자신의 작문과 기계번역의 작문을 비교하여 발견되는 오류를 수정하는 과정은 외국어 학습에 매우 도움이 된다. 교수자가 수정된 결과물에 대한 전체적인 피드백을 해주고, 학습자가 그 피드백을 확실하게 습득해 나간다면 효과적인 학습으로 이어질 것이다. 나아가 이런 과정의 반복을 통해 학습자는 좀 더 자기 주도적이고 비판적인 학습자로 성장할 수 있다.
abstract_en: The main purpose of this study is to examine what perceptions of Portuguese machine translation Korean learners of Portuguese have, and to find areas that should be considered in education. To this end, a survey was conducted on university students majoring in Portuguese on the current status of, satisfaction with, necessity of, and advantages and disadvantages of machine translation use. The results were analyzed to examine strategies that teachers and learners can use in Portuguese education. The most commonly used machine translation tool by learners is Google Translate, and although machine translation certainly helps learning, they also expressed concerns that it may not lead to skill improvement. Most learners recognize the need to use machine translation tools because they can quickly and easily resolve things they do not know or are uncertain about. On the other hand, students may have difficulty dealing with inaccurate translation results due to their frequent dependence on machine translation tools, which may hinder their skill improvement. Learners are required to correctly recognize and use the two sides of the two issues of “dependence” and “accuracy”. Machine translation can be used without limitations in time and space. Ease of use and performance are already excellent aids to learning. However, it is essential to review the translation results for errors. The process of comparing your own writing with the machine translation and correcting the errors found is very helpful for learning a foreign language. If the professor provides overall feedback on the corrected results and the learner acquires that feedback, it will lead to effective learning. Furthermore, through repetition of this process, the learner can grow into a more self-directed and critical learner.

title_ko: EFL Students’ Perceptions of ChatGPT Feedback in IELTS Opinion Essays
title_en: EFL Students’ Perceptions of ChatGPT Feedback in IELTS Opinion Essays
kw_en: EFL students; IELTS Opinion Essay; writing; ChatGPT; feedback
abstract_ko: This study investigates Uzbek EFL students’ perceptions of ChatGPT as a tool for IELTS Opinion Essay writing support, and explores the aspects of writing that they perceived as most effectively addressed by feedback from ChatGPT. Given the challenges many candidates face in IELTS writing, this research addresses a critical gap in understanding AI-driven writing support. 26 Uzbek EFL students preparing for IELTS participated in the study. After an introductory session on using ChatGPT with a pre-designed prompt, students wrote IELTS opinion essays, obtained ChatGPT feedback, and completed a survey about their experience. Data were collected through questionnaires and students’ interaction logs with ChatGPT. Participants generally perceived ChatGPT as a valuable tool for IELTS essay writing, particularly in task response, coherence and cohesion, with many recognizing its alignment with IELTS assessment criteria. Students reported increased confidence in their writing and appreciated the immediate, detailed feedback provided by ChatGPT. The study also revealed potential implications for test preparation strategies, suggesting that AI tools could provide targeted support for high-stakes language examinations. These findings suggest that AI-driven tools like ChatGPT, when used with appropriate guidance, can potentially enhance IELTS preparation strategies and support EFL learners in improving their writing skills for highstakes exams.

title_ko: 초등영어교육에 있어 인공지능 도구의 효과성에 관한 문헌 분석
title_en: Analysis of the Literature on the Effects of AI Tools on Elementary English Education
kw_ko: 번역기; 인공지능 도구; 챗봇; 초등영어교육; 펭톡

abstract_ko: 본 논문에서는 초등영어교육에 있어 인공지능 도구의 효과성에 대한 연구의동향을 분석했다. KCI에 등재된 논문을 대상으로 ‘인공지능 도구’ 및 ‘초등영어’ 등의 키워드로 검색하였으며, 최종 분석 대상 29편의 논문을 통해 다음과같은 결론을 얻었다. 첫째, 초등영어교육에 있어 인공지능 도구의 효과에 관한연구는 매년 증가 추세에 있으며 실험 연구는 한 학급을 대상으로 하는 것이가장 일반적이었다. 가장 자주 활용된 인공지능 도구는 펭톡(PengTalk)이었으며발음 능력 향상에 가장 효과가 컸다. 또한 챗봇, 번역기, ChatGPT 등도 초등영어교육의 도구로서 긍정적인 효과를 보였다. 그러나 분석 대상 논문에 나타난적은 실험 참가자의 수, 짧은 실험 기간 등을 고려할 때 인공지능 도구의 효과성을 보다 정확히 검증하기 위해서는 실험 방법의 개선이 필요해 보인다.
abstract_en: This paper analyzed the trends of experimental research on the effectiveness of artificial intelligence (AI) tools in elementary English education. KCI(Korea Citation Index) papers were searched using the key words such as ‘AI tools’ and ‘elementary English education’ to find the appropriate papers for the analysis. The following results were obtained through the analysis of 29 final papers. First, research on the effectiveness of AI tools in elementary education is on the rise every year. The most frequently used AI tool was PengTalk, and chatbots, translators, and ChatGPT were also used. PengTalk was the most effective in improving pronunciation, and it showed positive results for affective factors. The other AI tools were also effective in elementary English education. However, it seems necessary to improve the experimental methods to prove the effectiveness of AI tools on elementary English education in a more objective way.

title_ko: Exploring ChatGPT Literacy in EFL Reading Education
title_en: Exploring ChatGPT Literacy in EFL Reading Education
kw_en: reading; artificial intelligence; English reading; perception; ChatGPT literacy
abstract_ko: This study examined how incorporating ChatGPT in EFL reading classes influences ChatGPT literacy and participants’ perspectives on its usage. The participants included 37 undergraduate students enrolled in a General English course. Students engaged in structured discussions with ChatGPT based on reading materials, focusing on applying concepts, exploring interpretations, and addressing comprehension. Data were collected through pre-and post-surveys, which included open-ended questions about the benefits and limitations of using ChatGPT. Semi-structured interviews were also conducted to gain deeper insights into using ChatGPT. Findings revealed significant improvements across five key literacy dimensions: Technical Proficiency (TP), Critical Evaluation (CE), Communication Proficiency (CP), Creative Application (CA), and Ethical Competence (EC). Interviews indicated that students generally have high trust in ChatGPT, tempered by caution regarding its information accuracy, leading them to employ strategies such as follow-up questioning, query refinement, and cross-referencing with reliable sources. Ethical concerns, including avoiding plagiarism and the responsible use of AI-generated content, were also emphasized. Students viewed ChatGPT as a versatile tool for enhancing comprehension, problem-solving, and supporting academic goals while acknowledging limitations related to reliability and accuracy. Overall, the study demonstrated the importance of critical thinking, ethical awareness, and adaptive strategies in effectively integrating AI tools into EFL education.

journal: The International Journal of Internet, Broadcasting and Communication
title_ko: The Impact of Utilizing AI Chatbots on Elementary English Learners' Willingness to Communicate and Affective Factors
title_en: The Impact of Utilizing AI Chatbots on Elementary English Learners' Willingness to Communicate and Affective Factors
kw_en: AI Chatbots; Willingness to Communicate (WTC); Confidence; Anxiety; Elementary English Learners
abstract_ko: This study investigates the impact of AI chatbot interactions on elementary English learners’ willingness to communicate (WTC), confidence, and anxiety. Conducted with 23 fifth-grade EFL students in South Korea, the research utilized Replika, a text-based chatbot, over a 14-week intervention. Results showed significant improvements in learners' confidence and reductions in anxiety, highlighting the chatbot's potential to create an affectively supportive and engaging environment. However, there was no statistical significance in WTC. Qualitative data indicated that the gamified features motivated learners, while challenges included difficulties in understanding complex chatbot responses. Pedagogical implications emphasize the importance of providing modified and comprehensible input, teacher scaffolding, and multimodal interaction formats to enhance learning outcomes. The findings suggest that while AI chatbots can positively influence affective factors, further research is needed to explore their impact on oral communication and linguistic proficiency.

journal: The International Journal of Internet, Broadcasting and Communication
title_ko: A Systematic Review of Online AI Translation Tools for English Language Learning and Teaching
title_en: A Systematic Review of Online AI Translation Tools for English Language Learning and Teaching
kw_en: Machine Translation; Systematic Review; English Education; AI Translation Tools.
abstract_ko: This study reviews the recent literature of which topic related to the application of machine translation (MT) tools in English education. 26 studies published between 2012 and 2023 are selected and analyzed based on the following criteria: publication years, target learners, language skills, effect variables, educational utilization, types of translation tools, and research methodologies. The key findings reveal that MT tools, such as Google Translate and Naver Papago, are frequently used for reading and writing. While the majority MT studies have involved tertiary-level learners' use and perceptions in MT, little attention has been paid to those of young learners. As for publication years, the result indicates three phases such as early adoption, expansion, and refinement, showing increased integration of AI-based tools into the more recent studies. The study also highlights recent trends regarding the cognitive and affective benefits of MT tools, alongside challenges such as over-reliance and cultural and textual inaccuracies. Implications for optimizing MT tools in English education will be discussed.

title_ko: 일본어 교수 학습의 도구로서 챗GPT의 활용 방법 및 가능성에 관한 고찰- 「비즈니스 일본어」 수업을 중심으로 -
title_en: A Study on the Application Methods and Potential of ChatGPT as a Tool for Japanese Language Teaching and Learning- Focusing on ‘Business Japanese’ Classes -
kw_ko: 비즈니스일본어; 챗GPT; 학습; 수업; 활용방법
kw_en: Business Japanese; ChatGPT; Learning; Class; Application Methods; ビジネス日本語、チャットGPT、学習、授業、活用方法
abstract_ko: 本研究は、生成型AIの代表例であるChatGPTを活用し、「ビジネス日本語」授業における活用可能性を探求し、外国語教育における新たなパラダイムを模索することを目的とした。そのため、ChatGPTが提供する検索、要約、創造的文章の作成、文章検証、エラー検証対象生成、音声対話による会話練習などの機能が、学習過程でどのように活用できるかを具体的に分析した。その結果、ChatGPTは企業調査、自己PR作成、ビジネス場面を想定した会話練習などにおいて、有用な学習ツールとしての可能性が示された。特に、敬語の使用や表現の適切性を練習する過程で実質的なフィードバックを提供し、他のウェブツールと組み合わせることで協力的な学習環境が構築できることが確認された。一方で、ChatGPTには最新情報の反映や個別の文脈処理において限界が見られ、生成された結果物の品質は学習者が作成するプロンプトの質に大きく依存することが明らかになった。今後、これらの限界を補完するための体系的な授業設計や学習効果を定量的に分析する研究が求められる。
abstract_en: This study explores the potential application of ChatGPT, a leading generative AI model, to “Business Japanese” classes and aims to identify new paradigms in foreign language education. To this end, the study specifically analyzed how ChatGPT’s functions-such as search, summarization, creative text generation, text verification, error detection, and conversation practice using voice interaction- could be utilized in the learning process. As a result, ChatGPT demonstrated its potential as a useful learning tool for activities such as corporate research, self-PR preparation, and conversation practice in simulated business scenarios. In particular, it was confirmed that ChatGPT provides substantial feedback in practicing polite language and appropriate expressions, and that combining it with other web tools can help create collaborative learning environments. However, limitations were observed in its ability to incorporate the latest information and handle individual contextual nuances. It was also revealed that the quality of the generated output heavily depends on the clarity and specificity of the prompts created by learners. Future research is required to develop systematic lesson designs and quantitatively analyze the learning outcomes to address these limitations.

title_ko: Automated Evaluation and Feedback of Argumentative Essays Using LLM and Argument Analysis Tool
title_en: Automated Evaluation and Feedback of Argumentative Essays Using LLM and Argument Analysis Tool
kw_ko: 자동 쓰기 평가 시스템; 대형 언어 모델; 랭그래프; 논증 마이닝; 프롬프트 엔지니어링
kw_en: Automated Writing Evaluation (AWE); Large Language Model (LLM); LangGraph; Argument Mining; Prompt Engineering
abstract_ko: This study proposes a novel Automated Writing Evaluation (AWE) system that integrates a fine-tuned DeBERTa model and ChatGPT within the LangGraph framework to enhance the evaluation of argumentative essays. Traditional AWE systems have primarily focused on surface-level features such as grammar and vocabulary, while demonstrating limitations in evaluating the logical structure and depth of argumentative elements. To address these shortcomings, the proposed system leverages DeBERTa for high-accuracy detection of argumentative elements and employs ChatGPT’s flexible learning capabilities for essay classification and feedback generation. The system’s performance was validated through three experiments. The fine-tuned DeBERTa model achieved superior performance in detecting argumentative elements, recording an F1 score of 0.74, while ChatGPT demonstrated strong adaptability in essay type classification, showing higher accuracy in few-shot learning environments compared to zero-shot settings. Furthermore, the feedback generated by the system significantly improved students’ use of argumentative elements, with notable enhancements observed in challenging components such as Counterclaims (+28%) and Rebuttals (+30%). The LangGraph-based approach efficiently manages the dynamic flow of tasks, offering scalability and adaptability across diverse educational contexts. This system makes a substantial contribution to the analysis of argumentative structures and the generation of personalized feedback, highlighting its potential for expansion to various writing genres in the future.
abstract_en: This study proposes a novel Automated Writing Evaluation (AWE) system that integrates a fine-tuned DeBERTa model and ChatGPT within the LangGraph framework to enhance the evaluation of argumentative essays. Traditional AWE systems have primarily focused on surface-level features such as grammar and vocabulary, while demonstrating limitations in evaluating the logical structure and depth of argumentative elements. To address these shortcomings, the proposed system leverages DeBERTa for high-accuracy detection of argumentative elements and employs ChatGPT’s flexible learning capabilities for essay classification and feedback generation. The system’s performance was validated through three experiments. The fine-tuned DeBERTa model achieved superior performance in detecting argumentative elements, recording an F1 score of 0.74, while ChatGPT demonstrated strong adaptability in essay type classification, showing higher accuracy in few-shot learning environments compared to zero-shot settings. Furthermore, the feedback generated by the system significantly improved students’ use of argumentative elements, with notable enhancements observed in challenging components such as Counterclaims (+28%) and Rebuttals (+30%). The LangGraph-based approach efficiently manages the dynamic flow of tasks, offering scalability and adaptability across diverse educational contexts. This system makes a substantial contribution to the analysis of argumentative structures and the generation of personalized feedback, highlighting its potential for expansion to various writing genres in the future.

title_ko: Examining Changes in Korean College Students’ Perceptions Toward ChatGPT Use in their English Class
title_en: Examining Changes in Korean College Students’ Perceptions Toward ChatGPT Use in their English Class
kw_en: Ability to Use ChatGPT; Class Satisfaction; Confidence in English; Korean College Students
abstract_ko: The purpose of this research was to find out how Korean college students’ perceptions of ChatGPT use had changed throughout the semester while they were taking an English speaking class. Specifically, this research attempted to investigate how they viewed the ChatGPT-utilized English speaking class, in terms of class satisfaction, confidence in English speaking, and ability to use ChatGPT. A total of 45 students completed both a pre- and post-survey, and a t-test was employed to see how the students’ perceptions of the ChatGPT use had changed throughout the semester. The results of data analysis indicated that, first of all, there was no statistically significant change in terms of ‘Class satisfaction’ between pre- and post-survey responses. The students’ class satisfaction before and after using ChatGPT was shown to have not changed. Second, only the mean score has slightly increased in terms of ‘Confidence in English speaking’ throughout the semester, and it did not show any significant change. Third, ChatGPT was confirmed to have a statistically significant influence on students’ perceptions toward their ‘Ability to use ChatGPT’ in their learning process of English speaking, which means that the students recognized that they had come to have the ability to use it. From the findings, some pedagogical implications for using AI-utilized tools in the EFL classes were suggested.

title_ko: AI 기반 영어평가 연구의 국내 동향과 과제: 종합연구 관점에서의 분석
title_en: Current trends and future challenges in AI-based English language assessment research: A synthesis study
kw_ko: 인공지능; 자동화; 영어평가; 연구 동향; 종합연구
kw_en: AI; automation; English language assessment; research trend; synthesis study
abstract_ko: Recently, generative artificial intelligence (GAI) systems, such as ChatGPT, is becoming a buzz word in almost every sector of our society. This innovative technology is being widely applied, used, and researched in various contexts of English language education and assessment. The main goals of the current paper are to: (a) investigate the current trends in research and development on AI-based English language assessments by reviewing, and analyzing, recently published research studies in South Korea; and (b) identify a program of research that urgently needs to be conducted to facilitate wide application and effective use of GAI in the field of English language assessment in the South Korean context. Results of analyses show that there were few research studies that attempted to newly develop AI-based, automated English assessment systems or rigorously investigate the reliability and validity of such AI-based assessment systems. Implications of the major findings are also discussed along with some promising avenues of future research.

title_en: A case study on vocabulary and grammar instruction using ChatGPT for English underachievers in elementary school
kw_ko: 초등영어; 학습 부진; 어휘; 문법
kw_en: elementary English; underachiever; vocabulary; grammar
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study is two-fold. One is to explore elementary school students’ experience of learning English vocabulary and grammar to identify problems that cause underachievement in English. The other is to support programs for underachievers in English at elementary school. A qualitative research method was employed for this research, and in-depth, semi-structured interviews were conducted with 6th grade elementary school underachievers. Ten problems were identified as causes of the underachievement in vocabulary and grammar learning. Each interview was recorded, transcribed, and analyzed to find effective ways to solve such problems. It was found that underachievers need support programs that can help them understand grammar on the one hand, and internalize the vocabulary they learn on the other. Furthermore, the study demonstrates that ChatGPT has positive impacts on students’ English achievement and affective domains such as confidence, interest and anxiety in English learning. It is shown that AI relieved the anxiety of the underachievers and gave them confidence by providing them with options when faced with difficulties in class. The results of this study are expected to foster teachers’ deeper understanding when applying digital tools in the elementary school context.

title_ko: AI 기반 학습 도구의 활용이 어휘 학습에 미치는 영향: ChatGPT와 ZEP Quiz를 중심으로
title_en: The Impact of AI-Based Learning Tools on Vocabulary Acquisition: Focusing on ChatGPT and ZEP Quiz.
kw_en: AI-based learning tools; vocabulary acquisition; gamified learning; student engagement; reading comprehension
abstract_ko: This study investigates the impact of AI-based learning tools, ChatGPT and ZEP Quiz, on vocabulary acquisition and reading comprehension in a university-level English reading course. This study employed a single-group pretest-posttest design involving 58 students from diverse academic disciplines. Participants engaged in a 13-week intervention using ChatGPT for personalized vocabulary exercises and contextual learning, while ZEP Quiz provided a gamified environment that fostered repetitive practice and competitive engagement. The pretest and posttest scores revealed a statistically significant improvement in vocabulary and reading comprehension. In addition, survey responses indicated that students experienced increased interest, confidence, and motivation in their learning process. ChatGPT enabled students to grasp the contextual use of words, while ZEP Quiz promoted retention and practical application through participatory learning activities. These findings suggest that AI-based tools can promote gains in vocabulary acquisition and academic performance, as well as enhance affective learning outcomes, offering an effective approach to vocabulary acquisition and student engagement in language learning.

title_en: How to Enhance the Liberal Arts Japanese Language Course Using the 3D Metaverse -Focusing on Analyzing Learner Needs for the S University Speech Contest-
kw_ko: 3D 메타버스; 스페이셜; 교양일본어; 비교과활동; 스피치콘테스트; 학습자 요구 분석
kw_en: 3D Metaverse; Spatial; Liberal Japanese Language Education; Co-Curricular Activities; Speech Contest; Learner Needs Analysis
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 S대 교양일본어 스피치 콘테스트에서 학습자 요구를 분석하고, 3D 메타버스 플랫폼 “스페이셜(Spatial)”을 활용한 비교과 활동의 활성화 가능성을 탐구하였다. 설문조사 결과, 스페이셜 기반 학습 환경이 학습 흥미와 참여를 증진하고, 긍정적인 학습 동기를 부여하는 데 효과적임을 확인하였다. 1학기 파일럿 조사와 2학기 설문조사를 비교한 결과, 학습자들의 참여 동기가 “기타”와 같은 불명확한 이유에서, “새로운 경험을 쌓기 위해” “회화 실력을 향상하기 위해” 등 구체적인 목표로 변화하였다. 또한, 평균 “보통 이상” 응답 비율이 1학기 80.8%에서 2학기 85.1%로 상승하여, 비교과 활동 개선이 학습 동기 형성과 참여 유도에 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤음을 보여주었다. 특히 3D 메타버스 기반 전시실은 학습자들에게 몰입적이고, 창의적인 학습 경험을 제공하며, 스피치 콘테스트 참여에 대한 심리적 장벽을 낮추는 데 기여하였다. 다만, 본 연구는 설문 응답자의 표본 수가 제한적이며, 단기간에 걸친 조사라는 한계를 지닌다. 또한, 메타버스 미활용 집단과의 비교 연구가 이루어지지 않았다는 점에서 향후 연구에서 보완이 필요하다. 따라서 장기적이고 통시적인 연구를 위해 더 큰 표본을 대상으로 한 추가 연구가 요구된다. 본 연구 결과를 바탕으로, 학습자 맞춤형 프로그램 개발, 기술적 접근성 향상, 콘텐츠 다양화, 장기적 평가 체계 구축 등의 개선 방안을 제안하였다. 이를 통해 3D 메타버스 플랫폼 “스페이셜”이 학습자 중심의 비교과 활동 설계에 유용한 도구로 자리 잡을 가능성을 확인하였다.
abstract_en: This study explores the potential of 3D Metaverse-based environments, specifically using the platform"Spatial" to enhance co-curricular activities in liberal Japanese language education, focusing on the S University Speech Contest. The study shows that by looking at what learners want and their experiences from surveys, the Metaverse is effective in increasing engagement, sparking interest in learning, and encouraging positive motivation. A comparison between the first-semester pilot study and the second-semester survey revealed that learners’ motivations shifted from vague reasons such as “other” to specific goals like “gaining experience” and “improving conversational skills.” The percentage of "average or above" responses wentup from 80.8% in the first semester to 85.1% in the second semester. This shows that improvements in co-curricular activities helped boost student motivation and participation. The 3D Metaverse platform "Spatial" was particularly effective in providing immersive and creative learning experiences, reducing psychological barriers to participation in the speech contest. However, this study is limited by the small sample size and the short-term nature of the investigation. Future research should include a larger sample and employ longitudinal analyses for more comprehensive results. The study recommends ways to improve co-curricular activities using 3D Metaverse environments. These include creating programs focused on learners, making them more accessible, offering varied content, and setting up long-term ways to evaluate their effectiveness. These findings demonstrate that the 3D Metaverse, particularly through the platform "Spatial," can serve as a valuable tool for learner-centered co-curricular activity design and contribute to advancing educational practices.

title_en: A study on learners’ perceptions of participation, affective factors, and English proficiency in AI-assisted ‘Reading British and American Literature’ classes

abstract_ko: The purpose of this study is to examine learners’ perceptions of AI-based machine translation (MT) in high school ‘Reading British and American Literature’ classes. This research explored how students perceived the impact of MT on their class participation, learning motivation, confidence in English use, and improvement in English ability. The study also examined how the effectiveness of MT use differed according to students’ English proficiency levels. A total of 153 third-year students participated in a nine-week English literature course. Data were collected through an online survey and statistically analyzed. The findings reveal that students showed positive perceptions regarding class participation, learning motivation, confidence in English use, and improvement in English ability. Notably, participation in the English literature classes using AI-based MT was significantly higher than that in other English classes. Analysis by English proficiency levels showed no significant differences in class participation and affective factors (learning motivation and confidence). However, lower-proficiency learners perceived greater improvement in English proficiency compared to higher-proficiency learners. These results suggest that incorporating AI-based MT in English literature classes can create an inclusive learning environment that supports learners across different proficiency levels, particularly benefiting lower-proficiency students in terms of improvement in English ability.

title_en: Using ChatGPT for Revision in EFL Writing: What College Students Consider During Revision Process
kw_ko: ChatGPT 보조 글쓰기; 글쓰기 수정; 글쓰기 정체성; EFL 글쓰기; 과정 중심 글쓰기
kw_en: ChatGPT-assisted writing; writing revision; writer identity; EFL writing; process writing
abstract_ko: Objectives This study aimed to explore how undergraduate EFL students utilized ChatGPT during the writing re vision process and the factors that influenced their decisions to accept or reject the platform’s suggestions. Methods Sixteen undergraduate freshmen participated in the study. Data were collected from their interactions with ChatGPT while writing their rough drafts to observe how they use ChatGPT and from their final drafts to see what they had actually revised. Additionally, students’ reflective journals and interview excerpts were collected as data and analyzed qualitatively. Results The findings revealed that students used ChatGPT at both macro and micro levels, addressing grammar, vocabulary, coherence, and logical flow. A key factor influencing their decisions to accept or reject suggestions was alignment with their current proficiency level, which ultimately connected to their sense of writer identity. Conclusions In conclusion, the study highlights that undergraduate EFL students’ decisions to accept or reject ChatGPT’s revision suggestions are closely tied to their self-perceived proficiency and writer identity. This under scores the need for further exploration of how AI tools can be effectively integrated into the writing revision proc ess, particularly in ways that support students' development without undermining their autonomy.

title_en: English for Specific Purpose (ESP) with ChatGPT: ESP learners’ reading proficiency and perceptions
kw_ko: 특수목적을 위한 영어; 챗GPT; 영어읽기; 대학생 인식; 무역영어

abstract_ko: This study examined effects of ChatGPT on Korean college students’ business English reading comprehension and their perceptions of the AI tool. Fourteen college students enrolled in a business English course completed ESP reading tasks using ChatGPT as a learning aid over ten weeks. They were asked to take reading tests twice: a pre-test at the beginning of the semester and a post-test at the end of the semester. They also responded to questionnaires designed to measure their perceptions of ChatGPT and their affective satisfaction. Data were analyzed using paired sample t-tests with SPSS 25.0. Results showed that students significantly improved their reading skills over the semester. Furthermore, they regarded ChatGPT as a valuable tool for enhancing their reading proficiency. Most students expressed high levels of satisfaction with ChatGPT in their learning process. These positive effects have meaningful pedagogical implications for ESP teachers and learners, as ChatGPT can effectively support the teaching and learning of field-specific contents.

abstract_ko: This study investigates the impact of utilizing ChatGPT in an extracurricular English newsletter writing course on university students’ writing skills and perceptions. The research was conducted over several months with students from diverse academic backgrounds, focusing on their experiences with ChatGPT for drafting articles. The findings suggest that most participants viewed the use of ChatGPT positively, appreciating its help in improving grammatical accuracy and fostering creative thinking. However, some noted a reliance on the tool that could hinder the development of their English language skills. The study highlights the need for educational strategies that effectively integrate AI tools like ChatGPT without diminishing the learners’ engagement or the educational outcomes. Future research should explore these dynamics across broader contexts to enhance personalized learning experiences and develop more refined educational methodologies.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 2025년 도입 예정인 2022 개정 교육과정 초등학교 영어과 AI 디지털교과서 7종(3-4학년 대상)을 분석하여 교육과정 부합성, 학습 지원, 교사 지원, 기술적 측면을 평가하였다. 분석 결과, AI 디지털교과서들은 2022 개정 교육과정의 목표를 대체로 반영하고 있으나, 표현 영역과 상호작용적 교수 활동의 디지털 환경 구현은 미흡한 것으로 나타났다. AI 기반 평가와 개별화된 피드백 시스템은 우수했지만, 자기 주도적 학습 경로 설정과 멀티미디어 도구 활용은 제한적이었다. 교사 지원 기능은 기본적으로 잘 구현되었으나, 교과서 간 교수학습 자료의 품질과 다양성에 차이가 있었다. 기술적 측면에서는 기기 호환성은 확보되었으나, 사용자 인터페이스의 직관성과 특수교육 대상자 지원은 미흡했다. 분석을 통해 AI 디지털교과서의 지속적인 개선과 발전을 위한 과제를 제시하였다.
abstract_en: This study analyzed seven AI digital textbooks in the English department of elementary schools for 3rd and 4th grades scheduled to be introduced in 2025 and evaluated curriculum conformity, learning support, teacher support, and technical aspects. As a result of the analysis, it was found that AI digital textbooks generally reflected the goals of the 2022 revised curriculum, but the realization of the digital environment of expression areas and interactive teaching activities was insufficient. The AI-based evaluation and individualized feedback system were excellent, but the establishment of self-directed learning paths and the use of multimedia tools were limited. The teacher support function was basically well implemented, but there was a difference in the quality and diversity of teaching and learning materials between textbooks. In terms of technology, device compatibility was secured, but the user interface intuition and support for special education subjects were insufficient. Through the analysis, tasks for continuous improvement and development of AI digital textbooks were presented.
note: AIDT 7종 교과서 자체 분석

title_ko: 중등 예비 영어 교사의 AI 디지털 교과서에 대한 인식 및 요구
title_en: Pre-Service Secondary School Teachers’ Perceptions and Needs Regarding English AI Digital Textbooks
kw_ko: AI 디지털 교과서; 요구; 인식; 교사 개인차; 교사 훈련
kw_en: AI Digital Textbook; needs; perception; individual teacher differences; teacher training
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 영어 교사 훈련을 받은 국내 사범대학 학부생과 교육대학원생을 대상으로 중등 영어 AI 디지털 교과서(AIDT) 의 주요 기능에 대한 요구와 언어 기능 발달에 미치는 도움 정도에 대한 인식을 조사·분석하였다. 자료 수집은 133명을대상으로 한 설문조사를 중심으로 이루어졌다. 분석 결과, 설문 참여자들은 영역별 학습 역량 확인, 오답 노트 작성, 교사가 선택한 맞춤형 콘텐츠 제공, 학습 계획 정보 제공 등 평가와 맞춤형 콘텐츠 제공과 관련된 기능들을 AIDT의주요 필수 요소로 응답하였다. 개인차 변인 분석 결과, AIDT의 필요성과 사용 의도가 높은 집단은 낮은 집단에 비해AIDT의 여러 기능에 대한 요구가 높았으며, AIDT가 언어 세부 능력 발달에 미치는 영향에 대해서도 긍정적인 인식을나타냈다. 설문지 질적 응답 분석 결과, AIDT 도입 및 교실 활용을 위한 실질적 연수 프로그램의 필요성과 교사역할 축소 및 학생의 디지털 기기 중독에 대한 우려가 드러났다. 이러한 결과는 중등 영어 예비 교사 개인차에 따라AIDT에 대한 기대가 다를 수 있음을 보여주며, 개별 예비 교사의 요구와 인식을 반영한 맞춤형 교사 훈련 프로그램의필요성을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study investigates and analyzes the perceptions and needs of undergraduate and graduate students in teacher education programs in South Korea regarding the key features of Secondary English AI Digital Textbooks (AIDT) and their impact on language skill development. Data were collected through a survey of 133 participants. The analysis revealed that participants identified functions related to assessment and personalized content provision,- such as checking learning competencies by skill, creating error logs, providing teacher-selected personalized content, and delivering study plan information -as essential features of AIDT. The analysis of individual difference variables indicated that participants with a higher perceived necessity and intention to use AIDT had greater demands for its features and expressed more positive perceptions of its impact on the development of specific language skills. Qualitative responses to open-ended survey items highlighted the need for practical training programs for the implementation and classroom use of AIDT, alongside concerns about reduced teacher roles and potential student addiction to digital devices. These findings suggest that pre-service secondary English teachers’ expectations of AIDT may vary based on individual differences, emphasizing the importance of developing customized teacher-training programs that reflect the specific needs and perceptions of each teacher candidate.
note: 예비교사 AIDT 인식·요구 조사

title_ko: 비대면 영어학습을 위한 VR기반의 AI 튜터링 서비스 플랫폼 개발
title_en: VR-based AI tutoring service platform for non-face-to-face English learning
kw_ko: 에듀테크; 가상현실; 영어학습; AI 튜터링; 게이미피케이션
kw_en: UI/UX; VR; Interactive Learning; AI Tutoring; Gamification
abstract_ko: 최근 에듀테크 시장의 발전으로 비대면(언택트) 교육에 대한 관심이 높아지고 있다. 교육의 디지털화를 위한 다양한 시도에서 교육에 기술을 접목한 서비스들이 주목받고 있다. 이러한 시대적 환경에서 정보통신기술(ICT)을 접목한 교육 서비스들의 발달로 가상현실, 증강현실, 인공지능 등의 최신 기술들이 다양하게 적용되고 있다. 본 논문에서는 이러한 시대의 흐름에 맞춰 인공지능과 실감형 콘텐츠 VR기술을 활용하여 초등학생용 상황영어를 대화형 UI/UX로 제공하여 학습의 효과를 극대화 시킬 수 있는 튜터링 서비스 플랫폼을 제안한다. 개인별 학습상황 분석 및 통계를 학습자의 분석을 통한 LMS구성하고 음성인식기반 음성인지 및 AI 답변처리를 통해 맞춤형 튜터링 서비스를 제공한다. 이를 통해 교육격차가 심한 교육환경에서의 저학년층에서 학습에 대한 실제감과 몰입감을 느끼고 상황에 맞는 영어학습 콘텐츠 제공이 가능하다.
abstract_en: With recent advancements in the edtech market, interest in untact education is on the rise. Various attempts to digitize education are gaining attention, especially services that integrate technology into learning environments. This paper discusses the use of information and communication technologies in education, highlighting the widespread adoption of cutting-edge technologies such as Virtual Reality, Augmented Reality, and Artificial Intelligence. It proposes a conversational AI-powered VR training service for elementary English language learning. This service aims to enhance learning effectiveness by providing realistic and immersive English language experiences through VR technology and personalized tutoring through AI. Utilizing a learning management system, the service will analyze and track individual learning progress. Through voice recognition and AI response processing, it will offer tailored tutoring services to meet each learner's unique needs. This service has the potential to bridge the educational divide present in many countries, particularly for young learners. By offering immersive and realistic English language learning experiences, it can help learners from diverse backgrounds develop essential skills for success.
note: VR+음성인식 AI 튜터링 초등 상황영어 플랫폼 제안, VR 경계

title_ko: Counselor Education in the Era of ChatGPT and Other Artificial Intelligence-Based Chatbots
title_en: Counselor Education in the Era of ChatGPT and Other Artificial Intelligence-Based Chatbots
authors: Rakesh K. Maurya(University of North Florida); Terence Cavanaugh(University of North Florida)
kw_en: ChatGPT; counselor education; counseling; chatbot; artificial intelligence
abstract_ko: Conversation AI such as ChatGPT is a disruptive technology which will alter the educational landscape. The present article used a self-study research design to evaluate commonly used curriculum-based assessments (CBAs) by counselor educators in light of ChatGPT and other artificial intelligence-based chatbots. The authors propose that these assessments should be modified to better support student learning in the context of AI technology. Moreover, the authors provide recommendations for counselor educators on how to integrate AI into their teaching practices to improve counselors-in-training classroom engagement and learning outcomes. Authors also discussed the current limitations of ChatGPT and other AI-based chatbots.

title_ko: Generational Gap in Accepting AI Integration in Korean EFL Classrooms: Comparing Pre-Service and In-Service Teachers Within Technology Acceptance Model
title_en: Generational Gap in Accepting AI Integration in Korean EFL Classrooms: Comparing Pre-Service and In-Service Teachers Within Technology Acceptance Model
kw_ko: 세대 차이; 인공지능 기반 언어 교수; 기술 수용 모형
kw_en: generational differences; AI-based language teaching; technology acceptance model
abstract_ko: This study explored generational differences in acceptance and use of AI-based language learning technologies among pre-service GenZ and in-service GenX&Y English teachers in Korean EFL (English as a Foreign Language) context. As AI tools like machine translators and ChatGPT become more prevalent in classrooms, understanding how different generational groups perceive and adopt these technologies is crucial for their successful integration. Using a mixed-methods approach with 70 participants, the study analyzed both quantitative and qualitative data. Results indicate that GenZ pre-service teachers are more open to adopting generative AI technologies, recognizing their potential to facilitate personalized learning tailored to individual student needs. However, their enthusiasm was accompanied by concerns about administrative challenges, particularly in managing AI-related tasks. In contrast, GenX&Y in-service teachers showed a more cautious approach, preferring traditional non-generative AI tools such as online translators and grammar-checking applications. They primarily regard AI as a supplementary tool to enhance existing teaching practices, with limited interest in its use for core instructional tasks. Instead, they emphasized its role in post-class tasks, such as grading, assignment management, and providing prompt feedback. These findings highlight the importance of designing generation-specific teacher training programs that address the distinct needs and challenges of each group.

title_ko: EFL학습자의 영작문과 인공지능도구기반 영작문의 특징 비교
title_en: Comparing the Characteristics of English Compositions by Korean EFL College Students and AI Tools
kw_ko: 인공지능 활용 쓰기 지도; ChatGPT 사용; 영어 쓰기; 한국 EFL 대학생; 영어 쓰기 지도
kw_en: AI-Utilized Approach to Writing; ChatGPT Use; English Writing; Korean EFL College Students; Teaching English Writing
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 영어학습자들이 작성한 영어 쓰기 결과물과 인공지능기반 도구가 산출해낸 쓰기 출력물은 각각 어떠한 특징을 나타내고 있는가에 대하여 조사, 분석해보고자 하였다. 구체적으로 영어 쓰기 결과물의 기초적 특성과 글의 명확성 및 정확성 등에 대하여 분석해보고자 하였다. 5명 학생들이 제출한 영어 쓰기 결과물 2편씩(학생 작성 영어 쓰기 결과물과 인공지능생성 영어 쓰기 출력물) 총 10편의 글쓰기 저작물을 분석대상으로 하였다. 수집된 자료는 인공지능기반 글쓰기평가도구(WordCounter, Grammarly 등)를 사용하여 양적 분석하였으며, 양적 분석 결과를 바탕으로글쓰기 결과물을 문장 단위로 질적 분석하였다. 분석 결과, 학생 작성 및 인공지능생성 영어 쓰기 결과물의 기초적 특성에는 큰 차이가 없었으며, 어휘의 다양성 및 깊이 측면에서는 차이를 보였다. 또한, 글의 정확성 측면에서는 학생 작성 영어 쓰기 결과물이 인공지능생성 영어 쓰기 출력물에 비하여 현저하게 많은 오류를 범한 것으로 나타났으며, 명확성 측면에서는 인공지능생성 영어 쓰기 출력물에서는 더 많은 오류가 나타났다. 이와 같은 연구 결과의 도출로부터, 영어학습자를 위한 글쓰기지도 현장에서 인공지능도구들의 실질적인 구현 가능성 등의 교육적 시사점을 제시하였다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study was to find out the characteristics of outputs producedby artificial intelligence-based tools and English compositions written by English learners, interms of general metrics, and accuracy and clarity, respectively. A total of 10 compositions(five students’ English compositions and five artificial intelligence produced outputs) submittedby five students were quantitatively analyzed by using artificial intelligence-based writing evaluation tools such as Wordcounter and Grammarly. In addition, the collected compositionswere compared and qualitatively analyzed sentence by sentence by the researchers. Theresults of the study analysis are as follows: 1) There was no significant difference in thebasic characteristics of the students’ English compositions and artificial intelligence producedoutputs, but the qualitative analysis results at the sentence level showed differences in termsof vocabulary diversity and depth; 2) In terms of accuracy, the students’ English compositionshad significantly more errors than the artificial intelligence produced outputs, and in terms ofclarity, the artificial intelligence produced outputs had more errors. Base on the researchfindings, educational implications for the practical implementation of artificial intelligence toolsin the EFL classroom were suggested.
note: 학습자 영작문 vs AI생성 영작문 특징 비교분석

title_ko: 글쓰기 윤리 실천을 위한 디지털 기반 대학 글쓰기 수업 사례 연구 - 생성형 AI 활용에 대한 인식과 작성물 비교를 중심으로
title_en: A case study of digital-based university writing classes for writing ethics practice － Focusing on awareness of generative AI use and comparison of written works
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 글쓰기 윤리; 설문조사; 과제물 비교; 자기 주체성; 윤리적 실천
kw_en: Generative AI; writing ethics; survey; assignment comparison; self-sovereignty; ethical practice
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 대학 글쓰기 수업에서 글쓰기 윤리 실천 방안을 모색하는데 주안점을 두었다. 쓰기 주체로 대학생들의 글쓰기 윤리에 대한 인식을 설문 조사한 뒤 디지털 기반 글쓰기에서 자신이 쓴 글과 생성형 AI가 만든 글을 비교하여, 글쓰기 윤리의 주체로서 자각을 이끌어 내기 위한 수업 사례 연구이다. 2023년부터 2024년까지 A대학에서 학기마다 글쓰기 윤리 인식 설문조사, 칼럼 쓰기를 진행, 2024년에는 앞선 설문조사를 바탕으로 자신의 글과 생성형 AI가 만들어주는 글을 비교하여 설문에 답하도록 하였다. 생성형 AI 시대에서도 글쓰기의 본질은 자신의 인식과 사유를 문자를 통해 표현하여, 타자와 소통하여 자기 주체성을 정립하는 데 있다고 보았다. 그런 점에서 글쓰기는 글을 쓰는 주체를 반영하는 동시에 주체를 넘어 자기 주체성을 재정립하는 작업이다. 글을 쓰는 도구로써 전자매체의 활용은 전자매체의 매개성과 하이퍼매개를 이용한 즉각적이고 효율적인 방식이 필요하기 때문이다. 글쓰기 윤리에 대한 인식조사에서 학생들은 유사도 검사앱 활용이 증가하였으며, 표절의 원인으로 크게 잘못된 일이 아니라는 인식이 많았으나 해결방안에서 인용과 주석, 참고문헌에 대한 교육이 필요하다는 구체적 실천이 필요하다고 응답하였다. 또한 생성형 AI를 활용하는 글쓰기 주체의 정보 판단력이 있어야 한다고 보았다. 실제 칼럼쓰기 과정에서 인용과 주석 표현, 개요구성과 초고 피드백, 자신의 글과 생성형 AI 글을 비교 검토한 결과 생성형 AI의 장점보다 단순한 정보 전달, 출처 없는 신뢰도의 문제, 의존성의 문제를 인식하게 되었고, 자신이 원하는 글, 자신이 쓴 글이 아니라는 점을 분명하게 인식하고 있었다. 이와 달리 자신의 글에 대한 자존감이 상승하였으며, 생성형 AI를 활용할 때 글쓰기 윤리 방안으로 출처나 인용의 확실한 표기, 자신의 독창성을 중심으로 쓰기, 윤리적 책임감과 비판적 사고가 중요하다고 응답하였다. 글쓰기 윤리는 제재나 벌점보다 글쓰기 주체의 자기 주체성 인식과 윤리적 실천으로 함양될 수 있다.
abstract_en: This study focuses on finding ways to practice writing ethics in college writing classes. It is a case study of a class that aims to elicit self-awareness as a subject of writing ethics by surveying college students’ perception of writing ethics as subjects of writing and comparing their own writing with writing created by generative AI in digital-based writing. From 2023 to 2024, University A conducted a survey on awareness of writing ethics and column writing every semester, and in 2024, based on the previous survey, students answered a survey by comparing their own writing with writing created by generative AI. Even in the era of generative AI, the essence of writing is to establish self-identity by expressing one's own perception and thoughts through letters and communicating with others. In that sense, writing is a task that reflects the subject of the writing and at the same time reestablishes self-identity beyond the subject. This is because the use of electronic media as a writing tool requires an immediate and efficient method that utilizes the mediation and hypermediation of electronic media. In a survey on awareness of writing ethics, students reported that the use of similarity check apps increased, and many recognized that plagiarism was not a major problem, but they responded that specific practices were needed, such as education on citations, annotations, and references in the solution. They also believed that the writer using generative AI should have the ability to judge information. As a result of comparing and reviewing citations and annotations, outline composition and draft feedback, and their own writing and generative AI writing in the actual colAbstract umn writing process, they recognized the advantages of generative AI over simple information delivery, reliability issues without sources, and dependency issues, and they clearly recognized that it was not the writing they wanted or wrote. In contrast, their self-esteem for their own writing increased, and they responded that when using generative AI, clear indication of sources or citations, writing centered on their own originality, ethical responsibility, and critical thinking were important as writing ethics measures. Writing ethics can be fostered through the self-awareness and ethical practice of the writer, rather than sanctions or penalties.
