title_ko: ‘생성형 AI’의 창의적 활용을 통한 글쓰기 교육과정 개발
title_en: Development of a Writing Curriculum Through the Creative Use of ‘Generative AI’
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 글쓰기 교육과정; 과정 중심 평가; 자기주도학습; 성찰학습
kw_en: PBL; Generative AI; Writing Curriculum; Process-based Assessment; Self-directed Learning; Reflective Learning
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 ‘생성형 AI(이하 AI)’가 지닌 학습 도구로서의 잠재력에 주목하며, 이를 대학 글쓰기 교육과 접목하기 위한 구체적인 방안을 모색하는 데 목적이 있다. AI를 단순히 문장 수정이나 형식적 모방을 위한 도구로 사용하는 데 그치지 않고, 연구 과정 전반에서 창의적이고 분석적인 도구로 활용하는 방법을 제안한다. 특히 AI와 상호작용하는 ‘과정 자체’를 ‘학습목표’이자 ‘학습내용’으로 설정하였다. 이를 위해 학습자가 보다 창의적으로 AI를 활용할 수 있도록 다양한 방법을 제시하고, 그 과정에서 도출된 결과물을 비판적으로 수용할 수 있는 교육과정을 설계하였다. 본 교육과정은 ‘AI를 활용한 글쓰기에 관한 인식’을 주제로 충청권의 K 대학 학생들을 대상으로 실시한 설문조사와 대학 글쓰기 강의를 담당하는 교수들을 대상으로 진행한 FGI(Focus Group Interview) 결과를 토대로 구성되었다. 본 교육과정의 핵심은 수업의 전(全) 과정에서 학생들이 AI를 어떻게 활용했는지, 어떤 결과를 얻었는지, 그 과정에서 무엇을 배웠는지 등을 스스로 평가하고 기록할 수 있도록 설계된 ‘자기주도학습(Self- directed learning)’과 ‘성찰학습(Reflective learning)’에 있다. 이는 AI와의 지속적인 상호작용을 강조하며, ‘지식 전달’이라는 전통적인 교수법에서 벗어나 ‘과정 중심’이라는 새로운 교육 패러다임을 실현하려는 시도이다. 이를 통해 학습자들은 AI의 기능과 자신의 역할을 성찰하고, AI가 제시한 결과의 신뢰성과 적절성을 스스로 평가함으로써 비판적 사고 능력을 함양할 수 있을 것이다. 나아가 본 연구는 AI를 활용하는 학습자뿐 아니라, 실제 교육 현장에서 적용 가능한 구체적인 방안을 제시함으로써 교수자들에게도 유용한 자료가 될 수 있으리라 기대한다.
abstract_en: This study focuses on the potential of generative AI (hereinafter referred to as AI) as a learning tool, aiming to explore concrete ways to integrate it into university writing education. The goal is not to use AI merely for sentence correction or formal imitation, but to explore how it can be employed creatively and analytically throughout the research process. The ‘process itself’ of interacting with AI is proposed as both a ‘learning objective’ and ‘learning content.’ To this end, the study suggests various ways to help students use AI more creatively and designs a curriculum that allows them to critically engage with the results produced in the process. The curriculum is based on the results of a survey on ‘attitudes towards writing with AI’ conducted among students at K University in the Chungcheong region and Focus Group Interviews (FGI) with university writing instructors. The core of this curriculum is ‘self-directed learning’ and ‘reflective learning,’ which are designed to allow students to evaluate and record how they have used AI throughout the course, what results they have obtained, and what they have learned in the process. This approach emphasizes continuous interaction with AI and seeks to move away from traditional teaching methods focused on ‘knowledge delivery,’ aiming instead to realize a new educational paradigm centered on ‘the process.’ Through this, students will reflect on both AI's functionality and their own role, critically evaluate the reliability and appropriateness of the results presented by AI, and develop critical thinking skills. Furthermore, this study is expected to provide valuable resources not only for learners using AI but also for instructors by offering concrete strategies that can be applied in real educational settings.
note: 대학 교양 글쓰기 교육과정 개발

title_ko: 미주(Mizou) 챗봇 빌더로 제작한 생성형 AI 챗봇 수업에 대한 학습자 인식 및 영어 학습동기의 상관관계
title_en: A Study of the Correlation between Learner Perception and English Learning Motivation for the Use of Generative AI Chatbot Created with Mizou
kw_ko: 생성형 AI 챗봇; 챗봇 빌더; 영어 학습동기; 학습자 챗봇 상호작용; 자기노출의지
kw_en: Generative AI Chatbot; Chatbot builder; English Learning Motivation; Learner-Chatbot Interaction; Self-Disclosure
abstract_ko: This study investigates the correlation between English learning motivation and secondary students’ perceptions of generative AI chatbot-assisted classes. Conducting with 101 first-year middle school students, the researchers used Mizou, an educational chatbot builder, over two English lessons. Based on a Likert scale survey, quantitative analysis assessed motivation through the L2 Motivational Self-system and Self-determination Theory. In contrast, the qualitative analysis examined chatbot conversations, focusing on self-disclosure and conversation turns per session (CPS). Results showed a positive correlation between learning experience, intrinsic motivation, and confidence in chatbot interaction. However, concerns arose about students’ willingness to continue using and confidence in English, highlighting the need for Korean language support and motivational lesson design. Chatbot conversations also encouraged self-expression, linking language practice to learners' ideal selves. The study underscores AI chatbots’ potential in promoting engagement and identity exploration, suggesting strategies for integrating them into English education to enhance motivation.

title_ko: 인공지능 기반 영작문 보조 도구 QuillBot을 활용한 쓰기 수업이 대학생의 AI 리터러시와 정의적 인식에 미치는 영향
title_en: The Effectiveness of QuillBot in Enhancing AI Literacy and Affective Engagement in Korean EFL College Writing Classes
kw_ko: 인공지능 글쓰기 보조 도구; 인공지능 리터러시; 디지털 리터러시; 인공지능 피드백; 과정중심 글쓰기
kw_en: AI-assisted writing tools; AI literacy; digital literacy; AI-generated feedback; process-oriented writing
abstract_ko: This study aimed to investigate the effectiveness of QuillBot in enhancing both AI literacy and affective engagement among Korean EFL college students in academic writing classes. Twenty students participated in process-oriented writing instruction that incorporated teacher and QuillBot-generated feedback. Quantitative data were collected through background surveys and questionnaires measuring students’ AI literacy, and the analysis was conducted using SPSS. Qualitative data were gathered from open-ended responses, reflective journals, and semi-structured interviews, which were thematically analyzed. The statistical analysis revealed that using QuillBot significantly improved students’ AI literacy competencies, with the greatest enhancement in technology proficiency, followed by information processing, while creative production and digital ethics showed the same level of improvement. Moreover, qualitative analysis revealed that integrating QuillBot into writing classes increased students’ motivation and interest in English composition, reduced their anxiety while enhancing their confidence in writing, and showed their satisfaction with the combined teacher-AI feedback approach. These findings provide pedagogical suggestions for effectively integrating QuillBot into academic writing courses to enhance students’ writing development, digital literacy, and affective engagement.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 작문에 대한 고등학생의 인식 연구
title_en: High School Students' Perceptions of GenAI Writing
kw_ko: 작문 교육; 생성형 AI; 생성형 AI 작문; 챗GPT; 생성형 AI 인식
kw_en: writing education; GenAI; GenAI writing; ChatGPT; GenAI perception
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 AI를 활용한 작문이 고등학교 교육 현장에서 유용하고 안전하게 사용되도록 선행적으로 국내 고등학생들의 실질적인 인식을 연구하였다. 이에, ‘생성형 AI와 교사 협업 기반 작문 피드백’ 수업에 참여한 전체 학생 중 12명을 대상으로 하여 심층 인터뷰를 활용한 질적 연구를 시도하였다. 연구 결과, 생성형 AI 작문 과정에서 AI가 제시하는 즉각적인 피드백이 쓰기 효능감과 자기 조절 학습에 도움이 된다고 평가하였지만, 프롬프트 작성, 신뢰도, 학습 역량 격차 등의 어려움을 지적하였다. 학생들은 이를 보완할 수 있는 인간 평가자인 교사와의 정서적·맥락적 지도가 필수적이라는 인식이 강하였다. 또한, 상위 및 하위 수준의 학생들에 따라 개별 수준을 고려한 교사의 AI 활용 안내 지침이 필요하였다. 이에, 본 연구는 다음을 제언한다. 첫째, 교사가 AI와 협력하여 학생의 작문 수행 과정을 지원하되, 윤리적 의식과 비판적 사고를 함양할 수 있는 교육적 설계를 병행해야 한다. 둘째, 교사와 대면할 수 없는 상황에서 학생들이 주도적으로 작문 과정에서의 문제를 해결할 수 있도록 돕는 도구로 생성형 AI를 활용할 수 있다. 셋째, 교사의 피드백 이전에 학생 스스로 글의 오류를 탐색하여 상위인지를 활성화하고 쓰기 효능감을 높이는 데 활용할 수 있다.
abstract_en: This study examined the perceptions of Korean high school students regarding the usefulness and safe use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) writing in high school. A qualitative study using in-depth interviews was conducted with 12 students who participated in a generative AI writing class. The results showed that immediate feedback in generative AI writing was helpful for writing efficacy and self-regulated learning but pointed out difficulties such as prompt writing, reliability, and learning ability gaps. Students strongly felt that emotional and contextual guidance from teachers, who are human evaluators, was essential. Teachers needed AI-based guidance that considered individual levels depending on the students' upper and lower levels. This study makes the following recommendations: First, teachers should collaborate with AI to support students' writing, while also designing their teaching to foster ethical awareness and critical thinking. Second, when teachers are unable to meet with students, they can use generative AI to help students solve writing problems. Third, before receiving teacher feedback, students can use it to identify errors in their writing to activate higher-order cognition and improve their writing efficacy.
note: 고교생 생성AI 작문 피드백 수업 심층면담, 실증 유지

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능 활용 글쓰기에 대한 예비교사의 인식 - 근거 이론에 의한 탐구
title_en: Pre-Service Teachers' Perceptions of Writing with Generative AI - A Grounded Theory Approach
kw_ko: 인공지능; 챗지피티; 작문; 작문교육; 예비교사; 인식 조사; 패러다임 모형
kw_en: artificial intelligence; ChatGPT; writing; writing education; preservice teacher; Awareness; Paradigm model
abstract_ko: 생성형 인공지능을 작문교육에서 어떻게 활용할 것인지에 대한 논의가 활발한 가운데, 이에 대한 교육 차원의 인식 조사는 많지 않았다. 이 연구는 생성형 인공지능 활용 글쓰기의 진정한 의미를 확인하고 작문교육적 의의를 심층적으로 탐색하기 위한 목적으로, 학습자이자 교수자의 이중 정체성을 지닌 예비교사의 인식에 대한 질적인 탐구를 수행하였다. 이를 위하여 국어교육 전공 예비교사 27명이 직접 한 편의 글을 쓰는 한편, 생성형 인공지능 도구를 활용하여 동일한 과제에 대한 글을 생산하고, 두 과정을 비교 분석하는 자기보고를 작성하였다. 근거이론 및 패러다임 모형에 의거하여 자기보고 및 이들의 글 결과물에 대한 질적 분석이 이루어졌다. 개방 코딩과 축 코딩, 선택 코딩으로 이어지는 일련의 분석 과정을 통해, ‘예비교사들은 GenAI 활용 글쓰기가 인간 글쓰기와 대비하여 지니는 효과를 참여자 간 혹은 참여자 내에서 모순적으로 인식하였으며 작문교육적으로 제한적이고 신중한 적용이 필요하다고 주장함’이라는 핵심 범주를 도출하였다. 이러한 복합적이고 모순적인 인식과 관련하여, 생성형 인공지능 도구가 인간의 글쓰기를 돕는다는 개념을 넘어서서 이 도구가 ‘인간의 글쓰기 능력 향상’을 도울 수 있는지를 더욱 탐구할 필요가 있음을 지적하였으며, 예비교사 교육 및 후속 연구를 위한 별도의 제언들을 제시하였다.
abstract_en: Despite the ongoing discourse on how to utilize generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in writing education, there has been a lack of research on this phenomenon from an educational perspective. This study aims to examine the true meaning of writing using GenAI and explore its pedagogical implications in depth by conducting a qualitative inquiry into the perceptions of pre-service teachers, who embody dual identities as learners and educators. To this end, 27 pre-service Korean language teachers completed two writing tasks: one by composing an essay independently and the other by utilizing GenAI tools to produce an essay on the same topic. Participants also submitted self-reports comparing and analyzing the two processes. A qualitative analysis of the self-reports and written outputs was conducted based on grounded theory and a paradigm model. Through a systematic analytical process—including open, axial, and selective coding—the present study identified a core category: "Pre-service teachers perceived the effects of writing with GenAI in contradictory ways, both across and within participants, as compared to human writing, and emphasized the need for a cautious and limited application of GenAI in writing education." This study highlighted the necessity of exploring whether GenAI tools could transcend merely assisting human writing to actively enhancing human writing abilities.
note: 예비 국어교사 생성AI 글쓰기 자기보고 근거이론 분석

title_ko: AI 시대, 인간 글쓰기의 위상과 글쓰기 교육의 지향
title_en: Status of human writing and direction of writing education in the AI era
kw_ko: 글쓰기; AI(인공지능); 저자성; 향유와 즐거움; 수양과 자기 돌봄; 참여와 실천; 사고력; 쓰기 윤리
kw_en: Writing; Artificial Intelligence(AI); Authorship; Enjoyment and Pleasure; Cultivation and Self-care; Participation and Practice; Thinking; Writing Ethics
abstract_ko: 유창하게 글을 쓰는 AI는, 글쓰기는 무엇인가, 저자는 누구인가, 글쓰기는 인간 또는 AI를 어떻게 형성하는가, 인간의 존재론적 특성과 글쓰기는 어떤 관계가 있는가? 등의 질문을 던진다. 이 연구에서는 이러한 질문에 답하면서 ‘인간 글쓰기의 위상’을 구체화하고, 이에 근거하여 글쓰기 교육의 지향을 제안하였다. AI는 인간 저자, 인간 글쓰기가 무엇인지를 새롭게 인식하도록 요청하는 의미 있는 타자가 되었다. Ⅱ장에서는 저자성, 생각하기, 정동의 측면에서 인간 글쓰기와 AI 글쓰기의 차이를 논의하였다. AI는 인간 글쓰기를 대체할 것이라는 목소리가 커지고 있다. Ⅲ장에서는 인간의 존재론적 특성에 근거하여 인간 글쓰기는 지속되거나 도리어 활성화될 것이라고 보았다. 구체적으로 향유와 즐거움의 글쓰기, 수양과 자기 돌봄으로서의 글쓰기, 참여와 실천으로서의 글쓰기로 나누어 인간 글쓰기의 의의와 쓸모를 규명하고자 하였다. Ⅳ장에서는 Ⅱ장과 Ⅲ장의 논의에 근거하여 글쓰기 교육의 지향에 대하여 논의하였다. 구체적으로 사고의 근력 키우기, 새로운 글쓰기 윤리 감수성 기르기를 제안하였다.
abstract_en: Artificial intelligence(AI) system writes fluently asks questions such as What is writing? Who is the author? How does writing shape humans or AI? What is the relationship between human ontological characteristics and writing? In this study, I would like to specify the status of human writing and propose a direction for writing education. AI has become a meaningful others that calls for a new understanding of what authorship and writing are. In Chapter II, I discuss the differences and relationships between human and AI writing in terms of authorship, thinking, and emotion. Growing evidence suggests that AI will replace human writing. In Chapter III, I argue that human writing will continue or even become more active based on the ontological characteristics of humans. Specifically, I attempt to clarify the significance and usefulness of human writing by dividing it into writing for enjoyment and pleasure, writing as cultivation and self-care, and writing as participation and practice. In Chapter Ⅳ, I focus on the direction of writing education based on the discussions in Chapters II and III. Specifically, I suggest not only the strengthening of thinking power but also the fostering of new ethics in writing.
note: AI시대 인간 글쓰기 위상·교육 지향 논의만, 적용 없음

title_ko: 초등 영어교육에서 메타버스 학습환경이 학습자의 인식 및 인지적·정의적 영역에 미치는 효과
title_en: Effects of a Metaverse Learning Environment on Learners' Perceptions and Cognitive-affective Domains in Elementary English Education
kw_ko: 메타버스; 메타버스의 정의적 효과; 영어 학습; 학습자 변인; 초등영어

abstract_ko: 연구목적: 본 연구는 초등학생을 대상으로 메타버스를 활용한 영어 학습의 효과를 검증하고, 메타버스가 학습자의 정의적 영역에 미치는 영향을 분석하고자 하였다. 연구방법: 본 연구에서는 사전 및 사후 검사를 실시한 후, SPSS를 활용하여 신뢰도를 검증하고 대응 표본 t-검정을 통해 평균 차이를 분석하였다. 또한, 학습자 변인에 대한 기술 통계 분석 및 t-검정을 수행하였으며, 사후 설문 결과와 학업 성취도 간의 관계를 분석하기 위해 회귀 분석을 실시하였다. 아울러, 연구의 신뢰도를 높이기 위해 인터뷰 분석을 병행하였다. 연구결과: 연구 참여자들은 학습 도구로서의 메타버스를 긍정적으로 인식하였으며, 메타버스 학습 후 통계적으로 유의미한 성적 향상이 나타났다. 또한, 정의적 영역에서도 긍정적인 효과가 확인되었다. 그러나 불안감이나 자신감 요인은 성적 향상에 직접적인 영향을 미치지 않는 것으로 확인되었다. 학술적 기여: 본 연구는 메타버스 기반 영어 학습이 학습자의 인지적 성취뿐만 아니라 정의적 측면에서도 긍정적인 영향을 미칠 수 있음을 입증하였다. 이를 통해 메타버스가 효과적인 영어 학습 도구로서 활용될 가능성을 제시하며, 향후 디지털 학습 환경에서의 확장 가능성을 논의하는 데 기여할 것으로 기대된다.
abstract_en: Traditional English teaching, which focused on decontextualized drill and practice, is being replaced by communicative language learning, which emphasizes interaction and communication. In line with this trend, English learning in the metaverse is gaining attention. The present study used a metaverse platform, Spotvirtual, to investigate how a metaverse platform influences students' affective factors and learning outcomes. In this study, 78 EFL elementary school students in Korea participated in the lessons conducted in the metaverse environment for four sessions. A mixed-methods design was used, combining quantitative data, including pre- and posttests and surveys, with qualitative data from student interviews. Results showed that the metaverse environment was effective in improving learning outcomes, stimulating interest, and facilitating language learning. The study further investigated which affective factors (motivation, interest, self-efficacy, confidence, anxiety) significantly influenced learning outcomes. While motivation, interest, and self-efficacy positively influenced learning outcomes, confidence and anxiety did not have a significant effect. Based on these findings, the present study suggests pedagogical implications for L2 classes in primary education.

title_en: The Influence of Digital Literacy Competence on EduTech Adoption in AI-Based Learning: The Mediating Role of Self-Directed Learning Competence
kw_en: digital literacy competence; self-directed learning competence; EduTech intention to adopt EduTech; AI-based learning environment
abstract_ko: This study confirms the effect of high school students’ digital literacy competence on their intention to use EduTech in AI-based learning environments, with a particular focus on the mediating role of self-directed learning competence, as emphasized in the 2022 revised curriculum. Data from 308 vocational high school students were analyzed using statistical methods, including Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) and bootstrapping. Results indicate significant positive correlations among digital literacy, self-directed learning competence, and the intention to adopt EduTech. The study emphasizes the significant role of self-directed learning competence as a mediating factor in the relationship between digital literacy competence and the intention to adopt EduTech. The findings suggest that fostering self-directed learning is crucial for enhancing students’ adaptability and effective use of technology in AI-based learning environments.

title_en: The Effects of AI-Assisted English Reading Aloud Activities on Middle School Students’ English Proficiency and Affective Factors
kw_ko: 소리내어 읽기; 영어 유창성; 정의적 요인; 영어 학업 성취도; AI 기반 읽기 활동
kw_en: read aloud; English fluency; affective factors; English achievement; AI-based reading program
abstract_ko: This study investigated the effect of English reading activities on English achievement, fluency, and affective factors among 26 third-grade English learners in Korean middle schools. Microsoft Teams’ Reading Progress, an AI-based tool, was used to provide English text appropriate to the learner’s level for English reading activities, and the AI ​​pronunciation analysis results provided by the program are used for individual analysis. First, regarding the effects of reading English aloud on students’ achievement showed significant results in the listening and reading skills. The significant results shown in the low and middle groups suggest that English reading classes are helpful in many areas in the English achievement of low-achieving students. Regarding the effect of English reading aloud on the reading fluency of students across different proficiency levels, it has been shown to consistently improve the fluency of students in the upper, middle, and lower groups. Lastly, looking at the change trends in affective factors, it can be seen that all factors have steadily increased little by little, but not indicating the significant effect of reading English aloud on affective factors. This study found that reading aloud in English not only has a great effect on reading comprehension, but also allows students to discover the joy of reading.

title_ko: Impact of ChatGPT-Assisted Self-Assessment on L2 Writing Development
title_en: Impact of ChatGPT-Assisted Self-Assessment on L2 Writing Development
kw_ko: 챗지피티 (ChatGPT); 자기평가; 영어 (L2) 글쓰기; 글쓰기 능력; 자동 쓰기 평가 시스템 (AWE)
kw_en: ChatGPT; Self-assessment; Second language (L2) writing; Writing proficiency; Automated writing evaluation (AWE).
abstract_ko: This paper examines the impact of using ChatGPT on improving second language (L2) writing skills through self-assessment within a structured revision process. A total of 114 university students enrolled in an academic writing course participated in the study and evaluated their performance in multiple writing tasks. Using a quantitative research methodology, writing samples collected before and after the incorporation of ChatGPT-assisted feedback in four essay tasks were analyzed. The findings indicate that integrating ChatGPT into the writing process facilitates significant improvements in grammar, vocabulary, content, and coherence, demonstrating its effectiveness as a complementary tool in L2 instruction. The comprehensive revisions with ChatGPT helped students fully understand the feedback and encouraged them to apply the insights independently during the review phase, fostering deeper engagement with their writing. These results suggest that ChatGPT not only improves writing quality but also promotes self-assessment and learner autonomy, thereby contributing to a more holistic approach that complements time-constrained, teacher-led instruction in L2 classes.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 시대의 창의성과 프롬프트 리터러시
title_en: Creativity in the Era of Generative AI and Prompt Literacy
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 챗GPT; 프롬프트 리터러시; 창의성 교육; 분산적 창의성
kw_en: Generative AI; ChatGPT; prompt literacy; creativity education; distributed creativity
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 챗GPT로 대표되는 거대 언어 모델(LLMs) 기반의 생성형 AI가 리터러시와 소통의 변화를 이끄는 시대에 국어교육에서 창의성 교육이 나아갈 방향을 탐색하고자 하였다. 이를 위해 국어과에서의 창의성 교육을 다룬 선행연구의 흐름을 고찰하고, 역량 중심 교육과정에서 창의성을 다루고 있는 양상을 살폈다. 또한 생성형 AI를 둘러싼 창의성 담론을 비판적으로 검토하고, 인간과 생성형 AI가 협업을 통해 창의성을 구현할 가능성을 탐색하였다. 리터러시 실천의 관점에서 이를 ‘인간과 생성형 AI의 협력적 의미구성’으로서 ‘프롬프트 리터러시’로 개념화하고, 그 구체적인 실천의 양상을 Glăveanu의 분산적 창의성(distributed creativity) 프레임워크를 준용하여 분석하였다. 이상의 연구 결과를 바탕으로, 프롬프트 리터러시를 중심으로 창의성 교육의 방향과 내용에 대한 시사점을 제시하였다.
abstract_en: This study explored the direction of creativity in Korean language education within the context of generative AI, represented by large language models like ChatGPT. This study examined trends in previous research on creativity in Korean language education and critically reviewed discourses on creativity related to generative AI. From the perspective of literacy practices, this collaboration is conceptualized as “prompt literacy,” defined as the “collaborative meaning-making between humans and generative AI.” The specific practices of prompt literacy were analyzed using Glăveanu’s framework of distributed creativity. Based on these findings, the study offers implications for the direction and content of research centered on prompt literacy.

title_ko: Profiling and Understanding EFL University Students' Purposes for Using ChatGPT: A Latent Profile Analysis
title_en: Profiling and Understanding EFL University Students' Purposes for Using ChatGPT: A Latent Profile Analysis
kw_en: ChatGPT; Latent profile analysis (LPA); ChatGPT purpose profile; ChatGPT usage; University students; ChatGPT-integrated language learning
abstract_ko: This study aims to identify distinct profiles, or groups among Korean EFL university students based on their purposes for using ChatGPT and to explore the effects of gender, academic discipline, and English self-efficacy on these profiles. Additionally, it examines how these profile types influence ChatGPT acceptance. A quantitative approach was employed, involving data collection through an online survey. A total of 400 valid responses were analyzed using latent profile analysis (LPA), Chi-square tests, and One-Way ANOVA. The findings of the study are presented as follows: First, five distinct profiles were identified: “Active Users,” “Passive Users,” “Input/Output Seekers,” “Comprehensive Active Users,” and “Translation-Focused Users.” Second, gender did not significantly influence profile type, whereas academic discipline and English self-efficacy did. Third, significant differences were observed in learners' perceived usefulness, ease of use, and intention to continue using ChatGPT based on their profile type. These findings emphasize the importance of tailoring educational interventions to user profiles to enhance the acceptance and effective use of ChatGPT in English language teaching and learning.

title_ko: A Comparative Study of ChatGPT Feedback and Teacher Feedback in Middle School English Writing Classes
title_en: A Comparative Study of ChatGPT Feedback and Teacher Feedback in Middle School English Writing Classes
kw_en: ChatGPT feedback; teacher feedback; English writing; middle school; EFL contexts
abstract_ko: This paper focuses on comparing the effectiveness of AI-based feedback from ChatGPT with traditional teacher feedback in improving middle school students’ English writing skills. Using pre- and post-writing assessments, pre- and post-surveys, and a small number of focus group interviews, this study evaluates writing score improvements and analyzed students’ perceptions regarding the experience of ChatGPT feedback. The results indicate that while both groups showed writing improvement, the group receiving ChatGPT feedback had slightly higher writing scores than the teacher feedback group. However, both groups acknowledged the difficulty of writing and the necessity of receiving feedback. The results from post-survey and interviews revealed that students in both groups held positive perceptions regarding motivation, confidence, and overall satisfaction with writing through both feedbacks. However, the teacher feedback group exhibited slightly higher positive attitudes overall. The most appreciated aspects of ChatGPT feedback were convenience and immediacy. Additionally, students expressed a preference for combining both ChatGPT and teacher feedback rather than relying on just one source. This research significantly contributes to the field by addressing the gap in comparative studies on applying AI feedback in middle school English writing education.

title_ko: 대학 교양 토익 수업에서 ChatGPT 활용의 학습 효과 및 학습자 인식 분석: 학습자 활동분석을 중심으로
title_en: Analysis of the learning effects and learner perceptions of ChatGPT use in a college TOEIC course: Focusing on learning activity patterns
kw_ko: 대학 영어; 토익; 학습자 인식; 프롬프트 리터러시; ChatGPT 학습 활동 분석
kw_en: ChatGPT; college English; TOEIC; learner perception; prompt literacy; ChatGPT-based learning activity analysis
abstract_ko: This study examined the effectiveness of ChatGPT-based learning and students’ perceptions in acollege English course. A 9-week experiment was conducted with 42 students in the experimentalgroup using ChatGPT-3.5 and 40 in the comparison group without ChatGPT. The study analyzed pre and post-test scores and student survey responses. While the experimental group showed significantimprovement, no statistically significant difference was found between the two groups. ChatGPTactivities were classified into five types: answer checking, question generation, explanation,translation, and follow-up questioning. Among these, 70% involved basic functions, while 30%utilized dynamic interactive features. Higher satisfaction was reported for dynamic interactions likequestion generation. Despite occasional hallucinations, students expressed overall satisfaction andwillingness to continue using ChatGPT. To improve ChatGPT-based learning, three strategies aresuggested: increasing participation, enhancing activity quality, and implementing prompt literacyeducation. First, instructors can promote active participation by setting minimum interactionrequirements. Second, encouraging dynamic features, such as question generation and follow-upquestioning, can deepen learning engagement. Lastly, prompt literacy education is crucial foroptimizing AI-assisted learning. Providing structured guidance and refining prompts can helpstudents maximize ChatGPT’s potential.

title_en: Exploring the feasibility of automated scoring using generative AI in elementary English writing
kw_ko: 자동채점; 생성형 인공지능; 채점자 신뢰도; 구성형 문항 검사; 초등영어교육
kw_en: automated scoring; generative AI; rater reliability; constructed response item test; elementary English education
abstract_ko: This study explores the feasibility of automated scoring using generative AI (ChatGPT, Claude, and WorkAI) in an elementary English writing assessment. Essays from 87 elementary school students for English essay contest were analyzed using intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC) to examine agreement levels between human raters, among generative AI models, and between human raters and generative AI models. The results are as follows: (1) Agreement between human raters was generally high, but differences were observed in Item 2, particularly in the 'organization' criterion. (2) Agreement among generative AI models was good overall, with lenient scoring resulting in higher agreement for 'content,' 'organization,' and 'total score,' while stricter scoring worked better for 'accuracy' and 'range & mechanics.' (3) Agreement between human raters and generative AI models ranged from moderate to high. Stricter scoring produced higher agreement for Item 1 across all criteria, while lenient scoring worked better for 'content' and 'organization' in Item 2. These findings suggest that generative AI has potential as an automated scoring tool. Adjusting rater tendencies based on tasks and criteria allows generative AI to reflect human scoring patterns, supporting its use as a complementary tool in educational assessment.

title_en: Investigating pre-service elementary teachers' competencies in utilizing generative artificial intelligence technology for English instruction
kw_ko: 생성형인공지능; 에듀테크; 초등교사교육; 디지털 매체
kw_en: generative artificial intelligence; EdTech; elementary teacher training; digital media
abstract_ko: This study examines the implementation and outcomes of a four-week project-based learning (PBL) program designed to enhance participants’ understanding of generative AI tools and their application in teaching English to elementary-level students. Through hands-on engagement, 62 pre-service teachers explored various AI-driven technologies and integrated them into the development of innovative teaching materials. Specifically, participants created instructional video materials for teaching receptive skills using generative AI technologies and provided reflections on their experiences and perceptions of AI integration. The findings indicate that most pre-service teachers had limited prior experience in designing English teaching materials using digital tools. However, after participating in the program, they perceived a significant improvement in their digital competence and AI application skills. The results confirm that their self-assessed ability to develop and utilize AI-powered digital media significantly increased after participating in this study. Furthermore, this enhancement in digital technology competence was consistent across genders, with no significant differences observed. Among the generative AI tools used in the program, pre-service teachers found AI-powered music generation tools (e.g., Suno) and video creation tools (e.g., Vrew and Canva) to be the most beneficial for developing English instructional materials.

title_ko: Investigating ChatGPT’s phonology problem-solving abilities through reasoning with varying custom instructions
title_en: Investigating ChatGPT’s phonology problem-solving abilities through reasoning with varying custom instructions
kw_en: ChatGPT-4; ChatGPT-4o; phonology; reasoning; custom instructions
abstract_ko: In this paper, we investigate ChatGPT’s ability to solve phonological problems with varying custom instructions. It is known that ChatGPT has difficulty solving unfamiliar novel problems, and phonology provides a good test case for evaluating its reasoning abilities when faced with such challenges. We designed phonological problems using data or rules that are not observed in the phonology literature. We varied model versions (GPT-4 and GPT-4o) and custom instructions by varying the levels of knowledge: no custom instructions, beginner(‘Student’), and expert (‘Professor’) levels. Four novel questions were created by modifying the following phonological data: (1) Korean fricative palatalization, (2)Spanish intervocalic lenition, (3) Rule ordering in Canadian English, and (4) English syllabification. ChatGPT exhibits some level of reasoning capabilities, with test scores ranging from 27% to 75%. GPT-4o performed better than GPT-4. However, it made errors when dealing with novel patterns or rules. The effects of varying custom instructions were present but less clear and inconsistent. Our results suggest that,depending on the model version and customization, GPT can learn phonologically unnatural processes through reasoning.

title_ko: 챗GPT 일본어 수업 활용에 대한 대학교수 인식 연구
title_en: A Study on University Professors' Perceptions of ChatGPT Utilization in Japanese Language Teaching
kw_ko: 챗GPT; AI 활용; 일본어교육; 인식조사
kw_en: ChatGPT; AI-based Education; Japanese Language Education; Awareness Survey
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 대학에서 일본어를 가르치는 교수 및 강사 40명을 대상으로 챗GPT 활용에 대한 인식과 수업 활용 의지를 조사하였다. 연구 결과, 일본어 교수자들은 AI 활용 교육의 필요성에 공감하면서도, 실제 수업에서의 사용 경험은 타 교과에 비해 낮은 편이었다. 그러나 37.5%의 교수자는 챗GPT를 거의 매일 활용하며, 단순한 정보 검색을 넘어 작업 지원 및 수업 활동에 활용하여 높은 만족도를 보였다. 반면 절반 정도는 챗GPT 활용에 적극적이지 않았으며, 12.5%는 거의 사용하지 않는 등 양극화된 양상을 보였다. 수업에서 챗GPT를 활용하지 않는 주요 이유로는 저작권 문제 및 결과 신뢰성에 대한 우려뿐만 아니라, 외국어 학습의 특성상 학생들의 창의적인 문장 구성 능력이 저하될 가능성이 지적되었다. 또한 많은 교수자가 챗GPT를 수업에 활용하고 싶어 하지만, 구체적인 활용법이나 수업과의 융합 방법을 알지 못해 어려움을 겪고 있었다. 특히 챗GPT를 일본어 수업에 활용할 의사는 챗GPT 평소 사용 경험, 사용 빈도, 그리고 AI 활용교육 수강 여부에 영향을 받는 것으로 나타났다. 따라서 효과적인 AI 활용 수업을 위해서는 교수자 대상 챗GPT 등 AI 활용교육을 강화하고, 일본어 및 일본문화 수업에서의 구체적인 활용 가이드라인을 개발할 필요가 있다. 또한 다양한 교과목과 융합된 챗GPT 활용 사례를 적극적으로 공유하여, 학생들의 챗GPT 활용 경험과 학습 효과를 분석하고, AI 기반 일본어 교육의 실효성을 높이는 방안을 모색해야 한다.
abstract_en: This study surveyed 40 university professors and lecturers teaching Japanese language courses to explore their perceptions and willingness to use ChatGPT in their classes. While most instructors acknowledged the importance of integrating AI into education, the usage rate of ChatGPT in their courses was lower compared to other subjects. Nonetheless, 37.5% of instructors reported using ChatGPT almost daily--not just for ‘information searches’ but for ‘task support’ and ‘class activities,’-and expressed high levels of satisfaction. However, about half of the instructors were not proactive in using ChatGPT, and 12.5% rarely used it, indicating a polarized response. Concerns regarding the integration of ChatGPT into the classroom included copyright issues doubts about its accuracy, and fears that it might hinder students' creativity, especially in language learning, where independent sentence construction is encouraged. While many instructors showed interest in using ChatGPT, they lacked clear ideas on how to integrate it into their teaching. The study found that instructors' experience with ChatGPT and related training significantly influenced their willingness to adopt it in their teaching. To enhance AI-based education in Japanese language courses, it is essential to provide more instructor training, establish clear guidelines for ChatGPT usage in language and culture courses and share practical examples. By analyzing students' experiences with ChatGPT, educators can better assess and improve the effectiveness of AI-based language education.

title_ko: 독일어 L2 학습자의 추상적 개념의 인지처리 – 행동 실험으로 본 인공지능 시대의 독일어 교육
title_en: Kognitive Verarbeitung abstrakter Konzepte bei L2-Lernenden im Deutschen – Deutsch als Fremdsprache im Zeitalter der Künstlichen Intelligenz im Rahmen einer verhaltenswissenschaftlichen Untersuchung
kw_ko: 독일어 L2 학습자; 추상 동사; 구체 동사; 의미적 차이 분석법; 독일어 교육
kw_en: L2-Lernende; abstrakte Verben; konkrete Verben; semantisches Differential; DaF-Unterricht
abstract_ko: 최근 인공지능(AI)의 발전으로 인간의 언어 인지 과정을 모방하는 기술이 활발히 연구되고 있다. 특히, 인간이 언어를 어떻게 인지하고 처리하는지 이해하는 것은 AI 기반 언어 모델의 개발에도 중요한 기여를 할 수 있다. 추상 개념과 구체 개념 간의 차이는 인지 언어학 및 신경과학의 관점에서도 중요한 논의의 주제가 되고 있다. 구체적 개념은 보다 명확한 감각적, 운동적 및 사회적 경험과 연관되어 있어 뇌에서 빠르게 처리되며, 강한 신경 연결을 형성한다. 반면, 추상적 개념의 이해는 개인의 경험과 인지적 맥락과 깊게 연관되어 있다는 점에서 다층적이고 복합적인 특성을 지닌다. 본 연구는 추상 동사와 구체 동사의 인지처리를 분석하고, 그 과정에 있어서 모국어 화자와 L2 학습자 간의 차이를 조사하였다. 실험 결과, 구체 동사가 더 높은 구상성(이미지 구체성)을 가지는 것으로 나타났다. 그럼에도 추상 동사도 구체적인 요소를 활용하여 개념을 떠올린다는 사실을 확인할 수 있었다. 본 연구는 언어 인지의 복잡성을 이해하고, 다양한 언어 간의 의미적 차이를 분석하는데 기여할 수 있으며, 이는 독일어 교육에서 활용될 수 있을 것으로 기대한다.
abstract_en: Die jüngsten Fortschritte im Bereich der Künstlichen Intelligenz (KI) haben zu intensiven Forschungen geführt, die darauf abzielen, die sprachlichen Wahrnehmungsprozesse des Menschen nachzubilden. Ein tiefgehendes Verständnis darüber, wie Menschen Sprache erfassen und verarbeiten, kann einen bedeutenden Beitrag zur Entwicklung von KI-basierten Sprachmodellen leisten. Der Unterschied zwischen abstrakten und konkreten Konzepten ist ein wichtiges Diskussionsthema in der kognitiven Linguistik und den Neurowissenschaften. Konkrete Konzepte sind mit konkreten sensorischen, motorischen und sozialen Erfahrungen verbunden, was zu einer schnelleren Verarbeitung im Gehirn führt und starke neuronale Verbindungen bildet. Im Gegensatz dazu ist das Verständnis abstrakter Konzepte eng mit den individuellen Erfahrungen und dem kognitiven Kontext verknüpft, was ihnen mehrschichtige und komplexe Eigenschaften verleiht. Diese Studie analysiert die kognitive Verarbeitung von abstrakten Verben und konkreten Verben und untersucht die Unterschiede zwischen Muttersprachlern und L2-Lernenden. Die experimentellen Ergebnisse zeigen, dass konkrete Verben eine höhere Bildhaftigkeit aufweisen. Dennoch konnte festgestellt werden, dass auch abstrakte Verben konkrete Elemente nutzen, um Konzepte zu aktivieren. Die Ergebnisse der Studie könnten dazu beitragen, die semantischen Unterschiede zwischen verschiedenen Sprachen zu analysieren und so wertvolle Erkenntnisse für den DaF-Unterricht zu liefern.
note: 독일어 L2 학습자 추상개념 인지처리, AI는 배경

title_ko: 수능 국어 영역에서 ChatGPT의 문법 능력에 대한 연구: 2022~2025년 ‘언어와 매체’를 중심으로
title_en: A Study on ChatGPT’s Grammatical Competence in the CSAT Korean Language Section: Focusing on ‘Language and Media’ from 2022 to 2025
kw_ko: 대학수학능력시험; 언어와 매체; 문법 능력; 문법 평가; 생성형 인공지능; 챗지피티
kw_en: College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT); Language and Media; Grammatical Competence; Grammar Assessment; Generative Artificial Intelligence; ChatGPT
abstract_ko: This study analyzed the problem-solving results and error patterns of grammar questions presented from 2022 to 2025 to examine ChatGPT's grammatical competence. As a result, ChatGPT demonstrated strengths in integrated questions and those related to conceptual and factual understanding. However, due to data recognition errors, it failed to answer questions on the history of the Korean language. Additionally, it exhibited errors in phonological variation phenomena, microscopic analysis of linguistic units, and the application of semantic or pragmatic concepts. Furthermore, issues such as hallucinations and insufficient condition exploration were observed. Therefore, performance improvement through technological advancement is required. In addition, it is necessary to identify the principles of Korean grammatical competence and sufficiently train or fine-tune ChatGPT with learning data based on those principles. In addition, when utilizing ChatGPT’s grammatical competence, it is important to critically review the initially generated answers and follow up with additional questioning as needed.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 통한 대학에서의 요약 글쓰기의 활용 방안
title_en: Utilizing ChatGPT for Summarization Writing in Higher Education
kw_ko: 요약하기; 사용 매뉴얼; 활용 방안; 비판적 사고
kw_en: ChatGPT; Summarization; Guidelines; Applications; Critical thinking
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 대학 글쓰기 교육에서 ChatGPT를 활용한 요약 글쓰기의 효과와 활용 방안을 탐색하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 요약은 단순한 정보 축약이 아니라 텍스트의 핵심 정보를 선택하고 조직하는 고차원적 인지 활동으로, 비판적 사고 및 논리적 구성을 강화하는 데 중요한 전략이 된다. 최근에는 ChatGPT와 같은 생성형 인공지능 도구가 대량의 텍스트를 신속하게 요약할 수 있는 능력을 갖추면서, 교육 현장에서의 활용 가능성이 주목받고 있다. 이에 본 연구는 ChatGPT가 생성한 요약문과 학생들이 직접 작성한 요약을 비교·분석하여 정확성, 논리적 구조, 표현력 등의 차이를 규명하고자 하였다. 연구 결과, 학생들의 요약문에서는 핵심 개념의 누락이나 논리적 전개의 도약 현상이 다수 관찰되었으나, 이러한 결과는 역설적으로 ChatGPT와의 비교를 통해 학습자들이 자신의 문제의식을 점검하고 성찰하는 메타인지적 기회를 가질 수 있음을 시사한다. 이를 바탕으로 본 연구는 ChatGPT를 요약 교육의 보조 도구로 활용하면서도 학습자들이 비판적 사고를 기를 수 있도록 하는 교육적 접근법을 제안하고자 하였다. 아울러 ChatGPT를 효과적으로 활용하기 위한 가이드라인을 제시하고, 요약 글쓰기 수업에서 ChatGPT의 역할과 윤리적 고려사항을 교육하는 방안을 논의하였다.
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the effects and applications of using ChatGPT for summarization in academic writing education at the university level. Summarization is not merely a reduction of information but a higher-order cognitive activity that involves selecting and organizing key information from a text, serving as a crucial strategy for enhancing critical thinking and logical composition. With the recent advancements in AI tools like ChatGPT, which can rapidly generate summaries of large volumes of text, their potential applications in education have been increasing. Therefore, this study compares and analyzes the summaries generated by ChatGPT and those written by students to examine differences in accuracy, logical structure, and expressiveness. The findings indicate that while ChatGPT excels in accuracy and logical coherence, students demonstrate strengths in creativity and critical thinking. Notably, students’ summaries often lacked key concepts and exhibited somewhat fragmented logical flow. In contrast, ChatGPT’s summaries maintained a consistent logical structure but lacked creative expression. Based on these findings, this study proposes an educational approach that integrates ChatGPT as a supplementary tool for summarization training while fostering students’ critical thinking skills. It also discusses guidelines for the effective use of ChatGPT, the role of AI in summarization instruction, and ethical considerations in AI-assisted academic writing.
note: 대학 글쓰기 요약 교육

title_ko: 머신러닝 기법을 활용한 중학생의 영어과목 학업성취 예측 및 주요 요인 탐색
title_en: Predicting Middle School Students' English Academic Achievement and Exploring Key Factors Using Machine Learning Techniques
kw_ko: 머신러닝; 학업성취 예측; 학업성취 주요 예측요인; 서포트벡터머신; 의사결정나무
kw_en: Machine Learning; Prediction of Academic Achievement; Key Predictive Factors; Support Vector Machine; Decision Tree
abstract_ko: 목적 본 연구에서는 다양한 머신러닝 기법들로 중학생의 영어교과 학업성취를 예측하고, 주요 예측요인들을 상대적 중요도를 탐색하여 학년별로 비교⋅분석하였다. 방법 이를 위하여 최근접이웃기법(KNN), 의사결정나무(C5.0), 랜덤포레스트(RF), 서포트벡터머신(SVM), 신경망(NNET) 등의머신러닝 기법을 활용하여, 학년별로 기법별 예측력을 비교 및 분석하고, 주요한 예측요인들을 파악하고자 하였다. 학업성취를 학년별로 비교하기 위하여 영어과목 수직척도점수를 활용하였고, 학업성취를 예측하기 위한 요인은 개인수준, 가정수준, 그리고 학교수준으로 나누어 살펴보았다. 이를 위하여 경기교육종단연구(GEPS) 중학교 자료를 사용하였고, 데이터정제를 통해 중학교 1학년499명, 중학교 2학년 486명, 그리고 중학교 3학년 457명을 분석에 투입하였다. 또한 중학생의 학업성취 예측을 위하여 학생수준394개, 가정수준 45개, 학교수준 106개의 요인을 투입하여 결과를 비교 및 분석 하였다. 결과 연구 결과를 살펴보면 중학교 1⋅2학년에서는 서포트벡터머신(SVM), 3학년에서는 의사결정나무(C5.0)이 가장 높은 예측성능을 보였다. 또한, 학업 성취의 주요 예측 요인을 분석한 결과, 모든 학년에서 ‘직전 학년 영어 성적’, ‘영어 수업 이해도’, ‘영어교과 효능감’, ‘학습 태도’가 중요한 영향 요인으로 확인되었다. 반면, 부모 학력이나 가구 소득과 같은 가정 환경 요인의 영향력은상대적으로 낮은 경향을 보였다. 특히, 학년이 올라갈수록 학교 환경 요인(학교 만족도, 학급 분위기 등)의 중요성이 점진적으로 증가하는 패턴이 나타났다. 결론 본 연구에서는 여러 머신러닝 기법을 활용하여 중학교 학생의 학년별 영어 과목 학업 성취를 예측하고, 주요 예측 요인을 비교⋅ 분석하였다. 또한, 다양한 머신러닝 기법을 비교하여 학년별 최적의 예측 모델을 확인하고, 학업 성취의 주요 영향 요인을 도출하였다. 이러한 연구 결과는 향후 수준별 맞춤형 학습 지원의 기초 자료로 활용될 수 있으며, 개별화된 학습 지원 및 교육정책 수립에 기여할것으로 기대된다.
abstract_en: Objectives This study aims to predict middle school students' academic achievement in English using various ma chine learning techniques and to explore the relative importance of key predictive factors by comparing and ana lyzing them across different grade levels. Methods To achieve this, machine learning techniques such as k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Decision Tree (C5.0), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Neural Network (NNET) were utilized. The predictive ac curacy of each model was compared and analyzed for each grade level, and the key predictive factors were identified. To compare academic achievement across grade levels, vertical scale scores for each subject were used. The predictive factors were categorized into three levels: individual, family, and school. For data collection, this study used middle school data from the Gyeonggi Education Panel Study (GEPS). After data preprocessing, a total of 499 first-year, 486 second-year, and 457 third-year middle school students were included in the analysis. In total, 394 individual-level variables, 45 family-level variables, and 106 school-level variables were used to predict students' academic achievement, and the results were compared and analyzed accordingly. Results The findings indicate that Support Vector Machine (SVM) achieved the highest predictive performance for first- and second-year students, while Decision Tree (C5.0) performed best for third-year students. The analysis of key predictive factors revealed that previous-year English grades, English class comprehension, English self-efficacy, and learning attitude were consistently significant predictors across all grade levels. On the other hand, family-related factors such as parental education level and household income had relatively lower predictive power. Additionally, as grade levels increased, the importance of school environment factors (e.g., school sat isfaction, classroom atmosphere) showed a gradual increase. Conclusions This study utilized various machine learning techniques to predict English academic achievement among middle school students and to compare key predictive factors across different grade levels. Furthermore, the study identified the most suitable predictive model for each grade level by comparing different machine learn ing algorithms. These findings provide valuable insights for developing customized learning support systems and can serve as foundational data for personalized education strategies and future education policy development.

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능 활용 국어교육 연구의 동향 분석 - 체계적 문헌 분석과 LDA 토픽 모델링을 바탕으로
title_en: Analyzing Trends in Korean Education Research Using Generative AI -A Systematic Literature Review and LDA Topic Modeling Approach-
kw_ko: 국어교육; 생성형 인공지능; 연구 동향; 토픽 모델링; 체계적 문헌 분석
kw_en: Korean Education; Generative AI; Research Trend; opic Modeling; Systematic Literature Review; ChatGPT
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 국어교육과 생성형 인공지능에 관련된 연구에서 도출되는 주요 키워드가 무엇인지, 해당 논문에서 다루어진 연구 토픽이 어떠한 학문 영역과 연계되는지를 파악하기 위해 체계적 문헌 분석과 LDA 토픽 모델링을 실시하였다. 분석 결과, ‘인공지능’, ‘ChatGPT’, ‘글쓰기’, ‘윤리’ 등이 반복적으로 나타났으며, 특히 ‘생성형 인공지능을 활용한 작문교육’이 가장 큰 비중을 차지하였다. 이러한 결과는 국어교육에서 생성형 인공지능이 글쓰기와 평가, 문학·고전문학 교육 등 여러 분야로 확산될 가능성을 시사한다. 아울러 연구의 범위 확대, 다양한 도구 비교·분석, 기초·적용 연구 간 균형, 윤리적 고려, AI 기반 평가·피드백 체계 구축 등의 중요성을 제안하였다.
abstract_en: This study addresses two central questions about Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) in Korean education: Which major keywords emerge from relevant research, and How do the key research topics relate to diverse academic domains? To explore these, we conducted a systematic literature review and applied Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling. The findings reveal frequent mentions of “artificial intelligence,” “ChatGPT,” “writing,” and “ethics,” with “AI-assisted writing instruction” emerging as the dominant theme. This suggests that GAI can significantly influence various areas of Korean education, including composition, assessment, literature, and even classical texts. Moreover, key terms such as “human,” “creativity,” and “feedback” underscore the evolving considerations of learner-centered pedagogy and ethical concerns in an AI-driven era. Based on these insights, we recommend broadening research scopes beyond writing instruction to encompass other domains (e.g., grammar, speaking, and reading), conducting comparative studies of different AI tools, balancing foundational and applied research, establishing ethical guidelines for responsible AI integration, and developing AI-based feedback and evaluation systems for more effective teaching and learning in Korean education.

title_en: The effects of ChatGPT-based AskUp activities on elementary students' English reading and writing skills
kw_ko: 챗지피티 아숙업; 인공지능 기반 학습; 동료 피드백; 자기 주도 학습; 영어 읽기 쓰기 능력

abstract_ko: This study explores the impact of ChatGPT-based AskUp activities on elementary students' English reading and writing skills. Over an eight-week period, 50 sixth-grade students participated in AI-enhanced lessons integrating collaborative tasks and peer feedback. Results indicate a significant improvement in students' reading and writing abilities, particularly among mid-to-lower proficiency learners, with notable gains in reading fluency, vocabulary acquisition, and structured writing. AI-driven interactions fostered engagement and self-directed learning although excessive reliance on AI-generated responses posed challenges. The findings highlight the potential of AI chatbots in education, emphasizing the need for structured guidance to maximize benefits while maintaining student autonomy. These results may shed light on AI’s role in enhancing language learning in primary education.

kw_ko: 메타버스; 게이미피케이션; 영어 읽기 성취도; 영어 읽기 동기; 자기 주도적 학습 능력

abstract_ko: This study aims to examine the effects of applying gamification-based metaverse strategies on college English reading courses on students' reading achievement and affective domains such as English reading motivation and self-directed learning ability. To achieve this, two class sections were randomly assigned to either an experimental group (n = 40) or a control group (n = 38). The experimental group participated in an English reading class that incorporated gamification strategies applied within a metaverse environment, while the control group received traditional instruction. The findings revealed that gamification strategies in a metaverse environment positively impacted students' English reading achievement. The experimental group showed significantly higher interest, motivation, and confidence compared to the control group. This suggests that such strategies can enhance engagement and effectiveness in EFL reading education.

title_ko: 영어과 AI 디지털 교과서 교수·학습 모형 제안 연구
title_en: Proposing teaching models for AI digital textbooks in English education
kw_ko: 영어 AI 디지털교과서; 맞춤형 학습; 개인화 학습; 학습 분석; 교수모형
kw_en: English AI Digital Textook; Customized Learning; Personalized Learning; Learning Analytics; Teaching Model
abstract_ko: To prepare for digital transformation and the era of AI, Korea’s Ministry of Education announced the implementation of AI digital textbooks in English, mathematics, and computer science in elementary and secondary schools starting in 2025. AIDT aims at personalized/customized learning through AI-based learning analytics. AIDT can be an effective alternative tool to provide personalized/ customized learning in addition to traditional English classrooms. However, in the first year of implementation, models for effectively integrating AIDT into the classroom are still rare. Since instructional approaches and models are crucial for successful implementation and student learning, the purpose of this study is to present effective instructional models using AIDT. As a research method, the study analyzed the characteristics and specifics of AIDT and then applied them to the teaching models based on the characteristics of AIDT and the communicative language teaching approach. This study presents three models, task-based, project-based and problem-based language teaching, which English teachers can use in their teaching with AIDT. The models can be used as guidelines for teachers to integrate AIDT into their classrooms.

title_ko: 대학 영어 회화 수업에서 TED 강연과 ChatGPT를 활용한영어 발표 능력 향상 방안 연구
title_en: Enhancing English presentation skills through the integrated use of TED talks and ChatGPT in university English conversation classes
kw_ko: TED 강연; 영어 발표 교육; AI 기반 언어학습; 대학 영어 교육
kw_en: ChatGPT; TED Talks; English Presentation Education; AI-Based Language Learning; University English Education
abstract_ko: This study investigates the effectiveness of an instructional model that integrates TED Talks and ChatGPT to enhance English presentation skills. The research examined the implementation of a semester-long instructional intervention utilizing TED Talks and ChatGPT version 3.5 among 58 students enrolled in the English Conversation II course at J University. the study identified four primary purposes for which participants utilized ChatGPT: selecting topics and refining ideas, learning English expressions, drafting and revising presentation scripts, and improving pronunciation and intonation. The findings revealed differentiated usage patterns according to proficiency levels. Beginners relied on learning expressions and utilizing speech feedback, while intermediate and advanced learners focused on improving logical structure and coherence. These activities positively influenced the logical composition, linguistic accuracy, and delivery skills of presentations. However, the research also identified limitations, including technical constraints of ChatGPT, excessive dependence by learners on the tool, and insufficient reflection of individual presentation styles. This study proposes practical educational recommendations emphasizing differentiated utilization strategies based on learners’ proficiency levels and highlighting the complementary role of instructors. The findings contribute significant theoretical and practical implications for the integration of AI technology and TED Talks into university-level English presentation education.

title_ko: An Analysis of ChatGPT-Generated Feedback on Argumentative Essays in Korean EFL Classrooms
title_en: An Analysis of ChatGPT-Generated Feedback on Argumentative Essays in Korean EFL Classrooms
authors: 오현주(서울시립대학교); Shu-Fei Hsieh(National Taiwan Normal University)
kw_ko: ChatGPT 피드백; 인공지능; 논쟁적 에세이; 한국 EFL 교실
kw_en: ChatGPT-generated feedback; Artificial Intelligence; argumentative essays; Korean EFL classrooms
abstract_ko: In response to the increasing use of ChatGPT, this study aimed to analyze ChatGPTgenerated feedback on 126 argumentative essays written by university students in Korean English as a Foreign Language (EFL) classrooms, focusing on content, organization, language and grammar, and mechanics. Results revealed that ChatGPT assigned the highest score to content but the lowest score to language and grammar using a five-point scale. Furthermore, ChatGPT identified recurring writing issues, including a lack of clear thesis statements, underdeveloped arguments, insufficient specific examples or evidence, weak transitions and cohesion, unclear counterarguments, and grammar and syntax problems. These issues need to be reflected in writing instruction for improving argumentative essays. When it comes to the strengths of ChatGPT-generated feedback, it provided immediate and scalable feedback, explicit corrective feedback on language and mechanics, and a standardized overall evaluation that offered a comprehensive view at a glance. However, ChatGPT-generated feedback also had the limitations, including formulaic comments on content and organization, generic and overgeneralized feedback on final suggestions for improvement, and a lack of in-depth analysis of counterarguments and logical flow. The current study has pedagogical implications, offering valuable insights into the interpretation and analysis of ChatGPT-generated feedback as well as recommendations for its optimal integration within EFL contexts.

title_ko: ChatGPT의 피드백이 장르별 글쓰기 역량 인식에 미치는 영향
title_en: Effects of ChatGPT-Generated Feedback on Genre- Specific Writing Competence Perception.
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 장르; 인과문; 비교문; 논증문; 쓰기 역량
kw_en: ChatGPT; genre; cause and effect writing; comparison and contrast writing; argumentative writing; writing competence
abstract_ko: This study examined how pre-service English teachers would utilize ChatGPT in three different English writing genres and perceive their writing competences. Participants were pre-service English teachers in the Department of English Education in Seoul, Korea. They initially wrote essays in cause and effect, comparison, and argumentative genres. They then received ChatGPT-generated feedback. To assess their perception in writing competences, macroscopic aspects (Thesis Statement, Idea Generation, Idea Development, and Idea Organization) and microscopic aspects (Topic Sentence, Coherence, Lexical Diversity, and Syntactic Complexity) were measured using a 5-point Likert scale. Responses collected before and after ChatGPT feedback were analyzed using Multivariate Analysis of Variance (MANOVA). Findings indicated that ChatGPT use led to perceived improvements in both macroscopic and microscopic aspects regardless of genre, while no significant differences were found between genres. This study highlights the potential of using ChatGPT to enhance English writing skills. It provides insights for AI-integrated writing education.

abstract_ko: 생성형 인공지능(AI)이 교육의 학습도구로 활용됨에 따라 영어학습에서도 이를 이용하려는시도가 활발히 진행되고 있다. 본 연구에서는 대표적인 생성형 AI인 ChatGPT 기반의 AI 영어 교육 웹 애플리케이션을 개발하고, 초등학교 영어 수업에 적용하여 그 활용 가능성을 제안하였다. ChatGPT API를 활용하여 학생들에게 맞춤형 학습 자료와 실시간 피드백을 제공하는 웹앱을 개발하고 이를 통해 초등학생들의 영어 학습 효율성 및 흥미를 증진시키고자 하였다. 웹앱은 ADDIE 모형을 기반으로 설계되어, 초등학교 영어 수업에서 학생 개별 수준에 맞는 학습 활동과 피드백을 제공하고, 교사의 맞춤형 수업 준비를 지원하는 기능을 포함하고 있다. 실험 결과, 학생들은 개인화된 학습 콘텐츠에 긍정적 반응을 보였고, 교사들은 수업 준비와 학습 지원에 도움이 된다고 평가하였다.
abstract_en: With the use of generative artificial intelligence(AI) as a learing tool in education, there has been a growing effort to apply it in English language learning. This study focused on developing an AI-based English education web application using ChatGPT, a representative generative AI, and explored its potential for application in elementary schol English lessons. Utilizing the ChatGPT API, the web app was designed to provide students with personalized learning materials and real-time feedback, aiming to enhance elementary students' learning efficiency and engagement in English. Based on the ADDIE model, the app delivers learning activities and feedback tailored to individual student levels in elementary English classes, along with supporting teachers in customized lesson preparation. Experimental results show that students responded positively to the personalized learning content, and teachers found it helpful for lesson planning and learning support.

kw_ko: 생성형 AI; AI 리터러시; 중요도-실행도 분석; 에듀테크; 성인 EFL 학습자

abstract_ko: This study investigates how adult EFL learners understand and utilize generative artificial intelligence (AI) in English learning through an Importance-Performance Analysis (IPA). Fifty-nine adult EFL learners participated in the survey. The study measured their perceived importance and actual use of generative AI tools in English learning. The results revealed that, across all items, importance ratings were consistently higher than performance ratings. Notably, “understanding the types and features of generative AI tools”, “interdisciplinary competence using AI,“ “generating English learning content”, and “practicing English communication” emerged as areas requiring instructional intervention to bridge the performance gap. These findings highlight the need for targeted AI literacy education to enhance the integration of generative AI tools in adult EFL learning environments.

title_en: A preliminary study on designing a generative AI-based English Linguistics Course
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 영어학개론; AI 융합 수업
kw_en: generative AI; introduction to linguistics; AI-integrated classroom
abstract_ko: This study explored the integration of generative AI tools into an introductory English linguistics course to foster learner-centered education and enhance student engagement. Twenty-eight Korean college students performed various AI-integrated tasks related to various areas of linguistics. Findings revealed that AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gamma, and Leonardo.Ai enabled students to engage in meaningful activities and practically apply linguistic theories, leading to increased motivation and achievement. Prompt-writing activities further improved students’ English skills and creativity. Despite positive impacts, challenges included decreased creativity, reliability issues, and difficulties in managing AI-generated outputs, especially with video and voice AI tools. Despite limitations in sample size and study duration, this research emphasizes the importance of tailored task design, structured guidance, critical thinking, and digital literacy education. Further studies are needed to investigate the broader educational impacts of generative AI across diverse linguistic and humanities contexts.

kw_ko: 플립러닝; 프로젝트 기반 학습; 에듀테크; 교수학습모형; 영어교육
kw_en: Flipped Learning; Project-Based Learning; EdTech; Instructional Model; English Education
abstract_ko: This study aims to develop a practical instructional model to cultivate learners’ competencies in EdTech-based English content development, responding to the demands of digital transformation in English education. Employing a formative research methodology, this study integrates the strengths of Flipped Learning and Project-Based Learning (PBL) into a unified instructional design framework named NABI (Navigate–Aim–Build–Implement). The model emphasizes self-directed learning, collaborative problem-solving, and creativity. The model was validated by experts and applied in a university course, showing improved learner engagement and instructional effectiveness. This study contributes to the field by offering a feasible and adaptable instructional model that bridges English education and educational technology in higher education.

title_ko: AI 시대의 내러티브와 공감 교육: <영어 읽기: 스토리와 공감> 교과목을 중심으로
title_en: Narratives and Empathy Education in the Age of AI: Focusing on the Course ‘English Reading: Stories and Empathy’
kw_ko: 영미문학교육; 영어교육; 공감 교육; 내러티브; AI 시대
kw_en: Teaching English Literature; English Education; Empathy Education; Narrative; AI Era
abstract_ko: As Artificial intelligence advances, English educators are increasingly confronted with a fundamental question: “If AI can do it for us, why should we study English?” While this shift presents undeniable challenges, it also opens the door to a transformative reimagining of English education. The goal of English education in Korean universities should no longer be limited to only improving skills such as listening, speaking, reading, and writing, but expand into a broader concept of language learning. Narrative-based learning, which fosters students' empathy, could serve such a role. This paper offers a practical example of the use of narratives in English education. Specifically, it explores the methodology of integrating English education with empathy training through the liberal arts course, “English Reading: Stories and Empathy,” offered at Sahmyook University. To implement this methodology effectively, learner-centered teaching methods, such as discussion-based classes, are essential. This approach shifts away from traditional teacher-centered classes focused on enhancing English skills, towards classes aimed at improving humanistic imagination and empathy. This paper emphasizes the necessity for English education to embrace humanistic reflection beyond its narrow confines. It suggests a direction in which English education should progress in the AI era.

title_en: Generative AI in the English Literature Classroom: Integrating Critical Writing and Digital Analysis Activities
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 『기억전달자』(로우리); 교실 활동; 챗 지피티; 보이언트
kw_en: Generative AI; The Giver(Lowry); Classroom activities; ChatGPT; Voyant
abstract_ko: This article examines the pedagogical implications of AI integration in English literature education, focusing on how AI tools both enhance and complicate traditional methods of literary instruction. Through analysis of student writing samples and classroom implementations using Lois Lowry’s The Giver, the study demonstrates the limitations of AI-generated literary analysis and how these limitations can be used to enhance students’ critical thinking when used as a pedagogical tool. The article details specific classroom activities that incorporate AI tools like ChatGPT and Voyant while maintaining student agency in textual interpretation. The findings suggest that while AI can efficiently process textual data and generate basic analyses, its use in literature education should emphasize critical evaluation of AI-generated content rather than simple acceptance. The article concludes that successful AI integration in English literature education requires careful instructional design that positions AI as a tool to stimulate, rather than replace, students’ analytical and creative engagement with literary texts.

title_ko: Exploring Korean College Students’ Voices on Utilizing ChatGPT in their English Speaking Classes
title_en: Exploring Korean College Students’ Voices on Utilizing ChatGPT in their English Speaking Classes
kw_en: AI tools; ChatGPT; ChatGPT-used English speaking class; college English; students’ voices
abstract_ko: This research attempts to explore how Korean college students perceived and experienced the utilization of ChatGPT in their English speaking classes. To achieve this research purpose, it specifically aims to investigate 1) How did the students perceive the ChatGPT-used English speaking class, in terms of students’ satisfaction with the AI-utilized class, English speaking confidence with AI support, adjustment to utilizing AI tools? 2) What experiences did the students go through while participating in the ChatGPT-used class? Seventy-eight students responded to pre- and post-surveys, and nine students voluntarily participated in the focus group interview. The quantitative data were analyzed by SPSS 26.0, and the qualitative data by ClovaNote (NAVER, 2024) and Word Counter (2025). The analytical results indicated that 1) The ChatGPT-utilized English speaking class did not significantly affect students’ class satisfaction and confidence in speaking English; however, their ability to use ChatGPT for their learning had improved. 2) The participants perceived positively toward using ChatGPT in class, but they were not satisfied with ChatGPT-created outputs. Lastly, instructional implications and suggestions for the AI-utilized English speaking class were also discussed.

title_ko: The Accuracy, Linguistic Appropriateness, and Prompting as Properties of Use in ChatGPT Relevant to Korean EFL Learners
title_en: The Accuracy, Linguistic Appropriateness, and Prompting as Properties of Use in ChatGPT Relevant to Korean EFL Learners
kw_en: ChatGPT; accuracy; linguistic appropriateness; prompts; input; AI-interaction
abstract_ko: The primary aim of this research study is to investigate the potential use of AI chatbots as a useful source of language input for L2 learners in terms of accuracy, linguistic appropriateness, and prompt-based interaction through a case study methodology. The researcher, who is a PhD student, acted in dual roles as both the researcher and participant, having seven 20-minute chat sessions with the voice-based ChatGPT for social and academic purposes. To measure the grammaticality and appropriateness of ChatGPT’s language for different levels of EFL learners/users, the researcher first investigated the output of ChatGPT in unprompted mode. Then, the researcher attempted to prompt certain types of language use regarding linguistic features. The results showed that the language from ChatGPT is grammatically accurate, typically indicating over 90% accuracy in form. However, the analysis also showed that the language produced in unprompted mode is more suitable for higher-level users due to its lexical and syntactic complexity, as well as idiomatic aspects. The findings underscore the necessity of crafting effective prompts to align ChatGPT’s language output with learners’ different proficiency levels.

title_ko: Performance Analysis of LLMs in Applying Maritime English Using PHP Text Similarity Algorithm and BERT-based Transformer Models
title_en: Performance Analysis of LLMs in Applying Maritime English Using PHP Text Similarity Algorithm and BERT-based Transformer Models
kw_ko: 해사영어; 표준 해상 통신 문구; 대규모 언어 모델; 의사소통 표준화; 해기교육
kw_en: Maritime English; Standard Marine Communication Phrases; Large Language Model; Communication Standardization; Maritime Education
abstract_ko: Effective communication at sea is a crucial factor in safe vessel operations. To ensure clear and standardized communication, the International Maritime Organization (IMO) established the Standard Marine Communication Phrases (SMCP) for use in ship-to-ship and ship-to-shore communications. Maritime English, including SMCP, differs from general English in its grammatical, lexical, and structural characteristics, emphasizing clarity and conciseness. This study evaluates the ability of commercial Large Language Models (LLMs) to use Maritime English effectively using PHP Text Similarity algorithms and BERT-based models. The research tested three LLMs (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA 3 70B Instruct) using 60 standardized SMCP-based questions covering sentence construction, terminology definition, and fill-in-the-blank exercises. The results were then compared with the test scores of maritime high school students to assess whether LLMs can perform at a similar level to human trainees in maritime communication. Overall, the LLMs demonstrated high accuracy but showed limitations in applying standardized phrases and understanding conventional maritime expressions. The findings indicate that, while LLMs have potential applications in maritime training and operations, they are not yet fully reliable for independent use in real-world scenarios without human oversight. This study serves as a reference for evaluating the feasibility of LLMs in maritime education and practice, emphasizing the need for further research on more sophisticated models in the future.

title_en: A Study on the Changes of English Learners’ Writing Self-efficacy before and after AI-integration

kw_en: writing self-efficacy; writing performance; AI-integration; prompt; feedback
abstract_ko: The present study underscores the complex interplay between AI integration, writing self-efficacy, and writing performance. While AI can contribute positively to students’ writing abilities, it is part of a larger educational ecosystem that includes human instruction, peer interaction, and individual effort. Future research should explore the long-term effects of AI integration on self-efficacy and performance, as well as the most effective ways to integrate AI tools into the language learning curriculum to support, rather than replace, traditional teaching methods.

title_ko: Prevalence of ChatGPT Usage for Liberal Arts English Homework Assignments at a Korean University : A Case Study
title_en: Prevalence of ChatGPT Usage for Liberal Arts English Homework Assignments at a Korean University : A Case Study
kw_ko: AI 도구; 영어 수업; 영어 교육
kw_en: ChatGPT; AI tools; EFL; English education
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study is to explore to what extent EFL learners enrolled at a Korean university are using ChatGPT to assist with homework assignments in courses taught in English. Preferences on the role this technology has in the future were also explored. 261 students completed a 20-item survey questionnaire from which data was subsequently analyzed using general qualitative analysis for open ended questions and descriptive statistics for multiple choice and Likert scale questions. If permission was granted, respondents were then contacted to discuss responses in greater detail through the use of email and video calls. Overall, the prevalence of ChatGPT was high; however, students placed in intermediate level English classes appear to rely on it more often than those placed in other levels. Despite this high prevalence, some respondents indicated they chose not to use ChatGPT due to factors such as ownership of the language learning process, distrust of this technology, and reluctance to rely on AI based technology. Moving forward, there are clear indications that changes need to be made in how ChatGPT is integrated into academic settings. Respondents from this context appear to desire a greater level of flexibility from their English instructors on how they are allowed to use it. Furthermore, there is a space for more robust guidelines from university administration on how students can use ChatGPT for homework assignments in an ethical manner. Administrational and educational implications of such findings are also discussed.

title_ko: ChatGPT in English Learning: A Machine Learning Perspective
title_en: ChatGPT in English Learning: A Machine Learning Perspective
kw_ko: 인공지능(AI); 영어 학습; 글쓰기 피드백; 기계 학습
kw_en: ChatGPT; artificial intelligence (AI); English language learning; writing feedback; machine learning
abstract_ko: This study explores the transformative role of ChatGPT in education, focusing on its impact on language learning, writing support, and academic research through an analysis of English-language papers published from November 2022, when ChatGPT was developed, to 2024. Specifically, 20 research articles were selected and analyzed to examine how ChatGPT has been applied and discussed in educational contexts, with most of them published in journals indexed in Web of Science and Scopus. Using word frequency, similarity analysis, and clustering based on Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and K-means, the results highlight that ChatGPT is a multifaceted tool that enhances personalized learning experiences. The frequency analysis reveals strong associations with terms like “student,” “learning,” “education,” and “AI,” emphasizing ChatGPT’s role in supporting language acquisition, academic writing, and student engagement. The similarity analysis further demonstrates its contributions to writing, feedback, and research tasks. Clustering results identified four key areas of ChatGPT's application: AI and Technology in Education; Research and Data Utilization; Writing and Feedback; Language Learning and Education. These findings suggest that ChatGPT is a valuable resource in educational settings, though further research is needed to explore its long-term effects and ethical considerations in language learning contexts.

title_ko: 인공지능 디지털 영어교육의 현황과 전망: 자연어처리 기반 텍스트 분석
title_en: Issues and prospects of AI digital English education: Text analysis Based on Natural Language Processing.
kw_en: natural language processing; AI digital English education; network text analysis; topic modeling
abstract_ko: The study aimed to quantify the content and keyword relationships in AI-based English education texts to understand the current status of English education and gain insights into the future direction of English education. Data analysis involved a text analysis that utilized Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to extract meaningful content and information from large-scale text data, identifying new meanings and knowledge at the contextual level by considering the relationships between texts and words. The primary analysis methods used included keyword analysis, network text analysis, and topic modeling. The research findings are as follows. First, a frequency analysis of the collected texts revealed terms such as ‘technology,’ ‘learning,’ ‘textbooks,’ ‘big data,’ ‘application,’ ‘mathematics,’ ‘information,’ ‘students,’ and ‘edtech’ based on Term Frequency (TF) values. TF-IDF (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency) values identified ‘textbooks,’ ‘learning,’ ‘big data,’ and ‘edtech.’ Additionally, N-gram analysis highlighted the term ‘development and implementation of AI digital textbooks.’ Next, through ego-network analysis for relationship exploration, words related to ‘learning,’ ‘textbooks,’ ‘technology and future trends’ were found to be connected around the term ‘English.’ Finally, topic modeling analysis using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) classified the texts into five topics: ‘AI-Based Educational Innovation,’ ‘Transition to a Digital-Based Learning Environment,’ ‘Future-Oriented Changes in the Education System,’ ‘Learner-Centered Personalized English Education,’ and ‘Technological Innovation and Services in the Education Industry.’ This study provides insights into the future direction of English education by providing educators and learners with AI-powered text analysis tools.

title_ko: GPT API-based chatbots as adaptive and facilitative tutors for L2 English process writing
title_en: GPT API-based chatbots as adaptive and facilitative tutors for L2 English process writing
kw_en: process writing; GPT-4 turbo API; prompt fine-tuning; writing tutor chatbots; middle school students
abstract_ko: This paper explores the development and application of GPT API-based chatbots as adaptive and facilitative tutors in the context of the EFL process writing by secondary school students. In Study 1, we describe the development of four AI-powered chatbots, each customized for one of the four sequential stages of the L2 writing process, i.e., pre-writing, drafting, revising, and editing. Through prompt fine-tuning using the GPT-4-turbo API and OpenAI Playground, the chatbots were guided to provide stage-specific feedback, prevent unquestioning reliance on AI, and promote L2 writing development. In Study 2, the chatbots were evaluated in a case study with a cohort of six ninth-graders engaged in process writing tasks with the four stage-specific chatbots. We found that the tailor-made chatbots effectively assisted the EFL learners at each stage of the writing process, fostering constructive and creative human-AI collaboration. The learners evaluated the chatbots as helpful and knowledgeable, acknowledging their positive impact on writing quality. Based on these findings, we discuss implications for the design and use of AI chatbots in L2 writing.
