title_ko: ChatGPT-assisted writing: Learners’ perceptions of AI feedback and influencing factors
title_en: ChatGPT-assisted writing: Learners’ perceptions of AI feedback and influencing factors
kw_en: ChatGPT; English writing; AI feedback; perception; factors; university students; English proficiency; AI-assisted learning
abstract_ko: This study explored the effects of using ChatGPT 3.5 (ChatGPT) on the attitudes and perceptions of English writing by 17 intermediate and 17 advanced university students. Paired t-test results for pre- and post-surveys found that both groups experienced a significant increase (intermediate: t=-3.392, p=.004; advanced: t=-3.050, p=.008) in confidence towards English. ChatGPT was found to be beneficial for creating ideas, strengthening vocabulary, and enhancing writing abilities by the two groups. While advanced students noted ChatGPT’s usefulness in organizing ideas and conveying complicated concepts with an emphasis on language proficiency, several intermediate students stated its importance for motivation, and grammar improvement. Both groups expressed concerns over dependency on ChatGPT and production of erroneous data. Six intermediate students reported no detrimental feelings toward use of ChatGPT and only two students from the advanced class reported no detrimental effect. Findings from the research demonstrated that although English language learners of varying proficiency levels share some similar opinions about ChatGPT, there are also significant distinctions between the two groups in this study. To properly employ AI chatbots as writing aids, instructors should take into account the competency levels of their students. They should also customize strategies to match the unique needs of learners, so that goals can be attained at every step in the writing process.
abstract_en: This study explored the effects of using ChatGPT 3.5 (ChatGPT) on the attitudes and perceptions of English writing by 17 intermediate and 17 advanced university students. Paired t-test results for pre- and post-surveys found that both groups experienced a significant increase (intermediate: t=-3.392, p=.004; advanced: t=-3.050, p=.008) in confidence towards English. ChatGPT was found to be beneficial for creating ideas, strengthening vocabulary, and enhancing writing abilities by the two groups. While advanced students noted ChatGPT’s usefulness in organizing ideas and conveying complicated concepts with an emphasis on language proficiency, several intermediate students stated its importance for motivation, and grammar improvement. Both groups expressed concerns over dependency on ChatGPT and production of erroneous data. Six intermediate students reported no detrimental feelings toward use of ChatGPT and only two students from the advanced class reported no detrimental effect. Findings from the research demonstrated that although English language learners of varying proficiency levels share some similar opinions about ChatGPT, there are also significant distinctions between the two groups in this study. To properly employ AI chatbots as writing aids, instructors should take into account the competency levels of their students. They should also customize strategies to match the unique needs of learners, so that goals can be attained at every step in the writing process.
note: ChatGPT 쓰기 활용 전후 태도·인식 사전사후 t검정

title_ko: 교사와 인공지능 글쓰기 피드백에 대한 초등학생의 반응
title_en: Elementary School Students’ Responses to Teacher and AI Writing Feedback
kw_ko: 글쓰기 피드백; 교사 피드백; 인공지능 피드백; 피드백 반응; 초등학생 반응
kw_en: Teacher writing feedback; AI writing feedback; Responses to Feedback; Writing feedback; Elementary school students’ responses
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 초등학교 학생들이 교사와 인공지능이 제공한 글쓰기 피드백에 대해 어떤 반응을 보이는지 살펴보는 것을 목적으로 한다. 최근 교육 현장에서 인공지능 기반 피드백 시스템의 활용이 확대되고 있으나, 이에 대한 학습자들의 실제 반응을 살핀 연구는 부족하다. 이에 본 연구는 초등학교 5학년 학생들이 교사와 인공지능이 작성한 피드백을 읽고 보이는 반응을 탐색하였다. 먼저, 학생들에게 쓰기 과제를 제시하고, 교사와 인공지능이 이에 대한 피드백을 작성하였다. 다음으로, 학생들에게 피드백의 작성 주체를 밝히지 않은 상태에서 피드백에 대한 인상을 조사하였으며, 작성 주체를 밝힌 후 학생들의 반응도 수집하였다. 면담과 설문을 통해 수집한 학생들의 반응은 질적으로 분석하였다. 이 연구는 피드백에 대한 학생들의 반응을 분석함으로써, 향후 교사 피드백 전략 수립과 인공지능 기반 글쓰기 피드백 시스템 설계에 유용한 시사점을 제공할 수 있을 것으로 기대된다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to examine how elementary school students react to writing feedback provided by teachers and AI. Therefore, this study explored the reactions of fifth grade elementary school students when they read writing feedback provided by teachers and AI on their own writings. Initially, students completed a writing assignment, after which feedback was generated by a teacher and an AI system. Students were first asked to reflect on the feedback without being informed of its source. Subsequently, their reactions were collected again after disclosing the authorship of the feedback. The students’ responses were collected through interviews and questionnaires and analyzed qualitatively. By analyzing the students’ responses to feedback, this study is expected to provide implications for establishing teachers’ feedback strategies and designing AI writing feedback systems in the future.

title_ko: AI 피드백 기반 내러티브 EFL 수업 모형 개발 연구
title_en: A Study on an AI-Integrated Narrative EFL Instruction Model
kw_ko: EFL 교육; 내러티브; AI 피드백; 학습자 참여; 창의성
kw_en: Narrative; EFL Education; AI Feedback; Learner Engagement; Creativity
abstract_ko: This study investigates the effects of a narrative-based instructional model incorporating AI-mediated feedback in an EFL context. Seventeen university students participated in a 15-week advanced English conversation course, where they composed and revised personal narratives using both instructor guidance and optional AI feedback. Qualitative data collected through surveys and reflective writing indicated that personal storytelling enhanced learners’ creativity, authenticity, and self-expression. Meanwhile, AI feedback effectively improved grammatical accuracy and textual coherence. Despite these benefits, teacher intervention was essential in preserving the emotional nuance and contextual richness of students’ narratives. These findings suggest that a balanced integration of narrative instruction and AI support can foster learner motivation, support self-expression, and enrich EFL learning experiences by enabling students to articulate and present their unique stories in meaningful ways.

title_ko: 고등학교 영어 텍스트의 담화 연결어에 대한 코퍼스 기반 비교: 인간 저작물과 생성형 AI 텍스트를 중심으로
title_en: A Corpus-based Comparison of Discourse Connectors in Human and AI-authored High School Texts
kw_en: discourse markers; AI-generated texts; English language textbooks; ChatGPT; English language education
abstract_ko: This study examines the use of discourse markers in Korean high school English textbook texts and their AI-paraphrased counterparts generated by ChatGPT. Employing a corpus-based approach, the analysis focuses on five categories of discourse markers: additive, adversative, causal, temporal, and exemplification. The corpus comprises 47 textbook passages and 47 corresponding GPT-generated texts. The results reveal no statistically significant differences in the use of additive, causal, and temporal markers, suggesting that AI-generated texts can effectively replicate the logical flow in these areas. In contrast, notable discrepancies emerged in the adversative and exemplification categories, where textbook texts employed more explicit markers such as however and for example. These findings suggest that while GPT-generated texts exhibit overall fluency, they may lack pedagogically intentional discourse structures that are essential for fostering learners’ logical reasoning and conceptual clarity. The study underscores the need for instructional scaffolding when integrating AI-generated content into educational settings and offers insights for the development of more pedagogically aligned AI-assisted learning materials.

title_ko: 빅데이터 분석을 통한 AI 영어학습에 대한 사용자 인식 연구: 최근 3년간의 소셜 미디어 데이터를 중심으로
title_en: A Study on User Perception of AI-based English Learning Through Big Data Analysis: Focusing on Social Media Data from the Past Three Years
kw_ko: AI 영어학습; 빅데이터분석; 텍스트마이닝; 사용자경험; 챗지피티
kw_en: AI English learning; Big data analysis; Text mining; User Experience (UX); ChatGPT
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 2022년 1월부터 2025년 1월까지의 온라인 빅데이터를 활용하여 ChatGPT를 비롯한 생성형 AI 기반 영어학습에 대한 사용자 인식을 분석하였다. 텍스트 마이닝 방법론을 적용한 결과, 사용자들은 대화형 학습환경과 개인화된 맞춤형 콘텐츠에 높은 관심을 보였으며, 즉각적인 피드백과 개인 수준에 맞춘 학습 경험을 선호하는 것으로 나타났다. ChatGPT가 음성인식이나 기계번역 도구와 결합될 때 학습 만족도가 높아지는 시너지 효과가 확인되었으며, CONCOR 분석에서는 AI 학습 도구가 전통적 교육체제와 상호보완적 관계를 형성할 가능성이 시사되었다. 그러나 발음 교정의 정확도 부족과 AI 의존도 증가에 따른 자기주도 학습 기회 감소 등의 우려도 제기되었다. 본 연구는 성공적인 AI 영어학습 환경 구축을 위해 알고리즘 개발뿐 아니라 학습자 맥락에 부합하는 콘텐츠 기획이 필요함을 제시하였다.
abstract_en: This study analyzed user perceptions of AI-based English learning, particularly ChatGPT, using online big data from January 2022 to January 2025. Text mining methodologies revealed significant user interest in interactive learning environments and personalized content with immediate feedback tailored to individual needs. A notable synergy effect emerged when ChatGPT was combined with speech recognition or machine translation tools, enhancing features like pronunciation correction and conversation practice. CONCOR analysis indicated complementary relationships between AI tools and traditional educational systems, suggesting potential for a richer learning ecosystem. User concerns included insufficient accuracy in pronunciation assessment and reduced self-directed learning opportunities due to AI dependence. The research effectively captured diverse opinions often missed in conventional surveys, concluding that successful AI-based English learning environments require both innovative algorithms and content planning aligned with learner contexts.
note: 소셜미디어 빅데이터로 AI 영어학습 사용자 인식 텍스트마이닝

title_ko: 日本語教育における生成AI活用の一考察 -日本語作文授業の新しい可能性-
title_en: A Study on the Use of Generative AI in Japanese Language Education -New Possibilities for Japanese Composition Classes-
kw_ko: 생성 AI、일본어 작문 수업、사고의 언어화、창조력 향상、일본어 가능성
kw_en: 生成AI、日本語作文授業、思考の言語化、創造力の向上、日本語の可能性; Generative AI、Japanese composition lessons、verbalizing thoughts、improving creativity、the potential of the Japanese languageG
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 한국 대학교에서 일본어를 전공하는 학생을 대상으로 하는 ‘일본어 작문’ 수업에서 생성형 AI를 활용하여 학습자의 자율적인 사고력과 작문 능력을 기르고자 한 교육 실천 사례를 다룬 것이다. 15주간의 수업에서는 플립 러닝과 액티브 러닝을 결합하고, 학생들은 설명문 작성 사고의 언어화 조언 작성 과제 등 다양한 활동을 통해 생성 AI 통합의 효과를 평가했다. AI를 활용한 자기 표현력과 타자 이해 능력의 함양을 목표로 삼았다. 연구 결과 생성 AI는 학습자들이 일본어 작문에서 겪는 어려움을 극복하도록 돕고 창의성과 표현력을 향상시키는 데 기여하는 것으로 나타났다. 또 설문 결과, 학생들은 AI를 참고하면서도 자신의 생각을 주체적으로 글로 발전시키는 의식을 가졌음을 확인할 수 있었다. 한편, AI 의존이나 표현의 획일화 등의 과제도 드러났다. 이번 실천은 생성형 AI를 보조 도구로 적절히 위치시킴으로써 창의적이고 비판적인 사고력 활동을 촉진할 수 있는 가능성을 시사한다. 일본어 교육에 새로운 가능성을 제시하고 생성 AI의 교육적 활용에 도움이 될 것이다.
abstract_en: This study presents an educational practice aimed at fostering independent thinking and writing skills among students majoring in Japanese at a South Korean university by incorporating generative AI into a Japanese composition course. Over a 15-week period, the course combined flipped learning with active learning. Students engaged in various activities—including explanatory writing, verbalizing their thought processes, and providing written feedback—to evaluate the effectiveness of generative AI integration. The course aimed to cultivate self-expression and the ability to understand others through the use of AI. The findings revealed that generative AI supported learners in overcoming difficulties in Japanese composition and contributed to enhancing creativity and expressive ability. Furthermore, survey responses showed that students developed an awareness of independently shaping their ideas in writing, even while referring to AI-generated suggestions. However, issues such as overreliance on AI and the risk of standardized expressions also emerged. This practice suggests the potential of positioning generative AI as a supportive tool to encourage creative and critical thinking. It offers new possibilities for Japanese language education and provides insights into the educational use of generative AI.
note: 일본어 작문 수업 생성형 AI

title_ko: 日本語教育におけるPSC基盤のChatGPT利用に関する一考察
title_en: A Study on the Use of PSC-based ChatGPT in Japanese Language Education
kw_ko: 일본어교육; 수업실천; 설문조사
kw_en: 日本語教育; PSC; ChatGPT; 授業実践、アンケート調査; Japanese Education; Problem Finding and Solving Self Learning Collaboration; Teaching Practice; Survey
abstract_ko: 본 연구에서는 4차 산업혁명 시대를 배경으로 인공지능(AI) 기술이 점점 발달하고 있는 가운데, 일본어교육 중에서도 회화교육에 초점을 맞추어 PSC기반의 ChatGPT를 이용한 수업 실천을 통해, 실천 예를 제시함과 동시에 설문조사의 분석을 통해, 그 성과와 과제와 개선점을 분명히 하는 것을 목적으로 했다. 부산외국어대학교 일본어융합학부 과목인 「일본어 A1」 수업에서 PSC기반인 교재 대화문의 문제점을 살펴보고, 문제점을 바탕으로 공동으로 ChatGPT를 이용하여 대화문 작성과 발표를 진행하였으며, 설문조사를 통해 가능성과 과제에 대해 고찰하였다. 본 연구의 의의는 일본어교육에 있어서 PSC기반의 ChatGPT를 이용한 회화 수업의 실천 예를 나타낸 것과, 과제와 발표 시 ChatGPT를 사용해 봄으로써 가능성과 과제를 고찰할 수 있었고, 기존 연구와의 비교와 함께 ChatGPT의 버전을 비교해 ChatGPT의 진화 상황을 파악할 수 있어 수업 이용의 가능성을 더욱 기대할 수 있음을 보여준 것이다. 그러나 향후의 과제로서는 PSC기반의 새로운 실천이라고는 해도, 다수의 학생을 대상으로 한 상세한 분석은 이루어지지 않았기 때문에, 일반화하는 것은 어렵고, 보다 치밀한 수업 구성 및 실천을 통해 상세한 분석을 할 필요성과, 보다 많은 학생을 대상으로 실천하고 통계율을 높일 필요성, 그리고 전원을 대상으로 과제물 피드백을 의무화할 필요성, 마지막으로 회화교육이라고는 하지만 ChatGPT를 통해 회화문을 작성할 수 있어도 발음 등의 지도를 할 수 없기 때문에 교수자는 개별적으로 회화 연습을 지도할 필요가 있다는 것이다.
abstract_en: This study examines the gradual development of artificial intelligence (AI) technology within the context of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, specifically focusing on conversation education in Japanese language learning by presenting practical examples and analyzing surveys to clarify achievements, tasks, and areas for improvement. In the "Japanese A1" class at Busan University of Foreign Studies, we looked at the issues with the dialogue in the PSC-based textbook, then created and shared new dialogue using ChatGPT, and explored the possibilities and challenges through a survey. The significance of this study is to show an example of the practice of conversation classes using PSC-based ChatGPT in Japanese language education, to consider the possibilities and tasks by using ChatGPT for assignments and presentations, and to compare the version of ChatGPT with previous studies to understand the evolution of ChatGPT, which can further explore the possibility of using classes. However, despite being a new PSC-based practice, generalization is difficult because a detailed analysis of a large number of students has not been conducted. Additionally, there is a need for more detailed class composition and practice to involve more students and increase statistical data, as well as to make assignment feedback mandatory for all students. Finally, even though it is called conversation education, even though it is possible to write a conversation letter through ChatGPT, instructors need to teach conversation practice individually because they cannot teach pronunciation.
note: 일본어 회화 수업 ChatGPT

kw_ko: AI 기반 영어 말하기 학습 앱; 자기 주도적 영어 학습 준비도; 정의적 태도; 대학 비교과 프로그램
kw_en: AI-based English speaking application; self-directed English learning readiness; affective attitude; college extracurricular program
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 대학 비교과 영어 말하기 프로그램에서 인공지능 기반 영어 말하기 앱인 플랭(PLANG)의 활용이 학습자의 자기 주도 영어 학습 준비도나 정의적 태도에 미치는 영향, 그리고 학습자의 자기 주도 영어 학습 준비도나 정의적 태도가 학습자의 영어 말하기 수행 능력과 학습 시간에 미치는 영향을 참여자들의 프로그램에 대한 인식과 함께 탐색해 보았다. 총 46명의 대학생이 연구 대상이었으며, 이 중 27명은 앱을 활용한 실험군으로, 19명은 대조군으로 참여하였다. 프로그램 전후로 자기 주도 영어 학습 준비도와 영어 말하기에 대한 정의적 태도를 측정하였다. 영어 말하기 수행 능력 변화는 앱이 제공하는 말하기 점수와 레벨을 활용하여 분석하였다. 또한, 참여자의 프로그램 참여 경험 관련 주관식 응답도 자료로 수집하였다. 자료 분석 결과에 따르면, 자기 주도 학습 준비도는 실험군과 대조군 모두 소폭 상승하였으나 통계적으로 유의미한 차이는 없었다. 동기, 자신감, 흥미로 이루어진 정의적 태도 중에서 동기 요인에서만 유의미한 향상이 나타났다. 영어 말하기 수행 능력은 실험군에서 통계적으로 유의미한 향상을 보였다. 특히, 자기 주도 학습 준비도가 낮은 학습자들이 더 높은 성취를 나타내는 흥미로운 결과가 확인되었다. 학습자들의 참여 경험 관련 인식 분석에서는 즉각적인 피드백, 학습의 유연성, 동기 유발 측면 등에서 대부분 긍정적인 경험이 보고되었으나, 일부 참여자는 콘텐츠 선택권의 제한을 아쉬운 점으로 지적하였다. 끝으로, 본 연구는 AI 기반 말하기 학습 앱이 비구조적이고 자율적인 학습 환경에서도 학습 효과를 촉진할 수 있다는 가능성에 기반하여, 대학영어 현장에서 AI 기반 말하기 학습 앱의 활용 가능성을 제안하였다.
abstract_en: This study investigates the use of an AI-based English-speaking application(app), PLANG, within a college extracurricular English program. It examines the impact of the app on participants’ self-directed English learning readiness (SDLLR) and affective attitudes, and further explores how these variables relate to participants’ speaking performance and the amount of time spent on learning. Participants’ perceptions regrading the use of the app were also investigated. A total of 46 college students participated in this study, with 27 assigned to the experimental group utilizing the app and 19 to the control group. Pre- and post-program surveys were administered to measure SDLLR and affective attitudes toward English speaking, while speaking performance was measured using the app’s internal assessment criteria. Additionally, data on participants perceptions were collected through open-ended survey responses. The results indicated both groups showed a slight increase in SDLLR; however, the difference was not statistically significant. Among the affective variables, only motivation showed a statistically significant improvement. The experimental group demonstrated a meaningful enhancement in speaking performance, particularly among learners with initially low levels of SDLLR. Content analysis of the written responses from learners revealed generally positive perception of the app use. Nevertheless, some participants reported dissatisfaction with the limited autonomy in content selection. Despite the study’s limitations and need for further research, the findings suggest that AI-based speaking applications can facilitate speaking development and learner motivation even in minimally structured, self-paced learning context.
note: AI 말하기 앱 PLANG 실험군·대조군 비교과 프로그램

title_ko: Initiation-Response-Follow-up Pattern of Feedback Interaction between L2 Writers and ChatGPT
title_en: Initiation-Response-Follow-up Pattern of Feedback Interaction between L2 Writers and ChatGPT
kw_ko: 인공지능; 챗지피티; 제2 언어 작문; 피드백 상호작용
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence; ChatGPT; L2 writing; Feedback interaction
abstract_ko: ChatGPT, an AI-powered chatbot, has become increasingly integrated into L2 writing instruction, offering significant benefits by providing feedback through human-like interaction. Within the framework of the Initiation/Response/Follow-up (IRF) classroom interaction model, this study examined how L2 writers interact with ChatGPT to receive feedback for revision. Over a ten-week period, ChatGPT was used as a tool to assist students in revising their take-home writing assignments. The chat history was analyzed to identify prominent structural patterns and thematic categories in the follow-up responses that sustain the interaction. Findings showed that feedback interactions were often initiated by a student’s request for broad feedback on their writing, followed by ChatGPT’s extensive suggestions for revision, and then the student’s follow-up responses to address each suggestion based on their learning interests and needs. A thematic analysis of the follow-up responses identified four primary types: requests for elaboration and additional information, requests for confirmation of language use and grammar, resolution of miscommunications and presentation of counterargument, and expressions of appreciation and satisfaction. Paired t-tests were conducted and found that the interactive feedback led to improvement in L2 writing proficiency. Findings of this study offer implications for the effective integration of ChatGPT into foreign language education.

title_ko: 인공지능을 활용한 고전 영미 문학의 아동문학 변환 <텍스트와 이미지 생성 모델을 중심으로>
title_en: Transformation of Classic English and American Literature into Children's Literature Using Artificial Intelligence <Focusing on Text and Image Generation Models>
kw_ko: 아동 문학; 생성형 AI; 언어 발달; 프롬프트 엔지니어링; N-shot 프롬프팅
kw_en: Children's Literature; Generative AI; Language Development; Prompt Engineering; N-shot Prompting
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 인공지능 기술을 활용하여 고전 영미문학을 아동 문학으로 변환하는 가능성을 연구하는 것이다. 기존의 고전 문학 작품은 깊이 있는 주제와 복잡한 서사를 포함하고 있어 어린이들이 이해하기 어렵다. 생성형 인공지능 기술을 사용하여 고전 영미 문학을 아동 친화적인 문체로 변환하고, 이를 시각적으로 보완할 삽화를 생성하는 방법을 연구하였다. 텍스트 생성에는 ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini 등의 언어 모델을, 이미지 생성에는 Midjourney, DALL-E, KlingAI를 활용하였다. 실험 결과, Claude 3.5 Sonnet 모델이 가장 자연스럽고 아동 친화적인 문장을 생성하는 것으로 평가되었으며, 1-shot 프롬프팅 방식이 변환 과정에서 가장 효과적인 접근법으로 확인되었다. 이미지 생성에서는 DALL-E가 어린이 독자에게 적합한 일러스트를 제작하는 데 가장 적절한 모델로 선정되었다. 본 연구는 AI 기술을 활용하여 문학 교육을 혁신할 가능성을 제시하며, 어린이에게 더 풍부한 문학적 경험을 제공하기 위한 새로운 접근 방식을 제안한다. 또한 전문가 기반의 정성적 평가와 다층적 실험 설계를 통해, 생성형 AI 모델 간의 특성과 차이를 정밀하게 분석하였다. 이를 통해 향후 아동 콘텐츠 제작에서 인공지능의 실질적 적용 가능성과 활용 전략을 구체적으로 제시할 수 있는 기초 자료를 마련하였다.
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the possibility of transforming classic English and American literature into children's literature using artificial intelligence technology. Traditional classic literary works often contain deep themes and complex narratives, making them difficult for children to understand. This study investigates methods for converting Classic English and American literature into a child-friendly writing style using generative AI technology and creating illustrations to complement the text visually. Language models such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini were utilized for text generation, while image generation was conducted using Midjourney, DALL-E, and KlingAI. Experimental results showed that the Claude 3.5 Sonnet model generated the most natural and child-friendly sentences, and the 1-shot prompting method was identified as the most effective approach in the transformation process. Regarding image generation, DALL-E was selected as the most suitable model for producing illustrations appropriate for young readers. This study suggests the potential of AI technology to innovate literary education and proposes a new approach to providing children with a richer literary experience. Additionally, through expert-driven qualitative evaluation and a multi-layered experimental design, the study offers a detailed analysis of the characteristics and distinctions among various generative AI models. These findings provide foundational data for future applications and strategic uses of AI in children's content production.
note: 고전 영미문학의 아동문학 변환 AI 모델 비교; 학습자·수업 없음

title_ko: 교육실습에 대한 중등 예비 영어교사 인식: 역량 교육 및 생성형 AI 활용을 중심으로
title_en: Pre-service secondary English teachers' perceptions of teaching practicum: Focusing on competency-based education and generative AI utilization
kw_ko: 중등 예비 영어교사; 교육실습; 역량 교육; 생성형 인공지능
kw_en: pre-service secondary English teachers; teaching practicum; competency-based education; generative AI
abstract_ko: This study examines pre-service secondary English teachers’ perceptions of their teaching practicum, exploring opportunities to understand and practice competency-based education and factors related to generative AI utilization. Its aims are to identify whether current teacher training programs adequately prepare pre-service teachers for contemporary educational challenges and to derive implications for future teacher education models. Sixteen fourth-year pre-service teachers participated in the study after completing their four-week teaching practicum. Data were collected through surveys and interviews. Quantitative data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, while qualitative data supplemented the statistical findings. Results indicate that opportunities for analyzing and understanding the national English curriculum and implementing competency-based education were perceived as limited. Regarding generative AI, the majority use AI services like ChatGPT to support lesson planning and material development, reporting high satisfaction due to immediate feedback and creative suggestions. This study underscores the necessity of enhancing practicum guidance for competency-based curriculum implementation and integrating structured AI training to effectively prepare pre-service teachers for future educational environments.

title_ko: 빅데이터 기반 영어과 AIDT에 대한 기대와 우려의 키워드 네트워크 분석: 국내외 논문 및 국내 웹 뉴스 동향의 비교 연구
title_en: A Keyword Network Analysis of Expectations and Concerns Regarding AI-Based Digital English Textbooks (AIDT)
kw_ko: AIDT 영어 교과서; AI 영어교육; AIDT 영어 빅데이터 분석
kw_en: English AIDT; AI-powered english education; Big data analysis
abstract_ko: 목적 본 연구는 2014년부터 2024년 기간 국내 논문, 국외 논문 및 국내 웹 뉴스 자료에 대한 텍스트 마이닝과 키워드 빈도수 분석을통한 언어 네트워크 분석을 통해 2025년 3월부터 도입된 AI 기반 영어 교과서(AIDT)가 영어 교육에 미치는 기대와 우려 세밀하게분석하였다. 방법 본 연구는 텍스트 마이닝과 언어 네트워크 분석을 활용하여 AI 기반 영어 교과서 도입과 관련된 주요 키워드를 도출하고, 이에대한 언어 네트워크 분석을 수행하였다. 주로 언급되는 경향을 분석하기 위해 국내 논문 163편, 국외 논문 210편, 그리고 국내 웹뉴스 데이터 20,981개를 수집 및 분석하였고 TEXTOM 및 Netminer 4.5 프로그램이 이용되었다. 결과 '학습', '교사', '데이터', '윤리적 문제', '비용'이 키워드 네트워크 분석의 결과 주요 키워드로 분석되었다. 국내에서는 AI를 사용한영어 학습이 학생에게 맞는 학습 경험 제공하고 이를 통한 성취도 향상을 기대할 수 있다고 주장하였다. 아울러 교사의 역할 변화와교육 환경 개선에 대한 기대도 언급하였다. 그러나 AI 기술에 과도하게 의존할 때 교사의 수동적 역할이 우려되고, AI 학습 도구의 개인정보 침해 및 정보 편향으로 인한 문제를 언급한다. 국외 연구에서는 AI가 효율적이고 객관적인 학습 평가를 가능하게 할 것이라 기대한다. 다만, 교사의 역량 강화와 사용자의 사생활 침해와 같은 윤리적 문제를 해결해야 함을 주장한다. 국내 웹 뉴스 분석에서는 AI를 활용한 영어 교육이 효율적이며 맞춤식 교육이 가능할 것이라는 기대가 있지만, 도입 초기의 경제적 부담에 대한 우려가 분석되었다. 결론 AIDT를 이용한 영어 학습의 기대와 우려를 종합적으로 제시한 본 연구를 통해 향후 영어 AIDT의 활용의 더 나은 방향에 대한대화의 토대가 마련되길 기대한다.
abstract_en: Objectives This study conducted a detailed analysis of both the expectations and concerns regarding the impact of AI-based English textbooks (AIDT), introduced in March 2025, on English education. The analysis was carried out through text mining and keyword frequency analysis of domestic and international academic papers as well as domestic web news articles published between 2014 and 2024, followed by a language network analysis. Methods By utilizing text mining and language network analysis, this study identified key keywords related to the introduction of AI-based English textbooks and examined their network relationships. To analyze prevalent trends, a total of 163 domestic papers, 210 international papers, and 20,981 domestic web news articles were collected and analyzed using the TEXTOM and Netminer 4.5 programs. Results As a result of the language network analysis, the major keywords identified included ‘learning’, ‘teachers’, ‘data’, ‘ethical issues’, and ‘cost’. Domestic studies argued that AI-based English learning can offer personalized learning experiences and enhance learners’ achievement, thus contributing to changes in the teacher's role and im provements in the educational environment. However, concerns were raised about ethical issues such as the teacher's passive role due to overreliance on AI, data privacy, and potential bias. International studies anticipated that AI would enhance the objectivity and efficiency of learning assessments, though they emphasized the need to strengthen teachers' competencies and address ethical concerns. In the analysis of domestic web news, there was optimism about improved learning efficiency and personalized education through AI-based English education, but economic burdens and concerns about the integration of such tools in public education were also highlighted. Conclusions By comprehensively presenting both expectations and concerns based on prior domestic and inter national research and domestic web news analysis, this study aims to provide a new direction for future research and effective implementation of English AIDT.

title_ko: A Study on Korean EFL Students’ Perceptions of ChatGPT Feedback in Argumentative Writing
title_en: A Study on Korean EFL Students’ Perceptions of ChatGPT Feedback in Argumentative Writing
kw_en: ChatGPT feedback; Korean EFL students; Argumentative writing; Perceptions; AI-assisted writing
abstract_ko: This study explores how Korean EFL university students perceive ChatGPT-generated feedback in the context of argumentative writing, focusing not only on its surface-level utility but also on its emotional and pedagogical impact. Using a mixed-methods design with a quantitative emphasis, 31 students completed two writing tasks, revised them using ChatGPT, and reflected on their experience through a structured survey and reflective journal. The findings reveal a clear preference for feedback related to grammar and vocabulary, while students were more skeptical of higher-order suggestions, such as content development or idea organization. Correlational analysis showed that students’ emotional responses were strongly tied to their perceptions of technical reliability and functional usefulness. While learners appreciated ChatGPT’s efficiency, they expressed concerns about its accuracy and long-term impact on writing autonomy. Thematic analysis of reflections underscored a dual perception of ChatGPT as both a helpful assistant and a source of ethical tension. These insights highlight the need to move beyond binary views of AI in education and instead focus on supporting learners in critically evaluating, adapting, and responsibly integrating AI-generated feedback into their writing processes.

title_ko: 대학생 학습자의 영어 성취도에 따른 ChatGPT 활용과 학습 경험 분석
title_en: Analysis of ChatGPT Usage and Learning Experiences among University Students Based on English Proficiency Levels
kw_en: chatGPT; educational technology; English proficiency; English learning experience; university students
abstract_ko: This study investigates how university students, with different levels of English proficiency, use and perceive ChatGPT as an English learning tool. It also examines its impact on various language skills and affective factors. A mixed-methods approach was used, with 102 students divided into high- and low-proficiency groups based on an English proficiency test. Findings indicate that high-proficiency students used ChatGPT more frequently, primarily for essay writing and reading analysis, while low-proficiency students focused on grammar and vocabulary practice. High-proficiency students rated ChatGPT as more effective for language learning and perceived more significant improvement in learning ability, confidence, and motivation, as well as in reading, writing, and grammar. However, no significant difference was found in listening, speaking, or translation. Students valued ChatGPT for grammar correction, instant feedback, and writing support, but noted limitations in accuracy, translation quality, feedback consistency, and speech functionality. These findings highlight the need for proficiency-based AI learning strategies and improvements in ChatGPT’s capabilities.

title_ko: A Comparative Study on English Writing Feedback from ChatGPT, Chinese English Teacher, and Native English Teacher
title_en: A Comparative Study on English Writing Feedback from ChatGPT, Chinese English Teacher, and Native English Teacher
kw_en: ChatGPT; human teacher feedback; feedback amount; feedback focus; feedback types
abstract_ko: The study provides a comprehensive analysis of English writing feedback from ChatGPT, a Chinese English teacher, and a native English teacher in terms of feedback amount, feedback focus, and feedback types. This paper aims to investigate ChatGPT’s potential to complement human teachers from different backgrounds. Twenty two argumentative essays written by Chinese college students were collected and the feedback from the three feedback sources were analyzed across seven dimensions. The results indicate that the native English teacher provided a larger amount of feedback than either ChatGPT or the Chinese English teacher. The three feedback sources (raters) exhibited distinct feedback focuses: ChatGPT prioritizes content relevance, the Chinese English teacher emphasized grammar, and the native English teacher focused on coherence & cohesion. Additionally, ChatGPT and human teachers displayed tendencies towards using different feedback types when evaluating the students’ writing compositions. Based on the research findings, the paper suggests a collaborative approach that integrates ChatGPT and human teachers for more effective student writing feedback.

title_ko: AI 피드백 효용성이 영어 쓰기 성취감에 미치는 영향
title_en: The Impact of AI Feedback Efficacy on English Writing Achievement
kw_en: AI Feedback; Efficacy; Achievement; AI Tool; AWE; English Writing
abstract_ko: 본 연구에서는 대학 영어쓰기 수업에서 AI 툴이 제공하는 피드백을 활용하였을 때 학습자가 인식하는 피드백 효용감이 쓰기 자신감, AI 툴 만족도, 쓰기 성취감의 영향 관계를 구조방정식 모델을 활용하여 검증해보고자 하였다. 쓰기 과정에서 학습자들은 초안을 작성하고 초안에 대한 AI 툴의 피드백을 받아서 그것을 바탕으로 최종 작문을 과제로 제출하였다. 학기말에 설문응답을 통해 최종 99명으로부터 데이터를 수집하여 SmartPLS로 분석하였다. 효용감, 자신감, 성취감의 항목은 문법, 어휘, 문장구조, 문단구성, 구두점, 내용, 전체적인 작문 등으로 구성되었다. 분석 결과, AI 피드백에 대한 효용감은 학습자들의 영어 작문 자신감과 AI 도구에 대한 만족도에 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤으나, 학업 성취감에는 직접적인 영향을 미치지 않았다. 한편, AI 피드백 효용감은 쓰기 자신감을 매개로 쓰기 성취감에 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤으나, 쓰기 자신감과 AI 툴 만족도를 동시에 매개로 할 경우에는 학업 성취감에 영향을 미치지 않는 것으로 나타났다. 이러한 결과를 바탕으로 AI피드백의 활용 수업에서 교수자와 학습자의 역할, 그리고 AI 툴의 발전 방향을 논하였다.
abstract_en: This study uses a structural equation model to examine the perceived usefulness of AI-generated feedback in a college English writing course to determine the impact of AI on writing confidence, the satisfaction with AI tools, and the extent of writing achievement. During the writing process, students drafted compositions, received AI-generated feedback on their drafts, and submitted a final version based on that feedback. Data were collected from 99 students through surveys conducted at the end of the semester, which were analyzed using SmartPLS. The constructs of perceived usefulness, confidence, and achievement included aspects such as grammar, vocabulary, sentence structure, paragraph organization, punctuation, content, and overall writing. Results show that the perceived usefulness of AI feedback positively influenced writing confidence and students' satisfaction with AI tools, but did not have a direct impact on writing achievement. However, perceived usefulness indirectly influenced writing achievement through writing confidence as a mediating factor. In contrast, when both writing confidence and AI tool satisfaction were included as mediators, the effect on writing achievement was not significant. Based on these findings, this study discusses the roles of instructors and students in AI-assisted writing instruction, as well as future directions for AI tool development.
note: AWE 피드백 효용감-자신감-성취감 구조방정식 설문

title_ko: EFL College Students’ Use of ChatGPT in English Learning: Insights from a Class Assignment
title_en: EFL College Students’ Use of ChatGPT in English Learning: Insights from a Class Assignment
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 생성형 AI; 프롬프트 엔지니어링; AI 매개 상호작용
kw_en: EFL; ChatGPT; generative AI; prompt engineering; AI-mediated interaction
abstract_ko: This study explored how a group of EFL students interacted with ChatGPT for an elective English class assignment, focusing on their engagement patterns and perceptions. While most students viewed ChatGPT as helpful for English learning, the majority used it for basic editing or content generation, with limited engagement in ways that promote language development. By analyzing actual prompt-response records, this study provides an empirical look into how EFL learners use generative AI in practice. A typology of three interaction types: editing support, translation use, and interactive engagement was revealed based on students' prompt-response records. Although a few students demonstrated more iterative use of ChatGPT, their interactions often aimed at task completion rather than deliberate language practice. The findings highlight a gap between students’ perceived benefits of generative AI tools and their effective use for meaningful learning. The study also underscores the need for explicit, guided instruction on how to use ChatGPT not merely as a content generator, but as a learning partner, and practical teaching suggestions are included.

title_ko: 인공지능 활용 글쓰기의 윤리적 쟁점 탐색 - 표절 문제를 중심으로 -
title_en: Exploring the Ethical Issues in AI-Assisted Writing - Focusing on plagiarism -
kw_ko: 인공지능 활용 글쓰기 윤리; 글쓰기 윤리의 범주; 디자인 씽킹; AI 활용과 AI 표절
kw_en: ethics of AI-assisted writing; categories of writing ethics; design thinking; AI use and AI plagiarism
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 AI 활용 글쓰기의 윤리적 쟁점을 표절 문제를 중심으로 탐색하고, 교육의 영역에서 이에 대한 실질적인 대응 방안을 모색할 수 있는 기반을 마련하고자 하였다. 이를 위해 디자인 씽킹이라는 방법을 활용하여 표절 판정 시나리오를 탐색하고 AI 표절 판정 기준과 범위 히트맵의 프로토타입을 개발하였다. 본고에서 제시한 AI 표절 판정의 기준은 출처 표기의 명확성, (인간) 필자의 글 생성 관여 정도이다. 프로토타입을 기반으로 표절 가능성을 4가지 유형(명백한 표절, 표절 가능성 높음, 표절 가능성 낮음, 표절 아님)으로 구분하고, 각 유형을 ‘느슨한 입장’, ‘중간적 입장’, ‘엄격한 입장’에서 바라볼 경우 AI 활용과 AI 표절을 어떻게 판정할 수 있는지를 이론적으로 탐색하였다. 그 과정에서 도출된 AI 활용 글쓰기 윤리의 추가 쟁점은 출처 표기 방식, 프롬프트 작성 능력과 글쓰기 능력의 관계, AI 활용 글쓰기 상황에 따른 윤리적 기준의 유동성 문제이다. 이상의 논의가 AI 활용 글쓰기 윤리 실천으로 이어지기 위해서는 이론적 논의를 적용한 교육 기관의 적극적인 가이드라인 마련, 법적·제도적 장치 마련뿐 아니라 글쓰기 공동체의 합의도 필요할 것이다. 본고가 이를 위한 토대 마련에 기여할 수 있기를 바란다.
abstract_en: This study highlighted the lack of guidance on writing ethics and plagiarism prevention amid the growing use of generative AI and associated risks. Focusing on plagiarism, it explored ethical issues in AI-assisted writing and proposed educational responses. Using design thinking, the study examined plagiarism judgment scenarios and developed a prototype heatmap outlining AI plagiarism criteria and boundaries. Two main standards were proposed: (1) clarity of source attribution, and (2) the human writer’s involvement in text generation. The study classified plagiarism risk into four categories—clear plagiarism, high, low, and not plagiarism—and examined how AI-generated texts are judged from lenient, moderate, and strict perspectives. Additional ethical concerns related to AI writing were also identified. To effectively implement AI writing ethics, educational institutions must provide explicit guidelines, alongside legal frameworks and consensus within writing communities. This study aimed to lay the groundwork for such efforts.
note: AI 글쓰기 표절 윤리 쟁점 이론적 탐색, 수업·학습자 적용 없음

title_ko: 수학·영어 AIDT 구현 사례를 통한 사회과 AI 디지털 교과서(AIDT)의 연구 과제와 방향
title_en: Research Agenda and Directions for Social Studies AI Digital Textbooks (AIDT) through the Case Analysis of Math and English AIDT Implementation
kw_ko: AI 디지털 교과서; 사회과교육; 수학 AIDT; 영어 AIDT; 생성형 AI
kw_en: AI Digital Textbook; Social Studies Education; Mathematics AIDT; English AIDT; Generative AI
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 수학·영어 교과의 인공지능 디지털 교과서(AIDT) 구현 사례를 비판적으로 분석하고, 사회과 AIDT의 설계 방향과 주요 연구 과제를 도출하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 최근 AIDT는 학습자의 수준에 맞는 개인화 학습, 실시간 피드백, 탐구 유도 기능을 갖춘 미래형 교육 플랫폼으로 주목받고 있으며, 수학과 영어를 중심으로 2025년 도입이 추진되고 있다. 본 연구는 국내 초등교사 커뮤니티에서 수집된 784건의 현장 의견을 텍스트 코딩 분석하여, 수학 AIDT의 반복 중심 알고리즘, 영어 AIDT의 문화 맥락 결여 등 기술적·교육적 한계를 체계적으로 정리하였다. 이러한 분석을 통해 사회과 AIDT는 단순한 기술 이식이 아닌, 교과 고유의 사고 구조와 시민적 교육 목표에 부합하는 독자적 설계 원리를 필요로 함이 드러났다. 이에 본 연구는 사회과 AIDT 설계의 주요 방향으로, 첫째 영역별 사고 구조 기반 기술 분기, 둘째 설명 가능한 AI와 윤리적 피드백 구조, 셋째 지역성과 참여를 강조한 탐구 기반 시나리오, 넷째 협력적 상호작용 기반 협력학습 환경 조성을 제안하였다. 특히 4단계 AIDT 수업 설계 모델과 실제 단원(‘지역의 변화’) 적용 시나리오를 제시함으로써 실천 가능성과 교육적 타당성을 함께 확보하고자 하였다.
abstract_en: This study aims to critically examine the implementation cases of AI Digital Textbooks (AIDT) in mathematics and English education and to propose theoretical directions and practical research agendas for designing social studies AIDT. While AIDT is emerging as a future-oriented educational platform offering personalized learning, real-time feedback, and inquiry-based functions, early implementations reveal critical limitations such as repetitive algorithms in math and lack of cultural contextualization in English. Based on a text coding analysis of 784 responses from Korea’s largest elementary teacher community, this study identifies key pedagogical and technological concerns that must be addressed. Unlike subjects with clear-cut answers or linguistic performance goals, social studies require context-sensitive, value-laden, and multi-perspective learning. Accordingly, this paper proposes four core directions: (1) domain-specific algorithm branching based on disciplinary cognitive structures; (2) implementation of explainable and ethically-guided AI; (3) scenario-based inquiry models emphasizing locality and participation; and (4) collaborative learning environments encouraging civic engagement. A four-stage AIDT-based instructional design model and a lesson scenario applied to the elementary unit “Changes in Our Region” are presented to demonstrate both theoretical coherence and practical feasibility.
note: 사회과 AIDT 설계 방향이 목적, 영어 AIDT는 사례일 뿐

title_ko: EFL Student Engagement with ChatGPT in College Reading Classes via Prompts and Perceptions
title_en: EFL Student Engagement with ChatGPT in College Reading Classes via Prompts and Perceptions
kw_en: ChatGPT; generative AI; prompts; perceptions; college English
abstract_ko: This study explored EFL students’ interactions with ChatGPT, focusing on their prompting practices and perceptions towards ChatGPT in a college English class. A total of 36 university freshmen enrolled in English classes at a university participated in this study. Conversation logs from Weeks 4, 9, and 13 and Week 14 questionnaire responses were collected. Eleven prompt types were identified and analyzed for frequency, and Chi-squared tests examined prompt usage differences over time. Questionnaire data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and independent samples t-tests, while qualitative responses were interpreted using grounded theory to examine students’ opinions. Findings showed that students generated 11 prompt types, with information requests related to assigned passages being most frequent and increasing over time. Prompts for word definitions and sentence editing were also common, though their usage varied across three worksheets. Students revealed positive attitudes toward ChatGPT, valuing its fast responses, ease of use, and support for reading, writing, vocabulary, and grammar skills. However, challenges such as repetitive inquiry patterns, information overload from ChatGPT, and limited support for advanced grammar concepts were noted. The study underscores the importance of fostering prompt literacy in AI-supported language classes, helping students craft precise prompts and engage actively with ChatGPT. Despite limitations, the findings highlight ChatGPT’s potential as a supplementary tool for language learning. Future research should expand to diverse student groups, use standardized assessments, and conduct longitudinal studies to track changes in language proficiency and ChatGPT usage over time, further enhancing its integration into language education.

title_ko: 중학생의 의사소통 능력 향상을 위한AI와 디지털 테크놀로지의 통합적 활용 방법의 효과
title_en: Effectiveness of AI and digital technology integration in enhancing English communicative skills of middle school students
kw_ko: 인공지능; 챗봇; 디지털 테크놀로지; AI 통합; 영어 의사소통 능력
kw_en: AI; Chatbot; Digital Technology; AI-Integrated; English Communicative Skills
abstract_ko: This study examined whether integrating AI and digital technology can enhance English communicative competence. A technology-integrated instructional method was implemented over 10 weeks with 168 ninth graders, using Gliglish, VoiceTube, Lyricstraining, Padlet, etc. Pre and post-tests, along with surveys, were completed to monitor improvements in English skills and changes in students’ attitudes towards learning English. In addition, 27 students were interviewed to explore the advantages and limitations of the technology-integrated instruction. The results were as follows. First, the paired t-test indicated overall gains in English skills, and statistically significant improvements were found in the beginner and intermediate groups, whereas the advanced group showed no significant change. Second, the survey results revealed that the application of AI and digital tools increased students’ interest in speaking English and enhanced learner motivation. However, students still lacked confidence in speaking English with other people, implying that a longer practice period is necessary. Third, technology-integrated instruction offered several advantages: increased opportunities for English conversation, interactions with human-like partners, reduced anxiety, and immediate feedback. Nonetheless, challenges were also reported, including the complexity of unfamiliar digital tools and initial adaptation difficulties. These findings suggest the need for systematic implementation and continuous teacher support for effective AI-integrated instruction.

title_ko: Translating with ChatGPT to Understandthe Perfect Tense
title_en: Translating with ChatGPT to Understandthe Perfect Tense
kw_ko: ChatGPT-assisted learning(ChatGPT를 활용한 학습); Perfect Tenses(완료시제); Metalinguistic Awareness(메타언어 인식); AI(인공지능); Grammar Comprehension(문법적 이해력)
abstract_ko: This study explored the effectiveness of ChatGPT-generated translations as a tool to assess Korean EFL learners’ understanding of English perfect tenses. Learners evaluated the grammatical accuracy of English sentences generated by ChatGPT based on Korean source texts. Results showed that learners better understood past perfect and future perfect tenses, especially when clear temporal markers were present, while present perfect and perfect progressive forms were more challenging. Learners who preferred ChatGPT-assisted learning performed better than those using traditional grammar-based methods, suggesting that AI can enhance both comprehension and metalinguistic reflection. The findings indicate that integrating AI tools into instruction can help bridge the gap between grammatical form and contextual meaning. Future research should examine whether these benefits extend to productive skills such as speaking and writing, and whether gains are sustained over time. Expanding the approach to other grammar areas and exploring how learners interact with AI could offer deeper insight into the cognitive and pedagogical impact of AI-assisted language learning.

title_ko: 기계번역을 활용한 그리스어 명령법 교수-학습법 제안
title_en: A proposal for teaching and learning Greek imperatives using machine translation
kw_ko: 현대그리스어; 명령법; 기계번역
kw_en: modern Greek; imperative; machine translation; ελληνική γλώσσα; προστακτική; μηχανική μετάφραση
abstract_ko: This study explores a pedagogical approach to learning modern Greek imperative forms using machine translation and evaluates its relevance in language education. While imperatives frequently appear in textbooks and exams, they present challenges for beginners, highlighting the need for effective instruction. Machine translation can serve as a practical learning aid in this context. The study has two key aims: evaluating the quality of Greek-to-Korean imperative sentence translations from Google Translate and DeepL, and identifying effective learning activities for helping students recognize and acquire imperative forms, specifically in instructional texts. The analysis shows that although machine translation captures core meanings, it struggles with contextually accurate expressions and complex syntax. The study suggests using machine translation to familiarize beginners with imperative forms and support intuitive learning. For more advanced learners, comparing machine and human translations can promote deeper grammatical understanding. Ultimately, machine translation can function not only as a translation tool but also as a means for linguistic analysis and grammar awareness in second language learning.

title_ko: 영어 학습자와 AI 쓰기 튜터 챗봇의 상호작용에 나타나는 대화 전략 사용 양상
title_en: Situated use of conversation strategies in interactions between English learners and AI writing tutor chatbots
kw_ko: 인공지능 챗봇; 영어 과정 기반 쓰기; 대화 전략; 언어 조정; 중학교 영어 학습자
kw_en: AI chatbot; English process-based writing; conversation strategy; linguistic modification; middle school learner
abstract_ko: This study investigates the conversation strategies that Korean middle school English learners employ when interacting with AI-based writing tutor chatbots. A total of 79 eighth-grade students at a middle school in Seoul engaged in English process writing tasks with ChatGPT API-powered writing tutor chatbots, composing an argumentative and an expository essay. Their dialogues during the pre-writing and drafting stages were analyzed using content analysis, with a focus on linguistic modification strategies within situated writing contexts. The results reveal that learners actively interacted with the AI writing tutor chatbots, employing various strategies to refine chatbot responses, clarify misunderstandings, and negotiate meaning. These strategies demonstrated both backward- and forward-oriented approaches, allowing students to iteratively improve their writing through dynamic interaction. Based on these findings, the study provides pedagogical recommendations for optimizing AI chatbot-mediated conversations in L2 English writing instruction.

kw_en: Vietnamese; translation; teaching; ChatGPT; Korean; Tiếng Việt; dịch thuật; giảng dạy; người Hàn Quốc
abstract_ko: Thời đại trí tuệ nhân tạo hiện nay, nhu cầu được hiểu biết, thông suốt giữa các ngôn ngữ đã là bối cảnh cho sự ra đời của nhiều ứng dụng dịch thuật tự động nhằm hỗ trợ cho các hoạt động thường ngày của con người. Trong thời đại này, dịch thuật với sự hỗ trợ của các công cụ AI có thể trở thành phương tiện để xây dựng các phương pháp giảng dạy ngoại ngữ mới. Theo đó, những người làm công tác giảng dạy ngoại ngữ cần tìm kiếm mối quan hệ cùng tồn tại và trang bị cho mình khả năng sử dụng những công cụ này một cách sáng tạo trong lớp học. Ứng dụng công cụ hỗ trợ dịch thuật AI trong lớp học tiếng Việt dành cho người học là người Hàn Quốc cũng nằm trong xu thế tương tự. Dựa trên bối cảnh đó, bài báo này so sánh và phân tích kết quả dịch thuật các văn bản từ tiếng Hàn sang tiếng Việt để đưa ra một số ý kiến về ứng dụng công cụ dịch thuật AI trong giảng dạy tiếng Việt cho người học là người Hàn Quốc. Sau khi so sánh và phân tích các văn bản dịch thuật do ChatGPT và do con người tác nghiệp, bài báo đã đưa ra một số ý kiến thảo luận và đề xuất liên quan đến đối tượng người học, vai trò của giáo viên và định hướng lựa chọn văn bản dịch thuật để sử dụng trong quá trình giảng dạy tiếng Việt cho người học là người Hàn Quốc.
abstract_en: In the era of artificial intelligence, the need for cross-linguistic communication has led to the development of various automatic translation applications that support daily activities. Translation supported by AI tools is emerging as a potential foundation for new approaches to foreign language education. Language teachers today are required to find effective ways to integrate these technologies into their classrooms and use them creatively. The application of AI translation tools in Vietnamese language classes for Korean learners is part of this growing trend. Within this context, the present article compares and analyzes translations from Korean to Vietnamese to explore the use of AI tools in Vietnamese language teaching for Korean learners. By examining translation outputs generated by ChatGPT and by human translators, the article offers insights and suggestions regarding the target learners, the role of teachers, and the criteria for selecting appropriate texts for use in the classroom.

title_ko: 영어 학습자의 발음 취약점 분석과 대규모 언어 모델을 활용한 멀티모달 기반 문장 생성 시스템
title_en: A Multimodal Sentence Generation System Using an LLM for Analyzing Pronunciation Weaknesses of English Learners
kw_en: Phonetic Analysis; Text Generation; Multimodal; Language Model; LLM; Voice Recognition
abstract_ko: 영어 학습자의 발음 능력 향상을 위해 맞춤형 피드백과 취약한 발음에 대한 반복적인 연습을 제공하는 것이 효과적이다. 그러나 이러한 맞춤형 피드백 기반 학습 자료를 지속적으로 제공하는 시스템을 구현하는 데는 시간과 비용 측면에서 많은 제약이 따른다. 특히, 수작업으로 이루어지는 평가와 지도는 많은 자원을 필요로 하며, 대규모 학습 환경에서 적용하기 어렵다는 한계가 있다. 본 연구에서는 이러한 문제를 해결하고자 음성 인식 모델과 대규모 언어 모델을 결합한 멀티모달 문장 생성 시스템을 제안한다. 제안된 시스템은 학습자의 발음을 음소 단위에서 분석하여 유창성, 정확성, 취약성을 평가한 후, 이를 바탕으로 개별 학습자의 발음 개선을 위한 맞춤형 학습 문장을 자동으로 생성한다. 이를 통해 학습자는 특정 발음 오류를 집중적으로 교정할 수 있다. 제안한 시스템의 효과를 검증하기 위해 20명의 학습자를 대상으로 실험을 수행한 결과, 학습자의 발음 약점을 보완하고 영어 발음 능력 향상에 효과적임을 확인하였다. 나아가, 본 연구에서 제안한 접근 방식은 확장성이 뛰어나며, 비용 효율적인 발음 학습 솔루션으로서의 가능성을 보여준다.
abstract_en: Providing English learners with personalized feedback and repeated practice on weak pronunciation is effective for improving their pronunciation skills. However, continuously offering personalized feedback-based materials is limited by time and cost constraints. In particular, manual evaluation and instruction require substantial resources, making it difficult to apply such approaches to large-scale learning environments. To address these challenges, this study proposes a multimodal sentence generation system that integrates a speech recognition model with a large language model (LLM). The proposed system analyzes learners' phoneme-level pronunciation based on fluency, accuracy, and weaknesses, and generates personalized learning sentences based on the analysis to support improvement in an individual learner's pronunciation. This enables learners to focus on correcting specific pronunciation errors. Experimental results from a study involving 20 English students demonstrate that the proposed method effectively addresses pronunciation weaknesses and significantly improves pronunciation skills. Furthermore, the proposed approach shows strong scalability, and holds potential as a cost-effective pronunciation learning solution.

title_ko: 대학생의 영어 말하기 능력 평가를 위한 AI 플랫폼 활용 루브릭 개발 연구
title_en: A Study on the Development of Rubrics Using AI Platforms for Assessing University Students’ English Speaking Proficiency
kw_ko: AI 플랫폼 활용 평가; 루브릭; 영어 말하기 평가; EFL 대학생; 채점
kw_en: AI platform-based assessment; rubric; English-speaking assessment; EFL university students; scoring
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study was to develop and apply AI platform-based assessment criteria to ensure consistent and objective evaluation of university students’ English-speaking proficiency. It also aimed to verify the reliability and validity of AI-generated evaluations by comparing them with instructor assessments. Accordingly, this study examined fifteen AI-assisted English interview test responses produced by five students at the beginning, middle, and end of the semester. The collected data were analyzed using the developed rubrics based on the TOEFL iBT speaking scoring criteria, and AI platforms such as TurBoScribe, Coh-Metrix, and Grammarly were used to measure four key aspects: fluency, variety, coherence, and accuracy. The research findings revealed that the instructor and AI evaluations were highly consistent in fluency, variety, and accuracy, while significant differences were noted in coherence. These findings suggest that instrumental support via AI platforms can significantly aid in maintaining consistency and objectivity when evaluating English-speaking proficiency. Based on the research findings, this study also proposes practical educational implications for integrating AI platforms in future English language classrooms.

title_ko: Prompt Engineering for Writing Revision: EFL Students’ Interactions with ChatGPT-3.5 for Effective Grammar and Reformulation Feedback
title_en: Prompt Engineering for Writing Revision: EFL Students’ Interactions with ChatGPT-3.5 for Effective Grammar and Reformulation Feedback
kw_en: EFL students; AI literacy; ChatGPT-3.5; prompt engineering; grammar correction; text reformulation; writing feedback
abstract_ko: This study investigates how Chinese EFL students negotiate prompts with ChatGPT-3.5 to obtain effective writing feedback on grammar correction and text reformulation. Based on qualitative case studies of four exchange students, the research highlights how students’ iterative prompt revisions shape the accuracy and usefulness of AI-generated feedback. Students with higher AI literacy demonstrated greater ability to refine prompts, resulting in feedback that better aligned with their language learning goals, while less experienced users required more attempts to achieve satisfactory results. These findings underscore the importance of explicitly integrating AI literacy instruction— especially prompt engineering—into EFL writing curricula. Educators should equip students with foundational prompting strategies to help them engage more effectively with AI tools like ChatGPT and foster greater learner autonomy in writing development.

title_ko: 고등학교 영어 교과서와 ChatGPT 생성 텍스트의 어휘 및 구문 특성 비교: 코퍼스 기반 분석
title_en: A Corpus-Based Comparison of Lexical and Syntactic Features in High School English Textbooks and ChatGPT-Generated Texts
kw_ko: 고등학교 영어 교과서/ChatGPT/생성형 인공지능/어휘 다양성/코퍼스
kw_en: high school English textbook/ChatGPT/generative AI/lexical diversity/corpus
abstract_ko: This study empirically examines the strengths and limitations of generative AI texts as supplementary educational resources by comparing the lexical and syntactic features of high school English textbooks with those of texts generated by ChatGPT. A parallel corpus comprising 47 passages from ten government-authorized textbooks and their AI-generated counterparts was compiled for analysis. Four linguistic metrics were analyzed: number of word types, standardized type-token ratio (STTR), mean word length (MWL), and mean sentence length (MSL). WordSmith Tools 7.0 was used for corpus analysis, and statistical significance was assessed through independent t-tests. The results showed that while textbook passages contained a greater number of word types, ChatGPT texts demonstrated higher lexical diversity and longer mean word length. No significant difference was observed in sentence length. These findings suggest that AI-generated texts can offer enriched lexical input while maintaining structural clarity, thus serving as effective supplementary materials in classroom instruction. The study offers both theoretical insights and practical implications for integrating generative AI into secondary English education, especially for enhancing vocabulary exposure and expanding learner-centered reading resources.

title_ko: An Exploratory Study on English Pre-service Teachers’ AI Literacy
title_en: An Exploratory Study on English Pre-service Teachers’ AI Literacy
kw_ko: 인공지능(AI); AI 리터러시; AI 교육; 영어과 예비교사; 고등 교육
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI); AI literacy; AI education; English pre-service teachers (PSTs); higher education
abstract_ko: To explore the Artificial Intelligence(AI) literacy of English pre-service teachers (PSTs), this study investigated their interest in AI, recognition of necessity, knowledge, and attitudes of AI, difficulty in learning AI, prior AI learning experience, and the type of AI learning. As a result of an online survey with 75 PSTs, the participants were interested in AI and felt the necessity of AI in English education. In particular, English PSTs with prior AI learning experience strongly desired to further develop their knowledge and skills. They felt the necessity for AI education in English education more than their counterparts without prior AI learning experience. However, there was no difference according to the type of AI education. In addition, it was investigated that English PSTs with prior AI learning experience were more familiar with how to use AI among the knowledge of AI than those without such experience. However, there was no influence by the type of AI learning. In addition, when asked about difficulties in AI learning, PSTs responded that they lacked coding knowledge, math knowledge, and opportunities for AI education. English PSTs without AI learning experience felt relatively greater difficulties due to a lack of computer knowledge. In other words, their prior AI learning experience influenced the AI literacy of English PSTs, but the type of AI learning experience did not. This study suggested that AI-related courses should be developed in teacher training institutions for AI literacy of English PSTs.

title_en: Étude sur la conception de prompts pour ChatGPT et leur application dans l’enseignement intégré de la langue et de la culture françaises à l’ère de l’intelligence artificielle
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 프롬프트 설계; 언어·문화 통합교육; 프랑스어 교육
kw_en: AI; ChatGPT; intelligence artificielle; conception de prompts; enseignement intégré langue-culture; enseignement du français
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 AI 시대 프랑스 언어·문화 통합교육에서 챗GPT의 교육적 활용 가능성을 탐색하고, 실제 교수·학습 환경에서 이를 효과적으로 적용할 수 있는 구체적인 방안을 제시하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 프랑스 언어·문화 통합교육 맥락에서 챗GPT 적용의 이론적 기반과 프롬프트 설계 전략을 고찰하고, 해당 전략을 수업에 실제 적용한 사례를 분석하였다. 그 결과, 학습자의 프랑스어 능력, 자기주도적 학습 능력, 비판적 사고력, 의사소통 능력, 디지털 리터러시 등 다양한 역량의 증진에 긍정적인 효과가 나타났다. 아울러, 정보 신뢰성의 한계, 문화적 맥락 반영의 부족, 프롬프트 설계의 복잡성 등도 과제로 확인되었다. 본 연구는 챗GPT의 실제 수업 적용 사례를 통해 교육적 가능성과 실천적 방향을 제시하였으며, 이는 프랑스 언어·문화 통합교육의 교수·학습 방향 모색에 유용한 기초 자료로 활용될 수 있다.
abstract_en: Dans un contexte marqué par le développement rapide de l’intelligence artificielle, cette étude a pour objectif d’examiner les potentialités pédagogiques de l’intégration de ChatGPT dans l’enseignement intégré de la langue et de la culture françaises, et de proposer des stratégies concrètes pour son emploi en situation réelle d’apprentissage. Pour ce faire, elle repose sur une analyse approfondie des fondements théoriques de l’usage de ChatGPT dans ce domaine, ainsi que sur une analyse de cas d’application en classe. Les résultats montrent que les activités fondées sur la conception de prompts ont contribué au développement de diverses compétences chez les apprenants, notamment linguistiques, interculturelles, communicationnelles, en pensée critique et numériques. Néanmoins, certaines limites ont été relevées, telles que le manque de fiabilité des réponses générées, la faible prise en compte des spécificités culturelles, ainsi que la complexité de la formulation efficace de prompts. En explorant à la fois les apports didactiques et les contraintes d’usage de ChatGPT, cette recherche entend constituer une base pour la réflexion pédagogique et la conception de dispositifs innovants dans l’enseignement du français en contexte intégré.
note: 프랑스 언어·문화 통합교육 챗GPT 프롬프트

title_ko: 인공지능․디지털 도구를 활용한 중등 영어 글쓰기 교육에서 교수자-학습자-인공지능 협업 수업 설계 전략 개발
title_en: Developing an instructor-learner-AI collaborative instructional design strategies for middle school english writing using AI and digital tools
kw_ko: 인공지능 협력; 수업 설계 전략; 영어 글쓰기 교육; 인공지능 통합 수업; 설계개발연구
kw_en: English writing; digital learning tools; artificial intelligence; instructor-learner-AI collaboration; design and development research
abstract_ko: 영어 쓰기 교육은 개별화된 피드백과 과정 중심 접근이 요구되지만, 현실적인 수업 제약과 학습 격차로 인해 그 실현에 어려움이 따른다. 최근 인공지능 기술을 활용하여 문법 교정, 협업 플랫폼 등이 교육 효과를 높일 수 있음이 보고되고 있으며, 단순한 기술 사용을 넘어 교수자-학습자-인공지능 간협력적 상호작용을 기반으로 수업 설계가 요구된다. 본 연구는 중등 영어 글쓰기 교육에서 인공지능 및 디지털 도구를 활용한 협력 기반 수업 설계 전략을 개발하였다. 설계․개발 연구(design and development research) 방법론을 적용하여 선행 문헌 고찰, 교수자 요구 분석, 사례 분석을 통해 초기 전략을 도출하고, 전문가 타당화(2회) 및 현직 교원 대상 사용성 검토를 통해 전략을 수정․보완하였다. 최종 전략은 글쓰기 과정을 주제 선정, 아이디어 생성, 아이디어 조직, 작문하기, 첨삭하기, 평가하기의 6단계로 구조화하고, 각 단계별 교수자, 학습자, 인공지능의 역할을 제시하였다. AI 도구로는ChatGPT, Grammarly, Google Docs의 AI 기능 등을 활용하여 주제 추천, 아이디어 확장, 문법 교정, 자동 피드백을 수행하였고, 교수자는 도구 활용 안내 및 추가 설명과 피드백을 담당하였다. 사용성 평가는 만족도, 구성 적절성, 효과성, 사용 용이성, 재사용 의사 등을 중심으로 4점 척도 설문으로 수행되었다. 그 결과, 본 전략은 학습자의 몰입도와 쓰기 능력 향상, 교수자의 수업 부담 경감에 기여함을확인하였다. 본 연구는 영어 쓰기 교육에서 디지털 도구와 AI를 통합한 구체적 수업 설계 틀을 제시하며, 교수자-학습자-인공지능이 유기적으로 상호작용하는 수업 구조의 가능성을 보여준다.
abstract_en: This study aimed to develop instructional strategies for middle school English writing education that facilitate collaboration among instructors, learners, and artificial intelligence (AI) using digital learning tools. Adopting a design and development research methodology, the study derived initial strategies through a literature review, instructor needs analysis, and case analysis, followed by two rounds of expert validation and usability testing with in-service teachers. The final instructional strategies structured the writing process into six stages: selecting a topic, generating ideas, organizing ideas, writing, revising, and evaluating. For each stage, specific roles and activities were clearly defined for instructors, learners, and AI. AI tools-including ChatGPT, Grammarly, and Google Docs' AI features-supported topic recommendation, idea generation, grammar correction, and feedback provision. Instructors guided students in using AI tools effectively and provided supplementary feedback and explanations. Usability testing employed a 4-point Likert-scale survey covering satisfaction, content appropriateness, perceived effectiveness, ease of use, and future use intention. Results indicated that the strategies enhanced learners’ engagement and writing performance while reducing instructors’ instructional workload. This study offers a concrete framework for integrating AI and digital tools into writing instruction and demonstrates the potential of collaborative, technology-enhanced language learning environments.

title_ko: A Study on Korean University Students’ English Writing and the Role of AI-based Learning tools in the Age of A.I. : based on Activity Theory
title_en: A Study on Korean University Students’ English Writing and the Role of AI-based Learning tools in the Age of A.I. : based on Activity Theory
kw_ko: AI 지원 글쓰기; 활동 이론; 영어 능력; 한국 대학 학생들; 다문화 역량
kw_en: AI-assisted writing; activity theory; English proficiency; Korean university students; intercultural competence
abstract_ko: This study examines the impact of generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools on the English writing of Korean university students. Using activity theory as a framework, the researcher examined the writing processes and outcomes of two groups of students: those with high English proficiency and those with above-average proficiency. Each student completed four writing tasks under different conditions: with AI, without AI, and with mixed access. The researcher collected writing samples, measured essay scores and sentence complexity, and conducted interviews. The results showed that when AI tools were allowed, both proficiency groups produced higher-scoring essays with more complex sentences. While average-proficiency students performed worse than high-proficiency students when AI was unavailable to both groups, high-proficiency students, when they did not use the AI, sometimes matched AI- enabled average-proficiency students. These findings suggest that AI can improve writing efficiency and complexity, but it may also create a tension between student autonomy and dependence on the tool. Additionally, AI support did not guarantee a deeper understanding of English-speaking cultures. Pedagogical implications suggest integrating AI into writing instruction through guided tasks that balance AI assistance with culture- focused learning. Future research would benefit from including larger samples that can more effectively support the findings of this study and from strategies that can foster cultural awareness alongside AI use.

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능과 검색엔진 활용이 초등학교 6학년의 쓰기에 미치는 영향 분석: 쓰기 수준 상위 집단과 하위 집단 간 비교를 중심으로
title_en: Effects of Generative AI and Search Engine Use on Sixth-Graders’ Writing: A Comparative Study
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능(GAI); 뤼튼; GAI를 활용한 글쓰기; 검색엔진을 활용한 글쓰기; 쓰기교육; 초등학생 논설문; 초등학생
kw_en: Generative AI; WRTN; Writing Using Generative AI; Writing Using Search Engines; Writing Education; Argumentative Writing Classes; Elementary School Students
abstract_ko: 본 연구에서는 초등학교의 국어 수업에서 생성형 인공지능을 활용할 때 학생들의 학습 과정 및 결과에 미치는 영향을 구체적으로 확인할 필요가 있다고 보았다. 초등학교 6학년 10명의 참여자를 대상으로 검색엔진을 활용하는 방식, GAI를 활용하는 방식으로 각각 논설문 쓰기 과정과 결과를 관찰하여 분석하였다. 연구문제는 기존처럼 검색엔진을 활용하는 경우와 GAI 중 하나인 뤼튼을 활용하는 경우에 참여자들의 쓰기 과정및 결과가 달라지는가, 그리고 그러한 차이에 쓰기 능력 수준에 따른 영향이 있는가이다. ‘검색 양상 및 자료 채택 양상’을 분석한 결과는 다음과 같다. 검색엔진을 활용할 때보다 뤼튼을 활용할 때 검색어나 프롬프트를 입력한 횟수인 검색 수가 증가하였다. 쓰기 상위 수준 참여자들이 검색어를보다 주체적으로 입력하였고, 검색한 자료를 활용하는 양상도 쓰기 수준에 따라 차이를 보였다. 자료 검색 도구를 활용한 결과를 어떻게 글에 반영하는지를 살펴본 결과, 초등학교 6학년 필자들이 GAI를 활용하여 논설문을 작성하는 활동에서 기존의 검색엔진을 활용할 때보다 ‘자료를 꼼꼼히 읽으며 소화하는 시간’을 덜 할애하며, 자료에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 자신만의 문장을 창안하는 비율이 낮으며, 자료로부터의 표절률이 높아진다는 사실을 확인하였다. 마지막으로 검색엔진을 먼저 활용한 후 뤼튼을 활용하여 논설문을 작성한 집단1과 뤼튼을 먼저 활용한 후 검색엔진을 활용하여 논설문을 작성한 집단2 간에 표절률을 비교한 결과, 집단2의 표절률이 집단1보다 유의하게 높아 뤼튼 활용에서의 부정적 쓰기 행동이 지속될 수 있음을 확인하였다. 이러한 부정적 영향은 쓰기 능력에서 상위 수준 참여자보다 하위 수준 참여자에게 더 분명하기는 하였지만, 쓰기 능력 수준과 상관없이 모두에게 나타났다. 이런 결과를 바탕으로초등학교 국어 수업에서 GAI를 활용하는 의사결정이 보다 신중하게 이루어져야 함을 논하였다.
abstract_en: This study investigated the impacts of utilizing generative artificial intelligence (genAI) in elementary Korean language classrooms, particularly focusing on students’ writing processes and outcomes. Two instructional approaches were applied in two sixth-grade argumentative writing classes. One class first utilized conventional search engines before introducing a genAI tool, WRTN, and the other utilized WRTN followed by search engines. The study explored whether students’ writing processes and outcomes differed when using traditional search engines versus WRTN, and whether these differences were influenced by the students’ levels of writing competency. Analysis of participants’ search behaviors and material adoption patterns revealed that the number of searches— here defined as the frequency of keyword or prompt inputs—increased when students used WRTN compared to conventional search engines. High-competency participants used search terms more actively and autonomously, and the ways participants incorporated the retrieved information also varied according to their writing competency. However, the analysis of how students applied the retrieved materials in their writing indicated that sixth-grade students spent less time carefully reading and digesting sources when using WRTN. They also generated fewer original sentences explaining their own understanding and exhibited higher rates of plagiarism. Furthermore, comparison between Class 1 (using search engines first, then WRTN) and Class 2 (using WRTN first, then search engines) revealed that Class 2 demonstrated significantly higher plagiarism rates. This indicated that the negative writing behaviors associated with genAI use may persist across tasks. While these effects were more pronounced among students with lower writing competency, the trend was observed across competency levels. Based on these findings, this study argues for more cautious, critical decision-making when integrating genAI tools into elementary Korean language instruction.
note: 초6 국어 논설문 뤼튼 vs 검색엔진 쓰기 과정·표절률 비교

title_ko: Metacognitive Strategy Use in AI-Assisted Writing: A Mixed-Methods Study of EFL College Students’ Dialogues with ChatGPT
title_en: Metacognitive Strategy Use in AI-Assisted Writing: A Mixed-Methods Study of EFL College Students’ Dialogues with ChatGPT
kw_en: metacognitive strategies; AI-assisted writing; EFL learners; ChatGPT; mixed-methods research; self-regulation; cognitive offloading
abstract_ko: This mixed-methods study critically examines how Korean EFL college students regulate their academic writing processes when integrating ChatGPT, with a focus on the tensions between strategic engagement, cognitive offloading, and learner autonomy. Thirty students participated in a five-week AI-supported writing program involving structured prompting and reflective activities. Data sources included pre-task questionnaires, ChatGPT interaction logs, and NVivo-coded dialogue analysis. Findings revealed that while students activated planning, monitoring, and evaluating strategies, strategy use varied significantly by proficiency level and writing phase. Advanced students employed AI to enhance strategic thinking, whereas lower-proficiency students increasingly offloaded linguistic and organizational tasks. Strikingly, despite high self-reported metacognitive engagement, actual strategy use declined over time, especially in goal setting and evaluation, suggesting a growing dependence on AI. Cluster analysis identified three distinct learner profiles (Cluster 1, Cluster 2, and Cluster 3), pointing to the need for differentiated scaffolding. Qualitative patterns further captured shifts in writer identity, emotional regulation, and critical stance toward AI-generated suggestions. These results call for explicit, sustained strategy instruction to mitigate cognitive offloading and to cultivate autonomous, critically engaged writers within AI-mediated academic environments.

title_ko: Enhancing Beginner-Level L2 Writing: Direct vs. Hybrid Feedback with L1 Support via ChatGPT
title_en: Enhancing Beginner-Level L2 Writing: Direct vs. Hybrid Feedback with L1 Support via ChatGPT
kw_en: L2 writing; direct feedback; hybrid feedback; uptake; ChatGPT
abstract_ko: This study investigates the effectiveness of direct and hybrid written corrective feedback (WCF), both supported by learners’ first language (L1), in enhancing beginner-level L2 writing. Drawing on data from 28 student drafts revised across three stages, the analysis focused on error patterns and uptake across five dimensions: content, organization, grammar, vocabulary, and mechanics. Results showed that hybrid feedback—combining explicit corrections with L1-based metalinguistic explanations—was particularly effective in reducing local errors. Vocabulary and mechanics demonstrated the most notable improvements, with mechanics errors fully resolved by the second revision. Hybrid feedback also achieved the highest overall uptake percentages, underscoring its strength in promoting surface-level accuracy. In contrast, uptake in global areas such as content and organization remained static at 50%, highlighting the continued challenge of improving higher-order writing skills. Grammar uptake was moderate but uneven, suggesting the need for more targeted, form-focused instruction. L1 support played a critical role in improving learners’ understanding of feedback and facilitating revision, especially for low-proficiency students. These findings emphasize the importance of balancing feedback on both global and local aspects of writing. Pedagogical implications include incorporating L1-mediated explanations, guided revision, and instructional scaffolding to support comprehensive writing development in beginner-level L2 learners.

title_ko: Leveraging AI Tools in English Education: ChatGPT and Machine Translation in Adult Writing Tasks
title_en: Leveraging AI Tools in English Education: ChatGPT and Machine Translation in Adult Writing Tasks
kw_en: AI tools; English education; ChatGPT; machine translation; writing proficiency
abstract_ko: This study examines the use of AI tools, specifically ChatGPT and machine translation systems, to enhance the writing proficiency of adult English learners. By leveraging AI-driven natural language processing, these tools offer immediate feedback on grammar, syntax, and structure. While AI aids in producing more accurate and coherent writing, the research also highlights potential drawbacks. A mixed-methods approach was used to assess the writing of 16 adult English learners completing email tasks, with and without AI assistance. Results show significant improvements in grammar and organization with AI, though students’ over-reliance and reduced creativity were noted. The study concludes that AI tools can support technical writing improvements but must be balanced with traditional methods that encourage autonomy, creativity, and independent skills.

title_en: Exploring the Effects of MyGPTs-Based Chatbot Design on Pre-Service English Teachers’ Prompt Literacy Competnece
kw_ko: 프롬프트 리터러시; 예비 영어교사; 마이지피티; 챗봇 설계; 교사 교육; 생성형 인공지능
kw_en: prompt literacy; pre-service English teachers; MyGPTs; chatbot design; teacher education; generative AI
abstract_ko: In the era of generative AI, an ability to communicate effectively with Large Language Models(LLMs) has become a crucial digital literacy in teacher education. This study investigates how the experience of designing educational chatbots using MyGPTs supports the development of new literacy skills and pedagogical practices among pre-service EFL teachers. Thirty pre-service teachers participated in a six-week workshop, engaging in chatbot planning, prompting, creation, testing, and reflection. Qualitative data, including chatbot creation logs, design documents, and reflective journals, were thematically analyzed to explore changes in the participants’ cognitive, affective, and instructional dimensions. Two major themes were identified: learner-centered design thinking and the development of prompt literacy, which refers to the ability to strategically create, revise, evaluate, and implement the results that AI provides to achieve pedagogical goals. The findings highlight the transformative potential of AI-integrated instructional design and call for the inclusion of prompt literacy in future-oriented teacher education programs.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 챗봇과 중학생의 영어 자유대화 학습경험 사례 분석
title_en: A Case Study on Middle School Students' Learning Experience in Free English Conversation with Generative AI Chatbots
kw_ko: 생성형 AI 챗봇; 영어 자유대화 학습경험; 영어 말하기 학습; ChatGPT API 활용
kw_en: Generative AI chatbot; Free English conversation learning experiences; English speaking practice; Utilization of ChatGPT API
abstract_ko: 목적 본 연구는 생성형 AI 챗봇과 중학생의 영어 자유대화 학습경험 사례 분석을 통해 생성형⋅음성 기반⋅대화형⋅목적형 챗봇의교수⋅학습적 가능성을 탐색하였다. 방법 Y사에서 개발한 영어 말하기 학습용 생성형 챗봇과 3명의 중학생 간에 이루어진 자유 대화 텍스트와 인터뷰를 동영상으로녹화한 후 전사한 자료를 분석하였다. 연구문제에 따라 텍스트 분석, 이독성 분석, 어휘분석, 토큰 수 분석, 감성분석 등 질적, 양적분석이 실행되었다. 결과 생성형 AI 기반의 챗봇은 적극적 발화 유도, 개인 맞춤형 대화 제공, 적응적 지원, 정서적 상호작용, 동기유발의 측면에서 모두기존의 규칙 기반 챗봇에 비해 더 나은 수행을 보이는 것으로 나타났다. 양적 분석 결과는 개인 맞춤형 대화와 정서적 상호작용을강하게 지지하였다. 결론 연구 결과는 생성형 AI를 활용한 챗봇이 영어 말하기 학습에 있어 일대일 튜터링을 보조할 수 있는 유용한 도구가 될 수 있음을시사한다.
abstract_en: Objectives This study explored the pedagogical potential of generative, voice-enabled, conversational, and goal-oriented chatbots for English teaching and learning by analyzing the free conversation experiences between a generative AI chatbot and middle school students. Methods Video-recorded free conversations between a generative English-speaking chatbot developed by Company Y and three middle school students were transcribed and analyzed. Based on the research questions, both qualitative and quantitative analyses were conducted, including text analysis, readability assessment, lexical analysis, token count, and sentiment analysis. Results The findings indicated that the generative AI-based chatbot outperformed traditional rule-based chat bots in terms of encouraging active verbal output, providing personalized conversations, offering adaptive sup port, facilitating emotional interactions, and enhancing learner motivation. Quantitative analysis particularly sup ported the chatbot’s effectiveness in personalized conversation and emotional interaction. Conclusions The results suggest that generative AI-powered chatbots can serve as valuable tools to supplement one-on-one tutoring in English speaking instruction.
