title_ko: AI 기반 말하기 앱의 효과성 분석과 대학 교양 영어에서의 활용 가능성 탐색 －비교과 프로그램 운영 결과를 중심으로
title_en: Effectiveness of an AI Speaking App and Its Pedagogical Applicability in University English Courses : A Case Study of a Extracurricular English Program
kw_ko: 교양 영어; AI 기반 영어 교육; AI 말하기 앱; 비교과 프로그램
kw_en: University English Class; AI based English Education; AI speaking app; English extracurricular program
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 AI 기반 말하기 앱을 활용한 비교과 영어 프로그램의 효과성을 실증적으로 분석하고, 대학 교양 영어 수업에서의 적용 가능성을 탐색하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위하여 A 대학교에서 AI 기반 말하기 앱인‘플랭(PLANG)’을 활용한 비교과 프로그램을 운영하고, 학습 결과와 만족도, 정의적효과 및 정규 수업 내 활용 가능성에 대하여 양적⋅질적 방법으로 분석하였다. 분석 결과, 비교과프로그램 평균 이수율은 55.1%, 평균 학습 지속 일수는 50.7일이었으며, 학습자 평균 레벨은 98포인트향상되어 말하기 역량 향상에 실질적인 효과가 있었음을 보여주었다. 학습자 만족도는 전체적으로높게 나타났으며, 학습 참여도, 학습 유용성 인식, 콘텐츠 적합성, 피드백 유용성, 재참여 및 추천 의향항목 모두에서 긍정적인 평가가 확인되었다. 정의적 영역 분석에서는 학습 자기효능감과 자신감이통계적으로 유의미하게 향상되었고, FGI 분석 결과 학습자들은 수준별 맞춤형 학습 제공, 실제 상황과유사한 회화 연습 가능성, 즉각적인 피드백 제공, 흥미와 재미를 유도하는 다양한 영상 콘텐츠 제공, 정규 수업의 보조적 활용 가능성 등에 대해 전반적으로 긍정적으로 인식하였다. 이러한 결과는 AI 기반 말하기 앱이 국내 교양 영어 수업의 구조적 문제를 보완할 수 있는 유의미한 교수학습 도구로서기능할 수 있음을 시사하며, 이를 바탕으로 AI 기반 말하기 앱을 정규 영어 수업에 효과적으로 통합하는방안을 제안하였다.
abstract_en: This study aims to examine the effectiveness of an English extracurricular program using an AI speaking application and to explore its applicability in university English classes. The program was conducted using PLANG, an AI speaking app, and data were collected through quantitative and qualitative methods, focusing on learning outcomes, learner satisfaction, affective changes, and potential classroom integration. The average completion rate was 55.1%, with an average study duration of 50.7 days. Learners’ speaking levels improved by an average of 98 points, indicating a positive impact on speaking ability. Satisfaction results showed high ratings in engagement, perceived effectiveness, content appropriateness, feedback usefulness, and willingness to reengage. Statistically significant improvements were observed in learning self-efficacy and confidence. Focus group interviews revealed positive perceptions regarding personalized learning, realistic speaking practice, immediate AI feedback, and engaging content. Learners also acknowledged the app’s potential to supplement regular English classes, while suggesting the need for careful instructional design. These findings suggest that AI speaking apps can be practical tools for addressing structural limitations in university English education and for enhancing individualized, affective, and skill-based learning.
note: PLANG 비교과 프로그램 이수·레벨·만족도·정의적 효과·FGI

title_ko: Korean EFL Learners’ Perceptions of Using ChatGPT for English Writing
title_en: Korean EFL Learners’ Perceptions of Using ChatGPT for English Writing
kw_en: ChatGPT; second language writing; EFL; perceptions; noticing
abstract_ko: This study explores Korean EFL (English as a foreign language) learners’ perceptions on the use of ChatGPT for English writing and which types of its feedback they focus on. Since ChatGPT’s inception in 2022, numerous studies have examined its use among English learners. However, few studies have investigated the specific types of feedback ChatGPT provides and how students perceive them. This study examines the extent to which students engage with different feedback types. To fulfill this purpose, 20 EFL students compared their original writing with ChatGPT-edited versions and wrote reflection notes on the differences throughout the semester. At the end of the semester, they also completed a questionnaire on the advantages and disadvantages of using ChatGPT in writing. The findings reveal that ChatGPT not only provided feedback on vocabulary and expressions but also clarified and elaborated on students’ writing. However, students primarily focused on vocabulary and expression replacements while often overlooking clarification and elaboration. Furthermore, exit questionnaire responses suggest that students’ distrust of AI tools like ChatGPT led them to view it as a supplementary writing aid rather than a learning resource. These findings highlight the need to raise students’ awareness of AI’s full capabilities to maximize its educational benefits.

title_ko: The Impact of an AI-Based Extracurricular English Learning Program on Learners' English Speaking Self-Efficacy, Interest, and AI Literacy
title_en: The Impact of an AI-Based Extracurricular English Learning Program on Learners' English Speaking Self-Efficacy, Interest, and AI Literacy
kw_ko: 비교과 영어학습 프로그램; 영어 말하기 자기효능감; 영어 말하기 흥미; AI 리터러시
kw_en: Extracurricular English learning program; English speaking self-efficacy; Interest in speaking English; AI literacy
abstract_ko: This study investigates the impact of an AI-based extracurricular English learning program on learners' self-efficacy in English speaking, interest levels, and AI literacy. Utilizing a mixed-methods approach, the research statistically analyzed changes in participant at A University and delved into their learning experiences through the examination of reflection journals. Over a 12-week period, participants practiced English speaking using the AI-based app. Plang. The findings indicated statistically significant enhancements in English speaking self-efficacy, interest, and AI literacy. Key factors contributing to these improvements included immediate AI feedback, repetitive practice, and context-based learning, which greatly boosted learners' confidence and engagement. Additionally, participants developed a positive attitude towards the use of AI technology as a learning tool. This study provides empirical evidence that AI-based English learning effectively enhances college students' English speaking skills and AI literacy.

title_ko: Exploring Semantic Prosody Through Natural Language Processing (NLP): L1 and L2 Use of the Lexical Bundle There Are So Many
title_en: Exploring Semantic Prosody Through Natural Language Processing (NLP): L1 and L2 Use of the Lexical Bundle There Are So Many
authors: 신유경(한림대학교); 신유진(서강대학교 영문학과); Munkhsaikhan Batmunkh(Sogang University); 최수인(서강대학교); 김혜인(서강대학교); 유원호(서강대학교)
kw_en: Semantic prosody; Lexical bundles; Argumentative writing; L1 and L2 novice writers; Natural language processing
abstract_ko: This study explores the semantic prosody of the lexical bundle (LB) there are so many in native and non- native novice English argumentative writing. While previous research on LBs has largely focused on their structural and functional patterns, this study shifts attention to their evaluative meanings in context. Using NLP-based sentiment analysis, it examines how this bundle conveys evaluative stance across two comparable corpora: one consisting of argumentative essays written by native English-speaking students and the other by Korean EFL learners. Both groups were incoming college freshmen who responded to the same prompts under identical time constraints. The results exhibited a clear difference in semantic prosody: native writers tended to use the bundle in neutral or positive contexts, often to hedge or provide examples, whereas non-native writers used it more frequently in negative contexts, which could lead to semantic incongruity or pragmatic misalignment. These findings move beyond existing accounts of LBs by highlighting the role of evaluative meaning. They suggest that L2 learners may benefit from explicit instruction on how stance is expressed in frequently occurring word sequences—an area particularly challenging for novice academic writers. This study highlights the value of sentiment-aware writing pedagogy, as informed by corpus-based insights into learner language.

title_ko: L2 Learners’ Strategies for Using Machine Translation in Narrative Writing
title_en: L2 Learners’ Strategies for Using Machine Translation in Narrative Writing
kw_en: machine translation; narrative; writing strategies; EFL
abstract_ko: This study explores how four female Mandarin Chinese-speaking L2 learners at a U.S. university engage with machine translation (MT) in English writing and develop strategies to navigate its affordances and limitations. The participants completed both MT-assisted and non-MT-assisted writing tasks. Using Activity Theory as a framework, the study qualitatively examines how MT functions as a mediating artifact, shaping students’ writing processes through technological affordances, academic expectations, and individual agency. The findings reveal that while most students used MT for grammar and lexical choice, one student critically assessed its limitations and actively sought alternative strategies, such as peer feedback and writing center support. The findings underscore the varied and strategic ways L2 learners engage with MT and highlight how contradictions in its use can foster meaningful adaptation. This study contributes to a deeper understanding of digital mediation in L2 writing and offers pedagogical implications for integrating MT to support learner autonomy and metalinguistic awareness.

title_ko: 생성형 AI(ChatGPT)를 활용한 일본어 문법 교육 : 효과와 한계에 대한 실증적 고찰
title_en: Japanese Grammar Instruction Using Generative AI (ChatGPT) : An Empirical Study on Its Effectieness and Limitations
kw_ko: 생성형AI; 일본어문법교육; 자기주도학습; 혼합형수업모델
kw_en: ChatGPT; Generative AI; Japanese Grammar Education; Self-Directed Learning; Hybird Instructional Model
abstract_ko: 오늘날 생성형 인공지능(Generative AI)의 비약적 발전은 교육 패러다임에 근본적인 변화를 초래하고 있으며, 특히 ChatGPT(Generative Pre-trained Transformer)와 같은 대화형 AI는 단순한 정보 전달을 넘어, 상호작용 기반의 학습 환경을 가능하게 한다는 점에서 언어교육 분야에서 주목받고 있다. 본 연구는 생성형 인공지능의 대표 사례인 ChatGPT를 일본어 문법 교육에 활용하였을 때의 교육적 기능과 잠재적 한계를 분석하는 데 목적이 있다. 연구는 일본어를 학습한 지 3개월 정도 지난 초급 학습자를 대상으로, ChatGPT의 문법적 설명 능력, 예문 생성력, 피드백의 적절성에 초점을 맞추어 실험을 설계하였다. 구체적으로 사전·사후 문법 이해도 테스트, 만족도 설문조사, 자유 서술 및 인터뷰를 통해 데이터를 수집하고 정량적·정성적으로 분석하였다. 그 결과 예문 제공, 반복 질문 가능성, 심리적 부담 감소 등의 장점을 긍정적으로 평가하였다. 반면, 설명의 일관성 부족, 문맥 판단력의 한계, 정교한 문법 개념 설명의 부재 등은 주요 한계로 지적되었다. 본 연구는 ChatGPT가 일본어 문법 교육에서 자기주도 학습을 촉진하는 보조 도구로서 효과적일 수 있음을 시사하며, 동시에 문법 교육의 질을 담보하기 위해서는 교사의 맥락적 설명과 피드백이 반드시 병행되어야 함을 강조한다. 본 연구가 향후 생성형AI와 교사의 역할을 상호 보완적으로 융합한 혼합형(hybird) 교육 모델의 기초 자료가 되길 기대한다.
abstract_en: This study investigates the effectiveness and limitations of ChatGPT in Japanese grammar instruction for beginner learners. Participants with around three months of Japanese learning experience engaged in tasks involving grammatical explanations, example sentences, and AI-generated feedback. Data were collected through tests, surveys, and interviews. Results showed that ChatGPT effectively supported learner engagement and reduced anxiety through accessible examples and repeatable interactions. However, issues such as inconsistent explanations, limited contextual awareness, and superficial handling of complex grammar were noted. The study concludes that while ChatGPT is a useful tool for self-directed learning, it cannot fully replace teacher-led instruction. It highlights the importance of integrating AI with human guidance to develop effective hybrid instructional models.

title_ko: 머신러닝 활용 초등영어 교과서 텍스트 군집화 및 그림책 텍스트 분류 연구
title_en: A machine-learning approach to clustering primary English textbook dialogues and classifying supplementary picture-book texts
kw_ko: 머신러닝; 텍스트 군집화; 텍스트 분류; 의사소통기능; 초등영어교육
kw_en: machine learning; text clustering; text classification; communicative functions; primary English education
abstract_ko: This study explores how machine-learning technique can enhance text selection in primary English education by clustering textbook dialogues according to their communicative functions and by classifying picture-book texts within the same framework. 484 dialogue texts from five publishers’ Grade 3~6 textbooks were vectorized and clustered with an unsupervised algorithm. 13 clusters aligned perfectly with a single communcative functions, while 32 clusters showed high concordance when second-most frequent function was also considered. The validated cluster labels served as training data in a logistic-regression classifier that assigned seven English picture books to curriculum-specified communicative functions. Four picture books were classified with high probability for a single function, confirming that models trained on textbook dialogues can credibly map out-of-textbook reading materials onto the curriculum. Educationally, the approach furnishes an objective tool for teachers to identify picture-book texts that reinforce the communicative goals of a given unit. More broadly, it demonstrates that quantitative text analytics can reveal latent connections between mandated textbooks and external resources, offering a scalable pathway toward more coherent and diversified input in primary English classrooms.

title_ko: 영어과 AI 융합수업에 관한 초등교사의 경험 및 인식
title_en: Exploring elementary school teachers’ experiences and perceptions of English–AI convergence classes
kw_ko: 영어 AI융합수업; 초등영어 교사; 영어교사교육; 제2언어교사교육
kw_en: English–AI convergence classes; elementary English teachers; English teacher education; second language teacher education
abstract_ko: This study explored how elementary English teachers conceptualized and implemented English–AI convergence classes. Four elementary school teachers participated, and data were collected through semi-structured interviews and reflective journals. The data were analyzed qualitatively using content analysis. Findings revealed that teachers held varying perceptions of English–AI convergence instruction: some viewed it as an aspect of interdisciplinary teaching, while others regarded it as a form of curriculum-level restructuring. Motivations for implementation included intrinsic interest and awareness of AI’s instructional potential. Teachers expressed significant concern about the lack of applicable instructional models, as well as ethical and technical challenges. In practice, they utilized diverse AI tools to tailor lessons to classroom contexts. Reported outcomes included enhanced personalized learning and increased student engagement. However, challenges such as students’ overreliance on AI, limited teacher preparedness, and inadequate infrastructure were also noted. Teachers emphasized the need for high-quality, context-sensitive professional development and proposed improvements in teacher education, school environments, educational platforms, and policy support. As AI technologies continue to advance in education, addressing teachers’ perceptions and building their competencies is essential for meaningful integration. This study offers practical insights and suggests directions for the sustainable implementation of English–AI convergence instruction in elementary education.

title_ko: Development and Application of AI Agents for Elementary English Writing Assessment: Focusing on a Comparison with ChatGPT
title_en: Development and Application of AI Agents for Elementary English Writing Assessment: Focusing on a Comparison with ChatGPT
kw_en: elementary English education; writing assessment; AI agents; automatic question generation; automated answer scoring
abstract_ko: This study developed and examined AIEEWA, a specialized AI agent system for elementary English writing assessment, by comparing its utility against the general-purpose model ChatGPT. AIEEWA comprises two agents: (a) an automatic question generation (AQG) agent that generates curriculum-aligned questions and rubrics and (b) an automated answer scoring (AAS) agent that scores answers and generates feedback. The system was developed by leveraging retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and self-evaluation mechanisms (Self-RAG, LLM-as-a-Judge) with GPT-4o. Its performance was evaluated using questions generated by the agent and writing samples collected from Korean students in the 5th and 6th grades. Results show that AIEEWA’s AQG agent generated questions with a higher average content validity than those generated by ChatGPT, although expert review remains indispensable. The AAS agent also demonstrated significantly higher intra-rater scoring reliability and feedback consistency than ChatGPT. In addition, although AIEEWA’s AAS agent achieved better inter-rater agreement with teacher consensus scores than ChatGPT, the agreement level was still moderate, underscoring the difficulty of fully replicating nuanced human judgment. These findings suggest that purpose-built AI agents such as AIEEWA can substantially enhance assessment efficiency and consistency compared with ChatGPT. At the current stage, however, they are better suited to assisting teachers rather than replacing them.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 기반 일본문화 교육프로그램 개발 연구 ― 문화 간 의사소통 역량 강화를 중심으로 ―
title_en: Development of a Japanese Culture Education Program Utilizing Generative AI: Focusing on the Enhancement of Intercultural Communicative Competence
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 문화 간 의사소통 역량; 일본문화 교육
kw_en: Generative Artificial Intelligence; Intercultural Communicative Competence(ICC); Japanese Culture Education
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 AI(ChatGPT)를 활용하여 일본문화 교육프로그램을 개발하고, 대학 일본어 전공 학습자를 대상으로 문화 간 의사소통 역량(Intercultural Communicative Competence, ICC) 함양 효과를 검증하고자 하였다. CLE(구성주의 학습환경 설계 모형)와 Byram(1997)의 ICC 이론을 기반으로 프로그램을 설계하고, 전문가 타당화, 프로그램 수정·보완, 실제 수업 적용 및 효과 검증의 절차를 거쳐 연구를 수행하였다. 프로그램 적용 결과, 학습자의 ICC 전체 역량과 하위 영역(지식, 태도, 기술, 인식) 모두에서 통계적으로 유의미한 향상이 나타났다. 또한 학습자 심층 면담 결과, 생성형 AI 기반 상호작용이 학습자의 몰입감, 자문화 성찰, 이문화 이해 및 상황맥락 기반 표현 전략 습득에 긍정적으로 기여함이 확인되었다. 본 연구는 생성형 AI를 활용한 일본문화 교육이 학습자의 문화 간 민감성과 실질적 소통 역량 강화를 효과적으로 지원할 수 있음을 실증적으로 제시하였으며, 향후 AI 기반 외국어 교육 및 다문화 교육 프로그램 개발에 유용한 기초자료를 제공할 수 있을 것으로 기대된다.
abstract_en: This study aimed to develop a Japanese culture education program utilizing generative artificial intelligence (ChatGPT) and to verify its effectiveness in enhancing university students’ intercultural communicative competence (ICC). Based on the Constructivist Learning Environment (CLE) model and Byram's (1997) ICC framework, the program was systematically designed, validated through expert reviews, revised, and applied in an actual class setting. The application of the program revealed statistically significant improvements in students' overall ICC and its subcomponents (knowledge, attitude, skills, and awareness). In addition, in-depth interviews with participants demonstrated that interaction with ChatGPT promoted learner immersion, self-reflection on their own culture, understanding of other cultures, and acquisition of context-appropriate communication strategies. This study empirically demonstrated that AI-based Japanese culture education programs can effectively foster learners' cultural sensitivity and practical communication competence, offering meaningful insights for the development of AI-integrated foreign language and intercultural education programs in the future.

title_ko: 예비교사의 인공지능 기반 기술 및 영어 AI 디지털 교과서 평가 기준과 효용성에 대한 인식
title_en: Pre-service Teachers’ Perceptions of AI-Based Technologies and Evaluation Criteria and Usefulness of English AI Digital Textbooks
kw_ko: AI 디지털 교과서; 교과서 평가; AI 기술; 교사 훈련; 교사 인식
kw_en: AIDT; Textbook Evaluation; AI Technology; Teacher Training; Teacher Perception
abstract_ko: This study aims to provide foundational data for developing perception-based training materials for pre-service teachers during the early implementation phase of AI Digital Textbooks (AIDT) in English education. A survey was conducted with 24 pre-service secondary English teachers to examine their perceptions of AI-based digital technology, AIDT evaluation criteria, and the educational effectiveness of AIDT. The results indicated that participants prioritized ethical use and social responsibility regarding AI technology. Among AIDT evaluation criteria, fairness, linguistic accuracy, and personalized learning support were rated as the most important. In terms of perceived educational benefits, AIDT was viewed as most effective in improving listening, viewing, and vocabulary skills, while writing and presenting skills received lower ratings. Correlation analysis revealed a significant relationship between participants‘ self-assessed English proficiency and their perceptions of AI application in teaching, particularly for speaking and viewing. However, no significant correlation was found between English proficiency and perceptions of AIDT evaluation criteria. Qualitative responses highlighted both optimism about personalized learning and concerns about learner health, attention, and classroom management. These findings suggest that pre-service teacher education should include differentiated, practice-based AIDT training, emphasize ethical and sustainable use, and offer tailored support based on teachers' language proficiency levels.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 이용한 관광 영어 교수모형 사례 연구
title_en: A Case Study on a Teaching Model for Tourism English using ChatGPT
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 관광 영어; 프롬프트; 내용 중심 교수법; 특정한 목적의 영어; 챗지피티 피드백
kw_en: ChatGPT; English for Tourism; Prompt; CBI. ESP; ChatGPT feedback
abstract_ko: This study explores the integration of ChatGPT, an AI language model, into an English for Tourism course designed for EFL learners. Amid the expanding use of Content-Based Instruction (CBI) and English for Specific Purposes (ESP) in language education, this research investigates how ChatGPT’s prompt-based feedback supports learners in overcoming challenges such as grammatical errors, appropriate stylistic usages, and audience-aware language use. Twenty university students engaged in a semester-long course involving three presentations on Korean tourist sites, where they composed, revised, and presented English tour guide texts with ChatGPT’s assistance. Results showed that ChatGPT not only aided in correcting errors but also enhanced learners’ ability to adjust vocabulary difficulty, differentiate between spoken and written styles, and produce contextually appropriate texts for diverse audiences. Survey data revealed increased learner confidence, motivation, and positive attitudes toward AI-assisted learning, although concerns about over-reliance and unnatural AI outputs were noted. The findings underscore ChatGPT’s potential as a cognitive scaffold in ESP education, emphasizing the need for explicit prompt training and critical engagement to maximize educational benefits.

title_ko: 영어 수준별 학습자들의 기계 번역기 번역 결과물 평가와 사용에 대한 인식 비교
title_en: A Comparative Study on Learners’ Perceptions of Evaluating and Using Machine Translation Output Across English Proficiency Levels
kw_ko: 기계 번역기; 번역 결과물; 영어 학습자; 평가
kw_en: machine translator; translation result English learners; evaluation
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study is to compare English learners’ perceptions of evaluating and using machine translation (MT) output across different proficiency levels. A total of 60 participants took part in the study: 23 intermediate-level and 37 advancedlevel English learners. Participants were asked to assess the quality of translations produced by three different machine translators and to reflect on their use of such tools. Quantitative data were analyzed using frequency analysis and chi-square tests, while qualitative responses were examined through content analysis. The findings indicate that both groups were able to evaluate translation output appropriately in many cases, regardless of their proficiency. However, differences were also observed in the evaluation of specific results depending on the learners’ English levels. These findings highlight the importance of developing learners’ critical awareness when using MT tools and suggest the need for instructional support to foster more accurate and informed evaluation of machine-generated translations.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 치과영어 수업운영 사례 연구:인공지능 기반의 교수학습법 탐색
title_en: A Case Study on the Use of ChatGPT in Dental English Education: Exploring AI-Based Teaching and Learning Methods
authors: 최용금(선문대학교 건강보건대학 치위생학과 및 유전체 기반 바이오 IT 융합연구소); 김미선(부천대학교)
kw_ko: 인공지능 교육; 임상 영어; 치위생학 교육; 보건의료 의사소통 능력
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence in Education; ChatGPT; Clinical English; Dental Hygiene Education; Healthcare Communication Skills
abstract_ko: 연구의 배경 및 목적: 본 연구는 일부 치위생과에서 운영된 ‘치과 상담 및 진료 영어’ 교과목에 ChatGPT를 활용한교수학습 사례를 소개하고, 향후 AI 기반 교육의 확장 가능성과 현장 적용을 위한 기초자료를 제공하는 데 본 연구의 목적이 있다. 연구방법: 경기도 소재 대학 치위생학과 1학년 재학생 29명을 대상으로 혼합형 학습(blended learning)을 적용 분석하였다. 학생들은 치과위생사 역할을 수행하며 가상 환자인 AI와 상호작용하였다. 수업 전후로 인공지능 사용 능숙도와 두려움 수준에 대한 인식 자료를 4점 Likert 척도를 활용하여 수집하여 분석하였다. 결과: ChatGPT 기반 영어 학습을 통해 학생들의 사용 능숙도가 향상되었고, 초기의 두려움은 유의하게 감소하였다. 성적 수준에 따른 유의미한 차이는 없었으며, 모든 집단에서 AI 활용에 대한 긍정적인 반응이 공통적으로 나타났다. 고찰: AI 기반 학습 환경은 실제 진료 상황에 대비한 실용 언어 사용을 촉진하고, 반복적 상호작용을 통해 학습자맞춤형·확장형 교수학습전략으로 적극적인 활용을 기대할 수 있다.
abstract_en: Background: This study addresses that gap by using ChatGPT, a generative AI model, to simulate interactive clinical English scenarios. Methods: This study involved 30 first-year students from the Department of Dental Hygiene at a university in Korea. A blended learning approach was implemented, combining offline lectures with AI-based English conversation exercises. Students played the role of dental hygienists, interacting with ChatGPT acting as virtual patients using standardized clinical scripts. Quantitative data were collected on students’ perceived proficiency and fear of AI usage before and after the course using a 4-point Likert scale. Crosstabulation analysis and Monte Carlo simulation-based chi-square tests were conducted using SPSS. Results: The analysis showed that students' proficiency in AI-based English conversation improved, while their initial fear of using AI significantly decreased. No statistically significant difference was found across score groups, suggesting a universally positive response to AI integration. Conclusion: The AI-enhanced environment improved students’ practical language skills and readiness for realworld patient interaction. These findings suggest that AI tools can offer scalable, adaptive models for strengthening healthcare communication and cultivating globally competent professionals.
note: 치과영어 가상환자 ChatGPT 역할극, 사전사후 인식

title_ko: 초급 성인 학습자의 영어학습에 있어서 ChatGPT 또는 원어민 화자의 피드백 효과 및 인식 비교 연구
title_en: A Comparative Study of the Effectiveness of Feedback from ChatGPT or Native Speakers of English on Low English Proficient Adult Learners
kw_ko: 피드백; 생성형 AI; 영어원어민 화자; 챗지피티; 영어수업활동
kw_en: feedback; ChatGPT; native speakers of English; English class activities
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 AI인 ChatGPT와 원어민(NS)이 제공하는 피드백이 낮은 영어 능력(TOEIC 450점 미만)을 가진 성인 학습자들의 영어 문법 능력 향상 및 피드백 인식에 미치는 영향을 탐구했습니다. D광역시 소재 대학원생 39명(실험반 ChatGPT 그룹 19명, 통제반 원어민 그룹 20명)을 대상으로 6주간 피드백 활동을 진행했으며, 이 중 27명의 데이터를 분석했습니다. 연구 도구로 Google Sheets를 활용하여 피드백을 공유했으며, 비모수 통계 분석(Mann-Whitney U 검정, Wilcoxon Signed Rank 검정)을 사용했습니다. 분석 결과, 사전 및 사후 검사에서 두 그룹 간 영어 문법 능력에는 통계적으로 유의미한 차이가 나타나지 않았습니다. 두 그룹 모두 사후검사 평균이 향상되었으나, 그 정도는 통계적으로 유의미하지 않았습니다. 설문조사를 통한 피드백 인식 분석 결과, ChatGPT 그룹은 영어 작문 불안감 감소와 즉각적인 피드백을 긍정적으로 평가했으나, 피드백 정확성과 설명 부족에 대한 우려를 표했습니다. 반면, 원어민 피드백 그룹은 문법 교정, 학습 기회, 문장 구성 통찰력에 만족하며 일대일 멘토링 같다고 언급했습니다. 결론적으로, 양적 분석에서는 두 피드백 유형 간 유의미한 차이가 없었으나, 학습자들은 두 방식 모두 의미 있는 활동으로 인식했습니다. ChatGPT는 불안감 감소와 즉시성에 강점이 있었고, 원어민 피드백은 명확성과 문법 교육 측면에서 높이 평가되었습니다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to investigate the impact of feedback from ChatGPT and native speakers of English on beginning-level adult EFL learners' English proficiency development and their perceptions of the two feedback providers. The study with 41 adult English learners from two intact general English courses was conducted in three phases: a pre-test, eight feedback activity sessions, and a post-test including open-ended survey questions. The result showed that there was no significant difference in the participants’ English proficiency between the two groups. However, the ChatGPT group enjoyed the immediate feedback on their writing, whereas the native English speaker group liked forming a rapport and receiving compliments on their writing. Furthermore, both groups also expressed their concerns about the feedback activity.
note: ChatGPT vs 원어민 피드백 실험·통제집단

title_ko: 과정중심 영어글쓰기 활동에서의 AI 피드백 활용 분석
title_en: Analyzing Korean College Students’ Use of AI Feedback in a Process-oriented English Writing Task
kw_ko: 인공지능(AI); AI피드백; EFL 상황; 영어 글쓰기; 과정중심 글쓰기
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI); AI Feedback; EFL Context; English Writing; Process-oriented Writing
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 우리나라 대학생들이 과정중심 영어글쓰기 과제에 임할 때, 초안 작성에서부터 AI도구로부터 얻는 피드백을 수용하여 최종안의 완성 과정에 대하여 분석해보고자 하는 것이었다. 연구문제는 첫째, 학생들이 과정중심 글쓰기를 하는 동안에, 영어초안I, II, III, 최종안은 어떠한 변화를 거쳐 완성되는가? 둘째, AI피드백을 활용한 과정중심 글쓰기에 대한 학생들의 인식과 태도는 어떠한가로 정하였다. 학생들의 영어초안I, II, III, 최종안은 Grammarly(2022)에 의하여 분석되었으며, 그들과의 집단면담자료는 Miles & Huberman(1994)의 질적 분석 방법에 의하여 분석되었다. 분석 결과, 첫째, 글쓰기 과정에서 영어초안I, II, AI피드백기반 영어초안III, 최종안까지 글의 품질을 나타내는 점수는 지속적으로 높아졌으며, 단어 및 문장의 오류들이 점차 감소된 것으로 나타났다. 둘째, 학생들은 AI기반 피드백에 대한 비판적 태도를 견지하면서 선별, 사용하는 것으로 나타났다. 셋째, 학생들은 AI도구 사용의 편리함 등을 바탕으로 완성도 높은 글을 작성해 나갈 수 있다고 언급하였다. 끝으로, 연구결과로부터 도출된 결론으로부터 교실현장을 위한 시사점이 제시되었다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this research was to analyze how Korean college students have processed their English drafts, using feedback from AI tools in a process-oriented writing task. Research questions are as follows; First, what changes would English draft I, II, III, and the final draft go through? Second, what are the students' perceptions and attitudes toward the AI use? The English draft I, II, III, and final drafts written by students were analyzed by Grammarly (2022), and the group interview with students were analyzed by Miles & Huberman's (1994) qualitative analysis method. The results showed that first, the scores indicating the quality of writing continued to increase, and errors in words and sentences gradually decreased during the writing process. Second, the students selected and used AI feedback while maintaining a critical attitude toward AI feedback. Third, the students showed a positive attitude toward the AI use in the classroom.
note: Grammarly AI피드백 과정중심 글쓰기 초안 변화·면담

title_ko: AI 코스웨어 ‘Reading Progress’ 활용 영어 읽기 활동에서 교사 피드백이 초등학습자의 읽기 유창성과 정의적 영역에 미치는 영향
title_en: The Effect of Teacher Feedback on Elementary Students’ Reading Fluency and Affective Domains in English Reading Activities Using AI Courseware ‘Reading Progress’
kw_ko: AI 코스웨어; 리딩 프로그레스; 피드백; 읽기 유창성; 개별 맞춤형 학습; 초등영어교육
kw_en: AI Courseware; Reading Progress; Feedback; Reading Fluency; Personalized Learning; Elementary English Education
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 AI 코스웨어인 Microsoft Teams의 ‘Reading Progress’를 활용한 영어 읽기 활동에서, 교사 피드백 유형이 초등학습자의 읽기 유창성과 정의적 영역에 미치는 영향을 분석하였다. 6학년 학습자들은 동일한 AI 코스웨어를 사용하였으며, 교사 피드백에 따라 무선할당되어 [집단 1]은 교사 피드백 없이 AI 피드백만 받고, [집단 2]는 교사의 인지·교정적 피드백, [집단 3]은 교사의 정서·동기적 피드백을 추가로 제공받았다. 읽기 유창성에 대한 반복측정 분산분석 결과, 세 집단 모두 읽기 유창성(읽기 속도와 정확성)에서 유의미한 향상을 보였으나, 피드백 유형에 따른 집단 간 차이는 나타나지 않았다. 정의적 영역에 대한 공분산분석 결과 통계적 차이는 없었지만, 학습자 소감문을 통해 [집단 2]와 [집단 3]에서 교사의 실재감에 대한 긍정적인 인식이 확인되었다. 아울러 교사 인터뷰를 통해 학교 교육에서의 AI 코스웨어 기반 개별 맞춤형 교수학습의 가능성과 과제를 파악하였다. 본 연구는 AI 시대 교사의 역할을 조명하고, 효과적인 교사 피드백 제공 방안을 탐색함과 동시에, AI와 교사의 상호작용에 대한 시사점을 제공한다.
abstract_en: This study explored the effects of teacher feedback on elementary students’ reading fluency and affective domain using Microsoft Teams’ Reading Progress, an AI courseware. Three 6th grade groups used the same AI courseware: Group 1 received only AI feedback; Group 2 received additional cognitive and corrective feedback from the teacher; Group 3 received addi tional emotional and motivational feedback from the teacher. As a result of the repeated measures ANOVA of reading fluency, all groups showed significant improvement in reading fluency (words correct per minute and accuracy rate), but there was no differ ence between groups in accordance with the teacher feedback types. ANCOVA on the effects of teacher feedback in the affective domain also showed no significant differences. However, students in Groups 2 and 3 expressed positive feelings about the teacher’s presence and support in their written reflections. A follow-up interview with the participating teacher revealed both the potential and challenges of using AI courseware for personalized learning in school settings. This study sheds new light on the role of teachers in the AI era. It explores the possible ways to provide effective teacher feedback, and provides implications for the interaction between AI and teachers.
note: Reading Progress AI코스웨어+교사피드백 3집단 비교

title_ko: 기술창작시대의 문학 작품과 현대시 교육 - 생성형 인공지능 기술을 활용한 ‘창작’의 문제를 중심으로 -

kw_ko: 기술창작시대; 생성형 인공지능; 문학 작품 창작; 창작 교육; 현대시 교육
kw_en: generative artificial intelligence; era of technological creation; creative writing of literature; creative writing education; modern-poetry education
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 인공지능 기술의 발전이 문학 창작 및 문학교육에 미치는 영향을 비판적으로 검토하고, 그 결과에 근거하여 현대시 교육의 대응 방향을 제시하고자 하였다. 인공지능 기술의 발전으로 등장한 기술창작시대 담론은 문학과 문학교육의 패러다임 전환을 요청하고 있다. 생성형 인공지능 기술은 대규모 언어 모델에 기반한 복잡한 알고리즘으로 작동하면서도, 상당 부분 인간 주체의 개입을 필요로 한다는 점에서 창작 주체로서 일정한 한계를 지닌다. 본 연구는 인공지능 기술의 활용 정도에 따라, ‘도구로서의 인공지능’, ‘공동 주체로서의 인공지능’, ‘인공지능에 의한 창작’으로 범주화하여 생성형 인공지능 기술을 활용하여 창작된 현대시 작품 및 연구 성과를 분석하였다. 분석 결과 생성형 인공지능 기술을 문학 창작의 새로운 주체로 인정하려는 논의에는 여러 한계가 있으나, 한편으로 이러한 기술의 발전이 문학 작품을 교육 현장에서 다루는 방식에 일정 부분 변화를 요구하는 측면이 있음을 확인하였다. 이에 본 연구는 현대시 교육의 대응 방향으로 다음 세 가지를 제안하였다. 첫째, 창작의 과정에서 기획과 선별의 의미가 더욱 강조될 필요가 있다는 점, 둘째, 창작의 과정을 세분화하고 반복적 고쳐 쓰기를 활성화할 필요가 있다는 점, 셋째, 인공지능 기술을 활용한 창작에 적합한 이론을 문학교육의 장에 확장적으로 적용할 필요가 있다는 점이다. 본 연구는 기술창작시대 담론이 현실을 왜곡하거나, 해석 과잉의 양상으로 이루어지는 것을 경계하는 한편, 새로운 기술이 문학교육의 실천적 틀 안에서 의미 있게 적용될 수 있는 방향을 탐색하였다는 점에서 의미가 있다.
abstract_en: This study critically examines the impact of the development of generative artificial intelligence technologies on literary creation and literary education, and proposes new directions for modern poetry education based on its findings. The emergence of the discourse on the "era of technological creation," driven by the advancement of AI technologies, demands a paradigm shift in both literature and literary education. Although generative AI operates through complex algorithms based on large language models, it still requires substantial human involvement, thereby revealing certain limitations in its role as an creative agent. This study categorizes the application of AI technologies into three types—AI as a tool, AI as a co-creator, and AI as an autonomous creator—and examines recently created modern poetry works using AI technologies and relevant scholarly works within this framework. The analysis shows that while there are limitations to recognizing generative AI as a new subject of literary creation, the development of such technologies nevertheless calls for changes in how literary works are approached in educational settings. Accordingly, this study proposes the following three directions for modern-poetry education: first, the increased importance of planning and selection in the creative process; second, the need to subdivide the writing process and promote iterative revision; and third, the expanded application of literary theories suitable for AI-assisted creation in the field of literary education. This study aims to explore meaningful and practical applications of technological innovation in literary education while remaining cautious of distorted realities or ungrounded interpretive excesses in the discourse surrounding the era of technological creation.
note: 문학교육학, 생성형AI 시창작 담론·현대시교육 방향론(적용 없음)

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능을 활용한 국내 영어교육 연구동향: LDA 토픽모델링과 체계적 문헌 분석을 중심으로
title_en: Research Trends in the Use of Generative AI in English Education in Korea: LDA Topic Modeling and Systematic Literature Review
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 영어교육; 연구동향; 체계적 문헌 분석; LDA 토픽모델링
kw_en: Generative AI; Englsih Education; Research Trends; Systematic Literature Review; LDA Topic Modeling
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 인공지능을 활용한 국내 영어교육 연구 동향과 주요 주제를 파악하여 향후 연구 방향과 교육적 시사점을 제시하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 PRISMA 절차에 따라 2023년 1월부터 2025년 3월까지 RISS와 KCI에서 수집된 국내 학술 논문 52편을 대상으로 LDA 토픽 모델링과 체계적 문헌 분석을 병행하였다. 분석 결과, 도출된 주요 연구 주제는 ‘읽기 전략 향상’, ‘대학생 대상 생성형 AI 인식 조사 연구’, ‘프롬프트 기반 글쓰기 피드백 활용’, ‘초등영어교육에서의 활용 경험’, ‘생성형 AI 기반 영어 작문 평가’의 다섯 가지로 나타났다. 체계적 문헌 분석에서는 2024년 발표 문헌이 가장 많았고, 고등교육을 대상으로 한 연구가 대다수를 차지했으며, 연구 방법으로는 혼합 연구와 양적 연구가 주로 사용되었고, 쓰기 영역에서 가장 활발한 연구가 이루어졌다. 이러한 결과는 국내 영어교육에서 생성형 AI 활용이 특정 대상과 기능에 집중되어 있음을 보여주며, 다양한 언어 기능과 학습자 집단을 포괄하는 후속 연구가 요구됨을 시사한다. 본 연구의 결과를 바탕으로, 국내 영어교육에서 생성형 인공지능의 효과적 활용 방안과 후속 연구의 방향성을 제안하였다.
abstract_en: This study aims to identify the research trends and key themes in the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in English education in South Korea, and goes on to suggest directions for future research and educational implications. To this end, a total of 52 academic articles published between January 2023 and March 2025 were collected from RISS and KCI, and analyzed based on the LDA topic modeling and systematic literature review in accordance with the PRISMA protocol. The topic modeling analysis revealed five primary themes: (1) enhancing reading strategies, (2) perception studies on generative AI use among university students, (3) prompt-based writing feedback, (4) experiences in elementary English education, and (5) generative AI-based writing assessment. The systematic review showed that most studies were published in 2024, with a predominant focus on higher education. Mixed methods and quantitative approaches were most frequently employed, and the writing domain emerged as the most studied language skill. These findings indicate that current research on generative AI in English education is heavily concentrated on specific learner groups and skills, highlighting the need for future studies that address a broader range of language functions and educational contexts. Based on these results, this study proposes practical strategies for effectively applying generative AI in English education and outlines directions for subsequent research.
note: 국내 영어교육 생성형AI 연구동향 LDA·체계적 분석

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능과 인간의 글쓰기 작동 원리 비교 분석 - 디지털 리터러시 전환기에서 쓰기 교육의 이론적 재구성 모색
title_en: A Comparative Analysis of the Writing Mechanisms of Generative AI and Humans － Exploring the Theoretical Reconfiguration of Writing Education in the Transitional Era of Digital Literacy
kw_ko: 인간의 글쓰기; 인공지능의 글쓰기; 생성형 인공지능; 질문 능력; 프롬프트 엔지니어링; 비판적 프롬프트 리터러시; 메타인지; 스키마
kw_en: human writing; AI writing; generative artificial intelligence; questioning ability; prompt engineering; critical prompt literacy; metacognition; schema
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 생성형 인공지능 시대에 인간의 글쓰기와 인공지능의 글쓰기가 지니는 본질적 차이를 분석하고, 그 차이를 기반으로 효과적인 글쓰기 교육의 방향을 모색하는 데 있다. 인간의 글쓰기는 사고의 외화와 내면화를 반복하며 지식을 변형하고 확장하는 심층적 인지 행위인 반면, 인공지능의 글쓰기는 통계적 예측에 기반한 결과 중심의 출력이라는 점에서 구조적·기능적 차이를 지닌다. 이러한 맥락에서 글쓰기 교육은 프롬프트 활용 능력뿐만 아니라 사고의 주체로서 작동하는 인간의 질문 능력, 메타인지, 스키마, 자기주도성을 중심에 두어야 한다. 특히 질문 능력은 단순한 물음이 아니라 인공지능의 응답을 비판적으로 평가하고 재구성하여 사고를 심화시키는 핵심 역량으로 작동한다. 본 논문은 이러한 문제의식에 따라 ‘비판적 프롬프트 리터러시’의 개념을 제시하고, 생성형 인공지능 기반 글쓰기 교육의 이론적 토대와 실천적 원리를 구체화하였다.
abstract_en: This study analyzes the essential differences between human writing and AI-generated writing in the era of generative artificial intelligence and explores effective directions for writing education based on these distinctions. Human writing functions as a cognitive process that externalizes and internalizes thought. It transforms and expanding knowledge through iterative reflection, In contrast, AI-generated writing produces outcome-oriented outputs based on statistical predictions. In this context, writing education must focus not only on prompt use skills but also developing the learner’s cognitive capacities as an agent of thinking. This is particularly important for question-posing ability, metacognition, schema development, and self-directed learning. Questioning ability is especially important as it enables critical evaluation and reconstruction of AI responses. This process deepens human thought. Based on this problem awareness, this paper proposes the concept of “Critical Prompt Literacy” as an essential framework for guiding writing practices in AI-assisted environments. The paper also presents theoretical foundations and practical strategies for designing writing education that integrates human cognitive processes with generative AI technologies in a complementary and reflective manner.
note: L1 글쓰기교육 이론적 재구성 담론, 적용·데이터 없음

title_ko: 챗GPT 피드백에 대한 대학생 인식 연구: 영작 컨퍼런스 활용 사례
title_en: College Students’ Perceptions of ChatGPT Feedback: A Case Study Using Writing Conferences
kw_ko: 챗GPT 피드백; 영작 피드백; 컨퍼런스; 챗GPT 인식; 하이브리드 외국어 평가
kw_en: ChatGPT feedback; EFL writing skills; feedback; writing conference; hybrid foreign language assessment
abstract_ko: 목적 본 연구는 교양 영어를 수강하는 대학 신입생 64명이 챗GPT 피드백을 이용한 영작 컨퍼런스에 참여한 경험을 토대로 이들이챗GPT 피드백에 갖는 인식을 연구하였다. 이를 통해 EFL 교실 영작 수업에 향후 챗GPT 피드백을 적용할 수 있는 구체적인 방안과실효성을 살펴, 향후 연구 및 실제 교육에 활용 가능한 기초자료를 구축하고자 한다. 방법 교양영어를 수강하는 대학 신입생 64명은 챗GPT가 제공한 본인 영작에 대한 피드백을 분석하는 영작 컨퍼런스 활동에 총2회 참여하였고 경험을 토대로 학생들은 챗GPT 피드백에 어떠한 인식을 갖는지를 묻는 설문지에 의견을 제출하였다. 수집된 설문지 응답 내용을 내용 분석(content analysis)으로 핵심어를 추출하고 이를 빈도 분석을 수행하여 결과를 도출하였다. 결과 빈도 분석 결과에 따르면 학생들은 챗GPT 영작 피드백에 높은 신뢰도를 보였으나, 이를 영작 평가 도구로 사용하는 것에 회의적인 태도를 보였다. 이는 챗GPT가 보여준 다양한 오류에 대한 불신이 가장 큰 원인으로 작용했다. 결과적으로, 학생들은 챗GPT 피드백와 교사의 평가를 결합한 ‘하이브리드 외국어 평가1)(Hybrid foreign language assessment)’ 방안에 크게 동의하였다. 결론 연구 결과를 바탕으로 AI시대에서 챗GPT를 영작 피드백과 평가 도구로 활용하기 위해서는 실증적 연구를 기반으로 챗GPT 피드백 교실 활동을 개발하고 교사의 개입이 동반되어야 할 것이다. 이를 위한 학계와 교사의 교육 활용을 위한 챗GPT 피드백 모형개발에 대한 심도 있는 논의와 노력이 향후 과제로 남아있다.
abstract_en: Objectives The purpose of this study was to examine the EFL college-level students’ perceptions toward ChatGPT feedback through ChatGPT feedback-based writing conferences. Methods A total of 64 students enrolled in English Communication I, II courses completed two writings while us ing ChatGPT feedback and participating in face-to-face writing conferences and responded to the questionnaire eliciting their perception toward ChatGPT feedback. Results The findings indicated that the students considered ChatGPT feedback sufficiently reliable to supplement teacher feedback on both micro-level and macro-level errors; however, they opposed its use as an assessment tool to replace teachers’ evaluation. Doubts remained still in its potential errors, hoping for ‘hybrid-assessment’, in which both a teacher and ChatGPT evaluate collaboratively their writing skills. Conclusions The results of this study suggest how to employ ChatGPT feedback in EFL writing class for teaching and assessment, shading a light in a teacher’s new role in the era of AI-assisted foreign language learning and assessment. More discussion is needed to find more pedagogical methods to incorporate AI tools into EFL writing classes.
note: 영작 컨퍼런스 ChatGPT 피드백 인식 설문 내용분석

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 독일어 말하기 연습 - 비교과 활동 사례 소개와 학습자의 의사소통 전략 분석
title_en: Fertigkeitstraining zum Sprechen mit ChatGPT – Projektvorstellung und Analyse der Kompensationsstrategien
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 말하기 능력; 자기주도학습; 의사소통전략; 언어사용전략
kw_en: ChatGPT; Fertigkeit Sprechen; Lernerautonomie; Sprachgebrauchsstrategie; Kompensationsstrategie
abstract_ko: 본고는 생성형 인공지능을 상대 화자로 활용하여 말하기 연습을 진행한 비교과 활동에 관한 논의이다. 전반부에서는 독어독문학과 학생 소그룹 <도이치라보어>가 두 학기 동안 진행한 탐구 활동 ‘ChatGPT를 활용한 독일어 말하기 연습’을 소개한다. 활동의 핵심은 ChatGPT를 활용한 실험 대화인데, 후반부의 논의는 이 대화에서 이루어지는 사용자의 언어행위에 주목한다. 학습자가 가상의 의사소통 상황을 구성하는 화자로서 수행하는 발화인데, 교실 수업에서 이루어지는 학습자 간의 말하기 연습에서와는 다른 양상을 드러낸다. 이 특징적인 양상을 구체적으로 기술하는 것이 논의의 목표이다. 먼저 II장에서 생성형 인공지능의 활용에 관한 외국어 교육 분야의 연구동향을 개관한다. III장에서는 비교과 활동의 배경과 목표, 전반적인 진행 과정 및 결과를 소개한다. IV장에서는 이 활동의 핵심인 실험 대화를 연습유형론 Übungstypologie의 기술 범주를 토대로 하여 말하기 연습의 유형으로서 기술한 후, 이 유형을 특징짓는 학습자 발화의 특성을 조명한다. V장에서는 평가와 전망에 관한 견해로 논문을 마무리한다.
abstract_en: Diese Studie hat eine außer-curriculare Aktivität zum Thema, bei der generative KI als Gesprächspartner für das Sprechen genutzt wurde. In der ersten Hälfte wird der Hintergrund, das Ziel sowie der Ablauf und die Ergebnisse dieses Projekts vorgestellt, das von der Kleingruppe <Deutschlabor> aus Studierenden der Germanistik über zwei Semester hinweg durchgeführt wurde. Im Zentrum der Aktivität steht die Deutsch-Konversation mit ChatGPT. Die zweite Hälfte der Arbeit fokussiert sich auf die sprachlichen Handlungen im Rahmen dieser experimentellen Gespräche. Dabei handelt es sich um sprachliche Handlungen der Lernenden, die durch das sogenannte Prompting zugleich als Akteure einer simulierten Kommunikationssituation agieren. Diese Art des Sprechens weist neue Merkmale auf, die sich von traditionellen Sprechübungen zwischen Lernenden unterscheiden. Um diese neuen Merkmale systematisch zu erfassen, wird die Gesprächsform anhand der deskriptiven Kategorien der Übungstypologie als spezifischer Übungstyp klassifiziert. Anschließend wird durch die Analyse der Gesprächsprotokolle das kommunikative Strategieverhalten der Lernenden, das diesen Typus charakterisiert, herausgearbeitet. Kapitel II gibt einen Überblick über die Forschungslage zum Einsatz generativer KI im Fremdsprachenunterricht. Kapitel III stellt die erwähnte außer-curriculare Aktivität vor. In Kapitel IV wird die experimentelle Gesprächsform als Übungstyp beschrieben und die Merkmale der Lernendenäußerungen in diesem Kontext analysiert. Kapitel V schließt mit einer Evaluation und einem Ausblick.
note: 독일어 말하기 ChatGPT

title_ko: ChatGPT 기반 토론학습에서 나타난 대학생의 활용 양상과 학습 효과 분석: AI 교수효능감, 비판적 사고, 자기주도학습능력을 중심으로
title_en: Analyzing University Students’Usage Patterns and Learning Effects in ChatGPT-Based Debate Learning: Focusing on AI Teaching Efficacy, Critical Thinking, and Self-Directed Learning Abilities
kw_ko: 토론학습; AI 교수효능감; 비판적 사고; 자기주도학습능력
kw_en: ChatGPT; debate learning; AI teaching efficacy; critical thinking; self-directed learning
abstract_ko: 생성형 AI의 발전과 함께, 최근 교육 분야에서는 생성형 AI의 구체적인 교육적 활용방안을 탐색하고, 효과를 검증하기 위한 연구가 활발히 이루어지고 있다. 특히 생성형 AI는 토론학습과 같은 상호작용 기반 학습에서 활용될 때 가장 효과적일 수 있다고 일컬어진다. 그러나 실제로 ChatGPT를 교육 현장에 적용하고, 그 효과를 검증한 연구는 미흡한 실정이다. 이에 본 연구에서는 대학생을 대상으로 ChatGPT 기반 토론학습을 운영한 뒤, 대학생의 ChatGPT 활용 양상을 분석하고 그 효과를 검증하여 토론학습에서 ChatGPT의 구체적 활용방안에 대한 시사점을 도출하고자 하였다. ChatGPT 기반 토론학습은 교육방법 및 교육공학 교과목을 수강하는 18명의 대학생을 대상으로 총 5주에 걸쳐 이루어졌다. 연구 결과 대학생들은 토론학습에서 도움요청형, 탐구형, 검색형, 비판형 등의 형태로 ChatGPT를 활용하고 있었다. 또한 ChatGPT 기반 토론학습은 대학생의 AI 교수효능감 및 자기주도학습능력 향상의 효과를 보였으나, 비판적 사고에는 유의미한 영향을 미치지 않는 것으로 나타났다. 이상의 연구 결과를 바탕으로 다음의 결론을 제시하였다. 첫째, 대학생들이 과제 수행을 위해 ChatGPT를 복합적으로 활용할 수 있도록 지도하여야 한다. 둘째, 학습 과정에서 다양한 학습 목표 달성을 위해 ChatGPT와 상호작용할 수 있는 기회가 충분히 제공될 필요가 있다. 셋째, ChatGPT 활용 과정에서 비판적 사고를 촉진하기 위한 전략이 수반되어야 한다. 넷째, 대학생들이 과제 수행을 위해 ChatGPT를 자기주도적으로 활용할 수 있도록 지도하여야 한다.
abstract_en: With the advancement of generative AI, recent studies in the field of education have actively explored its specific applications and attempted to verify its effectiveness. In particular, generative AI is considered to be especially effective when utilized in interaction-based learning environments, such as debate learning. However, there remains a lack of empirical research that applies ChatGPT in actual educational settings and examines its effects there. To address this gap, the present study implemented ChatGPT-based debate learning with university students, analyzed their patterns of ChatGPT usage, and investigated its impacts. The aim was to derive implications for the practical use of ChatGPT in debate learning. The ChatGPT-based debate learning program was conducted over five weeks with 18 university students enrolled in a course on teaching methods and educational technology. The findings revealed that students utilized ChatGPT in various ways during debate learning, including help-seeking, inquiry-based, information-searching, and critical engagement types. Furthermore, ChatGPT-based debate learning was found to improve students’ AI teaching efficacy and self-directed learning ability, although it did not have a statistically significant effect on their critical thinking skills. Based on these results, the following conclusions were drawn. First, students should be guided to use ChatGPT in a multifaceted manner to accomplish academic tasks. Second, sufficient opportunities should be provided for learners to interact with ChatGPT to achieve various learning goals throughout the process. Third, strategies to promote critical thinking need to be integrated into the process of using ChatGPT. Fourth, students should be supported in using ChatGPT autonomously while completing learning tasks.

title_ko: 생성형 AI와 PBL의 만남: 심리언어학 수업 사례연구
title_en: Intergrating Generative AI into PBL: A Case Study in Psycholinguistics.
kw_en: problem-based learning (PBL); generative AI; critical thinking; prompting strategies; psycholinguistics
abstract_ko: This study investigates how ChatGPT was integrated into a 15-week problem-based learning (PBL) psycholinguistics course at a university in a metropolitan area in Korea. Seven undergraduate students participated in collaborative tasks and thematic explorations, investigating real-world cases related to language acquisition, cognitive processing, and cross-linguistic patterns, as well as other core topics. Thematic analysis of reflection journals, final reports, and instructor field notes revealed that ChatGPT enhanced students’ information access, conceptual understanding, critical thinking, and collaborative reasoning. Students developed prompting strategies, evaluated AI-generated responses, and connected theoretical concepts to real-world language experiences. ChatGPT also facilitated metacognitive regulation, enabling learners to monitor comprehension and adjust learning strategies accordingly. As a cognitive and strategic partner, ChatGPT fostered deeper engagement and learner autonomy. Notably, students used the tool to revise explanations, compare sources, generate questions, and visualize reasoning for presentations. During group collaboration, ChatGPT served as a discussion catalyst and helped students articulate and refine their perspectives. These findings suggest that generative AI, when thoughtfully integrated, can meaningfully support concept-oriented instruction in higher education contexts.

title_ko: 글쓰기 맥락에서 대학생 필자의 생성형 AI 수용 인식 연구 - 인공지능 기기 수용(AIDUA) 모형에 기반한 수용 구조 탐색과 타당도 검증 -
title_en: University Students’ Perceptions of Generative AI Acceptance in Writing Contexts -An Exploration of Acceptance Structure and Validity Based on the AIDUA (Artificial Intelligence Device Use Acceptance)
kw_ko: 국어교육; 작문 교육; 생성형 AI 글쓰기; AIDUA 모형; 학습자 인식
kw_en: Korean Language Education; Writing Education; Generative AI Writing; AIDUA Model; Students’ Perception
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 글쓰기 맥락에서 생성형 AI에 대한 대학생 필자의 수용 인식을 탐색하고, 이를 설명할 수 있는 이론적 모형을 도출 및 검증하는 것을 목적으로 하였다. 이를 위해 인공지능 기기 수용 모형(AIDUA)을 토대로 ‘인지–수용–도입’의 3단계 구조를 설정하고, 각 단계에 해당하는 인식 요인을 도출하여 전체 수용 인식 구조를 구성하였다. 생성형 AI를 활용한 글쓰기 경험이 있는 대학생 75명을 대상으로 설문조사를 실시하고, 탐색적 요인 분석을 통해 수용 인식 구조를 도출하였다. 분석 결과, 학습자의 수용 인식은 ‘탐색적 동기’, ‘인지된 인간성’, ‘사회적 영향력’, ‘실용성 기대’, ‘평가적 태도’의 다섯 가지 요인으로 구성되며, 이들은 ‘인지–수용–도입’의 단계적 경로를 따라 유의미한 상관관계를 형성함이 확인되었다. 반면 ‘도입 저항’은 이들과 무관하게 독립적인 인식 경로를 형성하는 별개의 요인으로 나타났다. 이러한 결과는 생성형 AI 수용이 글쓰기 전반에 대한 총체적 판단과 가치관에 기반하여 이루어짐을 보여준다. 또한 글쓰기 교육에서 생성형 AI를 기술 활용 차원에 국한하지 않고, 인지적‧정의적‧사회문화적 요인을 포괄하여 접근해야 하며, 수용 촉진과 저항 완화 전략을 함께 고려해야 함을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study investigates university students’ perceptions of generative AI acceptance in writing and proposes a theoretical model to explain these perceptions. Based on the AIDUA (Artificial Intelligence Device Use Acceptance) framework, a three-stage process—Cognition, Acceptance, and Adoption—was constructed, with corresponding factors identified. A survey of 75 students experienced in AI-assisted writing was conducted, and exploratory factor analysis revealed five core components: Exploratory Motivation, Perceived Human-likeness, Social Influence, Expected Usefulness, and Evaluative Attitude. These factors followed a meaningful path across the three stages, while Adoption Resistance emerged as an independent factor. The results suggest that AI acceptance in writing reflects students’ holistic judgments shaped by cognitive, emotional, and sociocultural dimensions. The study underscores the need for a pedagogical approach that accounts for both the drivers and barriers to AI use in writing education.

title_ko: ChatGPT as a Vocabulary Learning Tool for EFL Learners in Kazakhstan
title_en: ChatGPT as a Vocabulary Learning Tool for EFL Learners in Kazakhstan
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 어휘 학습; EFL 학습자; 프롬프트 개발
kw_en: ChatGPT; vocabulary learning; EFL learners; prompt development
abstract_ko: This study explores the role of ChatGPT in enhancing vocabulary learning among high school students in Kazakhstan. Twenty-seven students participated in a two-week intervention that utilized ChatGPT within a mixed-methods framework. Data were collected through vocabulary assessments administered before and after the intervention, learner surveys at both stages, ChatGPT interaction logs, and follow-up interviews. The tests results were analyzed using a paired t-test. The findings revealed that the students engaged with ChatGPT in strategic and diverse ways, such as adjusting prompt difficulty, requesting translations or definitions, and exploring creative tasks. Many also demonstrated autonomies by generating their own prompts beyond the provided set. A statistically significant improvement in vocabulary scores was observed after the intervention. Students reported highly positive perceptions of ChatGPT, citing its constant availability, adaptive feedback, and flexibility in meeting individual learning needs. Although some technical challenges, like unstable internet connections, were noted, these issues were external to the tool itself. Overall, the study suggests that ChatGPT can be as a flexible and responsive resource for supporting vocabulary development and fostering learner autonomy in EFL contexts. This study also discusses limitations and pedagogical implications.

title_ko: The Effects of ChatGPT on Politeness in L2 University Students’ Email Requests to Faculty
title_en: The Effects of ChatGPT on Politeness in L2 University Students’ Email Requests to Faculty
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 교수에게 보내는제2언어 이메일; 공손성; 화용 능력
kw_en: ChatGPT; L2 email to faculty; politeness; pragmatic competence
abstract_ko: This study investigated how ChatGPT can enhance L2 email writing, specifically focusing on politeness. Twenty-nine Korean university students were asked to draft an email in class requesting a recommendation letter from an English-speaking professor. For the assignment, they submitted their initial drafts to ChatGPT to receive guided feedback. Subsequently, they revised their drafts based on the politeness features observed in the ChatGPT-generated model email. Four days later, the participants wrote the same email again in class without ChatGPT’s assistance. The three versions of the emails were analyzed for address forms, levels of directness in the requests, and external modifications. The results indicated that ChatGPT had a significant immediate impact on the use of politeness features in the emails; however, many of these improvements diminished in the delayed post-task, except for sustained gains in email closings. These findings suggest that while ChatGPT can lead to immediate enhancements in L2 email politeness, explicit instruction may be necessary for ensuring long-term retention of these features.

title_ko: ChatGPT와의 상호작용을 통한 대학생의 글쓰기 경험 탐색: 문화역사적 활동 이론의 모순을 중점으로
title_en: Exploring the Writing Experience of College Students Through Interaction with ChatGPT: Focusing on Contradictions of Cultural-Historical Activity Theory
kw_ko: 학습자-ChatGPT 상호작용; 글쓰기; 문화역사적 활동 이론
kw_en: ChatGPT; Learner-ChatGPT Interaction; Writing; Cultural-Historical Activity Theory
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 ChatGPT와의 상호작용을 통하여 글쓰기 과제를 수행한 대학생들의 경험을 질적으로 탐색하고자 하였다. 이를 위하여 13명의 대학생을 사례로 선정하였고, 2회의 인터뷰 내용을 질적으로 분석하여 코드를 도출하였다. 문화역사적 활동 이론의 모순 개념에 근거하여 학습자들의 경험을 탐색한 결과, 학습자들은 요소 내 모순을 의미하는 1차 모순과 요소 간 모 순을 가리키는 2차 모순을 모두 경험하고 있었고, 이를 해결하기 위하여 나름의 노력을 기 울이고 있었음을 확인하였다. 본 연구는 교수학습 생태계에 새로이 등장한 생성형 인공지능 ChatGPT의 역할에 대하여 긍정적으로 논의하고 나아가 인간과 기계의 이상적인 관계 맺음 에 대한 시사점을 제공하였다는 점에 그 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: This study attempted to qualitatively explore the experiences of college students who performed writing tasks through interactions with ChatGPT. To this end, 13 college students were selected as examples, and higher codes were derived by qualitatively analyzing the contents of interviews. As a result of searching the students' experiences based on the concept of contradictions of Cultural-Historical Activity Theory, it was confirmed that the students were experiencing both primary contradictions that meant contradictions within elements and secondary contradictions that indicated contradictions between elements, and were making their own efforts to solve them. This study is significant in that it positively discussed the role of ChatGPT, a new Generative Artificial Intelligence(GAI) that has emerged in the teaching-learning ecosystem, and further provided implications for the ideal relationship between humans and machines.

title_ko: Preparing teachers for artificial intelligence integration: A systematic review
title_en: Preparing teachers for artificial intelligence integration: A systematic review
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence; AI-assisted Language Teaching; Professional Development; Systematic Review
abstract_ko: With the rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI), preparing teachers for its effective integration has become increasingly important. This study aims to examine how recent research addressed teacher preparation for the integration of AI in English education. It investigates literature between 2020 and 2025 on AI integration in English education, with a focus on teacher preparation for AI use. Using a systematic review methodology guided by Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses framework, 45 relevant studies were identified and analyzed. The findings reveal a growing interest in AI integration. However, significant gaps remain in teacher preparation. While many studies highlight improvements in teachers’ attitudes and perceived competence following AI-focused training, there is limited evidence of actual classroom application. The literature is dominated by perception-based research and relies heavily on self-reported data. Moreover, many qualitative studies lacked methodological transparency, limiting the reliability of their findings. These results suggest a pressing need for future research to adopt more rigorous and context-sensitive designs. Importantly, the study underscores the value of developing practical, classroom-oriented teacher training programs that go beyond raising awareness and address real instructional challenges in AI implementation.

title_ko: 챗GPT 관련 논문 요약문에 나타난 다단어 표현과 두문자어의 분석 및 임베딩 연구
title_en: Analyzing and Embedding Multi-Word Expressions and Acronyms in ChatGPT-related Paper Abstracts
kw_ko: 대규모언어모델; 다단어표현; 구 마이닝; 두문자어; 단어 임베딩
kw_en: LLM; Multi-word Expression; Phrase Mining; Acronym; Word-embedding
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 컴퓨터 언어학(Computational Linguistics) 분야에서, 텍스트 의미를 명확히 하고 논문의 내용을 효과적으로 전달하는 데 중요한 역할을 하는 다단어 표현(Multi-Word Expressions, MWEs)이 대규모 언어 모델(LLMs) 내에서 어떻게 워드 임베딩으로 표현되며, 문맥 속에서 어떻게 활용되는지를 탐구한다. 구체적으로는, 과학 논문에 대한 구 마이닝(phrase mining)을 통해 MWEs를 식별하고, 관련 약어(acronyms)를 추출하며, MWE 임베딩을 활용하여 기술 용어의 언어적·의미적 특성을 분석한다. 이를 위해 ChatGPT를 주제로 한 최신 국제 학술 논문 41,230편의 초록을 수집하여, 이 초록들에 포함된 MWEs를 추출하고 분석한다. 본 연구는 MWEs 임베딩의 자연어 처리(NLP) 과제에서의 활용 가능성을 확장하는 것을 목표로 한다. 궁극적으로는 자연어 처리 기술과 생성형 AI 시스템의 통합 과정을 심층적으로 이해하고자 한다.
abstract_en: In the field of computational linguistics, this study aims to investigate how multi-word expressions, which play an important role in disambiguating text meaning and effectively communicating a paper's content, are represented as word embeddings in large-scale language models (LLMs) and utilized in context. Additionally, we identify multi-word expressions (MWEs) through phrase mining in scientific papers, extract acronyms, and analyze the characteristics of technical terms using MWE word embeddings. To achieve this, this study collects 41,230 abstracts from recent international academic papers related to ChatGPT, extracts and analyzes the multi-word expressions present in these abstracts, extends the application of word embeddings for multi-word expressions in natural language processing, and seeks to understand the process of integrating natural language processing technology with the workings of generative AI.
note: ChatGPT 논문초록 MWE 임베딩 전산언어학, 교육 없음

title_ko: Direct vs. Reformulation Feedback through ChatGPT on EFL Learners’ Writings
title_en: Direct vs. Reformulation Feedback through ChatGPT on EFL Learners’ Writings
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 직접; 교정 피드백; 재구성
kw_en: ChatGPT; direct; written corrective feedback; reformulation
abstract_ko: This study investigates the short- and long-term effects of two types of written corrective feedback (WCF)—direct feedback and reformulation—delivered via ChatGPT on EFL learners’ writing performance. Twenty-seven university students participated in a three-stage writing process: an initial draft, a first revision immediately after feedback, and a delayed second revision two weeks later without additional support. Writing was evaluated across five dimensions: Content, Organization, Vocabulary, Language Use, and Mechanics. Descriptive and inferential analyses revealed that both feedback types led to short-term improvements, particularly in Content, Vocabulary, and overall writing scores. Direct WCF was effective in generating broad improvements across most areas, excluding Language Use. Reformulation feedback, in contrast, led to stronger gains in Content and Organization and continued to yield significant improvements in the delayed revision, especially in Content and Vocabulary. However, neither feedback type produced significant gains in grammatical accuracy (Language Use), indicating the need for supplementary grammar instruction. These findings suggest that reformulation feedback via ChatGPT is particularly effective in enhancing idea development and lexical variety, while direct WCF provides general but less targeted improvements. The study highlights the pedagogical potential of AI-mediated feedback and underscores the importance of differentiated instructional strategies to address persistent language accuracy issues.
abstract_en: This study investigates the short- and long-term effects of two types of written corrective feedback (WCF)—direct feedback and reformulation—delivered via ChatGPT on EFL learners’ writing performance. Twenty-seven university students participated in a three-stage writing process: an initial draft, a first revision immediately after feedback, and a delayed second revision two weeks later without additional support. Writing was evaluated across five dimensions: Content, Organization, Vocabulary, Language Use, and Mechanics. Descriptive and inferential analyses revealed that both feedback types led to short-term improvements, particularly in Content, Vocabulary, and overall writing scores. Direct WCF was effective in generating broad improvements across most areas, excluding Language Use. Reformulation feedback, in contrast, led to stronger gains in Content and Organization and continued to yield significant improvements in the delayed revision, especially in Content and Vocabulary. However, neither feedback type produced significant gains in grammatical accuracy (Language Use), indicating the need for supplementary grammar instruction. These findings suggest that reformulation feedback via ChatGPT is particularly effective in enhancing idea development and lexical variety, while direct WCF provides general but less targeted improvements. The study highlights the pedagogical potential of AI-mediated feedback and underscores the importance of differentiated instructional strategies to address persistent language accuracy issues.

title_ko: 초등 예비교사의 과정 중심 영어 글쓰기에 미치는 ChatGPT 피드백의 영향
title_en: The impact of ChatGPT feedback on the process-oriented English writing of primary pre-service teachers
kw_ko: 챗지피티 피드백; 과정 중심 글쓰기; 내용과 구성; 정의적 영역
kw_en: ChatGPT feedback; process-oriented writing; content and organization; affective domains
abstract_ko: This study investigates how the use of ChatGPT for revision in English writing classes affects the development of writing skills of ten primary pre-service teachers in the areas of content, organization, vocabulary, grammar, and mechanics of their writings, as well as their affective domains. To this end, qualitative data were analyzed from the first drafts written by participants during a process-oriented writing phase, and the final drafts revised after they received feedback from ChatGPT as well as their reflective journals. The results show that ChatGPT feedback significantly improved the content and the organization of primary pre-service teachers’ essays by encouraging them to add more details and examples, and to structure their ideas in a more logical and coherent manner. The findings also indicate that using ChatGPT as a revision tool helped them to select more appropriate vocabulary, correct grammatical errors for clarity, and use writing mechanics, such as spelling and punctuation, more accurately. Furthermore, with the support of ChatGPT, primary pre-service teachers reported increased interest in writing activities, greater confidence in sentence construction, enhanced motivation for essay writing, and more cautious and reflective attitudes towards using ChatGPT as a writing assistant.

title_ko: AI 앱 기반 영어 어휘 학습 활동이 대학생의 어휘 습득과 학습자 인식에 미치는 영향
title_en: The effects of AI app-based English vocabulary learning on university students’ vocabulary acquisition and learner perception
kw_ko: AI 앱 기반 영어 어휘 학습; 어휘 습득; 한국인 대학생; 학습자 인식
kw_en: AI app-based English vocabulary learning; vocabulary acquisition; Korean university students; learner perception
abstract_ko: This study examines the effects of using QuillBot, an AI-based learning tool, on English vocabulary acquisition among Korean university students. It also investigates learners’ perceptions toward AI app-based English vocabulary learning in order to establish an effective vocabulary learning method and teaching plan for self-directed learning. Quantitative data from pre- and post-vocabulary tests, five vocabulary quizzes, and pre- and post-surveys of 45 students taking a Basic TOEIC class as part of the liberal arts curriculum at D University in Chungcheongnam-do were analyzed. A qualitative analysis was also conducted on open-ended survey responses and learners’ experiences and opinions recorded in learning journals. The findings are as follows. First, learners using the AI tool showed statistically significant improvements in all quantitative vocabulary tests and quizzes. Second, positive responses were recorded regarding learner awareness and the effectiveness and satisfaction of using AI tools in vocabulary learning. Third, participating students frequently mentioned vocabulary learning support, learning efficiency, and self-directed learning as advantages. As in previous studies, the disadvantages included meaning distortion, limited free features, and a lack of detailed feedback due to limitations in the functionality, usability, and accessibility of the AI tool. Based on the findings, several educational suggestions are discussed.

title_ko: 디지털휴먼 기반 AI튜터 앱 개발 및 사용자 경험 평가
title_en: Development and user experience evaluation of a mobile application for digital-human AI tutors
kw_ko: 디지털휴먼; AI튜터; 사용자 경험 평가; 래피드 프로토타이핑; 모바일 앱
kw_en: Digital Human; AI Tutor; User Experience Evaluation; Rapid Prototyping; Mobile Application
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 초등 영어 말하기 학습용 디지털휴먼 기반 AI튜터 프로토타입을 개발하고, 교사의 관점에서 사용자 경험을 평가하는 것을 목적으로 하였다. 이를 위해 래피드 프로토타이핑 방법론에 따라, 페르소나 기반 시나리오를 개발하고 이를 토대로 중충실도의 프로토타입을 설계․구현하여 수정보완의과정을 반복적으로 거쳤다. 최종 개발된 모바일 앱 형태의 프로토타입은 실제 초등학교 영어 수업 현장에 적용한 다음, 총 8명의 영어 전담 교사의 설문 응답과 관찰 기반 피드백을 통해 교사 측면과 학생 측면의 사용자 경험을 평가하였다. 평가 결과, 디지털휴먼 기반 AI튜터는 영어 말하기 학습 활동에서 학생들의 흥미와 참여도를 높이는 데 효과적이었으며, 개인화된 피드백과 실시간 수준별/맞춤형 대화 기회를 제공함으로써 학습자에게 몰입감 있는 학습 경험을 지원하는 데 긍정적인 역할을 하는 것으로 나타났다. 반면, 시스템 반응 속도, 음성 인식 정확도, 콘텐츠 다양성, 시각적 매력성 등에 있어서는 개선이 필요함을 확인하였다. 본 연구는 디지털휴먼과 AI기술의 통합을 통해 AI기반 에듀테크의실현 가능성과 교육적 가치를 실증적으로 제시함으로써, 교육 분야에서 AI 활용 가능성을 확장하는데 기여한다. 향후 연구에서는 디지털휴먼 기반 AI튜터의 학습 성과에 대한 장기적인 효과를 검증하고, 영어 외의 다양한 교과에서도 적용 가능성을 탐색할 필요가 있다.
abstract_en: This study aimed to develop a digital human-based AI tutor prototype for elementary English education and evaluate user experience from teachers' perspectives. Following the rapid prototyping methodology, a persona-based scenario was created, and a mid-fidelity prototype was designed and iteratively refined. The final prototype, implemented as a mobile application, was applied in actual elementary English classes, and user experience was evaluated based on survey responses and observational feedback from eight English subject teachers. The results indicated that the AI tutor was effective in increasing students’ engagement and interest in English speaking activities and provided immersive learning experiences through personalized feedback and real-time, level-appropriate interactions. However, improvements are needed in system response speed, speech recognition accuracy, content variety, and visual appeal. This study demonstrates the educational value and feasibility of AI-based edutech through the integration of digital humans and AI technology, contributing to the expanded application of AI in education. Future research should investigate the long-term learning outcomes of AI tutor use and explore its applicability across subjects beyond English.

title_ko: 논술형 평가 전문성 강화를 위한 AI 자동채점 기반 평가자 협의 모델 개발: 교사-AI 협업을 중심으로
title_en: Calibrating human and machine: Developing an AI-assisted rater discussion model for automated writing evaluation(AWE)
kw_ko: AI 자동채점; 논술형 평가; 교사-AI 협업; 평가자 협의; 작문 평가
kw_en: Automated Scoring; Essay Assessment; Human-AI Collaboration; Rater Discussion; Writing Assessment
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 평가 공정성과 신뢰도 확보를 위하여 AI를 활용한 교사-AI 협업 기반의 평가자 협의 모델을 개발 및 검증하고자 하였다. 모델 개발 단계에서는 AI로 ChatGPT의 GPT-o3를 활용, <화법과 작문>의 논술형 평가 과제를 기준으로 프롬프트 설계 및 채점을 시행하였다. 모델 검증 단계에서는 교사 3인과 AI가 고등학교 3학년 222명의 논술형 평가 답안 중 예비 채점 25편, 본 채점 50편을 샘플로채점하였다. 이후, 국어 교사 8인을 대상으로 본 모델의 적합성 검증 FGI를 실시하였다. 양적 분석에는 채점 기준표의 설계 및 정교화, 예비 채점, 본 채점, 피드백 제공의 전 과정을 3단계로 구조화하고채점 결과에 대한 Cronbach’s α, Rasch 내적합도(infit), 완전일치도 및 근접일치도 분석을 시행하였다. 그결과, 교사-AI 간의 실제적인 프롬프트 설계를 제시함과 함께 본 채점 단계에서 AI 자동채점과 인간평가자의 완전일치도가 53.2~68%, 근접일치도가 95.3~98%로 분포함을 확인하였다. MFRM은 GPT o3 가 0.94로 적합한 채점자로 기능함을 확인하였다. FGI 분석 결과, 교사들은 단독 과목 운영 보조, 협의 효율성 제고, 평가 공정성 강화 측면에서 긍정적이라고 평가하였다. 그러나 교사의 AI 사용 역량편차가 존재하는 점, 교사 주도성 약화가 우려되는 점, 모델 자체의 복잡성과 AI 결과의 오류 가능성이 존재하는 점 등이 우려 사항으로 지적되었다. 이에, 본 연구는 생성형 AI를 교사 판단을 보완하는후행적 조언자로 위치시켜 교사의 평가 전문성을 보장하는 방향을 강조하고, 인간–비인간 주체 사이의 다원적 협의 개념을 제안하였다. 추가로 AI의 ‘메타 평가자’ 가능성과 평가 유형별 적합성, 그리고기술 활용 격차 해소 방안의 필요성을 제언하였다.
abstract_en: This study developed and validated a teacher-AI collaborative rater-moderation model to enhance fairness and reliability in essay assessment. In the development phase, GPT-o3 was employed for automated writing evaluation(AWE), designing prompts and evaluating writing tasks from the high-school course Speech and Writing. For validation, three teachers and the AI scored samples from Grade-12 students’ essays—25 for pilot scoring and 50 for operational scoring—and a focus group interview(FGI) with eight Korean-language teachers assessed the model’s applicability. Operational scoring showed exact agreement between AI and human raters of 53.2–68.0% and adjacent agreement of 95.3–98.0%, while Multi-Facet Rasch Measurement confirmed GPT-o3 as a well-fitting rater(infit=0.94). FGI findings noted benefits in supporting single-teacher course operation, improving the efficiency of rater discussions, and enhancing fairness, alongside concerns about disparities in AI literacy, potential weakening of teacher agency, model complexity, and the risk of AI-generated errors. The study positions Human-AI collaboration as a framework in which generative AI functions as a post-hoc advisor complementing teachers’ professional judgment and calls for exploring AI’s potential as a “meta-rater,” identifying writing assessment types best suited to AI collaboration, and addressing inequities in access and proficiency.
note: GPT-o3 논술형 자동채점 교사-AI 협의모델 개발·일치도

title_ko: 페르소나 기반 ChatGPT와의 논변적 상호작용이 논증적 글쓰기, 관용적 태도, 학습 몰입에 미치는 영향
title_en: The impact of argumentative interaction with persona-based ChatGPT on argumentative writing, tolerant attitude, and learning engagement
kw_ko: AI 챗봇; 페르소나; 논변적 상호작용; 상호작용 분석
kw_en: ChatGPT; AI Chatbot; Persona; Argumentation; Interaction analysis
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 페르소나 기반 ChatGPT와의 논변적 상호작용이 학습자의 논증적 글쓰기, 관용적 태도, 학습 몰입에 미치는 영향을 실증적으로 분석하고자 하였다. 이를 위해 국내 고등교육기관 재학생 및 졸업생 53명을 대상으로, 페르소나가 설정된 ChatGPT와 상호작용한 실험 집단 27명과 일반 ChatGPT와상호작용한 통제 집단 26명의 논증적 글쓰기, 관용적 태도, 학습 몰입 경험을 측정하였으며, 각 집단간 상호작용 패턴 차이와 연구 참여자들의 전반적인 경험을 정량적․정성적으로 분석하였다. 주요 연구 결과는 다음과 같다. 첫째, 논증적 글쓰기는 두 집단 모두 사후에 유의미하게 향상되었으나, 페르소나 설정 여부에 따른 통계적 차이는 나타나지 않았다. 둘째, 관용적 태도의 하위 요인 중 개방적 태도는 두 집단 모두 사후에 유의미한 향상을 보였으나, 공감적 태도는 두 집단 모두 유의미한 변화가나타나지 않았다. 셋째, 학습 몰입의 경우 실험 집단이 통제 집단보다 유의미하게 높은 몰입 경험을보고하였다. 넷째, 상호작용 패턴 분석 결과, 실험 집단은 질문과 평가, 대안 주장 등을 포함한 창의적이고 발산적인 논의 패턴을 보인 반면, 통제 집단은 근거 중심의 반박과 탐색 중심의 수렴적 논의 패턴을 보였다. 다섯째, 면담 분석에서는 페르소나 기반 ChatGPT와의 상호작용이 타인의 다양한 관점에대한 이해, 논증적 사고, 정서적 몰입을 촉진하였으나, 일관된 입장 유지로 인해 공감적 태도가 저해될 수 있다는 이중적 평가가 나타났다. 본 연구는 페르소나 기반 ChatGPT가 학습자의 인지적 학습 성과를 효과적으로 촉진할 가능성을 보여주며, 나아가 정의적 영역까지 지원할 수 있는 교육적 잠재성을 지님을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study empirically examined the effects of argumentative interactions with persona-based ChatGPT on learners’ argumentative writing, tolerant attitude, and learning engagement. Fifty-three Korean undergraduate and graduate learners were divided into two groups: an experimental group of 27 participants interacted with persona-based ChatGPT and a control group of 26 participants interacted with regular ChatGPT without persona. Quantitative and qualitative analyses assessed argumentative writing, tolerant attitude, learning engagement, interaction patterns, as well as participants’ experiences. The main findings are as follows. First, both groups significantly improved their argumentative writing, with no significant difference by persona presence. Second, among sub-factors of tolerant attitude, open attitude significantly increased in both groups, whereas empathetic attitude showed no significant change in either group. Third, the experimental group reported significantly higher learning engagement compared to the control group. Fourth, the experimental group exhibited more creative and divergent argumentative patterns, while the control group showed more convergent, evidence-focused patterns. Fifth, interview analyses revealed mixed evaluations of persona-based ChatGPT. Participants noted its effectiveness in promoting comprehension of diverse perspectives, activating higher-order thinking, and fostering emotional engagement, but also pointed out that an excessively consistent persona stance could impede empathy. This study demonstrates the potential of persona-based ChatGPT to enhance learners’ academic performance and suggests its promise for supporting the affective domain.
note: 대학생 논증 글쓰기 역량 실험

title_ko: Comparative Effects of AI and Peer Collaboration on L2 Writing Proficiency: An Empirical Study
title_en: Comparative Effects of AI and Peer Collaboration on L2 Writing Proficiency: An Empirical Study
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 제2 언어 습득; 영어 글쓰기 지도; 영어 학습자; 논쟁적 에세이
kw_en: Generative AI; SLA; English writing instruction; English learner; Argumentative essay
abstract_ko: This study examines the effectiveness of ChatGPT as a pedagogical tool in L2-English writing instruction over a semester. With L1-Korean college students as participants, the study compares the outcomes of a peer-interacted group (n = 34) with those of an AI-interacted group (n = 42). Both groups wrote argumentative essays responding to the same prompts and completed identical pre- and post-writing activities, including brainstorming and debating given essay topics. The only difference lay in the learners’ interaction partners during the activities: peers or ChatGPT. The results of a pretest and four posttests (three immediate and one delayed), scored on content, language use, and organization, show that the AI-interaction group consistently outperformed the peer-interaction group, specifically in content on the first posttest and language use on subsequent posttests. Furthermore, the peer-interaction group’s scores sharply declined on the delayed posttest, while the AI-interaction group maintained consistent performance, suggesting lasting benefits of interacting with ChatGPT. Follow-up interviews, however, revealed the learners’ ambivalence toward using ChatGPT in their writing process. The students appreciated the AI’s prompt and effective editing; however, they raised concerns about its lack of creativity and originality as well as the ethics of incorporating its content suggestions into their essays. Pedagogical implications and potential avenues for future research are discussed.
