title_ko: 영어 AI 디지털교과서에 관한 초등교사의 인식과 연수 요구 분석
title_en: Elementary school teachers’ perceptions and training needs for English AI digital textbooks
kw_ko: AI 디지털 교과서; 기술 수용; 영어교육; 초등 교사; 제2언어교사교육
kw_en: AIDT; AI Digital Textbook; technology acceptance; English education; elementary teacher; second language teacher education
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 초등교사의 영어 AI 디지털교과서(AIDT)에 대한 인식과 연수 요구를 탐색하고자 하였다. 이를 위해 다양한 지역의 초등교사 66명을 대상으로 설문조사를 실시하였고, 교사 9명을 대상으로 서면 면담을 실시하였다. 수집된 자료는 빈도분석 및 주제분석을 중심으로 양적, 질적 분석을 활용한 혼합분석방법으로 분석하였다. 주요 연구 결과는 다음과 같다: 첫째, 실시간 발음 평가 및 피드백 제공, 학생 맞춤형 학습 경로 제공, 게임화 요소를 활용한 학습 참여 유도 등에서 AIDT가 유용한 것으로 보았다. 향후 영어 AIDT를 수업에 실제 적용 계획에 대해서도 대체적으로 긍정적이었다. AIDT가 학습자 참여를 촉진시키는데 도움이 된다고 보았다. 영어 AIDT 연수가 대체적으로 영어 교수에 유용하다고 보았다. 영어 AIDT에 대한 기대(학생들의 학습 흥미와 동기 유발, 학생 맞춤형 학습 지원, AI 기반 영어 평가 및 피드백 제공 등)와 우려(기기 및 네트워크 환경 문제, 교사의 활용 역량 부족, 학생 간 학습 격차 심화, 콘텐츠 신뢰성 부족)를 나타내었다. 둘째, 교사들은 이론 중심의 연수보다 실습 위주의 실제 기반 연수, 그리고 대면과 온라인을 병행하는 혼합형을 선호하였다. 연수 참여 여건과 접근성이 개선되기를 바라고 있었다. 다양한 형태의 연수 기회 확대, 교사학습공동체와 연계 운영, 우수 사례 시스템 구축 등의 정책 및 지원이 있기를 바랬다. 셋째, 교직 및 영어 교수 경력에 따라 인식과 요구가 유사하면서도 다른 점이 있었다. 고경력 교사들은 기술의 교육적 활용 가능성과 한계를 신중하게 고려하는 한편, 저경력 교사는 새로운 수업 도구에 대한 흥미와 수용 태도가 높았다. 교육연수에서 고경력 교사들은 자료 수정 및 보완, 학습자 맞춤형 기능의 실제적용 등에 관심이 있는 반면, 저경력 교사들은 AIDT 활용법과 구체적인 사례를 알고 싶어 하였다. 연수 경험 유무에 따라 상이하였는데, 연수 경험이 있는 교사들은 도구의 기능뿐 아니라 수업 맥락에 맞는 활용 방식을 스스로 구상하거나 이미 실천하고 있었으며, 연수 미경험자는 도구 자체에 대한 이해 부족과 적용 거리감을 나타냈다. AIDT 관련 연수 기회 및 참여 가능성, 그리고 AIDT에 관한 정보 접근성이 근무 지역 및 환경에 따라 차이가 나타나기도 하였다. 넷째, AIDT의 실제 수업 적용시 어려운 점은 교실 상황에 맞지 않는 콘텐츠, 학생 수준과의 괴리, 기기 및 네트워크 환경의 불안정성, 기능 숙지 어려움, 학습 흐름 단절 우려, 수업 시간 내 활용 분량 조절의 어려움 등으로 나타났다. 영어 AIDT의 안정적 수업 적용을 위해 초등교사들이 제시한 개선 요구는 AIDT 활용에 적합한 수업시간 확보, 실제 수업 중심의 실습형 연수 확대, 교사 간 공동수업 및 협업체제 구축, 업무 경감을 위한 행정 지원, 학교 관리자 및 동료교사의 협조 강화, 정기적인 후속 연수 및 컨설팅 등으로 나타났다. 본 연구는 초등영어 AIDT의 적용과 개선, AIDT의 적용을 위한 교사교육 및 전문성 신장에 대한 필요성과 시사점을 던져주고 있다.
abstract_en: This study investigates elementary school teachers’ perceptions and training needs regarding English AI Digital Textbooks (AIDT). A survey was conducted with 66 teachers from diverse regions, and written interviews were collected from 9 participants. A mixed-methods approach was employed, combining descriptive statistics and thematic analysis. Overall, teachers viewed AIDT as a useful tool for English teaching and expressed positive intentions to implement it. They highlighted its potential for enhancing student motivation, supporting personalized learning, and enabling AI-based assessment and feedback. However, they also voiced concerns about technological infrastructure, teachers’ digital competence, learning gaps among students, and content reliability. Challenges in classroom implementation included mismatches between content and student level, unstable devices or networks, difficulties in mastering functions, and time management issues. Teachers called for practical improvements such as securing dedicated time for AIDT use, expanding training opportunities, fostering collaboration, and providing administrative support and collaborative support among teachers. Teachers preferred hands-on, practice-based training over theory-oriented programs and favored blended formats that combine in-person and online sessions. They emphasized the need to improve access to training, diversify learning opportunities, connect with teacher learning communities, and establish systems for sharing best practices. Differences in perceptions emerged by teaching experience and prior training. Experienced teachers focused on adapting AIDT to fit instructional contexts, while novice teachers were more eager to explore new tools but needed specific usage guidance. Teachers with prior training showed greater confidence and contextual application, whereas those without training expressed uncertainty. Regional disparities also affected access to AIDT-related resources and training. This study offers insights into enhancing AIDT adoption in elementary English education, underscoring the need for structured teacher training and continued professional development.

title_ko: A Comparative Study on the Use of Papago and ChatGPT in English Writing by Korean University Students
title_en: A Comparative Study on the Use of Papago and ChatGPT in English Writing by Korean University Students
kw_en: Papago; ChatGPT; survey; English writing; prompt guidelines
abstract_ko: This study compares the results of English open-ended writing assignments completed by 21 university students using two machine translation tools, Papago and ChatGPT. A survey was also conducted to examine their perceived usefulness and differences. To investigate the impact of English proficiency, participants are divided into two groups based on their TOEIC scores: above 600 and below 600. The analysis reveals that in the Papago-based writing tasks, there are noticeable differences in grammar and vocabulary usage between the two groups, while the results for content, structure, and mechanics are similar. In contrast, for the ChatGPT- based writing tasks, although the below-600 group uses prompts more frequently, the quality of their writing outcomes is similar to that of the above-600 group. This suggests that the quality of ChatGPT outputs depends more on the content of the prompts than on their frequency of use, and is largely unrelated to English proficiency. Survey results show that both groups raise concerns about overreliance on ChatGPT, including ethical issues and the potential decline in critical thinking and English language skills. These findings suggest the need for clear guidelines on how to use ChatGPT effectively.

title_ko: A Case Study of College EFL Students’ Reflections on ChatGPT Use for Reading and Writing: Implications for Digital Literacy
title_en: A Case Study of College EFL Students’ Reflections on ChatGPT Use for Reading and Writing: Implications for Digital Literacy
kw_en: ChatGPT; digital literacy; reflection; reading; writing; college English; case study
abstract_ko: As AI tools such as ChatGPT become more common, offering both advantages and drawbacks, it is important for learners to think critically about how they use them. Effective use of these tools requires digital literacy skills, encompassing functional, higher-order thinking, social awareness, and cooperation. This case study examined 12 college EFL students in a course where ChatGPT was extensively integrated into reading and writing tasks. Data came from student reflection logs and instructional materials collected after each ChatGPT session. Using inductive content analysis and deductive thematic analysis, the study found that students were capable of identifying benefits and limitations of ChatGPT for literacy practices. Moreover, student reflection logs revealed evidence of all digital literacy skills, along with overlapping areas and an uneven emphasis across skills. Overall, this study underscored digital literacy as both a prerequisite and an outcome of AI-integrated language learning and highlighted reflective practice as a critical component of this process.

title_ko: 생성형 AI를 활용한 영어 콘텐츠 개발 아이디어톤 설계 및 실행연구: 퀘스트 기반 학습을 중심으로
title_en: AI-Powered English Content Ideathon Through Quest-Based Learning
kw_en: AI literacy; quest-based learning (QBL); English content development; ideathon; gamification
abstract_ko: This study designed and implemented an AI-powered English content ideathon grounded in the quest-based learning (QBL) framework to enhance learners’ AI literacy, creative problem-solving, and content planning skills. Conducted over four months at D University, the program comprised five sequential quests—Exploration, Challenge, Implement, Reflection, and Showcase—integrating principles of gamification to foster motivation and engagement. Eleven undergraduate participants from diverse majors engaged in phased tasks that incorporated generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Canva to conceptualize, refine, and prototype projects in English content development. Final outputs included video presentations, storyboards, and posters with embedded QR codes for exhibition. Projects ranged from tourism and cultural promotion to English education, including a university entrance exam-focused reading and grammar learning app prototype. Qualitative analysis of post-program reflections revealed that the QBL structure facilitated immersion, guided idea development, and cultivated transferable skills such as teamwork, critical thinking, and self-directed learning. Participants reported a shift in perception of AI from a simple information retrieval tool to a strategic partner in content creation. The study highlights the potential of integrating generative AI, QBL, and gamification into higher education, offering a scalable, interdisciplinary model for learner-centered AI literacy education in English content creation.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 대학 교양 영어 작문 수업 연구
title_en: A Study on the Use of ChatGPT in a College English Composition Course.
kw_en: ChatGPT; English composition; generative AI; writing self-efficacy; EFL writing instruction
abstract_ko: This study investigated the effectiveness of a ChatGPT-integrated instructional approach in a college-level English composition course. The course employed a mixed instructional model: traditional teacher-centered instruction during the first half of the semester and ChatGPT-assisted learning in the second half. Data were collected through three stages of writing proficiency tests (pre-, mid-, and post-tests), writing self-efficacy surveys, weekly writing assignments, and student surveys and interviews. The findings revealed notable improvements in students’ writing proficiency and writing self-efficacy following the implementation of ChatGPT-based instruction. Additionally, the analysis of student writing demonstrated enhanced organization and linguistic accuracy. Students expressed positive perceptions of ChatGPT and employed it strategically for idea generation, lexical variation, and error correction. These results suggest that integrating generative AI tools such as ChatGPT can effectively support the development of writing skills and learner autonomy in EFL contexts.

title_ko: Preparing English Language Instructors for the AI Era: A Professional Development Approach
title_en: Preparing English Language Instructors for the AI Era: A Professional Development Approach
kw_en: Artificial intelligence; AI in ELT; teacher education; professional development
abstract_ko: The study explores the effects of a professional development program on English language instructors’ (1) knowledge, (2) practical skills, and (3) self-efficacy in incorporating artificial intelligence (AI) into their pedagogical practices. Grounded in the theoretical frameworks of cognitive apprenticeship and socio-constructivism, the study was conducted with 15 university-level instructors. Data were collected from two primary sources—participants’ perspectives and recorded teaching sessions—using four tools: pre- and post-course interviews, weekly instructional implementations, reflective journals on AI use, and course feedback. The findings indicate that the training program had a substantial impact, fostering enhanced integration of AI into teaching practices. Participants demonstrated notable development in their conceptual understanding, instructional competence, and confidence in using AI tools. Furthermore, the study identified several challenges and constraints, offering insight into the multifaceted nature of preparing language educators for AI-enhanced instruction. This course may thus serve as a replicable model for fostering AI readiness among English language teachers.

title_ko: The Impact of AI-Based English Classes on Students' Multimodal Literacy, Critical Thinking, and Creative Thinking
title_en: The Impact of AI-Based English Classes on Students' Multimodal Literacy, Critical Thinking, and Creative Thinking
kw_ko: 인공지능; 챗지피티; 멀티모달 문해력; 비판적 사고; 창의적 사고
kw_en: AI; ChatGPT; Multimodal literacy; Critical thinking; Creative thinking
abstract_ko: This study explores the impact of AI-integrated English class activities on college students' multimodal literacy, critical thinking, and creative thinking. Twenty-one students participated in a semester-long project creating short-form videos. Pre- and post-survey results, analyzed using paired sample t-tests, indicated modest but non-significant gains in multimodal expression and interpretation, with stable preferences for multimodal learning. Critical thinking showed significant improvement, while creative thinking increased slightly without statistical significance. Qualitative data revealed that AI tools facilitated meaningful learning experiences by supporting creative tasks and language practice. These findings offer valuable pedagogical implications and suggest future directions for integrating AI into English language education.

title_ko: Integrating Generative AI and Machine Translation into EFL Reading and Vocabulary Instruction
title_en: Integrating Generative AI and Machine Translation into EFL Reading and Vocabulary Instruction
kw_en: machine translators; AI; ChatGPT; reading comprehension; vocabulary; students’ perception
abstract_ko: This study investigated the effects of machine translators, ChatGPT, and their combined use on reading comprehension and vocabulary acquisition among 120 university students enrolled in English courses in 2024, who were randomly assigned to one of three tool-based groups. It also examined whether tool usage in EFL reading contexts led to varying outcomes and explored students’ perceptions of these tools. Results showed that all three groups improved in reading and vocabulary within groups, but no significant differences were found between groups. Additionally, learners’ perceptions regarding both the affective and motivational influence, as well as the educational impact of AI tools, showed no significant variation across experimental groups for the majority of survey items. Students who used machine translators found them helpful for understanding texts and reading speed but expressed concerns about inaccuracy, overuse, and unclear meanings. Those who used ChatGPT appreciated its usefulness and speed but also noted similar issues to those observed in the Machine Translation (MT) group. The group using both tools found them useful, clear, and fast, but still faced issues related to overreliance and occasional errors. Despite its limitations, this study provides an empirical example of integrating AI tools into foreign language education and offers meaningful pedagogical implications.

title_ko: Enhancing English Speaking Skills through AI: University Students’ Perceptions of ChatGPT as a Learning Tool
title_en: Enhancing English Speaking Skills through AI: University Students’ Perceptions of ChatGPT as a Learning Tool
kw_en: Artificial intelligence; ChatGPT; English as a Foreign Language; English speaking skills; EFL students’ perception
abstract_ko: This study aims to investigate the impact of an artificial intelligence tool, ChatGPT, on English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learners’ speaking skills, including fluency, lexical range, grammatical range with accuracy, and content. Learners’ perceptions and attitudes toward using an AI-mediated speaking tool to enhance their English-speaking skills were also qualitatively explored. Fifty students from a university in Seoul were assigned to an experimental group, which engaged in communicative tasks using a generative AI-powered voice interaction tool, and to a control group, which practiced without the aid of the tool. Data were collected through (1) a pre- and post-test on speaking skills and (2) a post-survey on affective attitudes administered to the experimental group. A five-point Likert scale online survey assessed students' perceptions of the tool’s use. Results revealed that the post-test speaking scores of the experimental group were significantly higher than those of the control group, which interacted with peers. The group using the AI tool showed significant improvement in EFL learners’ speaking skills. Analyses of the survey responses indicated high levels of perceived usefulness and positive attitudes toward the AI tool, and the study underscores that such positive attitudes significantly influence learners’ intention to adopt ChatGPT for English-speaking practice.

title_ko: 초등학생 대상AI 챗봇 기반 수업이 영어 어휘 성취도에 미치는 영향
title_en: The Effects of AI Chatbot-based Classes for Elementary Students on English Vocabulary Achievement
kw_en: AI chatbots; artificial intelligence speakers; English vocabulary achievement; affective domain Applicable level: elementary education
abstract_ko: This paper aims to analyze the effects of AI chatbots and artificial intelligence speakers (application) on elementary school students in English vocabulary classes. Thirty students in grades 4–6 were randomly divided into two groups, A and B. Vocabulary tests (pre-post) and surveys (pre-post) on affective domains were used to collect data. The experimental classes consisted of six sessions using AI chatbots and AI speakers for group A (n=15), and Classcard application for group B (n=15). The results of the research are as follows. First, there was a statistically significant difference in vocabulary achievement between the two groups. kw_ko: 챗지피티; 생성형 인공지능; 어휘 및 읽기 학습; 영어 교육; 영어 수준

abstract_ko: This study explores the effectiveness of ChatGPT-assisted vocabulary learning in university-level English reading classes. Pre- and post-tests were administered to evaluate the differential impact on learners’ comprehension abilities according to English proficiency levels. Paired-sample t-tests, ANOVA, and post-hoc analysis were conducted to compare learners’ performance in vocabulary and reading before and after ChatGPT-assisted classes. The findings of this study suggest that ChatGPT-assisted vocabulary and reading sessions were effective. Statistical analysis demonstrated a significant enhancement in learners’ academic outcomes. In addition, the lower-level group exhibited a higher degree of improvement in achievement than the intermediate and advanced groups. This suggests that ChatGPT-based English instruction significantly enhances the foundational comprehension among lower-level learners and supports their comprehensive language learning outcomes.

title_en: Perceptions of ChatGPT Among Learners in a ChatGPT-Based English Literature Course

abstract_ko: This paper examines learners' overall perceptions of ChatGPT by applying it in an English Literature class. The key findings are as follows. First, most learners expressed satisfaction with the explanations and answers provided by ChatGPT. Second, they were generally pleased with both the content and format of its suggestions, noting that ChatGPT offered new perspectives and helped deepen their understanding of discussions and literary works. Third, learners also recognized that some explanations were occasionally inaccurate, misaligned with the content, or contained potential errors. As shown in this study, while learners responded positively overall, they also pointed out issues—particularly errors—that impact ChatGPT’s reliability.

kw_ko: 챗GPT; 플립러닝; 자기주도적 학습; 영문학 수업; 학습자 인식

abstract_ko: This study investigates the integration of ChatGPT into a flipped learning–based English literature course, focusing on students’ perceptions and uses of the tool in group discussions. Drawing on survey data and reflective writings, the research identifies both pedagogical benefits and instructional challenges of ChatGPT in higher education. Reported benefits include diverse perspectives, efficiency, immediate feedback, informational support, and enhanced critical thinking. Concerns, however, center on plagiarism risks, factual inaccuracies, algorithmic bias, and reduced engagement. The findings indicate that while ChatGPT can function as a valuable supportive resource, its pedagogical impact depends on thoughtful instructional design and active instructor mediation. The study concludes by outlining implications for curriculum development and emphasizes the need for continued research on AI-assisted learning in literature education.

title_en: From Passive Recipients to Active Editors: Using Generative AI to develop Digital Literacy in Undergraduate General English Writing Courses
kw_ko: 학부교양과목; 영어 작문; 디지털 리터러시; 챗지피티; 생성형 AI
kw_en: undergraduate general education course; English writing class; digital literacy; ChatGPT; generative AI
abstract_ko: This study examines how generative AI tools can be used as teaching aids in college English writing classes and how ChatGPT can help undergraduate students enhance their digital literacy, critical thinking, and writing strategies. A case study shows that ChatGPT overall reduced the students' anxiety, basic grammar errors, and helped maintain coherence and style. However, many students tended to accept the ChatGPT's suggestions uncritically, revealing their over-reliance on the tool. To address this and to encourage a students-led learning environment and their critical engagement, students were required to document the reasons for accepting or rejecting the AI-generated feedback. This approach strengthened both their writing skills and their ability to view AI as a collaborative partner rather than an unquestionable authority.

abstract_ko: This study examines the applicability and limitations of interactive generative AI, particularly ChatGPT, in Arabic language education for military purposes. It explores the distinct characteristics of foreign and military language training and reviews AI’s potential across key functions such as speaking, listening, writing, and translation. The findings show that AI can serve as an effective support tool in repetitive and structured training environments. However, due to the security, hierarchy, and context-specific demands of military education, the immediate adoption of general-purpose AI remains limited. This study offers a theoretical basis for military-specific language education and proposes future directions, including the development of secure AI platforms and integrated voice feedback systems.

title_ko: 챗봇매개학습에서 인공지능 에이전트 의인화의 영어학습동기-만족도 매개효과 및 성별 조절효과 연구
title_en: Anthropomorphism of AI Agents in Chatbot-Mediated Learning: Mediating Effect of English Learning Motivation and Satisfaction, and the Moderating Effect of Gender
kw_en: Chatbot Mediated Learning; Anthropomorphism; Gender Difference; Learning Satisfaction; Learning Motivation
abstract_ko: 본 논문은 챗봇매개학습(CML)에서 사용되는 인공지능 에이전트, 즉 챗봇의 의인화가 학습자와 학습 경험에 어떤 영향을 미칠 수 있는지를 탐색하였다. 이를 위하여 메타버스 플랫폼에서 NPC로 디자인된 챗봇을 활용하여 영어 자유대화로 영어 학습을 해 본 경험이 있는 151명의 학생들(M=11.05세, S.D.=1.66. 남학생 58%)로부터 자료를 수집하여 분석하였다. 연구 결과, CML에서 사용자의 의인화 지각은 학습동기와 학습 만족도를 매개하는 효과가 있는 것으로 나타났다. 또한 학습동기와 의인화의 관계에서는 성별 조절효과가 유의하게 나타났다. 즉, 학습동기가 높은 남학생들은 여학생들보다 챗봇을 의인화하는 경향이 더 높았고, 의인화 지각은 CML에서의 학습 만족도와 정적인 관련이 있는 것으로 나타났다. 이러한 결과는 인공지능 에이전트의 의인화 효과에 있어 성별 차이가 작동할 수 있고 CML의 디자인에 있어 의인화 효과를 고려할 필요가 있음을 시사한다. 연구결과를 바탕으로 CML 환경 설계 시 학습동기 기반 인터페이스 개인화 알고리즘, 성별 기반 맞춤형 학습 인터페이스 설계, NPC 챗봇 캐릭터 설계 시 성별 민감도 등을 고려할 필요가 있음을 제안한다.
abstract_en: This paper explored how the anthropomorphism of artificial intelligence agents, specifically chatbots used in chatbot-mediated learning (CML), can affect learners and their learning experiences. To this end, data were collected and analyzed from 151 students (mean age = 11.05 years, S.D. = 1.66, 58% male) who had experience learning English through free conversation with chatbots designed as non-player characters (NPCs) on a metaverse platform. The results showed that the users' perception of anthropomorphism in CML had a mediating effect on learning motivation and learning satisfaction. Additionally, a significant gender moderation effect was found in the relationship between learning motivation and anthropomorphism. Specifically, male students with a higher motivation for learning showed a greater tendency to anthropomorphize chatbots compared to female students, and the perception of anthropomorphism was positively associated with the level of learning satisfaction These findings suggest that gender differences may influence the effects of anthropomorphism in AI agents and highlight the need for further empirical verification of anthropomorphism effects in the design of CML.

title_en: Effects of Utilizing ChatGPT on Learning Process in English Morphology Class
kw_en: utilizing ChatGPT; morphology class; teaching and learning method; academic achievement; learners’ satisfaction
abstract_ko: This study aims to investigate the effects of the utilization of ChatGPT on students’ learning in English morphology class in 2024, and verify the academic benefits that the GPT class elicits more learning activities than the traditional class. The research on learning interests, invigoration of self-directed learning, enhancement of academic inquiry or learning quality, and a higher academic achievement that a new learning tool GPT reinforces, deriving expansive knowledge and correlations with other linguistic features, could be clarified through a t-test result for academic achievement and a survey on learners’ satisfaction. GPTs also facilitate teaching activities such as personalized comments on students’ presentations and supplementary explanations about GPT’s information, and enable us to catch major learning points in a well-organized way. As a result, this paper would prove that the proper utilization of GPT in higher education leads to improved teaching quality and learners’ satisfaction, although it could be necessary that the instructor affirm the accuracy of the GPT’s information and provide the appropriate feedback and comments for satisfied fulfillment of the educational activities.

title_ko: Künstliche Intelligenz im DaF-Unterricht - Ein didaktischer Ansatz zur Förderung interkultureller Kompetenz
title_en: Künstliche Intelligenz im DaF-Unterricht - Ein didaktischer Ansatz zur Förderung interkultureller Kompetenz
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 상호문화 소통 능력; 외국어로서의 독일어; 프롬프트 설계; 교수자의 역할
kw_en: generative KI; DaF-Unterricht; interkulturelle Kompetenz; Promptgestaltung; Rolle der Lehrenden
abstract_ko: In jüngerer Zeit wächst das wissenschaftliche Interesse an der Integration generativer KI-Anwendungen in den Fremdsprachenunterricht. Während erste Studien im Bereich DaF überwiegend auf die Anwendung von KI in der Grammatikund Schreibdidaktik fokussieren, fehlt bislang eine systematische Auseinandersetzung mit ihrem Potenzial zur Förderung interkultureller Kompetenz. Diese Forschungslücke greift der vorliegende Beitrag auf. Ziel der Untersuchung war es, didaktische Möglichkeiten aufzuzeigen, wie generative KI – insbesondere durch gezielte Promptgestaltung und pädagogische Begleitung – die Entwicklung interkultureller Handlungsfähigkeit im DaF-Unterricht unterstützen kann. Im theoretischen Teil wurden zentrale Begriffe wie „generative KI im DaF-Kontext“ und „interkulturelle Kompetenz als Bildungsziel“ definiert und in den aktuellen Forschungsstand eingebettet. Das dritte Kapitel beleuchtet die Rolle der Lehrenden als interkulturelle Vermittler: innen sowie die Bedeutung einer reflektierten Promptgestaltung. Es wird betont, dass Lehrende nicht nur als Technikanwender agieren, sondern KI bewusst, kritisch und lernzielorientiert einsetzen müssen. Ethische Herausforderungen wie algorithmische Verzerrung, mangelnde Transparenz und Datenverantwortung wurden ebenfalls thematisiert. Im vierten Kapitel werden praxisnahe Unterrichtsmodelle vorgestellt, in denen KI als unterstützendes Medium für Perspektivwechsel, Reflexion und interkulturelle Mediation fungiert. Dabei kommen sowohl kontrastive Landeskunde-Aufgaben als auch KI-gestützte Rollenspiele zum Einsatz, die eine vertiefte Auseinandersetzung mit kultureller Differenz ermöglichen. Insgesamt zeigt die Untersuchung, dass generative KI kein Ersatz, sondern ein begleitendes didaktisches Mittel zur Erweiterung interkultureller Bildungsprozesse sein kann – vorausgesetzt, sie wird im Zusammenspiel mit technischer, didaktischer und ethischer Kompetenz verantwortungsvoll in den Unterricht eingebunden.

title_ko: Applying the Technology Acceptance Model to Generative AI Usage in EFL Academic Writing Classes at a Korean University
title_en: Applying the Technology Acceptance Model to Generative AI Usage in EFL Academic Writing Classes at a Korean University
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 영어 작문 수업; 영어 교육
kw_en: Generative AI; EFL; English Education; Technology Acceptance Model; TAM
abstract_ko: This study applied the principles of the technology acceptance model (TAM) to the use of generative AI in EFL academic writing courses at a Korean university. Quantitative data was collected from 111 participants through the use of a questionnaire. In addition, qualitative data was gathered through the use of a limited number of short answers questions which were included as part of the participants' homework assignments. Quantitative data was analyzed through the use of both inferential and descriptive statistics, and qualitative responses were analyzed using a qualitative thematic review. Both sets of data were examined holistically to identify patterns and trends in relation to the TAM. The results indicate participants use generative AI frequently, and they feel it is both useful and easy to use with a moderately strong correlation between both constructs. However, this is often dependent on certain societal elements (peer usage; validation from instructors; trust). Furthermore, certain emotive factors (guilt; pleasure) can also be influential. Finally, the desire for generative AI to replace these types of courses in the future remains unclear despite an overall perception that this technology is going play an ever-increasing role in this educational context. Administrational and educational implications are also discussed.

title_en: A study on grammatical diversity measures for automated English speaking assessment of Korean learners
kw_en: automated speaking assessment; grammatical diversity; English proficiency; L2 corpus; NLP-based analyses
abstract_ko: This study investigates various measures of grammatical diversity for automated speaking assessment (ASA) with Korean learners of English. Data were extracted from the Korean monologue set in the International Corpus of Asian Learners of English and classified into two proficiency groups. Using two NLP toolkits, i.e., the Biber tagger and the argument structure construction annotator, we measured the grammatical diversity of the speaking data based on six features over three levels (i.e., word, phrase, and clause), and conducted correlation and binomial logistic regression analyses. The results reveal significant correlations among the features, particularly between those related to part-of-speech and the others. It is also found that only the clause-level feature of the subordination type frequency significantly predicts proficiency levels. These findings provide insights into the potential of grammatical diversity as a valuable metric in ASA systems for Korean learners of English.

title_ko: 번역기를 활용한 고쳐쓰기 활동이 초등 영어 학습자의 쓰기 능력, 자기주도적 학습 및 인식에 미치는 영향
title_en: The effects of revision activities using machine translation on elementary English learners’ writing ability, self-directed learning, and perceptions
kw_en: artificial neural network machine translation; translator; elementary English; writing instruction; self-directed learning
abstract_ko: This study aims to examine the effects of revision activities using a neural machine translation (NMT) tool on elementary students’ English writing skills, self-directed learning competence, and perceptions of using NMT in their writing. Over a 15-week period, 20 sixth-grade students at an elementary school in Seoul participated in a 39 writing sessions. The writing process consisted of three stages: pre-writing in L1, English composition, and post-writing (revising by comparing the translation output with their own writing, followed by reflection). Data were collected through pre- and post-writing assessments, a self-directed learning inventory, perception surveys, and interviews. The data were mainly analyzed quantitatively, with supplementary qualitative analysis. The findings revealed three key outcomes. First, the revision activity significantly improved overall writing fluency and content development, especially among mid- to lower-level learners, while spelling and expression accuracy also showed gradual progress. However, grammatical accuracy did not improve consistently and even declined for some high-level learners. Second, self-directed learning notably increased, particularly in areas such as planning, interest, and perceived learning value, supported by the task’s structured process and iterative feedback. Lastly, students’ perceptions of the NMT tool shifted from a passive aid to an active self-monitoring resource, fostering their critical use and strategic engagement. This study offers meaningful insights into the pedagogical use of NMT tools in elementary English writing instruction.

title_ko: Automated Analysis of ESL Interaction Tasks Using ChatGPT
title_en: Automated Analysis of ESL Interaction Tasks Using ChatGPT
kw_en: ChatGPT; automatic grading; vocabulary exposure; task based learning; interaction analysis; prompt literacy; questioning skills; metrics; AI in education; student interaction
abstract_ko: This study explores the utility of ChatGPT, a large language model (LLM), for automated linguistic analysis in English as a Second Language (ESL) contexts. It examines whether ChatGPT can generate quantitative metrics, analyze learner prompts, assess vocabulary exposure, and evaluate questioning strategies. Ninety-nine CEFR A1 learners completed two structured chat tasks with ChatGPT. Data analysis was conducted using structured prompts and calibration procedures within ChatGPT-4o. Quantitative metrics (e.g., word counts, question types, sentence complexity) and qualitative classifications (e.g., vocabulary themes, follow-on question types) were generated by the model, formatted in .csv outputs, and partially verified through human-in-the-loop review. Results of transcript analysis indicate that ChatGPT effectively produces useful quantitative data including measures of sentence complexity and prompting skills. It also offers qualitative analysis of vocabulary exposure and investigative themes. Analysis of questioning skills revealed student ‘Wh’ word use and follow-on inquiry patterns. Despite noted strengths, ChatGPT showed limitations in analysis consistency, suggesting the need for teacher oversight. Recommendations include training educators in prompt-based analysis, guiding students in metric interpretation, and further validating LLM-generated data.

title_ko: 포르투갈어-한국어 기계번역 오류의 유형과 교수-학습에 대한 연구
title_en: A Study on Error Types and Teaching-Learning in Portuguese-Korean Machine Translation
kw_ko: 기계번역; 오류 유형; 포르투갈어; 한국인 학습자; 교수자의 역할
kw_en: Machine translation; Error Types; Portuguese; Korean Learners; Professors’ roles
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 포르투갈어-한국어 기계번역의 오류 유형을 살펴보고, 교수학습 측면에서 고려할 부분을 교육 현장에 제공하는 목적을 갖는다. 기초적인 오류 유형 파악을 위해 단문이나기초적인 대화문 위주로 자료를 수집하였고, 자료분석을 위해 국내 포르투갈어 학습 환경에서 가장 많이 사용되고 있는 구글 번역을 이용하였다. 번역문에 보이는 오류의 유형은 문법구문적 오류, 어휘의미적 오류, 사회문화적 오류로 구분하여 제시하였다. 혼동하기 쉬운 구문의 번역에서는 정문과 비문 간의 번역 차이가 나타나지 않기 때문에 생성된 도착언어의 번역문을 다시 역으로 확인하는 과정이 한국인 학습자에게 필수적이다. 번역 결과물에 대한 사후편집은 외국어 학습자에게 꼭 필요한 과정으로, 오류를 인식하고 수정하는 과정은 외국어 실력향상을 위해 매우 중요하다. 번역은 목표로 한 독자의 사회적 배경, 문화적 맥락 등을 고려해야 하기에 원문 텍스트의 내용을 의미화용론적으로 적용하여 목표어 문화에서 최대한 자연스러운 번역문이 되도록 해야 한다. 결국 직역보다는 의역이 바람직하며, 번역의 완성도는출발언어 텍스트가 도착언어에서 가장 자연스럽게 표현되는 것에 근거한다. 한편 교수자의 역할은 기계번역으로 얻은 번역물의 오류만을 수정하는 것이 아니라, 학생들이 더 적절한 표현 능력을 발휘할 수 있도록 이끌어주는 것이다. 동의어 활용 능력, 축약 능력, 확장 능력, 강조 능력이 사후편집에 활용된다면, 교수학습 측면에서 더 많은 발전을 이뤄낼 수 있을 것으로 본다.
abstract_en: This study examines error types in Portuguese-Korean machine translation and aims to provide educational settings with guidance on teaching and learning. To identify basic error types, data was collected primarily from short texts and basic conversations. For data analysis, Google Translate, the most widely used tool in Korean-Portuguese language learning environments, was used. Errors in the t ranslations were categorized into grammatical, lexical, semantic, and sociocultural errors. In particular, for translations of easily confusing phrases, the difference between accurate and inaccurate phrases is often unclear. Therefore, it is essential for Korean learners to back-check the translation in the target language. Post-editing is essential for foreign language learners, and the process of recognizing and correcting errors is crucial for improving foreign language proficiency. Translation must consider the social and cultural context of the target reader. Therefore, the content of the source text must be applied semantically and pragmatically so that the translation is as natural as possible in the target language culture. Free paraphrasing is preferable to literal translation, and the quality of translation is determined by how naturally the source text is expressed in the target language. Meanwhile, the role of professors is not simply to correct errors in machine translation, but to guide students to develop more appropriate expressive skills. If the ability to use synonyms, summarize, expand, and emphasize is utilized in post-editing, greater advancements in teaching and learning can be achieved.

title_ko: Exploring ChatGPT Usage Purposes and Profiles among Korean High School EFL Learners
title_en: Exploring ChatGPT Usage Purposes and Profiles among Korean High School EFL Learners
kw_en: ChatGPT usage purpose; learner profiles; generative AI-assisted language learning; latent profile analysis; exploratory factor analysis
abstract_ko: This study seeks to examine the main purposes of Korean high school EFL learners in using ChatGPTfor learning English and identify distinct learner profiles based on their usage patterns. A mixedmethod approach was employed to gather data. First, to develop scale items assessing students'ChatGPT usage purposes, the experiences of Korean high school students using ChatGPT for Englishlearning were collected through simulations, reflection logs, and open-ended surveys. Second, a surveywas conducted with 171 participants using a newly developed instrument to measure their purposesfor using ChatGPT. Various statistical techniques, including exploratory factor analysis (EFA), latentprofile analysis (LPA), repeated measures ANOVA, and multivariate ANOVA, were used to analyzethe data. The key findings of the study are as follows: EFA identified four main purposes for usingChatGPT: reading comprehension, linguistic analysis and correction, writing support, and reading testpractice, with reading comprehension being the most favored. Moreover, LPA identified four learnerprofiles: Active User, Comprehension Seeker, Writing and Metaknowledge Seeker, and Passive User,which demonstrated notable differences across the identified purposes. The findings highlightsignificant variations in ChatGPT usage patterns among EFL learners, suggesting the need forpersonalized teaching strategies to enhance learner-AI interaction.

title_ko: 초등 예비교사의 영어 AI 디지털교과서 활용에 대한 인식
title_en: Perceptions of pe-service elementary teachers on the use of English AI digital textbooks
kw_ko: AI디지털교과서; 초등영어; 초등 예비교사; 에듀테크; 인식
kw_en: AI digital textbook; elementary English; elementary pre-service teacher; EduTech; perception
abstract_ko: This study explores pre-service elementary teachers’ perceptions of using English AI digitaltextbooks (AIDT) in primary schools. To this end, a survey was conducted among 78 pre-serviceelementary teachers enrolled on an English materials development course in the spring semesterof 2025. The findings of the study were as follows. First, pre-service elementary teachers, like inservice teachers, acknowledged the positive features of AIDT, such as personalized learning andreal-time feedback. However, they also expressed concerns about disparities in learning outcomesresulting from varying levels of digital competency and difficulties in managing digital devices. Second, over 80% of participants rated their own digital and AI competencies positively. Regarding digital textbooks, 69% indicated that specialized training for their use is necessary. Onlya small number of pre-service teachers expressed a desire to use AIDT as a replacement fortraditional textbooks, while the vast majority preferred utilizing it as a supplementary resource. Third, in their descriptive responses, pre-service teachers expressed concern that using AIDT asthe primary textbook could reduce interactions between teachers and students, as well as amongstudents themselves. Based on these results, suggestions for future research and education areprovided.

title_ko: A Needs Analysis of Elementary School Teachers on AI-based Digital English Textbooks
title_en: A Needs Analysis of Elementary School Teachers on AI-based Digital English Textbooks
kw_en: AI-based digital textbooks; digital English textbooks; diagnostic assessment of learning; personalized instructional design; adaptive learning
abstract_ko: This study aimed to analyze elementary school teachers’ needs regarding the functions of AI-based digital English textbooks. Data were collected from a survey of 96 elementary school teachers. First, a paired sample t-test was first used to examine differences between perceived importance and current implementation. Borich’s needs assessment model was then applied to identify priority items, and the Locus for Focus model was followed visualize them. Finally, a comprehensive analysis was conducted to determine the most urgent needs. Results showed that among five categories— Diagnostic and Evaluation Functions, Support for Personalized Instructional Design, Adaptive Learning Support, AI Tutor and Assistant Teacher, and Dashboard and User Interface—the highest need was in Diagnostic and Evaluation Functions. Personalized Instructional Design and Adaptive Learning Support also showed high demand. These findings suggest that AI-based digital textbooks remain in a developmental phase, requiring further discussion on how to implement them effectively according to subjectspecific needs.

title_ko: Urban and Rural Students’ Experiences with AI PengTalk in English Learning: A Comparative Case Study
title_en: Urban and Rural Students’ Experiences with AI PengTalk in English Learning: A Comparative Case Study
kw_en: AI-assisted language learning; PengTalk; urban and rural education; elementary EFL learners; gamification
abstract_ko: This comparative case study examined the experiences of urban and rural elementary school students in Korea using PengTalk, an AI-based English learning application. Using a mixed-methods approach, the study analyzed student surveys, usage records, and interviews. Quantitative data were examined through descriptive statistics and Mann-Whitney U tests, while qualitative responses were analyzed thematically. Both groups expressed positive perceptions, especially regarding PengTalk’s gamified and interactive features. Urban students outperformed their rural peers in average scores (82.5 vs. 75.8) and cumulative totals (28,224 vs. 12,369). However, gamification alone was insufficient to sustain engagement, particularly in the rural school. Major challenges included limited digital literacy and inadequate instructional support in the rural school, as well as technical issues such as voice recognition errors in the urban school. The findings indicate that student engagement with AI tools depends not only on application design but also on contextual factors such as access, support, and digital infrastructure. This study concludes with recommendations for more inclusive and equitable AI-assisted language learning environments.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 아랍어 작문 과제 수행 상황에서 인공지능 도구 사용의 효과성을 탐색하고 상호작용 유형을 정리하여 이에 영향을 미치는 아랍어 학습자 특성과 상호작용 유형에 따른 수행 결과를 확인하고자 하였다. 인공지능 번역기를 사용하는 아랍어 작문 과정에서 나타나는 학습자의 행동별 시간 비율을 기반으로 군집분석을 실시한 결과, 제한적-한국어형, 제한적-아랍어형, 협력적 유형의 세 가지 유형이 나타났다. 제한적-한국어형은 학습자 단독 행동 중 한국어 작문의 행동 비율이 가장 높게 나타났으며, 제한적-아랍어형은 학습자 단독 행동 중 아랍어 작문 행동의 비율이 가장 높게 나타났다. 협력적 유형은 다른 두 유형과는 달리 한국어 작문과 아랍어 작문의 비율 차이가 크지 않았으며, 번역기와의 상호작용적 작문 활동 비율이 가장 높게 나타났다. 인공지능 번역기를 사용하는 과정에서 나타나는 행동 시간 비율에서도 확인할 수 있듯이 세 유형 간에는 명확한 차이가 존재하였다. 면담 분석에서는 이러한 차이를 보다 구체적으로 확인할 수 있었다. 제한적-한국어형 유형은 한국어로 전체 글을 작성한 후 번역기에 입력하는 이유로 초안 작성 단계에서 인공지능 번역기가 신뢰할 만하다고 응답하였다. 반대로, 제한적-아랍어형 유형은 초벌 번역 단계에서 학습자가 단독으로 아랍어 작문을 시도한 후 필요에 따라 인공지능 번역기를 활용하며, 그 이유는 표현의 정교화나 모르는 표현을 확인하기 위함이라고 응답하였다. 마지막으로 협력적 상호작용 유형의 학습자들은 아랍어 작문 내용 중 중요한 부분은 자신들이 주도적으로 작문하되, 상대적으로 중요도가 낮거나 부연 설명 목적의 문장은 인공지능 번역기에 맡긴다고 응답하였다. 또한, 이 유형의 학습자들은 인공지능 번역기와의 상호작용에서 소통 방식을 고려하여 번역할 내용을 입력하였다고도 응답하였다. 본 연구에서는 인공지능 및 아랍어 작문 관련 역량이 학습자와 인공지능의 상호작용 유형에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 확인하고자 하였다. 연구 결과 상호작용 유형별로 인공지능 관련 역량의 집단별 차이는 유의하지 않았으나, 아랍어 작문 역량의 차이는 유의하게 나타났다. 특히 제한적-아랍어형 유형은 다른 두 유형보다 통제집단의 인지된 수행 결과 점수 및 아랍어 작문 자기 효능감이 유의하게 높았다. 이를 통해 학습자의 교과지식이 높을수록 인공지능 도구에 대한 의존도가 낮아질 수 있음을 추측할 수 있다. 또한, 학습자의 유형에 따른 아랍어 작문 결과를 비교한 결과, 통계적으로 유의미한 차이는 나타나지 않았다. 기술 통계 분석에서는 협력적 유형의 내용 점수 향상이 가장 높았으며, 제한적-한국어형은 표현 점수와 전체 점수, 인지된 수행 결과의 향상이 가장 높게 나타났다. 반면 제한적-아랍어형은 모든 영역에서 향상도가 가장 낮게 나타났다.
abstract_en: This study investigates the interaction patterns between Arabic language learners and artificial intelligence (AI) translators, and examines how these interactions influence learners’ Arabic writing performance. Participants were intermediate-level Arabic learners at a university in Korea. Using a repeated-measures design, learners completed writing tasks under two conditions: without an AI translator and with Google Translate. Pre- and post-questionnaires measured learners’ Arabic writing self-efficacy, attitudes toward AI, and AI literacy, while semi-structured interviews explored learners’ perceptions of their interactions with the translator. Quantitative data, including perceived performance outcomes and writing evaluation scores, were analyzed using parametric and non-parametric statistical methods, and qualitative data were examined through open coding. The results show that learners’ interaction types with the AI translator varied according to their individual characteristics, and that these patterns influenced both the quality of writing and learners’ self-perceived outcomes. In particular, behaviors involving revision and selective use of translations were positively associated with improved writing results, while excessive reliance on direct output tended to reduce performance. The findings highlight the importance of developing pedagogical strategies that foster effective learner-AI interaction and provide implications for enhancing writing competence in Arabic as a foreign language.

title_ko: The Role of Prompt Language in ChatGPT-Assisted Revision: Effects on Korean EFL Argumentative Writing
title_en: The Role of Prompt Language in ChatGPT-Assisted Revision: Effects on Korean EFL Argumentative Writing
kw_en: ChatGPT; prompt language; argumentative writing; revision strategies; EFL learners
abstract_ko: This study investigates how Korean EFL university students revised their argumentative essays using ChatGPT, with a focus on how prompt language (English vs. Korean) and specificity influenced the nature and uptake of AI-generated feedback. Drawing on analyses of revised texts and prompts students used, the findings reveal that English prompts more frequently led to global-level changes, such as improved organization, argument clarity, and academic tone. In contrast, Korean prompts typically resulted in sentence-level edits, including lexical refinement and fluency improvement. Across both languages, prompt specificity emerged as a key factor: students who provided clear, goal-oriented instructions received more relevant and actionable feedback. While learners generally valued ChatGPT’s support in enhancing expression and correcting grammar, some expressed concerns about loss of authorial voice and over-dependence on AI tools. These results underscore the need to develop students’ prompt literacy and critical awareness when integrating AI into academic writing instruction.

title_ko: Examining the Effectiveness of Generative AI as a Bilingual Dictionary in Korean EFL Contexts
title_en: Examining the Effectiveness of Generative AI as a Bilingual Dictionary in Korean EFL Contexts
kw_en: second language acquisition; computer assisted language learning; dictionary use; generative AI; reading comprehension; vocabulary acquisition
abstract_ko: Large Language Model-based generative AI has the potential to change language education, as it is able to parse natural language prompts and provide natural-seeming responses to these prompts. To date, there has been little research into generative AI as a tool to assist language learners in reading comprehension and vocabulary acquisition. This paper presents an experimental study that compares the effectiveness of ChatGPT to the online bilingual NAVER Dictionary and to a control group in both a reading comprehension/written recall task and a vocabulary acquisition test using both the Vocabulary Knowledge Scale test and a multiple choice meaning test. The subjects were 120 Korean undergraduate students majoring in English Language and Literature. ANOVA results of pausal units and target vocabulary recalled during the written recall task suggest that a dedicated bilingual dictionary is superior to ChatGPT for reading comprehension, but AI can assist learners to identify unknown words just as well. For vocabulary acquisition, ANOVA results on both vocabulary measures show both ChatGPT and NAVER Dictionary groups significantly outperformed the control group, with no differences between the two dictionary groups. This suggests that ChatGPT may be an adequate substitute for a bilingual dictionary and a useful tool for language learners to improve vocabulary.

title_ko: 인공지능 시대 구어 의사소통 교육에 관한 예비 교사의 인식
title_en: Preservice School Teachers’ Perceptions of Oral Communication Education in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
kw_ko: 의사소통 교육; 대화형 인공지능; 인공지능 시대; 예비 교사; 주제 분석
kw_en: communication education; conversational AI; AI era; preservice teachers; thematic analysis
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 인공지능 기술의 급속한 발전이 의사소통 환경에 미치는 영향을 조명하고 예비 초등 교사들이 미래 구어 의사소통 양상과 교육의 방향을 어떻게 인식하는지를 질적으로 탐색하였다. 이들의 인식은 향후 구어 의사소통 교육의 방향을 설계하는 데 중요한 시사점을 제공할 수 있을 것으로 기대된다. 연구 참여자는 D 교육대학교 2학년 재학생 28명이며, 개방형 설문을 통해 자료를 수집하고 주제 분석으로 응답 내용을 분석하였다. 분석 결과, 예비 교사들은 인간-인공지능 상호작용을 새로운 의사소통 양상으로 수용하며, 의사소통 구조의 탈인간화, 이중 구조화, 인공지능의 역할 분화 등 다층적 변화를 인식하고 있었다. 또한 의사소통 교육의 지향점에 관해 인간의 고유성을 지키는 동시에 인공지능과의 공존을 위한 역량의 균형 있는 함양이 필요함을 강조하였다. 이는 향후 의사소통 교육이 인간 중심적 접근을 넘어 인간의 주체성을 강화하면서도 기술 환경에 능동적으로 대응할 수 있는 방향으로 재구성되어야 함을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study explores how preservice elementary teachers perceive changes in oral communication and its educational direction in the era of artificial intelligence. A total of 28 students from a university completed open-ended surveys. Thematic analysis revealed that participants viewed human–AI interaction as a new form of communication, recognizing structural shifts, dual communication patterns, and the varied roles of AI. They emphasized the importance of maintaining human communicative traits while fostering the ability to adapt to AI. These findings suggest that communication education should balance human-centered values with technological responsiveness.
note: 국어교과 예비교사 인식 실증; 담론 경계

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능이 중등 영어교육에 미치는 영향: 2022-2025년 수업 사례 연구 동향 분석
title_en: The Impact of Generative AI on Secondary English Education: A Trend Analysis of Classroom Case Studies (2022-2025)
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 생성형 인공지능; 동향 분석; 중등 영어교육; 체계적 문헌 고찰
kw_en: ChatGPT; generative AI; trend analysis; secondary English education; systematic literature review
abstract_ko: The purpose of this research is to investigate the impact of generative AI on Korean secondary English education, following the emergence of ChatGPT in 2022. Generative AI is predominantly used for reading and writing, a trend influenced by Korea’s assessment environment and AI’s technical capabilities and user accessibility. Research reveals that AI tools have differential effects based on proficiency; they significantly improve the language skills and confidence of low/intermediate-level students, potentially reducing learning gaps and implying the need for differentiated pedagogical strategies. The introduction of AI is also shifting the teacher’s role from a knowledge transmitter to a learning designer and facilitator. Furthermore, learners tend to adopt self-directed methods by using AI as an interactive partner for designing questions and revising work based on feedback. Overall, generative AI is a powerful tool for innovative pedagogical approaches and learner-centered education. To maximize its potential, future research should focus on developing integrated models that better incorporate competency-based learning models, redefining the teacher’s role, and creating new assessment methods for the AI era.

title_ko: 피터팬 이야기를 활용한 대학생 영작 활동 탐색: 챗GPT 기반 피드백을 중심으로
title_en: Exploring University Students’ English Writing Activities Using Peter Pan Stories: Focusing on ChatGPT-Based Feedback
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 영어 작문; 현상학적 연구; 대학 영어교육; 챗GPT 기반 피드백
kw_en: ChatGPT; English Writing; Phenomenological Research; University English Education; ChatGPT-based Feedback
abstract_ko: This study aims to phenomenologically explore the effects of ChatGPT-based English writing activities using the familiar story of Peter Pan with university students. Eight participants engaged in a structured writing activity and were later interviewed using semi-structured protocols to capture their subjective experiences. Data were analyzed following Colaizzi’s phenomenological method. The results revealed four essential themes: emotional stability, improvement in cognitive strategies, enhanced linguistic performance, and perceived limitations. ChatGPT contributed to emotional relief and facilitated the use of metacognitive strategies such as self-reflection and self-correction. Participants also reported improvements in expression and writing quality. However, concerns were raised about the potential decline in independent thinking due to frequent reliance on AI. Based on these findings, pedagogical suggestions for integrating AI feedback into university English writing instruction are discussed.

title_ko: 다국면라쉬모형을 활용한 ChatGPT-4o의 논술형 평가 자동채점 정확도 및 채점자 효과 분석
title_en: Analysis of ChatGPT-4o’s Automated Essay Scoring Accuracy and Rater Effects Using the Many-Facet Rasch Model
kw_ko: 논술형 평가 자동채점; 거대언어모델; 채점자 효과; 다국면라쉬모형
kw_en: Automated Essay Scoring(AES); Large Language Model; Rater Effects; Many-Facet Rasch Model
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 자동채점의 활용 가능성을 탐색하고자 거대언어모델 기반 논술평 평가 자동채점의 정확성과 채점자 효과를 실증적으로 분석하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 중학교 3학년 학생의 논술형 평가 응답 자료를 기반으로 인간 채점자와 ChatGPT 간의 채점 일치도를 분석하고, 다국면라쉬모형을 적용하여 채점자 특성을 비교하였다. 주요 분석 결과는 다음과 같다. 첫째, ChatGPT는 일부 항목에서 특정 점수에 집중하여 점수를 부여하는 경향을 보였다. 둘째, 인간 채점자와 자동채점 간 일치도는 ‘과제 수행’과 ‘근거의 타당성’ 등 구조화된 채점 기준을 가진 항목에서는 비교적 높은 수준을 보였으나 다른 항목에서는 전반적으로 낮은 수준이었다. 셋째, 일부 인간 채점자에게서는 부적합과 과적합 사례가 확인된 반면 ChatGPT는 허용 가능한 범위 내의 적합도를 보였다. 이러한 결과는 ChatGPT 기반 자동채점이 채점 신뢰도 제고에 일정 부분 기여할 수 있으나 정교한 판단과 맥락적 해석이 요구되는 항목에서는 추가적으로 기술적 보완이 필요함을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the potential application of automated scoring in educational settings by empirically analyzing the accuracy and rater effects associated with an essay-type assessment conducted by a large language model (LLM), specifically ChatGPT. To this end, the agreement between human raters and ChatGPT was examined. Furthermore, the Many-Facet Rasch Model was applied to compare rater characteristics. The key findings are as follows. First, ChatGPT tended to concentrate its scores on specific values in certain criteria. Second, the level of agreement between human and automated ratings was relatively high for criteria with structured scoring rubrics such as “task completion” and “validity of evidence,” but generally low in other criteria. Third, while some human raters demonstrated misfit or overfit behaviors, ChatGPT displayed a slightly lenient scoring pattern but remained within an acceptable range of model fit. These findings indicate that ChatGPT-based automated scoring may contribute to improving scoring consistency. However, further technical refinement is needed for criteria that require nuanced judgment and contextual interpretation.
note: 중3 논술 자동채점; L1 쓰기평가로 포함(prev N)

title_ko: Comparison of Human and ChatGPT on Holistic and Analytic Scoring of College EFL Opinion Writing
title_en: Comparison of Human and ChatGPT on Holistic and Analytic Scoring of College EFL Opinion Writing
kw_ko: 글쓰기 평가; 글쓰기 채점; 전체적 및 분석적 채점; 인간 채점; ChatGPT 채점
kw_en: writing evaluation; writing scoring; holistic and analytic scoring; human scoring; ChatGPT scoring
abstract_ko: Writing evaluation can be done using different approaches such as holistic and analytic scoring, and by different raters, including human raters and machine. This study investigated the inter-rater reliability in holistic and analytic scoring by human raters and ChatGPT and the associations between average scores assigned by the two raters. Data consisted of one-paragraph opinion essays (n = 196) written by 28 South Korean college freshmen, which were scored by two human raters and ChatGPT across two trials. Inter-rater reliability, independent-samples t-tests, and correlations were computed. Results indicated that both humans and ChatGPT demonstrated substantial consistency, with humans showing greater reliability in holistic judgments, while ChatGPT exhibited stronger reliability in analytic categories of language and organization. Holistic scores did not differ significantly between the two raters; however, humans tended to be stricter in content and organization, whereas ChatGPT was stricter in language and mechanics. Strong correlations across all scores further suggested that humans and ChatGPT produced comparable rank-order evaluations. Overall, these findings support the theoretical validity of incorporating AI into writing assessment and highlight its pedagogical potential as a complement to human raters in EFL writing evaluation.
abstract_en: Writing evaluation can be done using different approaches such as holistic and analytic scoring, and by different raters, including human raters and machine. This study investigated the inter-rater reliability in holistic and analytic scoring by human raters and ChatGPT and the associations between average scores assigned by the two raters. Data consisted of one-paragraph opinion essays (n = 196) written by 28 South Korean college freshmen, which were scored by two human raters and ChatGPT across two trials. Inter-rater reliability, independent-samples t-tests, and correlations were computed. Results indicated that both humans and ChatGPT demonstrated substantial consistency, with humans showing greater reliability in holistic judgments, while ChatGPT exhibited stronger reliability in analytic categories of language and organization. Holistic scores did not differ significantly between the two raters; however, humans tended to be stricter in content and organization, whereas ChatGPT was stricter in language and mechanics. Strong correlations across all scores further suggested that humans and ChatGPT produced comparable rank-order evaluations. Overall, these findings support the theoretical validity of incorporating AI into writing assessment and highlight its pedagogical potential as a complement to human raters in EFL writing evaluation.

title_ko: 영어교육에서 생성형 인공지능 활용 연구 동향(2022-2024)에 대한 체계적 문헌 고찰
title_en: Generative AI in English Education: A Systematic Literature Review (2022-2024)
kw_en: artificial intelligence; English education; systematic literature review; ChatGPT; generative AI
abstract_ko: This study presents a systematic review of empirical research on the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in English education published between 30 November 2022 and December 2024, covering 50 studies. The review identifies the predominant generative AI tools, their educational functions, and recent trends in their evolution. Results show that ChatGPT is overwhelmingly dominant, appearing in 56% of studies, yet 54% of them did not specify the model version, raising serious concerns regarding reproducibility. Reported functions include pronunciation analysis, interactive dialogue, vocabulary support, automated writing evaluation, idea generation, and machine translation, with applications supporting integrated language functions showing notably higher adoption rates. The findings further highlight the rapid advancement of AI capabilities, particularly in processing speed, accuracy, and multimodal functionality. These results underscore the necessity of detailed reporting on AI model versions and experimental conditions to ensure reproducibility and to establish standardized guidelines for AI-enhanced educational research.

title_ko: 영어교육에서 AI 챗봇과 인간 교사의 상호보완적 역할에 대한 교사와 학습자 인식 기반 연구
title_en: Exploring the Complementary Roles of AI Chatbots and Human Teachers in English Education: Perceptions of Learners and Educators
kw_en: artificial intelligence; chatbot; human teacher; English education; learner perception; collaboration
abstract_ko: With the rapid advancement of artificially intelligent (AI) technology, its applications are expanding across various sectors of society. The field of English education is no exception, witnessing a swift integration of AI tools. In this context, this study empirically examined teachers’ (n = 107) and learners’ (n = 147) perceptions of the complementary roles of AI chatbots and human instructors in English education. Using both one-sample and independent-sample t-tests, this study revealed that teachers rated the usefulness of chatbots significantly higher than students, although both groups recognized their value for grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation support. Teachers also perceived chatbot limitations more strongly, stressing their insufficiency in emotional support and motivation. Both groups rated human teachers’ roles very highly, with teachers showing stronger awareness of pedagogical and affective functions. While learners acknowledged teachers’ indispensability, they also recognized the supportive role of AI. Finally, both groups expressed positive attitudes toward a collaborative instructional model, viewing AI and human instructors not as substitutes but as complementary partners in language learning.

title_ko: An Exploratory Study of an AI-Supported English Reading Class in Korean High School
title_en: An Exploratory Study of an AI-Supported English Reading Class in Korean High School
kw_ko: AI 활용 수업; 개별화 학습; 수준별 수업; 학습 동기; 고등학교 영어 교육
kw_en: AI-supported instruction; personalized learning; differentiated instruction; student motivation; high school English education
abstract_ko: This year-long exploratory study examines an AI-supported personalized reading approach aimed at improving low student engagement. Conducted with 63 secondgrade high school students in a rural area, the researcher, a high school English teacher, utilized AI to generate engaging reading passages at various proficiency levels. Students were allowed to choose texts that best matched their abilities. A mixedmethods design was employed, collecting mock test scores to identify achievement trends and using comparative surveys to evaluate student perceptions compared to the previous grammar-translation method. The findings revealed a positive trend in academic achievement, marked by a decrease in low-level students and an increase in middle and high-level students. Additionally, students reported a significant improvement in their learning experience compared to the prior method, demonstrating much higher levels of satisfaction, motivation, and interest with the new approach. Notably, the autonomy students had in selecting passages successfully preserved their self-esteem, addressing a key challenge in traditional ability grouping. While acknowledging its exploratory nature and context-specific limitations, this research presents a practical model for revitalizing secondary English education and offers a rare long-term perspective on AI integration in an authentic K-12 classroom.

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능 WRTN과 SUNO 활용 초등영어 글쓰기 실행연구
title_en: Action Research on Elementary English Writing Using Generative AI Portal WRTN and SUNO
kw_ko: 실행연구; 생성형 인공지능; 초등영어 교육; 영어 쓰기; 영어교사
kw_en: Action Research; Generative AI; Elementary English Education; English Writing; English Teacher
abstract_ko: 본 실행연구는 생성형 인공지능을 초등학교 영어 자유 글쓰기 수업에 적용하는 과정과 그 결과를 탐색함으로써, 효과적인 활용 방안을 모색하는 것을 목적으로 하였다. 연구에는 영어 학습 환경이 상 대적으로 제한적인 초등학교 6학년 학생 25명이 참여하였으며, 총 11차시로 구성된 생성형 인공지능 기반 영어 글쓰기 프로그램을 이수하였다. 수업 활동은 생성형 인공지능을 활용하며 졸업 축하 영어 편지 작성하고 친구들과 나누기, 좋아하는 한국인 아이돌 온라인 영상에 영어 댓글 작성하고 업로드하기, ‘나의 꿈’을 주제로 영어 노래 제작하고 업로드하기 등으로 구성되었다. 교사 일지, 학생 설문, 학생 소 감문, 공개광장 (padlet.com)에 업로드된 영어 노래, 수업 결과물 등의 연구 데이터를 질적 분석한 연구 결과는 다음과 같다. 첫째, 학생들의 영어 글쓰기 능력이 향상되었다. 둘째, 생성형 인공지능을 활용한 자유 글쓰기 활동에 대해 학생들의 전반적인 만족도가 높아졌고 영어 글쓰기 불안감이 감소되 었다. 셋째, 수업 과정에서 교사는 학생들의 생성형 인공지능 과의존 문제를 가장 중요한 과제로 인식하 였으며, 이를 완화하기 위해 짝 활동 중심의 협동 학습 전략과 세분화된 활동 지시 전략을 적용하였다. 결론적으로, 본 연구는 생성형 인공지능이 초등학교 영어 자유 글쓰기 수업에서 학생들의 글쓰기 능력과 영어 글쓰기 불안감 감소에 유용한 도구로 기능할 수 있음을 보여준다. 동시에, 학생들이 생성 형 인공지능에 과도하게 의존하지 않도록 교사의 지도 전략이 필요하며, 이 과정에서 교사의 역할이 핵심적으로 작용함을 확인하였다. 나아가 본 연구는 생성형 인공지능이 초등 영어 글쓰기 교수⋅학습 맥락에서 교육적 도구로 활용될 수 있다는 잠재력과 향후 교사의 교수 전략과 학습자 주체성을 통합 적으로 조망하는 심층적 후속 연구의 필요성을 제기하고 있다.
abstract_en: This action research examined the integration of Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI) into elementary English free writing instruction to identify effective classroom applications of this technology. Twenty-five sixth-grade students with limited opportunities to learn English outside school participated in an 11-session Generative AI–based English writing program. During the program, the students completed tasks such as writing graduation congratulatory letters in English, posting comments on online videos of their favorite Korean idols, and composing English song lyrics about their dreams, which they recorded and shared on Padlet. The study yielded three main findings. First, students noticeably improved their English writing skills. Second, students reported high satisfaction with the Generative AI–mediated free-writing activities, alongside reduced writing anxiety. Third, to prevent overreliance on Generative AI during free-writing activities, the teacher used two key instructional strategies: encouraging pair work and giving detailed step-by-step task instructions. Overall, the findings suggest that Generative AI can effectively enhance students’ writing skills and motivation in elementary English free-writing contexts. The study emphasizes the importance of teacher-led strategies to limit dependency on AI and highlights teachers’ central role in designing and guiding these strategies. By demonstrating Generative AI’s potential as a catalyst for instructional innovation, this research not only affirms its value in elementary English education but also indicates the need for in-depth research that studies the interplay between teacher roles and learner agency.
note: 뤼튼·SUNO 초등영어 글쓰기 실행연구

title_ko: ChatGPT’s Corrective Feedback on Korean College Students’ Writing and Its Pedagogical Implications
title_en: ChatGPT’s Corrective Feedback on Korean College Students’ Writing and Its Pedagogical Implications
kw_en: ChatGPT; corrective feedback; EFL writing; error analysis; Korean EFL learners
abstract_ko: This study analyzed error patterns in the English writing of Korean EFL learners using ChatGPT and examined their pedagogical impli- cations. A total of 150 errors were identified from student writing samples, with the most frequent involving grammar errors followed by awkward phrasing, collocation, and structural errors. Many of these errors reflected Korean linguistic features such as the absence of articles and plural markers, as well as reliance on literal translation and limited exposure to authentic English. To address these challenges, the study proposes a multi- dimensional approach that combines explicit grammar instruction, contrastive analysis, data-driven learning, and context-based practice. A key contribution of this research lies in demonstrating the effectiveness of AI-powered tools like ChatGPT: it not only supported learners in recognizing and understanding errors but also provided instructors with diagnostic insights for targeted teaching. While AI cannot replace human feedback, it shows strong potential as a supplementary resource for improving accuracy in EFL writing.

title_ko: 메타버스를 활용한 문제기반학습(PBL) 수업이 교양영어 핵심역량 함양에 미치는 영향: 문화적 포용, 협력적 소통, 통섭적 사고 중심으로
title_en: The Impact of Metaverse-Based PBL on Core Competencies in College English
kw_ko: 메타버스; 문제기반학습(PBL); 문화적 포용; 협력적 소통; 통섭적 사고
kw_en: Metaverse; PBL; Cultural Inclusivity; Collaborative Communication; Integrative Thinking
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 메타버스를 활용한 문제기반학습(Problem-Based Learning, PBL)이 대학 교양영어 수업에서 핵심역량 함양에 어떠한 영향을 미치는지를 분석하는 데 있다. 연구는 부산 소재 P대학교 교양영어 수업에 참여한 97명의 대학생을 대상으로 8주간 Spot Virtual 메타버스 플랫폼을 활용한 PBL 수업을 운영하고, 사전·사후 설문, 서술형 문항, 개별 인터뷰를 통해 자료를 수집하였다. 수집된 정량 자료는 SPSS 29.02를 활용하여 대응표본 t-검정 및 효과크기(Cohen’s d) 분석을 실시하였으며, 질적 자료는 귀납적 내용 분석을 통해 핵심역량 변화 양상을 심층적으로 파악하였다. 분석 결과, 문화적 포용(평균 상승폭 +.41, d=.54), 협력적 소통(+.19, d=.59), 통섭적 사고(+.74, d=.71) 세 영역 모두에서 유의한 변화가 관찰되었으며, 특히 통섭적 사고에서 가장 큰 효과가 나타났다. 학습자들은 다양한 문화 콘텐츠와 팀 기반 활동을 통해 문화적 포용과 통섭적 사고 역량을 자연스럽게 신장시켰으며, 메타버스 환경은 학습자 간 심리적 거리감을 줄이고 자유로운 참여를 유도하는 데 긍정적으로 작용하였다. 반면 협력적 소통 영역에서는 기술적 제약과 불명확한 역할 분담으로 인해 향상폭이 상대적으로 낮게 나타났다. 본 연구는 메타버스 기반 PBL 수업이 교양영어의 핵심역량 함양에 기여할 수 있는 가능성을 시사하며, 특히 통섭적 사고력과 문화적 포용 역량 강화에 긍정적 요인이 될 수 있음을 보여준다. 다만 협력적 소통 역량을 보다 효과적으로 강화하기 위해서는 구조화된 협업 전략과 명확한 교수 설계가 병행되어야 할 것이다.
abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of metaverse-based Problem-Based Learning (PBL) on the development of core competencies in a college English course. A total of 97 students from P University in Busan participated in an eight-week PBL program using the Spot Virtual metaverse platform. Data were collected through pre- and post-course surveys, open-ended written responses, and individual interviews. Quantitative data were analyzed using paired-sample t-tests and effect sizes (Cohen’s d) with SPSS 29.02, while qualitative data were examined through inductive content analysis. The results indicated significant improvements across all three core competencies: cultural inclusivity (mean increase +.41, d = .54), collaborative communication (+.19, d = .59), and integrative thinking (+.74, d = .71), with the strongest effect observed in integrative thinking. Students enhanced their cultural inclusivity and integrative thinking through exposure to diverse cultural content and team-based activities. The metaverse environment also reduced psychological barriers and encouraged active participation, although improvements in collaborative communication were comparatively modest due to technical limitations and unclear role allocation during group tasks. These findings suggest that metaverse-based PBL is an effective pedagogical strategy for fostering core competencies in general English education, particularly by advancing integrative thinking and cultural inclusivity. To strengthen collaborative communication, structured collaboration strategies and clearer instructional design are recommended. Academically, this study contributes to the growing literature on competency-based English education by demonstrating how immersive environments can complement traditional PBL. Practically, it offers insights for instructors designing metaverse-enhanced courses and highlights the importance of aligning platform affordances with pedagogical goals.
note: 메타버스 PBL 교양영어; AI 없음

title_ko: LLM 기반 영어 말하기 자동 평가: 다차원 채점 및 피드백 생성 프레임워크
title_en: Automated English speaking assessment with large language models: A framework for multi-dimensional scoring and feedback generation
kw_ko: 자동 말하기 평가; 피드백 생성; 멀티태스크 기반 말하기 평가; LLM 기반 말하기 평가
kw_en: Automated Speaking Assessment (ASA); Feedback Generation; Multitask-based speaking assessment; LLM-based speaking assessment
abstract_ko: 기존의 자동화된 영어 말하기 평가 시스템은 단편적인 점수 생성에만 집중하여 학습자에게 의미 있는 개선 지침을 제공하는 능력이 제한적이다. 이러한 한계를 해결하기 위해 본 연구는 정량적 점수 예측과 정성적 피드백 생성을 동시에 수행하는 LLM 기반 통합 평가 모델을 제안한다. 제안 모델은 Whisper, BEATs, QFormer를 결합하여 다차원적 음성 특징을 추출하고, ChatGPT로 생성한 훈련 데이터를 활용하여, Llama 기반 instruction tuning을 통해 4개 영역(과업 완성도, 전달력, 정확성, 적절성)의 점수 예측과 구체적인 피드백 및 첨삭 문장을 생성한다. 실험 결과, 인간 평가자와의 상관관계는 영역별로 Pearson 상관계수 0.730–0.789를 나타냈으며, LLM-as-a-Judge 방법론으로 검증한 피드백 품질은 모든 평가 범주에서 평균 4.0점 이상을 기록하였다.
abstract_en: Traditional automated English speaking assessment systems are limited in their ability to provide meaningful improvement guidance to learners, as they typically focus solely on generating overall scores. To address this limitation, this study proposes an integrated LLM-based assessment model that simultaneously performs quantitative score prediction and qualitative feedback generation for comprehensive English speaking evaluation. The model combines Whisper, BEATs, and QFormer for multidimensional audio feature extraction, utilizes ChatGPT-generated training data for Llama-based instruction tuning, and employs large language models to predict scores across four domains (task completion, delivery, accuracy, appropriateness) while generating specific feedback and corrections. Experimental results demonstrate reasonable correlations with human evaluators (Pearson correlation coefficients ranging from 0.730 to 0.789) and feedback quality with average scores above 4.0 points in all evaluation categories as validated by LLM-as-a-Judge methodology.
note: Whisper·Llama 기반 말하기 자동평가 모델

title_ko: TED-Ed와 ChatGPT 기반 영어 듣기 수업이 대학생 학습자의 듣기 성취도와 듣기 자기효능감에 미친 영향
title_en: The effects of TED-Ed and ChatGPT-based English listening classes on EFL university students' listening achievement and listening self-efficacy
kw_ko: 영어 듣기 수업; 듣기 자기효능감; 생성형 인공지능
kw_en: English listening instruction; listening self-efficacy; generative AI; ChatGPT; TED-Ed
abstract_ko: This study explores the effects of English listening instruction that integrates TED-Ed video content with ChatGPT-based learning activities on EFL university students' listening achievement and listening self-efficacy. A 15-week instructional model was designed to promote learners' strategic engagement through sentence analysis, vocabulary expansion, and shadowing. ChatGPT was utilized as an interactive learning partner to provide personalized feedback, extend expressions, and support self-regulated learning. Quantitative data from pre- and post-tests showed significant improvement in both listening comprehension and listening self-efficacy. In addition, qualitative responses from open-ended questionnaires indicated that students experienced improved strategy awareness, and stronger motivation for continued listening practice. title_ko: Phonology meets AI: Can ChatGPT detect and differentiate cuteness in Korean aegyo?
title_en: Phonology meets AI: Can ChatGPT detect and differentiate cuteness in Korean aegyo?
authors: 심록(University of South Carolina); Drew Crosby(고려대학교)
kw_en: aegyo; Korean phonology; Phonological alternations; Sociophonetics; Large Language Models (LLMs)
abstract_ko: This study investigates whether ChatGPT can recognize the affective force of aegyo, a Korean speech style marked by playful phonological alternations such as nasalization, affrication, and /j/-insertion. More specifically, it examines whether ChatGPT detects aegyo forms as “cuter” than their canonical counterparts and whether it can distinguish degrees of cuteness based on phonological features and phonotactic acceptability, following Jang (2021). Three ChatGPT versions (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4o) rated 11 verbs in seven conditions on a 7-point scale. Results showed that aegyo forms were rated as cuter, indicating sensitivity to affective cues. However, internal rankings diverged from human judgments: while humans favored forms aligned with phonotactic constraints—especially affrication and stopping—ChatGPT prioritized /j/-insertion. Version-specific trends appeared: GPT-3.5 gave conservative scores, GPT-4 moderate contrasts, and GPT-4o stronger contrasts with greater variability, suggesting partial but limited sociophonetic sensitivity.

title_ko: 생성형 AI를 활용한 대학 토론 수업 사례 연구
title_en: A Case Study of University Debate Instruction Utilizing Generative AI
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 토론 수업; AI 리터러시; 에듀테크; 교양 교육; 교수법

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 대학 토론 수업에 생성형 AI를 활용한 토론 과제를 적용하고 그 효과를 분석한 연구이다. ChatGPT를 활용한 1:1 음성 토론 과제를 설계하여 학생들이 과제 형식으로 수행하도록 했으며, 이후 토론 역량과 AI 리터러시, 과제 만족도 등을 설문을 통해 평가하였다. 분석 결과, AI를 활용한 토론은 기존 토론의 시공간적 제약과 심리적 부담을 완화하고, 논리적 사고, 프롬프트 설계 능력 등 토론과 AI 리터러시의 핵심 역량을 실질적으로 높이는 데 기여하였다. 생성형 AI를 활용한 과제를 통하여 학생들은 반복 연습의 용이함과 자유로운 의견 표현, 흥미와 몰입도 증가 등에서 긍정적인 응답을 하였으며, 생성형 AI를 활용한 토론이 대학 교육 현장에서 효과적인 대안이 될 수 있음을 논의한다.
abstract_en: This study examines the application of generative AI in university debate classes and its educational effects. A one-on-one voice debate assignment utilizing ChatGPT was designed and administered to students as a course requirement, and students’ debate competency, AI literacy, and assignment satisfaction were subsequently assessed through surveys. Debates incorporating AI helped alleviate the spatial and psychological constraints commonly found in traditional classroom discussions, while also fostering core skills such as logical reasoning and prompt engineering, which are key aspects of both debate and AI literacy. As a result of the generative AI-based activity, students reported increased opportunities forrepetitive practice, greater freedom of expression, heightened interest, and deeper engagement. These findings suggest that integrating generative AI into debate education can offer an effective and meaningful pedagogical alternative in higher education contexts.
