title_ko: The effect of teacher-led scaffolding on Korean EFL adolescents’ writing engagement with AI writing feedback
title_en: The effect of teacher-led scaffolding on Korean EFL adolescents’ writing engagement with AI writing feedback
kw_en: AI Feedback; EFL Writing; Teacher Scaffolding; Metacognitive Engagement; Adolescent Learners
abstract_ko: As generative AI tools increasingly enter EFL classrooms, their role in supporting young learners’ writing development requires closer examination. This study explored the effects of AI-generated feedback on the writing revision process and outcomes of Korean middle school EFL students, with a particular focus on the mediating role of teacher scaffolding. A quasi-experimental mixed-methods design was employed with two instructional conditions: AI-only (where participants received only AI feedback) and AI+teacher scaffolding (where participants obtained both AI feedbacks and teacher scaffolding). Eighteen middle students participated in the study. Data sources included original and revised drafts, analytic rubric scores, metacognitive awareness surveys, and post-intervention interviews. Findings indicated that the AI-only group tended to apply suggestions at a surface level, while the AI+teacher scaffolding group was engaged in more strategic and reflective revisions. The AI+teacher group demonstrated greater gains in writing quality—particularly in vocabulary use and grammatical accuracy—and reported higher levels of metacognitive and emotional engagement. These findings suggest that while AI feedback provides immediate corrective input, its instructional value is significantly enhanced when embedded within teacher-led scaffolding that promotes critical thinking, self-regulation, and learner autonomy.

title_ko: 영어과 AI 디지털 교과서 도입 초기 중학교 교사들의 활용 실태와 인식 분석
title_en: An analysis of middle school English teachers’ use and perceptions of AI digital textbooks in the early stages of implementation
kw_ko: AI 디지털 교과서; 영어 교육; 교사 인식; 에듀테크; 맞춤형 학습
kw_en: AI Digital Textbook; English Language Teaching; Teacher Perception; Educational Technology; Personalized Learning
abstract_ko: This study explores middle school English teachers’ experiences and perceptions of using AI digital textbooks (AIDT) during the first semester of 2025. Employing a mixed-methods approach, the research conducted surveys and in-depth interviews with eight teachers who actively used AIDT in their classes across diverse regional contexts including Seoul, Gyeonggi, Daegu, and Jeonnam. Data were analyzed through content analysis and thematic analysis to examine classroom changes, core function utilization, effectiveness across language skills, and implementation challenges. The findings reveal that AIDT enhanced student participation and individualized learning, particularly benefiting underachieving students. Additionally, AIDT led to diverse teacher role identities including instructional designers, facilitators, and managers. Among core functions, teacher customization received the highest evaluation, whereas AI tutor functions were rated least favorably. Regarding language skills, speaking activities demonstrated the highest perceived effectiveness, while reading showed little advantage over traditional textbooks. Implementation challenges identified by teachers encompassed technical infrastructure limitations, complex administrative procedures, rushed policy rollout, teacher-related factors, and significant quality disparities among publishers. The study concludes that while AIDT holds promise for enhancing personalized learning and student engagement, addressing the identified challenges is essential to realizing its full potential in diverse educational contexts. Overall, the findings highlight the complex interplay of teacher-related and contextual variables in shaping teachers’ perceptions and practices of AIDT, offering critical insights for the future development of AI-based educational tools and the formulation of evidence-based policies.

title_ko: 2022 개정 영어과 교육과정의 구현: 중학교 1학년 영어 교과서의단원 구성, 디지털 리터러시, 자기 주도적 학습 분석
title_en: Implementing the 2022 revised English curriculum: Unit structure, digital literacy, and self-directed learning in Korean middle school English textbooks for seventh graders
kw_ko: 중학교 1학년 영어 교과서; 단원 구성; 디지털 리터러시; 자기주도학습; AI 통합; 2022 개정 교육과정
kw_en: Middle School English 1 Textbook; Unit Structure; Digital Literacy; Self-Directed Learning; AI Integration; 2022 Revised National Curriculum
abstract_ko: This study examines how the 2022 Revised English Curriculum’s core goals—digital literacy and self-directed learning—are implemented in the 2025 edition of first-year middle school English textbooks in South Korea. To ascertain whether the revised curriculum’s emphasis on personalized, AI-supported instruction, project-based learning, and integrated digital tools is reflected in textbook design, five nationally approved textbooks were analyzed across three dimensions: (1) unit structure and organization, (2) incorporation of digital literacy elements such as QR codes, multimedia, and online platforms, and (3) provision of support for learner autonomy through repeated listening prompts, self-assessment, and differentiated activities. The analysis reveals that while all textbooks share a general structure combining integrated language skill activities with project tasks, their pedagogical orientations diverge: some have adopted a theme-based structure, whereas others have retained skill-based formats. As for digital literacy, although digital resources are consistently accessible via QR codes, their depth of integration varies considerably, and AI-driven feedback functions are absent. In terms of learner autonomy, only a limited number of textbooks provide explicit opportunities for choice or scaffolds for self-regulated learning. These findings suggest a partial but uneven realization of curriculum intention and thus a need for stronger alignment between curriculum goals and textbook design by expanding functional digital integration beyond basic access.

title_en: A Study on Improving English Writing Competence Using Generative AI
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 쓰기능력; 향상도; 흥미도; 만족도
kw_en: Generative AI; Writing Competence; Improvement; Interest; Satisfaction
abstract_ko: 연구 목적: 이 연구는 중학교 3학년 학생 18명을 대상으로 영어 쓰기능력에 대한 점검을 하고 생성형 AI를 활용하여 학생들의 영어 글쓰기 능력을 향상시키는 것이다. 연구 방법: 생성형 AI의 도움을 받으면서 학습자들 스스로 글의 주제를 정하고, 글을 작성하며, 피드백을 받으면서 문장에 대한 교정까지 스스로 진행한다. 연구 내용: 첫째 생성형 AI를 활용한 학습은 학생들의 영어 쓰기능력 향상에 통계적으로 유의미한 효과가 있음을 보였다. 둘째, 생성형 AI를 활용한 학습에 참여한 학생들의 만족도 및 흥미도가 매우 높은 것으로 나타났다. 결론 및 제언: 이 연구 결과 생성형 AI를 활용한 영어 글쓰기 학습은 학생들의 영어 쓰기 능력 향상에 유의미한 효과가 있음을 확인할 수 있었다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to research middle school third grade students’ English writing problems and to suggest how to improve their English writing competence using the Generative AI. The experimental group had been performed using Generative AI from Apr. 7, 2025 to June 13, 2025 and a total 18 participated. The data needed for this study was obtained by the writing test about English. The data analyzing method was the response sample t-test through the statistics program SPSS. The results are as follows. First, the mean score for the post-test was significantly higher than that of pre-test. Second, most of the students who were performed by Generative AI responded that they were satisfied with and interested in the lesson. From the results of this study, we found that the use of Generative AI was effective in improving the middle school first students’ English writing competence.

title_ko: 대학 교양 영어 수업에서의 AI 활용 프로젝트 기반 언어학습 프레임워크: 학생의 학습 경험을 중심으로
title_en: An AI-Supported Project-Based Language Learning Framework in a University General English Course: Students’ Learning Expereince
kw_ko: AI 활용 PBLL 프레임워크; 영어 능력 향상; 비판적 사고 확장; 프롬프트 작성 어려움; AI 의존과 협업 약화
kw_en: AI-Supported PBLL Framework; English Proficiency Improvement; Critical Thinking Enhancement; Difficulties in Prompt Construction; Reliance on AI and Weakened Collaboration
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 AI 인프라가 없는 한국 대학의 교양 영어 수업에서 AI 활용 프로젝트 기반 언어학습(PBLL) 프레임워크를 개발하고 적용하여 학습자 관점을 탐구하였다. 6주 동안 학생들은 그룹 저널, 성찰 글쓰기, 구두 발표 등 협업 과제를 수행하였으며, 설문지, 저널, 인터뷰 등 다양한 자료가 수집되었다. 연구 참여자는 총 18명으로 다양한 전공과 영어 수준을 가진 학생들이었으며, 이 자료는 주제분석 절차에 따라 개방 코딩, 범주화, 주제화 과정을 거쳐 체계적으로 분석되었다. 분석 결과, 학습자들은 AI를 활용하여 글쓰기를 구조화하고 문법과 어휘를 교정하며 말하기를 연습함으로써 영어 능력을 향상시켰다. 또한 지니계수를 활용한 불평등 분석을 통해 비판적 사고를 확장하는 경험을 하였고, 교사의 프롬프트 설계 지도와 지속적 피드백은 학습 촉진에 중요한 역할을 하였다. 한편 프롬프트 작성의 어려움, 과제의 낯설음, AI 의존으로 인한 협업 약화 등 부정적 경험도 드러났다. 본 연구는 AI 활용 PBLL이 대학 교양 영어 교실에서도 효과적으로 운영될 수 있음을 보여주며, 긍정적 효과를 강화하고 한계를 보완할 교수 전략 개발의 필요성을 제시한다.
abstract_en: This study explored the development and implementation of an AI-supported Project-Based Language Learning (PBLL) framework in a general English course at a Korean university with no prior AI infrastructure. Over a six-week period, students engaged in collaborative tasks such as group journals, reflective writing, and oral presentations, while data were collected from surveys, journals, interviews etc. The participants were 18 students from diverse majors and English proficiency levels, and the data were systematically analyzed through thematic analysis, following iterative stages of open coding, categorization, and theme generation. The analysis revealed that learners enhanced their English proficiency by using AI tools to structure writing, refine grammar and vocabulary, and practice speaking. They also expanded their critical thinking through inequality analysis using the Gini index, while the teacher’s guidance in prompt design and ongoing feedback played a crucial facilitative role. On the other hand, challenges emerged, including difficulties in prompt construction, unfamiliarity with tasks, and weakened collaboration due to over-reliance on AI. The findings suggest that AI-integrated PBLL can be effectively implemented in university English classrooms, while also underscoring the need for pedagogical strategies that maximize positive outcomes and mitigate potential limitations.

kw_ko: 맞춤형 어휘 평가; 자동문항생성; 생성형 인공지능; 다단계 적응형 검사; 온톨로지; 평가 공학; 국어교육
kw_en: Adaptive Vocabulary Assessment; Automatic Item Generation; Generative AI; Multistage Adaptive Testing; Ontology; Assessment Engineering; Korean Language Education
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 생성형 인공지능과 자동문항생성(AIG) 기술을 활용하여 다단계 적응형 검사(MST) 기반의 맞춤형 어휘 평가 체제를 개발하여 효과적인 개별화 어휘 학습을 지원하기 위한 평가 개발 접근을 제안하는 데 있다. 이를 위해 맞춤형 어휘 평가가 갖추어야 할 요건을 고찰하여, 다양한 맞춤형 알고리즘을 비교하여 교실 환경에 적합한 MST의 이론적․방법론적 토대를 탐색하였다. 또한 규칙 기반 방식과 거대 언어 모델(LLM)을 결합한 혼합형 자동문항생성 모형의 핵심 요소로서 어휘 온톨로지의 중요성을 논의하고, 생성형 인공지능 에이전트를 활용한 평가 시스템의 구현 가능성을 검토하였다. 이를 바탕으로 어휘 평가 온톨로지의 설계 및 구축, MST 기반 맞춤형 평가 알고리즘의 설계, 규칙 기반 및 생성형 인공지능을 활용한 혼합형 어휘 평가 문항 생성 시스템의 개발 사례를 포함한 실제적인 맞춤형 어휘 평가 개발 과정을 구체적으로 제시하였다. 본 연구는 체계적이고 실용적인 맞춤형 어휘 평가 체제의 개발 방법론을 제공함으로써, 디지털 기반 국어 교육 환경에서 교사 주도 평가를 지원하고 실질적인 개별화 어휘 학습을 촉진하는 데 기여할 수 있다.
abstract_en: This study develops an adaptive vocabulary assessment system based on Multistage Testing (MST) that leverages Automatic Item Generation (AIG) and generative artificial intelligence to support adaptive vocabulary learning. The research first examines essential requirements for adaptive vocabulary assessment and explores the theoretical foundations of the MST algorithm, demonstrating its suitability for classroom-based assessment. Central to this approach is vocabulary ontology, which is a foundational component for a hybrid AIG model that integrates rule-based methods with large language models (LLMs). Three key components comprise the practical implementation: (1) designing a vocabulary assessment ontology, (2) architecting an MST-based adaptive assessment algorithm, and (3) implementing a hybrid vocabulary item generation system that combines rule-based and LLM-based approaches. This research provides a systematic methodology for developing adaptive vocabulary assessment frameworks that enhance learning effectiveness through personalized evaluation, reduce teacher workload in assessment processes, and enable authentic individualized vocabulary learning experiences in digital-based Korean language education.

title_ko: Scaffold, Not Surrogate: Korean EFL Writers' Perceived Benefits and Concerns of ChatGPT
title_en: Scaffold, Not Surrogate: Korean EFL Writers' Perceived Benefits and Concerns of ChatGPT
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 인공지능을 활용한 영어 글쓰기; ChatGPT 활용에 대한 학습자들의 인식; 학습자 동기부여
kw_en: Generative AI; ChatGPT; English writing utilizing AI-powered tool; Learner perceptions; Learner motivation
abstract_ko: The rapid emergence of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT has opened new possibilities in English as a Foreign Language (EFL) education, yet research on their application in scriptwriting for oral presentations remains scarce. This study explored Korean EFL college students’ perceptions of incorporating ChatGPT into a general English speaking course, focusing on both benefits and challenges. A qualitative design employed pre- and post-surveys, reflective journals, and interviews, following a three-stage writing process (drafting – AI-assisted revision – self-reflective revision). To analyze the data collected, inductive thematic analysis was used, following three coding process: pre-coding, open-coding, and coding to capture recurring patterns. Findings indicate that ChatGPT facilitated linguistic development and fostered positive affective outcomes including motivation, and reduced anxiety, while concerns emerged about over-reliance, reliability, and authorship ethics. The study highlights the importance of teacher-guided and ethical AI use in EFL contexts to enhance learner autonomy and competence. Despite limitations of a single context and self-reported data, findings suggest that thoughtful use of ChatGPT can effectively.

title_ko: 메타버스를 활용한 초등학생 면담 수행 양상의 질적 분석
title_en: A Qualitative Study of Elementary School Students’ Interview Performance in a Metaverse Environment
kw_ko: 면담 교육; 메타버스; 질문자; 답변자; 초등 화법; 젭
kw_en: interview instruction; metaverse; interviewer; interviewee; oral communication instruction in elementary school; ZEP
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 초등학교 6학년을 대상으로 메타버스를 활용한 면담 수업을 설계․실행하고, 학습자의 수행 양상을 질적으로 분석하여 향후 초등학생의 면담 수업의 설계 및 운영에 시사점을 제공하고, 메타버스 기반 화법 교육의 가능성을 탐색하였다. 분석 결과, 학습자들은 면담 절차와 질문자․답변자 역할을 기계적으로 재현하는 양상을 보였다. 그러나 메타버스 환경에서의 동시다발적 활동과 반복 수행을 통해 균형적이고 유연한 역할 체험을 하였으며, 이는 긍정적인 자기 인식으로 이어졌다. 또한, 자기 성찰과 학습자 간 상호작용, 디지털 기능 활용 면에서 교육적 효과를 보였다. 이러한 결과는 향후 메타버스 기반 면담 교육에서 체계적이고 유연한 면담 절차 교육, 역할 수행 점검 능력 교육, 성찰 촉진을 위한 평가 문항 보완 및 교사의 피드백 제공 등이 병행될 필요가 있음을 시사한다. 아울러, 디지털 환경에서의 윤리와 학습자 심리 안정성에 대한 고려 역시 요구된다. 이러한 내용이 교육 현장에 안정적으로 구현되기 위해서는, 교육과정의 성취기준에 따라 면담 담화 교육을 점진적․체계적으로 설계할 필요가 있다. 이 연구는 메타버스를 활용한 화법 교육이 ‘실제적인 담화 수행 기회 제공, 반복을 통한 숙련화, 자기 주도적 학습 기회 제공, 의사소통 역량과 디지털 미디어 역량 강화’ 등의 긍정적인 가능성이 있음을 확인하였다는 점에서 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: This study implemented a metaverse-based interview lesson for sixth -grade students and qualitatively analyzed their performance to explore its potential in speaking education. Students initially reproduced interview procedures and roles mechanically, but the metaverse environment enabled simultaneous activities and repeated practice, leading to more flexible role-taking and positive self-recognition. Educational benefits also appeared in self-reflection, peer interaction, and the use of digital tools. These findings highlight the need for systematic role instruction, reflective assessment, and teacher feedback, along with attention to digital ethics and learner well-being. Therefore, a systematic design based on curriculum achievement standards is needed. Overall, the study underscores the value of metaverse-based instruction in fostering authentic discourse, active participation, self-directed learning, and enhanced communication and digital competence.

title_ko: ChatGPT 활용에 대한 대학생들의 인식과 영어 학습 경험
title_en: University Students’ Perceptions of ChatGPT Use and Their English Language Learning Experiences.
kw_en: ChatGPT; English language learning; perceptions; Self-directed learning; motivation; achievement
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study was to explore the perceptions of university students who used ChatGPT for English learning and to analyze how these factors affected their learning motivation and achievement experiences. To achieve this research purpose, a mixed-methods approach was employed with data collected from 63 undergraduates in Gyeonggi-do, South Korea. Quantitative data were processed using SPSS 27 employing descriptive statistics, t-tests, multivariate analysis, Mann-Whitney U test, and regression; qualitative data were analyzed using content analysis based on students’ responses to open-ended questions. The findings revealed that higher-grade students used ChatGPT more actively, and perceptions of ChatGPT significantly affected self-directed language learning depending on academic division. ChatGPT users perceived significant improvements in their creative thinking, writing ability, and learning confidence. Qualitative results also highlighted enhanced efficiency in goal setting and task completion although some noted the risks of over-reliance. This study suggests the need for structured educational strategies to promote balanced and effective use of ChatGPT in English learning.

title_ko: Google Gemini AI 기반 ‘역할극 Gems’를 활용한 영어 말하기 학습 프로그램 개발과 지도방안 - 창의융복합 수업을 중심으로 -
title_en: Developing and Implementing an English Speaking Learning Program Using ‘Role-Play Gems’ Based on Google Gemini AI - Focused on Creative Convergence Classrooms -
kw_ko: 영어 말하기; 역할극; 생성형 AI; 창의융복합; 체화된 인지; 장소 기반 학습
kw_en: English Speaking; Role-Play; Generative AI; Creative Convergence; Embodied Cognition; Place-Based Learning
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 2022 개정 교육과정에서 강조하는 창의융복합 수업의 구현을 위해 생성형 AI, 특히Google Gemini의 맞춤형 AI인 Gems를 활용하여 ‘역할극 Gems’ 프로그램을 개발하고, 이를 통한 영어말하기 학습의 효과적인 지도방안을 제시하는 것이다. 개발한 ‘역할극 Gems’ 모델은 G(Get into the Role), E(Embody Language), M(Master the Scenario), S(Showcase Creativity)의 네 단계로 구성된다. 이 모델은 AI가 학습자의 근접발달영역(ZPD)에서 협력적 비계(scaffolding) 역할을 수행한다는 이론적토대에 기반하며, 의사소통 중심 교수법과 체화된 인지 이론(Embodied Cognition Theory)을 융합한다. 본 프로그램은 부산 지역의 실생활 문제를 소재로 한 장소 기반 학습(Place-Based Education)을 통해학습자의 실제적 의사소통 능력을 향상시키고, AI 기반 개인화 학습을 통해 창의적 문제해결 능력을 함양하도록 설계되었다. ‘Gems’ 프로그램은 초등 고학년 학습자의 영어 말하기 유창성 및 정확성 향상뿐만 아니라, 협력적 소통 및 창의융복합 역량 개발에 매우 효과적인 교육 모델이 될 것으로 기대된다. 이는 AI를 활용한 글로컬라이제이션(Glocalization) 교육의 구체적 모델을 제시하는 데 학술적, 실천적 의의를 지닐 것이다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to develop the role-play program 'Gems,' utilizing generative AI, specifically the customized Google Gemini AI named Gems, to realize the creative convergence classroom emphasized in the 2022 Revised Curriculum, and to propose effective instructional strategies for English speaking learning through this program. The developed role-play 'Gems' model is structured in four stages: G (Get into the Role), E (Embody Language), M (Master the Scenario), and S (Showcase Creativity). This model is theoretically underpinned by the AI's role in providing collaborative scaffolding within the learner's Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD), integrating the Communicative Language Teaching approach with Embodied Cognition Theory. The program is designed to enhance learners' authentic communication skills through Place-Based Education, utilizing real-life issues from the Busan area as content, and to foster creative problem-solving abilities through AI-based personalized learning. The 'Gems' program is expected to be a highly effective educational model, not only for improving speaking fluency and accuracy in upper-grade students but also for developing their collaborative communication and creative convergence competencies. This study holds significant academic and practical implications by proposing a concrete model for Glocalization education utilizing AI.
note: Gemini Gems 역할극 말하기 프로그램 개발

title_ko: 교수에게 보내는 요청 이메일의 챗지피티 수정본에서 한국 대학생들이 주목한 영어 공손 표현과 지연 학습효과
title_en: Politeness Features Noticed and Retained by Korean University Students in ChatGPT’s Revised Version of Their English Request Email to Faculty
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 요청; 영어 이메일; 공손성; 화용 능력
kw_en: ChatGPT; requests; English email; politeness features; pragmatic competence
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 우리나라 대학생들이 교수에게 추천서를 요청하는 영어 이메일을 쓰는과정에서 챗지피티로부터 영어 공손성 측면에서 향상된 수정본을 제공받아 자신의 초안과 비교하는 의식고양 활동을 한 후, 이들이 주목했던 공손성 표현의 지연 학습효과를 살펴보았다. 연구 참여자들은 서울 소재 대학의 영어 전공 28명의 대학생들이었고, 이들은 영어 원어민 교수에게 추천서를 요청하는 이메일 초안을 작성한 후, 챗지피티로부터 공손성 측면에서 향상된 수정본을 받아보고 자신들의 초안과 비교하였다. 이들은 챗지피티 수정본에서 주목한 영어 공손 표현과 이에 대한 자신들의생각을 개방형 설문지 형식으로 작성하는 의식고양 활동을 하였다. 4일 후 연구 참여자들은 수업 시간에 동일한 상황의 요청 이메일을 챗지피티 도움 없이 지필 형식으로 다시 작성하였다. 분석 결과, 연구 참여자들은 어휘와 가정법/복절 사용과 같은 언어적 유형에 가장 많은 주목을 하였고, 다음으로 이메일의 도입과 종결과 같은 형식적 유형, 요청의 전략적 유형 순서로 높은 주목도를 보였다. 4일 후 작성된 이메일에서는 연구 참여자들이 챗지피티 수정본에서 주목했던 영어의 공손 표현의 약 50%가 기억으로 보존되어 활용된 것으로 나타나 긍정적 지연 학습 효과가 확인되었다. 이 지연 학습 효과는 이메일의 도입과 종결과 같은 형식적 유형, 요청의 전략적 유형, 언어적 유형 순서로 높게 나타났다. 이러한 결과는 챗지피티와 같은 AI 기반 도구가 영어 학습자들의 공손 표현 습득을 지원하고, 지속적인 자기 주도적 개별 학습이 따라준다면 학습자의 전반적인 화용 능력 향상에도 이바지할 수 있음을 시사해 주었다.
abstract_en: This paper examined which politeness features Korean EFL university students noticed in ChatGPT’s revisions of their request email to faculty, and the extent to which these features were retained in subsequent email writing. Twenty eight students were asked to write an English email requesting a recommendation letter from a native English-speaking professor. They were then asked to receive a revision from ChatGPT and compare it with their original draft. As a consciousness-raising activity, they completed an open-ended questionnaire in which they described their reflections on the English politeness expressions they noticed in the ChatGPT-revised version. Four days later, during class, the participants were asked to write the same email again without assitance from ChatGPT. The analysis revealed that the participants paid the greatest attention to linguistic features, followed by email-opening and closing features, finally to strategic features. Overall, about 50% of the noticed politeness features were retained and used in the subsequent email written 4 days later. The highest retention rates were observed in email-opening and closing features, followed by strategic features and linguistic features. These findings provide positive evidence that AI-based tools such as ChatGPT can facilitate the acquisition of politeness features and enhance learners’ pragmatic competence.

title_ko: Investigating the Effects of ChatGPT-Assisted English Speaking Practice Based on Student Engagement Levels
title_en: Investigating the Effects of ChatGPT-Assisted English Speaking Practice Based on Student Engagement Levels
kw_en: ChatGPT; English Speaking; Engagement; Artificial Intelligence (AI); Perception
abstract_ko: This study examined the impact of college student’s engagement with ChatGPT-based speaking assignments on their speaking proficiency and perceptions of AI-assisted learning. A comparative analysis was conducted between high and low-engagement groups, excluding mid-engagement participants. Students completed ChatGPT-based speaking assignments twice a week over nine weeks, and both quantitative and qualitative data were collected. Paired samples t-tests indicated significant improvement in Responding to Questions and Expressing an Opinion for both the high- and low-engagement groups. In contrast, independent samples t-tests revealed that the high-engagement group significantly outperformed the low engagement group in overall speaking performance on the post-tests across both speaking tasks. These findings suggest that consistent participation meaningfully contributes to language development. Additionally, student’s perceptions of ChatGPT differed by engagement level. While low-engagement students acknowledged its convenience and emotional support, high engagement students reported enhanced confidence, reduced anxiety, and greater satisfaction with the learning process. Qualitative responses further highlighted differences in perceived strengths and limitations of AI, as well as preferences for human versus AI instruction. The results underscore the pedagogical potential of structured, AI-integrated speaking tasks and the crucial role of sustained engagement in maximizing both cognitive and affective learning outcomes.

title_ko: Translating Method with ChatGPT:Inductive Learning of the English Passive Voice
title_en: Translating Method with ChatGPT:Inductive Learning of the English Passive Voice
kw_ko: Inductive Learning(귀납적 학습); Translation Method(번역식); Passive Voice(수동태); ChatGPT(챗GPT); Self-directed Learning(자기주도학습)
abstract_ko: This study investigates the effectiveness of integrating ChatGPT- assisted translation-judgment tasks into inductive grammar learning for EFL students. Participants evaluated a series of English–Korean translations of passive-voice sentences generated by ChatGPT and completed a reflective survey about their learning experience. Findings revealed that students generally demonstrated a strong ability to recognize correct and incorrect uses of the passive voice, though they encountered greater difficulty when sentences included multiple grammatical features, such as the combination of progressive and passive forms. Qualitative results showed that learners developed heightened awareness of grammatical patterns, and increased motivation for self-directed learning. Many participants also expressed a more critical understanding of AI-generated translations, recognizing both their usefulness and their limitations. When used as a scaffold for guided comparison and reasoning, ChatGPT supports learners in discovering rules through analysis, offering a practical and engaging model for modern EFL grammar instruction.

title_ko: 中国县域中小学英语教师对AI工具的接受度研究: 基于UTAUT模型的实证分析
title_en: Acceptance and Usage of Generative Artificial Intelligence by English Teachers in Primary and Secondary Schools in Rural China: A UTAUT-Based Study
authors: 姜丽(浙江师范大学); 张梁(黑龙江东方学院)
kw_en: 人工智能、生成式、英语教学、中等教育、AI、中国县域; Generative; Artificial Intelligence; English teaching; Secondary Education; AI; County-level Regions in China
abstract_ko: 本研究基于技术接受与使用统一理论（UTAUT模型），利用问卷调查和结构方程模型，探讨中国县域中小学英语教师对生成式AI工具的接受度、使用情况和影响因素。基于对477份有效问卷的调查结果显示，当前中国县域中小学英语教师主要使用AI工具进行资源搜索和课程设计，但采用率因学历背景和任教阶段而异，高中教师的接受度更高。另外在所有AI工具中，Deepseek和豆包使用频率较高。在影响因素分析中，绩效期望和促进条件正向显著影响使用意向，而风险感知对教师使用AI工具的意向产生负面影响。尽管城乡人工智能的基础设施存在差距，教师们对推进智能化教育仍态度积极。这种现象提示中国教育部门需要提供定制的培训和政策支持，以弥合人工智能在城乡教育中的数字鸿沟。
abstract_en: Based on the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT Model), this study explores the acceptance, usage status, and influencing factors of generative AI tools among English teachers in primary and secondary schools in China's county-level regions, using questionnaire surveys and structural equation modeling. Data from 477 valid questionnaires show these teachers mainly use AI tools to search resources and design lessons. Adoption rates differ by education and teaching stage, and senior high school teachers accept AI most. Additionally, among all AI tools, Deepseek and Doubao are used more frequently. In the analysis of influencing factors, performance expectancy and facilitating conditions have a significantly positive impact on usage intention, while risk perception exerts a negative impact on teachers' intention to use AI tools. Though urban and rural infrastructure differs, teachers still have a positive attitude. So China’s education departments should give targeted training and policies to narrow the AI education digital gap between cities and countryside.

title_ko: 日本語学習支援における生成式AIモデル翻訳の日中対照研究 ―アスペクト表現「ている」の訳出傾向から―
title_en: A Contrastive Study of Generative AI Model Translation in Japanese Language Learning Support - From the Translation Tendencies of the Aspect Marker ‘-te iru’ -
kw_ko: 일본어 교육; 대조 연구
kw_en: ~“teiru” construction; Japanese language education; contrastive studies; ChatGPT; DeepSeek; 「ている」; 日本語教育; 対照研究
abstract_ko: 일본어 문법 연구에서 아스펙트(상)에 관한 성과는 적지 않지만, 그중 주요 표현형태 중 하나인 「ている」에 대한 일중(日中) 대조 연구는 많지 않아. 중국어를 모국어로 하는 일본어 학습자의 일본어 학습의 난점이 된다. 2019년 히토쓰바시대학교에서 개최된 「일본언어학회 제158회 대회」에서는 공개 심포지엄의 형식으로 「아스펙트 연구의 새로운 시좌로서의 ‘テイル’ 연구―일본어학에서 일반언어학으로의 공헌―」이 재검토되었으며, 이를 통해 서로 다른 차원과 다문화 공생의 언어 환경에서 「ている」의 일중 대조 연구에 새로운 기회가 제공되었습니다. 최근 몇 년, ChatGPT와 DeepSeek(이하 ‘생성형 AI 모델’로 약칭함)의 등장으로 외국어 연구 분야, 특히 다언어 번역 분야에서 혁신적인 발전이 보이게 되었다. 그러나 여전히 생성형 AI 모델이 전통적 언어학 연구 분야에서 활용되는 사례는 거의 없다. 따라서 전통적 언어학 연구에서 생성형 AI 모델을 활용하는 일은 언어 연구의 하나의 큰 시도이자 새로운 도전이기도 하다. 본논문에서는 대조언어학의 관점에서 일본어 텍스트에 나타난 「ている」을 중심으로 생성형 AI 모델 번역문과 학습자 번역문을 비교함으로써, 「ている」이 표상하는 다의성이 중국어로의 번역에서 어떠한 ‘충돌’을 일으키는지에 대해 분석을 시도한다.
abstract_en: While substantial achievements of studies on this aspect have been made in the field of Japanese grammar, contrastive studies between Chinese and Japanese on one of its primary expression forms—the “teiru” construction—remain relatively limited. This phenomenon constitutes a main obstacle for Chinese learners of Japanese. At the 158th Meeting of the Linguistic Society of Japan, held at Hitotsubashi University in 2019, the public symposium titled “New approaches to the study on the aspectual verbal auxiliary ‘teiru’ in Japanese: A contribution of Japanese linguistics to the general linguistics” was reexamined; this event provided a new impetus for Chinese–Japanese contrastive study on ‘teiru’ from different dimensions within the linguistic context of multicultural co-existence. Recently, the successive emergence of ChatGPT and DeepSeek (referred to as “generative AI models”) has produced revolutionary advances in foreign language studies, particularly in the field of multilingual translation. Nevertheless, the application of generative AI models within traditional linguistic research is still uncommon. Accordingly, employing generative AI models in traditional linguistics constitutes both a major endeavor and a novel challenge for language research.This paper, from the standpoint of contrastive linguistics, attempts to analyze how the polysemy encoded by the “teiru” construction gives rise to translational “conflicts” in Chinese by comparing translations produced by generative AI models with those by language learners.

title_ko: AI-assisted English Writing Tools: A Meta-Analysis of Effectiveness and Usage in Educational Contexts
title_en: AI-assisted English Writing Tools: A Meta-Analysis of Effectiveness and Usage in Educational Contexts
kw_ko: 쓰기 도구; AI 기반 기술; 메타분석; 효과; 쳇지피티; 평가도구
kw_en: Writing tools; AI-driven technology; Meta-analysis; Effectiveness; tools; ChatGPT; Challenges
abstract_ko: The objective of this study was to identify the key themes and topics addressed in recent research on AI-assisted writing tools in English education. Additionally, the study aimed to examine the research methods and participant groups commonly used in the selected studies, explore the reported pedagogical benefits and challenges, and consider the implications of the findings for language teachers, curriculum designers, and policymakers. To collect data, journal articles were retrieved from the Research Information Service System(RISS), and a total of 16 articles were selected through a multi-stage screening process. The data were analyzed using constant comparison, thematic analysis, and inter-coder reliability to ensure the trustworthiness of the findings. Through this process, five key themes emerged. In terms of pedagogical impact, the findings highlight several benefits, including improvements in grammar, vocabulary, coherence, and overall writing quality—particularly among students who received AI-generated feedback. However, a major challenge identified is the risk of overreliance on AI, which may hinder the development of students’ independent writing and critical thinking skills. The study concludes with a discussion of implications for educational practice and policy, as well as the limitations of the current research.

title_ko: 대학생의 온라인 읽기에서 생성형 AI 활용 양상 연구
title_en: A Study on How University Students Use Generative AI in Online Reading
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 온라인 읽기; 디지털 읽기; 읽기 전략; 디지털 리터러시
kw_en: Generative AI; Online Reading; Digital Reading; Reading Strategies; Digital Literacy
abstract_ko: 생성형 AI 기술의 보급으로 달라진 문식 환경에서 온라인 읽기는 어떻게 수행되고 있는가? 이 연구는 대학생이 온라인에서 정보의 탐색, 평가 및 통합을 수행하는 과정에서 생성형 AI를 어떻게 그리고 왜 사용하는지를 탐구하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 대학생 4명이 생성형 AI를 활용하여 온라인 읽기를 수행하는 과정을 관찰하고 인터뷰를 하였다. 수집된 자료에 대하여 주제 분석을 수행한 결과 대학생의 온라인 읽기 과정에서 세 가지 생성형 AI 활용 패턴이 도출되었다. 생성형 AI를 온라인 읽기에 활용하는 목적을 분석한 결과 생성형 AI 활용 패턴과의 연계성이 확인되었고, 참여자 내부에서의 복잡한 AI 활용 양상이 드러났다. 이를 통해 생성형 AI라는 새로운 도구가 도입된 온라인 환경에서 검색 엔진 중심의 기존 온라인 읽기 전략과 차별화되는 어떤 특징들이 나타나는지를 확인하였다. 나아가 AI와 기존 검색 엔진을 적절히 활용하여 온라인 읽기를 성공적으로 수행하는 것이 대학생 독자에게도 복잡하고 어려운 과제임을 엿볼 수 있었다. 연구 결과를 토대로 변화된 문식 환경에서의 읽기 교육에서 고려되어야 할 점들을 논의하였다.
abstract_en: How is online reading being carried out in a literacy environment that is being reshaped by generative AI technologies? This study examines how and why university students use generative AI while searching for, evaluating, and integrating information online. The study observed and interviewed four university students as they completed online reading tasks with AI support, then conducted a thematic analysis. The analysis identified three distinct patterns of AI use in their reading processes, revealing clear links between their usage patterns and underlying purposes, as well as complex forms of engagement within individual participants. The findings show that AI-augmented online reading exhibits characteristics that diverge from those found in traditional search-engine-based strategies, and that a successful coordination between AI tools and conventional search engines remains a challenging task even for university students. Based on these findings, the study discussed what should be considered for designing reading instructions in the evolving literacy landscape.

title_ko: A Historic Overview of Literacy Studies: From Orality to AI-Mediated Literacies
title_en: A Historic Overview of Literacy Studies: From Orality to AI-Mediated Literacies
kw_ko: 문해 연구; 신문해학 (New Literacy Studies); 학문적 문해력; 사회문화이론; AI 문해력
kw_en: Literacy Studies; Sociocultural Theory; Academic Literacy; New Literacy Studies; AI Literacy
abstract_ko: This paper provides a historical and synthetic overview of literacy studies, tracing major theoretical paradigms from early concerns about orality and writing to behaviorist and cognitive perspectives, sociocultural and critical shifts, and the emergence of New Literacy Studies. The discussion integrates key theoretical frameworks, including Vygotsky’s sociocultural perspective, Bakhtin’s dialogism, Bourdieu’s cultural capital, and Street’s ideological model of literacy, all of which have reoriented the field from skill-based models to those emphasizing practice and power. The paper further explores how literacy has expanded into digital, multimodal, and global contexts, with a particular focus on academic literacy and English for Academic Purposes (EAP), where genre-based and discourse-community perspectives have reshaped pedagogical approaches. The paper makes a critical contribution by arguing that literacy studies is at a pivotal inflection point: the rise of AI-mediated systems, algorithmic sorting, and the rhetorical demands of prompt design necessitate an expansion of the field’s conceptual toolkit. Specifically, the study calls for the integration of AI literacy, prompt literacy, and algorithmic/data literacies into educational frameworks, which challenge traditional notions of authorship, agency, and pedagogy. This paper uniquely contributes by offering empirical and pedagogical insights for elementary, secondary, and tertiary education, detailing how AI-related literacies should be integrated into curricula to foster critical engagement, ethical reasoning, and equitable access. In doing so, it presents actionable recommendations for developing literacy programs that maintain humanistic values and ensure educational equity in rapidly evolving digital and AI-infused learning environments.

title_ko: 인공지능 시대의 확장된 비판적 리터러시 평가 개발 연구
title_en: Development of an extended critical literacy assessment for the age of artificial intelligence
kw_ko: 비판적 리터러시; 인공지능 리터러시; 생성형 인공지능; 증거 중심 평가 설계; 온라인 평가 시스템
kw_en: critical literacy; AI literacy; generative artificial intelligence; evidence-centered design; online assessment system
abstract_ko: 생성형 인공지능의 등장으로 학습자는 인공지능이 생성한 텍스트를 읽고, 인공지능과 협력하여 글을 쓰는 새로운 문식 환경에 직면하고 있다. 이러한 변화 속에서 학습자가 인공지능에 종속되지 않고 비판적 관점을 유지하며 주체적으로 사고할 수 있는 역량을 기르는 것이 주요한 과제로 부상하고 있다. 본 연구는 생성형 인공지능 시대에 요구되는 확장된 비판적 리터러시를 개념화하고, 고등학교 학습자를 대상으로 한 평가 체제를 설계하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 비판적 리터러시와 인공지능 리터러시에 관한 문헌 연구를 수행하여 확장된 비판적 리터러시의 개념적 토대를 구축하였다. 이후 타당도 중심의 평가 설계를 위해 증거 중심 평가 설계 프레임워크를 적용하여 확장된 비판적 리터러시 평가 체제를 개발하였으며, 전문가 검토를 통해 내용 타당도를 확보하였다. 또한 실제 생성형 인공지능 환경을 고려한 웹 앱 기반 평가 플랫폼을 구현하여 교육 현장에서의 접근성을 제고하였다. 본 연구는 학습을 위한 평가의 관점에서 학습자의 비판적 리터러시를 제고할 수 있는 평가 도구를 마련함으로써, 인공지능 시대에 리터러시 교육의 방향 탐색과 교육과정 설계에 기초 자료를 제공할 것으로 기대된다.
abstract_en: In the era of generative artificial intelligence, learners are confronted with a new literacy environment where they both read AI-generated texts and collaborate with AI in writing. In this context, cultivating learners’ ability to maintain critical perspectives and think independently, without becoming subordinate to AI, has emerged as a crucial educational challenge. This study aims to define the extended critical literacy needed in the AI era and to design an assessment system for high school students. A literature review of critical literacy and AI literacy was conducted to establish a conceptual foundation for extended critical literacy. An extended critical literacy assessment system was then developed using the Evidence-Centered Design (ECD) framework. Experts reviewed it to ensure content validity. In addition, a web-based assessment platform that reflects real generative AI environments was implemented to enhance accessibility in educational settings. By providing an assessment tool that enhances learners' critical literacy from an assessment-for-learning perspective, this study is expected to provide foundational data for exploring future directions in literacy education and designing curricula for the AI era.

title_ko: 画像生成AIを活用した初級日本語会話支援の考察
title_en: Consideration of Beginner Japanese Conversation Support Using Image Generation AI
kw_ko: 이미지 생성AI; 초급 일본어 회화; 프롬프트 작성; 학습욕習; 창조성
kw_en: AI Image Generation; Beginner Japanese Conversation; Prompt Creation; Learning Motivation; Creativity
abstract_ko: This study aims to compare and analyze the characteristics and educational effects of textbook-based conversation activities (Activity A) and conversation activities (Activity B) using image generation AI in beginner Japanese conversation classes. As a result, Activity A was conducted around a relatively immediate response while imitating the vocabulary and example sentences presented in the textbook, and feedback was mainly limited to verbal modifications by teachers and learners. On the other hand, Activity B was an activity that repeats the process of creating and modifying prompts until learners obtained the desired image, and the generated visual stimulation served as the starting point for language activities. This process induced learners' spontaneous and creative expression and encouraged the experience of constructing utterances while moving back and forth between language and thought. In addition, the multi-step feedback generated during the generation process provided an opportunity for learners to visually recognize their learning progress and sense of accomplishment. Furthermore, the process of creating and correcting prompts in Japanese after organizing thoughts in the native language promoted the application of expressive and grammatical knowledge and showed results that increased learners' subjectivity. From the above, it was revealed that conversation activities using image generation AI have effectiveness as a new teaching and learning model that can foster learners' creativity and subjectivity in beginner Japanese conversation classes.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 활용 영어 콘텐츠 제작 수업에서 프롬프트 리터러시의 발현 양상에 대한 질적 연구
title_en: An Exploratory Study on the Emergence of Prompt Literacy in an English Content Creation Class Using Generative AI
kw_en: Prompt Literacy; Big P; little p; Generative AI; Project-Based Learning; GenAI Multimodal Composition
abstract_ko: The Journal of Studies in Language 00.0, 000-000. The main purpose of this study is to examine how EFL students develop and manifest a newly emerging concept of prompt literacy when interacting with generative AI(GenAI). Specifically, 43 undergraduate students participated in a project-based learning task that explored the sociocultural meanings and variations of English words or expressions by creating webtoons, short videos, or web pages with a help of GenAI. This study examined the whole process of their exploration, design and production, and sharing, enhanced by interactions with GenAI, peers, and the instructor. Though an in-depth analysis of qualitative date of students’ reflections and creation logs, this study examines how they conceptualized prompt literacy through two dimensions: ‘little p’ (micro and foundational level) and ‘Big P’ (macro and integrative level). Findings reveal that the ‘little p’ dimension involves skills of writing, reading, iteration, structuring, clarify, and contextual adjustment, while the ‘Big P’ dimension includes collaborative engagement, emergent creativity, multimodality, critical analysis, and ethical responsibility. More importantly, these two dimensions are interconnected and mutually complementary. Based on these findings, this study sheds new light on a dual model of prompt literacy and highlights the pedagogical importance of fostering cyclical development of foundational and integrative prompt literacy.

title_ko: AI 시대, 포용적 의사소통을 위한 소고
title_en: Toward Inclusive Communication in the Age of AI

abstract_ko: This study redefines the concept of inclusive communication and explores its practical implications in the age of artificial intelligence (AI). The literature mostly addresses the communication barriers caused by disabilities and the protection of marginalized groups from discriminatory speech. Expanding on this view, this study examines how AI technologies can concomitantly promote and threaten inclusion through hate speech and biases. Furthermore, careful attention must be paid to relational literacy, which is essential for realizing inclusive communication.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 시대의 교사의 새로운 역할에 대한 고찰
title_en: Rethinking the Role of English Teachers in the Era of Generative AI.
kw_en: generative AI in education; teacher identity; prompt literacy; critical digital literacy; sociocultural perspectives on learning
abstract_ko: The emergence of generative AI technologies, such as ChatGPT, is fundamentally reshaping educational landscapes, prompting urgent reconsideration of the teacher’s role. This study explores how teachers must reconceptualize their professional identity and instructional practices in the age of generative AI. Drawing on sociocultural theory and a comprehensive review of CALL and MALL literature, the paper argues that AI does not replace teachers but rather demands a structural transformation of their roles. Specifically, three core roles are proposed for teachers: prompt designer, critical mediator, and emotional and creative mentor. As prompt designers, teachers must master prompt literacy to co-create tailored learning materials with AI; as critical mediators, they safeguard against biases, misinformation, and ethical pitfalls; and as emotional and creative mentors, they nurture students’ motivation, creativity, and identity in ways AI cannot replicate. The study also highlights implications for teacher education programs and school systems, emphasizing the need for comprehensive AI literacy training and pedagogical innovation. Ultimately, the integration of generative AI offers opportunities to enrich learning experiences, provided that teachers actively lead its educational orchestration.

title_ko: 페르소나 기반 로컬 LLM 챗봇과 AI 프롬프트를 활용한 일본어 교육 프레임워크―비판적 AI 리터러시와 학습자 주도성 함양을 중심으로―
title_en: A Framework for Japanese Language Education Using Persona-Based Local LLM Chatbots and AI Prompts: Focusing on the Cultivation of Critical AI Literacy and Learner Autonomy
kw_en: Japanese Language Education; Generative AI; Critical AI Literacy; Learner Autonomy; Persona-based Chatbot; 日本語教育; 生成AI; 批判的AIリタラシー; 学習者の自律性; ペルソナ型チャットボット
abstract_ko: 生成AIの急速な普及は外国語教育分野において新たな教育モデルの構築を急務としている。しかし、現状の日本語教育におけるAI活用は表層的な利用に留まり、人文系専攻者に求められる批判的リテラシーや学習者主導性の育成には至っていない。先行研究においてもAI固有の限界を教育的に活用し、学習者を受動的な消費者から能動的な創造者へと転換させる体系的なフレームワークが欠如している。 本研究は、こうした問題意識に基づき、「批判的AIリテラシー」と「学習者主導性」の育成を目的とした新たな日本語教育フレームワークを提案する。本モデルは「脱構築・批判」「適用・制御」「創造・省察」の3段階で構成され、AIの構造的欠陥の分析、Ollamaを用いたローカルLLMの構築と制御、RAG技術を用いたペルソナベース・チャットボットの制作を実践する。 大学の授業における実践の結果、学習者は技術的不安を克服し、受動的な消費者から能動的な設計者へと役割を転換させた。分析の結果、高度なプロンプトエンジニアリング能力とAIへの深く批判的な理解が育成されたことが確認された。本研究は、AIの弱点を教育的強みとして転換する体系的なモデルを提示し、AIを脱構築・制御・創造する力を通じて、人文系学習者に不可欠な批判的思考能力と主体性を育成できることを実証した。
abstract_en: The rapid integration of generative AI into education necessitates new pedagogical models. However, current applications in Japanese language education often remain superficial, failing to cultivate the critical literacy and autonomy required for humanities majors. Existing research lacks a systematic framework that addresses AI's limitations while empowering learners to transition from passive consumers to active creators. This study proposes a novel framework designed to foster Critical AI Literacy and Learner Autonomy. Structured in three stages—“Deconstruction & Critique,” “Application & Control,” and “Creation & Reflection”—the framework involves analyzing AI flaws, controlling local LLMs using Ollama, and creating persona-based chatbots using RAG techniques. Application in a university course demonstrated a significant transformation in learners, shifting their role to active designers. Analysis confirmed the cultivation of sophisticated prompt engineering skills and a critical understanding of AI. This research contributes a replicable model leveraging AI's weaknesses as strengths, demonstrating that empowering learners to deconstruct and create with AI fosters the high-level critical thinking essential for humanities students in the AI era.

title_ko: AI 시대의 비판적 문식성 재개념화
title_en: Reconceptualizing Critical Literacy in the Age of AI
kw_ko: AI 텍스트; 비판적 문식성; 해체주의; 사회문식성
kw_en: AI text; critical literacy; deconstruction; social literacy
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 인공지능의 급격한 확산으로 텍스트의 생산과 유통, 해석의 지형이 근본적으로 변화하는 상황에서, 기존의 비판적 문식성 담론이 AI 텍스트의 고유한 특수성을 충분히 포착하지 못한다는 문제의식에서 출발하였다. AI 텍스트는 명시적 저자의 부재, 알고리즘적 생성 과정의 불투명성, 그리고 정보의 사실적 불안정성이라는 구조적 특징을 지니며, 이는 독자에게 텍스트의 의미 이해를 넘어 사실 검증과 사회적 영향력 평가를 포함하는 확장된 해석 활동을 요청한다. 이에 본 연구는 Ⅱ장에서 AI 텍스트의 특성을 구체적으로 분석하고, 권력과 이데올로기 분석에 강점을 지닌 전통적 비판적 문식성이 정보의 비가시성과 유동성을 다루기에는 한계가 있음을 지적하였다. Ⅲ장에서는 해체주의의 핵심 개념을 통해 AI 텍스트의 불확정성과 기원 부재를 설명하고, 두 관점이 의미 구성의 불안정성과 사회적·윤리적 판단을 위한 상보적 층위를 제공함을 논증하였다. Ⅳ장에서는 이러한 논의를 사회문식성 관점으로 확장하여, 독자를 능동적 의미 구성자이자 사실 검증자, 그리고 정보 유통의 책임을 고려하는 윤리적 주체로 재위치시켰다. 결론적으로 본 연구는 AI 시대의 비판적 문식성을 의미 구성, 사실 검증, 사회적 책임을 포괄하는 실천적 문식성으로 재개념화할 것을 제안하며, 이는 새로운 독자 역량 정의와 비판적 문식성 교육의 방향 모색에 중요한 시사점을 제공한다.
abstract_en: This study addresses the limitations of traditional critical literacy regarding AI-generated texts, which are characterized by ambiguous authorship, opacity, and factual instability. These features compel readers to move beyond simple meaning-making toward fact-checking and assessing social impact. Analyzing these characteristics, the study demonstrates that while traditional methods effectively examine power, deconstruction provides essential complementary tools for understanding the indeterminacy of AI texts. Consequently, the study reconceptualizes critical literacy through the lens of social literacy, repositioning readers as active agents engaged in collaborative verification and ethical information circulation. Ultimately, this research proposes reframing critical literacy as a practical social practice encompassing meaning construction, factual verification, and social responsibility, offering key implications for reorienting literacy education in the AI era.

title_ko: 글쓰기 교과에서 생성형 AI 활용 가이드라인 제언: 연구윤리 교육의 재검토와 글쓰기 윤리의 확장
title_en: Suggestion for guidelines for using generative AI in writing subjects: Reexamination of research ethics education and expansion of writing ethics
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 연구윤리 교육(RCR); 글쓰기 윤리; 학문적 진실성; 생성형 AI 활용 가이드라인; 생성형 AI의 책임 있는 활용
kw_en: Generative AI; Research Ethics Education; RCR(Responsible Conduct of Research); Writing Ethics; Academic Integrity; Guidelines for using generative AI; Responsible Use of Generative AI
abstract_ko: 생성형 AI의 급속한 상용화는 대학의 연구 환경과 교육에 불가피하고 불가역적인변화를 초래했다. 기존의 연구윤리 규범은 생성형 AI가 상용화 되는 최근의 새로운 상황을 충분히 담아내지 못하는 한계에 봉착했다. 특히 학습자의 학습과 성장 과정 중심에 중점을 두는 글쓰기 교육에서는 생성형 AI 활용의 윤리적 사용에 대한 구체적이고실질적인 가이드라인 마련이 시급히 요구되었다. 이 글은 생성형 AI 시대에 국내외 대학의 새로운 연구윤리 사례들을 검토하고, 대학 글쓰기 교육에 적용 가능한 실천적 생성형 AI 활용 가이드라인의 제언을 목적으로 한다. 2장에서는 미국의 연구윤리 교육(RCR)와 하버드 metaLAB의 ‘AI 행동 강령 제안’ 등 해외의 사례를 검토하였다. 하버드의 경우, 기존의 규정 중심 교육에서 벗어나 학문 공동체의 신뢰 회복을 중심에 두고 학습자 개인의 학문적 정직성과 책임감을 강조하는 패러다임의 전환을 보였으며, AI 탐지 도구의 사용을 지양해야 한다는 점에서 기존 RCR 교육과 차이를 보였다. 3장에서는 국내 주요 대학들의 생성형 AI 활용 가이드라인 제시 현황을 검토하였다. 국내 대학들은 AI 활용의 윤리적 책임성과 투명성 확보를 핵심 목표로 삼고 있으며, 교수자가 강의계획서 단계에서부터 AI 사용 범위와 절차를 명확히 규정하려는 제도적 관리 체계를 갖추고자 노력하고 있음을 확인하였다. 4장에서는 글쓰기 윤리 교육을 위한 생성형 AI 활용 가이드라인 제정을 위해 세 가지를 제안하였다. 첫째, 글쓰기 윤리 교육은 교육 효과의 지속성을 위해 사례를 기반으로 한 토론식으로 개발·운영되어야 한다. 둘째, 강의계획서 등을 통해 생성형 AI 활용 범위를 구체적으로 명시해야 하고, 교수자는 학습자가의 AI 활용에 반드시 구체적인 옵션을 제시해야 한다. 셋째, 글쓰기 종류와 수행 과정 단계에 대응하는 차등적이고 실천적인 가이드라인이 마련되어야 한다. 본 연구는 대학 글쓰기 교육이 생성형 AI 시대에 맞게 윤리적이고 비판적인 글쓰기역량을 강화할 방향을 제시하고, 교수자와 학습자에게 구체적인 지침을 제공한다는 점에 의의를 찾을 수 있다.
abstract_en: The widespread commercialization of generative AI has brought inevitable changes to university research and education. Existing research ethics norms inadequately address today's new circumstances, particularly in writing education, which centers on learners' growth processes. This study examines cases of research ethics in the generative AI era from universities internationally and domestically, proposing practical guidelines for university writing education. Chapter 2 reviews overseas guidelines, including the U.S. Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR) system and Harvard metaLAB's "Proposed Code of Conduct for AI." Harvard demonstrates a paradigm shift toward restoring academic community trust by emphasizing individual academic integrity and responsibility, while advocating against AI detection tools. Chapter 3 examines major domestic universities' generative AI guidelines. Korean universities prioritize ethical responsibility and transparency in AI use, developing institutional management systems whereby instructors clearly define AI use scope and procedures from the syllabus stage. Chapter 4 addresses limitations of existing research ethics education and proposes guidelines for writing ethics education as a fundamental alternative. The study emphasizes that strengthening research ethics requires transforming educational methods and expanding target audiences, particularly in writing courses where undergraduates encounter research ethics concepts. Three core measures are proposed: First, writing ethics education should be discussion-based using real cases and operated systematically through special lectures or workshops. Second, instructors must specify AI use scope in syllabi and provide learners with concrete options. Third, differentiated guidelines corresponding to writing types and process stages must be established.For example, prohibiting AI in self-reflective writing, while allowing restricted use in academic writing during data collection or revision but prohibiting it during core stages requiring independent thinking. These guidelines will guide learners to use generative AI instrumentally while performing core writing processes autonomously. Requiring transparent disclosure of AI usage and mandatory submission of self-assessment checklists can internalize responsible AI use and academic integrity. This study aimed to strengthen ethical and critical writing skills suitable for the era of generative AI, while providing specific guidelines for instructors and learners.

title_ko: 초등영어 수업에서 AI 기술 활용에 대한 교사의 인식
title_en: Teachers’ Cognition of AI Technology Use in Elementary English Classes
kw_ko: 초등영어 수업; AI 기술 활용; 교사의 인식과 인식변화; 교수 전문성
kw_en: elementary English classes; use of AI technology; teacher cognition; teaching expertise
abstract_ko: 교사의 인식은 인식 형성에 필요한 지식과 그러한 지식 적용에 대한 신념의 산물로서 교수 학습에 중요한 영향을 미칠 수 있다. 이 연구에서는 초등영어 수업에서 AI 기술 활용에 대한 교사의 인식에 초점을 두고, 인식과 인식의 원천, 지식이 신념에 미치는 영향, 전문 학습 경험을 통한 인식의 변화를 알아보았다. 이를 위해 초등영어 수업 전문성과 AI 기술 활용 전문성을 지식 수준과 지식 적용에 대한 신념으로 나누어 분석하였다. 연구 대상은 A교육대학교의 예비 교사와 AI 기술 활용 영어교육 연수에 참여한 현직 교사 70명이었으며, 설문 조사와 서술형 응답, 심층 인터뷰를 통해 교사의 인식에 관한 자료를 수집하였다. 연구 결과를 요약하면 다음과 같다. 첫째, 전문 학습 경험 전 교사의 지식 수준을 보면, 예비 교사는 AI 기술 활용 전문성에서, 현직 교사는 초등영어 수업 전문성에서 상대적으로 높은 수준을 보였다. 신념에서도 예비 교사는 AI 기술 활용에 대한 신념이 높은 반면, 현직 교사는 초등영어 수업 전문성은 높지만 AI 기술 활용에 대한 신념은 낮은 편이었다. 이러한 지식과 신념, 특히 AI 기술 활용 전문성과 관련된 인식은 대부분 개인 특유의 일반 학습 경험에 의해 형성된 것으로 나타났다. 둘째, 교사의 지식 수준은 신념 형성에 유의한 영향을 미쳤는데, 예비 교사와 현직 교사 모두 초등영어 수업 전문성보다 AI 기술 활용 전문성이 초등영어 수업에서 AI 기술 활용에 대한 교사의 신념과 더 밀접하게 연결되어 있었다. 셋째, 전문 학습 경험은 교사의 인식 변화를 촉진하였는데, 강의 중심 학습 경험은 제한적인 효과에 머문 반면, 수업 계획과 실행 중심 학습은 지식과 신념 전반을 강화하는데 핵심적인 역할을 하였다. 이러한 결과는 초등영어 수업에서 AI 기술 활용과 관련된 교사의 인식과 그에 기반한 교수 학습 현상을 심층적으로 이해하며, 나아가 미래 교육을 위한 교수 전문성 신장과 교육 혁신의 가능성을 탐구할 수 있는 중요한 정보를 제공할 것이다.
abstract_en: Teachers’ cognition, defined as the dynamic interplay between knowledge and beliefs about its application, plays a critical role in shaping teaching and learning. This study investigated teachers’ cognition of AI technology use in elementary English classes, with a focus on its sources, the influence of knowledge on belief formation, and changes resulting from professional learning. Teachers’ professional expertise was analyzed across two domains — elementary English teaching expertise and AI technology integration expertise — each examined in terms of knowledge and beliefs. Participants were 70 pre-service teachers and in-service teachers enrolled in a training program on AI-based English education. Data were collected through surveys, open-ended responses, and in-depth interviews. The findings indicated that, prior to professional learning, pre-service teachers demonstrated higher levels of AI integration expertise, whereas in-service teachers showed stronger English teaching expertise. With respect to beliefs, pre-service teachers expressed more positive views of AI use, while in-service teachers were more confident in English teaching but more cautious toward AI integration. Knowledge was found to significantly shape beliefs, with integrated knowledge domains (e.g., AI-TPACK) exhibiting the strongest associations. Professional learning, particularly lesson planning and teaching practice, proved essential in enhancing both knowledge and beliefs, exceeding the limited impact of lecture-based learning. These results highlight the importance of practice-based professional learning in strengthening teacher expertise and advancing AI-driven educational innovation.

title_ko: Investigating Korean College EFL Learners’ Perceptions and Intentions toward AI-Enabled Language Learning Applications
title_en: Investigating Korean College EFL Learners’ Perceptions and Intentions toward AI-Enabled Language Learning Applications
authors: 박문영(제주대학교); Chai Ching Sing(Chinese University of Hong Kong); Zheng Chunping(Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications)
kw_en: AI; language learning; self-directed learning; behavioral intention; Korean EFL learners; mixed methods; technology acceptance model
abstract_ko: This mixed-methods study investigated Korean college EFL learners’ perceptions and behavioral intentions toward AI-enabled language learning applications. A survey based on the Technology Acceptance Model and Theory of Planned Behavior was administered to 196 Korean university students, with model validation using 370 Chinese students. Structural equation modeling revealed a six-factor model with Perceived Usefulness, Attitude toward AI Use, and Subjective Norm significantly predicting behavioral intention, explaining 68% of the variance. The analysis confirmed the importance of social factors and positive attitudes in AI adoption decisions. Qualitative findings revealed a significant attitude-behavior gap. While students expressed favorable views toward AI language tools, their usage focused on basic functions: translation (60.3%) and grammar checking (20.6%), with limited engagement in advanced AI platforms (17.5%). Participants expressed high expectations for real-time feedback, pronunciation support, and personalized guidance. Results suggest Korean EFL learners possess positive attitudes toward AI-enhanced language learning but demonstrate limited utilization of sophisticated AI capabilities. The study highlights the need for targeted interventions to bridge the gap between current basic usage and AI’s pedagogical potential, emphasizing the importance of practical training and social support in promoting comprehensive AI adoption in Korean educational contexts.

title_ko: AI-Supported Language Learning for Developing English Listening and Speaking Skills and ChatGPT Literacy
title_en: AI-Supported Language Learning for Developing English Listening and Speaking Skills and ChatGPT Literacy
kw_en: Generative AI; ChatGPT; speaking; listening; ChatGPT literacy; perception
abstract_ko: This study explored the impact of AI-supported instruction on the development of English communicative skills and ChatGPT literacy among Korean university students in an EFL context. In the spring semester of 2024, the experiment was conducted with students enrolled in a college English course and lasted for one semester. Participants were divided into a control group (N = 25), who practiced speaking through face-toface conversations, and an experimental group (N = 26), who engaged in practice using ChatGPT. Data were collected through pre- and post-tests in speaking and listening, as well as surveys assessing ChatGPT literacy. While both groups showed significant within-group improvement in speaking and listening skills, no statistically significant differences between them. However, learners in the ChatGPT group demonstrated notably higher gains in speaking performance. The experimental group showed growth across five domains of ChatGPT literacy: technical proficiency, critical evaluation, communication proficiency, creative application, and ethical competence. Learners reported overall positive experiences, citing improved speaking skill, increased confidence, convenience, and engagement, while also noting limitations such as technical issues and occasional inaccuracies. These findings offer deeper insights into AI-integrated language instruction and highlight the importance of prompt literacy and pedagogical support in fostering autonomous learning in digital contexts.

title_ko: 자동채점 기반 영어 말하기 성적 보고서에 대한 학습자와 교사의 이해도 및 인식 탐색
title_en: An exploratory study on the development of an online score report for automated English speaking assessment
kw_en: score reporting; understanding; perception; automated speaking assessment; secondary school
abstract_ko: Score reporting plays an important role in supporting the validity of interpretations and uses of assessment results; however, it remains an underexplored topic particularly in domestic research contexts. This exploratory study examines how two user groups-students and teachers-understood and perceived a score report designed for an automated speaking assessment (ASA) system currently under development for Korean public education. A total of 224 Korean secondary school students completed an online survey measuring their understanding and perceptions. Five English teachers participated in online semi-structured interviews. Descriptive statistics, as well as group-independence chi-square and Mann-Whitney U tests, on the survey responses showed that the students overall held low levels of understanding but positive perceptions with no significant differences between school levels and negligible effect sizes. A thematic analysis of the interview transcripts revealed that teachers appreciated individualized feedback on the analytic aspects of speaking performance presented through visual graphs. However, they expressed concerns that the written prose feedback was too general and some terminology lacked specificity for students, providing recommendations for improvement. These findings have implications for the development of a user-friendly score report that enhances the validity of assessment interpretations and uses.

title_ko: ChatGPT 활용 수업이 고등학생들의영어 읽기 성취도와 영어 학습에 대한 인식에 미치는 영향
title_en: The effects of ChatGPT-assisted class on high school students’ English reading achievement and their perceptions toward English learning
kw_ko: 영어 읽기; 영어 학습; 고등학교 영어
kw_en: ChatGPT; English Reading; English Learning; High School English
abstract_ko: This study explored the impact of ChatGPT-assisted English instruction on high school students’ reading achievement and their perceptions of English learning. Fifty-six first-year high school students from two classes participated in the study over five weeks (20 class sessions) during one semester. Working in small groups, students collaboratively generated, shared, and reviewed ChatGPT-based questions related to reading comprehension, vocabulary, and grammar, providing explanations and peer feedback. Results from a paired-samples t-test indicated a statistically significant decrease in students’ English reading achievement after the intervention. Further analysis by proficiency level revealed that both high- and mid-level students showed significant declines, while low-level students exhibited no change. In contrast, analyses of pre- and post-survey data on students’ perceptions demonstrated a statistically significant increase in interest and confidence toward both English learning and reading, with the effect being particularly notable among mid-level learners. Post-study reflections suggested that students generally perceived the ChatGPT-integrated learning activities positively, although some reported technical challenges. These findings warrant further investigation into the cognitive and affective outcomes of integrating ChatGPT into English language instruction.

title_ko: 인공지능 기반 한글 보조 학습 도구의 활용이 초등학생의 쓰기 능력에 미치는 영향
title_en: Impact of AI-Based Korean Writing Assistants on Elementary Students' Writing Skills
kw_en: AI tool users; AI-based writing assistants; AI enhances technical accuracy
abstract_ko: This study investigates the efficacy of AI-based writing assistants in improving Korean writing skills among elementary students. Using a quasi-experimental design, 100 students were divided into experimental (AI tool users) and control groups (traditional methods). Over eight weeks, the AI group utilized Hangul Tutor, an adaptive platform providing real-time grammar checks, sentence restructuring suggestions, and gamified feedback. Post-tests revealed a 28% improvement in the AI group versus 12% in the control, with significant gains in structural coherence (p < 0.05). However, 15% of AI users exhibited reduced creativity, relying on automated corrections rather than original ideas. Results suggest AI enhances technical accuracy but requires balanced integration with teacher-led creative activities.
note: AI 한글 쓰기보조도구 초등 준실험; 학술대회

title_ko: 인공지능 챗봇의 영어학습 적용사례
title_en: Application of AI Chatbots in English Language Learning: A Mixed-Methods Study
kw_en: AI chatbots; English language proficiency; human mentorship
abstract_ko: This study investigates the efficacy of AI chatbots in enhancing English language proficiency, focusing on their role in vocabulary acquisition, grammar practice, and conversational fluency. A quasi-experimental design compared 120 learners using AI chatbots (Duolingo Max, Babbel) to a control group engaging in traditional classroom instruction. Over six weeks, chatbot users demonstrated a 22% improvement in vocabulary retention and a 15% gain in grammatical accuracy, with significant increases in confidence during spoken interactions (p < 0.05). However, 20% of participants reported reduced motivation due to the absence of human interaction. Qualitative feedback highlighted chatbots’ utility for self-paced learning but criticized their inability to contextualize cultural nuances. The findings advocate for AI chatbots as supplementary tools, emphasizing blended learning models to balance technological efficiency with human mentorship.
note: AI 챗봇 어휘·문법·회화 준실험; 학술대회

title_ko: The Impact of the AI-based Immersive Reader on Korean High School Students’ English Reading Comprehension and Perceptions
title_en: The Impact of the AI-based Immersive Reader on Korean High School Students’ English Reading Comprehension and Perceptions
kw_ko: 몰입형리더; 인공지능; 영어; 독해력; 인식; 고등학교 영어
kw_en: Immersive Reader; artificial; intelligence; English reading; comprehension; perception; high school English
abstract_ko: This study examined the impact of the AI-based Immersive Reader on Korean high school students’ English reading comprehension and their perceptions. Over eight weeks, the experimental group (n = 21) used Immersive Reader to read L2 texts, while the control group (n = 19) participated in traditional reading instruction. Data from preand post-tests, as well as surveys, were analyzed quantitatively. The findings reveal several key points: First, the experimental group demonstrated a statistically significant improvement in reading comprehension. Second, this enhancement was particularly evident among intermediate-proficiency students, who showed the most substantial gains. Third, survey results indicated that using Immersive Reader led to more positive attitudes toward English learning and reading, boosting students’ interest, confidence, and motivation while decreasing anxiety. Overall, these results suggest that Immersive Reader is an effective AI-based tool for enhancing both cognitive and affective aspects of L2 learning. The study underscores the potential of incorporating Immersive Reader into English education to foster self-directed learning.

title_ko: 고등학생들의 영어 학습 도구로서의 ChatGPT 활용 현황 및 인식 연구
title_en: A Study on Korean High School Students' Perceptions and Usage of ChatGPT as an English Learning Tool
kw_ko: 영어학습; 영어교육; 인공지능; 챗지피티; 학습자인식
kw_en: English Learning; English Education; Artificial Intelligence; ChatGPT; Learner Perception.
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 고등학생의 영어 학습에 대화형 인공지능 채팅 서비스인 챗지피티가 활용될 수 있는 가능성 을 탐색하고자 수행됐다. 최근 인공지능 활용 영어 교육에 대한 관심이 높아지고 있으나, 중등교육에서의 연구 들은 아직 부족한 실정이다. 이에 따라 본 연구는 고등학생들의 영어 학습에서 챗지피티의 활용 현황과 인식 수준, 영어 학습 동기 및 디지털 기기 사용 여부에 따른 인식 차이, 챗지피티 활용 영어수업 전후 인식 변화 분석을 수행했다. 연구를 위해 고등학생 197명을 대상으로 설문지를 통해 자료를 수집했다. 그 결과 첫째, 챗지 피티 활용 영어 학습을 경험한 학생들은 49.746%로 나타났다. 둘째, 챗지피티 활용 영어 학습에 대한 인식은 ‘관심 및 태도’, ‘영향력’, ‘유용성’ 순으로 긍정적으로 나타났다. 셋째, 영어 학습 내재적 동기와 외재적 동기 모두 ‘관심 및 태도’에 정적 영향을 미쳤지만, ‘유용성’과 ‘영향력’에서는 외재적 동기만이 정적 영향을 미쳤다. 디지털 기기 사용 여부에 따라 ‘관심 및 태도’ 영역에서만 유의미한 차이가 나타났다. 마지막으로, 챗지피티 활 용 영어 수업 전후 인식 비교를 통해 ‘유용성’과 ‘영향력’의 인식이 유의미하게 향상됨을 확인했다. 결과적으로 챗지피티가 고등학생의 영어 학습에 긍정적으로 활용될 수 있으며, 효과적 활용을 위해 교사의 지도와 구조화 된 전략이 필요함을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study examined the potential of using ChatGPT, a conversational AI tool, in Korean high school English classes. A survey was conducted with 197 students to investigate usage patterns, perceptions, and differences in English learning motivation, digital device use, and changes in perceptions before and after ChatGPT-assisted lessons. Results showed that only 49.7% had previously used ChatGPT before this study for English learning. Overall perceptions were positive, especially in interest and attitude. Extrinsic motivation influenced usefulness and influence, while intrinsic motivation affected only interest and attitude. Digital device usage patterns also showed significant differences in perception. After participating in ChatGPT-assisted English lessons, students reported a significant increase in their perceptions of its usefulness and influence. These findings suggest the potential of ChatGPT in secondary English education, highlighting the need for guided and structured use.
note: 고교생 ChatGPT 영어학습 활용현황·인식

title_ko: ChatGPT 기반 교재 분석을 통한 중학교 1학년 영어 교과서의 핵심역량 실현 양상 비교 연구
title_en: A Comparative Study on the Realization of Core Competencies in Korean Middle School English Textbooks through ChatGPT-based Analysis
kw_ko: 영어교과서; 핵심역량; 의사소통능력; 창의적 사고능력; 협업능력
kw_en: ChatGPT; English textbook analysis; core competencies; communication; creativity; collaboration
abstract_ko: This study investigates how core competencies—communication, creativity, and collaboration—are realized in Korean middle school English textbooks through AI-assisted analysis using ChatGPT. While previous textbook studies have largely relied on qualitative coding and researcher interpretation, this study addresses the methodological limitation by applying large-scale semantic network analysis. The data consist of two representative units selected from first-grade middle school English textbooks (2023–2025 editions) published by YBM, Chunjae, and Visang. ChatGPT was employed to conduct semantic similarity-based classification of unit objectives, tasks, dialogues, and project activities according to the behavioral indicators of the 2022 Revised English Curriculum. Human verification was applied at the final coding stage, and Voyant Tools and AntConc were used for cross-validation. The results indicate that all three textbooks predominantly emphasize communication, while creativity is most salient in project-based tasks and collaboration in group-based activities and role plays. Publisher-level differences were also observed, with Visang showing the highest proportion of creativity-oriented tasks and Chunjae emphasizing collaboration more strongly. The findings demonstrate the effectiveness of AI-assisted textbook analysis in reducing subjectivity and enhancing reproducibility. Despite the limited unit sample, this study provides a methodological foundation for future large-scale AI-based EFL materials research.

title_ko: Exploring Korean University Students’ Perspectives on AI-Enhanced Project-Based Learning (PBL) in EFL Reading Classrooms
title_en: Exploring Korean University Students’ Perspectives on AI-Enhanced Project-Based Learning (PBL) in EFL Reading Classrooms
kw_ko: 프로젝트 기반 학습(PBL); AI기반 PBL; 학습자 인식
kw_en: artificial intelligence (AI); project-based learning (PBL); English as a foreign language (EFL); ChatGPT; AI-enhanced PBL; students’ perspectives; AI; EFL
abstract_ko: This study examined Korean university EFL students’ perspectives on project-based learning (PBL) using AI tools in reading classes. Eighty students from two general English classes participated in a book-making project as a type of PBL, using ChatGPT as a language supporting tool. All participants completed a perception questionnaire after the project. Quantitative data were gathered through closed-ended questionnaires while qualitative data were collected through open-ended items. The research findings revealed that most students considered the reading project with ChatGPT beneficial for improving their English language skills, such as grammar, writing, speaking, and reading. Moreover, using AI for the project reduced anxiety and stress while increasing confidence. The results suggest that AI-enhanced PBL effectively integrates linguistic, cognitive, and affective dimensions of EFL learning, enabling students to engage in meaningful, personalized, and stress-free English practice. However, some students were concerned about overreliance on AI tools and the reliability of the information obtained from them. abstract_ko: This qualitative study explores how fifth-grade elementary school students experience AI-based feedback in English writing. Two students participated in writing activities and received feedback from ChatGPT. Data were collected from observation logs, drafts, reflection journals, and interviews over several weeks. The analysis focused on participants’ perceptions, cognitive/meta-cognitive and affective responses, and the impact of feedback on revision. Results indicate AI-based feedback is helpful, clear, and supports self-directed learning, increasing motivation and confidence. Effective classroom use requires instructional sequences integrating AI feedback with teacher facilitation, including drafting, feedback reception, revision, and reflection stages. Teacher training should prepare educators to manage AI tools effectively and foster students’ self-regulation. Teacher-led research and collaboration can enhance AI feedback integration, ensuring meaningful learning experiences for young EFL learners. These findings provide foundational insights for developing personalized feedback systems and instructional models combining technological innovation and pedagogy, supporting young learners’ growth as confident and autonomous writers.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 기반 일본어 예문 생성의 품질 검토─ 제약 수준별 프롬프트와 교수자의 역할 ─
title_en: Evaluating the Quality of Japanese Example Sentences Generated by Generative AI: The Impact of Prompt Constraints and Instructor Involvement
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 프롬프트 엔지니어링; 일본어 문법 교육; 교육 데이터 설계
kw_en: ChatGPT; generative AI; prompt engineering; Japanese grammar education; educational data design
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 일본어 문법 항목 ‘〜てしまう’를 대상으로, 프롬프트 제약 수준(L0-L5)에 따라 생성형 AI(GPT-5)가 산출하는 예문의 교육적 품질이 어떻게 변화하는지를 정량, 정성적으로 분석하였다. 제약 충실도(CSR), 다양성(VUC), 중복률(DUP), 교육적 제어 지수(ECI)를 활용한 정량 분석 결과, 제약의 단순한 강화가 품질 향상으로 직결되지 않으며, 의미 기능의 균형을 명시한 중간 수준(L3)에서 형식적 안정성과 의미적 다양성이 가장 조화롭게 나타났다. 정성 분석에서는 AI가 문법적으로는 정확하나 안전 주제에 편중되는 경향을 보였으며, 일부 번역의 어색함과 표현 중복이 관찰되었다. 또한 gloss, 품사 태깅, 출력 형식 지정 등의 기능은 교수자의 자료 제작 부담을 줄이는 실질적 보조 도구로서 유용함이 확인되었다. 이러한 결과는 생성형 AI가 문법적 정합성과 생산성면에서는 높은 수준에 도달했지만, 의미, 맥락, 표현의 관점에서는 여전히 교수자의 설계와 검증이 필수적임을 보여준다. 결국 AI는 교사의 역할을 대체하는 존재가 아니라, 교수자의 프롬프트 설계 역량과 결합될 때 교육적 잠재력을 실현하는 협력적 파트너로 기능할 수 있음을 제시하였다.
abstract_en: This study examines the quality of Japanese example sentences generated by GPT-5 under varying levels of prompt constraint, focusing on the grammar pattern “〜てしまう.” Quantitative indices (CSR, VUC, DUP, ECI) and qualitative analysis showed that moderate constraints achieved the best balance between grammatical accuracy and semantic variety, whereas excessive restrictions reduced contextual diversity. The AI frequently produced safe and repetitive topics, indicating limitations in creative variation. These findings suggest that pedagogical quality depends more on the instructor’s strategic prompt design than on the sheer number of constraints, positioning AI as a supportive tool for developing educational materials.

title_ko: 영어 쓰기에서 AI 기반과 다중모드 피드백의 통합적 고찰: 새로운 피드백 패러다임과 교육적 시사점
title_en: An Integrative Review of AI-Based and Multimodal Feedback: Exploring a New Feedback Paradigm and Pedagogical Implications in English Writing Education
kw_ko: AI 기반 피드백; 다중모드 피드백; 하이브리드 피드백 모형; 피드백 리터러시; 영어 쓰기 교육
kw_en: AI-based feedback; multimodal feedback; hybrid feedback model; feedback literacy; English writing education
abstract_ko: This study reviews domestic and international research on AI-based and multimodal feedback in English writing education, focusing on their key characteristics, learning effects, and pedagogical value. It explores how these feedback types help overcome the limitations of traditional feedback, such as time demands and lack of immediacy, while complementing each other to promote learner engagement. AI-based feedback, powered by natural language processing and machine learning, offers immediate, personalized, and repeatable responses that promote grammatical accuracy, language awareness, and self-regulated revision. Multimodal feedback, provided through audio, video, or screencast, combines verbal and visual cues to clarify meaning, increase motivation, and foster a stronger sense of connection between teachers and students. Integrating these two types of feedback can create a balanced feedback ecology that supports both cognitive precision and emotional engagement. Ultimately, their success depends on feedback literacy, the capacity of teachers and learners to interpret and apply feedback critically. By reframing feedback as an interactive and learner-centered process of reflection and knowledge construction rather than a corrective act, this study highlights the pedagogical importance of cultivating feedback literacy. It also calls for further research on hybrid feedback practices considering learner factors such as self-efficacy and digital competence across diverse contexts.

title_en: A Study on the Characteristics of Interaction in Metaverse Classes: Focusing on a Comparison with Face-to-Face Instruction
kw_en: Metaverse; Interaction; Avatar; Space; Compulsiveness; メタバース; インタラクション; アバター; 空間; 強制性
abstract_ko: 本研究は、Gather Town 授業を対面授業と比較した学習者の意見を分析し、相互作用の様相における差異を明らかにするとともに、教授․学習設計上の示唆を導き出した。Gather Town では、仮想空間という特性により学習に適した空間を提供することが可能であり、対面授業では容易ではない模擬体験を実現することができた。また、このように提供された空間を移動する経験は、学習活動への興味を高め、適切な強制性を与え、学習者の能動的な参加を促すことが明らかになった。対面授業と比較を通じ、このような｢空間構成の柔軟性｣がメタバース授業の第一の長所として浮彫りになった。 なお、アバターの活動は、より親密な相互作用を求める学習者には人見知りを和らげ、心理的距離を縮める効果をもたらし、対面状況における相互作用に負担を感じる学習者には、適切な距離感を確保することで安心感を与えることが示された。対面授業と比較を通じ、このような｢アバター媒介の相互作用｣がメタバース授業の第二の長所として浮彫りになった。 一方、Gather Town では、手書き文字を見せたり、微妙な表情や身振りなどの非言語的手がかりをキャッチしにくく、インターネット接続の問題や音声遅延といった技術的制約があることも確認された。また、メタバースを用いた授業はリアルタイム型のオンライン授業であるものの、Zoomなどの会議用プラットフォームを用いた授業よりも相互作用が多く生じるため、マイクを使用し、音声による発話が可能な場所を確保する必要があることを、事前に十分周知する必要があることも明らかとなった。 本研究を通して、第一に、対面状況とは異なる空間的特性を考慮した相互作用設計の必要性、第二に、学習者は適切な強制性のもとで、より安定的に授業および学習活動に集中できるということ、第三に、教室内には関係性や相互作用に対する態度の異なる学習者が共存しているため、それらを考慮した教授․学習設計が求められるということを、相互作用促進の観点から教授者が考慮すべき教育的示唆として導出した。
abstract_en: This study analyzed learners’ perceptions of Gather Town classes in comparison with face-to-face instruction to identify differences in interaction patterns and to derive pedagogical implications for instructional design. The findings indicate that the characteristics of virtual environments enabled the provision of learning-appropriate spaces and simulated experiences that are difficult to implement in face-to-face classes. In particular, the flexibility of spatial configuration allowed instructors to design diverse learning activities, while learners’ movement within these spaces increased interest and promoted active participation through an appropriate level of constraint. This feature emerged as a key advantage of metaverse-based classes. In addition, avatar-mediated interaction played an important role in shaping learners’ experiences. For learners seeking closer peer interaction, avatar use reduced feelings of shyness and narrowed psychological distance, whereas for those who felt burdened by face-to-face interaction, it provided a comfortable sense of distance. However, several limitations were also identified, including difficulties in conveying handwritten content and subtle nonverbal cues, as well as technical issues such as internet instability and audio latency. Moreover, because metaverse-based classes involve higher levels of interaction than conventional video-conferencing classes, learners need to be informed in advance of the requirement to participate through voice communication in an appropriate environment. Overall, the findings underscore the importance of interaction design that reflects the unique spatial characteristics of metaverse-based learning environments and accommodates diverse learner preferences.
