title_ko: Comparing ChatGPT 4o and Gemini 2.5 Pro in ESP Speaking Assessment
title_en: Comparing ChatGPT 4o and Gemini 2.5 Pro in ESP Speaking Assessment
kw_en: ChatGPT; Gemini; Word Error Rate; English for specific purpose; Speaking
abstract_ko: As English continues to function as a global lingua franca, achieving a single native-like pronunciation standard has become increasingly unrealistic. Since most English interactions now occur between non-native speakers, communicative effectiveness and mutual intelligibility are more essential than phonetic accuracy. This research investigates how large language models (LLMs) can support meaning-centered speaking assessment in global English and ESP contexts. Three hypotheses were tested: (1) ChatGPT 4o delivers significantly lower Word Error Rate (WER) than Gemini 2.5 Pro in transcribing non-native speech; (2) learners perceive a meaning-centered evaluation form as more valuable than a pronunciation-centered one; and (3) learners rate ChatGPT 4o’s feedback as clearer and more helpful. Twenty adult L2 learners, working professionals from diverse industries in Korea, participated to improve workplace communication and real-life fluency. Results revealed a substantial difference in transcription accuracy, with ChatGPT 4o achieving a 4.19% WER compared to Gemini 2.5 Pro’s 34.49%. Even though the study found no significant difference between meaning-centered and pronunciation-centered evaluation forms, the results demonstrate the potential of AI-driven speaking assessment to enhance clarity, accessibility, and communicative effectiveness for adult learners in both general and ESP contexts.

title_ko: AI·동료·교수자의 단계적 피드백이 대학생의 글쓰기 수행에 미치는 효과
title_en: Effects of Sequential Feedback from AI, Peers, and Instructors on College Students’ Writing Performance
kw_ko: 대학 글쓰기; 단계적 피드백; AI 피드백; 동료 피드백; 교수자 피드백; 피드백 수용
kw_en: College writing; stepwise feedback; AI feedback; peer feedback; instructor feedback; feedback uptake
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 AI·동료·교수자가 역할을 분담한 단계적 피드백 방안을 제안하고, 이를 대학 글쓰기 교육 현장에 적용하여 그 효과를 탐색했다. 세 주체의 피드백을 상호 보완적으로 활용하기 위해 ⑴ AI는 글의 구조와 표현을포함하는 형태적 측면에, ⑵ 동료는 독자 반응의 일환으로 내용적 측면에, ⑶ 교수자는 형태와 내용을 아우르는 심층 통합적 측면에 집중하여 순차적으로피드백을 제공하고, 학습자가 이를 비판적으로 점검하며 세 차례의 논증문수정을 수행하게 했다. 그리고 주체별 피드백에 대한 학습자의 반응과 단계별 글의 질 변화 양상을 고찰했다. 연구 결과, 학습자들은 전반적으로 높은 수준으로 피드백을 수용했고, 단계별 글의 질 또한 유의미하게 개선되었다. AI 피드백 단계에서는 글의 외형이 정비되어 형태적 완성도가 높아진 후, 이 효과가 이후 단계에서도 안정적으로 유지되었다. 동료 피드백 단계에서는 다양한 독자 반응을 비판적으로 해석하는 학습자의 저자성이 부각되었고, 교수자 피드백 단계에서는 앞단계의 한계를 보완하는 통합적 질 제고가 이루어졌다. 또한 세 피드백은 각기 다른 양상으로 학습자의 자기 수정을 유도하는 촉매로 작용했다. 이러한결과는 단계적 피드백 방안이 학습자의 인지적 부담을 완화하여 초점화된수정을 유도하고, 나아가 비판적 수용과 저자성 발달을 함께 촉진할 수 있음을 보여준다.
abstract_en: This study proposes a stepwise feedback model involving AI, peers, and instructors, each with a distinct role, and examines its effects in a college writing context. AI addressed structural and linguistic forms; peers contributed content-level reader responses; and instructors provided integrated feedback that combined both aspects. Students revised their argumentative essays three times while actively engaging with each feedback source. The findings indicate high feedback uptake and significant writing improvement at each stage. AI feedback improved formal accuracy with sustained effects, peer feedback enhanced authorial agency through critical reader interpretation, and instructor feedback was consolidated and refined before revisions. Each feedback type uniquely fostered self-revision, suggesting that the model reduces cognitive load, supports focused revisions, and promotes both critical reception and authorial voice.

title_ko: 멀티모달 AI 기반 수업 설계가 영어 교수자의 효능감 및 효율성에 미치는 영향
title_en: The impact of multimodal AI-based lesson design on English teacher efficacy and efficiency
kw_ko: 멀티모달 AI; 교수 효능감; 교수 효율성; 영어 교육
kw_en: Multimodal AI; Teacher Self-Efficacy; Teaching Efficiency; English Education
abstract_ko: This study explores the impact of multimodal Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools on English as a Foreign Language (EFL) teacher efficacy and efficiency perceptions and identifies preferred tools for lesson design. Grounded in the rapidly evolving landscape of AI in education, the research investigates how AI training influences EFL teachers' beliefs in their ability to effectively integrate AI into instruction and their views on the potential of AI to streamline and enhance language learning. This was conducted using a pretest-posttest design with 126 college students and graduate students in the Department of English. Through pre- and post-AI workshop surveys, teacher efficacy (pre: M = 2.76, post: M = 3.67, t = -5.03, p < .001) and efficiency perceptions (pre: M = 3.80, post: M = 4.43, t = -5.05, p < .001) both significantly improved. Furthermore, regression analysis identified that 57% (R² = .57) of variance in efficiency can be explained by teacher self-efficacy and a strong positive correlation between efficacy beliefs and efficiency expectations (β = .76, p < .001). Results revealed that music generation AI was identified as the most useful tool (81%). Therefore, this study highlights the potential of generative AI, particularly music generation AI, and emphasizes the importance of training for promoting positive teacher perceptions and the innovative application of this cutting-edge technology. Future studies should explore effective strategies to maximize the benefits of AI in education.

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능을 활용한 사고와 표현 교과의 다문서 읽기 교수학습 모델 제안
title_en: Proposal for a Multi-Document Reading Instructional Model in the Thinking and Expression Course Using Generative Artificial Intelligence
kw_ko: 다문서 읽기; 생성형 인공지능; 교차검증; K-컬쳐; 디지털 리터러시
kw_en: Multi-Document Reading; Generative Artificial Intelligence; Cross-Verification; K-Culture; Digital Literacy
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 생성형 인공지능 등장 이후, 사고와 표현 읽기 교과목의 읽기 교수학습 모델의 방향성을 ‘다문서 읽기’로 설정하고 인공지능을 활용해 디지털 리터러시 능력을 함양하는 교수학습 모델을 모색하였다. 다문서 읽기는 2개 이상의이질적인 텍스트를 상호 참조하고 관련 자료의 출처를 교차검증하며 저자의 관점과 상황맥락을 찾는 능동적이고 비판적인 읽기 훈련을 기반으로 한다. 이 연구는대학 학습자들이 흥미를 갖는 K-컬쳐 관련 예문을 선정하고 인공지능을 활용하였다. 학습자들은 저자의 입장과 주제어를 찾으며, 자료 교차검증으로 책임감 있는자료 탐색훈련을 하였다. 예측에 기반한 모델인 만큼 다문서 읽기 실행 모형의연속성, 읽기 자료의 풍부함 등을 추가적으로 모색할 필요가 있다.
abstract_en: This study proposes a teaching and learning model for the university course Thinking and Expression through Reading in the era of generative artificial intelligence (AI). The model focuses on multi-document reading to foster students’ digital literacy through the effective use of AI. Multi-document reading involves cross-referencing heterogeneous texts, verifying information sources, and identifying the authors’ perspectives within contextual frameworks. Using K-culture–related texts that engage university learners, the study integrates AI tools to help students identify key concepts and develop responsible information-searching skills through cross-verification. As a predictive model, further research is needed to ensure the continuity of the multi-document reading framework and to expand the diversity of learning materials.

title_ko: Patterns of ChatGPT Engagement and Argumentative Writing Development
title_en: Patterns of ChatGPT Engagement and Argumentative Writing Development
kw_ko: 인공지능; 챗GPT; 논증적 글쓰기; 쓰기 교육; 혼합 연구
kw_en: Artificial intelligence; ChatGPT; argumentative writing; writing instruction; mixed-methods research
abstract_ko: This study explored how first-year university students used ChatGPT during a semester-long academic writing course on argumentative writing. One hundred and twenty-four students enrolled in a required freshman writing course at a Korean university received explicit instruction in Toulmin-based argumentation and wrote argumentative essays. ChatGPT use for writing was measured across six subscales (surface revision, content elaboration, organization/coherence, metacognitive use, dependence, and collaborative refinement). Analytic rubric scores showed modest overall gains, with particularly strong improvements in evidence and counterarguments. The findings highlight that the quality, rather than mere presence, of AI use matters in strengthening the quality of argumentative writing.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 대학 영문법 수업에서 학습동기 변화와 학습자 인식 탐색
title_en: Exploring Changes in Learning Motivation and Learner Perceptions in a ChatGPT-Based University Grammar Class
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 생성형 인공지능; 영문법수업; 학습동기; 내재적동기
kw_en: ChatGPT; generative AI; English grammar instruction; learning motivation; intrinsic motivation
abstract_ko: This study examined changes in university students’ learning motivation in a ChatGPT-integrated English grammar course that provided interactive feedback, individualized explanations, and learner-led practice tasks through generative AI. Thirty-five Korean university students at the beginner level (approximately a 400 TOEIC score) participated in a 15-week grammar course. The study collected quantitative and qualitative data using pre- and post-motivation surveys that included open-ended items. The results showed significant improvement in intrinsic motivation and ideal L2 self, while extrinsic motivation and ought-to L2 self remained relatively unchanged. Qualitative findings revealed that learners perceived grammar learning as less burdensome and more engaging, reporting increased confidence and autonomy. Some students suggested clearer guidance for prompt writing, more reliable evaluation of AI responses, and the inclusion of gamified activities to enhance engagement. Overall, ChatGPT served as both an affective and pedagogical facilitator, enabling learners to experience grammar learning as more interactive and learner-centered. The study suggests that AI-integrated grammar instruction may support positive changes in learners’ affective experiences with grammar, potentially offering a meaningful complement to traditional rule-based instruction.
abstract_en: This study examined changes in university students’ learning motivation in a ChatGPT-integrated English grammar course that provided interactive feedback, individualized explanations, and learner-led practice tasks through generative AI. Thirty-five Korean university students at the beginner level (approximately a 400 TOEIC score) participated in a 15-week grammar course. The study collected quantitative and qualitative data using pre- and post-motivation surveys that included open-ended items. The results showed significant improvement in intrinsic motivation and ideal L2 self, while extrinsic motivation and ought-to L2 self remained relatively unchanged. Qualitative findings revealed that learners perceived grammar learning as less burdensome and more engaging, reporting increased confidence and autonomy. Some students suggested clearer guidance for prompt writing, more reliable evaluation of AI responses, and the inclusion of gamified activities to enhance engagement. Overall, ChatGPT served as both an affective and pedagogical facilitator, enabling learners to experience grammar learning as more interactive and learner-centered. The study suggests that AI-integrated grammar instruction may support positive changes in learners’ affective experiences with grammar, potentially offering a meaningful complement to traditional rule-based instruction.

title_ko: ChatGPT와 인간의 영어 글쓰기 피드백 비교 분석: 피드백 유형, 효과성, 학습자 인식을 중심으로
title_en: A Comparative Study of ChatGPT and Human Writing Feedback: Characteristics, Effectiveness, and Learner Preferences
kw_ko: 글쓰기 평가; 글쓰기 피드백; 챗지피티 피드백; 인간 피드백; 피드백 효과; 피드백 선호
kw_en: Writing evaluation; writing feedback; ChatGPT feedback; human feedback; feedback effectiveness; feedback preferences
abstract_ko: Writing feedback is a crucial component of writing assessment and can be provided by various agents, including teachers and AI tools. This study examined the characteristics and effectiveness of feedback from human experts and ChatGPT, as well as students’ preferences for each source. 28 first-year college students wrote a one-paragraph opinion essay and revised it twice based on feedback from a human rater and ChatGPT, respectively. Essays were evaluated using holistic and analytic rubrics, and feedback comments were coded by type (e.g., informative, directive, praise) and area (e.g., organization, content, language). Students also completed a questionnaire on their feedback preferences. Human feedback was more directive and focused on organization and content, whereas ChatGPT offered more informative comments on comprehensibility of the message and lexical choice. Consequently, there were greater holistic and analytic score gains for essays revised based on human feedback, while the impact of ChatGPT feedback was more limited. Meanwhile, students reported that lexical choice and language use were their greatest challenges but showed no clear preference between ChatGPT and human feedback. These findings suggest that the most effective feedback may be achieved by combining human feedback targeting higher-level features with ChatGPT feedback that focus on language use.

title_ko: 메타버스 기반 영문학 학습 콘텐츠 개발 연구: 설계 원리 도출 및 학습자 반응 분석
title_en: Development of Metaverse-based English Literature Learning Content: Deriving Design Principles and Analyzing Learner Responses
kw_ko: 메타버스; 영문학 교육; 설계 원리; 체화 학습; 게이미피케이션
kw_en: metaverse; English literature education; design principles; embodied learning; gamification
abstract_ko: This study develops metaverse-based English literature learning content by deriving theory-grounded design principles and evaluating their educational effectiveness through formative evaluation. Four principles were established: spatialization of narrative, sensory embodiment of psychology, visualization of symbolism, and integration of narrative with gameplay. These principles were applied to create Minecraft-based environments for Edgar Allan Poe’s The Tell-Tale Heart and Katherine Mansfield’s The Garden Party. Formative evaluation with five English literature majors revealed enhanced immersion, psychological engagement, and symbolic interpretation. Post-reading metaverse experiences deepened comprehension while pre-reading experiences stimulated interest and motivation. As an exploratory study, this research offers initial guidelines for metaverse-based literature education and suggests directions for further empirical validation.

title_ko: ChatGPT 기반 피드백을 활용한 영문입사지원서 (Cover Letter) 비교과 프로그램 효과 연구
title_en: The Effectiveness of an Extracurricular Program for English Cover Letter Writing with Integrated ChatGPT Feedback
kw_ko: 영문입사지원서; 챗지피티; 피드백; 비교과 프로그램; 글로벌 의사소통역량
kw_en: cover letter; ChatGPT; feedback; extracurricular program; global communication competence
abstract_ko: 본 연구는, ChatGPT 기반 피드백을 활용한 영문입사지원서 비교과 프로그램의 효과와 학습자만족도를 조사함으로써, 인공지능을 활용한 효과적인 영문입사지원서 비교과 수업 모델을 제시하고, 학생들의 글로벌 의사소통역량을 향상시키는 데 도움을 주고자 하였다. 본 프로그램에서, 학생들은 영문입사지원서 작성 방법에 대한 강의를 듣고, 강의 내용에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 학생들 스스로 본인의 영문입사지원서를 작성한 후, ChatGPT의 피드백을 받아 수정하여 완성하였다. 사전- 사후 영문입사지원서 작성과 사후 설문에 참여한 학생 35명의 자료가 분석되었다. 본 프로그램은학생들의 영문입사지원서 작성 능력에 유의하게 긍정적인 영향을 미쳤으며, 특히 (1) 경력의 구체적 서술, (2) 경력의 수치화, (3) 본인의 경력과 조직의 필요를 연결하여 본인이 적임자임을 설득하는 세 가지 항목에서 더욱 유의한 향상을 나타내었다. 또한, 학생들은 본 프로그램이 영문입사지원서 작성 능력과 자신감 향상에 도움이 되었다는 높은 만족도를 나타내었고, 이러한 결과는 본 비교과 프로그램이 효과적인 영문입사지원서 수업을 위한 하나의 바람직한 모델이 될 수 있음을 제안한다.
abstract_en: This study examined the effectiveness of an extracurricular program for English cover letter writing in which ChatGPT feedback was used to propose instructional models aimed at improving students’ global communication competence. In the program, students first attended a lecture on English cover letter writing, then drafted their own cover letters based on the lecture, and finally revised them after receiving ChatGPT’s feedback. Data from 35 students who submitted pre- and post-cover letters and completed a post-survey were analyzed. The results indicated that the program had a significant positive effect on students’ English cover letter writing proficiency, particularly in three areas: (1) describing work experiences in detail, (2) quantifying achievements, and (3) persuading employers of their suitability by connecting their experiences to employers’ needs. Furthermore, the students reported a high level of satisfaction, noting that the program was helpful in improving their English cover letter writing skills and their confidence. These results suggest that the extracurricular program could serve as an effective instructional model for English cover letter programs.
note: ChatGPT 피드백 영문 입사지원서 프로그램 사전사후 효과

title_ko: 딥러닝 기반 독일어 연어 표현의 분석과 확장 - 워드 임베딩과 마스크드 언어 모델을 활용하여
title_en: Deep-Learning-basierte Analyse und Erweiterung deutscher Kollokationen - Mithilfe von Worteinbettungen und maskierten Sprachmodellen
kw_ko: 연어; 다단어 표현; 독일어 어휘 교육; 워드 임베딩; 마스크드 언어 모델
kw_en: Kollokationen; Mehrworteinheiten; Vokabellernen; Worteinbettungen; Maskiertes Sprachmodell
abstract_ko: 연어는 단순한 단어의 병치가 아니라, 특정 단어들이 비정형적, 비대칭적으로 결합하는 경향성을 보이는언어학적 단위로서, 의미ㆍ통사적으로 긴밀하게 결속된다는 특징을 지닌다. 이러한 언어학적 특성은 자연스러운 의미 해석과 유창한 발화를 가능하게 하므로, 외국어 교육은 물론 언어 이해 및 생성 연구에서도핵심적인 분석 대상이 된다. 특히 외국어로서의 독일어 교육에서 어휘는 가장 기본적인 학습 요소이며, 학습자는 개별 단어가 아니라 실제 언어 사용에서 빈번하게 등장하는 다단어 표현을 습득함으로써 말하기와쓰기 등 실제 의사소통 능력을 효과적으로 향상시킬 수 있다. 이에 본 연구는 딥러닝과 같은 전산언어학적기법을 활용하여, 연속하는 두 단어로 이루어진 독일어 연어 표현을 추출, 분석, 확장하고자 하였다. 먼저마스크드 언어 모델을 이용하여 문맥 기반의 자연스러운 연어 표현을 추출하고자 하였다. 다음으로 워드임베딩과 벡터 연산을 활용하여 연어 표현의 조합적 특성과 문맥적 합성성을 분석하였다. 마지막으로, 마스크드 언어 모델을 기반으로 기존의 연어 표현을 구성하는 각 구성 요소 자리에 등장할 수 있는 표현을탐색하여 대체가능한 표현 또는 신규 연어 표현으로 확장하고자 하였다. 이를 통해 실제 독일어 사용과교육용 연어 목록 간의 간극을 좁히고 연어 사전 구축, 동의 표현 리스트 생성 등 교육적 활용 가능성을모색한다.
abstract_en: Kollokationen stellen linguistische Einheiten dar, bei denen bestimmte Wörter miteinander kombiniert werden und eine enge semantische sowie syntaktische Bindung aufweisen. Diese linguistischen Eigenschaften ermöglichen sowohl eine natürliche Bedeutungsinterpretation als auch eine flüssige Sprachproduktion. Daher sind Kollokationen ein zentraler Untersuchungsgegenstand in der Fremdsprachendidaktik. Insbesondere im Deutschunterricht als Fremdsprache bilden Wortschatz und mehrwortige Ausdrücke die grundlegenden Lerneinheiten. Lernende können durch den Erwerb solcher Kollokationen ihre kommunikativen Kompetenzen in Sprechen und Schreiben effektiv verbessern, statt einzelne Wörter isoliert zu lernen. Aus diesem Grund zielt die vorliegende Studie darauf ab, mithilfe computerlinguistischer Verfahren wie Deep- Learning-Methoden deutsche Kollokationen zu extrahieren, zu analysieren und zu erweitern. Zunächst wurden in dieser Studie zweigliedrige Kollokationen aus einem auf DaF-Texten basierenden deutschen Korpus mithilfe eines maskierten Sprachmodells (Masked Language Model, MLM) extrahiert. Dabei konnten unter anderem die Kollokationen ‘vor allem’, ‘bitten um’, ‘mich für’, ‘fühle ich’, ‘wie möglich’, ‘Damen und’, ‘finde es’, ‘ein paar’, ‘Problem haben’, ‘Wir treffen’ sowie ‘Du bist’ identifiziert werden. Durch den Vergleich der bidirektionalen Wahrscheinlichkeiten dieser Kollokationen wurde der asymmetrische Abhängigkeitsgrad zwischen den beiden konstituierenden Wörtern sowohl auf syntaktischer als auch auf semantischer Ebene analysiert. Zur weiteren Untersuchung wurden die extrahierten Kollokationen mithilfe von Clustering-Verfahren vertieft analysiert. Anschließend wurde eine auf distributioneller Semantik basierende computer linguistische Analyse der Kollokationen durchgeführt. Dabei wurden Worteinbettungen und Verfahren zur Berechnung von Vektorähnlichkeiten eingesetzt, um den Additive Compositionality Score (ACS) und den Inter-contextual Compositionality Score (ICS) der Kollokationen zu berechnen. Auf diese Weise konnte die semantische und inter kontextuelle Kompositionalität der Kollokationen untersucht werden. Abschließend wurde auf der Grundlage eines maskierten Sprachmodells untersucht, welche Ausdrücke an den jeweiligen Positionen der die Kollokationen konstituierenden Wörter auftreten können, um bestehende Kollokationen durch ersetzbare und neue Ausdrücke zu erweitern. Dies ermöglicht die automatische Generierung neuer Kollokationskandidaten, die in den bestehenden DaF-Lehrwerken nicht auftauchen. Auf diese Weise kann die Lücke zwischen tatsächlicher Sprachverwendung und pädago gisch genutzten Kollokationslisten geschlossen werden. Darüber hinaus eröffnen sich Potenziale für den Aufbau von Kollokationswörterbüchern und Listen synonymischer Ausdrücke.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 하이브리드 글쓰기의 방법론 연구: 키워드 추출 및 알고리즘 편향 방지를 위한 프롬프트를 중심으로
title_en: Methodologies of Hybrid Writing with ChatGPT : Prompt Engineering for Keyword Extraction and the Prevention of Algorithmic Bias
kw_ko: 프롬프트 엔지니어링; 독후감; 퀴어 소설; 세계문학; 모성; 공공성; 읽기/쓰기 교양
kw_en: book report; queer fiction; World literature; motherhood; publicness; reading/; writing literacy
abstract_ko: 본 논문에서는 2025년 연세대 학부대학･국어국문학과 대학원에서 개설되었던 <글쓰기> 및 <한국어로논문쓰기및발표하기> 수업을 바탕으로, ChatGPT를 활용한 키워드추출 사례를 제시하고 알고리즘 편향의 실제 및 이에 대응하기 위한 프롬프트 엔지니어링의 방법론을 제안했다. 본 논문은 ChatGPT를 활용한 하이브리드 글쓰기가 텍스트생산의 기술적 수단을 넘어, 인공지능-인간의 협업에 입각하여 새로운 윤리적 실천의가능성을 제시하는 매개체로 자리할 수 있음을 밝혔다. 특히 모성･이성애와 관련된 세계문학이나 퀴어 소설 독후감의 키워드 추출 사례를 통해 드러나는 알고리즘 편향은, 인공지능이 ‘중립성’의 명목하에 수행하는 비가시적 검열 구조를 인지하게 한다. 이는인공지능이 사회적 다수의 언어 규범을 내면화함으로써 주변화된 정체성을 ‘위험한 데이터’로 분류하거나, 윤리적 침묵의 형태로 소거하는 과정을 보여준다는 측면에서 주목할필요가 있다. 본 논문에서 제시한 프롬프트 엔지니어링은 이러한 문제에 대응하기 위한실천적 방안을 구체화한 것이다. 인공지능에게 스스로의 인식 기준을 설명･수정하게 하고, 사회적 다수의 규범 위주의 해석을 배제하며, “관찰되지 않는 특성(unobserved characteristics)”에 주목하도록 지시한 프롬프트는 인공지능의 해석 프레임을 윤리적으로 재구성하기 위한 시도이다. 이를 통해 학습자는 인공지능의 결과물을 수동적으로 소비하는 위치를 벗어나, 알고리즘의 규범적 전제를 비판적으로 교정하는 ‘주체적 참여자’로 자리매김할 수 있다. 이러한 윤리적 실천으로서의 하이브리드 글쓰기는 학문적 진실성과 타인의 고통에 대한 공감에 입각하여 “모든 존재를 위한 정의로운 디지털공동체”를 창출하고자 하는 AI 시대 읽기/쓰기 교양의 교육 목표와도 연관된다.
abstract_en: This study builds upon the undergraduate and graduate courses <Writing> and <Academic Writing and Presentation in Korean>, offered at Yonsei University in 2025, to present specific cases of keyword extraction using ChatGPT and to propose a prompt-engineering methodology designed to mitigate algorithmic bias. The paper argues that hybrid writing with ChatGPT functions not merely as a technical means of textual production, but as a mediating practice that opens up possibilities for new ethical collaboration between humans and artificial intelligence. Through case studies involving keyword extraction from world literature about motherhood･heterosexuality and queer fiction’s book reports, the research identifies forms of algorithmic bias that reveal the invisible mechanisms of censorship enacted under the guise of AI “neutrality.” Such bias occurs when AI internalizes the linguistic norms of social majorities, classifying marginalized identities as “risky data” or erasing them through forms of ethical silence. The prompt-engineering strategies proposed in this study serve as a practical response to these issues: by instructing AI to articulate and revise its own interpretive criteria, to exclude majority-norm-centered readings, and to attend to “unobserved characteristics,” the prompts aim to ethically reconfigure the interpretive frame of AI. Through this process, learners can move beyond passively consuming AI-generated outputs and become critical participants capable of correcting the normative assumptions embedded in algorithmic systems. As an ethical practice, hybrid writing thus aligns with the educational goal of fostering reading and writing literacy in the age of AI－ one grounded in scholarly integrity, empathy for others’ suffering, and the pursuit of a “just digital community for all beings.”

title_ko: 생성형 AI의 등장과 대학 글쓰기 교육의 재정향(再定向) : 사고 확장 도구로서의 생성형 AI와 사고의 변화⋅확장 경험으로서의 ‘생성형 AI를 활용한 대학 글쓰기’
title_en: The Emergence of Generative AI and Redirection of University Writing Education - Generative AI as a Tool for Expansion of Thought and ‘Writing with Generative AI’ as an Experience of Changing and Expanding Thought
kw_ko: 글쓰기; 대학 글쓰기; 글쓰기의 교육 목표; 글쓰기의 교육 방향; 생성형 AI; 생성형 AI의 특이성; 사고의 외부화; 사고 확장
kw_en: Writing; University Writing; Educational Goals of Writing; Educational Direction of Writing; Generative AI; Generative AI Specificity; Externalization of Thought; Expansion of Thought
abstract_ko: 본고에서는 생성형 AI를 활용한 대학 글쓰기의 교육 목표 및 바람직한 교육 방향을 모색하고자 하였다. 이를 위해 우선 생성형 AI의 특이성과 대학 글쓰기의 가치, 글쓰기와 생성형 AI의 접목 필요성 등을 살폈다. 생성형 AI는 사고의 외주화를 가능하게 하는 여러 기술 중 하나로, 인간의사고 능력 향상에 획기적 변화를 예고하고 있는 이 시대의 새로운 보편 기술이다. 또한 대학 글쓰기의 본질은 기능이 아닌 사고에 있으며, 그 목적은 학습자의 비판적⋅창의적 사고 능력 함양에있다. 이러한 맥락에서 볼 때 대학 글쓰기 교육에 있어 생성형 AI의 활용은 필수불가결함과 동시에 가치로운 일이기도 하다. 다만 생성형 AI의 특이성과 글쓰기의 본질적 목적을 고려할 때 생성형 AI 시대 대학 글쓰기 교육은 도구적 기술 활용 능력의 증진이 아니라 기술 변화를 통해 학습자들이 인간 사고의 변화와 확장을 경험하고 이러한 경험을 통해 사고력을 증진시킬 수 있는 방향으로 나아가야 한다. 대학에서 이루어지는 ‘생성형 AI를 활용한 글쓰기’는 학습자들에게 있어 단순히 생성형 AI의 ‘사용’ 경험이 아닌, 글쓰기에 있어 생성형 AI를 ‘활용’하는 경험이 되어야 한다. 이를 위해서는 보다 세심한 교육 환경 조성이 요구되며, 학습자의 추론 역량 수준에 따라 대학 글쓰기 교육을 이원적으로 구성하고, 각 단계에 따라 그 중점과 내용을 달리할 필요가 있다.
abstract_en: This paper aims to review the educational goals of university writing in relation to Generative AI and explore desirable educational directions. To this end, the specificity of Generative AI, the value of university writing, and the necessity of combining writing and Generative AI were examined. Generative AI is one of the many technologies that enable the outsourcing of thinking, and is a new universal technology that will bring about drastic changes in improving human thought ability. The essence of university writing lies in thought, and its purpose is to cultivate learners’ critical and creative thought. In this context, the use of Generative AI in university writing education is essential. However, university writing in the Generative AI era should not improve the ability to use instrumental skills. Still, it should move in a direction that allows learners to experience changes and the expansion of human thought, thereby strengthening their thinking skills through these experiences. “Writing with Generative AI” should not be a simple “use” experience, but an experience in which learners “utilize” Generative AI in writing. It is necessary to organize university dual writing education according to the learner’s level of reasoning competency and to adjust its focus and content at each stage.

title_ko: Exploring changes in feedback literacy and self-directed learning among low-achieving English learners through ChatGPT–teacher integrated feedback: A case study of general English at H university
title_en: Exploring changes in feedback literacy and self-directed learning among low-achieving English learners through ChatGPT–teacher integrated feedback: A case study of general English at H university
kw_en: ChatGPT-teacher integrated feedback; feedback literacy; self-directed learning; low-achieving English learners
abstract_ko: This study aimed to examine the effects of integrated feedback, composed of ChatGPT-based and teacher feedback, on the feedback literacy and self-directed learning of low-achieving English learners. The participants were 21 low-achieving university students enrolled in a general English course at H University. Surveys were conducted three times (pre-, mid-, and post-intervention) and changes in feedback literacy and self-directed learning were analyzed using repeated-measures ANOVA. In addition, qualitative analysis was conducted based on semi-structured interviews developed from the feedback literacy and self-directed learning questionnaires used in the quantitative analysis. The results showed that integrated feedback had a positive impact on subcomponents of feedback literacy, including understanding ‘feedback’, ‘feedforward’, ‘emotional control’, and ‘feedback seeking’. In terms of self-directed learning, improvements were most notable in the areas of ‘learning execution’ and ‘learning evaluation’. The qualitative findings further indicated that the complementary roles of ChatGPT’s immediate feedback and the teacher’s elaborative cognitive and emotional feedback contributed to learners’ shifts in awareness and behavioral strategies. This study provides theoretical and practical implications for designing effective feedback strategies that support low-achieving learners.

title_ko: 인공지능 기반 학습자 수준별 텍스트 생성의 가능성과 한계 - ChatGPT 활용 독일어 텍스트 난이도 조절의 타당성 평가
title_en: Potenziale und Grenzen von KI-basierten Erstellung niveaugerechter Lerntexte - Evaluation der ChatGPT-basierten Niveausteuerung deutscher Texte
kw_ko: 텍스트단순화; 독일어교육; 텍스트난이도; AI활용독일어학습
kw_en: ChatGPT; Textvereinfachung; Deutschdidaktik; Textniveau; AI-basiertes Deutschlernen
abstract_ko: 이 연구는 대형언어모델(LLM)이 학습자 수준에 따른 텍스트를 생성할 수 있는지를 평가하기 위한 연구이다. 이를 위해 가장 범용성 있는 LLM 모델로 평가되는 ChatGPT를 통해 고급 수준(C1-C2)의 독일어 텍스트를 각각 유럽공통참조기준(CEFR)에서 제시하는 언어 능력 수준 A1, A2, B1에 적합한 학습용 텍스트로 단순화하여 이를 평가하였다. 실험에서는 먼저 프롬프트 엔지니어링을 활용하여 총 90개의 고급 텍스트를 각 목표 수준(A1, A2, B1)에 맞게 단순화하여, 총 270개의 산출물을 생성하였다. 이렇게 생성된 텍스트에 대해 1차적으로 문장 길이, 어절 수, 가독성 평가 등의 지표를 통한 정량적 분석을 실시하였으며, 2차적으로 정성적 평가를 위해 어휘 적합성, 문법성, 종합적 적절성 측면에서 정성적으로 전문가 평가를 거쳤다. 연구 결과, ChatGPT는 유럽참조기준에 따른 수준을 반영하여 텍스트를 단순화하는 능력을 보이고는 있으나 그 능력은 아직 제한적이며, 특히 초급 수준(A1, A2)으로 변환하는 데 많은 한계를 보였다. 이 연구는 AI를 활용하여 수준별 학습 텍스트 및 쉬운 언어 텍스트 생성의 활용 가능성을 모색한 연구라는 점에서 그 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: In dieser Studie wird untersucht, inwiefern LLMs dazu in der Lage sind, schwierige Texte gemäß dem Sprachniveau der Lernenden zu vereinfachen. Zu diesem Zweck wurden mit ChatGPT schwierige deutsche Texte auf den Niveaustufen A1, A2 und B1 des Gemeinsamen Europäischen Referenzrahmens für Sprachen (GER) vereinfacht und anschließend evaluiert. Insgesamt wurden 90 Texte von Deutscher Welle auf die Niveaustufen A1, A2 und B1 vereinfacht (insgesamt 270 Texte). Zur Evaluation der Qualität der sprachlichen Vereinfachung wurden einerseits qualitative Analysen anhand von Indikatoren wie Satzlänge, Silbenanzahl und Lesbarkeitsindex durchgeführt und andererseits qualitative Bewertungen durch Experten eingeholt. Es zeigte sich, dass ChatGPT grundsätzlich in der Lage ist, Texte den GER-Niveaus entsprechend einigermaßen anzupassen, seine Leistung jedoch begrenzt ist, insbesondere bei niedrigeren Sprachniveaus. Diese Studie kann dazu beitragen, die automatische Textvereinfachung durch KI zu optimieren und Texte in Standardsprache in leichter Sprache zu verfassen.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 시대, 대학 글쓰기 교육의 쟁점과 과제 —국내외 생성형 AI 관련 지침 분석 및 학습자 인식 조사를 중심으로—
title_en: Issues and Challenges for University Writing Education in the Era of Generative AI —Focusing on the Analysis of Domestic and International Generative AI Guidelines and Learner Perception Surveys—
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 대학 글쓰기 교육; 주체성; 공정성; 윤리적 활용; 질문 설계 중심 수업; AI 리터러시; AI 지침
kw_en: Generative AI; college writing education; subjectivity; fairness; ethical use; inquiry-centered classes; AI literacy; AI guidelines
abstract_ko: 본고는 생성형 AI 시대 대학 글쓰기 교육이 직면한 교육적 쟁점과 과제를 규명하고, 그 에 대응하는 구체적 방안을 모색하고자 하였다. 이를 위하여 본고에서는 국내외 주요 교육⋅연구 기관의 생성형 AI 관련 지침을 분석하 여 지침에 함의된 ‘인간중심성 및 주체성’, ‘공정성 및 접근성’, ‘윤리적 활용’, ‘AI 리터러 시 역량 및 교육’, ‘교수 학습 및 평가 개선’ 이라는 5가지 윤리적⋅교육적 원칙을 도출함으 로써 이 5가지 핵심 요인을 중심으로 생성형 AI의 교육적 활용이 이루어져야 함을 제시하 였다. 이를 토대로 대학 글쓰기 교육에서의 구체적 쟁점과 현안을 모색하기 위하여, 이 5가 지 핵심 요인들을 ‘교육 목표’, ‘교육 도구’, ‘윤리적 활용’, ‘교육 평가’, ‘교육 제도 지원’ 이라는 5가지 핵심 쟁점으로 구체화한 후, 각각의 쟁점에 대하여 대학 교육 현장의 실제적 인식과 요구를 반영하기 위하여 대학 글쓰기 교과목 수강 예정 학습자 대상으로 설문 진행 및 결과를 분석하였으며, 교수자⋅대학 제도 관련 북미 연구 사례 등 실증적 연구문헌을 다각적으로 검토함으로써 현장의 쟁점을 구체적으로 진단하고자 하였다. 그 결과, 학습자 들은 생성형 AI를 보조 도구로 인식함과 동시에 사고 과정 전반에 의존하는 이면적 태도를 보임을 확인하였으며, 교수자가 처한 현실적 문제 및 대학의 제도적 미비점 등 현장의 문제 점들을 실증적으로 분석하여 구체화하였다. 이에 본고에서는 제기한 쟁점에 대한 구체적 과제와 방안으로, 주체적 사고를 위한 질문 설계 중심의 교육 목표 재설정 공정성 문제의 해소 방안 모색 생성형 AI 지침 마련 및 실천적 윤리 교육 실행, 대학 차원의 AI리터러시 교육 및 제도적 지원의 필요성을 제시하였으며 이는 향후 생성형, AI에 대응하는 대학 글쓰기 교육의 방향성을 정립하는 실천적 기반을 마련하였다는 점에서 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: This study aimed to identify the educational issues and challenges facing university writing education in the era of Generative AI and explore corresponding practical measures. Through an analysis of major domestic and international guidelines, the study confirmed five key factors for its educational application: ‘human-centricity and agency’, ‘fairness and accessibility’, ‘ethical use’, ‘AI literacy competence and education’, and ‘improvement of teaching, learning, and evaluation’. These factors were then specified into five core issues— ‘educational goals’, ‘educational tools’, ‘ethical use’, ‘educational evaluation’, and ‘institutional support’—which were examined through a multifaceted review of student survey results and literature pertaining to instructors and institutions. Findings revealed learners’ two-sided attitude, perceiving AI as an auxiliary tool while simultaneously depending on it for core cognitive processes. The study also empirically analyzed instructors’ practical challenges and institutional inadequacies. Accordingly, this study proposed specific tasks and measures, including re-establishing educational goals focused on independent thinking, ensuring fairness, implementing AI guidelines and ethics education, and providing university-level institutional support. The significance of this study lies in its establishment of a practical foundation for defining the future direction of university writing education in response to Generative AI.
note: 대학 글쓰기 교육 AI 지침 분석

title_ko: 인공지능 활용 프로젝트 기반 교양 영어 수업에서 전반적인 영어학습 경험과 초급 학습자의 참여 양상
title_en: English Learning Experiences and Lower-Level Learners’ Participation in an AISupported Project-Based Language Learning Course for College Students
kw_ko: 프로젝트 기반 언어학습; 인공지능; 영어학습 경험; 영어 초급 학습자; 교양 영어
kw_en: project-based language learning; artificial intelligence; English language learning experiences; lower-level English learners; English for college students
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 한국 A 대학교 교양 영어 수업에서 전통적 교실 환경에 인공지능 도구를 보조적으로활용한 프로젝트 기반 언어학습 과정을 적용하여, 학습자의 전반적인 영어 학습 경험과 초급 학습자의참여 양상을 질적으로 탐색하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 설문지 17부, 조별 보고서 16부, 성찰노트 17부 등의 다층적 자료를 수집⋅분석하였다. 분석 결과, 인공지능 활용 프로젝트 기반 언어학습은전통적 교실 맥락에서도 학습자 중심의 언어 사용 환경을 조성하며, 조별 과업 수행을 통해 학습자들이언어적 의미를 협력적으로 구성하는 교수학습 형태로 구현되는 것으로 나타났다. 학습자들은 ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Papago, Natural Readers 등의 다양한 인공지능 도구를 활용하면서 읽기, 쓰기, 말하기, 듣기 영역을 통합적으로 사용하였으며, 과제수행 과정에서 언어를 구성하고 표현하는 새로운 경험을형성하였다. 이러한 과정에서 인공지능 기반 언어 상호작용 역량이 점진적으로 형성되었으며, 학습자들은 인공지능과의 상호작용을 통해 자신에게 적합한 언어적 표현을 탐색하고 조정하는 능력을 함양하게되었다. 특히 초급 학습자들은 멀티모달 인공지능 기능을 활용하여 언어적 제약을 인식하면서도 시각, 음성, 텍스트 자원을 결합한 활동을 통해 참여의 기회를 확장하는 양상을 보였다. 교사의 지속적인피드백과 수준별 안내는 학습자의 불안을 완화하고 자기 주도적 탐구를 지원하는 핵심 요인으로 관찰되었다. 본 연구는 인공지능 활용 프로젝트 기반 언어학습이 교양 영어교육의 실제 교실 환경에서 학습자들이 어떠한 방식으로 의미를 구성하고 참여를 형성하는지를 탐색함으로써, 전통적 교실 맥락에서 인공지능과 학습자, 교사가 공존하는 학습 경험의 특성을 질적으로 조명하였다는 점에서 의의를 지닌다.
abstract_en: This qualitative investigation explores how project-based language learning (PBLL), complemented by artificial intelligence tools within a conventional classroom context, shapes students’ English learning experiences and reveals the participation trajectories of lower-level learners in an English for college students course at A University in Korea. Drawing on 17 questionnaires, 16 group reports, and 17 reflective journals, the study found that AI-supported PBLL can function as a learner-centered classroom model in which students collaboratively construct linguistic meaning through group-based tasks. Learners utilized various AI tools, including ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Papago, and Natural Readers, integrating reading, writing, speaking, and listening in authentic project contexts. Throughout the process, students experienced new ways of organizing and expressing language as part of their task performance. Prompt literacy gradually developed as learners interacted with AI tools and learned to adjust and refine language expressions appropriate to their own proficiency levels. Lower-level learners, in particular, addressed linguistic constraints by engaging with multimodal AI features and combining visual, auditory, and textual resources to expand their participation opportunities. Continuous teacher feedback and level-based guidance supported learners’ confidence and self-directed inquiry. The findings indicate that AI-supported PBLL provides a pedagogical context in which learners co-construct meaning and actively participate within a traditional classroom setting. This study qualitatively illuminates how AI, teachers, and learners coexist in English education for college students, and how language learning experiences are meaningfully shaped through their interaction.
note: AI 활용 PBLL 교양영어 학습경험·초급자 참여 질적분석

title_ko: 과정 중심 영어 글쓰기 수업에서 피드백 유형에 대한 학습자 인식 비교 연구 －동료, 교수자, ChatGPT 피드백을 중심으로
title_en: A Comparative Study of Feedback in Process-Oriented English Writing : Peer Feedback vs. Teacher Feedback vs. ChatGPT Feedback-Based on Learners’ Perceptions
kw_ko: ChatGPT 피드백; 영어 글쓰기; 피드백
kw_en: Generative AI; ChatGPT; Process-Oriented English Writing; Learner Perceptions
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 과정 중심 영어 글쓰기 수업 맥락에서 동료 피드백, 교수자 피드백, ChatGPT 피드백에대한 학습자의 경험과 인식을 비교⋅분석하고, 이를 토대로 효과적인 영어 글쓰기 교육 방안을 모색하는것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 각 피드백 유형에 대한 학습자의 인식(효과, 정확성, 반영 정도, 필요성, 선호도)과 장단점을 탐색하는 것을 연구 질문으로 설정하였다. 연구는 2024학년도 2학기 A대학교1학년 필수 교양 영어 수업 수강생 81명을 대상으로 하였으며, 수업은 동료 피드백, ChatGPT를 활용한수정 활동, 교수자 피드백이 체계적으로 결합된 과정 중심 영어 글쓰기 방식으로 운영되었다. 연구도구로는 ChatGPT 피드백 관련 문항을 추가⋅보완한 5점 리커트 척도 설문지(Cronbach’s α = .934)를사용하였으며, 객관식 문항은 반복측정 분산분석(repeated measures ANOVA) 및 프리드먼 검정(Friedman test)을 통해 분석하였다. 개방형 문항에 대한 응답은 주제 분석(thematic analysis)을 통해질적으로 검토하였다. 주요 연구 결과, 피드백 제공 주체에 따른 학습자 인식 차이는 모든 영역에서 통계적으로 유의하게나타났으며, 학습자들은 피드백의 효과 인식, 정확성 인식, 피드백 반영 정도, 향후 필요성, 최종 선호도의모든 영역에서 교수자 피드백을 가장 높게 평가하였다. 모든 인식 영역에서 교수자 > ChatGPT > 동료라는 일관된 순서가 유의하게 확인되었고(p < .001), 켄달의 조화계수(W = .820)를 통해 응답자간 순위 부여의 일치도가 매우 높음을 알 수 있었다. 특히 교수자 피드백은 전체 학습자의 95.1%에게1순위로 선택되었으며, ChatGPT 피드백은 동료 피드백보다 더 정확하고 실질적인 보조 자원으로 인식되었다. 질적 분석 결과, 교수자 피드백은 ‘정확성⋅전문성’(49.4%)과 ‘신뢰성⋅객관성’(18.2%)이 주요강점으로, ‘시간⋅접근성의 한계’(60.7%)가 주요 단점으로 나타났다. ChatGPT 피드백은 ‘편의성⋅접근성’(45.1%)과 ‘빠름⋅즉시성’이 중요한 장점으로, ‘오류⋅부정확성’(43.5%)과 ‘낮은 신뢰성’이 한계로지적되었다. 동료 피드백은 ‘상호작용⋅편안함’(25.7%)과 ‘유사한 시각⋅수준 공유’(22.9%)를 통한정서적⋅사회적 이점이 강조되었으나, ‘낮은 정확성⋅전문성’(60.7%)이 주요 한계로 나타났다. 결론적으로, 학습자들은 여전히 교수자 피드백의 전문성과 신뢰성을 가장 중요한 피드백 자원으로인식하고 있으나, ChatGPT 피드백은 교수자 피드백의 시간적⋅물리적 제약을 보완하는 실질적인 중간적 보조 수단으로 기능하고 있음이 확인되었다. 이러한 결과를 바탕으로, 과정 중심 영어 글쓰기 수업에서교수자⋅동료⋅생성형 AI 피드백을 상호보완적으로 설계⋅운영하기 위한 교육적 시사점을 논의하였다.
abstract_en: This study aims to compare and analyze learners’ experiences and perceptions of peer feedback, teacher feedback, and ChatGPT feedback within the context of a process-oriented English writing course, and to explore effective instructional strategies for English writing based on these findings. To achieve this goal, the research investigates learners’ perceptions of each feedback type—specifically its perceived effectiveness, accuracy, degree of incorporation, necessity, and preference—as well as the perceived strengths and weaknesses of each feedback source. The study was conducted with 81 first-year students enrolled in a required general English course at a university in the fall semester of 2024. The writing component of the course followed a process-oriented approach that systematically incorporated peer feedback, ChatGPT-assisted revision, and teacher feedback. The research instrument was a five-point Likert-scale questionnaire (Cronbach’s α = .934), which included additional and modified items related to ChatGPT feedback. Closed-ended items were analyzed using repeated measures ANOVA and the Friedman test, while open-ended responses were examined qualitatively through thematic analysis. The findings revealed statistically significant differences in learners’ perceptions across all domains depending on the feedback source. Learners consistently rated teacher feedback highest in terms of perceived effectiveness, accuracy, degree of incorporation, future necessity, and overall preference. The consistent ranking order—teacher > ChatGPT > peer—was statistically significant (p < .001), and Kendall’s coefficient of concordance (W = .820) indicated a very high level of agreement among respondents. Notably, 95.1% of the students selected teacher feedback as their top preference, and ChatGPT feedback was perceived as more accurate and more practically useful than peer feedback. Qualitative analysis further revealed that the major strengths of teacher feedback were “accuracy and expertise” (49.4%) and “reliability and objectivity” (18.2%), whereas its primary limitation was “limited time and accessibility” (60.7%). ChatGPT feedback was valued for its “convenience and accessibility” (45.1%) and “speed/immediacy,” but its weaknesses included “errors and inaccuracy” (43.5%) and “low reliability.” Peer feedback offered affective and social benefits such as “interaction and comfort” (25.7%) and “shared perspectives and proficiency levels” (22.9%), yet its most frequently cited limitation was “low accuracy and lack of expertise” (60.7%). In conclusion, while learners continue to perceive teacher feedback as the most essential and reliable feedback resource, ChatGPT feedback serves as a practical supplementary tool that compensates for the time and accessibility constraints of teacher feedback. Based on these findings, the study discusses pedagogical implications for designing and implementing a complementary feedback system that effectively integrates teacher, peer, and generative AI feedback within process-oriented English writing instruction.
note: 동료·교수자·ChatGPT 피드백 인식 비교 설문

title_ko: 생성형 인공지능 영어 글쓰기 평가 도구 간 비교 연구: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Grammarly를 중심으로
title_en: A Comparative Study of Generative AI-Based English Writing Evaluation Tools: Focusing on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Grammarly
kw_ko: 기계 번역기; 번역 결과물; 영어 학습자; 평가
kw_en: English writing sassessment; Generative AI; ChatGPT; Grammarly; Inter-rater agreement
abstract_ko: This study compared four generative AI-based English writing evaluation tools—ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Grammarly—by analyzing their assessments of Korean university students’ essays according to Grammarly’s five criteria: accuracy, clarity, conci- seness, tone, and formality. Forty first-year pre-medical students enrolled in a general English writing course participated in the study. Each essay was evaluated by all tools using the same prompt to obtain criterion scores (1-20) and overall scores (100). Descriptive statistics and repeated-measures ANOVA were used to test mean differences across tools, while Friedman tests and Kendall’s coefficient of concordance examined rank consistency. According to the results, ChatGPT demonstrated the highest overall mean being followed by Perplexity and Grammarly, whereas Gemini exhibited the lowest mean score. Significant differences were found in accuracy, clarity, conciseness, and formality (p<.001), but not in tone (p=.132). Nonparametric tests revealed no significant differences or agreement in overall rank, suggesting convergence in holistic evaluation tendencies. Findings indicate the pedagogical value of integrating multiple AI tools with human assessment, selecting tools aligned with rubric priorities, and guiding students to interpret and apply AI feedback effectively in formative writing cycles.

title_ko: AI를 활용한 대학 글쓰기 수업 방안: 자기 글쓰기와 AI 생성 글의 비교·분석을 중심으로
title_en: A College Writing Instruction Model Utilizing AI -Focusing on the Comparison and Analysis of Personal Writing and AI-Generated Texts-
kw_ko: AI 시대 글쓰기 수업; 자기 글쓰기; AI 생성 글; 디지털 리터러시; 글쓰기 역량 강화
kw_en: Writing Instruction in the AI Era; Personal Writing; AI-Generated Text; Digital Literacy; Enhancement of Writing Competence
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 AI 시대에 요구되는 효과적인 글쓰기 수업 방안을 마련하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 서사적 글쓰기를 기반으로 한 자기 글쓰기 활동에, AI 생성 글의 비교·분석 및 수정 활동을 결합한 수업을 구성하였다. 수업에서 학생들은 먼저 ‘서사’와 ‘묘사’의 개념을 학습한 후 영상을 바탕으로 서사적 글을 작성하고, 동일한 주제로 AI가 생성한 글과 자신의 글을 비교‧분석하며 두 차례의 수정 활동을 수행하였다. 이러한 경험은 학생들로 하여금 자신의 글쓰기 방식과 사고 과정을 객관화하고, 글쓰기의 구조적 요소와 의미 구성 방식을 재인식하도록 돕는다. 또한 AI 생성 글을 비판적으로 검토하는 과정은 AI 글쓰기의 한계와 인간 글쓰기의 고유한 판단·해석·표현 능력을 인식하게 하며, 비교‧분석‧수정 활동의 반복은 자기 성찰과 메타인지적 점검을 촉진하여 글쓰기 과정 전반의 이해를 심화한다. 이러한 결과는 본고에서 제안한 수업 방안이 학생들의 비판적 사고, 디지털 리터러시, 자기 글쓰기 역량 향상에 기여할 가능성을 보여준다.
abstract_en: This study aims to develop an effective writing instruction model suitable for the AI era. To this end, a writing class was designed by combining personal writing activities based on narrative composition with comparative analysis and revision tasks involving AI-generated texts. In the class, students first learned the concepts of narrative and description, then produced a narrative text based on a video. They subsequently compared their writing with an AI-generated version on the same topic and conducted two rounds of revision. Through these activities, students were able to objectify their writing processes, reassess the structural and semantic components of texts, and deepen their understanding of how meaning is constructed. The critical examination of AI-generated texts further enabled them to recognize the limitations of AI writing and the distinctive interpretive, analytical, and expressive capacities inherent in human writing. Moreover, the iterative process of comparison, analysis, and revision fostered self-reflection and metacognitive awareness, thereby enriching their overall understanding of the writing process. These results suggest that the proposed instructional approach holds the potential to enhance students’ critical thinking, digital literacy, and personal writing competence.
note: 대학 글쓰기 수업 방안

title_ko: 생성형 AI 기반 토론 수업의 의의와 한계
title_en: Educational Implications and Limitations of Generative AI-Based Debate Instruction
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능(AI); 인공지능(AI) 기반 토론 수업; AI 토론; 화법교육; 토론 교육
kw_en: Generative AI; AI-based Debate Instruction; AI Debate; Speech Communication Education; Debate Education
abstract_ko: 목적: 본 연구는 초등학생 대상으로 생성형 AI(Wrtn, Mizou) 기반 토론 수업의 교육적 의의와 한계를 탐색하고 교육적 시사점을 도출하여 기존 토론 교육의 현실적이며 구조적인 한계의 극복 가능성을 모색하는 데 목적이 있다. 방법: D광역시 소재 D초등학교 6학년 5학급(학생 117명)을 사례로 선정하여 생성형 AI 기반 토론 수업 실행 양상을 질적으로 분석하였다. 수업 관찰, 학습 일지, 학생 면담 등을 통해 수집된 자료를 귀납적 주제 분석 방법으로 분석하였다. 결과: 생성형 AI 기반 토론 수업의 교육적 의의로 ‘참여와 몰입’, ‘효과적인 토론 활동’, ‘정의적 만족감’, ‘지식의 확장’, ‘토론 역량 강화’라는 5가지 주제를 도출하였다. 반면 한계로는 ‘소극적 참여와 배제’, ‘토론 활동의 어려움’, ‘팀 구성원의 문제’, ‘환경적인 제약’이라는 4가지 주제를 도출하였다. 결론: 생성형 AI 기반 토론 수업은 AI의 장점과 인간이 지니는 고유한 장점을 조화롭게 통합하는 방향으로 설계되어야 한다. 특히 AI 토론 효과가 대면 토론으로 전이되기 위해서는 ‘브리지(Bridge)’ 단계의 체계적 설계 및 실행이 전제되어야 하며, 이러한 조건이 충족될 때 비로소 교육적 효과가 극대화될 수 있다.
abstract_en: Purpose: This study explored the educational implications and limitations of generative AI(‘Wrtn’ and ‘Mizou’)-based debate instruction for elementary school students, aiming to enhance debate education quality and overcome traditional constraints. Methods: 5 sixth-grade classes (117 students) from D Elementary School were analyzed qualitatively as a case. Data from classroom observations, learning journals, and student interviews were examined using inductive thematic analysis. Results: There are 5 themes as educational implications: ‘engagement and immersion’, ‘effective debate activities’, ‘satisfaction’, ‘knowledge expansion’, and ‘enhanced debate competency’. 4 limitations were identified: ‘passive participation and exclusion’, ‘debate difficulties’, ‘team member issues’, and ‘environmental constraints’. Conclusion: AI-based debate instruction should integrate the strengths of AI with the intrinsic benefits of human interaction. For the learning effects of AI-based debates to tranfer to face-to-face contexts, the systematic design and implementation of a ‘Bridge’ phase is essential to maximize educational benefits.
note: 뤼튼·Mizou 기반 초등 토론 수업 질적 사례

title_ko: 분산인지 관점에서 본 생성형AI 활용 글쓰기의 교육적 시사점
title_en: Educational Implications of Generative AI-Assisted Writing from a Distributed Cognition Perspective
kw_ko: 분산인지; 생성형AI; 쓰기 과정; 심리적; 기능적 지원; 공동인지 시스템
kw_en: Distributed Cognition; Generative AI; Writing Process; Psychological Support; Functional Support; Co-cognitive System
abstract_ko: 목적: 이 연구의 목적은 글쓰기 현상을 ‘분산인지(distributed cognition)’ 관점에서 새롭게 해석해 보고, 이를 통해 생성형AI 활용 글쓰기가 갖는 교육적 시사점을 탐구하는 것이다. 방법: 분산인지의 개념과 특징에 관한 탐구를 토대로 쓰기 교육을 위한 계획과 교육 단계에서 고려할 점들을 도출하였다. 결과: 분산인지 시스템 기반 글쓰기 지원 체계를 쓰기 과정별로 살펴보면, ‘계획하기’ 단계의 주제 생성 등에서, ‘내용 생성’ 단계의 주제 관련 제재 탐색 등에서, ‘내용 조직’ 단계의 생각그물과 얼개 구성 등에서, ‘내용 표현’ 단계의 쓰기 목적이나 예상 독자에게 알맞은 표현 및 내용 추가 등에서, ‘수정’ 단계의 형식 및 내용 요소의 점검 등에서, ‘조정하기’ 단계에서 활용할 수 있을 것이다. 또한, 분산인지 시스템에 기반한 생성형AI 활용 글쓰기의 지원 체계를 심리적 지원, 기능적 지원, 공동인지 시스템으로 제시하였다. 결론: 분산인지 관점에서 생성형AI 활용 글쓰기는 필자의 부담을 줄이며 쓰기 능력을 발달하도록 촉진하는 데 유용하게 활용할 수 있다.
abstract_en: Purpose: This study aims to reinterpret writing as a cognitive activity from the perspective of distributed cognition and to explore the educational implications of utilizing generative AI in writing instruction. Methods: Based on a theoretical investigation of the concept and characteristics of distributed cognition, this study derives instructional planning strategies and key considerations for each stage of the writing process. Results: When examined by stages of the writing process, a distributed cognition-based writing support system can be applied in the following ways: in the planning stage, for topic generation; in the content generation stage, for exploring related materials; in the organizing stage, for constructing idea maps and outlines; in the expression stage, for choosing appropriate expressions for audience and purpose; in the revision stage, for reviewing both form and content; and in the monitoring stage, for overall regulation. Furthermore, this study proposes a generative AI-supported writing framework grounded in distributed cognition, comprising psychological support, functional support, and a co-cognitive system. Conclusion: From the perspective of distributed cognition, generative AI-supported writing can effectively reduce the cognitive burden on writers and facilitate the development of writing abilities.
note: 분산인지 이론적 고찰만, AI 실제 적용·분석 없음(prev Y)

title_ko: AI 협력 글쓰기의 인지 과정 모형 제안과 교육적 함의
title_en: Proposing a Cognitive Process Model of AI-Collaborative Writing and Its Educational Implications
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; AI 글쓰기; AI 협력 글쓰기; 인지 과정 모형; 이중 점검; 과정 중심 글쓰기 교육
kw_en: generative AI; AI writing; AI-collaborative writing; cognitive process model; dual monitoring; process-oriented writing instruction
abstract_ko: 생성형 AI의 등장은 글쓰기를 필자와 AI가 함께 의미를 구성하는 협력적 과정으로 전환시켰고, 기존의 과정 중심 글쓰기 모형(Flower & Hayes, 1981)은 이러한 AI 협력 글쓰기의 실제 인지 활동을 설명하는 데 더 이상 유효하지 않다. 이에 이 연구는 변화한 글쓰기의 인지 과정을 모형화하여 제안하고, 이를 바탕으로 AI 시대의 과정 중심 글쓰기 교육이 어떻게 재구성되어야 하는지 논의하는 데 목적을 두었다. 이를 위해, 대학생 필자 36명의 글쓰기 과정에서 수집된 즉시 회상 프로토콜을 질적으로 분석했다. 분석 결과 도출된 ‘AI 협력 글쓰기의 인지 과정 모형’은 다음의 특징을 가진다. 첫째, ‘과제 환경’은 기존에 없던 외부 정보 자원, 특히 AI가 산출하는 ‘AI 텍스트 후보군’을 포함하는 방향으로 확장되었고, ‘필자의 장기기억’은 기존 지식의 정교화와 함께 ‘AI 활용 지식’이 편입되는 방식으로 재구성되었다. 둘째, ‘쓰기 과정’은 AI의 실시간 개입을 전제로 ‘기획하기-생성하기-조정하기’로 재구조화되었으며, ‘기획하기’에는 텍스트 표상 구성, 목표·방향 설정, AI 개입 설계가, ‘생성하기’에는 내용 요소 생성, 표현·전개 다중 생성, 통합 구조 형성이, ‘조정하기’에는 텍스트 문제 탐지, 내용·구조 조정, 표현 정교화가 주요 인지 활동으로 포함되었다. 셋째, 필자의 텍스트 표상과 AI 제안을 지속적으로 대조하며 텍스트의 방향성과 표상을 조율하는 ‘이중 점검(dual monitoring)’이 AI 협력 글쓰기 과정을 통제하는 핵심적인 상위인지 메커니즘으로 제시되었다. 이를 토대로, 이 연구는 AI 시대의 과정 중심 글쓰기 교육이 새롭게 구성되어야 하는 방향을 제안했다. 특히, ‘기획하기-생성하기-조정하기’ 전 과정을 필자와 AI의 상호작용에 기반하여 다루고, 텍스트 표상과 AI 제안의 비교·판단을 수행하는 이중 점검 능력과 AI 활용 지식의 함양을 교육 내용의 중요한 축으로 설정해야 함을 강조했다.
abstract_en: The rise of generative AI has transformed writing into a collaborative process in which meaning is co-constructed with the AI, rendering the traditional process-oriented model (Flower & Hayes, 1981) insufficient. Using immediate retrospective protocols from 36 university writers, this study proposes a revised cognitive process model that reflects real-time writer-AI interaction and considers implications for process-oriented instruction. The model shows that the task environment now includes AI-generated candidate texts and that long-term memory expands as writers integrate prior knowledge with knowledge of AI use. The writing process is reorganized into Planning(extended), Generating, and Regulating. Planning(extended) involves constructing textual representations, setting goals, and designing AI engagement; Generating entails producing content and exploring alternatives; Regulating focuses on detecting problems and refining text. Across stages, dual monitoring―continual comparison of the writer’s representation with AI suggestions―emerges as the central metacognitive mechanism. These findings suggest that process-oriented writing instruction should be restructured to foreground writer-AI interaction, emphasizing dual monitoring and effective AI-use knowledge as key instructional components.
note: 대학생 필자 대상 작문 인지모형

title_ko: ChatGPTs Voice Mode als virtueller Gesprächspartner – Einblicke in Bewerbungsgesprächsimulationen zwischen ChatGPT und DaF-Lernenden
title_en: ChatGPTs Voice Mode als virtueller Gesprächspartner – Einblicke in Bewerbungsgesprächsimulationen zwischen ChatGPT und DaF-Lernenden
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 고급음성모드; 외국어로서의 독일어; 말하기 능력; 대화분석
kw_en: ChatGPT; Advanced Voice Mode; Deutsch als Fremdsprache; Fertigkeit Sprechen; Gesprächsanalyse
abstract_ko: In den letzten Jahren haben KI-gestützte Lernwerkzeuge den traditionellen, lehrerzentrierten Fremdsprachenunterricht erweitert und eröffnen neue Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung mündlicher Sprachkompetenzen in digitalen Interaktionsumgebungen. Vor diesem Hintergrund untersucht die vorliegende Studie den Einsatz von ChatGPT in simulierten Bewerbungsgesprächen als explorativen Ansatz zur Förderung der Sprechfertigkeit im Fach Deutsch als Fremdsprache. Im Rahmen eines experimentellen Designs wurden Interaktionen mit insgesamt 20 Studierenden aus Korea und Taiwan analysiert. Die Befunde deuten darauf hin, dass Lernende in einem geschützten Rahmen ihre Redeanteile erweitern, vielfältigere Ausdrucksweisen erproben und durch unmittelbares Feedback an Selbstsicherheit gewinnen konnten. Quantitative Indikatoren wie Redeanteile, Type-TokenRatio (TTR) und Anzahl der Sprecherwechsel verdeutlichen, dass die Interaktionen zwischen Lernenden und ChatGPT dynamisch und ausgewogen verliefen. Die Analysen zeigen, dass ChatGPT ein hohes Maß an Interaktivität und Authentizität ermöglicht und als fehlertoleranter, jederzeit verfügbarer Gesprächspartner fungiert. Aus gesprächsanalytischer Perspektive erzeugt ChatGPT durch die Realisierung von Pausen, Verzögerungssignalen und Diskursmarkern eine menschenähnliche Sprechweise, die zur natürlichen Gesprächswahrnehmung beiträgt. Die Gespräche verliefen kohärent und formal strukturiert, wobei obligatorische Gesprächsphasen konsistent realisiert wurden, während spontane Elemente seltener auftraten. Als Einschränkungen sind das Fehlen visueller Hinweise sowie eine begrenzte Feedbackqualität zu verzeichnen. Die Befunde legen nahe, dass ChatGPT als komplementäres Instrument im DaF-Unterricht einen didaktischen Mehrwert bietet, insbesondere in Anwendungsszenarien wie Bewerbungstraining, Prüfungsvorbereitung oder selbstgesteuertem Lernen.

title_ko: 에듀테크를 활용한 초등 영어 교과융합 수업이 학생의 의사소통 능력 향상에 미치는 효과
title_en: A Study on the Effects of EdTech-Integrated Elementary English Instruction on Students' Communicative Competence
kw_ko: 에듀테크; 영어 의사소통 능력; 초등 영어 교육; 교과융합 수업
kw_en: EdTech; CLIL; English Communication Skills; Elementary English Education; Content-integrated Instruction
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 충청남도 C군 소재 초등학교 5~6학년 학생 28명을 대상으로, 에듀테크를 활용한 교과융합 영어 수업이 학생들의 영어 의사소통 능력 향상에 미치는 효과를 분석하였다. 8주간의 수업은 수학과 국어, 사회, 과학, 체육 그리고 미술 등의 교과 내용을 영어와 결합한 교과융합(Content and Language Integrated Learning) 방식으로 진행되었으며, AI펭톡, 뤼튼, 띵커벨, 투닝, 미리캔버스, 북크리에이터, 클래스카드 등의 에듀테크 도구가 수업에 적용되었다. 연구는 사전·사후 Cambridge YLE Speaking Test 점수 비교를 통한 양적 분석과 교사의 수업 관찰 및 학생 인터뷰를 통한 질적 분석을 병행하였다. 연구결과는 다음과 같다. 첫째, 영어의사소통향상 분석에서는 사전·사후 평가 점수에서 유의미한 향상이 나타났으며, 특히 말하기 유창성과 발음 정확도, 그리고 표현의 다양성에서 뚜렷한 성장이 확인되었다. 둘째, AI 기반 피드백 기능을 제공하는 도구(예: AI펭톡, 뤼튼)와 시각·창작 도구(예: 미리캔버스, 북크리에이터)의 결합이 학습 몰입도와 동기 부여에 크게 기여하였다. 셋째, 교사들의 관찰평가에서도 학생들의 발화 길이와 내용 구성의 복잡성이 증가했으며, 영어 사용에 대한 자신감이 높아졌음을 보여주었다. 또한, 학생들은 수업 중 시각자료 제작, 스토리텔링, 데이터 시각화 등의 활동을 통해 학습 내용을 실제 맥락 속에서 영어로 표현하는 경험을 반복하였고, 이 과정에서 자연스럽게 어휘력과 표현력이 향상되었다. 본 연구는 초등 영어 교육에서 에듀테크와 CLIL의 결합이 학습자의 언어 사용 기회를 확대하고 자기주도성과 협력성을 강화하는 효과적인 교수학습 모형임을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of an EdTech-based content and language integrated learning (CLIL) program on the English communication skills of 28 fifth- and sixth-grade students in C County, Chungcheongnam-do, South Korea. Over eight weeks, subjects such as mathematics, Korean, Social Studies, Science, Physical Education, and art were integrated into English instruction, using various EdTech tools, including AI PengTalk, Writon, Thingkerbell, Tooning, Miricanvas, Book Creator, and Classcard. A mixed-methods approach was adopted, combining quantitative analysis through comparisons of pre- and post-test scores on the Cambridge YLE Speaking Test, and qualitative analysis through teachers’ classroom observations and student interviews. The research findings are as follows. First, the analysis of improvements in English communicative competence showed a statistically significant increase in pre- and post-assessment scores, with particularly notable gains in speaking fluency, pronunciation accuracy, and expression diversity. Second, integrating AI-based feedback tools (e.g., AI PengTalk, Wrtn) with visual and creative tools (e.g., Miricanvas, Book Creator) significantly increased learners’ engagement and motivation. Third, teachers’ observational assessments indicated increases in students’ utterance length and the complexity of content organization, as well as enhanced confidence in using English. In addition, students repeatedly experienced expressing learning content in English in authentic contexts through activities such as creating visual materials, storytelling, and data visualization during lessons. Through this process, vocabulary and expressive competence improved naturally. This study suggests that the integration of educational technology and CLIL in elementary English education is an effective teaching–learning model that expands learners’ opportunities for language use while strengthening self-directed learning and collaboration. The study suggests that integrating EdTech tools into CLIL-based elementary English instruction effectively expands language-use opportunities while fostering learner autonomy and collaboration.
note: 에듀테크 7종 묶음 CLIL, AI펭톡·뤼튼은 일부 도구

title_ko: A Decade of Korean Research on AI-Mediated English Speaking: A Text-Mining Analysis
title_en: A Decade of Korean Research on AI-Mediated English Speaking: A Text-Mining Analysis
kw_en: artificial intelligence; English speaking; ChatGPT; chatbot; text mining; research trends
abstract_ko: This study examines abstract-level research trends in AI-mediated English-speaking education through a systematic text-mining analysis of English-language abstracts drawn from 130 Korean journal articles and theses published between 2015 and 2025. The dataset was constructed by retrieving English-language abstracts from RISS, a major Korean academic database and was analyzed using a combination of word-frequency analysis, TF-IDF weighting, N-gram extraction, and co-occurrence network analysis. These quantitative procedures were supplemented by topic modeling and CONCOR clustering to identify dominant thematic structures across the corpus. The results indicate that chatbot-based technologies—most notably PengTalk and ChatGPT—have emerged as the primary platforms for AI-mediated speaking practice, particularly within classroom-oriented instructional designs emphasizing proficiency development, level-based assessment, and feedback provision. Four major thematic domains were identified: classroom-based outcome validation, AI/chatbot-mediated support and proficiency gains, learner-centered task design and interaction, and speaker or user experience. Across these domains, AI is increasingly positioned not merely as an auxiliary tool but as an interactive learning partner that reshapes pedagogical practices and assessment approaches. The findings further suggest a growing emphasis on engagement, interactional authenticity, and formative feedback in AI-mediated speaking research. This study concludes by discussing implications for future classroom-embedded longitudinal research and the development of multimodal (speech–text) evaluation frameworks that foreground fairness, authenticity, and personalization in English-speaking assessment.

title_ko: A Systematic Literature Review on Instructors’ Roles in 2023-2024 Empirical Research on ChatGPT-based English Language Learning
title_en: A Systematic Literature Review on Instructors’ Roles in 2023-2024 Empirical Research on ChatGPT-based English Language Learning
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 생성형 인공지능; 영어교육; 교수자 역할; 체계적 문헌연구
kw_en: ChatGPT; generative artificial; intelligence; English education; instructors’ role; systematic literature review
abstract_ko: The current study seeks to illuminate the roles of instructors in prior empirical research conducted in the domestic English education field. It systematically categorizes empirical studies on ChatGPT-based English instructions according to the main roles of instructors and suggests their frequency. In addition to analyzing these roles, further analysis of actual ChatGPT users, school levels, and outcome variables was necessary because these roles are closely tied to specific contexts. The study reviewed 76 previous studies that were conducted in South Korea between 2023 and 2024. These include 66 journal articles, nine master’s theses and one doctoral dissertation. The analysis identified five instructors’ roles: facilitators, technical supporters, resources of feedback, instructional organizers, and language instructors. Facilitators were the most common role found in studies of ChatGPT-based English instructions. Technical supporters, though relatively new, ranked as the second most frequent role. Resources of feedback focused on developing productive skills such as speaking and writing. Instructional organizers were primarily school teachers rather than university faculty. Language instructors emphasized grammar even when teaching other written language skills. These findings are expected to give comprehensive educational implications and insights into instructors’ roles when utilizing ChatGPT for English language learning in the Korean EFL context.

title_ko: 수준별 피드백 프롬프트 기반 생성형 AI 영어 말하기 학습 챗봇 개발 및 효과성 검증
title_en: Developing a Generative AI-Based English Speaking Chatbot with Level-Specific Feedback: Effects on Speaking Performance and Anxiety
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 영어 말하기 학습 챗봇; 수준별 피드백; 말하기 불안
kw_en: Generative AI; English-speaking learning chatbot; level-specific feedback; speaking anxiety
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 성인 학습자의 영어 말하기 능력 향상과 말하기 불안 감소를 지원하기 위해, 수준별 피드백을 제공하는 생성형 AI 기반 영어 말하기 학습 챗봇을 개발하고 그 효과를 탐색적으로 검증하였다. 챗봇은 평가모드와 대화모드를 결합한 프롬프트 구조를 통해 학습자의 말하기 수준을 자동으로 진단하고, 진단 결과에 기반하여 학습자 수준에 맞는 피드백을 제공하도록 설계되었다. 실험은 국내 대학(원)생 19명을 대상으로 2주간 진행되었으며, 단일집단 사전-사후 설계를 활용하여 효과를 분석하였다. 사전 말하기 점수 기준으로 초급·중급·고급 그룹을 구분한 결과, 모든 수준 집단에서 말하기 능력이 통계적으로 유의하게 향상되었으며, 말하기 불안은 초급 학습자 집단에서만 통계적으로 유의한 감소가 나타났다. 대화 분석에서는 챗봇이 수준별 피드백을 일관되게 제공한 반면, 학습자의 피드백에 대한 즉각적인 반응률은 낮게 나타났다. 이러한 결과는 챗봇 기반 반복 말하기 연습과 자동화된 수준별 피드백이 성인 학습자의 영어 말하기 학습을 지원할 수 있는 잠재력을 지님을 시사하며, 생성형 AI 기반 말하기 학습 도구의 교육적 활용에 대한 기초적 근거를 제공한다.
abstract_en: This study developed and examined the effectiveness of a generative AI–based English speaking learning support chatbot designed to enhance adult learners’ speaking proficiency and reduce speaking anxiety through level-specific feedback. The chatbot employed a prompt structure combining an evaluation mode and a conversation mode, enabling it to automatically assess learners’ speaking proficiency and provide feedback tailored to their proficiency levels. The experiment involved 19 Korean undergraduate and graduate students who used the chatbot over a two-week period, employing a single-group pretest–posttest design. Based on pretest speaking scores, participants were categorized into novice, intermediate, and advanced groups. The results showed that all three proficiency groups demonstrated statistically significant improvements in speaking proficiency, while a statistically significant reduction in speaking anxiety was observed only in the novice group. Discourse analysis indicated that the chatbot consistently delivered level-specific feedback, although learners’ immediate response rates to the feedback were relatively low. These findings suggest that chatbot-based repetitive speaking practice combined with automated level-specific feedback can effectively support adult learners’ speaking development and highlight the potential of future generative AI–based chatbots in educational settings.

title_ko: Analyzing the Needs for Korean EFL Students’ AI Competency by their Perception and Actual Use of AI-Utilized Tools
title_en: Analyzing the Needs for Korean EFL Students’ AI Competency by their Perception and Actual Use of AI-Utilized Tools
kw_en: AI competency; Importance-Performance Analysis; the Borich needs analysis; AI use in the higher; education classroom; English language learning
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study is to figure out the educational needs for Korean college students’ competency of AI use, based upon the differences in their perceived importance and actual performance of AI-utilized tools in the classroom. To accomplish this research purpose, it specifically aims to uncover 1) How important did Korean college students perceive the use of AI tools for their English learning? 2) How much did the students perceive that they actually use AI tools for their English learning? 3) What are the most urgent educational needs regarding English learning competencies for using AI in the classroom? Fifty students responded to the IPA survey, and the collected data were analyzed by using IPA and the Borich needs analysis. The analytical results suggested that 1) learners have already secured basic skills in using AI tools and interacting with AI in English learning, 2) they have a significant educational need for higher-order competencies regarding critical evaluation of AI-generated output and strategic modification based on AI-provided feedback. Lastly, pedagogical implications and suggestions for the AI-assisted language instruction were also discussed.

title_ko: Teachers’ Experiences with AI Feedback in an AI Digital Textbook:An Affordance-Based Analysis
title_en: Teachers’ Experiences with AI Feedback in an AI Digital Textbook:An Affordance-Based Analysis
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence Digital Textbook (AIDT); AI Feedback; Writing Assessment; Teacher Assessment Practice; Affordance
abstract_ko: The Ministry of Education in Korea has officially approved the implementation of the Artificial Intelligence Digital Textbook (AIDT) in schools, which integrates adaptive learning and automated evaluation systems. This study examines the usefulness of the AI feedback system within AIDT from the perspective of English teachers. The AIDT’s AI feedback system aims to support teachers’ assessment practices by providing individualized feedback for students with developing writing skills. However, how the system influences teachers’ assessment practices remains unclear. This study investigated the experiences of four Korean middle school English teachers using the AI feedback system and identified the affordances and constraints that emerged during use. Teachers assessed sample student essays using the system; their online assessment sessions were recorded and followed by in-depth interviews. The findings indicate that, although the system offered technological advantages and instructional support, issues related to feedback inaccuracy and limited customization prompted teachers to engage in additional review and modification of the automated feedback. Based on these experiences, teachers suggested practical improvements to enhance the feedback quality and system usability. This study offers insights into how teachers incorporate AI feedback into classroom assessment and proposes directions for refining the AI feedback system.

title_ko: Text Mining Analysis on Perceptions of ChatGPT for English Education: Comparing 2023-2025 Studies with and without Instructions
title_en: Text Mining Analysis on Perceptions of ChatGPT for English Education: Comparing 2023-2025 Studies with and without Instructions
kw_en: Generative Artificial Intelligence; ChatGPT; Perception; English Education; Instructors’ Intervention
abstract_ko: The current study explores the characteristics of 2023-2025 studies on perceptions of ChatGPT under the Korean EFL context by comparing the two distinctively different types of research without any explicit guidance and with instructors’ instructions. This study aims to analyze the basic information (RQ1), research issues (RQ2) and patterns of results (RQ3). 85 relevant studies, including 71 journal articles, eleven master’s theses and three doctoral dissertations, were collected through RISS (Research Information Sharing Service). Publication years and forms, research subjects, and purposes were coded for the basic information (RQ1) based on the two types of studies. English abstracts were analyzed by text mining including word frequency, word clouds, and LDA topic modeling (RQ2). Qualitative analysis on patterns of results (RQ3) was implemented. As a result, the selected studies predominantly aimed at university students, and focused on writing. Research subjects and purposes were clearly different between the two types of studies. Text mining analysis revealed that research without instructions aimed at instructors more than research with instructions. Overall patterns of results in the selected studies suggested positive perceptions of ChatGPT for English education. The current study could offer timely implications at the very beginning stage of integrating ChatGPT into English instructions.

title_ko: AI-mediated Narrative Writing Processes among Korean Preservice EFL Teachers
title_en: AI-mediated Narrative Writing Processes among Korean Preservice EFL Teachers
kw_en: Generative AI; Korean Preservice EFL Teachers; Process-based Writing; Sociocultural Perspective; Agency
abstract_ko: The rapid integration of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) into educational contexts has raised pressing questions about how writing processes and learner agency are reconfigured in AI-mediated environments. This study examines how Korean preservice English as a foreign language (EFL) teachers engaged with GenAI during a narrative writing task and how AI mediation functioned across stages of composing. Fourteen senior-level preservice teachers completed a take-home narrative writing task that permitted GenAI use, accompanied by process journals. A qualitative thematic analysis revealed that GenAI was used primarily as a mediational resource rather than as an autonomous text generator, with its role shifting from idea generation and meaning negotiation in early drafting to linguistic refinement during later revision. Participants demonstrated differentiated patterns of agency, ranging from dialogic and evaluative engagement with AI output to minimally mediated use characterized by uncritical adoption. The findings suggest that AI-supported writing is best understood as a process-based and dialogic activity in which educational value depends on how writers regulate and interpret AI support. The study discusses theoretical and pedagogical implications for preservice teacher education in AI-rich writing contexts.

title_ko: Authorship Judgments, Judgment Criteria, and Writing Assessment of Student- and AI-Generated English Essays by Korean EFL Teachers
title_en: Authorship Judgments, Judgment Criteria, and Writing Assessment of Student- and AI-Generated English Essays by Korean EFL Teachers
kw_en: AI-Generated Essays; Student-Written Essays; Authorship Identification; Perceived Authorship; Writing Assessment
abstract_ko: The present study examines how accurately Korean EFL teachers identify the authorship of English essays as student-written or AI-generated and explores the criteria they employ in making these judgments. It further investigates whether teachers’ perceptions of authorship influence their assessment of writing quality. The participants were 78 Korean EFL pre-service and in-service teachers, who evaluated a total of 12 essays for both authorship identification and writing quality. The results showed that teachers’ overall authorship identification accuracy was approximately 58%, only slightly above chance level, despite their relatively high level of confidence (7.13 out of 10 points). Teachers tended to associate student-written texts with limited idea development, personal and experience-based examples, and a limited vocabulary and syntactic variation, while attributing well-developed and information-rich ideas, consistent but formulaic organization, generalized content, and sophisticated vocabulary use to AI-generated texts. In addition, teachers’ perceptions of AI involvement were found to significantly influence their writing assessments. Given the limited reliability of authorship identification and the influence of perceived authorship on writing assessment, the study suggests a need to revise assessment rubrics to foreground writing process, idea development, and learner agency, while incorporating AI as a pedagogical scaffold in L2 writing instruction.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 지능정보사회의 대학 FLE 교수·학습 환경에서 요구되는 생성형 AI대화서비스의 활용 양상과 학습자 인식을 분석하는 데 그 목적이 있다. 대학에서 프랑스어를 전공 또는 교양으로 학습하는 학습자 97명을 대상으로 설문조사를 실시하여 AI 서비스의 활용 목적과 방식, 교수자 설명과의 비교를 통한 이해도와 신뢰성, AI에 부여하는 역할 및 상호작용 경험을 조사하였다. 분석 결과 응답자의 약 70%가 프랑스어 학습에 AI대화서비스를 사용하였으며, 주로 어휘·표현 탐색과 번역 등 기초 학습에서 사용하는 것으로 나타났다. 또한, 79,1%가 AI의 설명을 교수자보다 이해하기쉽다고 평가했으나, 편파성과 정보 왜곡의 가능성도 동시에 인지하며 AI에 대한 조건적 신뢰를 드러냈다. 더불어 사용 경험자의 약 45%가 AI와의 소통에서 정서적 반응을 경험하였고, 관계적 존재로 인식할수록 그 경향이 강화되었다. 이에 따라 본 연구는 대학 프랑스어 학습에서의 AI활용에 대한 사용 기준의 제안과 비판적인 접근 등을 고려한 교수·학습 설계의 확장을 제안한다.
abstract_en: Cette étude analyse les modalités d’usage et les représentations des apprenants universitaires face aux services conversationnels d’IA générative dans l’enseignement-apprentissage du FLE. Une enquête par questionnaire a été menée auprès de 97 étudiants. Elle a porté sur les objectifs et les pratiques d’utilisation, la compréhension et la confiance accordées aux explications de l’IA en comparaison avec celles de l’enseignant, ainsi que les rôles attribués à l’IA et les expériences interactionnelles. Les résultats indiquent qu’environ 70% des ré pondants ont déjà eu recours à ces services, principalement pour la recherche lexicale, phraséologique et/ou la traduction. Par ailleurs, 79,1% jugent les explications de l’IA plus faciles à comprendre que celles de l’enseignant, tout en signalant des risques de biais et de distorsion de l’information, ce qui révèle une confiance conditionnelle. Enfin, près de 45% des usagers rapportent des réactions affectives lors des échanges, tendance plus marquée lorsque l’IA est investie comme entité relationnelle. Il serait préférable d’intégrer des critères d’usage selon les types de tâches et de renforcer la littératie critique de l’IA afin d’encadrer une intégration didactique pertinente.

title_ko: 생성형 AI시대 영어교사 정체성 재구성에 관한 비판적 내러티브 고찰
title_en: A Critical Narrative Review of EFL Teacher Identity Reconstruction in the Era of Generative AI
kw_ko: 영어교사 정체성; 생성형 AI; 전문적 정체성 재구성; 사회정서적 리터러시; 비판적 디지털 리터러시; 기술적 소외

abstract_ko: 생성형 인공지능의 급격한 등장은 영어 교육 분야 내에서 심각한 존재론적 위기를 야기했다. 본 고찰은 2020~2025년의 문헌 296개 중 엄선된 37개 논문을 분석하여 기술적 격변 속 영어교사 정체성 재구성 과정을 탐색하였다. 본 연구는 인공지능을 단순히 교육 효율성을 제고하는 도구로 인식하는 기능주의적 관점을 넘어, “기계의 시대에 교사를 교사이게 하는 본질은 무엇인가?”라는 근본적인 인문학적 질문을 중심에 둔다. 코로나19 팬데믹 시기의 급격한 디지털 전환부터 최근의 미래 지향적 논의에 이르기까지의 글로벌 연구 동향을 분석한 결과, 영어 교사 정체성은 기술적 소외에서 주체적 재구성으로 이행하는 궤적을 보였다. 이와 동시에, 교사를 윤리적 조율자, 인간적 멘토, 사회정서적 안내자로 재정의하는 인문학적 역서사가 확인되었다. 이러한 전환을 지원하기 위해, 영어교사의 전문적 면역력과 정서적 회복탄력성을 함양하는 AI 매개 성찰 저널 쓰기와 디지털 웰니스 워크숍의 교사 교육 도입을 제안한다.
abstract_en: The rapid emergence of GenAI has precipitated a profound ontological crisis within the field of English language teaching. This critical narrative review analyzes 37 seminal articles selected from 296 documents (2020–2025) to explore the process of English teacher identity (ETI) reconstruction amidst technological disruption. Moving beyond a functionalist view of AI as a tool for enhancing educational efficiency, this study addresses the inquiry: “What is the essence that makes a teacher a teacher in the age of the machine?” By analyzing global research trends from the COVID-19 digital transition to current projections, the study identifies a trajectory transitioning from technical alienation toward agentic reconstruction. Concurrently, a humanistic counter-narrative redefines the teacher as an ethical orchestrator, human mentor, and socio-emotional guide. To support this shift, the review recommends the introduction of AI-mediated reflective journaling and Digital Wellness Workshops into teacher education to foster EFL teachers’ professional immunity and affective resilience.

title_ko: Effects of ChatGPT-based Speaking Task on Strategic Self-Regulation for Speaking and Satisfaction at a University English Class
title_en: Effects of ChatGPT-based Speaking Task on Strategic Self-Regulation for Speaking and Satisfaction at a University English Class
kw_ko: 챗지피티/말하기 과업/영어교육에서의 인공지능/전략적 말하기 자기조절/만족감
kw_en: ChatGPT/speaking task/AI in English education/strategic self-regulation for speaking/satisfaction
abstract_ko: The study aims to investigate the effects of a ChatGPT-based speaking task on students’ strategic self-regulation for speaking (S2RS) and their satisfaction in a university-level English class. Thirty English majors participated in the study. The speaking task, which involved interacting with ChatGPT, was conducted over a six-week period. To measure the impact of this technology-enhanced task, students completed the S2RS questionnaire twice-once before and once after the intervention. Paired-samples t-tests were used to analyze changes in the S2RS domains, and frequency analysis was employed for the satisfaction data. The research findings are as follows. Firstly, the technology-utilized task had a statistically significant positive impact on the following domains: metacognitive (remembering and planning, assistance-seeking), social (interactional practice, environmental control), and motivational (anxiety control). However, some strategies did not reach statistical significance at the p＜0.05 level, including metacognitive (goal-based monitoring and evaluation, self-reflection), social (feedback management), and motivational (interest enhancement, motivational self-talk). Secondly, the students’ overall satisfaction with the ChatGPT-based speaking task was high. with scores ranging from three to five on the scale. For future research on the differentiated impact of the ChatGPT-mediated speaking task on speaking strategies, a mixed- methods study should be conducted.
