abstract_ko: 연구목적: 본 연구는 생성형 AI 앱을 활용한 이야기글 교수를 실시하여 읽기학습장애 초등학생에게 읽기유창성과 읽기이해력에 미치는 효과를 알아보고자 하였다. 연구방법: 연구대상은 경상남도 Y시 초등학교 재학 중인 3학년 읽기학습장애 학생 중 해독에는 어려움이 없지만 읽기유창성 및 읽기이해력에 어려움을 보이는 3명의 학생이다. 연구 설계는 중다간헐기초선설계를 적용하였다. 본 연구에서는 생성형 AI 앱을 활용해 이야기글을 음성으로 변환시키기, 변환한 음성을 들으며 이야기 반복 읽기, 앱으로 그림 장면 생성하기, 이야기 문법 요소 중심으로 이야기 나누기, 이야기를 다시 말하며 요약하기 순서로 중재를 실시하였다. 연구결과: 첫째, 생성형 AI 앱을 활용한 이야기글 교수는 읽기학습장애 학생의 읽기유창성 향상에 효과적이었다. 생성형 AI 앱을 활용한 ‘시범읽기-따라읽기-혼자읽기’ 3단계 반복 읽기 활동을 함으로써 학생들의 읽기 유창성이 향상되었으며, 그 효과는 중재 종료 후에도 유지되었다. 둘째, 생성형 AI 앱으로 생성한 그림장면을 보며 이야기 문법 요소를 중심으로 이야기 나누는 과정을 통해 학생들의 읽기이해 능력이 향상되었으며, 향상된 읽기이해 능력은 중재 종료 후에도 유지되었다. 결론: 생성형 AI 앱을 활용한 이야기글 교수는 읽기학습장애 학생의 읽기유창성 및 읽기이해력 향상에 있어 효과적인 중재임을 확인할 수 있다. 따라서 읽기학습장애 학생의 읽기유창성 및 읽기이해력 향상을 위해 생성형 AI 앱을 활용한 이야기글 읽기교수가 필요함을 시사하는 바이다.
abstract_en: Purpose: This study investigated the effects of narrative text instruction using a generative AI app on reading fluency and comprehension of elementary school students with reading disabilities. Method: The study participants were three third-grade students with reading disabilities attending an elementary school in Y City, Gyeongsangnam-do. They had no difficulty with decoding, but struggled with reading fluency and comprehension. A multiple-probe design across participants was used for the study. The intervention consisted of converting narrative texts into audio using a generative AI app, repeatedly reading the text while listening to the audio, generating picture scenes using the app, sharing stories based on grammatical elements of the text, and retelling and summarizing the text. Results: First, narrative reading instruction using a generative AI app was effective in improving reading fluency in students with reading disabilities. Using the generative AI app, students’ reading fluency improved through a three-step, repeated reading activity. This improvement in reading fluency was maintained after the intervention. Second, students’ reading comprehension skills improved through the process of sharing stories centered on story grammar elements while looking at picture scenes generated by a generative AI app, and the improved reading comprehension skills were maintained post intervention. Conclusion: Storytelling using a generative AI app is an effective intervention for improving reading fluency and comprehension in students with reading related learning disabilities. This evidence highlights the importance of generative AI app in storytelling to help students with reading disabilities.

title_ko: ChatGPT와 원어민 교사의 영어 작문 피드백 비교 및 학습자 인식 연구
title_en: A Comparative Study of ChatGPT and Native English Teachers’ Feedback on English Writing and Learner Perceptions
kw_en: English writing; feedback; ChatGPT; learner perception; writing error types
abstract_ko: <abstract lang="english">This study examines the similarities and differences between feedback provided by ChatGPT and native English-speaking instructors on Korean college students’ English writing, as well as learners’ perceptions of the two types of feedback. Twenty-seven college students enrolled in a general English course participated in the study, and a total of 1,524 error instances identified in students’ English writing were analyzed. The findings show that ChatGPT provided more extensive and detailed feedback across multiple dimensions, including content, organization, language use and vocabulary, whereas native English-speaking instructors tended to focus primarily on linguistic errors. Regarding learner perceptions, students evaluated ChatGPT feedback positively for its clarity and provision of corrected examples, while expressing concerns about its occasional lack of contextual understanding and inaccurate suggestions. In contrast, feedback from native English-speaking instructors was perceived as more personalized and sensitive to learners’ intentions. Overall, the results suggest that ChatGPT has considerable potential as a supplementary tool for English writing instruction, provided that its limitations are carefully addressed through integration with human expertise.

title_ko: AI 시대 제2언어 교육을 위한 양자론적 언어 모델 개념화
title_en: Conceptualizing the Quantum Model of Language for Second Language Education in the AI Era
kw_en: Quantum Model of Language; generative AI; second language education; quantum cognition; learner agency
abstract_ko: As generative AI is increasingly being used for real-time interaction, existing SLA theories—notably Complex Dynamic Systems Theory (CDST)—face limitations in explaining the micro-mechanisms of how meaning is constructed and negotiated through language in real-time human–AI interactions. Adopting an abductive approach, this study proposes the Quantum Model of Language (QMoL) to reconceptualize language as probabilistic meaning potentials that collapse into specific form-meaning combinations through contextualized interaction. Grounded in research findings in quantum cognition, QMoL defines language use and acquisition as a cyclical process involving meaning-wave generation, contextual collapse, particle-like realization, and reintegration into the learner’s semantic field. This framework provides a parsimonious explanation for linguistic complexity, variability, creativity, and context sensitivity through the unified quantum concepts of superposition, collapse, decoherence, and entanglement. Pedagogically, the study proposes a paradigm shift from knowledge transmission to AI-enhanced prompt engineering and coaching. In this model, AI functions as a dynamic resonance field while teachers act as coaches guiding learners to exercise their agency in orchestrating their own meaning-construction processes during interaction. Implications are discussed for establishing QMoL as a coherent theoretical model for fostering learner agency, adaptive fluency, and human-centered communication in AI-mediated second language education.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 와 메타버스의 교육적 융합: 영어권 문화 이해를 위한 사례 연구
title_en: Educational Convergence of Generative AI and the Metaverse: A Case Study for Understanding English-Speaking Cultures
kw_en: artificial intelligence; metaverse; digital literacy; intercultural understanding; case study
abstract_ko: This study explores the educational convergence of generative artificial intelligence (AI) and the metaverse in a university- level English course, with the aim of enhancing students’ understanding of English-speaking cultures and their digital literacy. A 16-week course was designed and implemented, in which 30 undergraduate students collaboratively developed English cultural content using generative AI tools (e.g., Vrew, Napkin AI, Hedra AI) and constructed immersive cultural spaces within a metaverse platform. Employing a case study approach, data were collected through a post-course survey and open-ended reflections. Quantitative data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, while qualitative responses were examined through thematic analysis. The results indicate that the course significantly promoted students’ intercultural understanding, particularly in recognizing cultural diversity and developing empathetic perspectives toward people from different cultural backgrounds. In addition, students reported high levels of confidence in using digital technologies, including real-time collaboration in the metaverse and creative multimedia content production with AI tools. Qualitative findings further revealed that learners perceived generative AI not as a substitute for learning, but as a collaborative tool that supported planning, visualization, and creative expression. Overall course satisfaction was also notably high, reflecting strong learner engagement and ownership. Based on these findings, the study highlights the pedagogical value of integrating generative AI and the metaverse in English education and suggests the importance of critical digital literacy to support effective and ethical technology use in higher education contexts.

title_ko: Learners’ Perceptions of AI-Mediated Repetition and Reinforcement in Adult Functional English Learning
title_en: Learners’ Perceptions of AI-Mediated Repetition and Reinforcement in Adult Functional English Learning
kw_ko: AI 매개 반복; 기능적 영어; 성인 EFL 학습자; 학습자 인식
kw_en: AI-mediated repetition; functional English; adult EFL learners; learner perceptions
abstract_ko: This study investigates adult EFL learners’ perceptions of AI-supported repetition in functional English instruction, focusing on how repetition is experienced and interpreted within AI-mediated learning tasks. Drawing on qualitative data from open-ended questionnaires and AI-generated task outputs, the study analyzes learners’ reflections on reinforcement and its perceived impact on learning and confidence. Findings indicate that learners view AI-supported repetition as meaningful and confidence-enhancing rather than mechanical. Participants report that repeated engagement with AI-generated language supports the internalization of professional discourse patterns and reduces language-related anxiety. Learners describe using AI output as a reference point to confirm expression choices, increase familiarity with functional language, and prepare for oral performance, while also demonstrating awareness of potential overreliance or uncritical copying. The study concludes that when repetition is adaptive, contextualized, and critically mediated, AI-assisted learning can foster perceived procedural fluency and learner autonomy, offering a pedagogically sustainable model for adult functional English instruction. By foregrounding learner perceptions, the study reframes AI-mediated repetition as an adaptive and reflective process shaped by learner agency rather than as mechanical practice.

title_ko: AI 챗봇 활용이 초등학생의 영어 성취수준, 자기주도학습 능력, 의사소통의지에 미치는 영향
title_en: Investigating the Use of AI Chatbots to Enhance EFL Young Learners’ Achievement, Self-Directed Learning, and Willingness to Communicate
kw_en: AI chatbots; English achievement; self-directed learning; willingness to communicate; elementary English education
abstract_ko: <abstract lang="english">Given the growing interest in AI technology, its potential to provide interactive language environments for young EFL learners has gained increasing attention. This study investigates the effects of using AI chatbots on English achievement, self-directed learning readiness, and willingness to communicate among primary school students in Korea. 49 fifth-grade students participated, divided into an experimental group (n = 25) and a control group (n = 24). The experimental group engaged in English lessons incorporating interactive and communicative activities utilizing two types of AI chatbots—Replika and ChatGPT—for 14 sessions over one semester, while the control group participated in traditional classroom activities. The data were analyzed using ANCOVA to examine the differences between the groups. The results revealed that while there was no statistically significant difference in English achievement, the experimental group showed significant improvements in self-directed learning readiness and willingness to communicate compared to the control group. Qualitative findings further indicated that the students perceived chatbots as non-judgmental conversation partners, which helped reduce anxiety and encouraged voluntary learning interactions. Despite some technical challenges reported, the findings suggest that AI chatbots have significant potential as educational tools to enhance the affective domain and self-directed learning autonomy of young EFL learners.

title_ko: 에듀테크·생성형 AI 기반 모의 영어 수업 실연을 통한 목표 정합성을 갖춘 예비 영어교사의 디지털 및 AI 수업역량 개발
title_en: From Tool Overload to Instructional Alignment: Developing Pre-Service Teachers’ Digital and AI Teaching Competence
kw_en: EdTech; generative AI; microteaching; instructional alignment; rehearsal-based feedback
abstract_ko: <abstract lang="english">This qualitative case study investigates how EdTech and generative AI were integrated into English microteaching to develop pre-service teachers’ digital and AI teaching competencies, with particular attention to instructional alignment among learning goals, activities, and assessment. The study was conducted in an elective teacher-education course titled “Digital·AI Teaching Competency Development,” redesigned from a conventional microteaching practicum. Nineteen pre-service English teachers designed and delivered English-medium microteaching lessons incorporating EdTech and generative AI, participated in rehearsal-based feedback sessions, and completed reflective journals and semi-structured interviews. Data included lesson plans, teaching artifacts, recorded lessons, reflections, and interview transcripts. Qualitative coding and cross-case comparison identified three findings. First, generative AI functioned primarily as linguistic and structural scaffolding during preparation. Second, tools such as Padlet and Kahoot were selected in the enactment phase because they supported learner participation and formative assessment. Third, rehearsal-based feedback corrected tool-centered designs and restored alignment among learning goals, communicative tasks, and assessment. The findings suggest that the educational value of digital tools depends not on the number of technologies used but on their contribution to coherent instructional design. Implications are discussed for practice-based teacher education that emphasizes alignment-oriented planning and iterative feedback cycles.

title_ko: Designing Speech-to-Speech Pipelines for Effective English Conversation Learning: A Modular VAD–STT–LLM–TTS Perspective
title_en: Designing Speech-to-Speech Pipelines for Effective English Conversation Learning: A Modular VAD–STT–LLM–TTS Perspective
kw_ko: 음성-대-음성 변환; 영어회화 학습; 파이프라인 설계; 음성 활동 감지; 음성-텍스트 변환; 대규모 언어 모델; 텍스트-음성 변환; 교육적 파이프라인 관점의 튜터링
kw_en: speech-to-speech; English conversation learning; pipeline design; VAD; STT; LLM; TTS; pedagogical pipeline tutoring
abstract_ko: This paper reconceptualizes Speech-to-Speech (STS) systems for English conversation education through a modular pipeline lens. We argue that educational effectiveness depends on intentionally designing the VAD–STT–LLM–TTS pipeline as an integrated pedagogical system rather than treating STS as a black box. We summarize the functional roles of each component and examine how they shape key dimensions of conversation learning, including fluency, accuracy, interactional competence, affective support, and pronunciation/listening development. We also highlight cross-module dynamics such as error propagation and compensation and discuss how end-to-end latency influences learners’ sense of real-time interaction. Based on these insights, we propose practical design principles for classroom and self-study contexts, including task- and proficiency-sensitive VAD/STT settings, level-adaptive LLM prompting and feedback strategies, and activity designs leveraging controllable TTS for listen-and-repeat, shadowing, and role-play. We conclude with implications for future empirical validation and learner- and domain-specific optimization.

title_ko: 챗지피티를 통한 비판적 독해와 복합양식적 창작:신입생 대상 영문학 전공 수업 사례
title_en: Critical Reading and Multimodal Composing through ChatGPT in the First-Year English Literature Classroom
kw_en: AI pedagogy; “A Scandal in Bohemia”; multimodal literacy; prompting; intermedial practice
abstract_ko: This essay offers a case study of the experience of teaching first-year English major students Arthur Conan Doyle’s “A Scandal in Bohemia” by integrating ChatGPT into a literature exercise. One of the course’s weekly assignments asked the students (all English majors, mostly freshmen) to convert Irene Adler’s letter that appears in the ending of the short story into six-panel comic strips by writing a specific set of prompts into ChatGPT and editing the resulting images. Investigating six assignment samples whose engagement with the chatbot demonstrates each student’s different understanding of and creative relationship with the tool, the essay suggests that with the help of ChatGPT’s multimodal function to draw illustrations the students ventured into creative terrain where they could reimagine Doyle’s source story. This intermedial exercise also underlines the role of prompts, which are becoming a new writing genre. Ultimately, AI technology calls for a reconsideration of pedagogical practices and goals to utilize prompt technologies as a new writing mode for the so-called digital natives in English classes.

title_ko: 영어 에세이의 AI 채점 타당성과 영역별 채점 결과 연구
title_en: Research on the Validity of AI-based Assessment of English Essays and Probing Measurement Outcomes of Specific Scoring Dimensions
kw_en: latest models of ChatGPT; AI-based essay scoring; validation of scoring results; dimension-specific scoring; AI-based qualitative feedback
abstract_ko: This study compared the performance of three ChatGPT versions, 4.1, 5, and the latest 5.2 in evaluating EFL college students’ English essays. It also examined the validity of AI-based automated scoring by comparing the results with those of expert raters. Comparisons were conducted from both quantitative and qualitative perspectives. This study is significant in that, following earlier validation studies of initial ChatGPT models, it investigates the most recent models to date. In addition, it explores AI-based scoring outcomes across distinct components of an analytic rubric, such as content, vocabulary, and grammar, thereby extending prior research to domain-specific scoring dimensions. Quantitative findings showed that ChatGPT-4.1 performed similarly to the 5.2 model, whereas ChatGPT-5 produced contrasting scoring outcomes. Overall, the 5.2 model yielded results most closely aligned with expert ratings. In the domain-level analyses, the three models produced different rating patterns in areas requiring deep content understanding and logical organization. This suggests that concerns raised in pre-AI automated scoring research remain relevant and warrant continued attention and investigation. Differences among the three versions were also evident in the qualitative descriptive feedback. The newest model, 5.2, provided the most detailed and practically useful feedback, highlighting its relative advantage in feedback quality. The paper concludes with suggestions for many future research avenues based on the limitations of the current study.

In the domain-level analyses, the three models produced different rating patterns in areas requiring deep content understanding and logical organization. Differences among the three versions were also evident in the qualitative descriptive feedback. The newest model, 5.2, provided the most detailed and practically useful feedback, highlighting its relative advantage in feedback quality. The paper concludes with suggestions for many future research avenues based on the limitations of the current study.
note: ChatGPT 4.1/5/5.2 에세이 채점 타당성 전문가 비교

title_ko: Attention 기반 문장 집계 모델을 통한 논술형 에세이 자동채점
title_en: Attention-Based Sentence Aggregation Model for Automated Essay Scoring
kw_ko: 자동채점(AES); 논술형 평가
kw_en: Attention; TransMIL; Gated MIL; Automated Essay Scoring (AES); essay assessment
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 한국어 논술형 에세이 자동채점(AES)에서 문장 단위 임베딩을 문서 수준으로 집계하는 방식에 따라 예측 성능과 문장 정보 활용 양상이 어떻게 달라지는지를 분석하는 것을 목적으로 하였다. 이를 위하여 문장 임베딩을 비학습적으로 통합하는 단순 풀링 기반 집계 방식(Mean, Max, Min Pooling)과 문장 단위 중요도를 학습적으로 산출하는 Attention 기반 집계 방식(Gated MIL Attention, TransMIL Attention)을 적용하여 성능을 비교하였다. 분석 결과, 단순 풀링 방식은 일정 수준의 예측 성능을 보였으나 Attention 기반 집계 방식과 비교할 때 성능 지표 전반에서 뚜렷한 우위를 보이지는 않았다. 반면 Gated MIL Attention과 TransMIL Attention은 일부 성능 지표에서 상대적으로 우수한 결과를 나타냈으며, 문장 단위 정보가 동일하게 처리되기보다 가중화되거나 문장 간 관계적 맥락 속에서 활용될 수 있음을 시사하였다. 특히 Attention 기반 집계 구조를 분석한 결과, 상대적으로 높은 가중치를 부여받은 문장들이 주장 및 근거 제시와 같은 논설문 핵심 기능을 수행하는 문장들로 나타나, 문장 중요도 정보가 점수 예측뿐 아니라 에세이 구조 해석에도 활용될 수 있음을 확인하였다. 다만 본 연구는 문장 간 Attention 관계를 탐색적으로 분석한 것으로, 개별 문장의 의미적 기능이나 평가 기준과의 직접적인 대응 관계를 정량적으로 규명하는 데에는 한계가 있다. 또한 채점자 식별 정보의 부재로 인해 채점자 간 일치도 산출이나 채점자별 편차를 고려한 분석은 수행하지 못하였다. 그럼에도 불구하고 본 연구는 문장 단위 정보를 고려하는 Attention 기반 집계 구조가 AES에서 구조적으로 의미 있는 접근임을 실증적으로 제시하였다는 점에서 의의를 갖는다. 향후 연구에서는 채점자 정보가 포함된 데이터셋과 다양한 논술 유형을 활용하여 Attention 기반 집계 구조의 타당성과 일반화 가능성을 추가로 검증할 필요가 있다.
abstract_en: This study examines how prediction performance and sentence information utilization differ according to methods for aggregating sentence-level embeddings to the document level in Korean essay assessment using Automated Essay Scoring (AES). Non-trainable aggregation methods (such as Mean, Max, and Min Pooling) were compared with attention-based aggregation methods that learn sentence-level importance (such as Gated MIL Attention and TransMIL Attention). The results show that simple pooling methods achieved a certain level of performance, but they did not demonstrate consistent advantages across evaluation metrics compared with attention-based approaches. In contrast, Gated MIL Attention and TransMIL Attention performed relatively better on several metrics, indicating that sentence-level information can be more effectively utilized when sentences are differentially weighted or modeled within inter-sentence relational contexts. Result of attention-based aggregation further revealed that sentences assigned higher importance weights tended to perform core argumentative functions, such as presenting claims, providing evidence, and emphasizing key points. These findings suggest that attention-based sentence aggregation is not only beneficial for score prediction but also informative and explainable for interpreting essay structure. Despite limitations related to exploratory analysis and the absence of rater identification data, this study empirically demonstrates that attention-based aggregation constitutes a structurally meaningful approach in AES.
note: 한국어 논술 AES 성능비교, L1 쓰기평가 포함(prev N)

title_ko: Impact of generative artificial intelligence (AI) on the English writing of Korean university students: based on Activity Theory
title_en: Impact of generative artificial intelligence (AI) on the English writing of Korean university students: based on Activity Theory
kw_ko: 영어 작문; 활동 이론; 한국 대학생; 생성형 인공지능; AI 지원 작문
kw_en: English writing; activity theory; Korean university students; generative artificial intelligence; AI-assisted writing
abstract_ko: This study examines the impact of generative artificial intelligence (AI) on the English writing of Korean university students. Using activity theory as a framework, the researcher examined the writing strategies and outcomes of two groups of students: those with high English proficiency and those with average English proficiency. Adopting a qualitative case study design, the study engaged ten undergraduates from two leading Korean universities. Data were collected through interviews and essay-writing tasks, and the essays were evaluated for originality, coherence, and critical ability. The results reveal that AI tools boosted students’ confidence and efficiency in writing. However, proficiency differences shaped outcomes: high-proficiency students tended to critically evaluate AI’s suggestions, while average-proficiency students often relied on AI uncritically. Across both groups, AI enhanced fluency and grammatical accuracy but showed limitations in fostering originality. Pedagogically, the findings suggest that AI should be incorporated into English writing instruction in ways that promote critical AI literacy and emphasize human agency in writing. The study is limited by its small sample size, which restricts generalizability. Future research should expand to include larger and more diverse student populations, and compare the impact of different AI platforms (e.g., Grammarly, Gemini, and ChatGPT).
abstract_en: 본 연구는 생성형 인공지능(AI)이 한국 대학생의 영어 작문에 미치는 영향을 고찰한다. 활동 이론을 틀로 삼아 연구자는 영어 능력이 높은 학생 그룹과 평균적인 학생 그룹, 두 그룹의 작문 전략과 결과를 분석하였다. 질적 사례연구 설계를 채택하여 국내 주요 대학 두 곳의 학부생 10명을 대상으로 연구를 진행하였다. 인터뷰와 에세이 작성 과제를 통해 데이터를 수집했으며, 에세이는 독창성, 논리성, 비판적 사고 능력을 기준으로 평가되었다. 결과에 따르면 AI 도구는 학생들의 글쓰기 자신감과 효율성을 향상시켰다. 그러나 능력 차이에 따라 결과가 달라졌다. 고 능력 학생들은 AI의 제안을 비판적으로 평가하는 경향이 있었던 반면, 평균 능력 학생들은 종종 비판적 사고 없이 AI에 의존했다. 두 집단 모두에서 AI는 유창성과 문법 정확성을 향상시켰으나 독창성 함양에는 한계가 있었다. 교육학적 관점에서 본 연구 결과는 비판적 AI 활용 능력 함양과 글쓰기에서의 인간 주체성 강조를 통해 AI를 영어 작문 교육에 통합해야 함을 시사한다. 본 연구는 표본 규모가 작아 일반화 가능성에 한계가 있다. 향후 연구는 더 크고 다양한 학생 집단으로 확대하고, 서로 다른 AI 플랫폼의 영향을 비교해야 한다 (예: Grammarly, Gemini, and ChatGPT).
note: 활동이론, 대학생 10명 GenAI 영어작문 질적사례

title_ko: 중등교사의 AI 디지털교과서 사용 경험에 대한 질적 연구 -수학, 영어, 정보 교과를 중심으로
title_en: A qualitative study on the experience of using AI digital textbooks by secondary school teachers -Focusing on mathematics, English, and information subjects
kw_ko: AI 디지털교과서; 질적 연구; 중등학교; 교사 인터뷰
kw_en: AI Digital Textbooks; Qualitative research; Secondary School; Teacher Interview
abstract_ko: 본 연구의 목적은 도입 초기 단계인 AI 디지털교과서를 직접 활용한 중등교사들의 경험과 의견을 분석하고, 향후 AI 디지털교과서의 개선방안을 도출하는 데 있다. 이를 위하여 본인의 수업에서 AI 디지털교과서를 직접 활용한 경험이 있는 6명의 수학, 영어, 정보 교사들을 대상으로 AI 디지털교과서 활용 과정과 환경을 깊이 있게 탐색할 수 있는 반구조화된 질문지를 구성하여 서면 인터뷰와 심층 인터뷰를 진행하였다. 심층 인터뷰 결과는 질적 연구방법인 반복적 비교분석법을 활용하여 중등교사들의 AI 디지털교과서 활용 경험을 범주별로 분류하였다. 범주는 크게 시스템 및 인터페이스, 콘텐츠, 수업 운영 및 관리, 인프라 및 제반시설 등 4개의 범주와 16개 하위 내용을 도출하였다. 연구 결과, 교사들의 AI 디지털교과서 활용 경험을 범주별로 분류하여 살펴봄으로써 AI 디지털교과서의 공통적 경험과 교과별 특성을 파악할 수 있었고, AI 디지털교과서의 개선방안도 도출할 수 있었다. AI 디지털교과서에 대한 주요 개선방안은 공통으로 인터페이스의 단순화, 수업 재구성 기능 강화, 제반 환경 제공 필요, 교과별로는 다양한 콘텐츠 제공(수학), 교내 AI 디지털교과서 통합 관리자 지정(영어), 채점기능 강화(정보) 등을 들 수 있다. 본 연구를 통해 도입 초기 AI 디지털교과서를 활용한 교사 경험을 탐색해봄으로써 앞으로 AI 디지털교과서의 지속적 개선의 토대가 되길 기대한다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to analyze the experiences and opinions of secondary school teachers who directly used AI digital textbooks, which are in the early stages of introduction, and to derive ways to improve AI digital textbooks in the future. Interview were conducted with six teachers in math, English, and information who have directly used AI digital textbooks in their classes. Interview were conducted with a semi-structured questionnaire that allows them to explore the process and environment of using AI digital textbooks in depth. The results of the interview were classified by category using the constant comparison method, a qualitative research method. 4 categories and 16 sub-contents were derived, including system and interface, content, system and accessibility, class operation and management, and infrastructure. As a result, by classifying teachers’ experiences in using AI digital textbooks by category, they were able to grasp the common experiences of AI digital textbooks and the characteristics of each subject, and to derive ways to improve AI digital textbooks. Major improvement measures for AI digital textbooks include simplifying interfaces, strengthening class reorganization functions, providing various environments, providing various contents (mathematics), designating integrated AI digital textbooks in school (English), and strengthening scoring functions (information). Through this study, it is expected that it will serve as the basis for continuous improvement of AI digital textbooks in the future by exploring the teacher experience using AI digital textbooks in the early stages of its introduction.
note: 수학·영어·정보 교사 AIDT 사용경험, 교과 일반(prev Y)

title_ko: 데이터 기반 AI 융합 글쓰기 수업 모형 개발 및 적용
title_en: Development and application of a data-based AI-integrated writing instruction model
kw_ko: AI 융합 글쓰기 교육; AI 리터러시; 데이터 리터러시; 탐구 기반 학습
kw_en: AI-integrated writing instruction; AI literacy; data literacy; inquiry-based learning
abstract_ko: AI 기반 글쓰기 교육에 관한 선행연구는 주로 생성형 AI의 도구적 활용에 초점을 맞추고 있다. 본 연구의 목적은 학습자가 데이터를 근거로 탐구하고 글쓰기 과정에서 AI를 비판적으로 활용하며 자신의 글을 성찰할 수 있도록 지원하는 데이터 기반 AI 융합 글쓰기 수업 모형과 설계 원리를 개발하고 타당화하는 것이다. 설계․개발 연구방법론의 유형 2 모형 연구 방법을 활용해 선행연구 분석, 2회에 걸친 내적 타당화 검토 이후 도출된 모형을 4개의 집단(학교)에서 외적 타당화를 수행하여 총 437명의 중․고등학생을 대상으로 수업을 실행하였다. 본 연구에서 개발된 모형은 5E 탐구 순환 모형(Engage, Explore, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate)을 기반으로 단계별 활동을 구조화하고 AI 기반 도구가 통합되도록 설계했다. 또한, 핵심 질문 탐구, 맥락적 데이터 탐색, 데이터 분석, 비판적 비교, AI 지원 스캐폴딩, 통합 데이터 관리, 순차적 AI 도구 통합, 표현 및 공유, 윤리적 AI 실천, 메타인지적 개인화의 10가지 설계 원리를 도출하였다. 현장 적용 결과 학습자의 AI 리터러시와 글쓰기 효능감에서의 유의미한 향상을 확인할 수 있었다. 본 연구는 AI를 사고 확장, 데이터 기반 논증, 메타인지적 성찰을 지원하는 인지적 조력자로 설정하여, AI 리터러시와 글쓰기 역량을 통합적으로 함양하는 수업 모형을 제시하였다는 데 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: Previous studies on AI-assisted writing education have primarily focused on the use of generative AI tools. This study aimed to develop and validate a data-based AI-integrated writing instruction model and design principles that enable learners to explore based on data, critically use AI in the writing process, and reflect on their own writing. Using Type 2 design and development research, the study conducted literature analysis and expert validation with six specialists, followed by field implementation with 437 students across four schools. The model structures activities based on the 5E inquiry cycle (Engage, Explore, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate) and integrates AI-based tools throughout. Ten design principles were derived: essential-question inquiry, contextual data exploration, data analysis, critical comparison, AI- supported scaffolding, integrated data management, sequential AI-tool integration, expression and sharing, ethical AI practice, and metacognitive personalization. Field implementation showed statistically significant improvements in AI literacy and writing self-efficacy. This study positions AI as a cognitive facilitator supporting thought expansion, data-based argumentation, and metacognitive reflection, presenting an instructional model that integrates AI literacy and writing competency.
note: 데이터 기반 AI 융합 글쓰기 수업모형 개발·타당화, 중고생 437명

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 EFL 학습자의 단계별 글쓰기 상호작용 분석: 순서화된 네트워크 분석(ONA)의 적용
title_en: Mapping EFL learners’ writing interactions with ChatGPT across stages: An ordered network analysis
kw_ko: EFL 학습자; 영어 글쓰기; AI 활용 글쓰기; 순서화된 네트워크 분석(ONA)
kw_en: ChatGPT; EFL learners; English writing; AI-assisted writing; Ordered Network Analysis (ONA)
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 EFL 학습자가 영어 글쓰기를 수행할 때 ChatGPT와 어떤 단계적 상호작용 패턴을 보이는지, ChatGPT 피드백 통합 수준에 따라 그 양상이 어떻게 달라지는지를 탐색하고자 한다. 서울 소재 4년제 대학 학부생 13명을 대상으로 “온라인 학습은 오프라인 학습보다 더 효과적이다”라는 주제의 글쓰기를 ChatGPT만을 활용해 수행하도록 하였다. 상호작용 로그는 Guo와 Li(2024)의 4단계 글쓰기 모형(준비-편집-교정-성찰)을 기반으로, 하위 단계인 아이디어 생성, 아이디어 구성, 논리적 전개, 근거 활용, 글쓰기 스타일 교정, 오류 수정, 글 평가의 7개 범주로 코딩하였다. 담화 단위별 ChatGPT 피드백 반영 정도를 ‘직접 반영-수정 후 반영-미반영’으로 코딩하여 통합 점수를 산출하고, 상대적 순위를 기준으로 고통합(7명)과 저통합(6명) 집단으로 나누어 순서화된 네트워크 분석(Ordered Network Analysis, ONA)을 통해 단계 간 전이 구조를 시각화․정량 분석하였다. 전체 네트워크에서는 ‘글쓰기 스타일 교정’과 ‘근거 활용’이 중심 허브로 작동하며, ‘글쓰기 스타일 교정 → 아이디어 생성 → 근거 활용 → 글쓰기 스타일 교정’으로 이어지는 순환적 전이 패턴이 나타났다. 또한, 고통합 그룹에서 ‘글쓰기 스타일 교정’, ‘근거 활용’, ‘논리적 전개’ 간 전이가 두드러졌고, 저통합 그룹에서는 ‘아이디어 생성/구성’, ‘근거 활용’, ‘오류 수정’ 중심의 전이가 강조되는 경향이 나타났다. 이는 ChatGPT가 EFL 학습자의 글쓰기 과정에서 주로 언어적 표현 조정과 근거 활용을 중심으로 활용되는 경향이 있음을 보여주며, 일부 학습자에게서는 아이디어 재검토와 논리 조정으로 확장될 수 있음을 시사한다. 이러한 결과는 AI 기반 글쓰기 지원의 활용 범위와 교수 설계 방향을 논의하기 위한 기초적 시사점을 제공한다.
abstract_en: This study examines how EFL learners interact with ChatGPT across English writing stages and how these patterns vary by feedback integration level. Thirteen undergraduate students from a university in Seoul completed an argumentative writing task on the topic “Online learning is more effective than offline learning” using ChatGPT as the sole writing assistant. Interaction logs were coded using Guo and Li’s (2024) four-stage writing model (Preparation, Editing, Proofreading, Reflection), operationalized through seven subprocesses: idea generation, idea organization, logical progression, evidence use, writing style refinement, error correction, and essay evaluation. ChatGPT feedback integration was coded as direct, modified, or no integration, and participants were grouped into high- and low-integration groups based on relative scores. Ordered Network Analysis (ONA) was used to examine stage-to-stage transitions. Results showed that writing style refinement and evidence use functioned as central hubs, forming a recurring transition pattern linking writing style refinement, idea generation, and evidence use. Group comparisons indicated that transitions among writing style refinement, evidence use, and logical progression were more prominent in the high-integration group, whereas transitions centered on idea generation/organization, evidence use, and error correction were more salient in the low-integration group. Overall, the findings suggest that ChatGPT is mainly used to support linguistic expression and evidence development in EFL writing, with some learners extending its use to idea reconsideration and logical adjustment.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 탐구 기반 영어 읽기 수업이 초등학생의 비판적 영어 읽기 능력과 학습자 인식에 미치는 영향
title_en: The Effects of ChatGPT-Assisted Inquiry-Based English Reading Instruction on Elementary Students’ Critical Reading Skills and Learner Perceptions.
kw_en: Generative AI; inquiry-based learning; critical reading; elementary English education; learner autonomy
abstract_ko: This study examines the impact of an inquiry-based English reading program using ChatGPT on elementary learners’ reading proficiency and perceptions. Conducted over four weeks with 5th-grade students, the study employed a mixed-methods approach combining pre- and post-tests with post-interviews. Results revealed significant improvement in learners' reading abilities, particularly in contextual understanding and inference-making. ChatGPT interactions boosted learners’ confidence, reduced anxiety, and fostered autonomy and metacognitive strategies. However, differentiated scaffolding was needed to accommodate varying levels of digital literacy and language proficiency. While AI acted as a motivating learning partner, effective integration required tailored prompts and leveled reading materials. This study may provide a practical framework for integrating AI into primary English education and could contribute to redefining the roles of teachers, learners, and technology in future classrooms.

title_ko: AI 디지털 환경에서의 영어 사용과영어 인식 및 사용자 정체성 변화
title_en: English Use in AI-Mediated Digital Environmentsand Shifting Perceptions of Englishand English User Identity
kw_ko: AI 디지털 영어사용; 플랫폼 기반 영어 사용; 영어 사용자 정체성; AI 매개 언어사용; 비판적 디지털 리터러시
kw_en: AI Digital English Use; Platform-Based English Use; English User Identity; AI-Mediated Language Use; Critical Digital Literacy
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 AI 기반 디지털 환경에서 이루어지는 영어 사용 경험이 대학생들의 영어 인식과 영어 사용자로서의 정체성 변화에 어떤 영향을 미치는지에 대해 탐구하였다. 디지털 기술과 생성형 AI를 매개로 한 영어 사용이 일상화된 오늘날, 영어교육의 새로운 방향을 설정하기 위해서는 기존의 규범 중심 영어관에서 벗어나, 디지털 환경에서 학습자들이 실제로 경험하는 영어 사용 양상과 그 의미에 주목할 필요가 있다. 이를 위해 본 연구는 서울 소재 한 대학의 수업을 사례로, 생성형 AI와 디지털 플랫폼을 매개로 영어 의사소통 활동을 수행한 학생들의 성찰 노트와 기말 프로젝트 보고서를 분석 자료로 수집하였다. 수집된 자료에 대해서는 주제 분석법을 적용하여 질적 분석을 실시하였다. 본 연구의 분석 결과에 따르면 학습자들은 영어를 문법적 정확성을 중심으로 학습해야 할 대상이 아니라, 디지털 맥락에 따라 의미를 구성하고 조정하는 자원으로 인식하고 있는 것으로 나타났다. 또한 플랫폼의 특성에 따라 영어 사용 방식이 달라져야 함을 인식하며, 맥락에 기반한 담화 실천의 필요성을 자각하고 있었다. 더 나아가 학습자들은 생성형 AI와의 상호작용을 통해 영어 사용자로서의 주체성과 비판적 판단의 중요성을 인식하였으며, 자동 생성된 언어를 수동적으로 수용하기보다 이를 검토하고 재구성하는 능동적이고 실천적인 영어 사용자 정체성이 필요하다는 것을 인식하고 있었다. 본 연구는 AI 디지털 환경에서의 영어 사용을 언어, 기술, 정체성의 상호 관계 속에서 분석함으로써, 향후 영어교육과 디지털 리터러시 연구에 대한 방향성 및 시사점을 제시한다.
abstract_en: This study explores how college students’ experiences of using English in AI-driven digital environments reshape their perceptions of English and their identities as English users. As digital technologies and artificial intelligence have become everyday conditions for English use, understanding the meaning of English and the formation of English user identity based on learners’ actual experiences in digital contexts has become essential for re-orienting the goals of English education, beyond traditional norm-centered views of the language. To this end, a qualitative analysis was conducted using thematic analysis of reflection notes and final project reports collected from students enrolled in a university course related to digital society and English, where learners engaged in English communication through generative AI and digital platforms. The findings reveal that learners no longer perceived English primarily as an object of grammatical accuracy-focused learning, but rather as a resource for meaning making in relation to specific digital contexts. They also demonstrated an increased awareness of the need for context-dependent discourse practices, recognizing that English use must be adjusted according to platform-specific norms and communicative purposes. Furthermore, through interaction with generative AI, learners actively evaluated and modified AI-generated English, which led them to recognize the importance of an English user identity grounded in agency and practical decision-making. By examining English use in AI-mediated digital environments through the interrelated dimensions of language, technology, and identity, this study offers implications for the future direction of English education and research on digital literacy.

journal: The International Journal of Internet, Broadcasting and Communication
title_ko: Trends, Research Issues and Applications of AI-based Primary English Education
title_en: Trends, Research Issues and Applications of AI-based Primary English Education
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence in English Education (AIEE); Primary English Education; Narrative Review; Generative AI; AI Digital Textbooks (AIDT); Normalization
abstract_ko: This study conducts a narrative review of domestic empirical literature of the past decade to explore the current state and future directions of AIEE for primary learners. Utilizing a multi-dimensional coding framework, the research analyzes 103 studies in terms of general research, educational, and implicational contexts. The findings reveal a chronological evolution categorized into three phases ranging from early inception to recent accelerated growth driven by generative technologies and digital policies. Methodologically, the result demonstrates a strong preference for mixed methods and quantitative approaches, focusing on verifying educational impacts and efficacy. Regarding educational context, AI applications have predominantly focused on productive skills, particularly speaking and writing, while consistently yielding significant positive impacts on the affective domain by reducing anxiety and increasing learners' willingness to communicate. The study further highlights a transition toward blended and flipped learning models that integrate commercial platforms and recent generative AI tools. Consequently, we demonstrate through our results underscore the impending normalization of AI-assisted language learning(AIALL), necessitating a paradigm shift in the teacher’s role from a primary linguistic source to a facilitator and coach.

title_ko: 초등교원임용시험 대비 LLM 기반 영어 문항 생성기에 대한 예비교사의 인식 조사
title_en: Pre-service Teachers’ Perceptions of an LLM-based English Item Generator for the Elementary Teacher Certification Examination
kw_ko: 초등교원임용시험; 문항 생성기; 포 에이아이; 프롬프트 리터러시; 디지털·AI 리터러시
kw_en: elementary teacher certification examination; item generator; Poe AI; prompt literacy; digital·AI literacy
abstract_ko: 본 연구에서는 초등교원임용시험 영어 문항 생성을 위해 LLM 기반 문항 생성기를 설계하는 실습에 참여한 예비교사25명의 경험과 인식을 조사하였다. 1시간 동안 진행된 실습에서 모든 참여자가 실제로 작동 가능한 문항 생성기를완성하였으며, 과반의 참여자들(88%)이 개발 난이도를 ‘보통이다’ 또는 ‘(아주) 쉬웠다’고 평가하여 적절한 연수 지원이제공될 경우 누구나 초등임용 대비 문항 생성기를 충분히 개발할 수 있음을 시사하였다. 생성 문항의 질에 대한평가는 전반적으로 긍정적이었으며, 86%는 ‘조금 고쳐쓰면 쓸만하다 생각했다’ 또는 ‘나름 훌륭했다’고 응답하였고부정적 평가는 거의 나타나지 않았다. 개방형 설문에서는 문항 생성기의 다양한 활용 방안이 제시되었다. 다만, 생성된문항에서 제시된 답안의 모호성, 개념 제시의 불충분, 단순화된 문항 패턴, 간헐적 시스템 불안정성, 세밀한 의미구분의 한계 등도 제한점으로 보고되었다. 또한, 참여자들은 해당 도구가 단답형 및 빈칸 채우기형 문항에 가장적합하다고 응답하였다. 연구결과를 종합하면, 본 연구에서 제공한 LLM 기반 실습만으로도 초등임용시험 준비를위한 효과적인 보조 도구의 개발이 가능했으며, 프롬프트 리터러시뿐 아니라 예비·현직교사 디지털 및 AI 리터러시함양에도 기여할 수 있다는 교육적 함의를 가진다
abstract_en: This study examined the experiences and perceptions of 25 pre-service teachers who participated in the design of an LLM-based English item generator for the Elementary Teacher Certification Examination. During the one-hour practicum, all participants successfully created a functioning generator. Most participants (88%) rated the development difficulty as “moderate” or “(very) easy,” indicating that most users could develop the tool, provided that appropriate training support is offered. Participants largely reported positive perceptions of item quality. Of these, 86% said the items were “usable with minor edits” or “good,” and negative views were rare. Open-ended responses were used to identify the various applications. The reported limitations included ambiguous answer options, incomplete concept specifications, simplified item patterns, occasional system instability, and inaccuracies in fine-grained distinctions. Participants viewed the tool as being best suited for short-answer and cloze formats. Overall, this LLM-based practicum is an efficient supplemental resource for preparing for the Elementary Teacher Certification Examination. This provides a practical means of developing prompt literacy and fostering broader digital and AI literacy in pre-service and in-service teacher education programs.

title_ko: Exploring Students’ Experiences in an AI-Supported Project-Based English Class
title_en: Exploring Students’ Experiences in an AI-Supported Project-Based English Class
kw_ko: 프로젝트 기반 학습; 인공지능 도구; 학습자 경험; 영어교육; 교사 퍼실리테이션
kw_en: Project-based learning; Artificial intelligence tools; Student learning experiences; English education; Teacher facilitation
abstract_ko: This study examines university students’ learning experiences in an English course that incorporated artificial intelligence tools within a project-based learning framework. Conducted over six weeks at a Korean university, the course involved eighteen undergraduate students from diverse non-English majors, none of whom were English majors and most of whom were lower-proficiency learners who utilized ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Naver Papago, and Natural Readers to complete collaborative projects on global inequality. Data were gathered through seventeen questionnaires, sixteen group journals, and seventeen reflection notes, then analyzed thematically. Findings revealed two primary experiential dimensions: supportive and challenging. In the supportive dimension, students reported enhanced engagement and confidence as they co-constructed knowledge through AI-assisted collaboration under teacher guidance. Students experienced new ways of organizing and expressing language while developing prompt literacy through iterative AI interaction. In the challenging dimension, participants described initial confusion in formulating AI queries and occasional over-reliance on generated outputs. The study emphasizes the critical role of systematic teacher facilitation, prompt construction instruction, and reflective practice in enabling learners to use AI tools meaningfully and responsibly in project-based English learning environments.

title_ko: 국내 대학 교양 영어 교육의 인공지능(AI) 활용 연구 동향 －체계적 문헌고찰
title_en: AI Research Trends in Korean University General English Education : A Systematic Review
kw_ko: 인공지능; 대학 교양 영어 교육; 하이브리드 교수전략; 체계적 문헌분석
kw_en: ChatGPT; Artificial Intelligence (AI); University General English Education; Hybrid Teaching Strategies; Systematic Review
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 국내 대학 교양 영어 교육 분야의 인공지능(AI) 활용 연구 동향을 체계적으로 고찰하고, 기술 중심 패러다임을 넘어 학습자 중심 교육으로의 이행을 위한 과제를 제언하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 PRISMA 가이드라인에 의거, 2019년부터 2025년까지 국내 학술지에 게재된 논문 50편을최종 분석 대상으로 선정하였다. 분석 결과, 2022년 말 ChatGPT의 등장을 기점으로 관련 연구가 급격한양적 팽창을 보였으며, 주로 영어 쓰기의 문법적 정확성, 어휘 다양성, 논리적 구성력 향상 효과에집중된 것으로 나타났다. 방법론적으로는 혼합 연구가 활발히 이루어진 반면, 장기적 언어 습득 효과를규명하는 종단적 접근은 상대적으로 미비하였다. AI의 즉각적인 맞춤형 피드백은 주요 강점으로 확인되었으나, 정보 왜곡, 기술 의존도 심화, 비판적 사고력 저하 등은 해결해야 할 과제로 도출되었다. 이러한결과를 바탕으로 본 연구는 언어 4대 기능의 균형 있는 연구 확대, AI를 인지 확장형 ‘학습 파트너’로재개념화할 것, 그리고 교수자의 역할을 ‘하이브리드 전략 설계자’ 및 ‘데이터 리터러시를 갖춘 학습코치’로 재정의할 것을 제언한다. 본 연구는 향후 AI 기반 교양 영어 교육 과정 설계를 위한 기초자료로서 학계와 현장에 실천적 가치를 제공한다.
abstract_en: This study aims to systematically review research trends regarding the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in general English education at Korean universities and suggest future directions for transitioning from a technology-centered paradigm to learner-centered education. Following the PRISMA guidelines, 50 articles published in domestic academic journals from 2019 to 2025 were selected for the final analysis. The results indicate that research has expanded rapidly since the emergence of ChatGPT in late 2022, primarily focusing on enhancing grammatical accuracy, lexical diversity, and logical organization in English writing. Methodologically, while mixed-methods research has been actively conducted, longitudinal approaches to investigate long-term language acquisition effects remain relatively scarce. Although AI’s immediate and personalized feedback was identified as a key strength, challenges such as information distortion (hallucination), technological overdependence, and the weakening of critical thinking were highlighted as critical tasks to be addressed. Based on these findings, this study suggests: expanding research across all four language skills, reconceptualizing AI as a “learning partner” that extends cognitive abilities, and redefining the instructor's role as a “hybrid strategy designer” and “learning coach equipped with data literacy.” This study provides foundational data with academic and practical value for designing future AI-integrated general English curricula.
note: 대학 교양영어 AI 연구 50편 PRISMA 체계적 문헌고찰

title_ko: 과정 중심 교양 영어 수업에서 ChatGPT 활용 학습 경험 분석 －Writing-for-Speaking 전이 기반 PAIL Model 적용 사례
title_en: Examining Learning Experiences in a Process-Based Liberal Arts English Course Integrating ChatGPT : A Case Study of a Writing-for-Speaking Transfer-Based PAIL Model
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 과정 중심 학습; 교양 영어 수업; 학습 경험
kw_en: ChatGPT; Generative AI; Process-based learning; Liberal arts English course; Learning experiences
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 AI(ChatGPT)를 활용한 과정 중심 교양 영어 수업에 Writing-for-Speaking 전이기반 PAIL 모델(Process-based AI-mediated Language Learning Model)을 적용하고, 학습자의 학습경험과 그 효과를 분석하는 데 목적을 둔다. PAIL 모델은 초안 작성, AI 피드백, 수정, 성찰, 말하기수행을 하나의 연속적 학습 과정으로 구조화한 수업 설계 모형으로, 이를 대학 교양 영어 말하기 중심수업에 적용하였다. 본 연구는 2025학년도 2학기 교양 영어 교과목 수강생 22명을 대상으로 하였으며, 학기 말 설문조사(15문항)와 학습 과정 중 작성된 소감문을 통해 자료를 수집하였다. 분석 결과, 학습자들은 ChatGPT를 활용한 과정 중심 과제 활동을 통해 이해도 향상, 표현 정교화, 오류 인식 증진 등인지적 수행의 향상뿐 아니라 학습 동기, 참여도, 수행 자신감과 같은 정의적 측면에서도 긍정적인변화를 경험한 것으로 나타났다. 이러한 결과는 AI 지원이 과정 중심 과제 구조 속에서 학습자의근접발달영역(ZPD) 내에서 상호작용적 비계로 기능하며 수행 범위를 점진적으로 확장한 데서 기인한것으로 해석된다. 본 연구는 생성형 AI 활용 수업의 효과를 결과 중심이 아닌 학습 과정과 학습 경험의변화로 조명함으로써, 교양 영어 교육에서 AI 통합 과정 중심 수업 설계에 시사점을 제공한다.
abstract_en: This study examines learning experiences in a process-based liberal arts English course integrating generative AI (ChatGPT) through the application of a Writing-for-Speaking transfer-based Process-based AI-mediated Language Learning (PAIL) Model. The PAIL Model is an instructional framework that structures drafting, AI-mediated feedback, revision, reflection, and speaking performance as a continuous learning process and was implemented in a university-level English speaking course. The study was conducted during the second semester of the 2025 academic year with 22 undergraduate students. Data were collected through an end-of-semester survey consisting of 15 items and reflective learning journals produced during the learning process. The results indicate that learners experienced improvements in cognitive performance, including enhanced comprehension, refined expression, and increased error awareness, as well as positive affective changes such as increased motivation, participation, and performance confidence. These findings suggest that AI support functioned as interactive scaffolding within learners’ zones of proximal development (ZPD) in process-based tasks. By conceptualizing generative AI as a mediator of learning processes rather than an outcome-generating tool, this study offers pedagogical implications for process-centered instructional design in AI-integrated liberal arts English education.
note: PAIL 모형 Writing-for-Speaking 22명 설문·소감문

title_ko: Discourse Connectives in Korean University EFL Learners’ Oral Presentation Scripts: A Pre-LLM Baseline for AI-Assisted Revision
title_en: Discourse Connectives in Korean University EFL Learners’ Oral Presentation Scripts: A Pre-LLM Baseline for AI-Assisted Revision
kw_ko: 담화 연결어; 학습자 코퍼스; LLM 확산 이전 기준선; AI 보조 수정
kw_en: Discourse connectives; Learner corpus; Pre-LLM baseline; AI-assisted revision
abstract_ko: As generative AI is increasingly integrated into education, the need to develop learners' ability to critically evaluate and self-directly revise AI-based texts is growing. Accordingly, this present study aims to establish a learner-driven revision model based on digital critical thinking. To this end, oral presentation scripts written by Korean university EFL learners were analyzed to examine the frequency, functional distribution, and lexical concentration of discourse connectives. A learner corpus (KULC) was constructed based on presentation scripts (totaling 21,203 tokens) written by 84 nursing and health science students on major-related topics in 2021, before the widespread adoption of AI-based writing tools. Discourse connectives were classified into additive, adversative, causal, and sequential connectives according to the classification system of Larsen-Freeman and Celce-Murcia (2015) and extracted using AntConc. The analysis results showed that discourse connectives in the additive and sequential categories were most frequently used, particularly high-frequency expressions such as "and," "also," "first," and "second." Conversely, adversative and causal connectives were used less frequently, and lexical diversity was limited due to a reliance on specific expressions such as "but" and "therefore." Based on these results, this study proposed a rubric to promote balanced use of discourse connectives across functional categories. Ultimately, this rubric will help learners evaluate and refine their AI-assisted presentation scripts independently. This self-directed process will strengthen both discourse cohesion and rhetorical clarity, leading to a much more effective presentation delivery.

title_ko: From Awareness to Application: University Students’ Conceptualizations of AI in English Education
title_en: From Awareness to Application: University Students’ Conceptualizations of AI in English Education
kw_ko: 인공지능; AI 리터러시; 영어교육; 성찰적 글쓰기; 동료 피드백
kw_en: Artificial intelligence (AI); AI literacy; English education; reflective writing; peer feedback
abstract_ko: Despite growing interest in AI adoption in higher education, limited research has examined how university students conceptualize the pedagogical meaning of AI beyond measures of attitudes and user satisfaction. This study explored how Korean university students conceptualized AI in English education through analysis of 40 reflective essays and 80 peer feedback comments collected across four instructional contexts. Qualitative thematic and constant comparative analysis identified four recurrent perspectives: AI as an efficiency tool, a source of risk or limitation, a catalyst for pedagogical reconfiguration, and a vision for future English education. While all perspectives appeared across contexts, their relative emphasis varied by instructional role. Students writing as learners focused on efficiency and risk; those considering policy stressed ethical guidelines; and those positioned as prospective teachers proposed practical classroom and materials design strategies. Peer feedback supported conceptual development by encouraging critical reflection and refinement of pedagogically actionable ideas. Overall, the findings suggest that students view AI not merely as a technical aid but as a pedagogical agent connected to autonomy, ethics, assessment, and teacher–learner dynamics, highlighting the need for instructional designs that foster AI literacy through guided reflection and peer feedback.

title_ko: Integrating ChatGPT into College English Learning : Effects on Language Anxiety, Self-Regulated Learning, and Learner Perceptions
title_en: Integrating ChatGPT into College English Learning : Effects on Language Anxiety, Self-Regulated Learning, and Learner Perceptions
kw_ko: 언어 학습 불안감; 자기조절학습; 대학영어
kw_en: ChatGPT; language anxiety; self-regulated learning; college English
abstract_ko: This study examined the effects of integrating ChatGPT into college English classes over one semester, focusing on changes in students’ perceptions of ChatGPT, language anxiety, and self-regulated learning strategies, as well as the relationships among these variables after integration. Thirty-seven first-year students participated in ChatGPT-supported reading and writing courses. From Weeks 3 to 13, students used ChatGPT to explore vocabulary meanings, construct sentences using newly learned expressions, and engage in text-based discussions on weekly topics. Pre-post questionnaires were administered, consisting of three sections: (1) English learning anxiety, (2) self-regulated learning, and (3) perceptions of ChatGPT. Adopting a pre-post questionnaire design, the study employed paired-samples t-tests and correlation analyses to assess changes and associations among the variables. The findings showed that students developed more positive attitudes toward ChatGPT as a language learning tool. Correlation analyses indicated strong to moderate within-domain relationships after ChatGPT use, whereas cross-domain correlations were relatively weak. These results underscore the need for explicit pedagogical guidance to reduce language anxiety and strengthen self-regulated learning in L2 contexts.

title_ko: 일본어 교직 관련 과목 수강생의 수업 설계 보완을 위한 하이브리드 AI 활용 전략 연구 ― ChatGPT와 Gemini의 피드백 유형 비교를 기반으로 ―
title_en: A Study on Hybrid AI Utilization Strategies for Enhancing Lesson Design in Japanese Teacher-Education Courses: Based on a Comparative Analysis of Feedback Types from ChatGPT and Gemini
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 일본어교육; 예비 교사 교육; 수업 지도안; AI 피드백 비교
kw_en: Generative AI; Japanese language education; pre-service teacher education; lesson plan; comparative analysis of AI feedback; ChatGPT-5.2 Thinking; Gemini 3 Pro
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 AI가 교수 설계의 파트너로 부상한 환경에서, 예비 일본어 교사의 수업 지도안 개선에 활용되는 AI 피드백의 특성을 실증적으로 분석하고 하이브리드 활용 전략을 도출하는 데 목적이 있다. 분석 대상은 일본어과 교직 관련 과목 수강생 14명이 작성한 일본어 수업 지도안 14건이며, ChatGPT-5.2 Thinking(Extended)과 Gemini 3 Pro(Thinking+Deep Research)에 동일한 실험 프롬프트와 동일한 출력 형식을 적용해 피드백을 산출하였다. 산출된 피드백은 ‘수정･제안･격려･질문’의 성격, ‘세부 표현･수업 설계’의 초점, ‘추상･구체’의 구체성 수준을 기준으로 내용 분석하였다. 또한 지도안은 수업 설계의 구조성과 학습자 참여성에 따라 교과서 준거형, 참여 유도형, 참여+구조 균형형, 구조 완결형으로 분류하고, 유형에 따른 피드백 양상의 차이도 함께 검토하였다. 분석 결과, ChatGPT는 수업 흐름의 개연성을 확장하고 상호작용 시나리오를 구체화하는 등 생성적 멘토링 성격의 조언이 두드러졌다. 반면 Gemini는 외부 정보 참조를 바탕으로 사실 관계와 시간 배분의 논리성을 점검하는 구조적 감사 성격의 조언이 두드러졌다. 이러한 차이는 일본어교육에서 중요한 문화 맥락 반영, 화용적 적절성 점검, 활동-평가의 연결 강화와 같은 요소에서 특히 뚜렷하게 나타났다. 본 연구는 예비 교사가 두 도구의 기능과 피드백 성향을 전략적으로 조합하는 ‘AI 오케스트레이터(조율자)’ 역량이 중요함을 시사하며, 수업 설계 단계에 따른 최적 도구 활용 모델을 제안한다. 나아가 생성형 AI를 단일 도구로 평가하기보다, 서로 다른 강점을 통합해 지도안의 완성도를 높이는 하이브리드 접근의 실천적 타당성을 실증 자료로 뒷받침한다.
abstract_en: In this study, I investigate how generative-AI feedback can support improved lesson plans developed by pre-service Japanese language teachers. I also propose hybrid-use strategies for instructional design. The dataset comprises 14 Japanese lesson plans produced by students in a teacher-education-related course. Using a single experimental prompt and a standardized output format, I used feedback generated with ChatGPT-5.2 Thinking (Extended) and Gemini 3 Pro (Thinking+Deep Research) and analyzed the content in terms of feedback function, focus, and specificity. Based on structural coherence and learner-participation design, the lesson plans were also classified into four types—textbook-aligned, participation-driven, balanced participation--structure, and completed structure. Results show that ChatGPT provided generative mentoring by strengthening lesson-flow plausibility and elaborating interactive scenarios. Gemini fact-checked and validated the logic of time allocation through external sources to provide structural auditing. These differences were evident in cultural-context integration, pragmatic appropriateness, and activity-assessment alignment. In this study, I highlight the importance of AI-orchestrator competencies and propose a stage-based model for tool use to enhance the quality of lesson plans.
note: 일본어 예비교사 지도안 ChatGPT·Gemini 피드백 비교

title_ko: AI 일한 번역에서의 정도부사 처리 양상과 교육 실천 방안 모색 - ChatGPT를 중심으로 -
title_en: Processing Patterns of Degree Adverbs in AI Japanese–Korean Translation and Pedagogical Implications - Focusing on ChatGPT -
kw_en: Japanese degree adverbs; Korean Correspondence Patterns; Translation Patterns; Pedagogical Implications; 日本語の程度副詞; ChatGPT; 韓国語の対応 様相; 翻訳の処理様相; 教育実践の方案
abstract_ko: 本稿では、ChatGPTによる日韓翻訳を中心に、程度副詞の処理様相を考察した。そ の結果は以下のようである。 韓国語に対応する場合、｢あまり｣と｢とても｣を除く程度副詞は、主に｢꽤(kkawe)｣ に統一される傾向を示す。しかし、プロンプトの違いによる差異も見られ、｢とても｣ ｢なかなか｣｢だいぶ｣はプロンプト4において、｢あまり｣｢かなり｣｢けっこう｣｢ずいぶん ｣はプロンプト3において意味の分布が拡張される。 翻訳における語順の変化は、ChatGPTと人間翻訳の｢なかなか｣においては生じず、 ｢あまり｣と｢だいぶ｣において最も多く見られる。これは、この副詞が他の副詞に比べ 文頭に出現しやすい構文的特徴によるものである。 添加の現象は人間翻訳よりもChatGPTにおいて多く現れ、特に｢かなり｣における発 生が著しいことが分かった。これは｢かなり｣が名詞を修飾する傾向によるものであ り、またプロンプト4において主に現れることから、副詞と表現を中心に翻訳する場 合、程度副詞の意味の補強が活発に行われることが分かる。 ChatGPTにおける変用は｢だいぶ｣を除くすべての副詞において確認されるが、人間 翻訳と比較するとその頻度は極めて低かった。ただし、ChatGPTの変用が一部であると はいえ、こういう傾向は人間翻訳に同じような意味深い変化として注目すべきである。 程度副詞自体の誤訳は、ChatGPTと人間翻訳のいずれにおいても見られず、｢あま り｣｢かなり｣｢だいぶ｣の含む文において他の要素による誤用が一部確認される。しかし その全体的な比率は極めて低く、翻訳の正確性は相当の水準であることが示される。
abstract_en: This study examines how degree adverbs are processed in Japanese–Korean translation by ChatGPT, and the results are as follows. In terms of correspondence with Korean, most degree adverbs-except ‘あまり(amari)’ and ‘とても(totemo)’-tend to be rendered uniformly as ‘꽤’(kkwae). However, differences according to the prompt was observed: ‘とても/なかなか(nakanaka)’, and ‘だいぶ(daibu)’ expanded in Prompt 4, whereas that of ‘あまり/かなり(kanari)/けっこう (kekkou)’, and ‘ずいぶん(zuibun)’ expanded in Prompt 3. In terms of word order variation, no changes occurred in ‘なかなか’ in either ChatGPT‘s or human translations, while ‘あまり’ and ‘だいぶ’ commonly showed the highest frequency of variation in both. This is attributed to a syntactic characteristic that two adverbs appear frequently at the beginning of a sentence. Additions occurred more frequently in ChatGPT’s translations than in human translations. Particularly the frequency was high in ‘かなり’, which can be attributed to its syntactic tendency to modify nouns. Also this phenomenon appeared mainly in Prompt 4, indicating that the semantic reinforcement of degree adverbs occur more actively when translation focuses on adverbs and expressions. Transformations occurred in all adverbs except ‘だいぶ’ in ChatGPT‘s translations, although their frequency was much lower than in human ones. However, despite the limited transformations in ChatGPT, this tendency carries significant implications as it represents a meaningful shift toward human translations. No mistranslations of the degree adverbs themselves were observed in either ChatGPT’s or human translations, although misuse caused by other elements occurred in embedded clauses containing ‘あまり’, ‘かなり’, and ‘だいぶ’. Nevertheless, the overall proportion of such errors was very low, showing a high level of translation accuracy.

title_ko: AI 기반 영어 발표 학습활동이 메타인지 전략에 미치는 영향
title_en: The impact of AI-based English presentation learning activities on metacognitive strategies
kw_ko: 영어 발표/AI 기반 학습활동/메타인지 전략/대학생
kw_en: English presentation/AI-based learning activities/metacognitive strategies/college students
abstract_ko: This purpose of the study is to examine the effect of AI-based English presentation learning activities on students’ metacognitive strategies. A total of 60 first-year students enrolled at D University in Chungcheong Province engaged in English presentation tasks using AI-based learning activities. The students used AI in the process of preparing for English presentations and completed four English presentation tasks. For the study, pre- and post-surveys related to metacognitive strategies and two English presentation tests were administered. The results indicated that learners’ English presentation ability improved after participating in AI-based learning activities. Overall metacognitive strategy use showed a significant increase with significant gains in planning, monitoring, and evaluating strategies, but not in problem-solving. Students also reported positive experiences, noting improvements in pronunciation accuracy, tone, speaking fluency, and confidence, as well as increased opportunities for independent learning. However, some concerns were raised regarding the reliability of AI feedback and the unnatural pronunciation or intonation compared to native speakers. One pedagogical implication of this study is that explicit instruction should be provided to promote the use of a range of metacognitive strategies, and that speaking tasks appropriate to learners’ English proficiency levels should be designed to ensure the effectiveness of AI-based activities.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 과업 중심 영어 쓰기 활동이 예비 영어교사의 글쓰기 수행과 인식 변화에 미치는 영향
title_en: The impact of ChatGPT-integrated task-based writing on the writing achievement and perceptions of preservice English teachers
kw_ko: ChatGPT 기반 영어 쓰기 지도/과업 중심 언어 교수법/예비 영어 교사/쓰기 수행/학습자 인식
kw_en: ChatGPT-based English writing instruction/task-based language teaching/ preservice English teachers/writing performance/learner perceptions
abstract_ko: This study investigates the effects of ChatGPT-integrated Task-Based Language Teaching (TBLT) on preservice English teachers’ writing performance and perceptions. While generative artificial intelligence (GAI) has emerged as a transformative tool in language education, empirical evidence regarding its integration with specific pedagogical models like TBLT remains limited. Employing a mixed-methods research design, this study examined whether GAI-supported writing tasks lead to measurable improvements in writing outcomes and how learners perceive this instructional approach. Data were collected from preservice teachers through pre- and post-writing assessments, pre- and post-perception surveys, and semi-structured interviews to capture learner experiences. Results showed significant improvements in writing, especially in content and accuracy. Survey findings also indicated positive changes in perceptions, supporting the high acceptance of ChatGPT as an instructional tool. Qualitative data from the interviews corroborated these findings, illustrating how ChatGPT functioned as an interactive scaffold that reduced psychological barriers, increased confidence, and promoted learner autonomy throughout the writing process. These findings suggest that integrating ChatGPT into TBLT can effectively enhance writing performance and foster positive professional perceptions among preservice teachers. This study provides empirical support for incorporating GAI into English teacher education and offers practical implications for designing effective GAI-integrated writing pedagogy in teacher education contexts.

title_ko: 생성형 AI와의 음성 상호작용이 영어 말하기 능력과 인식에 미치는 효과
title_en: The Effect of Voice Interaction with Generative Artificial Intelligence(GenAI) on English-Speaking Competence and Perception
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 영어 말하기 능력; 정확성; 유창성; 원 미닛 페이퍼
kw_en: Generative Artifical Intelligence(GenAI); English-speaking competence; accuracy; fluency; one-minute paper(OMP)
abstract_ko: <abstract lang="english">This study investigates the impact of Generative Artificial Intelligence(GenAI) voice interaction on English-speaking competence and perception in an English communication course. Thirty-five Korean university students in the experimental group engaged in GenAI conversations as end-of-class takeaways using a one-minute paper(OMP) approach, while 32 control group students completed the OMP without GenAI assistance. The study assessed speaking competence and perception of GenAI usefulness. The results showed that the experimental group made more gains in vocabulary complexity using diverse vocabulary(root type-token ratio) and rich words(lexical density) as well as syntactic complexity(the ratio of clauses per T-units) at the final assessment. Improvements in accuracy were observed, with clause-level accuracy(error-free clauses) at the midterm and T–unit-level accuracy at the final assessment(p = .048, 95% CI [-.00, .99]), with the latter showing marginal significance. In contrast, the control group outperformed only in lexical density at the midterm. In addition, the experimental group perceived that GenAI conversations helped improve speaking fluency and accuracy. Regression analysis further revealed that GenAI conversations were associated with fewer verb errors at the final assessment. These findings suggest that targeted GenAI use as end-of-class takeaways can potentially enhance productive language skills, supporting diverse, sophisticated, and meaningful language use.

title_ko: Back-Translation Activities in EFL Reading Classes: Effects on Students’ Perceptions on AI-Integrated English Learning
title_en: Back-Translation Activities in EFL Reading Classes: Effects on Students’ Perceptions on AI-Integrated English Learning
kw_en: AI; English reading; proficiency; learner perception; back-translation
abstract_ko: This study investigated back-translation activities in an English reading course and explored learners’ perceptions of AI use across different proficiency levels. Adopting a mixed-methods approach, the study collected quantitative and qualitative data through pre- and post-surveys administered to university students enrolled in a general English course. The analysis examined changes in learners’ AI-related abilities as well as their perceived benefits and limitations of AI-based translation activities. Overall, the findings indicate that integrating AI into reading instruction can enhance learners’ engagement with English texts and promote more effective and critical use of AI tools, regardless of proficiency level. At the same time, learners’ perceptions of AI varied depending on their English proficiency, particularly in terms of how AI was utilized and evaluated during reading tasks. These results suggest the pedagogical potential of AI-based reading activities while highlighting the need for instructional designs that account for learner characteristics and provide appropriate guidance to support meaningful and responsible AI use in language learning contexts.

title_ko: 生成AIを活用した日本語教育における学習プロセスと学習者認識の変容の質的研究 ― 人間中心のAI教育の視座から ―
title_en: Learning Processes and Changes in Learner Perceptions in Japanese Language Education Using Generative AI: A Qualitative Study from a Human-Centered AI Education Perspective
kw_en: 生成AI、日本語教育、人間中心のAI教育、クリエイティブ・ラーニング、質的研究; Generative AI; Japanese language education; Human-centered AI Education; Creative Learning; Qualitative Analysis
abstract_ko: 先行研究の多くは、生成AIの技術的特性や活用方法に焦点を当てる傾向が強く、生成AI活用が学習者の学びそのものにどのような変容をもたらすのか、特に学習者の内面的認識や学習プロセスの変化を時間的・発達的に捉えた研究は十分とは言えない。本研究は、生成AIを日本語教育に導入すること自体を目的とするのではなく、人間の学びを中心に据えた視点から、生成AIが教育実践の中でどのような役割を果たし得るのかを明らかにすることを目的とする。 分析対象は、2024年度第1学期に韓国の大学で開講された「コミュニケーション日本語」の授業において実施された、生成AIを活用したプロジェクト型学習の実践である。本研究では、三つの学生グループによる活動発表資料、中間レポート、期末レポートという三層のデータを用い、生成AIとの関わり方の違いが学習プロセスおよび学習者認識にどのような変容をもたらしたのかを質的に分析した。 その結果、生成AIは一様に学習効果を生み出す存在ではなく、①協働や関係性を促進する媒介、②判断や検証を促す思考対象、③内省と自己調整を支える支援装置という、複数の役割を取り得ることが明らかとなった。これらの差異は学習者の能力差によるものではなく、学習活動の設計および生成AIの位置づけ方によって生じていた。本研究は、生成AIを学習を代行する主体としてではなく、人間の思考・対話・内省を支える媒介として捉える「人間中心AI教育」の有効性を、日本語教育の具体的実践を通して示すものであり、生成AI時代の日本語教育における学習観および教育設計の再検討に示唆を与える。
abstract_en: Research on generative AI in Japanese language education has primarily focused on its technological features and instructional applications. However, limited attention has been paid to how generative AI reshapes learners' learning processes and internal perceptions over time. Addressing this gap, the present study examines the pedagogical roles that generative AI can play in language learning from a human-centered perspective. The study analyzes a project-based learning course conducted in the first semester of 2024 in a Japanese language class (“Communication Japanese”) at a university in Korea. The dataset consists of three layers of learner-produced materials from three student groups: presentation slides (PPTs), midterm reports, and final reflection reports. Through qualitative analysis, the study explores how different forms of engagement with generative AI influenced learners' learning processes and perceptions. The findings indicate that generative AI does not lead to uniform learning outcomes. Rather, depending on the instructional design and the positioning of AI within learning activities, it assumes three pedagogical roles: (1) a mediator that facilitates collaboration and interpersonal interaction, (2) a cognitive object that stimulates judgment and critical examination, and (3) a support device that encourages reflection and self-regulation. These differences were not determined by learners' proficiency levels but emerged from how generative AI was pedagogically framed within the learning environment. The study argues that generative AI should not be understood as an agent that replaces learning but as a mediating resource that supports human thinking, dialogue, and reflection. By empirically linking the concept of human-centered AI education with classroom practice in Japanese language education, the study offers theoretical and pedagogical implications for rethinking instructional design and learning perspectives in the era of generative AI.

title_ko: TOST-P 기법을 적용한 AI 생성 문항과 인간 출제 문항의 심리측정적 동등성 분석 ― Gemini 3.0 Pro를 활용한 JLPT N2 어휘 문항 평가를 중심으로 ―
title_en: Beyond Generation to Reasoning: Psychometric Equivalence of JLPT Items Developed via Gemini 3.0 Pro's “Deep Think” Mode
kw_ko: 자동 문항 생성(AIG); 심리측정적 동등성; 일본어능력시험(JLPT)
kw_en: AI; automated item generation (AIG); psychometric equivalence; TOST-P; JLPT
abstract_ko: 본고에서는 생성형 AI 중 하나인 Gemini 3.0 Pro의 ‘Deep Think(심층 추론)’를 통해 생성한 일본어능력시험(JLPT) N2 수준의 어휘 문항을 인간 전문가가 제작한 문항과 통계적 기법을 통해 비교 분석하여 AI가 개발한 문항이 심리측정적으로 동등한 품질을 담보할 수 있는가를 실증적으로 검증했다. 기존의 거대언어모델(LLM) 기반 문항 생성 연구는 주로 영어권 언어를 대상으로 수행되어 왔기 때문에 일본어와 같은 고맥락 언어 특유의 복합적인 뉘앙스와 오답 설계 논리를 구현하는 데에는 한계가 있었다. 이에 본고에서는 단순 텍스트 생성을 지양하고, AI가 인간 출제자의 사고 과정을 모사하여 학습자의 오류 패턴을 추론하고 검증하는 ‘추론 강화 에이전트 워크플로우’를 제안하고자 한다. 그 결과 일본어 학습자 120명을 대상으로 수행한 대응 표본 실험에서 TOST-P기법을 활용해 동등성을 검증한 결과, AI가 생성한 문항이 인간 제작 문항과 통계적으로 유의미한 동등성을 확보한 것을 확인할 수 있었다. 여기서 무엇보다 주목할 점은 문항 반응 분석에서 AI 문항이 인간 문항보다 오히려 더 높은 변별도와 오답지 매력도를 기록했다는 사실이다. 이는 AI가 학습자의 음운적･형태적 오개념을 정교하게 시뮬레이션하여 기능적 오답을 설계할 수 있다는 것을 의미하는 것으로, 따라서 본 연구는 AI를 단순 보조 도구로 사용하는 것을 넘어, 고품질의 평가 도구를 주도적으로 설계하는 ‘교육적 에이전트’로 활용할 수 있음을 실증했다는 데에 그 의의가 있다고 할 수 있겠다.
abstract_en: This study empirically investigates the psychometric equivalence of Japanese Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) N2 vocabulary items generated via Gemini 3.0 Pro's “Deep Think” capability compared with those developed by human experts. Existing research on large language model (LLM)-based item generation has been predominantly Anglocentric, often failing to address the complex nuances and distractor design logic required for high-context languages such as Japanese. To address this limitation, we propose a “Reasoning-Enhanced Agentic Workflow” that transcends simple text generation by emulating the cognitive processes of human examiners to infer and validate learner error patterns. A paired-sample study involving 120 Japanese learners utilized the TOST-P method, confirming that AI-generated items achieved statistical equivalence to human-generated benchmarks. Significantly, item response analysis revealed that the AI items exhibited superior discrimination indices and distractor attractiveness. These findings indicate that the model can effectively simulate phonological and morphological misconceptions to engineer functional distractors. Consequently, this study establishes the value of AI not merely as an auxiliary tool but as a primary “educational agent” capable of autonomously architecting high-quality assessment instruments.

title_ko: 생성형 언어모델을 활용한 수능 영어 자동문항생성에서 난이도 통제 방안 탐색
title_en: Exploring Variable-Based Difficulty Control in Automatic Item Generation for CSAT English Using Generative Language Models
kw_ko: 자동문항생성; 생성형 언어모델; 수능 영어 영역; 난이도 통제
kw_en: Automatic Item Generation; Large Language Model; CSAT English; Difficulty Control
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 언어모델 기반 자동문항생성에서 난이도를 체계적으로 통제하기 위한 변인 기반 방안을 탐색하고 그 효과성을 검증하였다. 수능 영어 영역 관련 선행 연구를 바탕으로 10개 난이도 변인을 선정하고, 2021~2025학년도 수능 및 모의평가 135개 문항을 분석하여 변인별 3수준 경계값을 도출하였다. 이를 프롬프트 체이닝, 생각의 사슬 프롬프팅, 정적 지식 증강 프롬프팅을 활용한 6개 모듈의 문항 생성 절차에서 활용하였다. 고등학교 영어 교사 9명의 평가 결과, 생성 문항은 평균 2.938점(4점 만점)으로 실제 문항(3.448점)과 0.509점의 차이를 보였으며, 전체 예측 정답률 차이는 2.14%p로 유사한 난이도 수준이 확인되었다. 본 연구는 추상적 난이도 지시에 의존하던 기존 접근의 한계를 넘어 정량적 난이도 통제 기준을 제시한 초기 연구로서 의의를 가지며, 향후 문항 유형별 차별화된 통제 전략의 필요성을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study explored a variable-based approach for controlling difficulty in automatic item generation using generative language models. Ten quantifiable variables were selected from prior CSAT English research, and 135 items from 2021-2025 CSAT and mock exams were analyzed to derive three-level threshold values. These were applied in a six-module framework using prompt chaining, chain-of-thought prompting, and static knowledge augmentation prompting. Evaluations by nine high school English teachers showed generated items scored an average of 2.938 points (out of 4), differing by 0.509 points from the actual items (3.448 points). The predicted correct answer rate differed by 2.14%p overall. This study offers quantitative difficulty control criteria beyond abstract instructions, suggesting differentiated strategies by item type are needed.

title_ko: Improving L2 Writing Through Artificial Intelligence: Comparing AIDT and ChatGPT Feedback
title_en: Improving L2 Writing Through Artificial Intelligence: Comparing AIDT and ChatGPT Feedback
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence; automated written feedback; L2 writing; AIDT; ChatGPT; feedback; middle school
abstract_ko: This study examines two AI-driven written feedback tools—ChatGPT and AI Digital Textbooks (AIDT)—by comparing their effects on Korean middle school students’ English writing performance and perceptions. Over six weeks, fifty seventh graders completed six expository writing tasks and received feedback from either ChatGPT or AIDT. Pre- and post-tests and questionnaires assessed changes in writing performance and affective factors, including motivation, self-efficacy, metacognition, and anxiety. Results showed significant improvement in both groups with large effect sizes, although overall post-test scores did not differ. Subcomponent analyses revealed that ChatGPT better supported content and idea development, while AIDT was stronger in grammar and cohesion. ChatGPT users also reported higher motivation, self-efficacy, and perceived usefulness. Overall, both tools supported L2 writing, but with distinct pedagogical strengths: AIDT promoted accuracy through structured, rule-based feedback, whereas ChatGPT provided adaptive, dialogic feedback encouraging higher-order thinking. These findings suggest that tool selection should align with learners’ proficiency levels and instructional goals across different stages of writing.
abstract_en: This study examines two AI-driven written feedback tools—ChatGPT and AI Digital Textbooks (AIDT)—by comparing their effects on Korean middle school students’ English writing performance and perceptions. Over six weeks, fifty seventh graders completed six expository writing tasks and received feedback from either ChatGPT or AIDT. Pre- and post-tests and questionnaires assessed changes in writing performance and affective factors, including motivation, self-efficacy, metacognition, and anxiety. Results showed significant improvement in both groups with large effect sizes, although overall post-test scores did not differ. Subcomponent analyses revealed that ChatGPT better supported content and idea development, while AIDT was stronger in grammar and cohesion. Overall, both tools supported L2 writing, but with distinct pedagogical strengths: AIDT promoted accuracy through structured, rule-based feedback, whereas ChatGPT provided adaptive, dialogic feedback encouraging higher-order thinking. These findings suggest that tool selection should align with learners’ proficiency levels and instructional goals across different stages of writing.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 매개 ESP 수업 설계를 통한 비전공 교수자의 하이브리드 전문성 형성: 3개년 종단 사례 연구
title_en: Developing hybrid expertise through generative AI-mediated ESP course design: A three-year longitudinal case study of a Bio-health English course
kw_ko: instructor professional development/생성형 인공지능; 특수목적영어(ESP); 하이브리드 전문성; 교수설계; 교수자 전문성 발달
kw_en: generative AI; English for specific purposes (ESP); hybrid expertise; instructional design; instructor professional development
abstract_ko: This longitudinal case study examines how a non-specialist English for Specific Purposes (ESP) instructor, trained in English education but with limited disciplinary expertise in Bio-Health, designed and refined an ESP course through the integration of generative AI over a three-year period (2023–2025). Using a mixed-methods approach, the study analyzed changes in instructional design practices and student perceptions. Data sources included annual student surveys, instructional materials, and the instructor’s reflective journals. Findings indicate that generative AI functioned as an external cognitive resource that reduced disciplinary content burden and supported instructional decision-making. Over time, instructional focus shifted from compensating for content limitations to structuring learning experiences through AI-supported design decisions, particularly in reading, vocabulary instruction, and project-based learning. Student perceptions of course effectiveness and major relevance increased, with the most positive evaluations following AI-supported project implementation in 2025. These changes are conceptualized as AI-mediated hybrid expertise, referring to professional knowledge in which pedagogical expertise is reconfigured through AI-supported access to disciplinary knowledge.
