title_ko: LLM 합성 선호도 데이터 기반 직접 선호도 최적화를 활용한 영어 서답형 튜터링 피드백 생성
title_en: English Tutoring Feedback Generation Using Direct Preference Optimization Based on LLM-Synthesized Preference Data
kw_ko: 영어 서답형 튜터링; 거대언어모델; LLM 기반 피드백 생성; 직접 선호도 최적화; 데이터 합성
kw_en: English tutoring; LLM; LLM-based feedback generation; Direct preference optimization; Data synthesis
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 영어 서답형 튜터링에서 학생의 오답에 대해 교육적으로 유의미한 피드백을 생성하기 위한 80억개 파라미터 이하의 소규모 LLM 최적화 방법을 제안한다. 기존 피드백 생성 연구는 전문가 피드백 레이블에 크게 의존하여 데이터 구축에 많은 시간과 비용이 소요되는 한계가 있다. 이를 해결하기 위해 영어 서답형 튜터링 벤치마크 데이터셋(DIRECT-M)을 활용하여 다양한 파라미터 규모의 LLM으로 피드백 후보를 생성한 뒤, 교육적 유의미성 평가 기준이 프롬프트로 제공된 GPT-5.1로 고품질·저품질 피드백을 선별하여 선호도 데이터를 구축하였다. 이후 구축된 선호도 데이터를 기반으로 직접 선호도 최적화(DPO)를 적용하여 LLaMA-3B/8B 기반 피드백 생성 모델을 학습하고 그 효과를 검증하였다. 실험 결과, 피드백 데이터 생성 단계에서 대규모 LLM이 소규모 LLM보다 교육적으로 더 유의미한 피드백을 생성하는 것으로 확인되었다. 또한, 선호도 데이터 기반 DPO는 소규모 LLM이 교육적 기준에 정렬된 피드백을 생성하도록 유도하여, 전문가 피드백과 의미적으로 더 유사하면서도 교육적으로 더 유의미한 피드백을 생성하도록 강화함을 자동평가 방식과 전문가 평가를 통해 확인하였다.
abstract_en: This study proposes a method for optimizing small-scale LLMs (< 8B parameters) to generate pedagogically meaningful feedback for students' incorrect answers in English open-ended tutoring. Existing feedback generation research relies on expert feedback labels, which results in high time and cost for data construction. To tackle this issue, we use the English open-ended tutoring benchmark dataset (DIRECT-M) to generate feedback candidates with LLMs of various parameter sizes, and then deploy GPT-5.1 to select high-quality and low-quality feedback based on feedback evaluation criteria to construct a preference dataset. Subsequently, direct preference optimization (DPO) is leveraged to train feedback generation models based on LLaMA-3B/8B, and the effectiveness of the approach is validated. Experimental results show that large-scale LLMs tend to outperform small-scale LLMs in the pedagogically meaningful feedback generation. Additionally, preference data-based DPO effectively tunes small LLMs to generate more pedagogically aligned feedback, resulting in feedback that is more semantically similar to expert feedback and more pedagogically meaningful based on automated and expert evaluation.
note: 영어 서답형 튜터링 피드백 생성 소규모 LLM DPO 최적화

title_ko: ChatGPT 기반 구두 복습 활동이 영어 말하기 동기 조절과 인식에 미치는 영향
title_en: The Impact of ChatGPT Oral Review Activities on English Speaking Motivational Regulation and Perception
kw_ko: 동기 조절; 영어 말하기 인식; 유창성; 특수목적 영어
kw_en: ChatGPT; motivational regulation; English speaking perception; fluency; English for Specific Purposes(ESP)
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 AI ChatGPT 기반 구두 복습 활동이 특수목적 교양 영어 수업에서 말하기 동기 조절과 말하기 인식에 미치는 영향에 대해 탐색하였다. 수강자 80명(실험반 42명, 통제반 38명)을 대상으로 수업 마무리 단계에서, 실험반은 ChatGPT와 음성 대화를 통한 복습 활동을, 통제반은 전통적 복습을 수행하였다. 모든 학습자들은 네 요인으로 구성된 말하기 동기(말하기 과제 가치 활성화, 교실 외 환경, 정서, 교실 환경)조절에 대한 자기 평가서에 학기 3회(초, 중, 말) 응답하였고, 실험반 학습자들은 ChatGPT와의 음성 대화가 영어 말하기에 도움이 되었는지에 대한 자기 평가를 2회(중, 말) 수행하였다. 연구 결과, 첫째, 실험반과 통제반 모두 학기 말 시점에서 말하기 동기 네 요인에서 유의미한 향상을 나타냈다. 다만, 중간 시점 이후로도 실험반은 말하기 과제 가치 활성화, 정서, 교실 환경 동기 조절에서 유의미한 향상을 나타내며 다차원적인 변화를 보였으나, 통제반은 정서 동기 조절에서만 유의미한 향상을 보여 제한적인 변화를 나타냈다. 집단 간 비교에서, 실험반은 학기 말 시점에서 말하기 과제 가치 활성화와 교실 환경 동기 조절에서 통제반보다 통계적으로 유의하게 높은 수준을 보였다. 둘째, 실험반 학습자들은 ChatGPT와의 음성 대화를 통해 영어 말하기 정확성과 유창성이 향상되었다고 인식하였고 유의미한 변화를 나타냈다. 셋째, 더 나아가, 다중 회귀 분석 결과는, ChatGPT와의 음성 대화를 통해 유창성이 향상되었다고 인식한 학습자일수록 중간 시점에서 교실 외 환경 동기와 기말 시점에서 모든 네 동기 요인에서 더 나은 결과를 보였다. 본 연구를 통해 ChatGPT 기반 구두 복습 활동은 학습자의 말하기 정확성 유창성 인식을 증가시키고 이는 자기 주도적 말하기 동기 조절을 촉진할 수 있는 효과적인 교수전략으로 활용될 가능성을 보여준다.
abstract_en: This study explores the impact of ChatGPT-assisted oral review on speaking motivational regulation and perception in a general English for Specific Purposes course. Eighty students participated, with the experimental group(42 students) engaging in ChatGPT-assisted oral review and the control group(38 students) performing traditional review tasks. Both groups self-reflected English speaking motivational regulations(task value activation, out-of-class learning environment, affect, class learning environment) at three time points (beginning, middle, and end of the course). Additionally, the experimental group rated perceived usefulness of ChatGPT for English speaking accuracy and fluency in the middle and at the end of course. Results revealed that both groups significantly improved motivational regulations at the end of the course. However, the experimental group maintained significant gains in task value activation, affect, and class environment motivational regulations at the end of the course, while the control group demonstrated significant improvement only in affect. Between-group comparisons revealed that the experimental group showed significantly higher levels of speaking task value activation and classroom environment regulation at the course’s end. Furthermore, the experimental group perceived ChatGPT oral interactions as beneficial for improving speaking accuracy and fluency, with statistically significant increases. Finally, multiple regression analyses indicated that the perceived fluency improvement predicted higher levels of out-of-class learning environment regulation in the middle and all four motivational regulations at the end of the course. Overall, the findings suggest that ChatGPT-based oral review activities may function as an effective instructional strategy that enhances learners’ perceptions of speaking accuracy and fluency and supports self-regulated speaking motivation.
note: ChatGPT 음성 구두복습 실험·통제 말하기 동기

title_ko: AI 기반 영어회화 애플리케이션 활용 수업에 참여한 대학생의 경험: 현상학적 연구
title_en: University Students’ Experiences in Classes Using AI-Based English Conversation Applications: A Phenomenological Study
kw_ko: 주요어 AI; 영어회화; 경험; 대학생; 현상학적 연구
kw_en: Key Words AI; English Conversation; Experience; University Students; Phenomenological Study
abstract_ko: 연구목적 본 연구는 AI 기반 영어회화 애플리케이션을 활용한 수업에 참여한 대학생들의 학습 경험을 현상학적으로 탐색하고, 그 경험이 지니는 의미 구조를 심층적으로 이해하고자 수행되었다. 연구방법 Colaizzi(1978)의 현상학적 연구 방법을 적용하여, AI 기반 영어회화 수업을 경험한 대학생 10명을 대상으로 심층 면담을 실시하고 자료를 분석하였다. 결과 참여자들의 경험은 총 5개 범주와 10개의 주제로 구조화되었다. 참여자들은 기존의 평가 중심 영어 학습 환경에서 느꼈던 심리적 부담에서 벗어나, 비교적 안전한 환경 속에서 발화를 시도하고 점진적으로 자신감을 형성하는 경험을 하였다. 또한 AI가 제공하는 즉각적 피드백과 반복적 발화 과정은 자신의 언어를 인식하고 문장 구조를 이해하는 계기로 작용하였다. 한편, 시공간의 제약이 없는 학습 환경은 학습 접근성을 높이고 자기주도적 학습을 가능하게 하였으나, 동시에 학습 지속에 대한 자기조절의 어려움을 동반하는 것으로 나타났다. 더불어 음성 인식 오류와 반복적인 콘텐츠는 학습 몰입을 저해하는 요인으로 작용하였으며, 참여자들은 보다 개인화되고 정교한 학습 지원에 대한 요구를 나타내었다. 결론 이러한 결과는 AI 기반 영어회화 학습이 단순한 도구 활용을 넘어, 학습자의 정서적, 인지적 경험이 상호작용하며 재구성되는 복합적 학습 과정임을 보여준다. 특히 학습자가 평가받는 존재에서 발화를 시도하는 주체로 전환되는 경험은 AI 기반 언어교육이 지니는 중요한 교육적 의미를 시사한다. 따라서 향후 AI 기반 영어교육에서는 개인화된 콘텐츠 설계와 함께 학습 지속을 지원하는 구조적 장치가 병행될 필요가 있다.
abstract_en: Purpose This study aims to explore the learning experiences of university students who participated in an AI-based English conversation course and to gain an in-depth understanding of the meaning structures underlying those experiences from a phenomenological perspective. Methods Colaizzi’s (1978) phenomenological method was employed, and in-depth interviews were conducted with ten university students who had experienced AI-based English conversation learning. The collected data were systematically analyzed. Results The findings revealed that the participants’ experiences were structured into five categories and ten themes. The participants described a shift from anxiety-provoking, evaluation-centered learning environments to a relatively safe space in which they were able to initiate speaking and gradually build confidence. In addition, the immediate feedback provided by AI, along with repeated speaking practice, enabled learners to become more aware of their own language use and to develop a deeper understanding of sentence structures. While the flexible learning environment, free from temporal and spatial constraints, enhanced accessibility and supported self-directed learning, it also introduced challenges related to sustaining engagement and self-regulation. Furthermore, speech recognition errors and repetitive content were identified as factors that hindered learning immersion. The participants also expressed a need for more personalized and sophisticated learning support. Conclusion AI-based English conversation learning extends beyond the mere use of technological tools and should be understood as a complex learning process in which learners’ affective and cognitive experiences are dynamically reconstructed. In particular, the transition from being evaluated learners to active speakers highlights an important pedagogical implication of AI-mediated language learning. Accordingly, future AI-based English education should incorporate not only personalized content but also structured support systems to sustain learners’ engagement over time.
note: AI 영어회화 앱 수업 대학생 경험 현상학

title_ko: AI 기반 수업에서 중등 영어 교과서 학습 목표 구현 가능성에 대한 교사 인식 탐색 연구
title_en: Teachers’ Perceptions of the Feasibility of Implementing Secondary English Textbook Learning Objectives in AI-Based Instruction: An Exploratory Study
kw_en: AI-based instruction; generative AI; textbook learning objectives; teacher perceptions; feasibility of implementation; English education; AI-assisted learning; .
abstract_en: This exploratory study investigates teachers’ perceptions of the feasibility of implementing learning objectives from Korean secondary English textbooks in AI-based instruction. Learning objectives were extracted from selected textbooks and then used as prompts to generate beginner-, intermediate-, and advanced-level instructional materials through a generative AI model. A survey was conducted with in-service English teachers in order to examine their perceptions of objective clarity, level alignment, goal coherence, and practical classroom applicability in actual teaching contexts. The results indicate that teachers generally perceive textbook learning objectives as useful and meaningful reference points in AI-assisted instruction. AI-generated materials were considered beneficial for scaffolded activities, differentiated tasks, and level-adjusted input, although concerns were raised regarding contextual sensitivity, instructional appropriateness, and output consistency, particularly at higher proficiency levels. As a small-scale exploratory study, this research identifies overall tendencies in teacher perceptions rather than directly verifying actual effectiveness. The findings suggest the need for further research involving larger samples, real classroom implementation, and more detailed learner outcome analysis in diverse educational settings.
note: 교과서 학습목표 기반 생성형AI 자료의 구현 가능성 교사 설문

title_ko: 대학 글쓰기 교육에서 생성형 AI 활용의 일례: 실용문 고쳐쓰기를 통해 살펴본 학습자의 인식과 활용 양상을 중심으로
title_en: An Example of Generative AI Application in University Writing Education: Focusing on Learners' Perceptions and Application Patterns through Practical Writing Revision
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 챗GPT; 대학글쓰기; 실용문쓰기; 고쳐쓰기
kw_en: Generative AI; ChatGPT; University Writing; Practical Writing; Revision
abstract_ko: 최근 생성형 인공지능의 급속한 확산으로 인간의 창의적 활동뿐만 아니라 대학 글쓰기 교육 전반에도 큰 변화를 가져오고 있는 실정이다. 무엇보다 학습자들이 대학 글쓰기 수행 과정에서 생성형 AI를 활용하는 현상이 일반화되었다. 그로 인하여 대학 글쓰기 교육 현장에서는 이러한 기술을 어떻게 교육적으로 활용할 것인지와 원칙적 활용 금지에 대한 논의와 연구가 활발하게 진행 중이다. 이에 이 연구에서는 경남 소재 G대학에서 2025학년도 2학기에 운영된 [실용문쓰기] 교과목 수강생 63명을 대상으로 설문과 생성형 AI를 활용한 문종별 글쓰기 과제 분석을 진행하였다. 우선, 학습자 스스로 생성형 AI의 활용 없이 다양한 실용문을 수업 시간에 직접 작성하여 LMS로 제출하게 하였고, 이후 고쳐쓰기 단계에서만 생성형 AI를 활용할 수 있게 하였다. 이 연구에서는 이 같은 일련의 글쓰기 과정에서 생성형 AI에 대한 학습자들의 인식과 생성형 AI 활용의 교육적 가능성을 탐색해 보았다. 나아가 문종별 고쳐쓰기 과정에서 나타나는 생성형 AI의 활용 빈도와 활용 방식, 학습자의 인식 변화를 비교 분석하였다. 연구 결과, 학습자들은 고쳐쓰기 단계에서 생성형 AI를 전반적으로 유용한 보조 도구로 인식하고 있음을 확인할 수 있었다. 고쳐쓰기 단계에서는 비교적 높은 비율로 생성형 AI를 활용하는 경향을 보였다. 다만, 생성형 AI의 활용 시간은 문종별로 차이는 있으나 전반적으로 20분 이내의 단기적 활용에 머물렀으며, 결과물에 대한 최종 만족도의 차이도 확인되었다. 특히, 구조적 명료성이 요구되는 글쓰기의 고쳐쓰기에서는 AI의 활용 효과에 대한 만족도가 높게 나타났으나, 창의성이나 개인적 정서 표현이 중요한 글에서는 상대적으로 AI 활용에 대한 신중한 태도가 확인되었다. 이러한 결과는 생성형 AI를 글쓰기 전 과정에 무분별하게 적용하기보다 학습자의 주체적 사고를 전제로 고쳐쓰기 단계에서 제한적으로 활용하는 교육 모형이 보다 타당함을 시사한다. 이는 ‘사고의 외주화’를 막을 수 있는 하나의 방법이 될 수 있기 때문이다.
abstract_en: The recent rapid proliferation of generative artificial intelligence (GAI) is bringing about significant changes not only to human creative activities but also to university writing education as a whole. Above all, the use of generative AI by learners in the process of university writing has become commonplace. Consequently, active discussions and research are underway in the field of university writing education regarding how to utilize this technology educationally and, in principle, prohibit its use. In this study, a survey and an analysis of writing assignments by text type were conducted on 63 students enrolled in the [Practical Writing] course at G University in Gyeongnam during the second semester of the 2025 academic year. Learners were instructed to write various practical texts directly during class time without the use of generative AI and submit them via the LMS, allowing them to utilize generative AI only during the revision stage. Through this process, this study explored learners' perceptions of generative AI and the educational potential of its use. Furthermore, it compared and analyzed the frequency and methods of generative AI utilization and changes in learners' perceptions during the revision process for each text type. The study results confirmed that learners generally perceive generative AI as a useful auxiliary tool during the revision stage. They showed a tendency to utilize generative AI at a relatively high rate during this phase. However, while the duration of AI usage varied by text type, it generally remained short-term, lasting less than 20 minutes, and differences in final satisfaction with the output were also observed. In particular, satisfaction with the effectiveness of AI was high during the revision of writing requiring structural clarity, whereas a relatively cautious attitude toward AI use was observed in writing where creativity or the expression of personal emotions is important. These results suggest that an educational model utilizing generative AI restrictively during the revision stage, premised on the learner's independent thinking, is more valid than indiscriminately applying it to the entire writing process. This is because it can serve as a method to prevent the "outsourcing of thinking."

title_ko: 생성형 AI 접목 팀 기반 글쓰기 모듈의 설계·개발과 효과 분석 - 단계별 프롬프트 템플릿과 성찰일지 기반 접근
title_en: Design, Development, And Effect Analysis Of A Generative AI-Integrated Team-Based Writing Module － A Stepwise Approach Using Prompt Templates And Reflective Journals
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 대학 글쓰기; 팀 기반 글쓰기; 프롬프트 템플릿; 성찰일지; 선별적 반영; 윤리·출처·검증
kw_en: generative AI; university writing; team-based writing; prompt templates; reflective journals; selective adoption; ethics-sources-verification
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 교양필수 <글쓰기와 표현> 수업의 팀 기반 사회문제 리포트 과제에 생성형 AI를 접목한 3-6주차(총 4주) 단계별 글쓰기 모듈을 설계·개발하고 AI를 ‘초안 대체’가 아닌 점검·수정·보완을 위한 협업 도구로 위치시킨 수업 설계 운영 결과를 바탕으로 관찰된 성과와 잔존과제를 분석하는 데 목적이 있다. 연구 대상은 수도권 C 대학교 수강생 69명(분반 A 35명, 분반 B 34명)이며 팀 단위로 개요, 서론, 본론, 결론을 단계적으로 산출했다. 각 단계에서 프롬프트 템플릿을 적용해 구조·독자·근거·문체를 점검하고 팀 토론을 거쳐 ‘선별적 반영’을 수행하도록 운영했으며 성찰일지와 사전·사후 설문 및 오픈형 설문을 수집해 기술통계와 서술적 내용으로 해석하였다. 사전 조사에서 AI 사용 경험은 A 분반 81.3%, B 분반 74.3%로 높았으나 윤리·출처 인지는 A 분반 40.6%, B 분반 54.3%로 낮게 나타났다. 사후 조사에서는 AI 활용의 자연스러움(A 87.5%, B 88.2%), 학습 효율(A 90.6%, B 88.2%), 수업 만족·향후 활용 의지(A 96.9%, B 94.1%)가 높게 보고된 반면 윤리 이해·실천은 A 53.1%, B 60.6%로 상대적으로 낮았다. 또한 성찰일지 분석에서 AI 활용 기능은 개요의 발상·구조화에서 서론 요건 점검, 본론의 근거·논증 보강, 결론의 요약·문체 편집으로 이동했으며 AI 반영은 전반적으로 ‘부분 반영’이 우세하되 최종 단계에서 고의존과 최소 활용이 함께 관찰되었다.
abstract_en: This study aims to design and develop a stepwise writing module (Weeks 3-6; four weeks) that integrates generative AI into a team-based social-issue report assignment in the general education required course Writing and Expression, and to analyze the outcomes and remaining challenges of an instructional design that positions AI not as a substitute for drafting but as a collaborative tool for checking, revising, and refining texts. The participants were 69 students at C University in the Seoul metropolitan area (Section A: 35, Section B: 34), who produced an outline, introduction, body, and conclusion in stages as a team. At each stage, prompt templates were applied to review structure, audience orientation, evidence, and style; teams then engaged in discussion to implement the principle of “selective adoption.” Data included reflective journals and pre-/post-tests along with open-ended surveys, which were interpreted through descriptive statistics and descriptive content analysis. In the pre-survey, AI use experience was high (Section A: 81.3%, Section B: 74.3%), whereas awareness of ethics and source use was low (Section A: 40.6%, Section B: 54.3%). In the post-survey, perceived naturalness of AI use (A: 87.5%, B: 88.2%), learning efficiency (A: 90.6%, B: 88.2%), and class satisfaction and intention for future use (A: 96.9%, B: 94.1%) were reported as high, while ethics understanding and practice remained relatively low (A: 53.1%, B: 60.6%). Reflective-journal analyses showed that AI functions shifted from ideation and structuring in the outline stage to genre-requirement checks in the introduction, evidence and argumentation reinforcement in the body, and summarization and style editing in the conclusion; overall, partial adoption of AI suggestions predominated, but both high reliance and minimal use were observed in the final stage.
note: 교양필수 글쓰기와 표현 모듈

title_ko: 글쓰기 교과목 적용을 위한 생성형 AI 활용 가이드라인에 대한 학습자 요구 분석 - 글쓰기 과정을 중심으로
title_en: Analysis of Learners’ Needs for Generative AI Usage Guidelines in University Writing Courses － Focusing on the Writing Process
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 대학 글쓰기; 글쓰기 교육; AI 활용 가이드라인; 글쓰기 과정; 평가의 공정성; AI 리터러시
kw_en: generative AI; university writing; writing education; AI usage guidelines; writing process; fairness in assessment; AI literacy
abstract_ko: 대학 글쓰기 교과목에서의 생성형 AI 활용은 필요성이 커지고 있음에도, 실제 수업에 적용할 수 있는 구체적 기준은 충분히 마련되지 않은 상황이다. 이에 본 연구는 글쓰기 교과목의 특성을 고려하여 활용 범위를 과정별로 세분화하고, 글쓰기 과목에 적용하기 위한 생성형 AI 활용 가이드라인에 대한 학습자의 요구를 분석하였다. 연구 결과, 학습자들은 생성형 AI의 활용 가능성을 전면 부정하지 않았으나, 글쓰기 과정에 따라 허용 범위를 달리 인식하는 경향을 보였다. 정보 탐색이나 표현 점검과 같은 보조적 기능에는 비교적 수용적인 태도를 보인 반면, 내용 작성과 같이 글의 저자성이 직접적으로 관련되는 영역에는 보다 엄격한 기준을 적용하였다. 또한 생성형 AI의 활용 여부와 무관하게, 정보의 검토와 글에 대한 최종 책임은 필자에게 있다는 인식이 공통적으로 확인되었다. 이는 대학 글쓰기에서의 생성형 AI 활용이 단순한 효율성의 차원을 넘어, 저자성 및 평가 원칙과 연동되어 이해되고 있음을 시사한다. 본 연구는 대학 글쓰기에서의 생성형 AI 활용이 허용과 금지의 이분법이 아니라, 글쓰기 과정의 특성과 교육 목표, 평가의 공정성을 함께 고려하는 방향으로 조정되어야 함을 시사한다. 아울러 본 연구에서 도출한 과정 중심 가이드라인은 비전공 대학생의 AI 리터러시 함양과 실제 교육 현장에서의 상향식 가이드라인 개발을 위한 기초 자료로 활용될 수 있을 것이다.
abstract_en: As the use of generative AI(GAI) in university writing courses has become increasingly necessary, concrete standards for classroom applications remain insufficient. Accordingly, this study categorized the scope of GAI use by stage in light of the characteristics of writing courses and analyzed learners’ needs for GAI-use guidelines. The findings showed that learners did not entirely reject GAI; rather, they perceived its acceptable scope differently across the stages of the writing process. Learners were relatively receptive to supportive functions, such as information searching and expression reviews but applied stricter standards to areas directly related to authorship, such as content generation. Moreover, learners commonly recognized that the responsibility for reviewing information and the final text ultimately rests with the writer, regardless of whether GAI was used. These findings suggest that GAI in university writing is understood not only in terms of efficiency but also in relation to authorship and assessment principles. This study suggests that GAI use in university writing should be guided not by a simple binary of permission and prohibition, but by the characteristics of the writing process, educational goals, and fairness in assessment. The process-centered guidelines derived from this study may also serve as a foundation for fostering AI literacy among non-major university students and for developing bottom-up guidelines in actual educational contexts.
note: 대학 글쓰기 교과 AI 가이드라인

title_ko: A Corpus-Based Analysis of AI-Generated Tourism Translation: Lexical Distribution and Translation Orientation
title_en: A Corpus-Based Analysis of AI-Generated Tourism Translation: Lexical Distribution and Translation Orientation
kw_en: AI translation; tourism translation; corpus-based analysis; lexical distribution; translation orientation
abstract_ko: This study presents a corpus-based comparison of Korean-to-English tourism text translations generated by ChatGPT and Claude, using four analytical parameters: standardized type-token ratio (STTR), mean sentence length (MSL), mean word length (MWL), and BNC/COCA-based lexical coverage. The results reveal significant differences in how linguistic complexity is realized across the two models. Claude produces significantly longer sentences, indicating greater syntactic complexity, whereas ChatGPT employs longer lexical items, reflecting comparatively greater lexical complexity. In contrast, no statistically significant difference was observed in overall lexical diversity (STTR) or cumulative lexical coverage. The BNC/COCA analysis further suggests subtle differences in lexical distribution. While the overall difference in non-core lexical coverage is small and not statistically significant, ChatGPT shows a greater tendency to incorporate non-core lexical items, including proper nouns and transliterations, whereas Claude demonstrates stronger reliance on high-frequency core vocabulary. Taken together, these findings suggest that the two models differ not in overall difficulty but in their translation orientation. The distributional tendencies observed in the data may indicate that ChatGPT leans slightly toward contextual specificity and source-culture visibility, whereas Claude may show a relatively stronger tendency toward accessibility and reader-oriented normalization.

title_ko: Selective Effects of an AI-Based Speaking Tool on Korean EFL University Students’ Speaking Proficiency and Self-Efficacy
title_en: Selective Effects of an AI-Based Speaking Tool on Korean EFL University Students’ Speaking Proficiency and Self-Efficacy
kw_en: AI-based speaking tools; EFL learners; speaking proficiency; self-efficacy; AI-mediated speaking practice
abstract_ko: This study examined the selective effects of an AI-based speaking tool on Korean EFL university students’ speaking proficiency and self-efficacy using a quasi-experimental mixed-methods design. Eighty-one intermediate-level learners participated in a 10-week intervention (experimental group: n = 41; control group: n = 40). The experimental group used Speak, a mobile application integrating automatic speech recognition (ASR) and AI-mediated speaking interaction, while the control group completed workbook-based speaking preparation. Speaking proficiency was assessed through task-based speaking tests measuring fluency, grammatical accuracy, lexical complexity, and pronunciation, while self-efficacy was measured using an adapted 5-point Likert-scale questionnaire. Reflective journals and semi-structured interviews were also analyzed to explain learners’ perceptions and the divergence between fluency gains and non-significant affective outcomes. Quantitative results showed significant improvement only in fluency, with no significant gains in grammatical accuracy, lexical complexity, pronunciation, or self-efficacy. Qualitative findings indicated that repeated speaking practice and reduced anxiety supported fluency development, whereas limited metalinguistic feedback and reduced authenticity of interaction constrained broader linguistic and affective gains. The findings suggest that AI-based speaking tools are effective for enhancing fluency through repeated oral rehearsal but provide limited support for interaction-dependent speaking development and efficacy construction. The study highlights the importance of integrating AI-mediated speaking practice with teacher feedback and communicative interaction.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 시대 책임 있는 담화의 양상과 형성 조건: 고등학교 영어 독해 수업을 중심으로
title_en: Accountable Talk in the Era of Generative AI: Patterns and Conditions in High School English Reading Classes.
kw_en: Accountable Talk; Generative AI; Classroom Discourse; High School English Reading Classes; Secondary English Education
abstract_ko: This qualitative case study with supplementary descriptive quantitative data explored how accountable talk was organized in high school English reading classes using AI-generated paraphrases for comparison. Participants were 287 second-year students in 12 classes at one high school taught by the teacher-researcher over ten weeks. Classroom transcripts served as the primary data, while ClassDojo participation records and assessment scores were used as contextual indicators. Guided by Michaels et al.’s framework of accountability to knowledge, rigorous thinking, and the learning community, the analysis found recurring interactional sequences, in which answer confirmation was extended into requests for textual evidence, explanation, and reasoning. AI-generated paraphrases served not as answer substitutes but as objects for comparison and verification. Participation norms, follow-up questions, and redistributed participation opportunities helped broaden student participation in accountable talk. Assessment data showed modest score changes but were interpreted only descriptively because the study lacked a control group and did not control test difficulty. The findings suggest that English reading instruction can support accountable talk when students are asked to evaluate AI outputs against texts and justify their interpretations and reasoning within a structured discourse community.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 기반 일본어 대화형 과제에 나타난 학습자와 AI 간의 상호작용 전략 분석
title_en: An Analysis of Interaction Strategies Between Learners and AI in Generative AI-Based Japanese Conversation-type Tasks
kw_ko: AI도구; AI튜터; 상호작용 전략; 상호작용 구조; 일본어교육
kw_en: AI-based tools; AI Tutor; Interaction strategies; Interactional structure; Japanese language education
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 AI를 활용한 일본어 대화형 학습에서 나타난 학습자와 AI 간의 상호작용을 과정 중심으로 분석하고, 그 교육적 의미를 탐색하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 대학 일본어 수업에서 수행된 AI 활용 과제의 대화 기록을 분석 자료로 활용하였다. 분석 결과, 학습자와 AI 간의 상호작용은 AI 응답 수용 중심, 요청 수정 및 정교화 중심, 연속적 요청 확장 중심의 상호작용 전략으로 나타났다. 이러한 전략은 고정된 유형으로 분리되기보다는 과제 수행 과정 속에서 상호 결합되며 전개되는 양상을 보였다. 또한 상호작용의 전개 구조는 제한된 범위에서 일시적으로 정리되는 경우, 동일 주제를 중심으로 반복·심화되는 경우, 하나의 응답을 출발점으로 다방향으로 확장되는 경우로 구분되었다. 이러한 분석은 생성형 AI 활용 일본어 학습에서 학습자가 AI의 출력을 수동적으로 수용하는 존재가 아니라, 질문을 조정하고 의미를 재구성하는 능동적 상호작용 주체로 기능하고 있음을 보여 준다. 본 연구는 AI 활용의 효과를 측정하는 접근을 넘어, 학습자와 AI 간의 상호작용 과정 자체를 분석 대상으로 제시함으로써 일본어교육에서 생성형 AI 활용 연구의 새로운 관점을 제공한다.
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the educational significance of learner–AI interaction in Japanese language learning by analyzing the interactional processes that emerge in generative AI–mediated dialogue tasks. Data were drawn from dialogue logs produced by university students during AI-based Japanese learning activities. The analysis revealed three major interaction strategies: AI response acceptance, request modification and refinement, and sequential expansion of requests. These strategies did not appear as fixed types but were flexibly combined and transformed throughout the task performance. In addition, interactional development was structured in three main patterns: temporarily limited progression, repetitive and in-depth exploration of a single topic, and multidirectional expansion from a single AI response. The findings indicate that learners function not as passive recipients of AI-generated output but as active agents who adjust questions and reconstruct meaning through interaction. By focusing on interactional processes rather than learning outcomes or perceptions, this study offers a process-oriented perspective on the pedagogical use of generative AI in Japanese language education.
note: 일본어 대화형 과제

title_ko: A Pedagogical Framework for AI-Mediated Interaction and Feedback in Korean EFL Contexts
title_en: A Pedagogical Framework for AI-Mediated Interaction and Feedback in Korean EFL Contexts
kw_ko: AI 매개 상호작용; 스캐폴딩; 협력적 프롬프팅; 한국 EFL 학습자
kw_en: Python; AI-mediated interaction; scaffolding; collaborative prompting; Korean EFL learners
abstract_ko: This paper proposes a pedagogical framework for integrating generative AI (GenAI) into Korean university EFL instruction, grounded in interactionist SLA theory. Drawing on negotiation of meaning (Long, 1996), collaborative dialogue (Swain, 2000), and ZPD-based scaffolding (Vygotsky, 1978), it argues that AI should function not as a replacement for human mediation but as a supplementary layer within a multi-tiered instructor-peer-AI support system. The study addresses three questions: (1) How can AI-mediated scaffolding be structured to address L1 transfer errors specific to Korean EFL learners? (2) How do recent collaborative prompting models inform the design of peer-AI interaction tasks? (3) What practical tools can instructors use to systematically implement AI-integrated instruction? Adopting a conceptual and design-based approach, the study synthesizes interactionist SLA theories to construct a pedagogical framework, illustrates its application through hypothetical instructional scenarios, and validates one component—automated error analysis using Python and the LanguageTool API—through application to authentic learner writing data (N=40). The framework is demonstrated through three applications: (1) graduated scaffolding sequences for article and say/tell errors based on Korean–English contrastive analysis; (2) collaborative prompting tasks drawing on the CoPIR model and its recent extensions; and (3) Python-based tools for automated error detection and proficiency-differentiated prompt templates. A four-week hypothetical classroom scenario integrates these components into a cohesive instructional workflow. The paper contributes to the growing body of research on AI-integrated language pedagogy by providing a theoretically grounded, practically implementable design proposal for multi-layered AI mediation in EFL contexts, while identifying specific hypotheses for future empirical testing.

The study addresses three questions: (1) How can AI-mediated scaffolding be structured to address L1 transfer errors specific to Korean EFL learners? (2) How do recent collaborative prompting models inform the design of peer-AI interaction tasks? (3) What practical tools can instructors use to systematically implement AI-integrated instruction? Adopting a conceptual and design-based approach, the study synthesizes interactionist SLA theories to construct a pedagogical framework, illustrates its application through hypothetical instructional scenarios, and validates one component—automated error analysis using Python and the LanguageTool API—through application to authentic learner writing data (N=40). The framework is demonstrated through three applications: (1) graduated scaffolding sequences for article and say/tell errors based on Korean–English contrastive analysis; (2) collaborative prompting tasks drawing on the CoPIR model and its recent extensions; and (3) Python-based tools for automated error detection and proficiency-differentiated prompt templates. A four-week hypothetical classroom scenario integrates these components into a cohesive instructional workflow. The paper contributes to the growing body of research on AI-integrated language pedagogy by providing a theoretically grounded, practically implementable design proposal for multi-layered AI mediation in EFL contexts, while identifying specific hypotheses for future empirical testing.

title_ko: University Students’ Perceptions of ChatGPT-Supported Storytelling in a Mobile-Assisted Blended Learning Environment
title_en: University Students’ Perceptions of ChatGPT-Supported Storytelling in a Mobile-Assisted Blended Learning Environment
kw_en: AI; speaking proficiency; storytelling; students’ perceptions; MABL
abstract_ko: With the growing interest in AI-assisted language learning, there is increasing attention to how generative AI tools such as ChatGPT can be integrated into structured instructional frameworks to support EFL speaking development. This pilot study examined the effects of ChatGPT-supported storytelling activities implemented within a Mobile-Assisted Blended Learning (MABL) environment on university EFL students’ speaking proficiency and learner perceptions. A total of 32 undergraduate students participated in a 16-week instructional intervention integrating ChatGPT, storytelling tasks, and mobile-supported collaborative activities through KakaoTalk. Students’ speaking proficiency was assessed through pre- and post-intervention interviews, and the results were analyzed using paired-samples t-tests. Learner perceptions were investigated through a questionnaire consisting of Likert-scale and open-ended items. The results indicated a statistically significant improvement in speaking proficiency following the intervention. Questionnaire findings also revealed generally positive learner perceptions, particularly in terms of perceived usefulness and overall satisfaction. Open-ended responses suggested that students valued opportunities for idea generation, extended speaking practice, and collaborative interaction, although some reported difficulties related to task complexity and group coordination. These findings suggest that the structured integration of ChatGPT within storytelling-based tasks in a MABL environment may provide a pedagogically meaningful approach to supporting speaking development and learner engagement in EFL contexts.

title_ko: The ChatGPT: A Pedagogical Intervention to Strengthen Korean University EFL Students’ Reading Comprehension
title_en: The ChatGPT: A Pedagogical Intervention to Strengthen Korean University EFL Students’ Reading Comprehension
kw_ko: 인공지능; 챗지피티; 영어를 외국어로 배우는 학습자; 읽기 이해력; 교수적 중제; 수용기능; 읽기교육을 위한 인공지능 활용
kw_en: AI; ChatGPT; EFL; reading comprehension; pedagogical intervention; receptive skill; AI use for reading education
abstract_ko: This study seeks to address how the use of ChatGPT impacts Korean university EFL students’ reading comprehension. This study was prompted by two factors: limited research into the impact of AI-assisted practice on EFL reading skills and a lack of classroom-focused research on applying AI methods in education. One teacher and ten students of low-intermediate levels of English proficiency participated in a twenty-four-hour long reading course which included interactions with ChatGPT. Students’ actual work with ChatGPT and class interactions were documented for qualitative analysis. The findings saw two distinctive ways that ChatGPT could contribute to students’ reading comprehension. ChatGPT was used to monitor students’ progress by quizzing them and providing feedback which encouraged students to revisit the text, to reconfirm their previous comprehension and to re-steer their comprehension. ChatGPT provided a proactive avenue for active conversation partner on reading passages; thus, not only providing students with richer language use but also sophisticating their previously-acquired comprehension. The use of AI technology for receptive foreign language acquisition along with the crucial role of human teachers in the creation of interactive scaffolding is discussed.

title_ko: The Convergence of Artificial Intelligence and Tourism English Education (1996–2025): A Bibliometric Mapping of Research Trends and Thematic Evolution
title_en: The Convergence of Artificial Intelligence and Tourism English Education (1996–2025): A Bibliometric Mapping of Research Trends and Thematic Evolution
kw_ko: 관광 영어 교육; 계량서지학적 분석; 인공지능; 생성형 인공지능; 주제적 진화; 의인화
kw_en: Tourism English education; Bibliometric analysis; Artificial Intelligence (AI); Generative AI(GAI); Thematic evolution; Anthropomorphism
abstract_ko: This study conducts a longitudinal bibliometric analysis of 325 academic papers on Tourism English education from 1996 to 2025, sourced from the Web of Science Core Collection. Factorial mapping signifies a transition from fundamental pedagogy to advanced technology integration, from Natural Language Processing to Generative AI. Thematic evolution reveals a three-phase process: an initial ESP phase, a pandemic-driven machine learning phase, and an extended ESP phase marked by a shift from collaborative learning to anthropomorphism. This shift redefines learner interaction — from form-focused exercises toward scenario-based, socio-emotionally responsive communication — and reframes the educational goal as cultivating distinctively human competencies that AI cannot replicate. This study proposes a hybrid competency model combining broad pedagogical frameworks with advanced technology in the post-pandemic era.

title_ko: Students’ Perceptions of AI-Supported Learning in Fully Online General English Instruction
title_en: Students’ Perceptions of AI-Supported Learning in Fully Online General English Instruction
kw_en: AI-supported learning; fully online general English instruction; engagement/strategy; anxiety in using English; performance confidence
abstract_ko: This study examined students’ perceptions of AI-supported English learning in fully online general English instruction, focusing on their relationships with engagement/strategy, anxiety in using English, and performance confidence. The data were drawn from a voluntary online post-course survey completed by 51 undergraduate students after they had completed the courses. The survey included items on perceived AI helpfulness, English learning attitudes and confidence, AI-related tool use, and open-ended feedback. Quantitative procedures included descriptive statistics, reliability estimates, exploratory factor analysis, exploratory group comparisons, and regression modeling. The results showed that students commonly used multiple AI-related tools, especially Papago, ChatGPT, and online dictionaries, and generally perceived AI as helpful for English learning. AI was viewed as more helpful for grammar, writing, and vocabulary than for immediate oral performance. The factor results identified three major attitudinal dimensions: engagement/strategy, anxiety in using English, and performance confidence. The regression model showed that engagement/strategy was the strongest positive predictor of performance confidence, whereas perceived AI helpfulness itself was not a significant direct predictor. These findings suggest that the educational value of AI in fully online English instruction lies less in the tool itself than in how learners use it within active and strategic learning processes.

title_ko: Collaborative L2 writing with ChatGPT: Learner interaction, uptake, and perceptions
title_en: Collaborative L2 writing with ChatGPT: Learner interaction, uptake, and perceptions
kw_ko: AI 기반 협동글쓰기; 글쓰기 과정; 학습자 인식
kw_en: AI-based collaborative writing; writing process; interaction; uptake; perception
abstract_ko: Collaborative writing (CW) has been a central focus in second language (L2) research for several decades, with extensive studies examining its effectiveness from multiple perspectives. With advances in educational technology, digital tools have increasingly been integrated into peer-based CW, expanding its instructional possibilities. More recently, generative artificial intelligence (AI) has been introduced into L2 classrooms, drawing growing attention to its potential role in L2 writing. However, existing research has largely examined AI tools as sources of feedback or idea generation, with limited attention to their role as active collaborators in the co-construction of written texts. To address this gap, the present study investigated L2 learners’ CW with ChatGPT by examining interactional behaviors, uptake of AI-generated suggestions, and learner perceptions. Fifteen university students participated, and data were collected from interaction logs, think-aloud protocols, writing drafts, and survey and interview responses. The findings indicate that learners played an active role in interacting with ChatGPT and selectively incorporated its suggestions. At the same time, uptake patterns varied by the focus of the suggestions, and although learners valued ChatGPT’s collaborative support, they also expressed concerns about overreliance and reduced cognitive engagement.

title_ko: AI의 사전적 활용에 대한 사용자의 인식 조사: 영어사전 활용을 중심으로
title_en: Survey on AI Users’ Perceptions of the Dictionary Use of AI: Focusing on English Dictionary Usage
kw_ko: AI 도구; 사전적 활용; 영어 사전; 대학생; 인식
kw_en: AI Tools; Dictionary Use; English Dictionary; College Students; Perceptions
abstract_ko: This study attempts to investigate college students’ perceptions about a dictionary use of AI tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini. There have been numerous studies about the interaction between AI tools and education, but research on the dictionary use of AI tools has been relatively underexplored. Thus, this study focuses on the lexicographical use of AI tools, especially focusing on English-Korean or Korean-English bilingual dictionary use and the users’ perceptions. The 108 participants are the college students attending at a university located in Busan, Korea, who belong to all English-related majors such as English, International Marketing, Hotel and Convention, and Aviation Service. The results show 76 out of 108 participants use AI tools for dictionary purpose, and they mainly use AI tools for understanding technical terms and concepts, for checking their assignments, for using translation tools, and for generating ideas. The participants commonly pointed out that the biggest problems were the hallucinations of the AI tools and the use of prompts. In contrast, the traditional and existing dictionaries were perceived as being more reliable regarding hallucinations. One of the implications is that the important role of traditional dictionaries will not disappear, rather, they will be necessary in the interaction with AI tools,, serving as the standard for both AI tools and AI users.

title_en: Development and Application of a User Experience Evaluation Scale for Educational Chatbots Based on LLM: Focusing on English Conversation App Services
kw_ko: 사용자 경험 평가 지표; 생성형AI; 교육용 챗봇; 디자인 가이드라인; 대화형 인터페이스

abstract_ko: 연구배경 생성형 AI 확산으로 LLM 기반 챗봇은 교육 환경에서 질의응답, 맞춤형 안내, 자동 피드백 등 학습 지원 기능을 수행하고 있다. 그러나 기존 사용성 평가는 기능적 편의성에 치중되어, 맥락 유지, 개인화, 피드백 품질 등 LLM 기반 상호작용 특성을 충분히 반영하지 못한다. 이에 본 연구는 이러한 특성을 고려한 사용자 경험 평가 지표 체계를 개발하고자 한다. 연구방법 본 연구는 지표 개발-검증-적용-활용 네 단계로 수행되었다. 먼저 문헌 조사와 연쇄 표집을 통해 지표 후보군을 도출하고, 어피니티 다이어그램과 전문가 검토를 통해 구조를 확정하였다. 이후 설문 기반 EFA로 타당성을 검증하였으며, LLM 기반 교육용 애플리케이션 평가에 적용해 활용 가능성을 확인하였다. 마지막으로 확정된 지표는 서비스 설계와 평가에 적용할 수 있는 가이드라인으로 제시하였다. 연구결과 본 연구는 문헌 조사와 전문가 검토를 통해 LLM 기반 교육용 챗봇의 사용자 경험 평가 지표 체계를 도출하였다. 최종 체계는 사용성(Usability), 사용자 가치(User Value), 사용자 수용도(User Acceptance)의 3개 범주로 구성되며, 총 9개의 주지표와 28개의 상세지표가 확정되었다. 또한 각 지표별 정의와 핵심 특징을 정리하여 설계 및 평가 과정에서 활용 가능한 기준으로 제시하였다. 결론 본 연구는 LLM 기반 교육용 챗봇의 사용자 경험을 평가하기 위한 지표 체계를 제안함으로써 기존 기능 중심 평가의 한계를 보완하였다. 제안된 지표는 학습 맥락을 반영하여 서비스 간 경험 차이를 식별하였으며, 설계·개발·운영 단계에서 활용 가능함을 확인하였다. 또한 가이드라인을 통해 서비스 품질 개선에 적용할 수 있는 실무적 근거를 제공하였다.
abstract_en: Background With the rapid expansion of generative artificial intelligence (AI), large language model (LLM)-based chatbots are increasingly used in educational settings to support tasks such as answering questions, providing personalized guidance, and delivering automated feedback. However, existing usability evaluations have mainly focused on functional convenience and therefore do not sufficiently address interaction characteristics unique to LLM-based services, such as context retention, personalization, and feedback quality. Accordingly, this study aims to develop a user experience evaluation framework that reflects these distinctive attributes. Methods This study was conducted through the phases of indicator development, validation, and application. First, a pool of candidate indicators was derived through literature review and referential sampling, and their structure was refined using affinity diagramming and expert review. Subsequently, exploratory factor analysis (EFA) was performed based on survey data to verify validity, and the indicators were applied to the evaluation of LLM-based educational applications to confirm practical applicability. Finally, the validated indicators were translated into design guidelines that can be utilized in service design and evaluation. Results This study derives a user experience evaluation index system of LLM-based educational chatbot through literature research and expert review. The final system is composed of three categories: Usability, User Value, and User Acceptance. A total of 9 well-known and 28 detailed indicators were confirmed. In addition, the definition and core characteristics of each indicator were summarized and presented as criteria that can be used in the design and evaluation process. Conclusions This study supplements the limitations of the existing function-oriented evaluation by proposing an indicator system to evaluate the user experience of the LLM-based educational chatbot. The proposed index identifies the difference in experience between services by reflecting on the learning context and confirms that it can be used in the design, development, and operation stages. In addition, the guidelines provide a practical basis for application to service quality improvement.

title_ko: 국내 ChatGPT 활용 영어교육 연구의 학술적 구조 및 연구 주제 간의 네트워크 분석
title_en: Mapping the Intellectual Structure and Research Themes of ChatGPT in English Education in Korea: A Network Analysis
kw_en: ChatGPT; Generative   AI; English   Education; Intellectual   Structure; Network Analysis
abstract_ko: The rapid emergence of generative artificial intelligence, led by ChatGPT, has catalyzed a paradigm shift in language education. Despite the burgeoning volume of related literature, research remains fragmented across various sub-topics and educational contexts. This study aims to delineate the intellectual structure and research themes of ChatGPT-assisted English education in Korea by employing a bibliometric approach. A total of 184 rigorously filtered articles published in KCI-indexed journals between 2023 and 2025 were analyzed. Data were processed using VOSviewer (v.1.6.20) for keyword co-occurrence network analysis and manual coding for educational level distribution. The findings reveal a significant upward trajectory in publication volume, with a predominant focus on university-level contexts (81.5%). Network analysis identified four distinct clusters: (1) AI-based feedback and assessment, (2) affective factors and learner perceptions, (3) writing proficiency and AI literacy in higher education, and (4) pedagogical models and skill expansion. Notably, ‘prompt engineering’ and ‘AI literacy’ have emerged as pivotal themes, bridging technical competencies with pedagogical outcomes. However, a critical imbalance was observed, with studies heavily skewed toward writing instruction and higher education. This research provides a comprehensive map of the current academic landscape and suggests future directions, emphasizing the need for longitudinal studies in K-12 settings and the integration of diverse language skills to ensure a more balanced development of AI-enhanced English education.

title_en: A Study on the Effectiveness of Learning English through an AI Automatic Translator
kw_en: artificial  intelligence-based  machine  translation; college  English  writing; class satisfaction; writing performance; paraphrasing; peer feedback
abstract_ko: This study explored the effects of two instructional approaches using artificial intelligence-based machine translation in college English writing classes. The purpose of this study was to investigate whether different ways of using AI-based machine translation in college English classes would produce differences in learners’ perceptions of the class, satisfaction, and writing performance. The participants were 59 university students enrolled in a general English course, and the experiment was conducted over a ten-week period with two groups. Group 1 used machine translation mainly as a reference tool for vocabulary, grammar, and sentence expressions. In contrast, Group 2 engaged in additional learning activities based on machine-translated output, including vocabulary extraction, paraphrasing, error correction, and peer feedback. Data collected from both groups were analyzed statistically. The results showed that the two groups differed significantly in class satisfaction, and Group 2 demonstrated better performance in the areas of content, grammar, and punctuation in English writing. These findings suggest that artificial intelligence-based machine translation can be effectively used in English writing instruction not merely as a simple translation aid, but as a pedagogical tool when integrated into systematic learning activities. The results provide useful implications for improving instructional methods in college English writing classes

title_en: Exploring Instructional Elements of an Edutech-Based Course for Pre-service Secondary English Teachers’ Digital Competence Development

abstract_ko: Considering the changes in the future society and the emphasis on digital literacy in 2022 National Revised Curriculum, the study was conducted with the goal of designing a course integrated with edu-tech for pre-service secondary English teachers. To achieve the research purpose, the study examined the effects of an edutech-based course on changes of pre-service secondary English teachers’ attitudes and their experiences on using edutech tools including generative AIs in the class. The 29 pre-service teachers from the two different courses responded to the pre- and the post-surveys including open-ended questionnaires. The quantitative data were analyzed using paired-sample t-tests and effect sizes, while qualitative responses were categorized to identify recurring themes. The results indicated that the course led to statistically significant improvement in participants’ attitudes toward edutech tools, particularly in terms of technical knowledge and perceived benefits. The participants also reported high levels of satisfaction with the course and recognized the usefulness of generative AI tools, such as ChatGPT, in lesson planning and material development. However, no significant change was found in their perceptions of applying edutech tools in actual classroom settings. These findings suggest that while edutech-based instruction enhances digital competence, further support is needed to bridge the gap between knowledge acquisition and practical classroom application.

title_en: Design and Implementation of English Learning Video Content Using Generative AI

abstract_ko: This study aims to explore the production methods and educational applications of English learning video content using Generative AI-based Text-to-Video technology. Previous studies on AI-assisted English learning have mainly focused on text-based technologies such as chatbots, writing assistance, and speech recognition, while research on AI-generated video content for English learning remains limited. In addition, current English learning materials are often textbook-centered or rely on limited multimedia resources, making it difficult to fully reflect authentic communicative contexts and learner engagement. Therefore, this study presents the process of creating scenario-based English learning video content by integrating GPT-based conversational AI with Text-to-Video generation tools and discusses practical ways to apply such content in educational settings. The findings suggest that Generative AI-based video content can rapidly produce personalized learning materials tailored to learners’ levels and goals, while also increasing learner interest and immersion through context-based audiovisual materials. This study is meaningful in that it highlights the educational potential of AI-generated video content in English education and provides foundational data for future empirical research.

title_ko: Temporal Changes in Linguistic Revision Burden in English Abstracts of Korean Sports Science Journals: A Pre- and Post-2022 Analysis in the Era of AI-Assisted Writing
title_en: Temporal Changes in Linguistic Revision Burden in English Abstracts of Korean Sports Science Journals: A Pre- and Post-2022 Analysis in the Era of AI-Assisted Writing
kw_ko: 영문 초록 언어 분석; 스포츠 과학; 수정·교정 밀도; 언어적 질 향상; 대규모 언어모형 기반 인공지능 글쓰기 도구
kw_en: ChatGPT; English abstracts of Korean journals; sports sciences; revision; correction density; improvement in linguistic quality; LLM-based AI writing tools
abstract_ko: The widespread availability of large language model (LLM)–based AI writing tools since 2022 has raised questions about whether measurable changes in academic writing quality are reflected in published texts. This study examines temporal shifts in linguistic revision burden, conceptualized as an indicator of the cognitive and discursive demands of academic writing, in English abstracts from Korean sports science journals. Forty abstracts from two journals—the Korea Journal of Applied Biomechanics (J1) and the Korean Journal of Sport Psychology (J2)—were analyzed, with 10 abstracts from 2019–2020 and 10 from 2024–2025 selected per journal. All abstracts underwent systematic linguistic auditing using ChatGPT (version 5.2), and correction density (revisions per 100 words) was calculated. Corrections were classified as grammatical accuracy, syntactic clarity, lexical choice, stylistic refinement, or discourse-level coherence. Results show a clear reduction in correction density in 2024–2025 compared to 2019–2020, consistent across journals. Category-level analyses indicate fewer grammatical and syntactic corrections and a proportional shift toward stylistic and discourse-level refinements in later abstracts. Segmented regression shows that revision burden was already declining before 2022 and continued thereafter, without a statistically decisive breakpoint. Overall, the findings document a substantial temporal decrease in linguistic revision burden in the post-2022 writing environment. Although the findings do not support a definitive causal claim regarding the role of LLM-based tools, the results provide system-level evidence consistent with evolving technological and institutional conditions in academic writing, including the normalization of AI-assisted support. By operationalizing linguistic revision burden through correction density at the level of published texts, this study offers a novel empirical framework for examining changes in academic writing across non-Anglophone research contexts.

title_ko: 대규모 언어 모델 자동 에세이 채점에 관한 연구: 4-bit QLoRA 양자화 모델의 신뢰성과 점수 분포 특성에 미치는 영향
title_en: A Study on Automated Essay Scoring with Large Language Models: Effects of 4-bit QLoRA Quantization on Reliability and Score Distribution Characteristics
kw_ko: 컴퓨터 교과교육; 자동 에세이 채점; 대규모 언어모델; 모델 경량화; 출력 분포 분석
kw_en: QLoRA; Computer Education; AES; LLM; Model Quantization; Output Distribution Analysis
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 4-bit 양자화 QLoRA 기반 대규모 언어모델 자동 에세이 채점(AES)에서 관찰되는 성능 저하의 원인을 규명하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 정확도 성능, 출력 안정성, 출력 분포 특성, 성능 붕괴 원인 분리의 네 범주로 구성된 단계적 실험 프레임을 설계하였고, BF16 기반 모델과 4-bit 양자화 QLoRA 모델을 비교 분석하였다. 실험 결과, 양자화 QLoRA 모델의 정확도 저하는 출력 파이프라인 오류가 아닌 출력 점수 분포의 구조적 붕괴와 밀접하게 연관됨을 확인하였다. 또한 QLoRA rank 증가가 일부 정확도 지표를 개선하였으나 분포 붕괴를 근본적으로 완화하지는 못하였다. 본 연구는 경량화 LLM 기반 AES 평가에서 평균 정확도 지표를 넘어 출력 분포 안정성을 함께 고려해야 함을 실증적으로 제시한다.
abstract_en: This study aims to identify the underlying causes of performance degradation observed in 4-bit quantized QLoRA-based large language models applied to automated essay scoring (AES). To this end, we design a staged experimental framework consisting of four analytical dimensions: accuracy performance, output stability, output distribution characteristics, and disentanglement of performance degradation causes. Using this framework, we conduct a comparative analysis between a BF16 baseline model and 4-bit quantized QLoRA models. Experimental results show that the observed accuracy degradation in quantized QLoRA models is not attributable to output pipeline errors, but is closely associated with structural collapse in the output score distribution. While increasing the QLoRA rank leads to partial improvements in certain accuracy metrics, it does not fundamentally mitigate the distributional collapse. These findings demonstrate that, in the evaluation of lightweight LLM-based AES systems, assessment should extend beyond average accuracy metrics to explicitly incorporate the stability and structural properties of output score distributions.

title_ko: Korean L2 learners’ English vowel adjustments during interactions with two ASR systems: An AI assistant and a speech-to-text tool
title_en: Korean L2 learners’ English vowel adjustments during interactions with two ASR systems: An AI assistant and a speech-to-text tool
kw_en: ASR feedback; vowel pronunciation; phonetic adjustment; Korean EFL learners; L2 English
abstract_ko: There has been growing interest in using Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems to support second-language (L2) pronunciation practice. This study examined how Korean learners of English adjusted their pronunciation in response to two ASR feedback modalities: auditory feedback from an AI assistant (Amazon Alexa) and visual text feedback from a speech-to-text tool (Google Docs). Nineteen Korean L2 learners produced 36 words containing six English vowels (/i, ɪ, ɛ, æ, ɑ, ʌ/). Following a misrecognition, they repeated the same word up to two additional times. Results from mixed-effects models showed that (1) recognition rates generally increased across attempts for most vowels, with the largest gains occurring between the first and second attempts; (2) when modifying their pronunciation, learners primarily relied on vowel lengthening rather than spectral adjustments; and (3) the two ASR systems appeared to elicit somewhat different adjustment patterns. Overall, ASR provided effective real-time feedback that prompted learners to modify their pronunciation. However, in the absence of explicit guidance, these adjustments were largely confined to temporal changes. These findings highlight the need for ASR activities and feedback to be carefully designed to facilitate pronunciation learning.

title_ko: 초등학생의 영어 쓰기를 위한 생성형 AI 기반 비계 챗봇 개발 및 적용 사례 분석
title_en: Development and Application of Generative AI-based Scaffolding Chatbots for Primary School Students’ English Writing: A Case Study
kw_ko: 초등영어 쓰기; 생성형 AI; 비계 챗봇; 바이브 코딩; 학습자 주도성
kw_en: Primary English Writing; Generative AI; Scaffolding Chatbot; Vibe Coding; Learner Agency
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 초등학생의 영어 쓰기 활동을 지원하는 생성형 AI 기반 비계 챗봇을 설계하고 수업에 적용하여 그 교육적 가능성을 탐색하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 바이브 코딩을 활용하여 초등학교 5 학년 영어교과서에 제시된 글쓰기 과업을 지원하는 맞춤형 비계 챗봇을 설계하였다. 챗봇 개발은 초등영어 쓰기 과업 선정, 글쓰기 비계 챗봇 구안, 설계 코드 생성을 위한 프롬프트 입력, 챗봇 제작 및배포, 챗봇 구동 테스트, 비계 챗봇 활용 수업 모형 개발 등 6단계의 절차로 진행되었다. 이때, 학습자의 정의적 여과망을 낮추기 위해 챗봇의 페르소나는 친절한 영어 쓰기 도우미 선생님으로 설정되었다. 또한, 한 문장씩 완성하여 글을 구성해 나가는 매크로 구조와 목표 문장 작성을 위한 점진적 비계의 마이크로 구조를 챗봇과의 상호작용에 적용하여, 학습자의 인지 부담을 줄이고 주도적인 쓰기를지원하였다. 개발된 챗봇은 초등학교 5학년 학생들을 대상으로 ‘도입-준비1-준비2-실행-정리’의 5단계 수업 모형으로 적용되었다. 수업 적용 결과, 학생들은 영어 쓰기 과업에서 어휘, 문법, 내용 선정등에서 어려움을 겪었으나, 챗봇이 제공하는 맞춤형 비계를 통해 이를 점진적으로 극복하는 모습을보였다. 또한 학생들은 챗봇의 비계를 무비판적으로 수용하기보다는, 자신의 의도에 맞지 않는 비계는거부하고 챗봇의 비계 수정에 필요한 정보를 제공하는 등 챗봇과의 상호작용에서 주도적인 역할을 수행하였다. 본 연구는 이러한 결과를 바탕으로 챗봇 개발과 수업 모형 간의 유기적 연계, 챗봇 개발 과정을 통한 영어교사의 디지털 교수 역량 및 융합적 전문성 강화, 그리고 학습자의 과잉 의존을 방지하기 위한 AI 기반 교육 생태계 조성의 중요성을 확인하였다.
abstract_en: This study aims to explore the potential of generative AI-based scaffolding chatbots designed to support primary school students’ English writing. To this end, two customized scaffolding chatbots were developed via vibe coding to assist with two writing tasks from a fifth-grade English textbook. The development process followed a six-step procedure: selecting writing tasks, designing scaffolding chatbots, inputting prompts for code generation (=vibe coding), producing and deploying the chatbots, testing their operation, and developing a lesson model. The chatbot persona was established as a kind English writing assistant teacher to lower learners’ affective filters. Furthermore, the chatbot interaction was designed with a macro-structure for sentence-by-sentence composition and a micro-structure for stepwise scaffolding to reduce cognitive load and support autonomous writing. The developed chatbots were implemented in fifth-grade English classes through a five-stage lesson model: introduction, preparation 1, preparation 2, implementation, and wrap-up. The results demonstrated that students, despite facing challenges in vocabulary, grammar, and content selection, gradually overcame these difficulties through tailored scaffolding. Notably, learners took a proactive role in interactions by rejecting inappropriate scaffolds and providing information to refine the AI’s suggestions rather than accepting them unconditionally. These findings highlight the importance of forging an organic connection between chatbot development and lesson models, enhancing English teachers’ digital competency and adaptive expertise, and cultivating an AI-based educational ecosystem that prevents learners’ over-reliance.

abstract_ko: 인공지능을 활용한 영어 읽기 능력 향상에 관한 연구 김 경 훈 연구 목적: 이 연구는 중학교 2학년 학생 17명을 대상으로 인공지능을 활용한 영어수업이 학생들의 영어 읽기능력 향상에 어떤 효과가 있는지를 알아보는 것이다. 연구 방법: 인공지능의 도움을 받으면서 학습자들 스스로 지문을 결정하고, 지문에 사용되는 어휘들의 의미를 파악하며, 피드백을 받으면서 문장의 내용을 이해할 수 있다. 연구 내용: 첫째 인공지능을 활용한 영어 학습은 학생들의 영어 읽기 능력향상에 통계적으로 긍정적인 효과가 있음을 보였다. 둘째, 인공지능을 활용한 학습에 참여한 학생들의 만족도 및 흥미도가 매우 높은 것으로 나타났다. 결론 및 제언: 이 연구 결과 인공지능을 활용한 영어 읽기 학습은 학생들의 영어 읽기능력 향상에 유의미한 효과 및 학생들의 영어 학습 참여에 대한 흥미도와 만족도가 높게 나타났음을 확인할 수 있었다. 핵심어: 인공지능 지원학습, 영어읽기숙달도, 중학생, 학습자흥미도, 학생만족도
abstract_en: A Study on Improving of English Reading ProficiencyUsing Artificial Intelligence DOI http://dx.doi.org/10.62783/SHSS.8.3.54 Kyunghoon Kim* Abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate the effects of AI-assisted English reading learning on the improvement of English reading ability among second-year middle school students. To achieve this, the class was conducted in a way that allowed learners, with the help of AI, to choose their own reading materials, identify the meanings of words used in the text, and comprehend sentence structures while receiving feedback. The following results were obtained. First, the implementation of AI-assisted English reading instruction led to a statistically significant improvement in the students' English reading ability. Second, the study examined student satisfaction and interest regarding the AI-assisted classes; the findings indicated that the students demonstrated high levels of both satisfaction and interest in the instruction. In conclusion, these findings suggest that AI-assisted English learning has a positive effect on second-grade middle school students. abstract_ko: 본 연구는 우리나라 중학교 영어 학습자의 질문 중심 능동적 읽기를 지원하기 위해 AI 페르소나 챗봇을 개발하고, 이를 실제 영어 읽기 수업에 적용하여 그 교육적 가능성을 탐색하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 중학교 2학년 영어 교과서의 여행기 텍스트를 재구성하고, 주인공의 인격을 반영한 AI 페르소나 챗봇을 설계하였다. 챗봇은 페르소나, 사용자, 대화 기능, 언어 수준, 창의성, 참조 텍스트를 중심으로 프롬프트가 구성되었으며, 구글 스프레드시트, 앱 스크립트, GPT API를 활용하여 웹 애플리케이션 형태로 구현되었다. 이후 경기도 소재 S중학교 2학년 학생들을 대상으로 읽기 전, 읽기 중, 챗봇 대화, 과업 수행의 네 단계 수업 모형을 적용하였다. 학습자와 챗봇의 대화 로그를 질적으로 분석한 결과, 학생들은 사전 준비 질문을 넘어 실시간으로 질문을 확장하였고, 상대방 문화에 대한 배경지식과 관심을 질문에 활용하였으며, 우리나라 문화와 외국 문화를 비교하는 등 문화 간 의사소통에 적극적으로 참여하였다. 이러한 결과는 읽기 텍스트에 기반한 AI 페르소나 챗봇이 학습자의 질문 생성, 의미 협상, 문화적 탐구를 촉진하는 능동적 영어 읽기 도구로 활용될 수 있음을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study developed an AI chatbot to support question-centered, active English reading among Korean middle-schoolers and explored its educational potential for English reading lessons. A travel journal text from a second-year middle-school English textbook was reconstructed, and an AI persona chatbot was designed to act as the main character. The chatbot was structured around persona, user, conversational function, language level, creativity, and reference text. It was implemented as a web application using Google Sheets, Apps Script, and the GPT API. It was then applied in English lessons at a middle school in Gyeonggi-do through a four-stage instructional model consisting of pre-reading, reading, chatbot interaction, and task performance. The dialogue logs demonstrate that the students expanded their inquiries beyond the questions they had prepared in advance, drew on their background knowledge of and interest in the target culture, and engaged in intercultural communication by comparing Korean and other cultures. These findings suggest that an AI persona chatbot based on a reading text can serve as an active English reading tool that promotes learners’ questioning, meaning negotiation, and cultural inquiry.
note: GPT API 페르소나 챗봇 능동적 읽기 개발·적용

title_ko: AI와 한국 직장인의 영어 요청 이메일 비교 연구: 무브 분석을 중심으로
title_en: English Request Emails by AI and Korean Professionals: A Move Analys
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 비즈니스 이메일; 영어 요청 이메일; 무브 분석; 비즈니스 커뮤니케이션
kw_en: Generative AI; Business email; Request email; Move analysis; Business communication
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 한국 직장인이 작성한 영어 요청 이메일과 AI가 생성한 이메일을 비교하여 요청의 담화 구성을 분석하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 외국계 기업 및 글로벌 로펌에서 근무하는 한국인 여성 사무직 종사자 15명이 담화완성과제(DCT)에 응답하여 작성한 이메일과 ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot이 동일한 시나리오에 대해 생성한 이메일 3편을 수집하고, 무브 순서, 무브 빈도, 무브 실현 방식을 분석하였다. 분석 결과, AI 이메일은 비교적 고정된 무브 순서와 정형화된 구조를 보인 반면, 한국 직장인 이메일은 다양한 배열과 높은 정서 표현 빈도를 나타냈다. 또한 AI는 요청 이유와 상황 설명을 중심으로 과업 지향적 구성을 보인 반면, 한국 직장인 이메일은 관계 조정과 구체적 실행을 함께 드러냈다. 본 연구는 요청 이메일이 이메일 전체에서 어떻게 조직되는지를 분석했다는 점에서 학문적 의의가 있다. 분석 결과는 AI가 정제된 이메일 초안을 제공하더라도, 실제 업무 맥락에서의 관계 조정과 설득에는 인간의 판단이 필요함을 보여준다. 이는 AI 시대 비즈니스 영어 이메일 교육에서 담화 구조 설계, 관계 조정, AI 산출물의 비판적 조정 능력을 다룰 필요가 있음을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This study analyzes the discourse organization of requests by comparing English request emails written by 15 Korean professionals with those generated by AI. The data, collected through a discourse completion task (DCT), were analyzed in terms of move sequence, move frequency, and move realization. The findings show that AI emails followed relatively fixed move sequences and standardized structures. In contrast, the Korean professionals’ emails showed more varied move arrangements and a higher frequency of emotional expressions. AI tended to construct requests in a task-oriented manner, centering on reasons for the request and situation descriptions. The professionals’ emails, however, combined relational management with concrete action-oriented requests. This study shows that request emails need to be understood at the level of whole-email discourse organization. It also suggests that AI-generated drafts require human judgment, especially for relational management and context-based persuasion. The findings point to the need for business English email instruction to address discourse-structure design, relational management, and critical revision of AI-generated text

title_ko: Latent Transitions in L2 Reading Skill Profiles of Korean Elementary EFL Learners in an AI Game-based Program
title_en: Latent Transitions in L2 Reading Skill Profiles of Korean Elementary EFL Learners in an AI Game-based Program
kw_en: L2 reading comprehension; AI-driven game-based learning; reading development; latent transition analysis; person-centered approach; young EFL learners
abstract_ko: This study employed latent profile analysis (LPA) and latent transition analysis (LTA) to examine the short-term longitudinal development of L2 reading comprehension among young Korean EFL learners in Grades 1 and 2 participating in an AI-integrated game-based learning program. L2 reading comprehension was assessed at three time points across vocabulary, sentence-level, and discourse-level comprehension. The LPA identified five distinct reading profiles, revealing substantial heterogeneity prior to formal English instruction. The LTA showed pronounced upward transitions during the early phase of the program, particularly among lower-performing learners, followed by strong profile stability in the later phase. These findings suggest that the instructional environment may support initial improvement in foundational reading-related skills. However, the limited later profile transitions indicate possible constraints in sustaining continued developmental progress. The findings highlight both the potential and limitations of AI-supported game-based learning and underscore the importance of examining heterogeneous learner trajectories in early technology-mediated language learning contexts.

title_ko: 대학 국제화와 영어교육전공의 새로운 가능성을 위한 생성형 AI 기반 프로젝트형 서비스러닝
title_en: Project-Based Service-Learning with Generative AI for Expanding the Possibilities of English Education and University Internationalization
kw_en: project-based learning; English education majors; service learning; generative AI; university internationalization
abstract_ko: This study develops a Project-Based Service-Learning (PBSL) model that integrates vibe coding, a prompt-based generative AI development approach, into English teacher education coursework, positioning international student support as the authentic problem-solving context for pre-service English teachers. The PBSL model was implemented across two English education major courses at a non-metropolitan South Korean university. Over a semester, 39 participants designed and developed functional multilingual apps, brochures, and instructional videos addressing international students’ real campus needs, including dormitory navigation, cafeteria usage, academic email etiquette, counseling center access, and cultural adaptation, using vibe coding platforms. Each participant then conducted face-to-face English-medium mentoring sessions with international students to deliver outputs and collect user feedback. Drawing on two primary data sources, a pre-post survey questionnaires and open-ended reflective responses, the study examined competency changes and career identity formation among the participants. Paired-samples t-tests revealed statistically significant improvements across all five competency domains (all p < .001): creativity (d = 1.03), convergence (d = 0.94), global competence (d = 0.83), selfmanagement(d = 0.80), and self-efficacy (d = 0.77). Post-test standard deviations decreased consistently across all domains, suggesting that competency gains were observed across participants following the PBSL experience, rather than being concentrated among high-performing students. Thematic analysis of qualitative data further revealed that PBSL reshaped participant career identities across three dimensions: expanding the perceived value of English education from classroom instruction to multicultural mediation, enabling self-verification of career competencies through authentic user interaction, and broadening career pathways beyond the teacher-nonteacher dichotomy toward EdTech and related fields. The study validates vibe coding as an accessible, low-cost development tool enabling non-computer science majors to translate educational intentions into functional digital artifacts, and provides a replicable PBSL curricular framework for teacher education programs navigating declining enrollment, campus internationalization, and AI-driven digital transformation.

title_ko: Assemblage, Rewilding, and the Korean EFL Learner-Generative AI Encounter
title_en: Assemblage, Rewilding, and the Korean EFL Learner-Generative AI Encounter
kw_en: Generative AI; assemblage theory; rewilding; morphologies of action; Korean EFL; domesticated interaction
abstract_ko: This conceptual paper examines how Korean English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learners reconfigure their language use and attitudes through sustained engagement with generative artificial intelligence (GenAI). Using assemblage theory, the rewilding framework, and Thorne’s (2016, 2024) concept of morphologies of action as a foundation, the paper reimagines the interaction between learners and GenAI as a heterogeneous coupling. In this coupling, human and nonhuman actors collaborate to create new patterns of action. Synthesizing prior work on text-based autonomous use, the paper proposes four interlocking discourse features for empirical scrutiny: absence of repair sequences, scarcity of non-lexical markers, a recurrent three-step pattern, and turn-length asymmetry. These features constitute domesticated interaction. The paper extends the framework of Thorne and his colleagues by integrating the structural particularity of the Korean EFL ecology. It also theorizes a use-to-attitude pathway via a register convergence hypothesis. The paper’s central argument is that cumulative domesticated interaction, mediated by register narrowing, can reshape learners’ tacit models of communication, images of legitimate English users, and self-positioning. Distinguishing short-term gains from long-term sedimentation, the paper derives four rewilded design principles for the Korean EFL context.

title_ko: 인공지능 기반 언어 자료 기반 학습 웹 도구 (AI-DDL)의 설계와 구현
title_en: Design and Implementation of an AI-Based Data-Driven Learning Web Tool (AI-DDL)
kw_en: Data-driven learning; AI-based web tool; elementary English education; corpus use; design-based research
abstract_ko: This study designs, develops, and validates an AI-based Data-Driven Learning (DDL) web tool for elementary English learners and teachers. While DDL has shown strong pedagogical benefits through corpus-based inductive learning, its use in elementary contexts remains limited due to learners’ low proficiency, cognitive constraints, limited corpus access, and the complexity of existing tools. Meanwhile, artificial intelligence (AI) offers new opportunities but raises concerns regarding reliability, control, and ethics. To address these issues, this study proposes a controlled AI-based DDL tool (AIDDL) that maintains core DDL principles while ensuring learner appropriateness and instructional control. Using a designbased research approach, iterative cycles of design, implementation, analysis, and revision were conducted. AI-DDL was developed based on four principles: exploratory learning support, curriculum alignment, controlled AI use, and learnerfriendly design. It integrates textbook-based corpus data with selectively generated AI content. Key features include concordance exploration, collocation mapping, inference prompts, and storage and review functions. Evaluation by 11 experts showed high design validity (M = 4.69) and usability (M = 4.56). Revisions improved interface clarity, level adjustment, and system stability. The findings imply that AI-DDL is pedagogically sound and practically applicable, offering a viable model for controlled AI integration in elementary language learning.

title_ko: ChatGPT-Mediated Revision in L2 Writing: An Exploratory Study of Learners’ Language Analytic Ability and Perceptions
title_en: ChatGPT-Mediated Revision in L2 Writing: An Exploratory Study of Learners’ Language Analytic Ability and Perceptions
kw_ko: AI 기반 L2 쓰기 수정/언어분석능력/학습자 인식
kw_en: AI-mediated L2 revision/language analytic ability/learner perception
abstract_ko: This study examined how learners’ use of ChatGPT (GPT-4) during a revision task was associated with changes in second language (L2) writing performance and explored its relationship with learners’ level of language analytic ability (LAA), as well as their perceptions of the revision process. Twenty-six Korean university students completed IELTS Academic Writing Task 2 essays before and after a ChatGPT-supported revision activity. Writing performance was evaluated in terms of task response, coherence and cohesion, lexical resource, and grammatical range and accuracy. LAA was measured using an artificial-language rule-induction test, and learner perceptions were collected through surveys and interviews. Results showed gains across all assessed dimensions following the revision activity. Correlational analyses indicated that LAA was associated with improvements in grammatical accuracy and task response, but not with lexical resource. Learners generally perceived ChatGPT as helpful for identifying issues and supporting revision, while also noting the cognitive effort required to engage with its feedback. These findings suggest that ChatGPT can function as a useful tool for supporting L2 writing revision; however, the extent to which learners benefit from such support may depend, in part, on their language analytic ability.

title_ko: L2 Writers’ Self-Directed Interaction with ChatGPT: Perceived Benefits and Temporal Changes
title_en: L2 Writers’ Self-Directed Interaction with ChatGPT: Perceived Benefits and Temporal Changes
kw_ko: AI 기반 제2언어 작문/챗지피티/외국어로서의 영어 글쓰기/피드백 인식
kw_en: AI-assisted L2 writing/ChatGPT/EFL writing/feedback perception
abstract_ko: With increasing integration of AI into L2 writing instruction, there is a growing need to examine how L2 writers interact with AI tools and how the nature of this interaction develops over time. This study examined students’ self-directed interactions with ChatGPT during take-home writing tasks and explored changes in their perceived benefits over ten weeks of use. Data were collected from university students enrolled in beginner-level EFL writing courses who completed ten weeks of writing tasks. Students’ weekly reflection notes on ChatGPT interaction for feedback were analyzed through inductive coding, and temporal changes were examined using repeated-measure ANOVA with post hoc tests. Additional data included ChatGPT chat histories, pre-/post-writing tests, and an end-of-semester survey. The analysis of student reflections identified six major areas of perceived benefit from ChatGPT feedback: vocabulary, grammar, mechanics, content, organization, and metacognitive awareness. Over time, reflections related to grammar and mechanics decreased significantly, whereas content-related reflections increased steadily. Taken together, the findings of this study indicate that sustained interaction with ChatGPT may foster developmental changes in how students use the tool, shifting from form-focused error correction to more meaning-oriented refinement.
