title_ko: A Comparison of AI, Professor, Peer, and Self-Feedback in University English Presentations
title_en: A Comparison of AI, Professor, Peer, and Self-Feedback in University English Presentations
kw_ko: 말하기 피드백/영어 발표/인공지능 피드백/교수 피드백/자가 및 동료 피드백
kw_en: speaking feedback/English presentation/AI feedback/professor feedback/self- and peer feedback
abstract_ko: This study aims to compare four common types of feedback used in university English presentation activities: artificial intelligence (AI), professor, peer, and self-feedback. A total of 38 first-year students enrolled in a first-year English course at a Korean university participated in this study by recording and evaluating practice videos to provide feedback to help improve their final presentations. Each of the two practice videos received evaluation scores and written comments from multiple sources, including AI tools, the professor, their peers, and themselves. To examine students’ perceptions of these feedback sources, data were collected through Likert-scale survey items measuring perceived effectiveness and preference, as well as open-ended responses explaining students’ choices. Data analysis included descriptive statistics for the survey responses and content analysis for the qualitative comments. The research findings are as follows. Firstly, professor feedback was perceived as the most effective source for improving presentation performance. Secondly, peer feedback was viewed as helpful for providing additional perspectives on presentation quality. Thirdly, AI and self-feedback were generally perceived as less reliable than human feedback. These findings suggest that combining multiple feedback sources may support speaking development in university English presentation tasks, with pedagogical implications and directions for future research discussed.

title_en: Mapping AI-Assisted English Language Assessment Research from 2015 to 2025: A Text-Mining Review
kw_ko: 인공지능/영어평가/텍스트 마이닝
kw_en: artificial intelligence/English language assessment/text mining
abstract_ko: This study provides a corpus-based, data-driven synthesis of research on AI-assisted English language assessment published between 2015 and 2025. Using a corpus of 275 peer-reviewed articles indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection, the study applies an integrated text-mining approach to identify dominant research themes and their structural relationships. The findings indicate that the field has been strongly anchored in automated writing evaluation and automated essay scoring, with writing assessment serving as the central research axis. At the same time, recent studies have increasingly emphasized feedback provision, learner engagement, human–AI comparison, and issues of transparency and fairness. Automated speaking assessment based on ASR technologies has also emerged as a growing but still underrepresented area. Overall, the results suggest an increasing thematic orientation toward learner-oriented and feedback-driven assessment practices. The study offers an empirical knowledge map of AI-assisted English language assessment and provides implications for the development of human–AI hybrid assessment systems and responsible use of AI in language assessment.

title_ko: AI 챗봇을 활용한 인터뷰 영어 수업의 항공 객실서비스 전공 대학생의 인식: 자기주도학습과 자기효능감을 중심으로
title_en: Perceptions of airline cabin service majors on AI chatbot-assisted interview English classes: Focusing on self-directed learning and self-efficacy
kw_ko: 인공지능/챗지피티/인터뷰 영어/자기주도학습/자기효능감
kw_en: artificial intelligence/ChatGPT/interview English/self-directed learning/self-efficacy
abstract_ko: This study investigated the relationships among learners’ perceptions of AI chatbot use, self-directed learning, and self-efficacy in an interview English course utilizing ChatGPT, and explored the educational implications of generative AI-based instructional design. The course was redesigned around AI tools and implemented in a cyclical structure consisting of model answer generation, instructor feedback, and speaking practice. Answer sharing through Padlet and TTS-based pronunciation practice were also incorporated. Survey data from 49 out of 63 enrolled students majoring in Airline Cabin Service were analyzed. The results indicated that learners perceived the AI chatbot as practically helpful for organizing interview responses and preparing for speaking tasks, with generally high levels of positive responses across related items. Experiences of adjusting question difficulty through prompting and generating responses were associated with increased learning efficacy and speaking confidence. Subcomponents of self-directed learning and self-efficacy showed significant correlations with perceptions of AI chatbot use, and regression analysis revealed that the model including these two variables significantly explained learners’ perceptions of AI use. This study shows that systematically integrating generative AI with instructor feedback can enhance learners’ self-directedness, self-efficacy, and speaking confidence, suggesting the value of positioning AI as a structured learning partner in speaking-focused courses.

title_ko: ChatGPT 기반 피드백을 활용한 대학교 영어쓰기 수업에서 학습자의 자기조절학습의 변화
title_en: Changes in university students’ self-regulated learning in an English writing course with ChatGPT-based feedback
kw_ko: English writing/ChatGPT-based feedback/self-regulated learning/learner’s perception/영어쓰기/챗GPT기반 피드백/자기조절학습/학습자 인식
kw_en: English writing/ChatGPT-based feedback/self-regulated learning/learner’s perception
abstract_ko: As artificial intelligence and digital technologies are widely used in writing instruction, classrooms are adopting technology-supported feedback. This study investigates changes in learners’ self-regulated learning in a ChatGPT-based feedback English writing course. The research question for this study was: How does self-regulated learning change across motivational, cognitive, and behavioral domains before and after the course? The study was conducted in the English writing classes during the fall semester of 2025. A total of 48 students participated over a 15-week period. Data were collected through pre- and post questionnaires, in-depth interviews, and classroom observations. Quantitative data were analyzed using the Wilcoxon matched pairs signed-rank test while qualitative data were analyzed to support and explain the quantitative results. The major finding was that statistically significant changes were observed only in learners’ self-efficacy within the motivational domain over the course. The finding suggests that ChatGPT-based feedback is effective in supporting learners’ motivational regulation, particularly self-efficacy. However, to promote broader development of self-regulated learning, AI-based feedback may need to be accompanied by instructional support that guides learners’ monitoring, decision-making, and sustained engagement.

title_ko: 인공지능의 한국어 수행 양상과 정렬 분석─공무원 국어 시험 기반 벤치마크를 중심으로─
title_en: Evaluating the Korean Language Performance and Alignment of Large Language Models: A Benchmark Study Based on the Korean Civil Service Exam
authors: 박서윤(연세대학교); 강조은(연세대학교); 김지학(연세대학교); 나예찬(연세대학교 언어정보학협동과정); 박경원(연세대학교 인공지능학과); 신현진(연세대학교); 안수빈(연세대학교); 엄주영(연세대학교); 왕소남(연세대학교 언어정보학협동과정); 윤미현(연세대학교); 임준호(튜터러스랩스); 전형배(튜터러스랩스); 김한샘(연세대학교)
kw_ko: 거대언어모델(LLM); 한국 공무원 국어 시험; 벤치마크; 언어 능력; 정렬(alignment); 강건성(robustness); 정성 평가
kw_en: Large Language Model (LLM); Korean Civil Service Exam; Benchmark; Language Proficiency; Alignment; Robustness; Qualitative Evaluation
abstract_ko: 한국어 자연어처리 분야에서 거대언어모델(LLM)의 언어 수행 능력을 정밀하게 평가하려는 수요가 높아지고 있으나 기존 벤치마크는 정답이 없거나 복수 정답인 문항을 포함한 단일 정답 선택형 문항에 편중되어 모델의 언어 이해 능력과 형식 적응 능력을 변별하는 데 한계가 있다. 본 연구는 이러한 문제를 해결하기 위해 공무원 국어 시험 문항을 기반으로 벤치마크 데이터셋을 구축하고 인지적 정렬(cognitive alignment)과 형식적 정렬(formal alignment)이라는 두 층위에서 LLM의 언어 수행 양상을 분석하는 평가 프레임워크를 제안하였다. 인지적 정렬 평가를 위해 각 문항에 Bloom(1956)의 교육목표 분류학에 기반한 이해 수준(지식적·사실적·추론적·비판적 이해)과 국어 교육과정 기준의 언어 영역(문법·어휘·문학·독서·쓰기·의사소통) 주석을 부여하였고, 형식적 정렬 평가를 위해 원본 문항에 복수 정답 선택 및 ‘정답 없음’ 선지 추가라는 두 가지 형식 변형 조건을 설계하였다. 상용·오픈소스·한국어 특화 모델을 포함한 9개 LLM을 대상으로 정확도 기반 정량 평가와 정확성·사실성·관련성·조직·표현 적합성 5개 축의 정성 평가를 진행한 결과, 추론 특화 상용 모델인 Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude, GPT-4.1이 정량·정성 평가 모두에서 우수한 성능을 보였다. 언어 영역별로는 대부분의 LLM들이 독서·문학에서 강세를, 문법·어휘에서 일관된 저성능을 나타냈으며 이해 수준별로는 지식적 이해 문항에서 가장 낮은 정답률을 기록하였다. 이는 현재 LLM이 텍스트 기반 정보 이해에는 일정 수준 정렬되어 있으나 한국어 언어 지식 인출을 요구하는 인지적 목표와의 정렬은 구조적으로 취약함을 보여준다. 형식 변경 후에는 GPT-4.1을 제외한 전 모델에서 정답률이 하락하였으며, 특히 독서·문학 영역과 사실적 이해 수준에서 하락폭이 두드러졌다. 정량-정성 상관 분석에서는 사실성과 관련성이 정답 여부와 유의한 상관을 보인 것과 다르게 표현 적합성은 전·후 조건 모두에서 정답과 무관한 것으로 나타났다. 본 연구를 통해 한국어 LLM 평가에서 표면적 유창성보다 내용적 정확성·사실성 중심의 정성 지표를 우선해야 하며 세부적인 평가 분석 프레임워크를 적용하는 것이 모델의 언어 이해 능력을 측정하는 데 필수적임을 확인하였다.
abstract_en: As the demand for precise evaluation of large language models’ (LLMs) Korean language performance continues to grow, existing benchmarks remain limited in that they often rely on single-answer multiple-choice formats and provide insufficient insight into models’ language competence and their sensitivity to question formats. To address these limitations, this study proposes an evaluation framework for analyzing LLM performance along two dimensions: cognitive alignment and formal alignment. The framework is applied to a benchmark dataset of 190 items drawn from the 2024 Korean-language section of the Korean Civil Service Exam. Each item was annotated according to comprehension levels derived from Bloom’s (1956) Taxonomy of Educational Objectives, knowledge-based, factual, inferential, and critical understanding, as well as six language domains in the national Korean language curriculum: grammar, vocabulary, literature, reading, writing, and oral communication. To measure formal alignment, two types of format modifications were applied to the original items: a standard multiple-choice format and a modified format with an added “none of the above” option. Nine LLMs, spanning commercial, open-source, and Korean-specialized models, were evaluated through an accuracy-based quantitative and a qualitative evaluation based on five criteria: accuracy, factuality, relevance, organization, and linguistic appropriateness. The results showed that reasoning-oriented commercial models including Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude, and GPT-4.1 — achieved better performance on both quantitative and qualitative evaluations. Across language domains, most LLMs demonstrated better performance in reading and literature than in grammar and vocabulary; across comprehension levels, knowledge-based items yielded the lowest accuracy overall. These findings indicate that current LLMs are relatively well aligned with text-based information comprehension, but remain structurally vulnerable when tasks require the retrieval and application of Korean linguistic knowledge. Format modification led to a decline in accuracy across all models except GPT-4.1, with particularly notable drops in the reading and literature domains and at the factual comprehension level. Correlation analysis between quantitative and qualitative measures showed that factuality and relevance are significantly associated with correct answers, whereas linguistic appropriateness was not significantly associated with accuracy regardless of format condition. Overall, these findings suggest that Korean LLM evaluation should place greater emphasis on content-oriented qualitative indicators, particularly accuracy and factuality, rather than surface-level fluency alone. They also demonstrate the need for a more detailed analytical framework alongside standard accuracy-based evaluation in order to better assess models’ Korean language comprehension.

title_ko: Tracking the Evolution of EFL College Learners’ Interactional Agency in ChatGPT-Mediated Speaking Tasks
title_en: Tracking the Evolution of EFL College Learners’ Interactional Agency in ChatGPT-Mediated Speaking Tasks
kw_en: GenAI/human-AI assemblage/interactional agency/discourse leadership/L2 speaking
abstract_ko: This multi-phase study investigates the seven-week developmental trajectory of interactional agency among EFL college learners (N = 32) in ChatGPT-mediated speaking tasks. Drawing on the human-AI assemblage framework, the research tracks the migration from initial agentic friction to discursive synergy. Data from three time points (T1, T2, T3) were analyzed via one-way repeated measures ANOVA. Results revealed a distinctive reconfiguration of interactional roles. First, learners’ initial mechanical and procedural struggles diminished significantly over time, marked by a sharp decline in both other-initiated repairs and procedural instructions by the final phase. Second, learners’ capacity for strategic interactional monitoring evolved robustly, characterized by a substantial turnover toward autonomous self-initiated repairs. Simultaneously, the density of agentic moves experienced a dramatic surge, reflecting proactive leadership where learners consistently orchestrated thematic transitions and initiations in their turns. Finally, topic durability expanded substantially, validating the successful attainment of sustained and complex conversational architecture. Qualitative triangulation confirmed this profound transition from interactional dependency to autonomous discourse orchestration. Qualitative triangulation confirmed a transition from interactional dependency to autonomous orchestration. Pedagogical implications for scaling this multi-phase developmental model in digital language curricula are discussed, specifically highlighting how educators can systematically scaffold human-AI collaboration.

title_ko: AI 기반 영어 읽기 플랫폼 활용 과정에서 나타난 초등학교 6학년 학습자 주도성에 관한 실행연구
title_en: An Action Research Study on Learner Agency among Sixth-Grade Students Using an AI-Based English Reading Platform
kw_ko: AI 기반 영어교육; AI 기반 영어 낭독 플랫폼; 초등영어 수업; 초등영어 읽기
kw_en: AI-Based English teaching; AI-Based English reading-aloud platform; primary English lesson; primary English reading
abstract_ko: This action research explored how learner agency emerged among 20 sixth-grade students participating in AI-based English reading activities over six months. Drawing on interviews, teacher journals, researcher meetings, and reading data from an AI-based platform, the study examined both the improvement of English reading ability and the different ways learner agency appeared in class. The findings showed that most students improved in reading accuracy, comprehension, and fluency. Four patterns of learner agency were identified: well-balanced agency, accuracy-oriented agency, transitional agency, and emerging-stage agency. The findings suggest that learner agency develops differently even within the same learning environment and is shaped by the interaction of intrinsic motivation, external learning conditions, peer interaction, and AI-based instructional contexts. While some students showed strong self-regulation and active participation, others were more affected by external rewards and classroom structures. The study suggests that supporting learner agency in AI-based English education requires not only careful teacher support and individualized coaching but also consistent educational support from schools and educational authorities.

title_ko: MCP와 생성형 AI를 활용한 영어 글쓰기 자동 채점 및 피드백 시스템의 타당도 검증 연구
title_en: Validating MCP-Based, GenAI-Powered Automated Essay Scoring and Feedback System in English Language Assessment
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 인공지능 에이전트; 모델 컨텍스트 프로토콜; 에세이 자동평가; 영어평가; 피드백
kw_en: GenAI; AI agents; MCP; automated essay scoring; English language assessment; feedback
abstract_ko: In recent years, generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), such as Claude and ChatGPT, are being used to develop automated scoring systems in various contexts of English language assessment. Oftentimes, the model context protocol (MCP) is employed as a platform for coordinating between LLM and AI agents in the AI agent (or agentic AI) systems. The main goals of the current paper are to: (a) build MCP-based, GenAI-powered automated essay scoring models (zero-shot, few-shot) by using Claude as the base GenAI program, (b) use these scoring models to evaluate the EFL learners’ essays enrolled in a college English course at a university located in Seoul, South Korea, and (c) investigate not only the reliability and validity of automated essay scores in comparison with human rater scores but also the usefulness of generative feedback from the automated scoring system. Results of analyses show that relatively high score agreement can be achieved between the Claude-powered automated essay scoring system and human raters; high correlations are observed between the automated and human rater scores; and the automated scoring systems also produced very useful diagnostic feedback for students. Implications of the findings are also discussed along with some recommendations for future avenues for research on GenAI-based automated essay scoring in South Korea.

kw_ko: 시각장애; 인공지능; 영어; 교수·학습 지도안; 인공지능 기반 수업 모형

abstract_ko: [목적] 이 연구는 시각장애 학생을 대상으로 인공지능 기반 수업 모형을 활용하여 영어 교수·학습지도안을 개발하고 직접 적용한 결과를 분석하는 데 목적을 두고 실시되었다. [방법] 인공지능 기반 수업 모형을 활용하여 영어 교수·학습지도안을 개발하는 근거로 설계 기반 연구(design-based research) 방식을 채택하였다. 문헌 연구를 통해 영어 교과에 적합한 인공지능 기반 수업 모형의 단계와 세부 활동을 결정한 후 시각장애학생들을 위한 영어 수업에서 필요한 교수 전략과 예시 활동을 수립하였다. 이를 토대로 C 시각장애 학교에재학 중인 시각장애 중학생 2명을 대상으로 45분 기준으로 총 12회기의 생활 주제 중심 영어 교수·학습지도안을 개발하여 적용한 후에 교사 평가와 학생 자기 평가를 통해 인공지능 기술을 포함한 영어 능력에서의변화를 분석하였다. [결과] 이 연구의 결과는 두 가지로 정리할 수 있다. 첫째, 영어 교과에서 인공지능 기반수업 모형의 단계와 세부 활동에 적용될 교수 전략과 예시 활동을 모색한 후 인공지능과 영어를 융합한 수업 활동으로 교수·학습지도안을 개발하였다. 둘째, 인공지능 기반 수업 모형을 활용한 영어 교수·학습지도안으로 시각장애 학생을 교육한 결과, 수업 전에 비해 수업 후에 학생들의 인공지능 기술을 포함한 영어 능력에 긍정적인 변화가 있었다. [결론] 이 연구는 시각장애 교육 분야에서 인공지능을 활용한 교과 수업 설계에대한 정보가 필요한 실정에서 인공지능 기반 수업 모형의 단계, 세부 활동, 교수 전략과 예시 활동 그리고교수·학습지도안까지 개발하였다는 데 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: [Purpose] This study was implemented to analyze the results of developing and applying English teaching‑learning plans using an artificial intelligence‑based instructional model for the visually impaired. [Method] The study employed a design‑based research approach as the foundation for developing English teaching–learning plans grounded in an AI‑based instructional model. After identifying the stages and specific activities of an instructional model appropriate for the English curriculum through a review of the literature, corresponding teaching strategies and example activities were developed for use in English classes for students with visual impairments. A total of 12 life‑themed English teaching–learning sessions were developed and implemented with two middle school students enrolled in C School for the Blind. Changes in their English proficiency, including competencies related to AI technology, were subsequently analyzed through teacher evaluations and student self‑evaluations. [Results] The results of this study can be summarized as follows. First, after identifying the instructional strategies and example activities appropriate for each stage and detailed component of an AI‑based instructional model in the English curriculum, teaching–learning plans integrating AI and English instruction were developed specifically for students with visual impairments. Second, as a result of implementing these English teaching–learning plans for students with visual impairments, positive improvements were observed in their English proficiency, including AI‑related skills, when comparing performance before and after instruction. [Conclusion] The significance of this study stems from its development of the stages, detailed activities, instructional strategies, exemple activities, and complete teaching–learning plans based on an AI‑based instructional model at a time when information on AI‑based instructional design is needed in the field of education for students with visual impairments.

title_ko: AI 기반 ESP 교육의 발전 방향 —소방영어를 중심으로
title_en: Developmental Directions for AI-Based ESP Education: Focusing on English for Firefighting
kw_ko: 소방영어; 특수목적영어; 지텔프; 생성형 AI
kw_en: English for Firefighting; English for Specific Purposes(ESP); G-TELP; Generative AI
abstract_ko: The purpose of this study is to suggest future directions for ESP (English for Specific Purposes) education in the era of artificial intelligence by developing and applying a specialized English for Firefighting teaching model. To achieve this, a three-stage ESP model was designed, integrating Generative AI to bridge the gap between academic theory and vocational practice: input, content-based language instruction, and task-based projects. The workbook features five core themes—Firefighter, Fire Escape, Fire Drill, Fire Suppression, and Fire Dynamics—structured into vocabulary, content, and group activities. To evaluate the pedagogical impact of the proposed model, a survey was administered to a total of forty-four university students enrolled in the English for Firefighting course. The results of the questionnaire showed that the participants expressed high satisfaction with the teaching materials, particularly in the balanced integration of major-related content and G-TELP preparation (M=4.23) and its effectiveness for test-taking (M=4.2). These findings empirically support the validity of the textbook design, which integrates job-based English learning with standardized test preparation. In conclusion, integrating Generative AI for material reconstruction and blended learning is vital for learner-centered ESP education in the digital era.

title_ko: Korean EFL Learner Corpus Research: A 20-Year Trajectory in the Age of Generative AI
title_en: Korean EFL Learner Corpus Research: A 20-Year Trajectory in the Age of Generative AI
kw_en: Learner corpus research; Korean EFL Learner Corpus Research; corpus linguistics; Korea Citation Index; diachronic analysis
abstract_ko: Against the backdrop of the paradigm shift brought about by generative AI, this study conducted a diachronic analysis of Korean EFL Learner Corpus Research (KLCR) over the past two decades, examining thematic, methodological, and technological developments. Drawing on 211 KLCR-related articles published in the Korea Citation Index (2002–2024), the study quantitatively tracked changes in research topics, corpus types, and analytical tools. Three key findings emerged. First, research on Grammar and Vocabulary dominated the field, while Pronunciation studies remained scarce, revealing a persistent thematic imbalance. Second, although privately compiled corpora are still prevalent, the rise in the use of open-access corpora since 2017 signals a clear shift toward data openness and shared resources. Third, analytical tools have advanced from reliance on stand-alone software to the broader use of programming languages and online platforms, culminating in the recent emergence of generative AI tools. KLCR appears to be transitioning beyond its traditional paradigm toward more meaning- and function-oriented interdisciplinary inquiry, supported by expanding data accessibility and technological sophistication. To ensure sustainable development, this study emphasizes diversifying research topics, strengthening collaboration across academic institutions to build large-scale open-access corpora, and enhancing researcher training in programming and AI.

title_ko: An AI-Assisted Framework for Error Annotation in Chinese Learner English Corpora
title_en: An AI-Assisted Framework for Error Annotation in Chinese Learner English Corpora
authors: 강병규(서강대학교); Jiangli Wei(Sogang University, Korea); 유원호(서강대학교)
kw_en: Learner corpus annotation; error tagging; Chinese learner English; AI-assisted analysis; human-in-the-loop
abstract_ko: Large-scale error annotation in learner corpora remains challenging, particularly for under-resourced L1 populations. Although Chinese learners represent the world’s largest group of English learners, publicly accessible, contemporary corpora of their English writing with comprehensive error annotations are scarce, limiting both research and pedagogical applications. This study introduces a human-in-the-loop, AI-assisted framework designed to deliver reliable annotations while also generating pedagogical feedback. The framework employs a streamlined three-domain taxonomy (Grammar, Lexis, and Mechanics) as well as a minimal four-field record structure (error type, span, correction, and explanation). Applied to Ten-thousand English Compositions of Chinese Learners (the TECCL corpus), the annotation pipeline integrates in-context demonstrations from the Chinese Learner English Corpus, chain-of-thought reasoning, and retrieval-augmented generation. In a proof-of-concept evaluation of 100 essays, inter-annotator agreement reached Cohen’s κ = 0.78 overall, with an exact-span match of 85%, and intra-annotator agreement exceeded 90%. Analysis of 164 sentences yielded 187 errors distributed as follows: Grammar 66.3%, Lexis 23.0%, and Mechanics 10.7%. Expert review confirmed high precision for morphosyntactic and lexical errors and identified nine omissions (recall = 95.4%), primarily involving idiomaticity or collocation. The pilot results suggest that the approach can support transparent scaling while preserving research comparability and producing materials suitable for classroom use. Although further validation with larger datasets is required, the framework shows potential for adaptation to other learner populations.

title_ko: ChatGPT-Assisted Approach to Redundancy Reduction: Pedagogical Implications for Information Compression in Advanced EFL Writing
title_en: ChatGPT-Assisted Approach to Redundancy Reduction: Pedagogical Implications for Information Compression in Advanced EFL Writing
kw_en: L2 writing; redundancy; syntactic compression; AI prompt; AI-mediated instruction; advanced L2 learners
abstract_ko: Producing concise and rhetorically effective prose is an essential skill in academic writing. This task, however, poses a particular challenge for EFL learners, as it involves various procedures for eliminating redundancy, ranging from simple lexical adjustments to the use of highly complex grammatical structures such as reduced relative clauses or elliptical concessive constructions (e.g., though not perfect). While a key objective is to compress information without sacrificing textual clarity, many EFL learners lack the requisite knowledge and skills, possibly because this area has received little attention in formal educational contexts. Drawing on 59 essays written by advanced Japanese EFL learners, this study identifies the major sources and patterns of redundant expressions and examines the potential of generative AI (GenAI) to support learners’ revision processes. The findings indicate that even advanced learners often fail to detect redundancy arising from seemingly simple repetition of lexical items and propositional content, and that these difficulties are closely associated with challenges in reconceptualizing sentence-level components as discourse-level elements. The study further demonstrates that carefully designed AI prompts, informed by linguistic research, can serve as an effective pedagogical tool to help learners identify and resolve redundancy-related issues.

title_ko: A Comparison of ChatGPT-Generated and Human-Authored Reading Comprehension Test Items
title_en: A Comparison of ChatGPT-Generated and Human-Authored Reading Comprehension Test Items
kw_en: ChatGPT-4; large language models; English language assessment; reading comprehension; automatic item generation
abstract_ko: The rapid advancement of generative artificial intelligence, particularly GPT-4, has intensified interest in its potential role in language test development. This study investigates the feasibility of ChatGPT-4 as a support tool for generating English reading comprehension items in high-stakes contexts. First, passage-level linguistic profiles were examined using TextEvaluator® for paired CSAT and ChatGPT-4- generated texts. The results showed a broadly similar overall complexity range, while revealing different subcomponent tendencies across syntactic, lexical, and discourserelated indices. Building on this textual comparison, a blind expert-rating survey was conducted with 31 Korean EFL teachers (in-service and pre-service), who evaluated ten paired items across five CSAT-style types in terms of linguistic authenticity, distractor’s attractiveness, and item difficulty. The survey results indicated that ChatGPT-4-generated items were rated higher for linguistic authenticity, whereas human-authored items were rated higher for distractor quality and perceived difficulty. Qualitative comments further suggested that AI-generated options were often less discriminating and more vulnerable to cue-based test-taking strategies. Overall, the findings support the practical value of ChatGPT-4 as a draft-generation resource, while underscoring the continued need for expert human oversight in construct alignment, distractor design, and difficulty calibration. The findings support a humanin- the-loop, augmented-intelligence approach to AI-assisted language assessment development.

title_ko: ChatGPT를 활용한 이야기 창작용 그림 프롬프트 개발: 가능성과 개발자 인식
title_en: The Development of ChatGPT-Generated Picture Prompts for Story-Writing: Feasibility and Developers’ Perceptions
kw_en: ChatGPT; picture prompt; picture development; task specifications; story writing; AI literacy
abstract_ko: The use of picture prompts is well established in story-writing tasks, with such pictures traditionally produced by hand, requiring considerable time and effort. Against this backdrop, this study is among the first to investigate the feasibility of using ChatGPT to develop picture prompts for story writing tasks. A total of 61 students enrolled in a university course on English Language Assessment participated in the study. After learning about task specifications and the characteristics required of effective picture prompts for story making, the students used ChatGPT to generate picture prompts, which were shared with the class through Google Presentations and revised based on feedback. The final products were uploaded to the instructor’s English writing YouTube channel, where they served as story prompts. The survey results revealed that: (1) ChatGPT-generated images are attractive and practical for story writing tasks; (2) Using ChatGPT greatly reduced the time required and compensated for developers’ limited artistic abilities; (3) Although limitations existed in fully reflecting developers’ intentions and subtle details, these shortcomings could be improved through repeated revisions; and (4) The experience enhanced the developers’ AI and digital literacy. Overall, this study provides promising evidence for the future use of AI programs in developing picture prompts for story-creation tasks.

title_en: Development and Application of an AI Diagnostic Assessment Platform for Primary English Literacy (AIDAPEL)
authors: 이수민(우암초등학교); 김민제(상당초등학교); 심규남(청주교육대학교); 권해경(나루초등학교); 이수지(솔강초등학교); 민덕기(청주교육대학교)
kw_en: English early literacy; diagnostic tool; basic academic proficiency level; AI-based assessment
abstract_ko: This study aims to develop and validate AIDAPEL, a specialized AI-based platform adapted from the DIBELS 8th edition to assess basic English literacy among 3rd and 4th graders in Korea. The research results confirmed high content validity and appropriate difficulty levels strictly aligned with the 2022 Revised National Curriculum. Notably, the AI-driven scoring system demonstrated superior accuracy, significantly outperforming standard speech-to-text technologies by effectively determining correctness through sophisticated contextual algorithms, even despite technical limitations such as ambient noise interference. Furthermore, students reported high levels of engagement and academic motivation due to the interactive nature and immediate feedback provided by the platform. Based on these significant findings, the study suggests enhancing technical stability through advanced prompt engineering, expanding the diagnostic scope to include upper primary grades. By integrating real-time error analysis and automated item generation, AIDAPEL can transcend simple assessment to provide highly personalized, self-directed learning support for underachieving students.

title_ko: AI 시대 초등영어교육의 생태적 재구성: 의사소통 기능에서 경험 중심생태계로
title_en: Ecological reconfiguration of elementary English education in the AI era: From communicative functions to experience-centered learning ecosystems.
kw_ko: 생태적 접근법; 의미 구성 역량; 내용 중심 통합 교수요목; 영어학습 생태계 플랫폼
kw_en: ecological approach; meaning-making competency; content-based integrated syllabus; English learning ecosystem platform
abstract_ko: This conceptual study proposes an ecological reconfiguration of elementary English education in the AI era. It begins from the recognition that elementary English education faces structural challenges, including limited instructional time, learner differences, unequal access to out-of-school English experiences, and the limitations of standardized classroom-based instruction. Against this background, the study reexamines the function-oriented implementation of communicative approaches in the Korean elementary EFL context and argues for a reorientation of elementary English education through the functional integration of CBI, WLA, and TBLT within experience-centered learning ecosystems. To develop this reorientation, this study draws on ecological perspectives on language learning, and reviews key concepts such as affordance, relationality, emergence, contextuality, context-sensitivity, and agency with attention to their implications for elementary English education. It then presents design directions for an expanded English learning ecosystem that connects school, home, after-school, digital, and AI-supported learning environments. Specifically, the study proposes a curriculum-based English learning ecosystem platform, English meaning-making competency as an overarching goal, a content-based integrated syllabus, children’s literary and informational texts in English as core multimodal materials, input-rich and meaning-oriented pedagogy, and process-oriented assessment. The study concludes by discussing implications and future research needs.

title_ko: 초등영어교육에서 기호학과 인공지능 활용 가능성 탐색: 애니메이션 유령신부 사례를 중심으로
title_en: Exploring the potential of semiotics and artificial intelligence in Primary English Education: A case study using the animated film Corpse Bride.
kw_ko: 인공지능; 기호학; 애니메이션 영화; 유령신부
kw_en: artificial intelligence; semiotics; animated films; Corpse Bride
abstract_ko: This exploratory case study investigated the educational potential of having elementary school students create stories in Korean using visual signs from an animated film and then transform those stories into English with the help of generative artificial intelligence. Corpse Bride was selected as the instructional material. The study was conducted over two months with four university students whose English proficiency levels were mid to low-intermediate. Four elementary school English teachers evaluated the educational potential of this approach. According to the findings, all the participants identified the Korean stories they created from visual signs as their own creative works. Becoming emotionally attached to their stories, they responded positively to the AI-generated English versions, stating that the process was helpful for English learning. The study suggests that generative AI may function not only as a technological tool but also as a mediator of meaning that connects learners’ experiences and ideas to English expression.

title_ko: 바이브 코딩(Vibe Coding)을 활용한 초등 예비교사의 AI 리터러시 함양 및 영어 교수·학습 자료 개발 역량 탐색
title_en: Exploring pre-service primary teachers’ AI literacy development and English teaching material design through vibe coding.
kw_ko: 바이브코딩; 인공지능; 에듀테크; 초등교사교육; AI 활용역량
kw_en: Vibe Coding; Artificial Intelligence; EdTech; Elementary teacher  training; AI Literacy
abstract_ko: This study explores the potential of “Vibe Coding” as a transformative tool for primary English education. While Artificial Intelligence offers a path toward individualized mastery learning, the lack of diverse, level-specific teaching materials remains a challenge. To address this, 24 pre-service teachers participated in a three-week project-based curriculum, developing 19 English learning applications using platforms like ChatGPT and Claude. Qualitative analysis revealed that participants successfully designed various tools, primarily focusing on 5th and 6th-grade literacy through gamified and scenario-based tasks. Quantitatively, the Wilcoxon Signed Rank Test showed statistically significant improvements (p < .05) across nearly all AI literacy domains, with particularly strong gains in prompt engineering and understanding AI principles. The findings suggest that Vibe Coding effectively lowers technical barriers, empowering non-specialist teachers to transition from passive technology users to “Educational Architects” who can create customized digital scaffolds. This research suggests that teacher education must evolve to foster these design-oriented competencies, enabling educators to bridge achievement gaps by integrating pedagogical expertise with generative AI. Ultimately, Vibe Coding serves as a practical bridge between a teacher’s creative vision and the delivery of equitable, personalized instruction in the AI era.

title_ko: 대학 교양 영어 독해 수업에서 클래스팅 AI를 활용한 독해-작문 연계 수업 사례연구
title_en: A Case Study of a Reading-Writing Integrated English Course Using Classting AI in a University Liberal Arts English Reading Class
kw_ko: 클래스팅 ai; 영어 독해; 영어 작문; 교양 교육; 사례 연구
kw_en: classting ai; english reading; english writing; liberal arts education; case study
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 대학 교양 영어 독해 강좌에서 AI 기반 플랫폼인 클래스팅의 교육적 잠재력과 실천적 적용 과정을 탐색하였다. 이를 위해 21명의 대학생을 대상으로 15주간 수업을 진행한 후 설문, 로그 데이터, 교수자 성찰 일지 등을 활용하여 질적으로 분석했다. 수업에는 AI 보조교사 '젤로'를 통한 독후 퀴즈와 영어 AI 글쓰기 기능이 활용되었다. 연구 결과, AI 퀴즈는 즉각적인 피드백으로 자기주도학습을 촉진하고 교수자의 채점 부담을 경감시켰다. 또한 AI 글쓰기는 작문 장벽을 완화하여 독해로 습득한 지식을 영작으로 자연스럽게 연계하도록 도왔다. 비록 글자 수 제한과 채점 일관성 결여 등의 기술적 한계가 지적되었으나, AI가 반복적인 평가 업무를 성공적으로 자동화할 수 있음을 보여주었다. 결과적으로 본 연구는 AI가 교수자로 하여금 고차원적 사고와 의미 있는 상호작용에 집중할 수 있게 함으로써 교양교육 현장에서 교수자의 교육적 역량을 확장할 수 있음을 나타낸다.
abstract_en: This study investigates the pedagogical potential and practical application of integrating an AI-powered EdTech platform, Classting, into a university liberal arts English reading course. Rather than focusing on quantitative performance metrics, this research qualitatively analyzes the instructional process and experiences of 21 university students over 15 weeks, using surveys, learning log data, student artifacts, and the instructor’s reflective journals. The core implementation featured two AI tools: 'Jello,' an AI teaching assistant for post-reading quizzes, and an AI English writing assistant for connected composition tasks. The results suggest that the AI-generated quizzes supported self-directed learning through immediate, individualized feedback while lessening the instructor's assessment burden. Furthermore, the AI writing assistant effectively alleviated the psychological barriers of English composition, helping students transfer the vocabulary and conceptual knowledge gained from reading into coherent writing. Although technical challenges such as word count restrictions and algorithmic inconsistencies in grading were noted, the study suggests that AI can successfully automate repetitive evaluation tasks. Consequently, this automation allows instructors to reallocate their time toward higher-order critical thinking and meaningful classroom interactions, showing that AI can extend professional instructional capacities in general education.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 기반 교육 환경에서 영어 교사의 교수 동기에 대한 질적 연구
title_en: EFL teachers’ teaching motivation in generative AI-integrated classrooms: A qualitative study
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 디지털 교과서; 영어 교사; 교수 동기; 탈동기
kw_en: generative artificial intelligence (GenAI); digital textbooks; English teachers; teaching motivation; demotivation
abstract_ko: This study investigates how generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and AI-based digital textbooks (AIDT) influence English teachers’ teaching motivation and demotivation, as well as their instructional experiences and professional identity perceptions, in the Korean public education context. A qualitative approach was employed, drawing on semi-structured interviews with teachers across different school levels to capture their lived experiences of AI integration in classroom. Findings reveal that AI enhanced teaching motivation by reducing classroom anxiety, fostering confidence, and creating opportunities for innovative lesson design. Teachers emphasized that adapting texts, incorporating real-world issues, and personalizing materials for diverse learners increased both professional identity and student-teacher engagement. Such experiences reflect the fulfillment of competence and relatedness needs. Moreover, the use of AI expanded teachers’ sense of instructional efficacy, while also generating new challenges such as device management, technical setup, and the need of establishing assessment rubric for students’ assignment assisted by AI tools. The findings also highlighted that teachers redefined their roles from English-language knowledge transmitters to learning facilitators and advisors, though concerns about professional deskilling and identity crisis persisted. Overall, AI served double-edged functions simultaneously destabilizing and re-establishing teachers’ teaching motivation, instructional experiences, and professional identity perceptions.

title_ko: 중학생의 영어 AIDT 수업 활용, 교육적 가치와 기술 수용 인식 및 학습자 요구
title_en: Middle school students’ use of English AI digital textbooks, perceptions of educational value and technology acceptance, and learning needs
kw_ko: 영어 AI 디지털 교재; 수업 활용; 교육적 가치; 기술 수용; 학습자 요구; 중학생
kw_en: English AI digital textbook; classroom use; educational value; technology acceptance; learning needs; middle school students
abstract_ko: As AI digital textbooks (AIDT) are increasingly adopted in K-12 education, systematic research on their actual classroom implementation and student reception remains scarce. This study investigates classroom use of English AIDT, students’ perceptions of educational value and technology acceptance, and associated learning needs. A total of 653 first-year middle school students from four schools responded to a survey. Results revealed that classroom use of AIDT was generally limited and varied across schools. Among AIDT’s five core functions, learning analytics and assignments were used more frequently, whereas AI tutor was less utilized. Despite limited use, students reported largely positive perceptions of AIDT’s educational value and technology acceptance. Higher levels of classroom AIDT use and English proficiency were associated with more positive perceptions. Analysis of learner needs showed that students perceived AIDT as a convenient tool that supports language learning, enhances engagement, and facilitates personalized learning. Nonetheless, unmet needs included operational complexity, login difficulties, and system instability, alongside additional needs for enhanced learning support, gamification, expanded language-learning support, improved usability, and more advanced personalized functions. These findings reveal a critical gap between AIDT’s pedagogical potential and its current classroom realization, calling for deliberate improvements in system usability, instructional integration, and personalized support.

title_ko: Integrating AI, cognition, and affect: A systematic thematic review of English vocabulary research
title_en: Integrating AI, cognition, and affect: A systematic thematic review of English vocabulary research
kw_en: English; vocabulary; learning; teaching; systematic review; coding
abstract_ko: This study was to examine the major themes addressed in recent research on English vocabulary learning and teaching in Korean contexts, as well as the research methods and participant groups commonly employed, and the key findings reported. Data were collected through a systematic search of the Research Information Service System (RISS). The initial search yielded a substantial number of results, which were subsequently refined through a multi-stage screening and coding process. Through this multi-layered analysis, six major themes were identified. The findings indicate that AI-based and digital instructional tools play a significant role in enhancing vocabulary learning outcomes, while cognitive processing variables remain primary determinants of vocabulary retention. In addition, affective factors emerge as important mediating variables influencing vocabulary development. Furthermore, this study underscores the pedagogical value of reading based vocabulary instruction and emphasizes that lexical breadth plays a foundational role in reading performance. Regarding research design, the 21 studies employed a range of methodological approaches, including quasi-experimental designs with pre- and post-tests, task manipulation experiments, mixed-methods designs, corpus-based analyses, and survey-based investigations of learning strategies. The participant groups were diverse, encompassing elementary, middle, and high school students, as well as university learners. Pedagogical and research implications are discussed accordingly.

title_ko: ChatGPT as a Thinking Tool: Possibilities for Critical AI Literacy for EFL College Students’ English Debating
title_en: ChatGPT as a Thinking Tool: Possibilities for Critical AI Literacy for EFL College Students’ English Debating
kw_en: Critical Pedagogy; Critical Literacies; Critical Digital Design; ChatGPT; Generative AI; Practitioner Action Research; English as a second/foreign Language; Critical Design Literacy
abstract_ko: This paper explores how ChatGPT may contribute to developing EFL students’ critical digital literacies skills and what concurrent pedagogical interventions are required. The field of critical digital pedagogy centers around instrumental and functional approaches to technologies. While critical analysis of digital contents to be culturally biased and raising culturally marginalized voices through digital tools bring in critical emphasis in functional approaches to technology use in class in previous research, there exists a lack of attention paid to methods of incorporating AI to help students challenge their own positions. Practitioner action research was conducted in an English reading and discussion class. Eight hours of class discussion was documented for analysis. Analysis was driven by qualitative thematic methodology. Collaboration between ChatGPT and a human teacher demonstrated three representative processes of students’ critical digital literacies skills: construction of a position, deconstruction of that position to embrace multiple perspectives, and reconstruction of more critically aligned positions. The human teacher’s pedagogical approaches of moderating debates, leading students in articulating their viewpoints and consulting with ChatGPT, and reflecting on issues with diverse perspectives contributed to students’ construction and deconstruction of their positions and in many cases reconstruction of new perspectives. Students’ responses suggested that their thinking processes were aligned with the principles of critical digital pedagogy.

title_ko: Korean EFL Learners’ Perceptions of an LLM-Based Language Learning Strategy Recommendation System
title_en: Korean EFL Learners’ Perceptions of an LLM-Based Language Learning Strategy Recommendation System
kw_en: LLM; Emotional Intelligence; Foreign Language Anxiety; Learning Strategy Recommendation System; EFL learners; Perception
abstract_ko: This study developed an LLM-based language learning strategy recommendation system and examined EFL learners’ perceptions of the system in relation to Emotional Intelligence (EI) and Foreign Language Anxiety (FLA). A total of 51 EFL learners used the system to receive personalized learning strategy recommendations based on their affective characteristics and evaluated the system in terms of usability, appropriateness, utility, and satisfaction. Post-use in-depth interviews were also conducted to complement the survey data. The results showed that learners generally evaluated the system positively across all perception-related dimensions. Correlation analysis revealed that EI was negatively associated with usability, appropriateness, utility, and satisfaction, whereas FLA showed no significant relations with these variables. Mediation analysis further indicated that appropriateness fully mediated the relationship between EI and satisfaction, and serial mediation analysis demonstrated that EI influenced satisfaction through a sequential pathway of appropriateness and utility. These findings suggest that, in AI-based language learning environments, learners’ satisfaction is shaped not simply by the recommendation itself but by how appropriately and usefully they perceive the recommendation. This study emphasizes the importance of appropriateness in designing learner-centered AI systems for EFL learners.

title_ko: 중등 영어 교사의 생성형 AI 통합 실천과 교육적 신념: I-TPACK 관점의 혼합연구
title_en: Secondary English Teachers’ Generative AI Integration Practices and Pedagogical Beliefs: A Mixed-Methods Study through an I-TPACK Lens
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 중등 영어 교육; 교사 신념; 혼합연구
kw_en: I-TPACK; Generative AI; secondary English education; teacher  beliefs; mixed-methods research
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 I-TPACK 모델을 이론적 틀로 삼아, 한국 중등 영어 교사들이 생성형 AI를 교실 수업에 통합하는 실천 양상과 그 기저를 이루는 교육적 신념을 혼합연구 방법으로 탐구하였다. 이를 위해 현직 교사 60명을 대상으로 설문을 실시하고, 그 중 5명을 선정하여 심층 면담을 수행하였다. 분석 결과, 교사들의 AI 활용은 수업 준비와 텍스트 기반 활동에 편중되어 있었으며, I-TPACK 하위 영역 중 AI 기술 지식은 비교적 높은 수준을 보인 반면, 교수법과 내용 지식의 통합적 활용은 상대적으로 미흡한 것으로 확인되었다. 수업 설계 측면에서는 학생들이 AI 생성 결과물을 무비판적으로 수용하지 않고 비판적으로 재구성하도록 유도하는 전략이 주를 이루었으며, AI를 통한 즉각적 피드백과 개별화된 학습 지원에 대한 교사들의 긍정적 인식도 확인되었다. 한편, 인지적 의존성 심화, 학습 격차 확대, 윤리적 위험에 대한 우려 역시 일관되게 표출되었다. 양적·질적 자료의 통합적 분석을 통해, 영어 교육에서의 생성형 AI 수용은 교사의 신념, 수업 설계 역량, 맥락적 조건이 복합적으로 상호작용하는 다층적 과정임이 밝혀졌다. 이러한 결과는 단순한 도구 활용 훈련에 머무르지 않고, I-TPACK 기반의 체계적인 교사 전문성 개발 프로그램이 필요함을 시사한다.
abstract_en: This mixed-methods study examines how secondary English teachers in South Korea integrate generative AI into classroom practice and the pedagogical beliefs underlying such integration, framed by the I-TPACK model. Survey data from 60 in-service teachers and in-depth interviews with five participants revealed that AI use centers predominantly on lesson preparation and text-based activities, with AI technological knowledge as the strongest I-TPACK domain while pedagogical-content integration remained comparatively underdeveloped. Instructional design strategies focused on guiding students to critically rework AI-generated outputs rather than adopt them uncritically, and teachers highly valued AI-mediated immediate feedback and personalized learning support. Concurrently, concerns over cognitive dependency, widening learning disparities, and ethical risks were prominently expressed. The integrated analysis suggests that generative AI adoption in English education is a multifaceted process shaped by the interplay of teachers’ beliefs, instructional design competencies, and contextual conditions, underscoring the need for I-TPACK-based professional development beyond basic tool training.

title_ko: ChatGPT-Mediated Direct and Indirect Hybrid L1 Feedback in English Writing
title_en: ChatGPT-Mediated Direct and Indirect Hybrid L1 Feedback in English Writing
kw_en: ChatGPT; L2 Writing; (In)Direct Feedback; Hybrid Feedback; Uptake
abstract_ko: This study examined the impact of two types of L1-mediated written corrective feedback—direct and indirect hybrid (indirect plus metalinguistic)—on L2 writing. Twenty-six Korean university students, at beginner to intermediate proficiency levels, completed a three-stage revision task: an initial draft, a first revision after receiving feedback, and a second revision without further assistance. Participants were divided into two groups, each receiving L1 feedback via ChatGPT: one group received direct feedback, and the other received indirect hybrid feedback. Uptake was analyzed across five writing components: content, organization, grammar, vocabulary, and mechanics. Both feedback types significantly improved writing after the first revision, with the most substantial uptake observed in mechanics and grammar. However, uptake decreased in the second revision, particularly in content and organization, and new or reintroduced errors were common. Notably, direct feedback proved more effective for beginner-level learners in later revisions, specifically for structural improvements and overall uptake. Conversely, intermediate learners benefited more from indirect hybrid feedback, especially in content development. These findings suggest that feedback effectiveness may vary with learner proficiency, offering pedagogical implications for customizing AI-mediated feedback in L2 writing instruction.

Participants were divided into two groups, each receiving L1 feedback via ChatGPT: one group received direct feedback, and the other received indirect hybrid feedback. Uptake was analyzed across five writing components: content, organization, grammar, vocabulary, and mechanics. Both feedback types significantly improved writing after the first revision, with the most substantial uptake observed in mechanics and grammar. However, uptake decreased in the second revision, particularly in content and organization, and new or reintroduced errors were common. Notably, direct feedback proved more effective for beginner-level learners in later revisions, specifically for structural improvements and overall uptake. Conversely, intermediate learners benefited more from indirect hybrid feedback, especially in content development. These findings suggest that feedback effectiveness may vary with learner proficiency, offering pedagogical implications for customizing AI-mediated feedback in L2 writing instruction.

title_ko: Effects and Affordances of AI Chatbot-Mediated Refusal Instruction for Korean Elementary EFL Learners
title_en: Effects and Affordances of AI Chatbot-Mediated Refusal Instruction for Korean Elementary EFL Learners
kw_en: L2 pragmatic instruction; refusal strategies; AI chatbot; pedagogical affordance; young EFL learners
abstract_ko: The development of pragmatic competence is essential yet often under-addressed in elementary English as a foreign language (EFL) classrooms. To address this gap, this study investigated the impact of brief, curriculum-aligned AI chatbot-mediated instruction on the refusal strategies and perceptions of young Korean EFL learners. Using a mixed-methods approach, this study analyzed data from 57 fourth-grade elementary school students who participated in a two-lesson intervention involving pragmatically intensive (PDR-high) situations. Quantitative findings demonstrated a significant developmental shift from unmitigated, direct refusals toward contextually appropriate, mitigated patterns. Statistical analyses showed robust gains, characterized by medium-to-large effect sizes for key pragmatic shifts, suggesting that AI-mediated instruction was positively associated with pragmalinguistic development. Qualitative data further revealed that learners predominantly perceived AI chatbot interactions as a source of enjoyment and motivation, alongside valuing the immediate feedback provided. Although technological constraints such as speech-to-text (STT) recognition difficulties were frequently reported, learners demonstrated self-regulation by transforming these challenges into opportunities for pronunciation practice. In conclusion, strategically designed generative AI chatbots offer a viable pathway for cultivating early pragmatic competence beyond the limitations of the traditional classroom, provided that their pedagogical integration carefully balances cognitive and technological load.
