title_ko: 중국학 AI 챗봇 프롬프트 엔지니어링
title_en: Prompt Engineering for AI Chatbots in Chinese Studies
kw_ko: 챗봇; 중국학; 데이터
kw_en: AI; Chatbots; Chinese studies; Data
abstract_ko: 중국학 연구와 교육은 방대한 양의 정보와 자료를 필요로 하며, 이를 효율적으로 관리하기 위해 AI 챗봇의 활용이 주목받고 있다. AI 챗봇은 학습 목표에 맞춘 맞춤형 기능을 제공하며, 검증된 자료를 바탕으로 정확하고 신뢰할 수 있는 콘텐츠를 제공한다. 또한, 로컬 서버나 보안 환경에서 운영하여 데이터 보안과 개인정보 보호를 강화할 수 있으며, 직관적인 사용자 경험을 통해 학습 및 연구의 몰입도를 높일 수 있다. 특히, 중국의 역사와 문화적 맥락을 반영한 답변을 제공해 사용자의 심층적 이해를 지원한다. 그러나 챗봇에는 몇 가지 한계가 있다. 첫째, 복잡한 질문이나 다단계 질문에 대응하기 어려우며, 고급 학술적 토론을 반영하기에 한계가 있다. 둘째, 챗봇은 중국의 문화적 뉘앙스와 맥락을 완전히 이해하지 못할 수 있다. 셋째, 중국학의 최신 연구 결과와 사회적 변화를 반영하기 위해 챗봇의 지속적인 업데이트와 유지보수가 필요하다. 이러한 한계를 극복하기 위해, AI 챗봇을 외부 도구와 연계해 쉽게 수정하고 유지보수할 수 있는 방식으로 활용하면 시간 절약과 정보 접근의 효율성을 높일 수 있다. AI 챗봇은 중국학 교육과 연구의 방법론을 다양화하고 심화하는 데 중요한 역할을 할 수 있다.
abstract_en: Chinese studies research and education require vast amounts of information and resources, and the efficient management of these materials has brought attention to the use of AI chatbots. AI chatbots offer customized functions tailored to specific learning goals and provide accurate, reliable content based on verified data. Additionally, they can be operated on local servers or secure environments to enhance data security and protect personal information. By providing an intuitive user experience, these chatbots can increase engagement in learning and research. They are particularly useful in offering responses that reflect China's historical and cultural contexts, supporting users' in-depth understanding. However, there are some limitations to chatbots. First, they struggle with handling complex or multi-layered questions and have difficulties reflecting advanced academic discussions. Second, chatbots may not fully grasp the nuances and contexts of Chinese culture. Third, to stay current with the latest research and social changes in Chinese studies, continuous updates and maintenance of chatbots are necessary. To overcome these limitations, AI chatbots can be integrated with external tools, allowing for easy modification and maintenance. This approach can improve efficiency in time management and information access. AI chatbots have the potential to play a significant role in diversifying and deepening the methodologies used in Chinese studies education and research. A chatbot simultaneously has both advantages and disadvantages, but by creating various types of chatbots, whether simple or complex, and using them as supplementary tools in education and research, it is possible to achieve time savings, information accessibility, and consistency.
note: 중국학(역사·문화) 교육·연구용 챗봇, 언어교육 아님

title_ko: AI를 활용한 중국어 교육 적용 방안-실례를 중심으로
title_en: Application Strategies for AI in Chinese Language Education: A Focus on Practical Examples
kw_ko: 인공지능(AI); 중국어 교육; 거대언어모델(LLMs); 교육방안; 언어 학습
kw_en: Artificial Intelligence(AI); Chinese Language Education; Large Language Models(LLMs); Teaching Strategies; Language Learning
abstract_ko: This study investigates the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), in Chinese language education and learning in Korea. This study examines practical methodologies and real-world applications in pronunciation, writing, and teaching material preparation. This study found AI's benefits, such as personalized feedback and engaging learning environments, while also recognizing its limitations in addressing the unique aspects of the Chinese language. Thus, this study concludes that AI should enhance, rather than replace, instructors, highlighting the complementary relationship between AI and educators, particularly in teaching Chinese to Korean learners.
abstract_en: This study investigates the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), in Chinese language education and learning in Korea. Thus, this study concludes that AI should enhance, rather than replace, instructors, highlighting the complementary relationship between AI and educators, particularly in teaching Chinese to Korean learners.

title_ko: 중국어문 텍스트 시각화 및 공유 플랫폼 구축 전략 연구― AI 프롬프트 엔지니어링을 중심으로
title_en: A Study on the Strategy for Building a Visualization and Sharing Platform for Chinese Texts
authors: 朴正元(韓國外國語大學校中國言語文化學部)
kw_ko: 중국어문 텍스트; 텍스트 시각화; 자연어처리; 플랫폼; 프롬프트 엔지니어링
kw_en: Chinese Texts; Text Visualization; NLP; Service Platform; Prompt Engineering
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 중국어문 텍스트 시각화 및 공유, 소통을 위한 서비스 플랫폼 구축 전략을 제시하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 통해 중국어문 텍스트의 특성과 시각화의 필요성을 파악하고, AI 기반의 자연어 처리(NLP) 기술을 활용한 텍스트 시각화 방법론을 탐구하였다. 효과적인 텍스트 공유와 소통을 위한 서비스 플랫폼의 설계 방안도 제안하였다. 중국어문 텍스트 시각화 및 공유, 소통을 위한 서비스 플랫폼 구축은 현대 학술 연구와 교육에 매우 중요한 과제이다. AI 기술의 발전은 이러한 플랫폼 구축에 새로운 가능성을 제공하고 있으며, 본 연구는 이러한 가능성을 실현하기 위한 구체적인 전략을 제안하였다. 이를 통해 연구자들이 보다 효율적으로 텍스트 데이터를 분석하고, 이를 바탕으로 새로운 지식을 창출할 수 있도록 기여하고자 한다. AI 기반의 데이터 분석은 거의 완벽하게 지원되지만 텍스트 기반의 시각화, 콘텐츠화에는 여전히 한계가 있다. 프롬프트를 여러 번 반복하면서 오류를 보완해야만 원하는 최종 결과물을 얻을 수 있다. 창의적인 프롬프트 엔지니어링을 통해, 그동안 기술적 장벽 때문에 제작하거나 구축하지 못했던 시각화, 콘텐츠, 플랫폼을 수월하게 제작하여 교육과 연구의 효율성을 강화할 수 있을 것이다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to propose a strategy for building a service platform for the visualization, sharing, and communication of Chinese texts. By doing so, it aims to identify the characteristics of Chinese texts and the need for visualization, and to explore text visualization methodologies utilizing AI-based natural language processing (NLP) technologies. The study also suggests design approaches for a service platform that facilitates effective text sharing and communication. Building a service platform for the visualization, sharing, and communication of Chinese texts is a critical task in modern academic research and education. The advancement of AI technologies offers new possibilities for the development of such platforms, and this study proposes specific strategies to realize these possibilities. The goal is to enable researchers to analyze text data more efficiently and, based on that analysis, generate new knowledge. Although AI-based data analysis is almost fully supported, there are still limitations in the visualization and content creation of text-based data. Achieving the desired final results often requires multiple iterations and corrections. Through creative prompt engineering, it will become easier to create visualizations, content, and platforms that were previously unattainable due to technical barriers, thereby enhancing the efficiency of education and research.
note: 중국어문 텍스트 시각화 연구 플랫폼 전략, 교수학습 아님

title_ko: AI 음성 인식 ChatGPT 앱의 중국어 수업 말하기 영역 활용 방안
title_en: Exploring the Use of AI Voice Recognition ChatGPT App for Chinese Speaking Classes
authors: 權娥麟(成均館大學校中語中文學科)
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 챗GPT; 음성인식; ChatGPT앱; 인공지능; 중국어교육; 말하기; 회화; 활용; 프롬프트
kw_en: ChatGPT; ChatGPT App; AI; Voice; Speech-recognition; Educational tool; Chinese Language; Conversation; Self-directed learning; Prompt Engineering; Application
abstract_ko: ChatGPT의 발전 속도는 가속이 붙어 GPT-4 모델이 출시된 이후 2023년 5월에는 iOS용 공식 ChatGPT 앱, 7월에는 안드로이드용 앱을 출시하여 음성을 인식하는 방식으로 상호 소통이 가능해졌다. 2023년 11월부터는 ChatGPT Plus 구독자만 이용 가능했던 앱을 개방하여 회원가입만 하면 GPT-3.5 모델이 탑재된 무료 버전을 이용할 수 있었고, 2024년 5월에는 GPT-4o를 발표하면서 GPT-4 버전 앱의 무료 이용이 가능해졌다. 이에 중국어 수업을 진행하며 가장 아쉽게 느껴졌던 학생들의 직접 발화 시간을 늘릴 수 있는 보조 수단으로 음성 인식 ChatGPT 앱의 활용을 떠올리지 않을 수 없었다. 따라서 초급중국어 학습자가 접근하기 쉽고, 회원가입을 하면 무료로 이용할 수 있는 GPT-4 모델이 적용된 ChatGPT 애플리케이션(앱)을 통해 대학 교양 중국어 수업의 말하기 활용 방안을 모색해 보았다. 본 연구는 기존 연구 성과와 사전 설문조사 결과를 바탕으로, 대학에서 다루는 중점적인 교육 내용을 유지하면서 말하기 교육을 강화하기 위해 현재 수업에서 사용 중인 말하기 연습 방법을 ChatGPT 앱에서 구현할 수 있는지 단계적으로 실험하였다. 이 과정을 통해 교양 중국어 수업의 한계를 극복할 수 있는 방법론과 중국어 말하기 능력을 향상시키기 위한 적합한 프롬프트를 도출하였으며, 음성 인식 앱의 장점과 한계도 함께 논의하였다. 본 연구 결과를 통해 AI 기반 교육 도구의 실제 적용 가능성을 확인하고, 중국어 교육 방법의 다양화에 기여할 수 있을 것으로 기대한다.
abstract_en: This study aims to explore methods for teaching Chinese conversation using voice recognition technology that enables interaction with AI. Previous research on using ChatGPT in university courses has mainly focused on its potential, indicating a need for practical and specific methodologies. Therefore, we experimented with strengthening students’ speaking skills while maintaining the core educational content of college liberal arts Chinese classes by utilizing the customized learning and voice speech functions of the ChatGPT app. Experiments conducted using speech recognition apps focused on accurate pronunciation guidance and simulating real conversation partners. The results revealed several benefits: 1. Real-time feedback allows students to practice and correct their pronunciation immediately. 2. ChatGPT can enhance fluency and promote the practice of real-life expressions by presenting natural conversation scenarios appropriate to the learner’s level. 3. It can complement individualized instruction that may be lacking in a traditional classroom environment. However, challenges remain, such as improving the accuracy of user pronunciation detection and the efficiency of interaction. Despite these limitations, ChatGPT has proven to be a useful auxiliary tool for Chinese language education. The potential of voice recognition ChatGPT is significant, and it is crucial to continuously monitor the impact of future technological developments on the educational environment.
note: 음성인식 ChatGPT앱 말하기 연습 프롬프트 도출

title_ko: 중국어 교육에서 ChatGPT를 활용한 상호작용 수업 방안 모색 — 중국어 작문 수업사례를 중심으로 —
title_en: Exploring Interactive Teaching Methods Using ChatGPT in Chinese Language Education - Focusing on Chinese Writing Classes -
kw_ko: 중국어 작문사례; 중국어 교육; 설문조사; 구문문법
kw_en: ChatGPT; Chinese Writing Cases; Chinese Education; Survey
abstract_ko: 인공지능의 시대에 맞춰, 사회 전반의 변화와 함께 미래 사회의 교육 패러다임도 변화하고 있으며, 이는 현재 우리의 교육 패러다임에도 큰 영향을 미치고 있다. 본 연구는 이러한 삶의 변화에 발맞춰 ChatGPT를 활용한 중국어 작문 수업을 설계하고, 학생들의 작문 능력 향상 및 실생활 활용하고자 하는 의도에서 진행되었다. 본 수업은 2023년도 2학에 진행된 중국어 작문 수업으로, ChatGPT를 수업에 활용하여 작문 교육을 진행한 후 설문 분석을 통해 수업의 가능성, 방향성 그리고 한계점을 분석하였다. 설문 항목을 분석한 결과, ChatGPT를 활용한 중국어 작문 수업은 흥미를 유발하고, 인공지능과의 상호 작용을 통해 학습 참여도를 높이며, 조작 방법에 대한 평가와 함께 학습 내용에 대한 이해를 증진시키는 등 전반적인 영역에서 긍정적인 학습효과를 거둔 것으로 나타났다. 특히, 중국어 작문 수업에서 요구되는 문법의 오류 문제, 자연스러운 문장 쓰기 등 면에서 높은 긍정 값을 나타냈다. 다만, 인간과 인공지능과의 상호 작용이 학습 내용 전반으로 확산할 수 있는지는 추가적인 교수전략과 심도있는 연구, 학습설계가 필요할 것이다. 본 연구는 2학기 수업을 위주로 수업을 진행하고 자료를 수집했으므로 설문 집단 범위가 넓지 않고, 2학기 1회성 수업으로 진행되었다는 한계가 있지만, 차후 ChatGPT를 수업에 활용하여 수업을 설계하고 운영할 수 있는 좋은 사례가 될 수 있을 것이다. 끝으로 효율적이고 효과적인 상호 작용을 위해서는 일회성 체험수업에 그치지 않고 지속으로, 심화학습을 할 수 있는 방안이 필요할 것이다.
abstract_en: In line with the changing societal landscape and the evolving educational paradigm in the age of artificial intelligence, this study aimed to design a Chinese composition class utilizing ChatGPT to enhance students' writing abilities and promote practical application. Conducted in the second semester of 2023, the class integrated ChatGPT into the writing curriculum and subsequently analyzed the survey results to assess the potential, direction, and limitations of this approach. The survey results indicated that the Chinese composition class using ChatGPT had a positive impact on various aspects of learning, including increased interest, enhanced learning engagement through interaction with AI, positive evaluations of the tool's usability, and improved understanding of the learning content. Notably, the tool demonstrated particularly high positive ratings in addressing grammar errors and facilitating the writing of natural-sounding sentences, which are crucial in Chinese composition. However, further pedagogical strategies, in-depth research, and instructional design are needed to ensure that the interaction between humans and AI can be effectively extended to all aspects of learning. Although this study was primarily based on a single semester of data collection with a limited sample size, it can serve as a valuable reference for future implementation of ChatGPT in classroom settings.
note: ChatGPT 작문 수업 설계·실행 후 설문 분석

title_ko: 중국의 생성형 AI의 HSK 독해 능력 고찰 — ERNIE Bot4.0(文心一言)을 중심으로 —
title_en: Chinese Generative AI in HSK Reading Comprehension: An In-depth Analysis of ERNIE Bot 4.0
kw_ko: 중국어 독해력; HSK 시험; 생성형 AI; 사전 훈련 모델; 미세 조정 모델; 중국어 교육; 프롬프트 설계
kw_en: ERNIE Bot (文心一言); Chinese reading comprehension; HSK test; Generative AI; Pre-trained model; Fine-tuned model; Chinese language education; Prompt design
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 중국의 대표적인 생성형 AI인 ERNIE Bot(文心一言)의 중국어 독해 능력을 HSK 독해 시험 문항을 통해 객관적으로 평가하고 분석하였다. 결과에 따르면, ERNIE Bot은 전반적으로 우수한 중국어 독해 능력을 보여주었으며, 사전 훈련 모델은 어휘 영역과 담화 영역에서 특히 높은 성능을 나타낸 반면, 미세 조정 모델은 문법과 연결 영역에서 유의미한 개선을 보였다. 또한 ERNIE Bot은 풍부한 문맥을 제공하는 긴 텍스트에서 가장 뛰어난 성능을 보였으며, 한 번에 받아들일 수 있는 프롬프트 길이도 대폭 늘어나서 HSK 영역별 시험 문항을 처리하는 데 충분히 성능을 발휘할 수 있음을 확인할 수 있었다. 그러나 ERNIE Bot은 기본 규칙에 대한 이해가 부족했으며, 짧은 문장 간의 논리적 관계를 파악하거나 단독으로 제공된 문장에 대한 독해 능력이 상대적으로 부족했다. 이러한 한계를 극복하려면 프롬프트 설계와 함께 교육 전문가의 적극적인 참여가 필요하다. 본 연구의 의의는 중국 생성형 AI의 중국어 독해 능력을 체계적으로 분석하여, 향후 중국어 교육 및 평가 분야에서 AI 기술의 활용 가능성을 제시하는 데 있다. 또한, 사전훈련 모델과 미세조정 모델의 성능을 비교 분석함으로써, ERNIE Bot의 학습 능력과 개선 가능성을 확인하였으며, 이의 장단점을 분석함으로써, 향후 중국어 교육에서의 활용 방안과 개선 방향을 제시하였다. 향후 연구에서는 다양한 중국어 생성형 AI 모델들 간의 비교 연구, 실제 중국어 교육 현장에서의 적용 사례 연구, 그리고 ERNIE Bot의 한계를 보완하기 위한 방법론적 연구에 초점을 맞춰야 할 것이다. 결론적으로, ERNIE Bot은 중국어 독해 능력에서 높은 수준의 성능을 보여주었으며, 특히 미세조정을 통한 성능 개선 가능성이 확인되었다. 이는 향후 중국어 교육 분야에서 AI 기술의 활용 가능성을 크게 높여주는 결과로, 앞으로 더욱 심도 있는 연구와 실제 적용을 통해 중국어 교육의 질적 향상을 기대할 수 있을 것이다.
abstract_en: This study evaluated the Chinese reading comprehension abilities of ERNIE Bot, a leading Chinese generative AI, using HSK reading test items. Results showed that ERNIE Bot demonstrates excellent overall Chinese reading comprehension skills, with the pre-trained model excelling in vocabulary and discourse domains, while the fine-tuned model showed significant improvements in grammar and cohesion areas. ERNIE Bot performed best with longer texts providing ample context, and its recently expanded prompt length capacity allows for inputting comprehensive HSK test items across various domains. The research's significance lies in its systematic analysis of a Chinese AI's reading comprehension abilities, suggesting potential applications in Chinese language education and assessment. By comparing pre-trained and fine-tuned models, the study verified ERNIE Bot's learning capacity and improvement potential. However, ERNIE Bot showed limitations in understanding basic test-taking rules, logical relationships between short sentences, and comprehension of isolated sentences. Overcoming these limitations requires careful prompt design and involvement of education experts. Future research should focus on comparative studies of various Chinese AI models, practical application studies in educational settings, and methodological research to address ERNIE Bot's limitations. In conclusion, ERNIE Bot demonstrated high-level performance in Chinese reading comprehension, with potential for improvement through fine-tuning, promising qualitative advancements in Chinese language education through further research and practical applications.
note: ERNIE Bot HSK 독해 문항 성능 평가

title_ko: ChatGPT 활용 ‘真是’의 감정 색채 정량적 분석
title_en: A Sentiment Analysis Study of ‘真是’ Using ChatGPT
kw_ko: 감정 분석; 긍정적 감정 색채; 부정적 감정 색채
kw_en: ChatGPT; Sentiment Analysis; Zhenshi; Positive Emotional Coloring; Negative Emotional Coloring; 真是
abstract_ko: 본고에서는 ChatGPT를 활용하여 ‘真是’의 긍정, 부정, 중립적 감정 색채 비율 등 ‘真 是’의 감정 색채 양상을 정량적으로 분석하였다. 다량의 문장을 개별적으로 분석하기에는 한계가 있기에 ChatGPT를 활용한 연구 방법을 활용하였다. 분석 결과 총 1000 개의 문장 중에 긍정적 감정 색채가 531개로 53.1% 차지했고, 부정적 감정 색채는 451개로 45.1%로, 중립적 감정 색채는 18개로 1.8%로 나타났다. 이는 사전에 정의된부정적 감정 색채보다 긍정적 감정 색채로 사용된 것이 더 많이 나타났다. 現代漢 語詞典(第7版)와 現代漢語八百詞(增訂本)에 제시된 ‘真是’의 정의와는 매우 상반되는 결과임을 알 수 있다. 두 사전에는 ‘真是’를 동사와 관용어로 부정적 감정 색채를나타낸다고 정의하고 있다. 하지만 CCL 코퍼스를 통해 확인하면 ‘真是’는 이 두 가지 용법뿐만 아니라 부사로의 쓰임도 다수 발견된다. ‘真是’의 이러한 세 가지 쓰임을 통해 ‘真是’가 과거부터 연속적으로 변화되는 언어의 변화 과정임을 볼 수 있었다. 언어는 사람들의 의사소통 도구이다. 따라서 사람들의 생활 환경이 변화하게 되면언어도 그에 맞추어 자연스럽게 변화하고 전달되고 수용된다. 본래 실질적 의미를 가진 형태소 ‘真’과 ‘是’가 결합되면서, 문법적 기능을 하는 허사로 변화하고 이는 더나아가 관용어라는 화용적 담화 표지로 발전하는 과정 또한 언어의 자연스러운 진화단계라 볼 수 있는 것이다.
abstract_en: In this paper, we utilized ChatGPT to quantitatively analyze the emotional coloring of ‘真是’, including the ratio of its positive and negative, neutral usage. Due to the limitations in analyzing a large number of sentences individually, we employed a research method leveraging ChatGPT. The analysis results showed that out of 1000 sentences, 531 (53.1%) exhibited positive emotional coloring, while 451 (45.1%) displayed negative emotional coloring, 18 (1.8%) exhibited positive emotional coloring. This indicates a higher frequency of positive emotional usage compared to the negative connotations suggested by dictionary definitions. This finding significantly contrasts with the definitions of ‘真是’presented in “The Contemporary Chinese Dictionary (7th Edition)" and "Eight Hundred Words in Modern Chinese (Revised and Enlarged Edition)”. These dictionaries define ‘真是’ as a verb and idiom expressing negative emotions. However, examination of the CCL corpus reveals that ‘真是’ is not only used in these two ways but also frequently appears as an adverb. This raises the question of why these three usages are not fully defined in the aforementioned dictionaries. The three different uses of ‘真是’ can be viewed as part of a continuous and unified process of language evolution. Language is a tool for human communication, naturally evolving, transmitting, and adapting as people's living environments change. The combination of ‘真’ and ‘是’, originally words with substantial meanings, has evolved into a grammatical function word and further developed into a pragmatic discourse marker as an idiom. This process can be seen as a natural stage in the evolution of language.
note: ChatGPT로 '真是' 감정색채 분석, 순수 어휘의미 연구

title_ko: 快板书中的AI对话：ChatGPT与Ernie Bot中文创作能力比较研究
title_en: AI Dialogues in Rapid Clapper Performance: A Comparative Study of Chinese Creative Capabilities between ChatGPT and Ernie Bot
authors: 李六一(韩国加图立大学)
kw_en: ChatGPT; Ernie Bot; generative AI; Chinese content creation; comparative analysis; ChatGPT，Ernie Bot，生成式AI，中文创作，对比分析
abstract_ko: 本研究旨在通过“快板书”这一传统曲艺形式，系统比较ChatGPT与Ernie Bot在中文创作领域的实际应用能力，为AI技术在中文内容创作中的应用提供实证参考。研究采用定性与定量相结合的方法，从仿写能力、中文贴合度及作品易用性三个维度深入剖析了两款AI工具的表现差异。 研究显示，尽管ChatGPT与Ernie Bot在基础语言生成层面均展现出强大竞争力，但Ernie Bot在特定文化内容处理、韵律保持等方面表现尤为突出，尤其在文化准确性与文化背景深度挖掘上展现出显著优势。然而，尽管在多项评估指标上领先，Ernie Bot在实际应用中的易用性却未获使用者广泛认可，凸显了AI工具效果受个体需求与偏好深刻影响的特性。具体而言，ChatGPT则因其内容的可改编性和创作空间的灵活性，在作品易用性方面受到使用者青睐，表明在教育内容与艺术创作领域，技术完美性并非唯一考量，使用者的实际需求与创作体验同样重要。
abstract_en: This study aims to systematically compare the practical application capabilities of ChatGPT and Ernie Bot in Chinese content creation through the traditional performing art form of “Rapid Clapper Performance” (a type of Chinese rhythmic storytelling), providing empirical insights into the use of AI technology in Chinese creative content. Employing both qualitative and quantitative research methods, the study delves into the differences in performance between these two AI tools across three dimensions: imitation capabilities, Chinese language proficiency, and usability of the generated works. The findings reveal that although both ChatGPT and Ernie Bot demonstrate strong competitive abilities in basic language generation, Ernie Bot excels in handling culturally specific content and maintaining rhythmic consistency. Particularly, Ernie Bot shows significant advantages in cultural accuracy and depth of cultural background exploration. However, despite outperforming in several evaluation criteria, Ernie Bot’s usability in practical applications has not garnered widespread approval from users, highlighting the influence of individual needs and preferences on AI tool effectiveness. In contrast, ChatGPT is favored by users for its adaptability and creative flexibility, especially in the usability of its outputs. This indicates that in fields such as educational content and artistic creation, technical perfection is not the sole consideration; the actual needs and creative experience of the users are equally important.
note: 快板书 창작능력 비교, 콘텐츠 창작 연구·교육맥락 없음

title_ko: “文心一言”与“ChatGPT-4.0”近代文言文汉韩翻译效果对比研究 — 以《女界钟》西源人名地名音译词为例
title_en: A Comparative Study of Classical Chinese-to-Korean Translation between “Ernie Bot” and “ChatGPT-4.0”: Focusing on Transliteration of Foreign Names in Nüjie Zhong
kw_ko: 문심일언; 문언문; 중한 번역 효과; 인명과 지명 음역어
kw_en: Ernie Bot; ChatGPT; Classical Chinese-to-Korean Translation Effectiveness; Transliteration of Names and Places
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 “文心一言”과 ChatGPT의 《女界钟》 인명 및 지명 음역어의 한국어 번역 양상을 체계적으로 평가하였으며, ‘과거와 현재의 형태가 동일한 음역어(古今同形音译词)’, ‘과거와 현재의 형태가 부분적으로 변화한 음역어(古今部分同形部分异形音译词)’, ‘과거와 현재의 형태가 완전히 다른 음역어(古今形态全异音译词)’ 세 가지 유형의 음역어 번역 정확성을 중점적으로 분석하였다. 연구 결과, ‘과거와 현재의 형태가 동일한 음역어’에서 두 AI는 각각 90%와 96.3%의 정확도를 보여, 표준화된 번역 방식에 대한 일관성을 잘 유지하는 것으로 나타났다. 그러나 더 복잡한 ‘과거와 현재의 형태가 부분적으로 변화한 음역어’와 ‘과거와 현재의 형태가 완전히 다른 음역어’에서는 정확도가 크게 하락하여, 전자인 경우 ChatGPT와 “文心一言”의 정확도는 각각 58.3%와 41.7%였고, 후자인 경우 각각 40%와 33.3%로 더욱 낮아졌다. 이러한 결과는 두 AI가 특히 생소하거나 역사적인 단어의 표준화된 번역에서 안정성이 부족하여, 번역 정확성에 차이가 있음을 보여준다. 본 연구는 현재의 생성형 AI 도구가 근대 중국어 문언문 음역어 번역에서 나타내는 차이를 밝혀 향후 기계 번역 기술 개선의 방향에 대한 참고 자료를 제공할 수 있을 것이다.
abstract_en: This study systematically evaluates the Korean translations of personal and place names in Nüjie Zhong by Ernie Bot and ChatGPT, focusing on three types of transliterated words: ‘phonetic loanwords retaining the same form across historical periods(古今同形音译词),’ ‘phonetic loanwords with partially altered forms across historical periods(古今部分同形部分异形音译词),’ and ‘phonetic loanwords with entirely different forms across historical periods(古今形态全异音译词).’ The results indicate that for ‘phonetic loanwords retaining the same form across historical periods,’ the two AI systems achieved high accuracy rates of 90% and 96.3%, respectively, demonstrating consistent adherence to standardized translation methods. However, accuracy significantly declined for the more complex ‘phonetic loanwords with partially altered forms across historical periods’ and ‘phonetic loanwords with entirely different forms across historical periods.’ For the former, the accuracy rates of ChatGPT and Ernie Bot were 58.3% and 41.7%, respectively, and for the latter, 40% and 33.3%, respectively. These findings highlight the limitations of both AI systems in providing standardized translations for unfamiliar or historically nuanced terms, revealing discrepancies in translation accuracy. This study sheds light on the differences exhibited by contemporary generative AI tools in transliterating phonetic loanwords in modern Chinese classical literature and offers insights for improving future machine translation technologies.
note: 문언문 음역어 AI 번역 정확도 비교, 학습자 맥락 없음

title_ko: AI Hub [교육용 한국인의 중국어 음성 데이터]의 평가와 활용
title_en: A Critical Evaluation of AI Hub Korean Learners’ Mandarin Speech Corpus: Structures and Applications
kw_ko: 음성 데이터; 한국인의 중국어; 전사; 라벨링; 자동 평가; 자음; 대체오류
kw_en: AI Hub; speech database; Korean learners’ Mandarin; transcription; labeling; automated assessment; consonant; substitution
abstract_ko: AI Hub [교육용 한국인의 다국어 음성 데이터]에 포함된 중국어 음성 데이터는 국내외적으로 가장 규모가 큰 비모어화자 중국어 음성 데이터 가운데 하나이다. 따라서 이는 언어학적 연구와 더불어 교육용 AI 데이터 구축, AI 음성 자동 인식과 실시간 통역, AI 기반 발음·말하기 자동 평가 모델 개발에 매우 중요한 활용 가치를 갖는다. 본 연구는 [교육용 한국인의 외국어 음성 데이터]의 중국어 음성 데이터의 구조와 특성을 소개, 평가하고, 더 나아가 발음 평가용 데이터의 라벨링 데이터(labeled data)를 활용하여 한국인 학습자의 중국어에 나타나는 자음 대체오류를 분석한 결과를 제공한다. 따라서 본 연구 결과는 향후 학습자 한국인의 중국어 음성 데이터 구축과 품질 평가 시 보완, 고려되어야 할 점을 구체적으로 제안하며, 발음 오류 분석을 위하여 대규모 음성 데이터를 활용하는 연구방법론을 제시한다.
abstract_en: The Mandarin speech database, part of AI Hub “Korean Learners’ Multilingual L2 Speech Corpora”, is one of the largest L2 Mandarin speech datasets available both in and outside Korea. It therefore holds significant value not only for linguistic research but also for constructing datasets for AI training, automated speech recognition, and real-time interpretation. It is also essential for developing AI-based Mandarin pronunciation and speaking assessment models. The present study provides a detailed introduction and evaluation of the structure and features of the Mandarin speech database included in AI Hub “Korean Learners’ Multilingual L2 Speech Corpora”. It further demonstrates how large-scale databases can be utilized to analyze pronunciation errors in Korean learners’ Mandarin by examining consonant substitution errors using tagged data for pronunciation evaluation. The findings of this study offer constructive suggestions for enhancing the quality and reliability of the Mandarin speech database of Korean learners and further propose a novel research method for analyzing pronunciation errors using large-scale speech data.
note: AI 발음평가용 음성데이터 평가·자음 대체오류 분석

title_ko: 现代汉语歧义句的AI翻译研究——ChatGPT 4.0与“文心一言 3.5”的汉韩翻译对比
title_en: A Study on the AI Translation of Ambiguous Sentences in Chinese ― A Comparative Analysis of ChatGPT and ERNIE Bot in Chinese-Korean Translation
kw_en: 汉韩翻译; 人工智能; 歧义句解析; ChatGPT; 文心一言; Chinese-Korean translation; artificial intelligence; ambiguity interpretation; ERNIE Bot
abstract_ko: 本文以汉语歧义句的汉韩翻译为研究对象，重点分析ChatGPT4.0与“文心一言3.5”两款AI在处理不同类型歧义句时的表现差异，揭示其优劣势及局限性。研究从词汇、语法、语义三种歧义类型出发，评估两者在翻译中对双重语义的解析能力，旨在探讨AI翻译工具在高复杂度语境中的适配能力和改进方向。研究结果显示，ChatGPT4.0在词汇歧义处理上表现较优，能更灵活地结合上下文生成译文，双重语义解读的覆盖率显著高于“文心一言3.5”。然而，在语法和语义歧义的处理上，两者表现差距不大，且均存在双重语义解析不足、复杂语法结构处理能力有限的共性问题。此外，针对多义负载型句子的翻译，二者的语义解析和语境适配能力仍显不足，常倾向于单一解读，未能充分体现语境的多样性。本文不仅揭示了两款人工智能在歧义句翻译中的表现边界，还指出当前AI翻译在高阶语义处理中的技术瓶颈，为未来AI翻译技术的优化方向提供了参考。
abstract_en: This study examines the translation of modern Chinese ambiguous sentences into Korean, comparing ChatGPT 4.0 and Ernie Bot 3.5. It evaluates their ability to interpret dual meanings across lexical, grammatical, and semantic ambiguities, identifying strengths, weaknesses, and areas for improvement in handling complex contexts. The results show that ChatGPT 4.0 excels in lexical ambiguities, leveraging contextual information more effectively and providing broader dual-meaning coverage than Ernie Bot 3.5. However, for grammatical and semantic ambiguities, both tools perform similarly, with common issues such as insufficient dual interpretation and difficulty handling complex structures. Both also struggle with high semantic load sentences, often defaulting to a single interpretation and lacking contextual adaptability. This study highlights the performance limitations of ChatGPT 4.0 and Ernie Bot 3.5 in ambiguous sentence translation and identifies key challenges in advanced semantic processing, offering insights for future AI translation optimization.
note: 중의문 AI 한중번역 성능 비교, 학습자 맥락 없음

title_ko: 基于体认理论的AI辅助初级汉语口语教学研究
title_en: AI-Assisted Teaching of Primary Chinese Oral Skills: A Model Based on Embodied Cognition Theory
kw_ko: 체인 이론(Embodied Cognition Theory); AI 보조 기술(AI-Assisted Technology); 초급 중국어(Primary Chinese); 구두 수업(Oral Course); 교육 모형(Educational Model)

abstract_ko: 인공지능 기술의 급속한 발전과 더불어, 그 언어 교육 분야에서의 활용이 점차 연구의 주요 화제로 떠오르고 있다. 본 논문은 체인 이론(Embodied Cognition Theory)을 기반으로 한 AI 보조 초급 중국어 구두 표현 수업의 효과성과 가능성을 탐구하는 데 목적이 있다. 먼저 체인 이론과 그 언어 학습에서의 적용, 그리고 중국어 교육에서 AI 기술의 연구 동향을 고찰하여 본 연구의 배경과 의의를 명확히 하였다. 다음으로 AI 기술이 초급 중국어 구두 수업에 적용될 가능성과 장점을 상세히 분석하고, 이에 부합하는 교육 모형을 설계하였다. 이후 실증 연구를 통해 해당 교육 모형의 효과를 검증하였으며, 여기에는 대조군 실험과 설문조사 결과 분석이 포함된다. 연구 결과, 체인 이론을 기반으로 한 AI 보조 교육은 학생들의 학습 흥미와 구두 표현 능력을 유의미하게 향상시킬 수 있으며, 전통적 교육에서 발생하는 일부 문제를 효과적으로 해결할 수 있음을 확인하였다. 마지막으로 연구의 결론을 제시하고, 향후 연구 방향을 제안하였다.
abstract_en: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, its application in language teaching has gradually become a research hotspot. This paper aims to explore the effectiveness and feasibility of AI assisted primary Chinese oral teaching based on recognition theory. Firstly, by reviewing the theory of recognition and its application inlanguage learning, as well as the research progress of AI technology in Chinese language teaching, the background and significance of this study have been clarified. Subsequently, the feasibility and advantages of applying AI technology to primary Chinese oral classes were analyzed in detail, and corresponding teaching models were designed. Subsequently, the effectiveness of this teaching model was verified through empirical research, including the analysis of control group experiments and survey questionnaire results. The research results show that AI assisted teaching based on recognition theory can significantly improve students' learning interest and oral expression ability, while also effectively solving some problems in traditional teaching. Finally, the conclusions of the study were summarized and future research directions were proposed.

title_ko: ChatGPT 기반 현대중국어 어법 수업 설계 모색 ― ‘了’ 어법 항목을 중심으로
title_en: A Draft of Lesson Design for Modern Chinese Grammer Based on ChatGPT : Focusing on the Grammatical item ”了”
kw_en: ChatGPT-Based Application; Chinese Grammar Education; AI-based Learning Model; Grammar Learning Scenarios; Personalized Feedback
abstract_ko: This study designed a Chinese grammar teaching model utilizing ChatGPT and developed AI-powered tailored learning scenarios based on learners’ proficiency levels. Focusing on the frequently misunderstood grammar element “了”, the research provides detailed strategies for elementary, intermediate, and advanced learners. ChatGPT serves as an effective tool to enhance educational outcomes through real-time feedback and abundant example generation, complementing instructors’ supplementary explanations. Scenario-based analysis evaluated the strengths and limitations of ChatGPT, showcasing its potential as an AI-driven educational aid. The findings contribute to the empirical validation of AI tools in education and propose effective methodologies for integrating them into grammar instruction.

title_ko: 인공지능(AI)기술을 활용한 중국어 학습지도안 개발
title_en: Development of Chinese Lesson Plan Utilizing AI Technology
kw_en: AI Technology; Chinese Lesson Plan; ChatGPT; GPTs; Pre-service teachers
abstract_ko: This study investigates how AI technology can be used to develop Chinese lesson plans and assist pre-service teachers in creating effective plans through ChatGPT’s GPTs feature. To facilitate this, the ‘Chinese Lesson Planner’ GPTs was developed, and pre-service teachers used it to create lesson plans. The GPTs offered support in modifying lesson formats, recommending teaching methods, developing assessments, providing cultural resources, correcting linguistic content, and translation. However, there were instances where the responses from GPTs were inaccurate or did not align with students’ levels, and some responses were difficult to obtain due to insufficient or excessive learning data. Despite these challenges, GPTs proved to be a powerful tool for streamlining the lesson plan creation process and supporting teachers’ creativity. It is essential, however, for teachers to verify the accuracy of the information provided by the GPTs and use their expertise and critical thinking to refine the lesson plans. Teachers must carefully review and adjust the AI-generated content to ensure that the essence of education is preserved and the quality of teaching is maintained. A collaborative relationship between AI and teachers is necessary to maximize AI’s efficiency and creativity. By doing so, teachers can focus on delivering customized education that addresses individual student needs. Ultimately, AI can help reduce teachers’ workload, improve the quality of education, and enable more effective and innovative teaching. Continuous research and development of AI technology are required to shape the future of education.

title_ko: 基于ChatGPT的汉语会话课程设计以及教学效果研究
title_en: Research on Chinese Conversation Course Design and Teaching Effect Based on ChatGPT
kw_en: ChatGPT; Natural Language Processing; Chinese Language Teaching; Conversation Class; Artificial Intelligence; Teaching Effectiveness; 人工智能，自然语言处理， 汉语教学，会话课，教学效果
abstract_ko: 随着人工智能（AI）技术的快速发展，特别是自然语言处理领域的进步，智能语言助手在教育中的应用越来越广泛。ChatGPT作为一种大型语言模型，能够为学习者提供互动的语言交流环境，尤其适用于语言学习。本文旨在探讨如何利用ChatGPT设计汉语会话课程，并通过实践检验其在汉语教学中的效果。通过对实际教学过程的观察与分析发现，基于ChatGPT的汉语会话课不仅能够提升学习者的语言表达能力，还能增强其学习兴趣和自主性。
abstract_en: With the rapid development of Artificial Intelligence(AI)technology, particularly advancements in the field of Natural Language Processing(NLP), the application of intelligent language assistants in education is becoming increasingly widespread. As a large language model, ChatGPT can provide learners with an interactive language exchange environment, making it especially suitable for language learning. This paper aims to explore how to design Chinese conversation courses using ChatGPT and empirically examine its effectiveness in Chinese language teaching. Observations and analyses of the actual teaching process reveal that ChatGPT-based Chinese conversation classes not only improve learners' language expression abilities but also enhance their interest and autonomy in learning.

title_ko: 텍스트 마이닝을 활용한 AI 기반 중국어 교육 연구 동향 분석
title_en: A Text Mining Analysis of Research Trends in Artificial Intelligence -based Chinese Language Education
kw_ko: 텍스트마이닝; 인공지능; 중국어; 중국어 교육; 연구 동향

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 2000년부터 2024년까지 발표된 AI 기반 중국어 교육 관련 연구 41편을 대상으로 텍스트 마이닝 기법을 활용하여 연구 동향을 분석하였다. 분석 결과, AI 기반 중국어 교육 연구는 이론적 탐색기(2016-2020), 현장 적용 시도기(2021-2023), 생성형 AI 중심의 급증기(2024)의 세 단계로 발전해 왔다. 단어 빈도 분석과 네트워크 분석을 통해 '인공지능', '챗봇', '중국어교육'이 주요 연구 키워드로 도출되었으며, 특히 ChatGPT와 같은 생성형 AI를 활용한 학습자 맞춤형 교육이 최근 연구의 핵심 주제로 부상하였다. 그러나 영어교육 연구와 비교할 때 연구의 양적 규모, 주제의 다양성, 실증적 검증 측면에서 한계점이 있었다. 향후 연구 영역의 다각화, 실증적 연구 강화, 교육적 맥락과 윤리적 측면을 고려한 연구 확대가 필요하다.
abstract_en: This study examines the evolution of artificial intelligence applications in Chinese language education through text mining analysis of 41 research papers published between 2000 and 2024. Our findings reveal three distinct developmental phases: a theoretical exploration period (2016-2020), initial field application attempts (2021-2023), and a recent period of accelerated growth centered on generative AI technologies (2024). Word frequency and network analyses identified "artificial intelligence," "chatbot," and "Chinese language education" as predominant research keywords, with significant emphasis on personalized learning approaches utilizing generative AI tools such as ChatGPT. However, when compared to research in English language education, this field demonstrates notable limitations in research volume, topic diversity, and empirical validation. Our analysis suggests that future research should prioritize diversification of research domains, enhancement of empirical methodologies, and expanded investigation of educational contexts and ethical considerations specific to AI implementation in Chinese language instruction.

title_ko: A Corpus-Based Comparative Study of ChatGPT and DeepSeek in Chinese-English Translation
title_en: A Corpus-Based Comparative Study of ChatGPT and DeepSeek in Chinese-English Translation
kw_en: machine translation; ChatGPT; DeepSeek; translation Coh-Metrix; lexical diversity; syntactic complexity; discourse cohesion; corpus-based analysis
abstract_ko: The purpose of this research is to compare the translation performance of two advanced AI-based machine translation systems (MT) - ChatGPT and DeepSeek - in Chinese into English translation, focusing on multidimensional linguistic features such as lexical, syntactic and discourse aspects. To achieve this research goal, the study poses the following questions: Which AI-based system exhibits better translation quality, ChatGPT or DeepSeek? What are the specific linguistic strengths and limitations of these systems? Data sources were original Chinese texts, translations generated by ChatGPT and DeepSeek, and human reference translations. Automated linguistic analyses were conducted using standard MT evaluation metrics (BLEU, METEOR, and BERTScore) and Coh-Metrix to assess lexical diversity, syntactic complexity and discourse cohesion. The results show that ChatGPT performs better than DeepSeek, with more accurate word choices, simpler language suited for readers, and better text flow, making translations easier to read and understand. This study highlights the strengths and weaknesses of AI translation and suggests further research on human-AI collaboration and its role in education.

title_ko: AI 챗GPT와 딥시크를 활용한 중국시 연구와 학습
title_en: Research and study of Chinese poetry using AI ChatGPT and DeepSeek

abstract_ko: AI, one of the core technologies of the 4th Industrial Revolution, is currently causing major changes in our society. A representative example of this is ChatGPT, a generative artificial intelligence launched by Open AI in the United States at the end of 2022, and it has gained sensational popularity because it is a conversational model specialized in language. Then, at the end of January 2025, a Chinese artificial intelligence startup called DeppSeek developed DeepSeek-R1, an open source large language model, and created a sensation once again. What is particularly noteworthy is that DeepSeek developed AI with almost similar performance at a much lower cost than that developed by Open AI. Amid changes in the AI e c osystem, the author has been steadily researching Chinese poetry using artificial intelligence with interest. Previously, we considered ways to learn and teach Chinese poetry using artificial intelligence Jiuge and ChatGPT. This paper goes further and seeks to compare and analyze the use of ChatGPT and DeepSeek, which can be considered as representatives of open AI, in the study of Chinese poetry. To this end, we will compare the Chinese poetry creations of AI ChatGPT and DeepSeek, conduct a comparative study on the analysis of Chinese poetry works, and explore ways to use AI and future changes in Chinese poetry research.

title_ko: 중국어 교육의 생성형 AI 활용 효과와 방안 연구
title_en: Effects and Proposals of Using Generative AI in Chinese Education
kw_en: Generative AI; Language Education; Chinese Dialog
abstract_ko: In education, Generative AI is being used as a way to increase competencies along with subject matter knowledge. As AI is being used in education, the potential for personalization and active education is being studied, and it is necessary to study the application and effectiveness of Generative AI in education as it develops in the fields of assisting, collaborating, and coaching. It is expected that Generative AI will be used in education not only as an educational content creation tool, but also as a tutor and assistant in a role-split interaction. Therefore, in the Chinese language class, we will look at the steps to utilize Generative AI after basic Chinese language acquisition as creating 'conversation scenarios' and creating interactive video content. A survey was conducted before the use of Generative AI, after the role-divided interaction, and after the educational content creation tool, and the results showed significant positive effects on class participation, interest, satisfaction, and motivation. Of these, interest and satisfaction had the highest effects. “Role-splitting interaction” had a higher effect on engagement and satisfaction, and ‘educational content creation tools’ had a higher effect on interest. The overall competency effect of using Generative AI was on communication and critical thinking, and the effect of role-splitting interaction was on content, critical thinking, creative innovation, and self-confidence compared to educational content creation tools, which showed an overall increase in self-confidence. Training should extend experience from knowledge transfer to validate knowledge and increase flexibility and the ability to utilize vast amounts of knowledge under different conditions.

title_ko: 챗GPT_PBL 기반 한문법 교수학습 사례 연구 － 계륵 고사성어를 중심으로 －
title_en: A Case Study on Hanmun Grammar Instruction Using ChatGPT-PBL － Focusing on the Gyerik Idiom －
kw_ko: 한문법 교육; 계륵; 생성형 인공지능(챗GPT); 문제중심학습(PBL); 메타인지적 학습; 디지털 인문교육
kw_en: 汉文语法教学; 鸡肋(典故; 生成式人工智能(ChatGPT); 问题导向学习(Problem-Based Learning; PBL); 元认知学习; 数字人文教育; Classical Chinese Grammar Education; Gyerik; Generative Artificial Intelligence (ChatGPT); Problem-Based Learning (PBL); Metacognitive Learning; Digital Humanities Education
abstract_ko: 이 논문은 생성형 인공지능(챗GPT)과 문제중심학습(PBL)을 융합한 한문법 수업을 설계하고, 그 교육적 효과를 분석한 사례 기반 연구이다. 수업은 총 3차시로 구성되었으며, 각 차시에서 학습자들은 ‘계륵’의 출처와 의미, 어휘 구성, 문장 구조 등을 중심으로 챗GPT에게 질문하고, 그 응답의 타당성을 비판적으로 분석하는 활동을 수행하였다. ‘之’의 문법적 기능, 주술⋅목적 구조, 어순 등 한문법의 핵심 요소를 실천적으로 분석함으로써, 학습자의 문법 적용 능력 향상을 도모하였다. 챗GPT의 응답에 대한 조별 토론과 발표 활동을 통해 학습자들은 협업 속에서 문법 개념을 구체화하고, 고전 텍스트를 현대적으로 재해석하는 과정을 경험하였다. 수업 활동 중에는 챗GPT 응답의 오류, 정보 왜곡, 정답 맹신 등 생성형 AI 기반 수업의 잠재적 리스크도 확인되었다. 이에 교수자는 ‘응답 검토 과제’와 ‘정답 근거 제시 활동’ 등 메타인지적 학습 전략을 도입하여, 학습자의 비판적 사고력과 정보 검증 능력을 강화하고자 하였다. 나아가 학습자들은 단순한 AI 활용을 넘어, 고전 문장의 맥락과 의미를 주체적으로 탐색하고 구성함으로써, 언어적 사고와 인문학적 통찰을 함께 심화하는 성과를 보였다. 결론적으로 본 연구는 한문법이라는 특정 교과 영역에서 생성형 AI를 교육적으로 활용한 실천적 시도로, AI 시대의 한문법 수업 모델을 제시하였다는 점에서 디지털 인문교육의 가능성을 확장하는 학술적 의의를 지닌다.
abstract_en: This study is a case-based research project that designs a Classical Chinese grammar lesson by integrating generative artificial intelligence (ChatGPT) with problem-based learning (PBL), and analyzes its educational effectiveness. The course was structured into three sessions, during which learners engaged in activities that involved questioning ChatGPT about the origin, meaning, vocabulary, and sentence structure of the idiom “Gyerik” (chicken rib), then critically analyzing the validity of its responses. Key grammatical elements such as the function of 之, subject-object structures, and classical word order were explored in practice to enhance learners’ ability to apply grammatical knowledge. During the course, potential risks of AI-assisted learning were identified, including hallucinations in ChatGPT’s responses, factual inaccuracies, and learners’ tendency to uncritically accept AI-generated outputs. To address these issues, the instructor implemented metacognitive learning strategies such as “response verification tasks” and “evidence-based justification activities” to foster critical thinking and information literacy. In conclusion, this study presents a practical model for incorporating generative AI into Classical Chinese grammar education, and demonstrates the potential of AI-assisted instruction to innovate digital humanities education in the age of artificial intelligence.

title_ko: 생성형 AI를 활용한 중국어 변형 구조 문장의 생성 연구
title_en: A study on the generation of transformed Chinese sentences using generative AI
kw_ko: 중국어 쓰기 교육; 생성형 AI 활용 쓰기 교육; 중국어 변형 구조
kw_en: Chinese writing education; writing education utilizing generative AI; Chinese transformed structures; 漢語寫作敎育; 生成式人工知能寫作敎育; 漢語變形結構
abstract_ko: This study examined how 16 Chinese transformational structures are generated using generative AI from the perspective of learners whose native language is Korean. To summarize: (1) In weak AI models, using the zero-shot input method, Baidu generated 13 transformed Chinese Sentences, and Papago generated 11 transformed Chinese Sentences. (2) In strong AI models, using the prompt input method, WRTN generated 12 transformed Chinese Sentences, and Yuanbao generated 11 transformed Chinese Sentences. The possible reason why weak AI showed better results than strong AI may be because the analysis target was simple sentences. Baidu and Papago AI are programs specialized in translation. Therefore, under the same conditions as the experiment, it can posited that weak AI is more specialized than strong AI. Thus, it may be sufficient to utilize weak AI in current Chinese writing education. Nevertheless, for this research be applicable to Chinese writing education, the following additional analyses are necessary: (1) This study targeted ‘simple sentences.’ If applied to ‘complex sentence’ writing education, an analysis of whether weak AI remains useful is necessary. (2) An analysis of how to conduct education using Artificial Intelligence is required.

title_ko: 생성형 AI를 활용한 한문 어휘 학습의 교육적 가능성 탐색: <계륵>을 중심으로
title_en: Exploring the Educational Possibilities of Chinese Vocabulary Learning Using Generative AI: Focusing on ‘Gyereuk’
kw_ko: 생성형 인공지능; 한문 어휘 학습; 고사성어 계륵; PBL 수업 설계; 창의융합역량
kw_en: Generative AI; Classical Chinese Vocabulary; Idiom “Gyeruk”; PBL-Based Instruction; Creative-Convergent Competency
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 고사성어 <계륵(鷄肋)>을 중심 주제로 하여, 생성형 인공지능(Generative AI) 기반 도구들이 한문 어휘 학습에 어떻게 활용될 수 있는지를 탐색하였다. Wrtn, ChatGPT, HIX Chat 등 다양한 AI 도구의 응답 구조, 문맥 해석력, 학습자 중심 설명 방식 등을 비교 분석하였고, 이를 실제 대학 교양 수업에 적용하여 교육적 가능성과 한계를 검토하였다. 분석 결과, 생성형 AI는 단순한 정보 제공을 넘어 학습자의 질문 생성과 창의적 사고 확장에 유의미한 기여를 하는 것으로 나타났다. 특히 Wrtn은 직관적인 설명과 출처 제시에서 초급 학습자에게 유용했으며, ChatGPT는 고전 문맥에 대한 깊이 있는 이해와 응답 구성의 완성도 측면에서 중·고급 학습자에게 더 적합하다는 평가를 받았다. 전체 참여자 55명 중 54명이 팀 프로젝트에 ChatGPT를 활용한 점은, 학습자 중심 수업 환경에서의 높은 선호도와 실질적 효용을 반영한다. 본 연구는 이와 같은 결과를 바탕으로 ‘탐색–해석–창작’의 통합적 사고 과정을 중심으로 한 형성평가 체계와 수업 설계 모델을 제안하며, 향후 디지털 인문학 및 융합 교육 콘텐츠 개발을 위한 기초 자료를 제공하고자 한다.
abstract_en: This study investigates how generative AI-based tools can be utilized for classical Chinese vocabulary learning, using the idiom Gyeruk as the focal theme. By comparing the response structures, contextual interpretation capabilities, and learner-centered explanatory styles of various AI platforms—Wrtn, ChatGPT, and HIX Chat—the research examines their educational potential and limitations. Applied to an actual liberal arts course at a university, the findings show that generative AI contributes not only to information delivery but also significantly supports question generation and the expansion of creative thinking in learners. Wrtn demonstrated strengths in intuitive explanations and source citation, which were particularly helpful for beginning learners. ChatGPT was evaluated highly for its comprehensive understanding of classical contexts and structured response composition, making it more suitable for intermediate and advanced learners. Notably, 54 out of 55 students used ChatGPT for their team projects, indicating a strong learner preference and perceived effectiveness in student-centered learning environments. Based on these insights, the study proposes a formative assessment framework and instructional design model structured around the integrated cognitive process of exploration, interpretation, and creative convergence. These results provide foundational implications for future research and instructional practices in digital humanities and interdisciplinary educational content development.

title_ko: 生成式 AI 对汉语高频关联词的使用及搭配研究
title_en: Generative AI's Use of High-Frequency Conjunctions and Implications for International Chinese Education
authors: 李朋(浙江传媒学院 文学院); 贾改琴(浙江传媒学院 文学院)
kw_ko: AI 말뭉치; 고빈도 접속사; 접속사 결합; 국제 중국어 교육
kw_en: AI corpus; high-frequency connective words; connective word collocations; International Chinese Language Education
abstract_ko: 디지털 지능화 시대의 도래와 함께, 중국어 비원어민 학습자들이AI를 활용하여 중국어 학습을 보조하는 사례가 점차 보편화되고 있다. 이에 본 연구는, 기존 연구 성과를 바탕으로 26개의 고빈도 접속사를연구 대상으로 선정하여, 생성형 AI에서의 사용 양상을 분석함으로써AI가 생성한 언어가 중국어 자연어의 표현 논리와 사용 습관에 부합하는지 고찰하였다. 생성형 AI 플랫폼 ‘문심일언(文心一言)’을 주요 분석 대상으로 삼아, 이와의 대화를 통해 생성된 응답 텍스트를 추출하여 10만 자가 넘는 AI 말뭉치 데이터베이스를 구축하였다. 온라인 중국어 형태소 분석 도구인 ‘Kalvin’을 이용해 AI 말뭉치에 대해 단어 분리 작업을 한 뒤, 고빈도 접속사 26개를 대상으로 주석 처리를 했다. 이어서 AntConc 프로그램을 활용하여 해당 접속사들의 사용 빈도와 결합 양상을 분석 하였다. 분석 결과에 따르면, AI 말뭉치에서는 ‘但(하지만)’, ‘或者(또는)’, ‘而(그리고/반면에)’, ‘如果(만약)’ 등의 핵심 접속사의 사용 빈도가 가장 높았으며, ‘虽然(비록)……但(하지만)……’, ‘或者……或者……’ 등의 전형적 결합 패턴 또한 중국어의 논리 구조에 부합하는 것으로 나타났다. 비록 일부 접속사(예: ‘要不’는 전혀 나타나지 않았고, ‘万一’는 출현 빈도가 낮았다)의 사용은 제한적이었으며, ‘因为……所以… …’와 같은 일부 고정 표현은 기대만큼 보편적으로 사용되지 않았다. 그러나 생성된 문장은 전반적으로 접속사 사용 측면에서 중국어의 논리 구조와 표현 습관을 효과적으로 모사하고 있었다. 이러한 분석 결과는 ‘문심일언’과 같은 AI 플랫폼이 생성한 언어 텍스트는 전반적으로 중국어의 표현 논리와 사용 습관에 부합함을 보여준다. 또한 AI의 상호작용형 대화 기능을 활용한 중국어 접속사 연습은 실제 언어의 맥락을 일정 수준까지 재현할 수 있음을 시사한다. 대규모 언어 모델을 효과적으로 활용한 AI 보조 학습은 중국어 습득 효율성을 제고하는 유망한 방안 중 하나로 평가된다.
abstract_en: With the advent of the digital intelligence era, the use of AI to assist Chinese language learning among non-native speakers has become increasingly prevalent. Building on existing research, this study selects 26 high-frequency conjunctions as research subjects to analyze their usage in generative AI, aiming to evaluate whether AI-generated language aligns with the logical structures and expressive conventions of natural Chinese. Focusing on the generative AI platform “ERNIE Bot (Wenxin Yiyan)”, the study extracts AI-generated responses through interactive dialogues to construct a corpus of AI-generated texts. This corpus is then analyzed for the frequency and collocation patterns of the 26 high-frequency conjunctions. Results indicate that core conjunctions such as “dan (但)”, “huozhe (或 者)”, “er (而)”, and “ruguo(如果)” exhibit the highest frequency in AI-generated texts. Common collocations like “suiran (虽然) …… dan (但) ……” and “huozhe (或者) ……huozhe (或者)……” also conform to Chinese logical structures. While some conjunctions appear less frequently and fixed collocations are not as prevalent as anticipated, the overall usage of conjunctions in AI-generated sentences effectively simulates Chinese logical and expressive norms. The findings suggest that language texts generated by AI platforms like ERNIE Bot largely adhere to Chinese logical and conventional expressions. Utilizing AI interactive dialogue functions for practicing Chinese conjunctions can partially replicate authentic contextual effects. Effectively leveraging large language models for AI-assisted learning represents a viable pathway to enhance efficiency in Chinese language acquisition.

title_ko: 중국어 교육을 위한 프롬프트 기법 탐색 ― 계층적 프롬프트를 중심으로
title_en: Exploring Prompting Techniques for Chinese Language Education : Focusing on Hierarchical Prompting
kw_en: Chinese Language Education; Prompting Techniques; Large Language Models; AI in Education; Prompt Literacy; Hierarchical Prompting
abstract_ko: This study looked through effective prompting techniques for Chinese language education using Large Language Models. Since ChatGPT's emergence in 2022, LLMs have developed rapidly, with educational models enhancing its education capabilities. Effective application requires prompting strategies that consider Chinese language's unique characteristics. Through literature review and case analysis, this research examines the development of prompt engineering and explores prompt techniques suitable for Chinese language education. The findings indicate that reasoning techniques align with Chinese language's progressive learning structure. Structured frameworks provide systematic prompt design approaches. Hierarchical prompting suits graduated difficulty levels, and specialized techniques enhance instructional clarity. Specifically, least-to-most prompting is effective for pronunciation and vocabulary learning, role prompting for conversation practice, and chain-of-verification prompting for writing instruction.

title_ko: N-gram을 활용한 특수목적중국어의 어휘다발 연구: AI-Hub 학습용 데이터를 중심으로
title_en: A Study on the Lexical Bundle of CSP Using N-gram: Focusing on AI-Hub Learning Data
kw_ko: 특수목적중국어; 어휘다발; 관광중국어
kw_en: AI-Hub; N-gram; Chinese for Specific Puposes(CSP); Lexical Bundles; Travel Chinese
abstract_ko: In this study, as the demand for tourism increases in Korea-China relations, the need for tourism vocabulary learning is increasing when using apps and machine translation. Therefore, in order to construct basic data necessary for learning tourism Chinese vocabulary, the type of N-gram vocabulary was analyzed based on a native Chinese corpus on the AI-Hub platform. As a result of the analysis, in the 2-gram, many high-frequency vocabulary bundles similar to the types appearing in general-purpose Chinese learning contents appeared. The characteristic of the 3-gram vocabulary bundle is that adverbs occupy a large proportion in the tourist Chinese vocabulary list. The characteristic of the 4-gram vocabulary bundle is that it can be used as an independent expression as a lot of professional vocabulary appears and syllables grow. Next, tourism Chinese vocabulary was categorized, classified into verb phrases and noun phrases, and analyzed through frequency of use and example sentences. The verb phrase is a type of 'pronoun + auxiliary verb + verb', and includes 我 想 去, 我 想 买, and 你 能 告诉. In addition, auxiliary verb 能 often appears in dialogues. The noun phrase was categorized into 'investigation + noun' and 'association + noun', and the biggest feature is that vocabulary bundles that include professional vocabulary 飞机, 着陆, 登机, 航班, and 预 settings appear frequently in 4-gram.

title_ko: 生成式語言模型在韓國中文敎學中應用與影響 ― 以ChatGPT與DeepSeek為例
title_en: Application and influence of generative language model in Korean Chinese teaching : Take ChatGPT and DeepSeek as examples
kw_en: Generative Artificial Intelligence; Chinese Language Education; Chinese Learning in Korea; Comprehensible Input; Constructivism learning theory; Absorb understandable language; Changes in Teacher Roles; Autonomous Learning
abstract_ko: With the rapid development of generative language models such as ChatGPT and DeepSeek, international Chinese language education is facing new opportunities and transformations. Based on the theories of Comprehensible Input and Constructivist Learning, this paper explores the current applications and impacts of generative AI tools in Chinese language education in South Korea, with a specific focus on their roles in supporting learners, teachers, and classroom activities. A review of relevant research by Chinese and Korean scholars reveals that Chinese scholars mainly emphasize the macro-level changes brought by ChatGPT to international Chinese education, while Korean scholars, grounded in frontline teaching practices, highlight the value of AI tools in providing personalized feedback, enhancing situational authenticity, and improving language skills. Through case analysis, the paper further illustrates how ChatGPT and DeepSeek offer large amounts of comprehensible input materials—such as pronunciation demonstrations, grammar correction, and contextual dialogue generation—to meet students' individualized needs and strengthen their autonomous learning abilities. Meanwhile, the role of teachers has shifted from knowledge transmitters to guides, supervisors, and motivators, requiring them to balance the acquisition of declarative knowledge via AI tools with the cultivation of procedural knowledge through classroom practice. Moreover, the adaptability of AI tools in non-target language environments enhances the authenticity of conversational contexts, alleviates learning anxiety, and stimulates learners' motivation. By analyzing specific teaching examples, the paper discusses strategies and considerations for optimizing instructional design, enriching content, and improving classroom interaction through AI integration. Overall, AI-assisted Chinese education not only increases teaching efficiency but also raises higher demands for teachers' professional competencies. This study aims to provide references and insights for the practice of Chinese language education in Korea.

title_ko: AI 활용 新HSK6급 쓰기 교육을 위한 프롬프트 설계 一考
title_en: Prompt Design for AI-Assisted Writing Instruction for the New HSK Level 6 ― An Exploratory Study
kw_ko: 新HSK6급; 쓰기; 작문; 중국어 쓰기; 중국어 작문; 프롬프트
kw_en: AI; New HSK Level 6; Chinese; Chinese Writing; Chinese Writing with AI; prompt
abstract_ko: 본고는 기존 新HSK6급 쓰기 학습과 교수법의 한계를 보완하고 학습 효율을 제고하기 위해 선행연구를 바탕으로 新HSK6급 쓰기 능력을 향상을 위한 교수 방안과 AI 활용 프롬프트 설계를 모색한다. 먼저 新HSK6급 쓰기에 대한 유형과 특징에 대해 살펴보고 크게 읽기, 쓰기, 평가 세 영역으로 나누어 AI가 학습 보조 도구로서 중국어 쓰기에서 교수자와 학습자의 부담을 경감하고 작문 능력 향상에 실질적인 기여를 할 수 있는지에 대한 분석을 진행한다. 분석 결과를 토대로 실제 수업 적용을 위한 프롬프트 예시와 절차를 제시한다.
abstract_en: This study recognized the problems of traditional teaching methods in Chinese writing education and proposed the necessity of AI-powered personalized learning. In particular, it suggested AI prompt-based teaching and learning methods to overcome the limitations of New HSK Level 6 writing education and improve learning efficiency. The research results are summarized as follows: First, New HSK Level 6 writing was confirmed to be a complex task that comprehensively evaluates reading comprehension, memory, summarization, and writing skills, requiring students to read and memorize a 1,000-character passage for 10 minutes, then summarize it in approximately 400 characters within 35 minutes. Second, it was found that New HSK Level 6 writing question types can be categorized into event-centered, character-centered, and fable/classical allusion types, with each type requiring differentiated approach strategies. Third, this study proposed AI-integrated teaching methods by designing specific prompts for reading, writing, and evaluation domains. In the reading domain, prompts were presented for understanding the overall plot, key elements, and narrative structure. In the writing domain, detailed prompts were designed for grammar correction, sentence improvement, and paragraph optimization. In the evaluation domain, prompts reflecting comprehensive criteria including content relevance, logical coherence, grammatical accuracy, and format compliance were proposed.

title_ko: 국제 중국어 교육의 인공지능 활용 현황과 전망
title_en: Application Status and Prospect of Artificial Intelligence in International Chinese Language Education
authors: 范慧琴(中国传媒大学); 邬宇航(中国传媒大学); 运涵(中国传媒大学); 오현주(영남대학교 중국언어문화학과)
kw_ko: 국제 중국어 교육; 인공지능; 중국어 학습 앱; 지능형 교육 시스템
kw_en: International Chinese language education; Artificial intelligence; Chinese language learning app; Intelligent education system
abstract_ko: Under the backdrop of the Fourth Industrial Revolution and the era of digital transformation, this study presents the possibility and necessity of integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into international Chinese language education for foreigners. It analyzes the current utilization of AI in international Chinese education and proposes directions for improvement to build a future-oriented intelligent education system. AI can promote the intelligent development of international Chinese education by providing technical support for personalized learning. In this study, we investigated and analyzed 148 Chinese learning applications that currently support international Chinese education. The results indicate that the overall intelligence level of these applications is relatively low, revealing a need for improvement in the depth of AI technology application, integration, and usability. Therefore, in the new educational environment of international Chinese education, it is necessary to comprehensively strengthen the capacity for AI integration and to establish a future-oriented smart education system.
abstract_en: Under the backdrop of the Fourth Industrial Revolution and the era of digital transformation, this study presents the possibility and necessity of integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into international Chinese language education for foreigners. It analyzes the current utilization of AI in international Chinese education and proposes directions for improvement to build a future-oriented intelligent education system. AI can promote the intelligent development of international Chinese education by providing technical support for personalized learning. In this study, we investigated and analyzed 148 Chinese learning applications that currently support international Chinese education. The results indicate that the overall intelligence level of these applications is relatively low, revealing a need for improvement in the depth of AI technology application, integration, and usability. Therefore, in the new educational environment of international Chinese education, it is necessary to comprehensively strengthen the capacity for AI integration and to establish a future-oriented smart education system.
note: 중국어 학습앱 148종 AI 활용 현황 조사

title_ko: 멀티모달 AI를 활용한 《당시삼백수》 학습과 교학
title_en: Multimodal AI-Assisted Learning and Teaching Approaches to the Three Hundred Tang Poems
kw_ko: 인공지능; 멀티모달; 챗GPT-5; 중국시 학습; 중국시 교학; 당시삼백수
kw_en: Atificial Intelligence; Multimodal; Chat GPT-5; Chinese Poetry learning; Chinese Poetry Teaching; Three Hundred Tang Poems
abstract_ko: The emergence of the Fourth Industrial Revolution has accelerated the integration of cutting-edge IT technologies into diverse fields, thereby shaping a more interconnected and intelligent society. Among these innovations, Artificial Intelligence(AI) has rapidly advanced into mainstream application, evoking comparisons with the flourishing schools of thought during the Warring States period. Within this context, the potential role of AI in the humanities-particularly in literary research and pedagogy—has garnered increasing attention. This paper continues the author’s line of inquiry into how AI can contribute to the study and instruction of classical Chinese poetry. It takes Three Hundred Tang Poems, one of the most widely circulated and representative anthologies of Tang poetry, as its central text. While traditional scholarship has primarily emphasized philological and textual approaches, this study explores new methodologies by leveraging the multimodal affordances of AI. The research is divided into two sections. The first focuses on learning applications, in which ChatGPT-5 is employed to analyze the anthology and generate visualizations such as statistical charts and word clouds. The second addresses teaching applications, examining how AI can be integrated into instructional contexts-for example, by offering poetic feedback and employing images or videos to enhance student engagement. In doing so, this study aims to demonstrate the potential of AI not only as an analytical tool but also as a pedagogical partner in the field of Chinese classical poetry.“
